Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Senior Strategist 

21GRAMS | Strategy | London 

Job Summary 

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Strategist to join the growing 21GRAMS Strategy team in London. This is an opportunity to support high-profile global accounts within one of healthcare advertising’s most creative agencies, working alongside award-winning creative, strategy and client teams. 

You will combine strong research and analytical foundations with creative strategic thinking. You will explore markets, audiences and competitors, turn insights into clear strategic recommendations, and help shape work that resonates with clients and their audiences. The role will mainly support senior strategists while offering strong scope to learn, collaborate internationally and progress as the team continues to grow. 

What you’ll do 

  • Conduct primary and desk research to build a clear understanding of markets, sectors, audiences and behaviours. 
  • Develop consumer and stakeholder insights that help shape creative and brand strategy. 
  • Carry out category and competitor analysis, identifying the most relevant opportunities and challenges. 
  • Support senior strategy colleagues across global account work, strategic projects and client deliverables. 
  • Contribute to creative briefs, strategic narratives and presentations, making complex findings clear and engaging. 
  • Work closely with Creative, Client Services, Medical Education and wider cross-functional teams. 
  • Support new business pitches through research, insight development and strategic thinking. 
  • Present thinking confidently to internal teams and, as experience grows, to clients. 
  • Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving agency environment. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if 

  • You are curious, creative and commercially aware, with a genuine interest in understanding people and what drives them. 
  • You are a clear and engaging communicator who enjoys presenting ideas and contributing to discussion. 
  • You bring positive energy, ambition and a desire to develop within strategy. 
  • You can balance detailed research with the ability to step back, identify the key insight and tell a compelling story. 
  • You are collaborative, proactive and comfortable working across different disciplines and with colleagues in other markets. 
  • You are adaptable, organised and able to deliver high-quality work against deadlines. 
  • Our Company values - Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” - really speak to you. 

What you should have 

  • Approximately 3-5 years of strategy, planning, research or insight experience within an agency environment. 
  • Experience in healthcare advertising is welcome, but candidates from traditional consumer or AOR advertising agencies who are interested in moving into healthcare will also be considered. 
  • A strong foundation in market research, desk research, audience insight and competitor or category analysis. 
  • Experience working across more than one client, category, sector or therapy area. 
  • An understanding of how agency teams operate, including fast-paced delivery and changing priorities. 
  • Experience supporting new business pitches is useful but not essential. 
  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to distil information into clear, persuasive recommendations. 
  • A collaborative mindset and the potential to grow into greater strategic ownership over time.

job.description:
Promotion/Social Media Specialist - KS95

#26-1339

Minneapolis/St. Paul, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

KSTP-FM

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard Radio-Twin Cities is a full-service media company with legendary radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions. We serve the Greater Minneapolis-Saint Paul community and offer a menu of marketing services including radio, full-service digital, influencer marketing, creative services, custom content, podcasts and events. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

The Promotions Coordinator/Social Media Strategist serves as the primary liaison for contest winners, manages prize fulfillment, coordinates station events, and works closely with programming, sales, and promotional partners to ensure flawless execution of station campaigns and experiences. The role also provides support for the station's digital and social media strategy by analyzing audience engagement, evaluating campaign performance, identifying opportunities for growth, and helping shape content strategies that strengthen listener connection and brand impact.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-service focused, and thrives in a fast-paced environment with multiple deadlines and moving pieces.

Job Responsibilities

Contest & Promotion Management

Coordinate and execute all on-air and online contests and giveaways.

Manage winner selection, verification, paperwork collection, and prize fulfillment.

Process contest-related documentation, including tax forms and check requests.

Track winner paperwork and ensure compliance with station, legal, and accounting requirements.

Maintain accurate records of prize inventory and distribution.

Monitor and respond to promotions email and phone lines.

Event Coordination

Execute station events, appearances, and promotional activations.

Coordinate event staffing, logistics, and communication with sales, talent, and street team.

Create event materials, schedules, and briefing sheets.

Maintain event supplies, promotional inventory, and station vehicles.

Attend and support station events, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

Digital Marketing & Social Media Strategy

Create a station social media strategy for KS95. Provide actionable recommendations to enhance station/brand content performance, audience growth, engagement, and campaign effectiveness.

Assist with content planning and social media calendars, ensuring consistent and strategic messaging across platforms.

Coach and direct the team on best practices in social media posting by platforms.

Analyze social media, digital marketing, and audience engagement performance to identify trends, successes, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Help execute sponsor and client deliverables across social media platforms.

Assist in promoting station events, contests, and community initiatives.

Stay informed on emerging social media trends across platform changes, algorithm updates, digital marketing best practices, and new advertising opportunities across TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Event Management, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.

Strong understanding of major social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging digital channels.

Experience using analytics and reporting tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Google Ads, or similar platforms.

Ability to analyze audience, social media, and promotional campaign data; identify what is driving engagement and results; and make strategic recommendations for future content, campaigns, and marketing initiatives.

Strong organizational and project management skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.

Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and Holidays.

Preferred

Experience in radio, media, entertainment, promotions, marketing, or event coordination.

Familiarity with WordPress, VPromo, Asana, Audience, and Canva

Experience with contesting, prize fulfillment, and event logistics.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

The hourly rate of pay for this position is $24.04 per hour.

For information regarding our benefits, please copy the link below and paste in your browser: https://hubbardbroadcasting.com/our-company/working-here/

EEO Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability/vets.

Diversity Statement

Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. We know the best way to accomplish this is by recruiting and retaining top talent from diverse cultures, life experiences, and world views. With dignity and respect, we value YOU and everything that makes YOU uniquely YOU.

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The Account Manager supports Account Executives’ sales efforts by taking ownership of fulfillment in such a way that the AE can play their role of being client-facing, creating opportunities and closing revenue. The Account Manager manages the day-to-day responsibilities of accounts to ensure proper implementation of their solutions. The Account Manager influences and drives sales by providing superior customer service and support across Broadcast Television and Digital, aiming at retaining clients and growing business. This  job reports to Sales Manager. 

 

Responsibilities:

  • Provide support to assigned Account Executives on post-sale activity including campaign implementation, maintenance, and review.
  • Daily interaction with existing advertising agencies and direct clients; this responsibility includes maintenance of client schedules on television and digital in addition to implementation of special projects and promotions.
  • Works in tandem with Account Executives, Marketing Director, Research Director, and Creative Services to support client needs.
  • Attend sales meetings and sales trainings to gain sales, product and process information and keep abreast of company products and services to articulate to client, when appropriate.
  • Partner with designated Account Executives in identifying new/incremental revenue based on campaign results.
  • Assist designated Account Executives with maintenance of contracts, generating avails, traffic, make-goods, collection and overall customer service.
  • Regular tracking of clients’ audience delivery using ratings, impressions, clients KPIs, and campaign fulfillment.
  • Coordinate with team to set up new customer accounts, contracts, order entry and revisions.

 

Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of account management in a professional, fast-paced media sales environment.
  • Track record of successfully retaining and growing clients.
  • Knowledge of marketing solutions including broadcasting and digital advertising is preferred.
  • Knowledge of Google Analytics and advertising solutions is highly desirable.
  • Prior experience using CRM systems and MS Office suite.
  • Able to make decisions and solve problems independently to support customer needs.
  • Self-motivation and willingness to work as a team player are essential attributes.
  • Demonstrate ability to be creative, flexible, and able to adapt to change with evolving priorities.
  • Creative with ability to work effectively as part of a team and independently.
  • Detail oriented with ability to handle and prioritize multiple tasks to meet deadlines.
  • Position requires strong written and verbal communication skills, as well as strong organization and time management skills.

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WFMY-TV Greensboro in CBS is looking for a dynamic and engaging Meteorologist to join our passionate team. This position is responsible for preparing and delivering accurate weather reports on-air and online in a conversational manner. The key responsibility is the ability to gather and analyze information and alert our audiences about what’s going to happen with weather in their community. We are looking for a team player who can help with every aspect of meteorology, from forecasting, to preparing graphics, to reporting in the field, you will be an integral part of severe weather coverage, and reaching our consumers not only on TV, but online and on social media. The ideal candidate embraces new technology and is willing to explore new ways to present the weather story. As a central member of the WX department, the ideal candidate is a team player who participates in brainstorming and planning for future shows, including important weather events and explainers.  

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities: 

  • Provide accurate and compelling weather forecasts in a multi-platform environment
  • Prepare and deliver severe weather updates, interrupting regular programming as necessary.
  • Produce clean, creative and informative graphics to tell the weather story
  • Fill in on other shifts when necessary.
  • Write and report from the field or inside the newsroom
  • Update website and interact with viewers on social media platforms daily
  • Perform special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Make public appearances

Requirements: 

  • BA/BS degree in Meteorology, Geoscience or Atmospheric Science.
  • 1-3 YEARS on-air meteorology experience required
  • Be proficient at posting content to various websites and social media; computer literacy required, including weather and newsroom computer systems

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

job.title: Fellow, Opinion Video
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Join the 2027 New York Times Fellowship class as an editor of video commentary in the Opinion section in New York.

As a vertical video editor, you will create videos for nytimes.com and social media. While editing is at the core of this position, you will be equal parts producer, writer and editor. This opportunity will allow you to conceive of new video formats for mobile-first journalism.

You will exercise journalistic and creative judgment to ensure excellence and accuracy in your work, and you should be eager to experiment with different forms of storytelling. You might be hosting a video one day and the next day be deep in an edit or rewrite of a script. You will collaborate with the Opinion Audience team, as well as department journalists and external contributors.

The Opinion department is separate from the newsroom. This is an in-office position and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance. You may be required to work some nights, weekends and holidays as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Produce, write and edit vertical videos
  • Act as a host in some videos to help translate our journalism for off-site audiences
  • Write engaging, SEO-driven social captions
  • Post videos to our site and platforms such as TikTok and YouTube
  • Collaborate with other journalists and editors to adapt, script and edit videos
  • Work with editors on inventive on-site and social formats that align with Opinion’s mission and identity
  • Participate in training and social programs designed for the fellowship
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

Basic Qualifications:

  • No more than five years of full-time, professional journalism experience, excluding internships
  • 3+ years of experience with creative video editing, with demonstrated success in the creation of innovative journalism in a fast-paced environment
  • Can produce and publish short-form vertical videos on tight deadlines
  • Experience in video and graphics editing with Adobe Premiere and AfterEffects
  • Experience in archive producing, including using photo, video, graphics and audio

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Record of multiple journalism internships, or equivalent experience
  • Can appear and speak on camera as a host
  • Deep knowledge of TikTok and Instagram, and broad knowledge of the social media landscape and awareness of platform trends as they change

To apply, upload a résumé and cover letter. You should also include a link to a portfolio of your work. The application will prompt you when to upload materials and ask you for the link to your portfolio. Applications that fail to include any of these materials or follow these instructions will not be considered.

You must be authorized to work in the United States. We will not sponsor work visas for the fellowship, but we will consider applicants with valid work authorization or a valid student visa that can be extended with Optional Practical Training.

You may apply to only one fellowship position per year. For instance, if you apply as a shows editor in Opinion, you should not apply for any other positions in the fellowship. Duplicate applications will be discarded.

The application deadline is 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on Nov. 20. 

The Times Fellowship generates a high level of interest, so we cannot acknowledge the status of applications upon receipt or during the vetting process, which can take eight weeks or more. We cannot accept applications that are mailed or emailed to us. We will contact you for interviews as needed.

The fellowship program will begin on or about June 7, 2027, and end on May 26, 2028, subject to satisfactory performance. There is no guarantee of a full-time position upon completion of the program.

For more information about the Times Fellowship, visit here.

 

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of New York.

REQ-020780

 

Additional Compensation and Benefits:

For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process.

The annual base pay range for this role is between:$82,414.80—$82,414.80 USD

Candidate Use of GenAI Tools:

We’re excited to learn more about you and your experience. To keep our hiring process as fair and authentic as possible, we ask that you submit your own work and not use GenAI tools to generate substantive content during the application and interview process.

If you’re an engineering candidate, we’ll let you know what specific GenAI tools you are permitted to use for your technical assessment.

 

The New York Times Company is committed to being the world’s best source of independent, reliable and quality journalism. To do so, we embrace a diverse workforce that has a broad range of backgrounds and experiences across our ranks, at all levels of the organization. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of an individual's sex, age, race, color, creed, national origin, alienage, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation or affectional preference, gender identity and expression, disability, genetic trait or predisposition, carrier status, citizenship, veteran or military status and other personal characteristics protected by law. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. The U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC)’s Know Your Rights Poster is available here. 

The New York Times Company will provide reasonable accommodations as required by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. Individuals seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process should email reasonable.accommodations@nytimes.com. Emails sent for unrelated issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.

For information about The New York Times' privacy practices for job applicants, click here.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings. Scammers may post fraudulent job opportunities, and they may even make fraudulent employment offers. This is done by bad actors to collect personal information and money from victims. All legitimate job opportunities from The New York Times will be accessible through The New York Times careers site. The New York Times will not ask job applicants for financial information or for payment, and will not refer you to a third party to do so. You should never send money to anyone who suggests they can provide employment with The New York Times.

If you see a fake or fraudulent job posting, or if you suspect you have received a fraudulent offer, you can report it to The New York Times at NYTapplicants@nytimes.com. You can also file a report with the Federal Trade Commission or your state attorney general.

job.title: Associate Director, Omnichannel & Media Strategy
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is a fully integrated media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization that helps healthcare brands create meaningful, measurable connections with their audiences. The Omnichannel Strategy team sits at the center of this ecosystem, partnering closely with Media, Analytics, CRM, Engagement, Creative, Technology, and Client Services teams to design customer-centric experiences that align business objectives, audience needs, and channel activation. Our strategists help clients move beyond channel planning to deliver coordinated engagement across the full customer journey. 

The Associate Director, Omnichannel & Media Strategy will lead the development of omnichannel engagement strategies for assigned brands, products, and business challenges, grounded in a strong understanding of media strategy and how paid media connects across the broader customer experience. This role translates audience insights, customer needs, media behaviors, market dynamics, and business objectives into actionable journey architectures, media and channel strategies, and engagement plans that drive measurable outcomes.   As a strategic leader, you will guide audience segmentation, customer journey development, media and channel planning, engagement strategy, and orchestration design while serving as a trusted strategic partner to clients and internal teams. You will collaborate across Media, Analytics, CRM, Creative, Engagement, and Client Services to create integrated experiences that connect customer needs with business goals.

What you’ll do 

  • Architect omnichannel engagement strategies with media strategy at the core, connecting paid media with owned, earned, CRM, field, and digital channels.
  • Lead audience segmentation, persona development and customer prioritization across healthcare professional, patient, caregiver and other relevant audiences. 
  • Design end-to-end customer journeys that identify audience needs, barriers, behaviors, triggers and engagement opportunities. 
  • Develop media and channel orchestration frameworks that define the role of paid media and connect it effectively across owned, earned, field, CRM, and digital touchpoints.
  • Lead client and internal workshops focused on audience strategy, journey design and engagement planning. 
  • Define measurement frameworks, testing plans and strategic requirements for CRM, analytics and engagement platforms. 
  • Translate client needs, market research, media and campaign performance, and audience insights into clear strategic recommendations for cross-functional teams.
  • Oversee supporting strategists, delegate work and review deliverables for strategic quality and consistency. 
  • Contribute to scoping conversations and manage multiple client workstreams to established timelines and utilization expectations. 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if 

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

What you should have 

  • Demonstrated experience developing media strategy, ideally within healthcare, pharmaceutical marketing, or another highly regulated or complex industry.
  • Strong understanding of paid media strategy and how channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic, video, and other digital media work together within an omnichannel ecosystem.
  • Experience leading client workshops, strategic planning sessions or collaborative working sessions.
  • Strong understanding of how paid media connects with owned channels, CRM, field engagement, content and digital experiences.
  • Ability to translate research, data, media performance and campaign results into strategic recommendations. 
  • Experience overseeing junior strategists and providing feedback, training or quality review.
  • Strong client communication, presentation development and facilitation skills. 

 

Pay Range: $90,000-$115,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. Client delivery

  • Ensure momentum is maintained across the programme and contact with client continues whenever the account lead is absent

Team management

  • Look for opportunities to inspire, motivate, and empower your team on a daily basis, leading by example and setting the standard for junior accounts team members

  • Provide coaching and mentoring to junior team members and manage their performance

  • Support interviewing for new AAs – SAAs

  • Line manage at least one accounts team member AAs – SAAs, providing day-to-day support and longer-term career development guidance

  • Coach others to develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting back on previous projects and gathering cost quotes

  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across the majority of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Keep abreast of award-winning work and insights from other industries, sharing as appropriate

  • Excellent business communication skills, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills

  • Excellent business communication skills

job.description:
Spring Semester News Intern

#26-1341

Minneapolis/St. Paul, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

KSTP-TV

Employee Classification

Part Time Temporary

About Us

KSTP 5 Eyewitness News is the award-winning ABC network affiliate for the Twin Cities. Part of Hubbard Broadcasting, KSTP-TV is a longtime market leader, and is committed to excellence in all that it does-broadcast news with hyper-local coverage, important public service that deals powerfully with today's issues, and now, more than ever, top-notch digital content, to reach our viewers and followers with information the way they want to receive it. When you work for KSTP, or our other local, independently operated station KSTC, Channel 45, you will find yourself among dedicated, passionate people who work hard every day to improve our product and our community. If you have the qualifications, and you are a person of talent and integrity, we invite you to apply!

Job Overview

A professional internship for a full-time student on the college/university level providing practical multiplatform journalism experience through paid internship work on a weekly basis within a local television newsroom in the Twin Cities.

Job Responsibilities

Works in various areas of the news department as assigned, learning first-hand the operation of the newsroom and gaining valuable hands-on experience under the direct supervision of news staff.

Activities to include any regular functions of the newsroom, including but not limited to writing, producing, reporting, photojournalism, and operations in the day-to-day newsgathering performed by members of the news staff.

Attends daily editorial meetings, checks news sources, including wire services, email contacts, and phone calls received by the content desk. Assigned practical work in supporting working journalists, including researching, writing, and editing material to be reviewed and potentially incorporated in the newsgathering processes of the news department.

Is knowledgeable about local, national, and world events. Is informed about issues and concerns of the station's audience.

Other duties as may be assigned, in keeping with the spirit of providing practical experience to the student who will, in turn, document the internship as may be required by their educational institution.

Must be able to work in areas and conditions that are often noisy with many distractions. Must be able to listen to and respond verbally in English to others.

Must have manual dexterity to operate office equipment (including telephone, PC workstation, copier, etc.) and manipulate computer keys. Ability to think critically and logically.

Must be able to lift and carry up to 25 lbs. Average pushing and pulling, bending and stooping. Articulate information in a clear, concise manner to others verbally and in writing.

Must be able to move quickly at times throughout the building.

Works with time-sensitive information under tight deadlines and in pressure situations. Must be able to stand or sit for periods of time.

Able to work outside in extreme weather conditions as needed to gather information, including video shots, for stories. The Company will make reasonable physical accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job functions.

Works in professional, fast-paced, collaborative team environment with a number of members at any given time

Qualifications

Full-time student pursuing a college degree with a major in journalism, mass communications or related field in an accredited institution of higher learning.

Should have recommendation of the academic advisor of the student.

Ability to read, write and speak English well with good communications skills. Good news judgment and understanding of daily news content.

Able to work well in a high-pressure environment, often under tight deadlines. Must be capable of handling multiple tasks, prioritizing, and managing time-sensitive material in real-time.

Highly organized and detail-oriented.

Proficient with computers and web-based skills in research. Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office software suite.

Able to respond to emails, answer phone calls and communicate professionally.

Ability to report to the newsroom for work for up to eight-hour shifts on determined schedules.

Must have a valid drivers license and pass a driving background check.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

The payrate for this position is $17.02 per hour.

Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. job.title: Staff Software Engineer, Application Delivery
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role

The Developer Platforms mission at The New York Times builds the foundational platforms, tooling, and paved paths that help product teams ship high‑quality experiences quickly and safely. Our Application Delivery team owns the shared software delivery platform (CI/CD, artifact management) and deployment workflows used by hundreds of engineers across News, Cooking, Games and Audio to ship software.

As the Times leans into AI‑assisted and agentic development, Application Delivery is where those changes become real. You will set the technical direction for how AI‑generated and agent‑driven change flows safely, observably, and at scale through CI/CD.

You'll help teams reduce release risk with modern deployment patterns, and turn effective delivery practices into reusable pipelines and templates that scale across the organization, much like our GenAI platform roles turn internal practices into reusable tools and agents. When you improve this platform, you change how The New York Times ships software.

You will report to the Engineering Manager of the DevEx Application Delivery team. This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days/week.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical direction of software delivery as a shared product: shape paved paths in our shared platform that improve code health, release quality, and delivery speed for product teams.

  • Set the technical direction for agent‑ready delivery: design the policy, guardrails, and paved paths that turn AI‑generated and agent‑driven changes (migrations, test generation, pipeline maintenance) into safe, observable releases at scale by partnering with our Developer AI team.

  • Collaborate with Product, engineering leaders, and internal users to shape the roadmap for the delivery platform and bring measurable impact on quality and speed.

  • Deliver scalable, secure, and observable software delivery systems and workflows that improve reliability, and overall software quality and velocity.

  • Champion engineering excellence in delivery by setting best practices for testing, deployment strategies, progressive delivery, and observability that are easy to adopt through the platform.

  • Mentor engineers across the mission, contribute to hiring, and help foster an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture centered on shared platforms and high‑quality software delivery.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our mission and values and a commitment to our purpose to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience building the technical strategy and driving software delivery (Github Actions, Argo CD or equivalent CI/CD systems) or similar platform work with broad organizational impact beyond operations.

  • Experience building and scaling a platform as a product for internal engineers with multi-tenancy serving many teams through self‑service paved paths, with attention to adoption, backward compatibility, and isolation/guardrails between tenants

  • Demonstrated proficiency in building and maintaining production services in one or more general‑purpose programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, or Java), including code review and debugging complex issues.

  • 5+ years of experience with containers, Kubernetes, package management tools(Helm or equivalent), IAC tools(Terraform or equivalent), Gitops‑based deployment workflows and cloud services such as AWS, GCP.

  • Experience using delivery and productivity metrics (e.g., DORA, SPACE) and platform observability to measure and improve release quality and delivery.

  • Proficiency with GenAI‑assisted developer tooling (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, or Claude Code) and judgment about how to integrate agentic workflows into CI/CD safely.

  • Experience leading cross‑team technical work, communicating trade‑offs, and building understanding among diverse partners including Product, platform, and product engineering teams.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to artifact/package management (e.g., Artifactory or similar) with attention to security, retention, cost, and ease of use for engineers.

Benefits include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Founded in 1954, KFVS12 has a rich heritage of serving "America's Heartland" with the best local news and weather information, along with a legacy of community service and disaster relief. Murrow Awards.

job.title: Director, Financial Data Reporting
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Director, Financial Data Reporting

 

Position Overview

The Director, Financial Data Reporting leads the strategy, architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise ﬁnancial data and business intelligence solutions. This role combines deep expertise in data engineering, warehousing, analytics, ﬁnancial systems, and technical leadership to improve business processes, expand access to trusted information, and enable timely, informed decision-making.

 

The Director owns the full systems development life cycle for complex reporting and data initiatives—from requirements and solution design through testing, implementation, production support, and continuous optimization. The role also directs the conﬁguration of interactive dashboards, including global and local ﬁlters, to meet a broad range of ﬁnance and business requirements.

 

Serving as a trusted partner to executive leadership, Corporate Finance, IT, Security, and cross-functional stakeholders, the Director translates business needs into scalable technical solutions, strengthens data governance and controls, resolves performance challenges, and advances the organization’s ﬁnancial reporting capabilities.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic leadership: Connects data and technology priorities to business strategy and long-term enterprise needs.
  • Business partnership: Builds credibility across Finance, IT, Security, operations, vendors, and executive leadership.
  • Execution and accountability: Converts complex requirements into reliable solutions and delivers measurable results across competing priorities.
  • Continuous improvement: Uses data, technology, and disciplined problem-solving to simplify processes and improve performance.
  • Communication and inﬂuence: Presents complex information clearly and drives alignment across technical and nontechnical audiences.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the strategy, design, development, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise ﬁnancial data reporting, data warehouse, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Manage the full systems development life cycle across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring solutions align with stakeholder requirements, technical standards, delivery commitments, and business priorities.
  • Own the AWS (RDS MySQL, S3) and SQL Server reporting databases, including moving the remaining legacy reporting to AWS.
  • Own month-end close data processing: WideOrbit, programmatic, digital and MAI revenue loads and the journal entry/invoice ﬁles into SAP, including reconciliations and controls.
  • Own the Power BI estate: reports, data models, scheduled refreshes and subscriptions, including daily revenue pacing and the daily liquidity summary.
  • Lead digital analytics data engineering on Google Cloud (BigQuery) and the Tableau-to-Power BI migration.
  • Direct the contractors and vendors supporting data and reporting.

job.description:
Sales Internship, Townsquare Media Group – Boise

*This position requires you to work in-office and on-site as needed. * 

 

Launch Your Sales & Media Career:

Interested in a career in sales, advertising, or digital marketing? Townsquare Media’s Sales Internship gives college students the opportunity to gain real-world experience while learning how businesses use media and marketing to grow.

As a Sales Intern with our Boise team, you won’t spend your internship sitting on the sidelines. You’ll work alongside experienced sales professionals, learn the fundamentals of consultative selling, and gain exposure to the full sales process—from identifying prospective clients and qualifying opportunities to conducting needs analysis and securing appointments.

You’ll also get a behind-the-scenes look at how a local media company operates, with exposure to our radio brands, digital marketing solutions, on-air operations, community events, and the teams that bring it all together.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Boise stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As an intern on our Boise sales team, you’ll gain hands-on experience with the fundamentals that drive successful sales organizations. You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Learn how to identify and research prospective local businesses
  • Develop prospecting skills through phone, email, and other outreach
  • Learn how to qualify potential clients and identify strong sales opportunities
  • Practice conducting needs analysis to better understand a business, its goals, and its marketing challenges
  • Build confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers
  • Learn how to secure appointments and create opportunities for our sales team
  • Shadow experienced Account Executives throughout different stages of the sales process
  • Gain exposure to client meetings, sales presentations, and marketing strategy
  • Learn how our team uses broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorship solutions to help local businesses grow
  • Develop an understanding of pipeline management, sales activity, and performance goals

 

You’ll also have opportunities to experience other areas of our Boise operation, including our radio stations, on-air teams, promotions, and off-site events, giving you a broader understanding of how sales connects with the entire organization.

This is a sales-focused internship designed to give you practical experience, meaningful coaching, and a strong foundation in consultative selling.

 

What You’ll Bring:

We’re looking for students who are curious, motivated, and excited to learn. You don’t need previous sales experience—we’ll help you build the skills.

  • Currently pursuing a college degree in Sales, Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field
  • Genuine interest in exploring a career in sales
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Confidence starting conversations and willingness to step outside your comfort zone
  • Coachable mindset and desire to learn
  • Strong work ethic, organization, and follow-through
  • Positive attitude and ability to work collaboratively with a team
  • Interest in media, digital marketing, advertising, or local business is a plus
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

This internship is designed to give you more than something to add to your resume. You’ll leave with real-world experience and a better understanding of what it takes to build a career in sales.

  • Hands-on sales training and coaching
  • Real-world experience in prospecting, qualifying, needs analysis, and appointment setting
  • Opportunities to shadow successful Account Executives
  • Exposure to digital advertising, radio, programmatic marketing, events, and local media
  • Experience working with local businesses and understanding their marketing challenges
  • Opportunities to attend station and community events
  • Direct access to experienced sales and market leadership
  • A chance to build your professional network and résumé before graduation
  • Exposure to potential career opportunities with Townsquare Media

 

If you’re competitive, curious, comfortable talking to people, and interested in learning how great sellers build relationships and create opportunities, we’d love to meet you.

job.title: 21GRAMS- Senior Delivery Manager
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a AI-Forward Technical Delivery Manager join our growing team!

21GRAMS, Real Chemistry’s advertising agency, has been ranked the #2 creative health agency in the world by Cannes Lions. ROOM42 is 21GRAMS’ in-house production company, content studio, and Digital & Technology services arm — the team that turns briefs, Figma files, and napkin sketches into working, beautiful, compliant digital deliverables for the top pharma and biotech companies in the world.

We are looking for an AI-Forward Technical Delivery Manager (TDM) to run technical delivery across the full ROOM42 output spectrum — marketing websites, microsites, emails (including Veeva rep-triggered and approved email), banners, IVAs, conference kiosks and interactive experiences — built with in-house developers and specialist vendor partners. This is the person who owns whether the right work gets to the right build team, whether the estimate is real, whether it ships to spec and on time, and who is increasingly using AI to make all of that faster and more consistent. The project manager and account teams own the client relationship and the date. The TDM owns whether that date is achievable and gets the work built — qualifying intake, routing to the right build team, running the review-and-QA lifecycle, holding vendors to standard, and applying AI where it creates genuine delivery leverage, not novelty.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do:

Intake & Technical Qualification

  • Triage incoming requests from Workfront and Jira; assign deliverable type, complexity tier, and dependency flags (Veeva, MLR, client restrictions) within a defined SLA.
  • Return incomplete requests rather than absorbing them — no handoff to build without specs, assets, link matrix, CTAs/UTMs, and a real level-of-effort estimate.
  • Own or validate the estimate before any build commitment, using ROOM42’s estimation tooling and rate card. 

Build Team Routing & Vendor Management

  • Decide in-house vs. vendor partner per project against MSA offshore rules, client restrictions, Veeva dependency, and capacity — and escalate routing decisions that carry cost or transition implications.
  • Run day-to-day vendor delivery: standing syncs, staging-date accountability, cap-burn visibility against SOW, and knowledge-transfer documentation during vendor transitions.
  • Escalate quality issues to the vendor lead and commercial issues to the Digital & Technology leadership.

Technical Delivery Lifecycle

  • Own delivery from kickoff through post-launch: dev kickoff, staging links, review-round sequencing (R1/R2/R3), MLR/PRC submission readiness, QA gate, and go-live.
  • Maintain a live view of technical progress across a concurrent portfolio; proactively flag risks to Producers and Delivery leadership before they surface in status calls.
  • Drive milestone gates with QA — confirm that what moves from development to QA to UAT to production is actually ready, not optimistically ready.
  • Manage technical dependencies across concurrent projects (shared environments, overlapping timelines, licensing, PDUFA-anchored dates) and surface conflicts before they collide.

AI-Augmented Delivery

  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate the delivery workflow — status synthesis, ticket hygiene, QA support, specification drafting, and documentation — not as novelties but as real accelerators.
  • Partner on ROOM42’s AI-augmented QA and design-to-code workflows (visual regression, accessibility scanning, Figma-to-code handoff) so quality is structural and repeatable across deliverable types.
  • Help define and document AI-assisted delivery playbooks per deliverable type so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner, and evaluate emerging tooling for genuine leverage.
  • Apply judgment to AI output — know where AI-assisted work needs human review before it reaches a client, and keep quality from degrading as volume scales.

Quality, Standards & Portfolio Hygiene

  • Define ‘done’ for each deliverable type with the technical lead and QA — not just ‘it works,’ but performant, accessible, cross-browser validated, MLR-clean, and visually faithful to approved design.
  • Own quality accountability for your portfolio: if something ships broken or fails an MLR technical review, own the root cause and the remediation.
  • Enforce Jira/Workfront field discipline and status accuracy so the portfolio is legible to leadership and reporting is reliable.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Director, Social Media to join our growing Activation team and lead smart, platform-native social work that drives meaningful impact for healthcare clients. 

For us, social isn’t just a channel — it’s a craft. Our Social Media team blends deep healthcare expertise with sharp strategy, standout content, paid media fluency and data-driven execution to help clients show up with purpose across platforms. As Director, you’ll be a day-to-day lead across multiple books of business, helping teams move from big ideas to smart execution while coaching people, guiding clients and raising the quality of the work.

Social Leadership, Strategy & Business Impact

Client Partnership, Meetings & Storytelling 

  • Serve as a trusted day-to-day client lead, running recurring, ad-hoc and planning meetings with confidence, clarity and a little spark.

  • Stay one step ahead of client needs, bringing thoughtful solutions, clear next steps and a steady hand to help programs run smoothly from planning through execution. 

AI, Innovation & Smarter Social Operations 

  • Champion responsible AI adoption across social workflows, using tools like Microsoft Copilot, Canva, social listening platforms and analytics dashboards to improve research, ideation, content development, reporting and presentations. 
  • Help teams use AI with good judgment, keeping healthcare accuracy, client privacy, compliance and brand standards at the center. 

Business Growth & New Opportunities 

  • Partner with colleagues to identify opportunities to expand, refine or elevate social media programming across existing accounts. 
  • Contribute to growth opportunities by shaping smart social POVs, strategic recommendations and pitch-ready thinking. 

This Position is a Perfect Fit for You if: 

Mindset, Ownership & Leadership Style 

  • You’re a confident, curious social leader who loves the pace of platform change but keeps the work grounded, strategic and reputable. 
  • You can zoom out to spot patterns, connect insights to business opportunities and zoom in to make the strategy, copy, storytelling and details sharper. 
  • You enjoy coaching people, building trust with clients and living our values: Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I.” 

What Experience & Skills You Should have: 

Experience, Leadership & Healthcare Context 

  • 7–10 years of social media, digital marketing or integrated communications experience, ideally in healthcare, biotech, pharma or another regulated industry. 
  • Agency experience in a client-facing role, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, assignments and stakeholders at once. 
  • Experience leading teams, managing performance and supporting the development of direct or indirect reports. 
  • Comfort balancing hands-on client work with team leadership, internal initiatives and business development support. 
  • College degree required; BA or equivalent preferred; understanding of FDA, fair balance, adverse event and client review considerations preferred. 

Social, Paid, Influencer, Analytics & Tools 

  • Deep understanding of social platforms, audience behavior and content best practices across organic, paid and influencer-led programs. 
  • Experience building strategic plans, channel recommendations, paid social approaches and insight-led performance narratives for senior stakeholders. 
  • Fluency with social buying, publishing, listening, analytics and AI-enabled tools, including platforms such as Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Microsoft Office and Canva. 
  • Strong communication, organization and judgment, with the ability to synthesize inputs, shape strong copy, delegate effectively and keep work moving.

job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Meteorologist - WSB TV

 

Position Overview

WSB-TV in Atlanta is seeking a Meteorologist to join Severe Weather Team 2. The Atlanta area experiences all four seasons, making forecasting a central part of our coverage. Severe weather is a major focus, and we’re seeking a candidate with strong on-air delivery who can provide breaking weather coverage with a clear, authoritative presence.

 

The ideal candidate is creative and clear in their presentation and graphic support, has a digital-first mindset and connects authentically with viewers both on-air and online. This Meteorologist will also contribute to daily editorial meetings and turn stories.

 

Please submit your resume, link to demo reel (including breaking weather coverage), and examples of digital/social content in your application.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Deliver clear, accurate, and engaging forecasts across multiple newscasts
  • Provide confident, in-depth coverage during severe and breaking weather events
  • Contribute to storm tracking and team coverage during high-impact weather
  • Create and publish timely, compelling content for digital, app, streaming, and social platforms
  • Produce weather explainers and enterprise content that enhances viewer understanding
  • Utilize The Weather Company and Baron Lynx weather systems to build visually compelling graphics and presentations
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership to integrate weather coverage across all platforms
  • Represent the station at community events and public appearances

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science
  • Minimum 3–5 years of on-air broadcast meteorology experience (major or competitive mid-major market preferred)
  • Proven experience covering severe weather and extended storm events
  • Strong working knowledge of The Weather Company system
  • Excellent live presentation, ad-libbing, and storytelling skills
  • Demonstrated digital-first approach, including social media and app engagement
  • Flexible scheduling, including weekends and holidays, is required, along with participation in an on-call rotation
  • This is an on-site, in-station role in the WSB-TV Newsroom
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active AMS Seal of Approval (CBM or CDM preferred)

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Manager, Public Relations Strategy
job.description:
The Manager, Public Relations Strategy will lead and execute proactive and strategic media relations efforts that elevate AccuWeather’s global brand, reinforce our position as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, and amplify our mission of saving lives and protecting property. Manager, Public Relations Strategy will report directly to the Vice President of Corporate Communications and will have direct involvement with the Director of Corporate Communications and the Media Relations Supervisor, as well as lead and mentor the corporate communications interns.

This role is responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with national, regional, and trade media; providing strategic guidance to secure high-impact coverage of AccuWeather's news and content; shaping compelling narratives around AccuWeather’s Superior Accuracy™, products, innovation, leadership, and enterprise solutions; and supporting executive visibility. Manager, Public Relations Strategy will serve as a key strategic advisor, ensuring consistent, timely, and accurate messaging across earned media channels in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and execute comprehensive media relations strategies aligned with corporate priorities, product launches, major weather events, research releases, partnerships, and company milestones
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with reporters, editors, producers, and influencers across national, business, technology, science, trade, and broadcast media
  • Draft, edit, and oversee the distribution of press releases, media advisories, statements, talking points, FAQs, and executive messaging
  • Lead proactive media outreach strategy to secure coverage highlighting AccuWeather’s Superior Accuracy™, innovation, thought leadership, AccuWeather For Business solutions, and the AccuWeather Network
  • Serve as a primary media contact; manage inbound inquiries and coordinate interviews with executives, meteorologists, and subject matter experts
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure message alignment and maximize media impact
  • Manage communications during significant weather events and time-sensitive situations
  • Monitor media coverage, analyze results, and provide reporting and insights to leadership
  • Support executive visibility initiatives and thought leadership opportunities
  • Maintain organized media lists, press materials, messaging documents, and coverage archives
  • Work with external PR agencies or vendors as needed
  • Be available to work outside of normal business hours, including nights and weekends, as needed based on company needs and events
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field
  • 2-4+ years of progressive experience in media relations, public relations, or corporate communications
  • Proven track record of securing national and top-tier media coverage
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills
  • Experience serving as a spokesperson and managing media inquiries
  • Strong understanding of AP Style and media best practices
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, particularly during high-profile weather events

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience in broadcast, science, technology, or weather-related communications
  • Familiarity with media monitoring and distribution tools
  • Experience supporting executive communications and thought leadership platforms
  • Background working with B2B and B2C brands

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strategic thinker able to translate complex scientific and technical information into compelling media narratives
  • Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities
  • Calm, decisive, and solutions-oriented under pressure
  • Collaborative team player with the ability to work independently
  • High level of professionalism and sound judgment
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and digital collaboration tools

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

ABOUT HALLMARK’S INTERNSHIP PROGRAM  

We're looking for curious, creative, and consumer-focused interns who are passionate about storytelling, trends, culture, creativity, and human connection. 

This posting includes two distinct Creative Internship opportunities within Hallmark Greetings Creative .

 

Writing Studio & Greetings Editorial Intern 

This internship provides hands-on experience in creative writing, content development, editorial planning, trend research, and greeting card product strategy. Interns will partner with writers, editors, and product teams to develop consumer-focused content and concepts that help Hallmark create meaningful connections through greeting cards and related products.  

 

What you'll do 

  • Create original writing for greeting cards and related Hallmark products. 
  • Explore emerging trends, voices, and cultural insights relevant to Gen Z and Gen Alpha consumers. 
  • Learn how Hallmark plans, develops, and curates greeting card programs. 
  • Conduct editorial analysis and consumer research to identify future content opportunities. 
  • Develop concepts and editorial content that authentically connect with consumers. 
  • Partner with writers, editors, designers, and product teams throughout the creative process. 
  • Present recommendations and creative concepts to business and creative leaders. 

               

              BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 

              The following is required to be considered for this role: 

              • Pursuing a bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Creative Writing, Advertising, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field 
              • A graduation date of December 2027, May 2028, December 2028, May 2029, December 2029, or May 2030.  

                 

                PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

                Your resume and application will stand out if you are: 

                • Demonstrated interest in writing, content creation, publishing, media, advertising, or product development 
                • Strong writing and editing skills 
                • Familiarity with social, cultural, and consumer trends relevant to Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences 
                • Experience through coursework, publications, student organizations, freelance work, or personal creative projects is a plus 

                        

                      ADDITIONAL DETAILS 

                      • A portfolio is required for this position. Your portfolio should be compiled into one PDF document that is no larger than 5 MB. If your portfolio file size is above the 5MB limit, you can submit a one-page overview of your work (see example). You can also submit a link to a personal portfolio website to supplement your uploaded portfolio. Applicants who do not upload a portfolio or one-page overview will not be considered.
                      •  Candidates selected to move forward in the interview process will be asked to complete a few brief exercises later in the process.
                      • Our internship program is 12 weeks long, starting in late May and ending in early August. 
                      • This summer internship is a hybrid position, with the flexibility to work from both our recently renovated headquarters building in Kansas City, MO, and from your summer residence within the KC metro area. 
                      • Some relocation and housing assistance is provided for interns whose permanent address is outside of the KC metro area. Relocation is required for this role. 

                             

                            Interested? Follow the application instructions below to apply. 

                             

                            APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS  

                            Along with your resume and application, please provide up to 10 samples of your own writing that demonstrate:

                            • Your unique voice
                            • A range of content types (academic, creative, journalistic, prose, verse, etc.)
                            • Ability to edit for clarity / conciseness (for example, a piece of writing that shows before and after edits)
                            • Success in writing for a variety of audiences

                             

                            You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT.  

                             

                            In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks. 

                             

                            ABOUT HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important  

                             

                            For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like!  

                            When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team, even in a remote/hybrid work environment. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success.  

                            Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the ings we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.
