job.title: Editorial Intern
job.description:
AccuWeather’s Digital Team is seeking an Editorial Intern for Spring 2027. Join us in a hands-on newsroom role where you'll help shape daily weather coverage for AccuWeather.com. You’ll collaborate closely with editors and meteorologists to pitch compelling story ideas, research developing weather events, and write digital-first articles that inform and engage our audience. This role offers the opportunity to build real-world newsroom experience, sharpen your writing skills, and learn how data, SEO, and emerging AI tools support modern digital publishing. You’ll also assist with sourcing and clearing user-generated content to help bring impactful weather stories to life across platforms.

This paid internship spans 5 months and requires a commitment of approximately 20 hours per week. Morning and daytime availability is preferred, though some evening hours may be accommodated.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

● Finding and gathering information to pitch timely, weather-related story ideas for AccuWeather.com.

● Writing multiple digital stories per month for publication on AccuWeather.com.

● Conducting source gathering and research to support accurate, compelling weather coverage.

● Using ChatGPT and other AI tools to edit content, test prompts, and optimize stories for digital platforms.

● Sourcing and clearing user-generated content for use in articles and on social platforms.

● Collaborating with editors, meteorologists, and the social team to align coverage across platforms.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

● Pursuing a 4-year Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Meteorology or a related field that requires experience in writing and research.

● Strong writing, editing, and research skills with attention to accuracy and detail.

● Interest in weather, climate, and science-based storytelling.

● Basic understanding of SEO and digital publishing best practices is a plus.

● Demonstrated ability to be self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

● Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.

● Must be willing to work occasional evenings or weekends as needed.

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

job.title: 21GRAMS- Senior Editor
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Editor—21GRAMS to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, is a full-service healthcare advertising agency built on the belief that healthcare should feel more human. We combine bold creativity, strategic rigor, and deep scientific understanding to create work that changes behavior, improves outcomes, and makes a meaningful impact on people's lives. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to doing exceptional work. We believe in being good to each other while pushing ourselves to deliver ideas that move audiences, brands, and healthcare forward.

The Senior Editor maintains quality control of agency deliverables during all stages and is a liaison for the Editorial Department to other colleagues to own and reinforce established standard operating procedures. Grows professional relationships with internal brand team members and works collaboratively to ensure best practices. Performs all functions necessary to keep workflow running smoothly and able to maintain a good level of quality control even with crunched timelines.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What you’ll do:

  • Establishes solid working relationships internally and with internal brand team accounts to which they are assigned; proactively and collaboratively engages with Copy, Medical, Account, Art/Studio, and Project Management teams to provide support

  • Is the lead editor for 1 or more accounts

  • Raises a red flag with brand teams and/or senior managers when timelines are too tight, additional resources are needed, or when there is a disruption to normal workflow, among other concerns

  • Maintains oversight for their own jobs to complete them on schedule whether by managing their own time or delegating promptly and responsibly to other resources
  • Supports and reinforces team and agency initiatives established by senior managers
  • Participates in team meetings and contributes to fostering a team mentality
  • Practices a positive “can do” attitude at all times
  • Mentors and trains new and/or junior employees and freelancers

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

 

What you should have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher desirable
  • 2+ years’ experience in medical advertising, medical publishing, and/or medical education, with 0+ years’ experience in medical advertising
  • Expected to be 95%+ billable
  • Advertising, marketing, business, English, or related degree preferred

Marketing Consultant

#26-1343

Alexandria, Minnesota, United States

Business Unit

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard Radio is a full-service media company with 16 radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions in four of northern Minnesota's most beautiful and active resort communities: Alexandria, Bemidji, Brainerd and Wadena. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

The Marketing Consultant is responsible for selling advertising to clients and developing new business relationships by prospecting, developing and selling new direct-business accounts, making sales presentations, performing collections, maintaining client relations and sales.

Job Responsibilities

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets including spot, digital, and new direct business. Prospect new businesses on a weekly basis.

Prepare and complete sales presentations with decision makers.

Make presentations to include a customer needs analysis, research and supporting documentation, and creative business solutions.

Follow up and close all pending business in a timely manner.

Update General Manager weekly on progress of pending business.

Work closely with other departments in creating effective promotional sales solutions for clients.

Create and make presentations to agency personnel, including selling and pre-selling the station audience attributes.

Provide exceptional customer service to direct and agency accounts. Personally contact each active account regularly- defined as an in-person meeting, including the presentation of pertinent sales information.

Obtain credit approval for new accounts.

Ensure all accounts are paid in a timely manner. Follow up and assist in the collection process for past due accounts.

Utilization of and proficiency with Sales software.

Attend special events, such as remotes and broadcasts, which involve clients. These events may occur after business hours and on weekends.

Complete all written business requirements within established deadlines. These requirements include but are not limited to: forecast reports, pending business updates, written orders and advertising copy.

Attend and participate in weekly sales staff meetings, individual meetings with manager and other necessary meetings and training as required by management.

Have a thorough understanding of rates, promotions, inventory, and personnel. Continue to learn and stay abreast of trends in digital and broadcast advertising industry.

Maintain regular, reliable attendance.

Work cooperatively and collaboratively with others. Build working relationships with co-workers, customers, vendors and the general public.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

Previous sales, advertising, digital sales, or media experience preferred

Knowledge of, and familiarity with, (or ability to learn) broadcasting and digital terminology and methodology preferred.

Ability to understand the features and benefits of advertising and competitive media.

Familiarity with Microsoft Word for Windows; sales software knowledge helpful.

Excellent written and oral English language communication skills.

Experience developing presentations for the purpose of direct-business selling and ability to effectively present and communicate.

Ability to respond to questions appropriately and think on feet.

Establish and maintain customer relationships; communicate effectively with a wide range of personalities in a professional manner.

High level of initiative and ability to work independently required.

Must have reliable transportation, a valid driver's license and a safe driving history as determined by the Company for the purpose of meeting clients and attending events. (Driving record will be checked.)

Demonstrate effective negotiation and closing techniques.

Strong analytical skills, good judgment, and a "positive can do attitude" are required.

Ability to read, hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction.

Ability to think critically, analytically, creatively and logically; and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others.

Ability to work evenings and weekends.

Physical Requirements: Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.). Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. The Company may make reasonable accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job function.

Additional Information

This position is subject to pre-employment driving record background check. A conviction, violation pending adjudication, or adverse driving record more than 3 years old or does not meet the major violation definition per company policy will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Maintain extensive community contacts and awareness of local, state and national current events.

Minimum of two years’ experience as a news anchor preferred.

Quick & effective decision-making, live ad-libbing, and maintain performance under extreme pressure.

Professional & maintained on-air appearance.

job.title: Product Engineer, Membership and Front-End
job.description:
ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest. 

We will stop accepting applications for this role on Monday, November 30th @ 11:59PM ET.

ProPublica is hiring a software engineer to work primarily on the systems and services that power our audience data platforms. This important role serves to advance ProPublica’s mission — publishing journalism with real-world impact — by enabling systems that bring us greater understanding of our audiences and donors.

We’re looking for an experienced engineer who believes in our mission and thrives in multifaceted roles, contributing both to the long-term product road map and to hands-on development. Your responsibilities will include shipping high-quality and resilient code and collaborating with designers, product managers, data analysts, other engineers and agency partners. You’ll write code, configure no- and low-code integrations, contribute to our documentation, share your expertise and proactively solve problems.

As a member of our expanding, crossfunctional product team, you’ll work with colleagues across ProPublica’s engineering, audience and membership operations, ensuring that our capabilities align with our principles and advance our organizational objectives. This position reports to our director of product engineering and will work closely with the audience data and insights analyst.

What you’ll do

  • Build and ship reader-facing features that drive membership — calls to action, donation flows, and account and authentication experiences — with clean, resilient code.
  • Integrate the systems behind them: messaging tools, payments and donation processing platforms, user accounts, CDP and CRM, and the data infrastructure that connect them.
  • Instrument the audience and donor journey. Set up accurate and actionable event tracking so every meaningful step is captured cleanly and becomes data we can act on.
  • Support making experimentation routine. Build the infrastructure for A/B testing and, with internal business teams, run experiments regularly so our decisions rest on evidence instead of guesswork.
  • Write front-end  services and integrations as needed. (Our site runs on Wordpress VIP.)
  • Working with our engineering leaders, protect reader privacy and keep us compliant with legal and regulatory requirements.

Required qualifications

  • At least three years of experience in front-end software development and system integrations, with a track record of implementing and maintaining performant, secure, scalable solutions.
  • Experience interacting with audience and reader data platforms, such as Salesforce, Google Analytics, Parse.ly, Sailthru, or similar CRMs, CDPs and analytics tools.
  • Experience working on a customer data platform implementation within the last two years.
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with experience in a highly collaborative team environment, supporting diverse stakeholders and adapting solutions to evolving business needs.
  • Clear and effective spoken and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical processes and present complex integration workflows to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel for occasional staff summits or other required events.

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience implementing solutions such as Piano or MonetizationOS or building similar functionality.
  • Working knowledge of Wordpress and/or Wordpress VIP.
  • Fluency with at least one language used in web development, such as PHP, Typescript or vanilla JS.
  • Track record of doing hands-on work with cloud data warehouses like Google BigQuery and customer data platforms such as Braze or Hightouch.
  • Knowledge of newsroom workflows and a passion for journalism.

This job is full time and includes benefits. ProPublica is based in New York, but we’re open to remote candidates. We have offices in New York City; Washington, D.C.; Atlanta; Chicago; Phoenix; and Berkeley, California. Applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S.

This role is subject to an in-office work requirement of two days per week in the New York City office. That requirement may be extended to other offices with 60 days’ notice. 

This job is covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with The NewsGuild of New York, Local 31003, CWA, AFL-CIO

The expected salary range for this position is $120,000 to $145,000.

This is a good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this position. The final salary figure will take into account a person’s experience, accomplishment and location. ProPublica is committed to paying its staff equitably, and these ranges should not be considered career salary limits or caps.

We will begin reviewing applications as we receive them, but we will continue to consider candidates as long as the posting remains live on our site.

Questions? Send an email to talent@propublica.org. 

No phone calls, please.

We know there are great candidates who may not fit into what we’ve described above or who have important skills we haven’t thought of. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself.

We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age or any other status protected under applicable law. We are dedicated to building an inclusive newsroom and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

job.title: Analytics Engineer
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Role Overview

The Analytics Engineer role serves as a key member of the Measurement Enablement team, responsible for ensuring client healthcare marketing data is accurate, current, and ready for reporting and analysis. This role bridges the gap between Data Engineering, analytics teams, and client stakeholders by managing data ingestion processes, validating data quality, maintaining reporting-ready data structures, and resolving issues throughout the data lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating data questions, identifying root causes of data discrepancies, improving data quality, and working across multiple teams to ensure reliable data powers business decisions. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis, or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

Primary Responsibilities 

Data Ingestion & Source Management 

  • Coordinate the onboarding of new client data sources and data feeds.  
  • Partner with Data Engineering to ensure successful ingestion of data into Databricks.  
  • Monitor data delivery schedules and ingestion processes.  
  • Maintain source documentation, field mappings, and data inventories.  
  • Work directly with internal teams and external partners to resolve source-related issues. 

Data Quality & Stewardship 

  • Monitor data freshness, completeness, and accuracy across client datasets.  
  • Perform ongoing quality assurance and reconciliation checks.  
  • Investigate missing, unexpected, or inconsistent data.  
  • Escalate, coordinate and resolve remediation efforts with the appropriate teams.  
  • Maintain documentation of data quality findings and resolutions.  
  • Support the development of automated data quality checks and monitoring processes. 

Data Modeling 

  • Develop and maintain client-specific standard, custom, and master tables and reporting views within Databricks based on a medallion architecture.  
  • Assist with transforming and standardizing data from multiple sources into reporting-ready structures. 
  • Solve problems and help build solutions related to the data model to meet evolving reporting and analysis needs. 
  • Document business rules, transformation logic, and metric definitions.  
  • Support maintenance of reusable reporting datasets and standardized data models. 

Stakeholder Support 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for routine data-related questions.  
  • Partner with Client Services, Media, Strategy, and Data teams to align on data outputs and expectations. 
  • Work with analysts and measurement leads to understand reporting requirements, translate into technical requirements, and provide database-modeled data for reporting.  
  • Communicate data issues, impacts, and resolutions to stakeholders.  
  • Assist with troubleshooting data discrepancies impacting reporting deliverables. 

Reporting Support 

  • Support Power BI developers and business analysts with data-related questions.  
  • Assist with report validation and troubleshooting.  
  • Help verify data displayed in dashboards aligns with source systems and business requirements.  
  • Provide support for semantic models and reporting datasets when needed. 

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, in a Databricks environment preferrable. 
  • Experience using ETL tools and data manipulation concepts (Funnel.io, DBT, or similar applications). 
  • Comfort partnering with Data Engineering on data sources, schemas, and refresh logic. 
  • Deep analytical and problem-solving skills related to data storage and structure for reporting.
  • Experience reviewing data logic, KPI definitions, and QA outputs. 
  • Basic BI (Tableau, Power BI) skills including data modeling, dashboard structure, calculated fields, usability, data storytelling. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to translate complex business reporting requests into modeled data to support current and future analysis. 

Preferred / Bonus 

  • Pharma, HCP, or healthcare media analytics experience, including experience with media PLD (Physician Level Data).  
  • Digital media measurement expertise (media KPIs, attribution concepts, omnichannel analysis). 
  • Experience inheriting or stabilizing existing data warehouse schemas. 

Pay Range: $90,000-$110,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

job.description:

FGS Global (FGS) partners with the world's most influential leaders to move minds and markets. Working where business, government, and public opinion intersect, we advise CEOs, boards, and leadership teams at the most consequential moments. Our expertise spans strategic and financial communications, policy and public affairs, corporate reputation, crisis management, and data-driven digital engagement. Across 31 global offices, our partners draw on the full depth of the firm so clients can operate with clarity, act with confidence, and lead with trust. 

About the Program 
Students interested in digital communications, social media, and technology are encouraged to apply for FGS Global's Winter/Spring 2027 internship program. This paid, part-time opportunity offers hands-on experience supporting client work, exposure to a variety of communications disciplines, and the chance to learn from experienced communications professionals. 

 The internship will begin in January 2027 and end that following May with an expectation of three full days of contribution (roughly 25 hours per week). This position is based in our Washington, D.C. office, and interns are expected to work in-office.  

 Responsibilities:

  • Monitor news, conduct research, create media lists, and aid multiple account teams to help clients with digital channel management, profile raising, crisis, issues management, mergers and acquisitions, litigation support, etc. 
  • Conduct and analyze industry- and company-specific social media research
  • Assist in building, managing, and reporting on performance for digital ad and/or email newsletter campaigns
  • Work under the direction of an assigned mentor to devise recommendations and solutions for clients’ digital channels
  • Recognize and identify noteworthy patterns or changes in social media activity.
  • Assist in planning, brainstorming, and executing social media tactics and strategies
  • Create content for clients across owned social media channels, including Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Bluesky, and more.
  • Perform social channel research audits and develop social media content calendars.
  • Produce data-driven analytics reports related to social and digital channel performance.
  • Write email newsletter copy, blog posts, and web content as necessary.
  • Work with team members on related digital projects and tasks. 

 Qualifications:

  • Current undergraduate student 
  • Eagerness to learn about digital strategy and our client-facing industry
  • Strong writer and editor
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel as well as our core social media platforms
  • Interest in and enthusiasm for social media, digital communications, and/or public relations

Job Title:  New Business and Sports Sales Manager - WSOC TV

 

Position Overview

Join WSOC-TV, a leading local media brand within Cox Media Group, as our New Business and Sports Sales Manager. In this role, you’ll lead new-client acquisition, grow sports sponsorship and advertising revenue, and accelerate growth across television, streaming, and digital marketing platforms.

 

This player-coach role is built for an accomplished media sales leader who thrives on building a disciplined new-business engine, expanding digital and sports revenue, and developing a high-performing sales team. You’ll bring strong leadership along with expertise in linear television, sports programming and sponsorships, connected TV (CTV)/OTT, streaming video, audience-based advertising, and the broader digital marketing ecosystem.

 

You’ll guide Account Executives through the full sales cycle—from target-account identification and prospecting through discovery, solution design, presentation, negotiation, close, renewal, and expansion. You’ll set clear activity and pipeline expectations, strengthen the team’s digital and sports selling skills, package and sell sports programming, sponsorships, and events, and collaborate across WSOC-TV and Cox Media Group to deliver integrated, measurable marketing solutions for local and regional advertisers.

 

If you’re a competitive, collaborative sales leader ready to shape the future of local media sales in Charlotte while helping clients achieve meaningful business results, we’d love to hear from you.

 

At WSOC-TV, you’ll combine the strength of a trusted local media brand with the resources of Cox Media Group to help Charlotte-area businesses grow. This is a chance to lead with impact, build something meaningful, and grow your career with a team that values results, collaboration, and community.

  • Sell with powerful assets. Bring clients trusted local news, sports programming, streaming, and digital solutions that reach audiences across the region.
  • Own the strategy. Shape the new-business and sports sales approach, build your team, and see the direct impact of your leadership on revenue growth.
  • Be part of a dynamic market. Work in Charlotte’s growing business community and passionate sports culture, with opportunities to connect brands with the fans and communities they want to reach.
  • Collaborate with talented teams. Partner with News, Sports, Creative Services, Digital Operations, and Traffic to deliver creative, high-impact solutions.
  • Grow your career. Develop as a leader within Cox Media Group, with opportunities to expand your expertise across television, streaming, and digital media.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Build a focused, accountable sales team that consistently generates qualified new business opportunities and advances them through the pipeline.
  • Achieve or exceed new-business, digital revenue, total revenue, client retention, and market-share goals.
  • Achieve or exceed sports revenue and sponsorship goals by securing new sports advertisers, renewing, and expanding sponsor partnerships, maximizing sell-through of sports inventory, and delivering on all sponsor commitments.
  • Improve key performance indicators, including prospecting activity, pipeline coverage, conversion rates, average deal size, forecast accuracy, and digital revenue mix.
  • Help advertisers achieve measurable business outcomes through integrated, insight-led solutions and effective campaign optimization.
  • Build productive partnerships across Sales, News, Creative Services, Digital Operations, and Traffic to deliver a seamless client experience.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Sales Leadership

  • Lead and develop Account Executives focused on new clients, digital growth, retention, and account expansion.
  • Build a high-performance culture grounded in prospecting, consultative selling, digital expertise, and accountability.
  • Set clear expectations for sales activity, pipeline coverage, conversion, forecasting, and revenue performance.
  • Coach sellers through one-on-ones, pipeline reviews, call preparation, field support, and deal strategy.
  • Support priority presentations, negotiations, and closes while removing barriers to growth.

 

New Business Development

  • Execute a market-level new-business strategy focused on priority categories, target accounts, and prospecting campaigns.
  • Coach sellers to generate qualified opportunities through research, outreach, networking, referrals, and insight-led conversations.
  • Build relationships with businesses, agencies, and key decision-makers across the market.
  • Turn advertiser objectives into integrated strategies using WSOC-TV and Cox Media Group assets.

 

Sports Sales and Sponsorships

  • Lead sports sales strategy across sponsorships, programming, special events, and multi-platform sports packages.
  • Identify and develop new advertisers and categories for local, regional, high school, college, and professional sports opportunities.
  • Build integrated sports packages across broadcast, streaming, digital, social, and on-site activations.
  • Cultivate relationships with teams, leagues, schools, venues, and sports organizations to create new revenue opportunities.
  • Manage sports inventory, pricing, and sponsor fulfillment to maximize revenue and deliver on every client commitment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Multi-Platform Advertising Solutions

  • Champion integrated solutions across television, CTV/OTT, streaming, display, search, social, digital audio, email, and audience targeting.
  • Coach sellers on discovery, positioning, audience strategy, measurement, and outcome-based selling.
  • Ensure proposals are strategic, accurately priced, executable, and aligned with client objectives.
  • Use campaign results to optimize performance, demonstrate value, renew business, and uncover growth opportunities.

 

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Partner with WSOC-TV News and Sports on sponsorships, content integrations, and community-focused revenue opportunities.
  • Work with Creative Services to develop compelling, differentiated advertising solutions.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Digital Operations, Traffic, and other teams to execute multi-platform campaigns.
  • Create revenue opportunities around station initiatives, partnerships, special projects, and events.

 

Client Success and Retention

  • Build lasting client relationships through strategic guidance, responsiveness, and service.
  • Turn campaign results into persuasive renewal stories, case studies, and recommendations that drive renewals, upsells, and cross-platform growth.
  • Position WSOC-TV as a trusted business-growth partner.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Five or more years of media, sports, or digital advertising sales experience, with a demonstrated record of acquiring new clients, growing digital revenue, and expanding existing accounts.
  • Experience leading, coaching, and developing sales professionals, including setting expectations, managing performance, and driving accountability.
  • Proven ability to build and execute new-business strategies, manage prospecting and sales pipelines, use CRM tools, forecast accurately, and deliver revenue results.
  • Working knowledge of linear television, CTV/OTT, streaming video, audience targeting, digital advertising, campaign measurement, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Experience translating client objectives into multi-platform advertising solutions and using campaign results to drive optimization, renewals, upselling, and retention.
  • Experience selling sports programming, sponsorships, or event-based marketing, including developing packages, and managing sponsor fulfillment.
  • Effective communication, presentation, negotiation, organizational, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to engage clients and support sellers on priority opportunities.
  • Ability to analyze audience, market, and campaign data and collaborate across Sales, News, Creative Services, Digital Operations, and Traffic to deliver effective client solutions.
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record.
Tools and Technology
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms, such as HubSpot, to track prospecting activity, manage pipeline health, and support accurate forecasting.
  • Working knowledge of WideOrbit Media Sales and Traffic or comparable broadcast sales and traffic systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Familiarity with advertising analytics, reporting, audience insights, and campaign management platforms.
  • Comfort using company-approved AI tools to support prospecting, planning, productivity, and campaign development.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field.
  • Prior sales leadership experience in a local broadcast, media, advertising, or digital sales organization.
  • Established relationships with sports teams, leagues, schools, venues, or sports marketing organizations in the Charlotte region.

job.title: Weekend AM Anchor/MSJ
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KTHV11, a TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Little Rock, Arkansas, is seeking an engaging Anchor/Multi-Skilled Journalist to lead our Saturday morning newscasts and report stories that matter across central Arkansas. This journalist will help viewers start their weekend informed, prepared and connected to their communities. We are looking for a journalist with strong news judgment, clear and conversational on-air delivery, and the curiosity to find the people and context behind the headlines. The successful candidate will work closely with producers and the newsroom team to shape useful, accurate newscasts, while also reporting, shooting, writing and editing original stories for broadcast and digital platforms. This is a visible newsroom role that calls for a dependable teammate, a thoughtful community presence and a calm, flexible approach to breaking news.

Responsibilities
• Anchor THV11 Morning News on Saturday with accuracy, warmth, authority and energy.
• Partner with producers, editors, photographers and newsroom leaders to plan and deliver clear, compelling newscasts; contribute ideas, editorial judgment and strong writing.
• Prepare for each broadcast by reviewing scripts, confirming facts and pronunciations, tracking developing stories and making timely updates as news changes.
• Report, write, shoot, produce and edit original stories and live reports for television, streaming, mobile and social platforms.
• Develop enterprise and community-focused stories through social listening, public records, independent research and trusted local sources.
• Build and maintain relationships with people and organizations throughout Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley, reflecting the range of communities in our viewing area.
• Use social media and digital tools to discover story ideas, engage with the audience and distribute accurate, useful journalism.
• Create or contribute to digital content, including web stories, video, live updates, images and social posts, in coordination with the newsroom.
• Deliver clear, authoritative live coverage during breaking news and severe weather, adapting quickly while following newsroom standards and direction.
• Represent THV11 professionally at community events
• Serve as a fill-in anchor and fulfill other duties as assigned

Requirements
• 1-3 years news anchor/reporting experience preferred
• Journalism, communications or related degree preferred
• Excellent writing, interviewing and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex issues in clear, conversational language.
• Sound editorial judgment and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy, fairness, ethics and accountability.
• Ability to shoot and edit video and produce content for broadcast and digital platforms.
• Experience with newsroom systems, editing tools and graphics
• Ability to report, publish and engage with the community on social media daily.
• Ability to work any shift in a 24/7 newsroom environment
• Knowledge of central Arkansas is a plus

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

job.title: Director, Advertising Sales
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking an accomplished, strategic and results-driven Advertising Sales Director in New York to help build and sell digital advertising solutions. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced sales leader with a proven track record to navigate complex digital media and data targeting solutions, work cross-functionally to develop innovative advertising solutions and build lasting client relationships. You’ll contribute to a high-caliber team in a business that is experiencing rapid and dramatic growth. We are looking for demonstrated performance in a constantly changing, ambiguous environment and problem-solving leadership with limited oversight.

This role will manage Holding Company agency relationships with a focus on the C-Suite, Agency Investment Leads, Brand Teams, Buying Teams, Programmatic Buying Arms and Data Analytics & Strategy Teams. In partnership with senior leadership, this role will develop a strategy specific to assigned holding companies, while driving AccuWeather’s media, data, measurement and analytics revenue. This position requires extensive knowledge of the changing agency & media landscape, the drive to develop industry-transforming strategies and the ability to build relationships with senior agency management and brands direct. The ideal candidate has media agency planning experience, a deep knowledge of measurement & analytics used to evaluate performance, ability to develop and effectively communicate creative ideas and solutions along with a proven ability to influence multiple levels of an organization.

This position will be located onsite at AccuWeather’s New York City office with the expectation of being in office with teammates three days a week.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Achieve and exceed revenue goals set by the company for existing and new accounts. Focus on selling AccuWeather digital advertising products to advertising agency and brand direct partners maintaining and fostering positive relationships across both new and existing clients.
  • Build and elevate relationships at the highest levels within the assigned agencies, C-Suite, Senior Agency Influencers to continuously uncover strategic opportunities to drive AccuWeather revenue on a global, regional, and local level.
  • Serve as internal voice of the agency customer to help shape product and marketing roadmaps. Assess the revenue potential of assigned account list and identify highest value targets.
  • Prospect new business opportunities within territory through regular, thoughtful outreach to new clients/agencies with face-to-face meetings, presentations, events, entertainment and other related efforts.
  • Identify revenue opportunities to grow existing clients/advertising agencies relationships.
  • Client account management including, but not limited to: maintaining contact lists, establishing meeting cadence with (internal and external) key stakeholders, seeking out new relationships/contacts, developing quarterly business reviews, organizing and coordinating agency education initiatives (cross discipline agency days and/or training sessions), fulfilling ad hoc client requests, campaign performance reviews along with client entertaining.
  • Consistent pipeline maintenance, and strong internal communications skills to ensure leadership and cross functional partners are apprise of pipeline updates, progress to goal, territory updates and opportunities, along with challenges
  • Contribute to AccuWeather’s tentpole senior-level events, conferences and activations within assigned agencies.
  • Collaborate with internal specialists (i.e. marketing, strategy, data, operations/analytics) as needed to meet revenue requirements and to continuously identify relevant opportunities for agencies/brands.
  • Contribute to agency holding company partnership level agreements, with opportunity to lead specific initiatives in addition to capturing revenue opportunities at the account level
  • Be a trusted thought leader to both external stakeholders and investment teams by leading consistent customer and prospect education initiatives and events.
  • Operate at the ‘tip of the spear’, immersing in industry shifts (in-housing, rise of independent agencies and consultancies etc.) and competitive offerings, to bring an ‘outside-in’ perspective, framing new sales initiatives and recommendations
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in the industry; act as an ambassador and spokesperson for AccuWeather in the advertising community.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS 

  • BA/BS degree required with 5+ years digital ad sales experience with a focus on digital media, programmatic, first party data and analytics; experience executing large scale brand partnerships across channels ideal.
  • High performer – achieve and exceed revenue targets through effective sales strategies, performance optimization and development of innovative campaign strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically about a particular industry and/or product set to achieve customer goals and KPIs; ability to think creatively to solve problems to maintain and grow revenue, and to break new business
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills along with strong presentation skills in both small and large groups.
  • Familiarity with agency holding companies and strong relationships across the agency and brand direct
  • Ability to work collaboratively amidst cross-functional teams including but not limited to strategy, marketing, ad operations and analytics.
  • Tenacious and driven self-starter who takes a hands-on approach in discovering new business opportunities and proactive outreach with a focus on high-value prospects.
  • Hunter mentality – focus on cold outreach and prospecting to secure meetings with new clients and expanding relationships with existing.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Ability to build internal networks to accomplish goals through collaboration with resources across teams.
  • Driven and solution-oriented and can overcome obstacles to drive projects through completion and can balance the need for quick turnaround with longer-term strategic efforts.
  • Strong writing and copy-editing skills.
  • Comfortable with a fast-paced, always-on, start-up environment
  • Strong belief in AccuWeather's vision and goals

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated marketing abilities, programmatic advertising expertise and experience pitching first party data
  • Exhibits a high level of competency in oral and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated expertise in building relationships with senior agency decision makers.

 

Pay Transparency: AccuWeather offers a competitive salary commensurate to experience in the range of $130K - $150K base + commission.

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion 

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.  
 
AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Community Connections - Central Coast & Southern Central Valley
job.description:
At Scripps, we believe strong local journalism starts with strong community connections. As the Sr. Manager, Community Connections for the Central Coast (KSBY) and Southern Central Valley (KERO), you’ll serve as the station’s primary connector to the Central Coast community and Southern Central Valley Coast, building trusted relationships that deepen local engagement, inform our journalism, and create meaningful partnerships. You’ll bring community voices and insights into the newsroom while helping ensure questions, concerns, and story ideas are heard and acted on thoughtfully. Working across News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership, you’ll turn community intelligence into opportunities for greater impact. Your work will help ensure these communities remains an essential, responsive, and trusted part of community life. This position will be located on-site at KSBY in San Luis Obispo, CA.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, government, and other community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and share community insights with station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to help inform decision-making, journalism, and local engagement.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and strengthen audience engagement across community channels.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and develop partnerships that create long-term value, trust, and local impact.
  • Respond to community members, partners, and stakeholders with timely, professional communication, ensuring audience questions, concerns, and story tips are acknowledged, routed, and resolved appropriately.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Collaborate with News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and station leadership to develop meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics and stakeholder coordination while measuring effectiveness to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities, advising leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and helping build engagement capabilities across teams.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of relevant experience preferred.
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or a related field.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills, with the ability to establish credibility across a wide range of communities and organizations.
  • Strong community listening skills and the ability to recognize emerging issues, needs, and opportunities.
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to translate community insights into meaningful action.
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, station leadership, and external community organizations.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion, and integrity when working with diverse communities and sensitive topics.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and adapt effectively to changing community and business needs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM or community relationship platforms, and collaboration tools.
  • A strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills, and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns, and sensitive community issues.

Application Review: Applications received by November 9, 2026 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


OUR TEAM:

We’re a team of journalists, storytellers, relationship builders, and community advocates who care deeply about the people and places we serve. At KSBY, we bring different backgrounds, perspectives, interests, and experiences to our work, united by a shared commitment to meaningful local journalism and stronger communities. You’ll work alongside collaborative colleagues who value curiosity, authenticity, responsiveness, and finding new ways to connect with audiences both inside and outside the newsroom.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

San Luis Obispo offers an incredible Central Coast lifestyle, surrounded by rolling hills and within easy reach of California’s coastline. The area blends an active outdoor lifestyle with a welcoming community, local restaurants, wineries, farmers markets, arts, and plenty of opportunities to hike, bike, explore, and enjoy the outdoors.

As Sr. Manager, Community Connections, you’ll have the opportunity to build relationships with the people and organizations that shape San Luis Obispo and communities across the Central Coast. Whether you’re attending a community event, meeting with local leaders, or discovering the stories people are talking about, you’ll be immersed in the communities KSBY serves.

job.description:
KNXV, The E.W. Scripps ABC affiliate in Phoenix, Arizona, is looking for an Executive Reporter who is as passionate about the craft of storytelling as they are about the community. In this role, you'll leading, inspiring, and mentoring reporters and MMJs at every level to discover powerful ways to grow their storytelling skills. You'll partner with newsroom leaders to execute a content strategy rooted in authenticity, impact, and journalistic integrity, all while shaping a culture where great stories aren't just told — they're felt. If you're ready to elevate the voices that matter most and leave a lasting mark on local journalism in one of the country's most vibrant and fast-growing cities, we want to hear from you. 

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead, develop, and enhance the storytelling skill and abilities of all reporters and MMJs in the station.
  • Collaborate with other newsroom leaders to consistently execute the content strategy through authentic, meaningful storytelling .
  • Oversee the writing of stories for all platforms; provide timely feedback to foster continuous improvement.
  • Develop and supervise effective workflow strategies and procedures for multiple news programs and outlets.
  • Ensure that all content adheres to journalistic standards and ethical guidelines.
  • Deliver a vision and create trust among reporters, photographers and newsroom staff.
  • May provide on-air, multi-platform coverage for breaking news as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in related field preferred

  • Knowledge and demonstration of editorial judgment, journalistic ethics and libel laws
  • Curiosity for the community, city, state and world we report on daily
  • Deep understanding of the content strategy
  • Ability to work a variety of shifts including nights, weekends, early morning, and holidays

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Phoenix, Arizona, is one of the most dynamic and fast-growing cities in the United States — a sprawling desert metropolis that blends stunning natural beauty with a thriving urban energy. Surrounded by the Sonoran Desert, Phoenix offers year-round sunshine and unmatched outdoor adventures, from hiking the iconic trails of Camelback Mountain and South Mountain Park to exploring the scenic beauty of the Tonto National Forest just an hour away. The city is a haven for golf enthusiasts, cyclists, and outdoor lovers of all kinds.

Beyond the desert landscape, Phoenix boasts a rich and diverse cultural scene. The city is home to world-class museums like the Heard Museum, dedicated to Native American art and culture, and the Phoenix Art Museum, one of the largest art museums in the Southwest. The downtown core is alive with acclaimed restaurants, craft breweries, and a vibrant nightlife, while neighborhoods like Roosevelt Row serve as the beating heart of the local arts community. From the Phoenix Symphony to the bustling farmers markets and food halls, there is always something new to discover.

Sports are a way of life in the Valley of the Sun. Phoenix is home to the NFL's Cardinals, the NBA's Suns, the MLB's Diamondbacks, the NHL's Coyotes, and the WNBA's Mercury — giving residents a full calendar of live sports action. job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is a healthcare-focused media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization dedicated to helping life sciences brands create more meaningful customer relationships. Through integrated media, omnichannel strategy, CRM, analytics, and engagement solutions, we help clients design and activate connected experiences across the healthcare ecosystem.

The Associate Director, Client Experience (Media) leads integrated media and omnichannel planning across complex pharmaceutical and life sciences accounts. This role is responsible for translating business objectives, customer insights, and audience needs into strategic media programs that engage healthcare professionals, patients, and caregivers while driving measurable business performance.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What You'll Do

  • Lead integrated planning across paid, earned, owned, and omnichannel engagement initiatives.
  • Develop strategic HCP and DTC media recommendations informed by audience insights, market conditions, and business objectives.
  • Oversee media investment strategies, channel mix recommendations, measurement frameworks, and optimization plans.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor for clients navigating evolving healthcare engagement challenges.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with Strategy, CRM, Analytics, Creative, and Activation teams.
  • Guide campaign performance discussions and identify opportunities for innovation and growth.
  • Manage and develop planning talent while maintaining excellence across all client deliverables.

This Position is a Perfect Fit for You If

  • You are a strategic thinker who enjoys turning complex business challenges into integrated media and customer engagement solutions.
  • You understand how media, omnichannel engagement, CRM, analytics, content, and customer experience work together to influence behavior.
  • You can comfortably advise pharmaceutical and life sciences clients on media investment decisions, audience strategy, and performance optimization.
  • You enjoy building strong client partnerships and are viewed as a trusted problem solver rather than simply a service provider.
  • You bring a point of view to discussions, supported by data, research, experience, and industry trends.
  • You are comfortable leading teams while also remaining actively involved in strategic thinking and client problem solving.
  • You enjoy mentoring others and raising the quality standard across a broader portfolio of work.
  • You are motivated by helping healthcare brands create more meaningful, measurable customer experiences.

What You Should Have

  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare media experience.
  • Deep expertise across integrated media planning and omnichannel customer engagement.
  • Experience developing HCP and DTC media strategies for complex brands or therapeutic areas.
  • Strong client leadership, presentation, and storytelling abilities.
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple client relationships and teams.

Position Overview

The Promotions & Activation Lead for CMG Atlanta Radio reports directly to the Promotions and Activations Manager and closely partners with sales and content teams to assist with the implementation of client promotions, and events that drive revenue and/or listenership for four radio stations including B98.5 (WSB-FM / Adult Contemporary), 97.1 The River (WSRV / Classic Hits-Rock), KISS 104.1 (WALR / Urban Adult Contemporary) and 95.5 WSB (WSB-AM WSBB-FM /  News-Talk).

 

Exceptional communication, planning, leadership, creative, analytical and digital skills are a requirement. Oversight of events and promotions will require working nights and weekends regularly.  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Coordinate promotions for programming and sales including community programs, contesting, social media partnerships and more
  • Coordinate station events including scheduling staff, setting up signage/tents/activation areas, conducting site visits in advance, working with vendors and security, and planning event layout
  • Manage the fulfillment of all prizes including winner communication, eligibility verification, required paperwork, prize distribution and accurate records
  • Attend station, client and community events as needed during the week and weekends to supervise and assist the Activation Specialists as requested by the Promotions and Activations Manager
  • Assist in creating proposals, recaps and other materials to help the sales team sell station events and programs
  • Create and manage promotions-based content for station social media channels and assist programming with additional content as needed
  • Keep station vehicles stocked, clean and maintained
  • Ensure all equipment is in working condition

  • Partner with CMG Legal and other internal resources to generate contest rules
  • Recruit and manage a team of part-time Activation Specialists in partnership with the Promotions and Activations Manager
  • Keep accurate records of all prize values awarded to winners and compile quarterly winner reports for tax purposes

  • Strong organizational, planning, problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment

job.description:
Associate, Reporting & Finance System Administration Specialist

The Associate, Reporting & Finance System Administration Specialist supports the daily administration, reporting, and operational effectiveness of the organization's financial systems. This role assists with system support, report development, data validation, troubleshooting, and user support across Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, BlackLine, and other finance applications.

Partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Shared Services, and IT teams, this individual helps ensure data integrity, reporting accuracy, and efficient financial operations while contributing to process improvement and system enhancement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Systems Administration & Support

  • Provide day-to-day support for Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, BlackLine, and related finance applications.
  • Troubleshoot system and reporting issues, escalating more complex matters as needed.
  • Support user access, security administration, and master data maintenance.
  • Assist with system testing, upgrades, patches, and enhancements.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities by resolving system-related issues.

Reporting & Data Management

  • Develop and maintain, standard and ad hoc financial reports.
  • Validate financial data and investigate reporting discrepancies.
  • Monitor data quality and support reconciliations across systems.
  • Maintain reporting documentation, standards, and data definitions.
  • Assist with data validation during system updates and enhancements.

Process Improvement & Projects

  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and automation.
  • Support implementation of process improvements and system enhancements.
  • Participate in upgrades, implementations, and finance technology projects.
  • Assist with business requirements gathering, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and issue tracking.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, training materials, and end-user guides.

Collaboration & Customer Support

  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, Shared Services, IT, and business stakeholders.
  • Provide responsive support and clear communication regarding system issues, updates, and process changes.
  • Build strong working relationships with users and cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 1-3 years of experience in finance systems support, accounting operations, financial reporting, business analysis, or a related field.
  • Experience working with ERP systems, financial applications, or reporting tools.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Preferred

  • Experience with Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, BlackLine, or similar financial systems.
  • Experience supporting financial reporting, data analysis, or business intelligence initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Power BI or comparable reporting platforms.
  • Exposure to Finance, Accounting, Shared Services, or IT operations.

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
The Executive Assistant provides high-level administrative and operational support to two senior executives in a fast-paced, highly visible environment. This role manages complex calendars, meeting preparation, travel, expenses, communications, and projects while anticipating priorities and helping the executives remain organized and focused.   The Executive Assistant serves as a key liaison with internal and external stakeholders and regularly handles highly confidential information. Success requires exceptional judgment, discretion, attention to detail, organization, adaptability, and the ability to anticipate needs and act proactively with limited supervision.

Responsibilities

  • Manage complex, frequently changing executive calendars, coordinating meetings across multiple time zones, resolving scheduling conflicts, and proactively protecting time for critical priorities.
  • Anticipate the executives' day-to-day needs and priorities, proactively identifying scheduling issues, meeting requirements, emerging developments, and matters requiring timely attention or follow-up.
  • Coordinate and prepare executives for meetings and appointments, including agendas, briefing and presentation materials, conference rooms, audio/visual requirements, conference calls, external guests, and related logistics.
  • Plan and coordinate complex domestic and international travel, developing detailed itineraries that integrate transportation, accommodations, meetings, agendas, and other logistical requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted liaison and point of contact among the executives, their direct reports, other Executive Assistants, and internal and external stakeholders, exercising professionalism, diplomacy, tact, and discretion.
  • Manage executive communications and information flow, including reviewing and prioritizing correspondence, drafting and editing communications, memos, reports, and presentations, and ensuring time-sensitive matters receive appropriate attention and follow-through.
  • Exercise sound independent judgment when executives are unavailable, assessing urgency, making appropriate administrative decisions, escalating critical matters, and maintaining confidentiality.
  • Coordinate large and complex meetings and executive activities, ensuring materials, participants, technology, facilities, security, and other logistical requirements are organized and executed effectively.
  • Manage executive and departmental administrative processes, including preparing, reconciling, and submitting invoices and credit card expenses in Concur and maintaining accurate internal and external contact information.
  • Maintain awareness of relevant sports business developments, organizational initiatives, and department priorities, identifying information, deadlines, or developments requiring executive awareness or action.
  • Build strong working partnerships with Executive Assistants, direct reports, facilities, travel, IT, security, and other key stakeholders to facilitate effective executive operations.
  • Provide additional administrative and project support as needed, including document and records management, shipping and mail coordination, and other assignments that support executive and department priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 4+ years of administrative or executive assistant experience supporting a senior-level executive.
  • Significant proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong technology skills, including experience working across PC and Mac environments and mobile devices.
  • Demonstrated experience handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex calendars, meetings, travel, communications, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, solve problems independently, and follow through on commitments with limited supervision.
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated project-management capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Experience in the digital, entertainment, or sports industry.
  • Fast and accurate typing skills.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics

  • Proactive and anticipatory: Consistently thinks ahead, identifies needs and potential issues early, and takes appropriate action.
  • Judgment and discretion: Handles confidential and sensitive information appropriately and makes thoughtful decisions in high-pressure situations.
  • Executive presence and diplomacy: Communicates effectively and professionally with senior executives, high-profile individuals, colleagues, and external partners.
  • Organization and execution: Effectively manages multiple priorities, deadlines, details, and changing requirements while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.
  • Composure and adaptability: Remains calm, solution-oriented, and effective in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Resourcefulness and problem solving: Approaches challenges with curiosity, sound judgment, resilience, and a continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Collaboration: Builds trusted relationships across functions and works effectively with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.

job.title: Digital Strategist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WUSA9, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Washington, DC, is looking for a detail-oriented, proactive Digital Strategist to be the go-to expert behind our digital and streaming (CTV/OTT) business. You’ll partner with Account Executives, Account Managers, and sales leaders to build smart digital solutions and make sure campaigns launch and run flawlessly. You’ll also turn campaign data into clear stories that grow revenue and strengthen client relationships. This client-facing role is for someone who sweats the details, spots opportunities before anyone asks, and is always looking to raise the bar.

Responsibilities

  • Own campaign accuracy from proposal through launch and wrap, working with Account Managers and fulfillment teams on setup, execution, and optimization.
  • Monitor campaign performance closely, flag issues early, and recommend optimizations before clients ask.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert on client performance calls, proposals, and quarterly business reviews.
  • Turn complex campaign data into simple, clear stories that clients and sellers can act on.
  • Use campaign and category insights to find revenue opportunities for sellers, such as upsells, gaps in current campaigns, and new prospects.
  • Build case studies and attribution reports that show results and help sellers win new business.
  • Partner with Account Executives on custom campaigns across digital, streaming, and broadcast.
  • Build strong client relationships by learning each client’s business, goals, and competitive landscape.
  • Train and support sellers on digital products, data, and best practices.
  • Find smarter ways to work, including using AI and automation to improve speed and accuracy.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience (preferred) in digital media, campaign management, ad operations, or digital sales support.
  • Strong knowledge of CTV/OTT, targeted display, and campaign measurement and attribution.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines without letting anything slip.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, and comfortable making decisions and owning outcomes.
  • An analytical mindset, with the ability to simplify data and tell a clear story.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills with clients, sellers, and internal partners.
  • Sales-minded, with a drive to grow client relationships and revenue.
  • Curious and eager to learn. Experience with AI tools is a plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, plus experience with ad-serving platforms and CRM software such as Salesforce.
  • Google Ads and IAB certifications are a plus.
