job.title: Vice President, Marketing Strategy
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR’s Marketing team is responsible for building and growing our audience for podcasts, programs, and platforms. The team seeks to grow the reach and impact of everything NPR puts out in the world—from our up-to-the-minute digital and broadcast content to our on-demand podcasts, events, videos, website, and app  The Vice President, Marketing Strategy leads the operational planning and execution of comprehensive marketing strategies across NPR's portfolio. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, this role manages a team of marketing professionals to execute targeted initiatives that attract, grow, and retain diverse audiences for NPR while driving brand alignment and engagement across all channels. 

Responsibilities

  • Partner across divisions to identify emerging audience opportunities and propose initiatives and campaigns aligned with NPR’s strategic goals.
  • Directly manage, guide, and mentor a team of marketing professionals overseeing audience development work on NPR products, podcasts, and platforms.
  • Define target audiences, perform competitive landscape analyses, identify market opportunities, establish messaging frameworks, and set KPIs to launch new properties and sustainably grow audiences.
  • Create cohesion and consistency across marketing strategy work by lifting up best practices, strengthening and reimagining workflows, and deepening team collaboration.
  • Maintain and enforce a consistent brand expression, voice, and positioning across all channels and consumer touchpoints.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to develop third-party publisher and brand partnerships to grow, diversify, and acquire new audiences.
  • Strengthen the marketing team’s commitment to cultivating meaningful, collaborative partnerships with our network of Member stations.
  • In close collaboration with the CMO, set operational priorities, allocate staff effectively, and manage project workflows.
  • Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships to ensure Marketing’s capabilities, role, and integration across the organization are clear.
  • Measure project success using industry-standard metrics (Nielsen ratings, Cume, AQH, CTR, downloads, etc.) to evaluate show and podcast campaign performance.
  • Support and optimize NPR’s consumer products marketing strategy to expand brand reach and complement revenue initiatives.
  • Select, manage, and hold accountable external partners, such as digital ad agencies.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 12 to 15+ years of progressive marketing experience, with at least 7+ years in a senior management role overseeing multidisciplinary teams and project budgets.
  • Proven track record of operationalizing strategic goals into execution roadmaps, managing competing priorities, and leading cross-functional project teams through complex, deadline-driven product or campaign launches. 
  • Hands-on experience conceptualizing, building, and executing end-to-end integrated marketing campaigns across multiple distribution touchpoints—including broadcast, podcasting, digital display, social media, email lifecycle marketing, and mobile app ecosystems. 
  • Demonstrated proficiency in establishing performance benchmarks and leveraging audience measurement metrics (such as Nielsen ratings, Cume, AQH, CTR, downloads, active users, and conversion rates) to evaluate, optimize, and report on campaign ROI. 
  • Strong listening, writing, and speaking skills.
  • Knowledge of best marketing practices for email, display ads, websites, and apps.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of the public media landscape, preferably with direct experience either at a Member station or in close collaboration with federated systems.
  • Experience managing external creative or digital advertising agency relationships.
  • Experience supporting product marketing, merchandising, or consumer brand expansion
  • Demonstrated understanding of the unique dynamics, revenue models, and collaborative touchpoints between national network programming and local station engagement. 
  • Hands-on experience working alongside product development, digital design, and editorial teams to align marketing strategy directly with audience UX and content lifecycle management. 

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Exceptional collaboration skills with a proven ability to work cross-functionally and gain the respect and support of internal and external clients.
  • Deep knowledge of modern audience acquisition, retention, and engagement practices across broadcast, podcasting, digital display, social media, lifecycle email marketing, and mobile app ecosystems. 
  • Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Creative mindset with a passion for marketing, advertising, design, and storytelling.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust, drive consensus, and maintain productive relationships across diverse departments (editorial, product development, legal, finance, and revenue teams). 

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degree (e.g., MBA) preferred.

Work Location & Requirements

NPR Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid-permitted role based in one of NPR’s office locations: New York City, Washington, D.C., or Los Angeles. Employees are expected to work from their designated office at least three days per week and must reside within commuting distance of their assigned office.

Job Type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

job.title: Senior Product Manager
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking a strategic and results-oriented Senior Manager, Digital Subscriptions to grow our subscription offerings across mobile, web, and connected platforms. This role is instrumental in defining the roadmap for our digital subscription services, driving audience growth and revenue, and ensuring competitiveness in a fast-evolving landscape. Reporting directly to the SVP of Digital Strategy, the successful candidate will bring deep expertise in subscription ecosystems, customer segmentation, product packaging, pricing strategy, and cross-functional leadership.

 

Key Responsibilities:

· Define and execute end-to-end product and go-to-market strategies for digital subscription offerings across all consumer segments.

· Conduct assessments of Total Addressable Market (TAM), perform customer segmentation and needs analysis, and develop pricing models and packaging strategies to drive business growth.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including design, engineering, marketing, sales, operations, and business development—to ensure a unified approach to product development and market execution.

· Monitor market trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to identify strategic opportunities and potential threats.

· Build and maintain robust financial models to support decision-making, forecast performance, and prioritize investment opportunities.

· Analyze user behavior and business performance using quantitative and qualitative data to inform product roadmap and feature prioritization.

· Serve as a key voice in business development efforts, providing product insight and support for partnership and audience acquisition opportunities.

· Communicate key findings, strategic recommendations, and performance updates to senior leadership and stakeholders.

 

Qualifications:

· 7+ years of experience in digital product management, with at least 5 years developing and executing go-to-market strategies.

· Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Digital Media, or related field; MBA preferred.

· Proven success in managing consumer-facing digital subscription products across multiple platforms.

· Deep understanding of the digital subscription ecosystem and associated business models.

· Experience across product marketing, pricing, sales enablement, and communications, with a strong ability to resolve complex internal and external challenges.

· Strong strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and creative problem-solving abilities.

· Demonstrated experience in cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management.

· Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and inspire across all levels of the organization.

· Skilled in financial analysis and scenario modeling to support strategic initiatives.

Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment. Together we keep the world cheering. 

 

Position Summary: 

AXS is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end strategy and execution of our Resale platform. This role is responsible for the core marketplace engine that powers secondary ticketing across the AXS ecosystem, including resale listings ingestion and distribution, inventory and pricing services, event and venue data models, partner and marketplace integrations, public-facing APIs, and the platform services that connect fan demand with resale supply across thousands of events each year.  

Success requires balancing platform scalability, data integrity, marketplace health, and delivery velocity while evolving the core engine to support new partners, markets, and fan experiences.  

The ideal candidate combines strong product instincts with a deep technical foundation and a systems-modeling mindset. You are comfortable leading engineering teams through domain and data modeling, API and data contract design, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and platform integrations while translating those capabilities into measurable business and marketplace outcomes. You are execution-focused and thrive on turning ambiguous problems into clear requirements, well-sequenced roadmaps, and shipped software.   

You will work closely with Engineering (including onshore and offshore delivery teams), Architecture, Data, Payments, Partner Experience, and business stakeholders to deliver a scalable, reliable resale platform that grows marketplace liquidity and improves the fan experience across the live event lifecycle. 

Essential Functions: 

As a Senior Product Manager you will be accountable for: 

  • Defining product vision, roadmap, and priorities for the core Resale platform engine across the AXS ecosystem. 
  • Establish platform priorities that balance scalability, reliability, modernization, and marketplace growth.  
  • Own platform capabilities delivered through APIs, data contracts, integrations, event-driven services, and backend systems that power resale listings, inventory, and pricing.  
  • Lead systems and domain modeling for core resale entities, including events, venues, seating, listings, inventory, and transactions, to create a durable and extensible platform foundation. 
  • Serve as the day-to-day product leader for Engineering, driving sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria through delivery. 
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture to define API standards, service-level objectives, reliability goals, and operational readiness standards. 
  • Drive product decisions using marketplace metrics, platform telemetry, observability, and performance data. 
  • Own capacity planning and delivery sequencing with engineering leadership, managing dependencies across onshore and offshore teams. 
  • Partnering with the Partner Experience team to ensure platform capabilities, APIs, and integrations are ready for external partner and developer adoption. 
  • Identifying and prioritizing improvements that reduce technical debt, data quality issues, and integration friction across the resale ecosystem. 
  • Develop a deep understanding of secondary ticketing, marketplace supply and demand dynamics, and resale workflows.  
  • Lead modernization efforts across legacy resale and listing systems while maintaining marketplace continuity.  
  • Define and monitor KPIs related to platform reliability, data quality, listing coverage, performance, and delivery predictability. 
  • Communicate roadmap, risks, priorities, and outcomes clearly across technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership. 
  • Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and influence decisions through data-driven insights and customer understanding. 

 

We are looking for: 

 

Required Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience delivering complex software products in Agile environments. 
  • Demonstrated success owning technical products, platforms, APIs, SDKs, integrations, or enterprise software solutions. 
  • Experience partnering closely with engineering teams to deliver platform, integration, or infrastructure-adjacent products within modern distributed architectures. 
  • Experience supporting mission-critical workflows where reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency are essential. 
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures, distributed systems, operational telemetry, observability, and data-driven product decision making. 
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex ecosystems spanning modern platforms, legacy systems, integrations, and operational processes. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to define ambiguous problems, synthesize data, and deliver measurable outcomes. 
  • Proven ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and technical constraints while driving product strategy and execution. 
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align technical and non-technical stakeholders across organizational boundaries. 
  • Systems thinker with a platform-oriented mindset who can connect business processes, technical systems, operational workflows, and customer experiences to build scalable solutions. 
  • Curious, data-driven, and comfortable operating in complex environments, with a strong bias toward continuous improvement, experimentation, and measurable outcomes. 
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

 

  • Background building platform products that enable external partners through APIs, SDKs, integrations, or developer ecosystems. 
  • Track record of modernizing legacy operational systems while balancing migration risk, business continuity, and long-term platform evolution. 
  • Familiarity with software-plus-hardware ecosystems, including mobile applications, hardware integrations, edge devices, or operational technology environments. 
  • Understanding of service reliability, operational readiness, performance objectives, and incident management practices. 
  • Proven ability to design configurable platform capabilities that support regional variation while maintaining a scalable core product. 
  • Exposure to complex global organizations and products serving multiple international markets. 
  • Domain expertise in live entertainment, ticketing, venue operations, access control, identity, payments, transportation, hospitality, logistics, or other operationally intensive industries.

 

 

At AXS, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but can't "check every box" in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

job.description:

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Manager to join our growing team!

 

As an Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium-sized projects. As a captain, you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead.

 

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans
  • Take responsibility for the day-to-day management of your account, including managing the processes of the account (including running regular internal team meetings), flow of work (review content developed by more junior team members), delegation of tasks (oversee status reports to ensure all team actions are complete) and the status of jobs across the account (not just your own)
  • Ownership of and accountability for medium-sized client projects, ensuring that projects are delivered to highest possible standards within budget and agreed timeframes
  • Actively demonstrate an understanding of your clients’ needs (building an awareness of their strategy and brand) and preferences in your interactions and the delivery of work
  • Confidently develop written content (briefing documents, etc) and gain experience reviewing junior team members’ work, ensuring content is accurate and developed to a high standard ahead of more senior review

 

Business development

  • Start to identify areas for growth (evolving existing programmes and/or additional tactics), proactively sharing new ideas with your team and client
  • Take an active role in new business, which may include undertaking and presenting research to the pitch team, or facilitating team input via brainstorms/presenting as part of the pitch team

 

Team management

  • Maintain an awareness of the professional development of more junior team members on your accounts, through regular catch ups and interactions
  • Develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members
  • Buddy new SAA/AM starters

 

Financial management

  • Develop a greater understanding of the account finances beyond your projects, proactively supporting your account lead with financial management including managing Salesforce opportunities, invoicing and forecasting
  • Develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting on previous projects and gathering cost quotes
  • Manage the budget for projects that you own, feeding into your account lead as part of the broader programme finances; identify where project is going out of scope and alert your account lead with details of additional budget required
  • Input into the resourcing process by sharing with your account/medical writer lead the requirements for your projects
  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)
  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

 

What you should have:

  • Relevant degree in a scientific subject
  • Highly organised with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail
  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration
  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines
  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable
  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget
  • Ability to develop project scopes and vendor contracts
  • Excellent business communication ability, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills
  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

 

We are seeking a business-oriented Digital Analyst to join our Global Centre of Excellence (COE) in Mumbai. This role will play a critical part in enabling digital first decision making across across Global Procurement and Real Estate & Workplace Solutions (REWS).

The analyst will act as a digital partner for both functions – Primarily focussed on Procurement where the resource will act as a product owner for Current Source to Contract solution for WPP Procurement (GEP) and also for any future tools. The resource will also be responsible for all

This is a hands-on role requiring strong analytical capability, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership.

 

Digital & System Support – Procurement

· Support the Global Director in managing the Procurement digital roadmap, including enhancements, automation opportunities, and future solution design.

· Assist in the design, testing, rollout, and adoption of source-to-contract and supplier-related systems.

· Maintain and improve Procurement system processes, including user access, onboarding/offboarding, templates, and compliance with internal policies and quality standards.

· Monitor system performance, identify issues, and coordinate resolution with internal and external technology partners.

· Support the development and maintenance of Procurement portals, dashboards, and reporting tools to improve visibility of supplier, spend, and performance data.

· Help identify opportunities for automation, AI-enabled workflows, and smarter ways of working.

Digital & Systems Support – REWS

· Support the onboarding, adoption, and ongoing management of REWS systems and tools.

· Act as a super user for platforms such as JLL Azara, Tango Analytics, CoStar, and other relevant REWS applications.

· Conduct analysis to understand business needs, identify gaps, and support solution enhancements.

· Partner with stakeholders to ensure tools and systems are effectively used to support workplace and real estate decisions.

Analytics, Governance & Reporting

· Provide analysis, reporting, and insights to support the Global Director and leadership teams in making informed decisions.

· Track and report key metrics such as:

o user adoption

o compliance

o issue resolution

job.title: (Senior) Data Engineer – Data Modeling & Core Systems
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why We’re Hiring

We are scaling the core engineering capability behind real-time, high-throughput ad-tech infrastructure that processes large-scale audience data at global scale.

This is not a role for basic ETL scripts or glue code. In this role, data engineering is treated as a true software engineering discipline. You will take deep technical ownership of complex, multi-layered data models (canonical schemas, high-dimensional behavioral signals, and vector embeddings) that power live targeting and measurement decisions for advertisers worldwide.

You’ll help evolve a distributed, production-grade data platform while collaborating with a high-trust engineering team that values clean architecture, continuous improvement (kaizen), and modern development standards.

 

Who You’ll Be Working With

You’ll work closely with fellow engineers across backend systems, Quality Assurance, Analytics, and connector teams. We value teamwork over ego, collaboration over competition, open and honest communication, strong opinions held with curiosity, and delivering well-tested, maintainable code.

Our Technology Environment

  • Languages & Core: Scala, functional programming, strongly typed distributed services
  • Processing & Streaming: Apache Spark for large-scale distributed processing, event-driven architectures
  • Cloud & Storage: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, Parquet
  • Engineering Standards: Automated CI/CD, robust unit & integration testing, Git workflows, and Tyda (our open-source, automation-driven SDLC process)

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own and evolve production data models spanning input/output models, schema evolution, field types, and partitioning strategies across multi-stage distributed pipelines.
  • Maintain and extend our audience framework, normalizing high-velocity raw inputs into standardized, canonical formats across behavioral signals, demographics, and brand affinity.
  • Design and manage models handling relational structures, real-time behavioral signals, high-dimensional embeddings, and anomaly detection.
  • Develop and maintain Spark-based data services in Scala and GCP, adhering to software design patterns, modular architecture, and edge-case resilience.
  • Lead by example with automated unit/integration testing, strict code reviews, Git branching discipline, and CI/CD best practices.
  • Partner with QA, Analytics, and downstream product teams to guarantee contract integrity, data correctness, and reliable system consumption.

 

What You’ll Need

  • 3+ years of software engineering or data engineering experience, with a proven track record of shipping production-grade distributed data systems.
  • Production experience writing quality code in Scala OR another statically typed language (Java, Kotlin, C#, Go). If your background is in Java/Kotlin/Go, you are eager and excited to build in a Scala-first environment.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating on large codebases with automated testing (unit/integration testing), version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and structured code reviews.
  • Proven ability to design and reason about complex, multi-layered data architectures (e.g., canonical schemas, dimensional modeling, Data Vault, or domain-driven data design).
  • Solid experience with Apache Spark (or similar distributed frameworks) handling high-volume datasets.
  • Experience with GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Storage) or equivalent cloud data platforms (AWS/Azure).
  • The ability to explain complex data models, schema trade-offs, and technical designs clearly to both technical and product stakeholders.

What Makes This Role Different? Real Software Rigor. You won't just be stitching together SaaS tools; you'll be writing modular, compiled, testable code for real-time systems.

job.title: Meteorologist I
job.description:
We are seeking a meteorologist with strong forecasting and communication skills to join the AccuWeather Forecasting Team at our Global Headquarters in State College, Pennsylvania, beginning January or February 2027. We are looking for someone who is collaborative, curious, and passionate about helping people and businesses make the best weather-informed decisions. Our mission is to save lives, protect property, and help people plan with confidence. If you want to grow your career on a team that is committed to Superior Accuracy™, this opening is for you!

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Meteorologist I, you will prepare and communicate impact-driven forecasts that power AccuWeather’s app, website, and business solutions used by millions worldwide. These include:

· Prepare specialized weather forecasts and products for media outlets, business clients, and digital platforms.

· Collaborate with colleagues to evaluate data, discuss differing analyses, and reach consensus on predicted weather outcomes.

· Communicate complex weather scenarios clearly through verbal briefings, written products, and digital forecasts.

· Monitor new weather data, determine whether forecast adjustments are needed, and communicate updates to customers.

· Contribute to special projects such as quality assurance, process improvement, customer support, or research and development.

· Stay current on emerging forecasting tools, models, and techniques, and learn to use AI and machine learning to improve forecasting efficiency, and streamline product creation and dissemination.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

· Bachelor’s degree in Meteorology or Atmospheric Sciences, or equivalent education and experience.

· Eligibility for membership in the American Meteorological Society or National Weather Association.

· Proven forecasting skills across multiple regions or weather types.

· Ability to translate complex meteorological data into clear, accurate forecasts.

· Excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills.

· Strong collaboration and leadership abilities in a team-based environment.

· Availability to work evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays.

· All levels of forecasting experience are encouraged to apply.

 

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

 

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion 

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.  
 
AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: KIDZ BOP, Video Editing and Production Coordinator
job.description:
Overview

Founded in 2008, BMG is committed to building the world’s most trusted, forward-looking music company. Following its combination with Concord in 2026, BMG brings together global scale, deep expertise, technology, and partnership to unlock new opportunities for creators while protecting and growing the long-term value and cultural impact of their work.  

 

Headquartered in Nashville with 18 offices globally, BMG is privately held and part of Bertelsmann, the international media, services and education company, with a minority stake held by affiliates of Great Mountain Partners. 

 

KIDZ BOP is the #1 music brand for kids, featuring today's biggest hits, "sung by kids for kids." Since 2001, the family friendly music brand has generated 14 billion streams and currently records in 5 different languages. The brand connects with its fans through year-round music releases, music videos, in-school activations, global partnerships, a dedicated channel on SiriusXM (KIDZ BOP Radio channel 135) and live tours. Each year, KIDZ BOP LIVE, the ultimate pop concert for kids (and grown-ups) hits all major cities across the US. 

Responsibilities

Your Mission:

KIDZ BOP is looking for a creative, highly organized Video Editor & Production Coordinator to support video content across social media, music, marketing, live events and brand partnerships.

 

The ideal candidate is a strong editor who stays current on TikTok, Reels and YouTube trends, brings creative ideas to the table and is comfortable supporting video production from pre-production through post.

 

What You'll Be Doing:

Video Editing & Creative

• Edit video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, live tour, music releases and marketing.• Create engaging edits using captions, graphics, pop-ups, sound effects, transitions and music-driven pacing.• Stay current on social video trends and help develop fun content ideas that connect with kids and parents.• Take creative feedback well and make revisions quickly.• Explore new editing tools and AI video platforms such as Runway.

Video Production

• Help coordinate approximately 15 KIDZ BOP video shoots per year, including scheduling, call sheets, equipment and freelance crews.• Work with outside production companies and freelancers.• Support shoots on set as needed, including occasional travel, evenings and weekend shoots.• Comfortable with all aspects of smaller scale production including camera, lighting, and sound.• Help build and maintain a network of freelance editors, shooters, motion designers and production crew.

Asset & Project Management

• Manage in-house edit priorities and video requests.• Maintain organized production servers and the KIDZ BOP Video Archive.• Manage video delivery to outside partners and platforms.

Budget & Department Support

• Assist with production budgets and tracking.• Organize invoices and department expenses.• Support additional video and production needs as required.

Qualifications

What You Bring:

• Strong video editing skills with experience in Adobe Premiere.• Working knowledge of After Effects and Adobe Creative Cloud.• Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and current editing trends.• Strong sense of pacing, music, humor and visual storytelling.• Creative thinker who can pitch ideas as well as execute them.• Highly collaborative, open to feedback and comfortable working through multiple rounds of edits.• Organized, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple projects at once.• Experience with AI video or editing tools is a plus.• Experience working with children or family content is a plus.• Existing network of freelance video and production talent is a plus.• Ability to travel and work occasional evenings and weekends based on production schedules.

 

Salary: $55,000/year

 

*This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days minimum on-site.

 

Please include a portfolio or reel with examples of your editing work, especially short-form or social content.

 

BMG is an equal opportunity employer. We employ, train, compensate and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We believe that diversity, inclusion and equity is paramount for the creation of music, theater and film that celebrates and empowers all cultures.

job.title: LA Kings - Sr Director Human Resources
job.description:
The LA Kings are where hockey, culture, and community come together. As one of the most iconic franchises in the NHL, the Kings deliver high‑energy games, unforgettable moments, and a game‑night experience that goes far beyond the ice.

Owned by AEG, the LA Kings are powered by teams who bring passion, precision, and pride to everything they do, from game‑day operations and fan experiences to the work that happens behind the scenes. Every role plays a part in creating nights fans remember and a culture that represents Los Angeles.   If you want to be part of a team where the work matters on and off the ice, there’s a place for you here. You’re part of what makes it happen.

Job Summary

The Sr Director Human Resources provides strategic and operational leadership for the human resources function supporting the AEG Sports properties, including the LA Kings and Ontario Reign. The role serves as a senior advisor to business leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, leadership coaching, employee relations, talent strategy, and change initiatives. The Sr Director leads the HR team and provides direction across process improvement, staff development, talent acquisition, learning and development, compliance, and employee relations. This role works across each organization and department to promote consistent, practical, and business-aligned application of human resources programs, policies, and practices while addressing the distinct needs of each property. 

Essential Functions

  • Translate business priorities into an integrated Human Resources strategy for each supported property. Advise senior leaders on workforce, organization, and people implications of business decisions. Participate in key leadership and department discussions, bringing a broad HR perspective and recommending practical solutions that support near-term operating needs and longer-term objectives.
  • Maintain current knowledge of industry trends and employment legislation and oversee the organization's compliance. Assess the impact of regulatory and policy changes, communicate requirements to leaders, and recommend updates to policies, procedures, controls, and practices to reduce risk and support consistent application.
  • Lead the Human Resources department, establish priorities, clarify accountability, coach and develop team members, and monitor goals and service delivery to ensure work is completed accurately, consistently, and in a timely manner.
  • Connect broader business strategy to HR priorities and ensure programs remain relevant to the needs of the supported organizations. Identify patterns and opportunities across properties and recommend approaches, policies, and processes that improve organizational effectiveness, productivity, and HR service delivery.
  • Provide proactive counsel on complex and sensitive people matters, serving as a trusted advisor, coach, and thought partner to senior leaders. Frame issues, assess risk and organizational impact, develop well-supported recommendations, and guide leaders toward timely and sustainable resolutions. Oversee significant employee relations matters and partner with Legal as appropriate.
  • Provide strategic direction for employee experience, recognition, training, and development initiatives. Partner with leadership and the administration team to assess organizational and employee needs, identify capability gaps, prioritize learning solutions, and evaluate whether programs support business and talent objectives.
  • Provide oversight for core HR operations supporting new hires, employee changes, payroll coordination, and benefits administration. Establish appropriate review and escalation practices, ensure regulatory and policy compliance, partner with Legal as needed, and provide leaders and employees with clear interpretation of HR policies.
  • Lead the performance review and merit increase processes for supported properties, ensure appropriate planning and governance, monitor completion and quality of performance discussions, and address exceptions with leadership and corporate partners.
  • Serve as the senior HR liaison between AEG corporate partners and the supported properties. Shape local implementation of enterprise programs and initiatives, communicate business requirements and feedback, and promote alignment while accounting for legitimate operating differences.
  • Provide governance and oversight for the integrity, security, and confidentiality of employee data and records, including documentation standards, access controls, record retention, and lawful disposition of personnel files.
  • Oversee talent acquisition strategy and execution across supported departments. Ensure recruitment, selection, and hiring decisions follow approved practices, address critical and hard-to-fill needs, strengthen candidate quality and experience, and support retention of key talent.
  • Develop and manage the Human Resources budget and workforce plan. Allocate resources against business priorities, monitor spending and capacity, and recommend adjustments that support effective and sustainable HR delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) in Business Management, Business Administration, or Human Resources Management. Advanced degree preferred. 
  • 7+ years of Human Resources leadership experience, including direct people leadership, experience advising senior executives, and responsibility for leading a broad HR function or major client group.
  • Broad experience across Human Resources disciplines, including compensation, talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, and talent management, with the ability to integrate these areas into practical business solutions.
  • Experience leading and developing HR teams that support multiple locations, properties, or business units.
  • Experience with Human Resource Information Systems (i.e. UltiPro; Workday; Oracle; PeopleSoft); and Applicant Tracking Systems (i.e. Greenhouse; Taleo)
  • Experience with compensation planning, job leveling, workforce planning, and organizational design and development.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and improving HR initiatives that support measurable business and organizational outcomes.
  • Experience working within entertainment or sports industry is preferred.
  • SPHR or SHRM-SCP is highly preferred.
Skills and Abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate, assess, and resolve complex and sensitive Human Resources matters using sound judgment, discretion, and an appropriate balance of business and employee considerations.
  • Executive-level verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex or sensitive matters clearly and follow through on commitments.
  • Strong knowledge of California, Federal and local employment laws including, but not limited to, ADA, FLSA, EEOC, Title VII, Pay Transparency, etc.
  • Ability to professionally handle sensitive and confidential information
  • Ability to establish credibility and influence decisions with senior leaders while communicating effectively across all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to navigate conflict, competing priorities, and ambiguity and to recommend balanced, sustainable solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to synthesize data, identify implications, and present clear recommendations.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Products (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and ability to learn applicable business systems.
  • HR Systems knowledge (i.e., UltiPro, applicant tracking system)
  • Ability to read, listen and communicate effectively.
  • Able to balance strategic priorities with operational requirements and respond with an appropriate sense of urgency.

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Position Summary:

The Senior Director of Production serves as AEG's on-site representative providing strategic leadership for the operational and execution of large-scale touring productions. Serving as the senior production representative on assigned tours, this role oversees daily show operations, revenue optimization, and cross-functional coordination to maximize tour performance. The Senior Director partners with artists, promoters, venue personnel, ticketing, and production teams to drive operational excellence while ensuring accurate execution throughout the tour lifecycle.

  • Extensive experience managing large-scale touring productions, including live event operations and financial settlements.
  • Strong knowledge of production accounting, revenue management, and ticketing operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to make independent operational decisions in high-pressure, live event environments.
  • Experience with tour settlement systems, ticketing platforms, and production management software.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel skills, and experience using budgeting, project management, and financial systems.

  • Strong organizational skills
  • Self-motivated and takes initiative
  • May require heavy travel for long period of time of the road

job.title: Sr. Director, Production - Global Touring
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. 

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. 

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Position Summary:

The Senior Director of Production serves as AEG's on-site representative providing strategic leadership for the operational and execution of large-scale touring productions. Serving as the senior production representative on assigned tours, this role oversees daily show operations, revenue optimization, and cross-functional coordination to maximize tour performance. The Senior Director partners with artists, promoters, venue personnel, ticketing, and production teams to drive operational excellence while ensuring accurate execution throughout the tour lifecycle.

Essential Functions:

  • Lead the day-to-day operational and financial execution of assigned touring productions, serving as the senior production representative with responsibility for production delivery, show settlements, and operational decision-making.
  • Drive revenue optimization by evaluating venue configurations, production layouts, and ticket inventory opportunities to maximize sellable seating while maintaining production, safety, and guest experience standards.
  • Oversee daily financial settlements, expense management, and accounting activities, ensuring timely reconciliation and compliance with internal financial controls and contractual requirements.
  • Coordinate cross-functional tour operations by partnering with ticketing, venue management, production, catering, temporary staffing, and other internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless show execution.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and operational leadership by developing best practices, mentoring production staff, and supporting organizational initiatives related to tour operations, financial processes, and production standards.

Required Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience managing large-scale touring productions, including live event operations and financial settlements.
  • Strong knowledge of production accounting, revenue management, and ticketing operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to make independent operational decisions in high-pressure, live event environments.
  • Experience with tour settlement systems, ticketing platforms, and production management software.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel skills, and experience using budgeting, project management, and financial systems.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with clients, venues, and co-workers
  • Excellent written, verbal and listening communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Self-motivated and takes initiative
  • May require heavy travel for long period of time of the road

Payscale: $163,766.72 -  $250,671.20

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

job.title: Ticketing Operations Analyst - Product Ops
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

The Ticketing Operations Analyst – Product Operations coordinates cross-departmental product initiatives, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement in User Acceptance Testing and managing issue tracking with product teams under the supervision of the Manager, Ticketing Operations.  The role also supports data cleansing efforts and fraud monitoring, collaborates on triage and escalation of product issues, and participates in after-hours on-call rotations as needed. 

What Will You Do?

  • Recruits, coordinates, and holds accountable the business stakeholders required to complete User Acceptance Testing (UAT) on new AXS products and features, working closely with the Product Owner and Project Managers. 
  • Assists with the evaluation and escalation of Global Triage bug tickets. Troubleshoots any reported issues and resolves or escalates as needed. 
  • Serves as overflow support to team members responsible for creating and validating fees, investigating fee variance tickets, and managing Apex user accounts. 
  • Assists with completing client and promoter requests for OTL sweeps, generating reports on problematic orders for clients, and coordinating the bulk cancellation of orders in violation of ticket limits. 
  • Participates in an on-call rotation with other department staff to assist with daily bulk refunds for rescheduled events and triaging emergency requests after hours and on weekends. 
  • Provides general and project-specific assistance as needed to the other Ticketing Operations staff under the supervision of the Manager, Ticketing Operations. 

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or Marketing major preferred. 
  • 2-4 years of significant experience in live event ticketing and/or ticketing software administration may be substituted for equivalent education depending on the nature of the work experience. 
  • Ability to independently manage complex projects
  • Familiarity with software testing protocols  
  • Excel experience required, including a familiarity with data parsing and vlookup functions 
  • Strong communication skills and the ability gracefully enforce accountability standards 
  • Ability to juggle multiple pressing priorities and meet aggressive deadlines 
  • Flexibility in adapting to rules and processes that frequently evolve

job.title: Acting Lex Columnist
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness
We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

 

The role

This is an opportunity for a UK-based financial journalist to cover a period of parental leave at the FT’s award-winning Lex opinion column.

At Lex we write views on companies and markets. No hot takes — only concise, deeply informed, analytical notes on big business, public and private markets and what makes finance tick.

We are looking for a numerate, naturally curious writer who wants to provoke debate with well-reported insights. The Lex column is central to the FT’s premium subscription strategy, and reaches an influential, engaged global audience.

Sector expertise is welcome, but we'll also want to see that you are an all-rounder. We’ll help you hone your ability to write punchy, directional and entertaining opinion.

 

What you will bring to the role

Analytical rigor: A strong grasp of corporate reporting, accounting, and the mechanics of M&A and earnings.

Conviction: The ability to generate clear, directional, and deeply reported views, backed up with numbers.

Intellectual agility: A fearless approach to untangling complex, unfamiliar topics.

Source management: A knack for conducting difficult, probing and diplomatic conversations with high-level sources.

Ambition: A drive to make a tangible impact, both in the market and within the FT newsroom.

 

Please submit your application by the end of the day, Thursday 19th November 2026.

 

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not by default use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

FT Newsroom staff are expected to work onsite a minimum of three days per week, subject to role requirements and regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for Editorial roles.

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

*LI-RS1

job.title: Corporate Communications Intern
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Ready to skip the typical intern coffee runs and jump straight into work that actually matters? At Burson, we don’t just “do PR” – we shape conversations, influence behaviours, protect reputations, and build campaigns that spark change across social, digital, and traditional channels – in Canada and globally. We're all about smart strategy, real impact, and an international network of thinkers, doers, and game-changers.

This is an existing opportunity to join our team as a Corporate Affairs Intern – someone curious, creative, proactive, and genuinely excited about the intersection of business, reputation and current affairs.

In this paid internship role, you’ll work alongside experienced corporate communications and advisory professionals supporting clients across a variety of industries, including financial and professional services, energy and technology. From monitoring and analysis and media relations to stakeholder engagement and thought leadership, you'll gain hands-on experience helping organizations tell their stories and build trust with their audiences.

This isn’t just an internship – it’s a launchpad into a career in corporate communications.

Annual Compensation: C$38,462, plus applicable vacation pay

What you’ll be doing (and probably have a blast doing):

  • Developing client-ready deliverables including media lists, pitches, stakeholder maps, meeting agendas and summaries, briefing notes, media monitoring and social listening analysis reports
  • Assisting with media relations in support of client announcements focusing on business, news and trade media
  • Conducting research on companies, industries, competitors and current affairs to support client work and new business opportunities
  • Bringing your big ideas to brainstorms and planning meetings
  • Becoming our trend and news spotter – tracking business news, industry developments, emerging issues, and online conversations, and sharing relevant insights with the team and clients

One day you might be supporting a major corporate announcement or helping position a subject-matter expert as an industry voice. The next? You’re tracking a news announcement, pitching journalists or researching an emerging reputational issue. No two days are the same – promise.

What makes you a great fit:

  • You’re a recent graduate in public relations, journalism, business, political science, or a related field
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments and juggle deadlines with ease
  • You have strong writing and research skills and excellent attention to detail (typos tremble in your presence)
  • You’re proactive, curious, and ready to take initiative
  • You’re curious about the world around you – business, current affairs, crisis communications, issues management, corporate reputation
  • You enjoy meeting new people, learning from others, and building your network
  • You’re interested in understanding how organizations communicate with their internal and external audiences to build and manage reputation

Why Burson Is That Internship:

  • Work with leading organizations across a variety of industries
  • Get mentorship from people who are excited to see you flourish, grow, and learn
  • Build a portfolio that makes future-you proud
  • Join a team that’s ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely fun
  • Gain exposure to corporate communications, reputation management, media relations, executive positioning, and integrated communications
  • Be part of a global network of communications experts and learn how strategic communications shape businesses and society

If you’re looking for an opportunity to do great work with great people – and make your mark in the corporate affairs and communications space – we’d love to hear from you.

#LI-YA1

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

job.title: Photojournalist
job.description:
Photojournalist

#26-1356

Minneapolis/St. Paul, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

KSTP-TV

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

KSTP 5 Eyewitness News is the award-winning ABC network affiliate for the Twin Cities. Part of Hubbard Broadcasting, KSTP-TV is a longtime market leader, and is committed to excellence in all that it does-broadcast news with hyper-local coverage, important public service that deals powerfully with today's issues, and now, more than ever, top-notch digital content, to reach our viewers and followers with information the way they want to receive it. When you work for KSTP, or our other local, independently operated station KSTC, Channel 45, you will find yourself among dedicated, passionate people who work hard every day to improve our product and our community. If you have the qualifications, and you are a person of talent and integrity, we invite you to apply!

Job Overview

Responsible for shooting and editing video for daily newscasts under tight deadlines. Works with reporters and producers to create accurate, engaging content for broadcast and digital platforms.

Job Responsibilities

Shoot steady, sequenced video with good, clean audio for news, weather and sports for daily newscasts, specials and station websites, as well as social medio under tight deadlines.

While shooting, get clean audio and Gather great natural sound while in the field. Ensure good lighting, making sure the shot is bright not dark.

Edit in camera for sequences. Uses movement off the shoulder to show viewers what is seen in the field and a tripod or steady bag for the steady Soose wide, medium and tight shots with a variety of subjects for the purpose of telling the story through pictures.

Edit video and audio satisfactorily for news stories, VOs, VO/SOTs, setups and reporter packages using different techniques and editing platforms (including non-linear editing with Adobe ang Final Cut Pro) under tight deadlines and in stressful situations while completing on time. Editing is done in house and in the field. Learn and perform competent multi-layering and special effects such as witness protection, highlighting video clips, color correction, and Photoshop. Aspire to editing excellence to raise the level of storytelling.

At times, may conduct interviews for broadcast with formulating May also use questions supplied by producers, reporters or news management.

Work in tandem with a reporter to “tell” a story.

Have full knowledge of working with reporters to turn packages and live shots for daily newscasts.

Learn streets and highways to drive quickly to a news Be able to operate and follow GPS.

Learn and operate effectively and satisfactorily new technology and equipment including but not limited to Final Cut Pro, different cameras, servers, and editing platforms.

Communicate frequently throughout the day and work collaboratively with others in the newsroom including reporters, anchors, producers, assignment editors, creative services and other photographers about assigned stories and other assignments. Check in face-to-face with Assignment Desk when returning to station from assignments and proactively pitch in to assist others.

Respond and work well in a crisis and during breaking.

Handle last minute and unexpected changes, communicating quickly and clearly to necessary staff and talent.

Attend editorial and other Come prepared, interact professionally with others and contribute story ideas daily.

Have knowledge of local, national and world Have a handle on what is going on in the community.

Travel regularly, often locally however, may travel nationally and internationally.

Work assigned Shifts may change often. Fill in for absent co-workers, if needed.

Ability to work other hours or alternate schedules including when called to cover breaking news.

Drive company vehicles to and from stories under various driving conditions.

Obey all traffic laws and safety rules of the road while in a company vehicle.

Report any problems or concerns with vehicle and traffic incidents promptly to appropriate company representative.

If assigned to take a news vehicle home, must follow take home guidelines which include securing equipment and vehicle.

Keep car clean and in good condition.

Ensure equipment is in good working condition.

Build working relationships with co-workers, customers, vendors and the public.

Act in a courteous professional manner when representing the station and the news department.

Look presentable and neat on the job.

Must possess a valid driver’s license and clean driving record as determined by the company. A driving record check will be required.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

Minimum 2 years of TV news photography and editing experience preferred.

Must be proficient with current broadcast cameras and editing equipment.

Have knowledge and expertise of non-linear editing.

Ability to work alone and with a reporter.

Must be reliable and able to work additional hours if needed, as well as travel as required.

Must possess a valid driver’s license and clean driving record as determined by the company. A driving record check will be required.

Good news judgement and thorough understanding of daily news content.

Ability to read, write and speak English well.

Ability to work well under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

Ability to learn and run ENG trucks preferred.

Physical Requirements:

Must have manual dexterity to operate camera and editing equipment.

Must be able to lift, carry and move with up to 50lbs of equipment in various environments, including outdoors in extreme weather conditions.

Must be able to work in areas and conditions that are often noisy, have many distractions, in extreme weather (heat and cold) and landscape conditions.

Must be able to stand for long periods of time.

Able to listen to and respond verbally to others in English.

Able to move quickly inside and outside on uneven, unfamiliar terrain and areas.

Able to drive news vehicles.

Work under tight deadlines and in pressure situations.

Additional Information

This position is subject to pre-employment driving record background check. A conviction, violation pending adjudication, or adverse driving record more than 3 years old or does not meet the major violation definition per company policy will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

The hourly pay rate for this position is $26.44 per hour - $33.65 per hour.

For information regarding our benefits, please copy the link below and paste in your browser: https://hubbardbroadcasting.com/our-company/working-here/

EEO Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability/vets.

Diversity Statement

Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. We know the best way to accomplish this is by recruiting and retaining top talent from diverse cultures, life experiences, and world views. With dignity and respect, we value YOU and everything that makes YOU uniquely YOU.

job.title: Manager, Inventory and Yield
job.description:
The Manager, Inventory and Yield will own the accuracy and consistency of Red Seat Ventures’ inventory source of truth, review and approve deals in Operative AOS, and implement Revenue Operations strategies related to inventory and yield. This role works alongside Sales, Client Service, Ad Ops, Revenue Operations, and other teams to support consistent execution.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Inventory Source of Truth: Own the accuracy and consistency of inventory information across current and future systems. Coordinate updates and resolve discrepancies with the teams that use the data.
  • Deal Review and Approval: Review and approve deals in Operative AOS in accordance with established business rules. Identify and escalate deals that require additional review.
  • Strategy Implementation: Implement Revenue Operations strategies related to inventory, yield, and approved pricing guidance in partnership with Sales, Client Service, Ad Ops, and other teams.
  • Execution Monitoring: Monitor how inventory and yield plans are being carried out; share results, issues, and feedback with Revenue Operations and relevant partners.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Ad Operations, deal desk, order management, inventory management, or a related operational role.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience maintaining accurate business data across teams or systems.
  • Ability to review transactions against established guidelines and exercise sound judgment.
  • Strong coordination and communication skills, including the ability to turn direction into consistent execution.
  • Comfort working with data to monitor results and identify discrepancies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in media, advertising, podcasting, digital audio, video, or streaming.
  • Familiarity with inventory, pricing, yield, ratecards, or deal approval workflows.
  • Experience with Operative AOS, Salesforce, or other CRM and order management systems.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration, or a quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

job.title: Manager, Podcast Marketing
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world’s top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content through advertising, subscriptions, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our proprietary technology stack, including Supercast for subscriptions and Speakeasy for hosting, distribution, and monetization.

Named after Ted Williams’ longest home run at Fenway Park, Red Seat Ventures was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we are the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is looking for a Manager, Podcast Marketing to lead cross-promotional campaigns across our portfolio of nearly 70 podcasts while building relationships with external shows, creators, and platforms. Reporting to the Senior Director, Podcast Marketing, you will own campaigns from initial planning and creative development through ad operations, measurement, and reporting. You will translate campaign performance into clear insights that help senior leaders understand what worked and what we should do next.

This position sits within a growing Audience Development function with established systems and active campaigns already in place. The work is currently hands-on and high-volume as we continue to improve and automate our processes. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys owning complex systems, maintaining operational precision, and turning campaign data into a compelling and actionable story.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
