job.title: Business Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Business Director to join Translation!

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, with four days in office and one remote.

Position Summary

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner, deeply invested in understanding your clients’ business challenges and uncovering opportunities to solve them through innovative, culturally attuned creative solutions. You’ll cultivate strong, proactive client relationships, guide cross-functional teams, and drive initiatives that deliver measurable business impact. With Program Management leading operational excellence, you will focus on shaping strategic agendas, fostering growth, and ensuring our work drives tangible results for both the client and agency.

What You’ll Do

Drive Business & Strategic Leadership

  • Act as the day-to-day senior business lead on assigned accounts, serving as a strategic partner who uncovers and addresses core client challenges and opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with mid-to-senior client stakeholders, proactively offering strategic counsel rooted in a deep understanding of their business, category, and competitive dynamics.
  • Partner closely with Program Management to align on priorities and ensure our collective approach delivers on both business objectives and operational rigor.
  • Keep a constant pulse on the health of client relationships and business performance, identifying risks or growth opportunities early and collaborating with agency leadership to proactively address them.

Lead Creative Solutions with Business Impact

  • Collaborate with Strategy, Creative, and other internal teams to ensure our work solves real business problems and capitalizes on cultural opportunities.
  • Champion the development of strategies and creative solutions that are grounded in business insights and tied to clear performance metrics.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends and cultural shifts to bring fresh, informed thinking that drives innovative solutions for clients.
  • Partner with production leads, creative teams and program management to execute creative work that fully brings to life the approved creative concepts within the allocated time and budget
  • Advocate for additional budget and or push the boundaries with clients to create the most compelling executions possible 

Team & Partnership Leadership

  • Guide and inspire cross-discipline partners, fostering a culture of strategic curiosity, accountability, and partnership excellence.
  • Work hand-in-hand with Program Management, who will lead the operational planning, scoping, budgeting, and executional excellence—freeing you to focus on driving the business agenda and strategic growth.
  • Together with Program Management, ensure seamless integration across disciplines, maintaining the highest standards in client service and delivery.

Champion Growth & Client Success

  • Proactively identify opportunities to grow agency partnerships within existing accounts, aligning agency capabilities with the client’s long-term business goals. Responsible for creating and actioning growth plans for assigned clients
  • Play a key role in broader business development efforts, participating in pitches and strategic growth initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Deep understanding of the QSR or restaurant category, with an appreciation for cultural nuances that inform creative strategies.
  • Experience leading multicultural or African American targeted work
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to quickly grasp client industry dynamics and uncover opportunities for impactful creative solutions.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills, with the confidence to provide strategic counsel to clients and inspire internal teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading integrated work across multiple channels, with a strong sense for how creative and strategic solutions drive business results.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with the optimism and resilience to tackle challenges and move work forward.
  • Passion for culturally relevant work that delivers against both business objectives and consumer engagement.
  • Proven track record of leading creative initiatives that drove real business change or results for clients

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7–10 years of experience in an agency or communications-related industry, with a well-rounded understanding of advertising, marketing, media, creative, production, and agency finance.
  • Proven success managing the end-to-end lifecycle of integrated campaigns, engaging with mid-to-senior-level clients, and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on production experience with large-scale, multi-channel initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with QSR brands. Culturally driven brand experience is also a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $115,000 - 135,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Temporary Copywriter
job.description:
UnitedMasters

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters' music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a versatile, culture-obsessed part-time Copywriter to join our team on a part-time basis. 

The Role

This role will sit at the intersection of music, tech, and media, supporting both the UnitedMasters brand and the 16Bars platform.

The ideal candidate has a sharp ear for voice, a deep understanding of music culture, and the ability to pivot between high-level brand storytelling and punchy social communications. You will collaborate closely with the Integrated Marketing, Social and Creative teams to drive engagement across our digital ecosystem.

What You’ll Do 

  • Digital & Web: Draft compelling website copy for landing pages and product launches, ensuring a seamless user experience.
  • Go-To-Market (GTM): Develop clear, impactful messaging for brand initiatives and new feature rollouts.
  • CRM & Editorial: Write engaging weekly newsletters and email marketing campaigns that drive conversion and community loyalty.
  • Social Media: Craft platform-specific copy (Instagram, TikTok, X) that resonates with independent artists and music fans.
  • Creative Development: Assist in writing creative treatments and "big idea" pitches for brand partnerships.
  • Content Scripts: Script short-form video content (Reels/TikToks) that feels authentic, trendy, and on-brand.

Who You Are 

  • 4-7 years of experience: working on internal and external facing brand copy across digital and social platforms
  • Culture-First Mindset: You’re plugged into music and culture, specifically the independent artist landscape.
  • Versatile Portfolio: Proven experience writing for tech, music, or lifestyle brands across web, email, and social.
  • Adaptability: Ability to switch voices between the professional/empowering tone of UnitedMasters and the editorial/sharp tone of 16Bars.
  • Efficiency: Capable of managing multiple projects under tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Collaboration: A team player who can take feedback from integrated marketing leads and turn it into polished prose.

Our Values

  • We Get on the Plane — Entrepreneurial spirit means fully committing to the journey not just having the idea.
  • We Expect Challenge + Respect — We constantly challenge each other and the work to reach excellence, always with respect.
  • We Are Defined by Our Resilience — We stay resourceful, fail fast, keep getting better, and never quit on our mission or our team.
  • We Pursue Answers Before the Question Has to Be Asked — We understand our customers so well that we anticipate what they need before they ask.
  • We Run Towards Darkness — We have the courage to work through uncertainty rather than settling for an easier, inferior plan.
  • We Know What We Don't Know — We bring confidence in what we do know, and honesty about what we don't.

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $45 - $55/ hr 

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. job.title: Senior Medical Writer
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Position Summary:

The Senior Medical Writer serves as an integral part of the Real Chemistry Medical Communications division in developing scientific content in support of a variety of omnichannel medical communication tactics, as assigned to particular therapeutic areas and client brands. The Senior Medical Writer must have the ability to analyze and interpret complex scientific data and translate these into compelling and relevant clinical communications and commercial/medical messages. The Senior Medical Writer collaborates closely with the Medical Director and cross-functional teammates in the development and execution of scientific strategies and tactics. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Indianapolis, Lambertville (NJ), or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role requires working eastern US hours.

What you'll do:

  • Develop core deliverables (eg, PowerPoint slides, manuscripts, video scripts, executive summaries) and ancillary materials (eg, participant handouts, moderator guides) for medical communication projects, including promotional/medical presentations, advisory board meetings, product theaters as well as various educational videos and digital solutions
  • Perform and analyze literature searches and scientific research regarding clinical data and key scientific information for content development projects to meet client needs for relevant, up-to-date, evidenced-based, and accurate medical communication content
  • Collaborate with the Medical Director, in partnership with Creative and Client Services, on medical storytelling, drawing upon client insights, landscape intelligence, and relevant evidence-based medical literature to provide informed and relevant strategic recommendations
  • Partner with Presentation and Graphic Designers on various illustrations, animations, and creative applications of medical and scientific information
  • As assigned, develop relationships and collaborate closely with clients and key opinion leaders to develop scientific content and execute medical communication strategy to communicate complex scientific information to medical professionals 
  • Conduct quality checks on all content-related materials, including annotated deliverables, to ensure scientific integrity and accuracy, and support Veeva submissions of all medical communication deliverables for client medical/legal/regulatory reviews by highlighting all relevant references and creating detailed reference notes
  • Support project management within the cross-functional team by effectively communicating and aligning with Account and Project Managers, and actively participating in all internal and client meetings
  • Train and mentor more junior medical writers under the guidance of the Medical Director
  • Maintain full compliance with legal, regulatory, and corporate requirements as well as all applicable US laws and regulations
  • Perform any other duties as reasonably assigned; duties and responsibilities may be removed, modified, or added by leadership at any time as business or operations warrant 

Working Conditions:

  • Work Schedule/Hours: This position requires occasional nonstandard work hours in accordance with project needs, deadlines, deliverables, and urgent client requests    
  • Business Travel: This position requires moderate overnight/weekend travel (up to 20%) based upon client geography
  • This position has no direct reports and does not perform supervisory tasks 

What you should have: 

  • Advanced degree (eg, MD, PhD, PharmD, MPH, MS) in a healthcare-related field required 
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in medical education, scientific research, or clinical practice/insights preferred, or 2-3 years of experience in medical education in a pharmaceutical company or medical communications agency required, with experience in promotional/medical communication to healthcare professionals preferred
  • Experience with medical, legal, and regulatory reviews preferred
  • Expert verbal and written communication skills in the field of medical science 
  • Intermediate ability to analyze the scientific relevance, validity, and credibility of the published medical literature
  • Intermediate level of conceptual and functional understanding of modern digital marketing practices and the applications of artificial intelligence technology 

Core Competencies:

Whether acting in a promotional or nonpromotional nature, we serve as envoys for our clients’ messages, a resource for their customers, and stewards of the money they invest with us. As such, Real Chemistry holds employees to a high standard when it comes to communication, culture, and collaboration, specifically:

job.description:

Why we're hiring:

You're disrupting AdTech from inside one of the world's largest media companies—with startup velocity and enterprise muscle to make SSPs and agencies move. We're building Open Intelligence Activation, a programmable platform enabling cross-channel audience orchestration, supply-side targeting, and activation across SSP partners and Publishers.

AdTech Strategy & Market Intelligence

Execution & Prioritization

  • Ship, learn, iterate—fast cycles beat perfect planning 
  • Ruthlessly kill features that don't move the needle 
  • Work closely with Design, Data, and cross-functional teams to unblock and drive adoption 

 

Who you'll be working with:

Global advertising agencies are finally innovating in AdTech—and we're leading. We have the technical capability to build what agencies need, the enterprise relationship muscle to make SSP partners move, and the startup velocity to iterate faster than incumbents. We're literally on the edge of what's possible in supply-side targeting and cross-channel orchestration. 

What you'll need:

AdTech Expertise

  • Familiarity with cross-channel activation (CTV, display, video) Behavioral and contextual targeting

Founder Mentality

AI-Forward & Go-to-Market Focused

  • Understand that product success requires narrative alignment across engineering, sales, and strategy

  • Product Marketing experience a plus 

Execution Excellence

  • Detail-oriented on user stories and acceptance criteria, but never lose sight of strategy

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

  • Lead and collaborate with cross-functional partners on complex projects to sustain and enhance employment law compliance across multiple jurisdictions.

Qualifications

  • J.D. with New York Bar admission
  • Big Law experience, with experience advising on U.S. federal and multi-state employment law matters, required

  • Outstanding writing, drafting and communication skills
  • Ability to use good judgment and demonstrate attention to detail

job.title: Maintenance Technician - Prince George, BC
job.description:

Maintenance Technician

Prince George, BC

Pattison Media is looking for an experienced Maintenance Technician to join our Technical Services team in Prince George.

This is a hands-on technical position supporting our radio and television operation in Prince George. We are looking for someone with a strong technical background who enjoys troubleshooting, working with technology, and learning how complex systems work. Broadcast experience would certainly be an asset, but we are equally interested in candidates coming from electronics, telecommunications, IT, networking, audio/video, RF, or other related technical fields.

The successful candidate will support day-to-day operations and participate in equipment installations, system upgrades, technical projects, and the ongoing modernization of Pattison Media's broadcast infrastructure. The position works closely with our broader Technical Services team, which will provide support and help the successful candidate become familiar with our specialized radio and television systems.

What you'll do
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and install radio and television studio and broadcast equipment.
  • Maintain and support radio and television transmission systems, including transmitters, RF systems, and associated equipment.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot audio and video systems, including studio, production, and signal-distribution equipment.
  • Support computers, servers, network equipment, and other technology used throughout the Prince George operation.
  • Support broadcast and production systems, including automation, newsroom, audio, video, and content-delivery systems.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues affecting on-air, production, newsroom, and business operations.
  • Install and commission new technical equipment and systems.
  • Diagnose problems across complete broadcast workflows, from studio and production systems through transmission and distribution.
  • Work with IP networking, server infrastructure, and increasingly IP-based and cloud-connected broadcast systems.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, records, and system drawings.
  • Work closely with programming, news, television production, sales, and other departments to provide reliable day-to-day technical support.
  • Help ensure technical systems follow Pattison Media standards for reliability, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure.
What we're looking for
  • A graduate of a recognized Electronics Technician, Electronics Engineering Technologist, Broadcast Technology, or related technical program, or a combination of relevant education and practical technical experience.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to logically diagnose technical and electronic systems.
  • Experience working with electronics, electrical systems, telecommunications, IT, networking, audio/video systems, RF, or other related technical equipment.
  • Good working knowledge of computers, IP networking, and modern IT infrastructure.
  • Comfort learning and working with radio and television studio, transmission, audio/video, automation, and production systems.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and see tasks through to completion.
  • Ability to work independently while also being part of Pattison Media's larger Technical Services team.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills with a practical, positive, solutions-focused approach.
  • Comfort working at transmitter sites and other technical facilities as required.
  • A valid driver's license.
Experience we're particularly interested in

Previous radio or television broadcast experience would be an asset, but it is not essential.

We recognize that strong technical candidates can come from many different backgrounds. We are interested in people with solid hands-on experience in electronics, telecommunications, IT and networking, audio/video systems, RF, or other related technical fields. Someone with a strong technical foundation, good troubleshooting skills, and a willingness to learn the specialized systems used in broadcasting could be an excellent fit.

Experience with broadcast automation, production, or newsroom systems would also be an asset. Pattison Media uses systems such as WideOrbit in radio and Broadstream OASYS in television, along with newsroom and other supporting broadcast technologies.

About Pattison Media

Pattison Media is one of Canada's leading independent media companies, operating radio, television, and digital platforms across Western Canada. We continue to invest in modern broadcast technology, IP and cloud-based systems, and new workflows that support reliable multi-platform content delivery.

This position offers the opportunity to work with a broad range of technology. One day may involve troubleshooting a radio studio or computer system, while another may involve television production equipment, networking, servers, or a transmission system.

If you enjoy solving problems, working with technology, and keeping radio and television operations running reliably, we'd like to hear from you.

job.description:
Director of Digital News & Audience – New Jersey 101.5

* This is a full-time, in-office position in Trenton that involves working closely and collaboratively with our New Jersey content teams. * 

 

Lead the Next Evolution of Digital News & Audience Growth

Are you a sharp editor, strategic digital thinker, and hands-on content creator who understands how great stories find audiences today? At Townsquare Media – New Jersey, we’re looking for a Director of Digital News & Audience to help lead the digital evolution of New Jersey 101.5, while serving as a digital content resource for our other brands across New Jersey.

This is a digital-first, hands-on content leadership role at the intersection of journalism, content, audience, and growth. You’ll work alongside our journalists, personalities, producers, and content teams to create compelling original content, strengthen the stories we’re already telling, and expand their reach across web, social, video, apps, newsletters, and emerging platforms.

You don’t need to come from radio. Your experience may be in a digital newsroom, social or video team, local media company, creator-led organization, or another digital-first environment. What matters most is that you understand great storytelling, strong journalism, and how audiences discover, consume, and share content across platforms.

And this isn’t a role that manages from the sidelines. You’ll write, edit, publish, produce, package, analyze, and create content yourself, while helping talented people around you make their work even stronger.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted New Jersey stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As Director of Digital News & Audience, you’ll help shape our digital content strategy while staying deeply involved in day-to-day execution. You’ll serve as both a leader and a hands-on editor, helping shape the digital voice of our local brands. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading digital news and content strategy for New Jersey 101.5, helping identify, develop, and execute compelling original and breaking-news coverage across platforms
  • Creating, editing, publishing, and packaging content across websites, apps, social media, video, newsletters, and other digital channels
  • Partnering with journalists, on-air personalities, producers, and creators to turn strong ideas and existing content into platform-specific digital experiences
  • Elevating our social and video storytelling, including platform-native hooks, headlines, captions, thumbnails, pacing, formats, and creative approaches for Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms
  • Coaching and collaborating with content teams on digital storytelling, SEO, audience development, social strategy, and evolving best practices
  • Using audience and content analytics to understand performance, identify opportunities, test new ideas, and make data-informed editorial decisions
  • Expanding content distribution through SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and other audience-growth channels
  • Supporting day-to-day news priorities and coordination while balancing breaking news, daily content production, and longer-term audience-growth initiatives
  • Serving as a digital content resource across our New Jersey brands, helping teams capitalize on strong stories and audience opportunities
  • Exploring new platforms, technologies, and AI-assisted content and workflow tools to improve efficiency and creativity while maintaining strong editorial standards and human judgment

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in digital journalism, digital media, audience development, social/video content, online publishing, or a related content environment
  • A proven track record of creating digital content that earns and grows an audience
  • Exceptional writing, editing, story-framing, and headline-writing skills
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to make smart, responsible decisions quickly, particularly during breaking or developing news
  • Deep familiarity with Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, including platform-specific formats, audience behavior, discovery, and best practices
  • Strong understanding of social and short-form video storytelling, including hooks, pacing, captions, thumbnails, titles, and vertical video
  • Hands-on experience creating, editing, publishing, and packaging digital content—not simply directing others
  • Experience using analytics and performance data to identify opportunities and turn insights into actionable content decisions
  • Strong understanding of SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and digital audience development
  • Experience collaborating with and coaching reporters, writers, personalities, producers, or other content creators
  • Strong organizational, communication, and project-management skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms, social publishing tools, analytics platforms, and digital/video production workflows

  • Knowledge of New Jersey—its communities, culture, issues, and personalities—is a major plus
  • High School Diploma (required); college coursework or BA/BS degree (preferred)

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone with great instincts, curiosity, creativity, and a bias toward action. Just as importantly, you’ll be a collaborative, positive teammate who makes the people around you better.

job.title: Regional Market Engineering Manager
job.description:
Regional Market Engineering Manager - Yakima

*This is a hybrid position that involves travel, after-hours and weekend work, and on-call availability as required. You will be supporting our Boise, Twin Falls, Tri-Cities, Yakima, and Wenatchee markets. *

 

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Boise, Twin Falls, Tri-Cities – Richland/Kennewick/Pasco, Yakima, and Wenatchee stations. 

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

The Regional Market Engineering Manager Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a Regional Market Engineering Manager to oversee our multi-station broadcast radio facilities in the Boise, Twin Falls, Tri-Cities, Yakima, and Wenatchee markets. 

 

Essential Functions:

Travel & Transportation:

  • Maintain a valid driver's license and reliable transportation
  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations
  • Respond to emergency equipment failures on short notice, including after hours and weekends
  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Technical Operations:

  • Manage activities for a goal of 100% uptime of station on-air and streaming products
  • Inspect, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with FCC technical rules and perform duties of Chief Operator
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

Cognitive & Communication:

  • Read and interpret technical documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, schematics, and procedure manuals
  • Follow detailed verbal and written instructions accurately and retain information necessary to complete tasks
  • Identify and differentiate between multiple transmitters, equipment components, and site locations
  • Diagnose equipment issues and make real-time decisions to restore broadcast operations
  • Write routine reports and correspondence
  • Speak effectively with programming staff, management, and other employees to achieve operational goals
  • Interface with Senior Vice President of Engineering and Senior Vice President, Information Technology, as well as other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed.

Safety & Physical Requirements:

  • Follow all safety protocols for working with high-voltage equipment and at tower sites
  • Maintain situational awareness to prevent falls and injuries
  • Climb ladders and work at heights
  • Work in varying weather conditions and outdoor environments
  • Frequently stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear
  • Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
  • Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds; occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
  • Maintain close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data and figures, view a computer terminal, read extensively, visually inspect small defects and parts, operate machines, and use measurement devices

 

Qualifications:

  • Technical training school, or two to four years related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience (required)
  • SBE or computer-related certification helpful but not required
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Windows (all versions), Microsoft Office, networking concepts, computer hardware, and wireless/handheld devices
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists
  • Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

 

Work Schedule:

  • After-hours and weekend work as required
  • On-call availability for emergency response

 

Disclaimer:

This job description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. The incumbent will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties as may be required by the supervisor. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

Benefits:

  • 3 weeks of PTO (+ 9 paid holidays)
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunity for upward mobility
  • Company provided laptop
  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • Company discounts
  • Pet Insurance
  • Time off for volunteering
  • And much more…

 

About Us:

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing web sites, search engine optimization, social platforms and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 357 local terrestrial radio stations in 74 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps including legendary brands such as WYRK.com, WJON.com, and NJ101.5.com, along with a network of national music brands including XXLmag.com, TasteofCountry.com, UltimateClassicRock.com and Loudwire.com.

The Regional Market Engineering Manager Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a Market Engineering Manager to oversee our multi-station broadcast radio facility in the Fort Collins, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie markets. 

This position serves as the sole technical authority for market-level engineering operations and is responsible for the planning, analysis, and independent decision-making that governs broadcast continuity, FCC compliance, and infrastructure strategy across all assigned stations. The Market Engineering Manager exercises independent judgment on matters that directly affect station revenue, regulatory standing, and operational performance, and will personally perform technical work when operational circumstances require.

  • Ability and willingness to serve as Chief Operator under FCC rules, with independent authority to ensure station compliance with all applicable technical regulations
  • Conduct root cause analysis of equipment failures and develop technical solutions to prevent recurrence
  • Evaluate and optimize broadcast transmission infrastructure and technical systems to ensure operational continuity and regulatory compliance
  • Develop technical operating standards for market engineering operations
  • Develop and recommend capital expenditure plans for infrastructure upgrades, including vendor evaluation, budget proposals, and cost-benefit analysis for executive approval
  • Evaluate and select vendors and contractors for engineering projects and maintenance

  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

Travel and Emergency Response

  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations

  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Cognitive and Communication Requirements

  • Read and interpret technical documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, schematics, and procedure manuals

  • Information Technology, and other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed

  • Maintain close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data and figures, view a computer terminal, read extensively, inspect small defects and parts, operate machines, and use measurement devices

 

Qualifications:

Required

  • Five or more years of progressively responsible broadcast engineering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent technical judgment in high-pressure, time-sensitive environments
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office, networking concepts, computer hardware, and wireless/handheld devices
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists
  • Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

job.description:
OVERVIEW

The Durham Bulls are hiring a Senior Designer to help bring one of Minor League Baseball's most iconic brands to life. You will report to the Creative Director and work alongside a small team to create the graphics, content, and photography fans see every day. Will also help create the imagery that defines the Bulls' 125th anniversary season in 2027.

Photography is a core part of this job, as important as graphic design. With no staff photographer on our team, you will be the club's primary photographer, capturing everything from retail and merchandise to in-game action and styled campaign shoots. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing at a desk and shooting from the field level, and is excited to tell the Bulls' story through both.
 
KEY RESPONSIBILITY AREAS

Design

  • Create graphics for social media, web, email, video boards, in-ballpark signage, print, advertising, and merchandise.

Photography

  • Own photography for the club, including:
  • In-game action, fans, and ballpark atmosphere
  • Retail and merchandise product shots for the team store and e-commerce
  • Stylized and studio-style shoots for campaigns, promotions, and social content
  • Community events, partner activations, and behind-the-scenes moments

  • Edit, retouch, organize, and archive photos so the team can find them fast.
  • Turn around game-day photos quickly for social and media use.

 
Motion and content

  • Create animated graphics and short-form motion content for social and video boards.
  • Partner with the video producer on graphics packages, lower thirds, and in-game elements.
  • Pitch content ideas that fit current trends and platforms.

 
Team and collaboration

  • Take direction from the Creative Director and help manage your own project load.
  • Work with ticketing, partnerships, promotions, merchandise, and community relations on their creative needs.

 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of professional graphic design experience, in-house or agency.
  • 3+ years of professional photography experience, including live events and sports.

Named the South Carolina Broadcasters Association's Station of the Year a record 17 times, WIS has earned the Edward R. Murrow Award for Journalism Excellence, the National Association of Broadcasters' Service to America Award, the George Foster Peabody Award, and is an annual attendee of the Southeast Emmy Awards.

Among the many notable former journalists who helped set our standard, NBC Today Show co-host Craig Melvin began his career with WIS as an intern, photographer, reporter, and then anchor.

WIS produces more than 60 hours of local, original programming per week. The station offers a unique variety of multiplatform advertising solutions, sponsored content, and professional creative services for businesses of any size.

Columbia, South Carolina, is a vibrant and growing capital city with a diverse population. It is home to the U.S. Army's largest installation for Basic Combat Training, Fort Jackson, along with the University of South Carolina and multiple other colleges and universities. WIS is located downtown, just two blocks from the South Carolina Statehouse.

Our community combines affordable quality of living with a variety of entertainment and activities to accommodate your lifestyle, whether it's our 50,000-acre Lake Murray, our Columbia Fireflies minor league baseball team, the Riverbanks Zoo & Gardens, nearby Congaree National Park, and so much more.

As a highly adaptable collaborator, you will be expected to think quickly and provide creative solutions to varied requests within a demanding news environment.

You must be available to work 24-32 hours per week, with flexibility around overnights, weekends, and holidays.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on a variety of programs, delivering distinctive and stylized content under demanding deadlines across all platforms.
  • Display initiative and focus to remain as productive as possible when working either collaboratively or independently.
  • Serve as the "last line of defense" on all audio/video requirements to ensure no technical or editorial mistakes occur on air.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • A passion for news and a demonstrated knowledge of current events.

RESPONSIBILTIES

As a Lead VFX Artist, you will manage and mentor a team of skilled VFX artists, supporting their development and championing a collaborative, inclusive environment. You will work with other Artists, Art Directors, Engineers and Producers, to create visual effects that immerse players in the experience. You will play a key role in driving the high-fidelity effects in our game, while also shaping a team culture grounded in creativity, trust, and respect.
You will play a key role in establishing the VFX pipeline and visual quality bar, while also researching and developing new workflows, tools, and emerging technologies, including AI-assisted solutions, to improve efficiency, iteration, and scalability across production. This role is well suited to someone comfortable experimenting, prototyping, and helping shape pipelines that are still evolving.

  • Design and implement impactful real-time VFX that support a wide range of in-game moments and player experiences.
  • Foster technical excellence and artistic creativity across the VFX pipeline.
  • Research and prototype new workflows, tools, and techniques to push the boundaries of real-time VFX.
  • Ensure all VFX content is performant, optimized, and within technical constraints.
  • Coordinate with Directors and Production to align VFX planning with milestones and timelines.
  • Provide feedback, training, and support to junior VFX artists, fostering growth and maintaining quality standards.
  • Research, prototype, and evaluate new workflows, tools, and AI-assisted approaches that can improve the VFX pipeline and cross-disciplines.
  • Partner with Technical Art and Engineering to develop scalable tools and workflows that reduce repetitive work and support efficient content production.

RESPONSABILITÉS

À titre d’Artiste VFX Lead, vous gérerez et accompagnerez une équipe d’artistes VFX chevronnés, soutiendrez leur développement et favoriserez un environnement collaboratif et inclusif. Vous travaillerez avec d’autres artistes, des directeurs et directrices artistiques, des membres des équipes d’ingénierie et de production afin de créer des effets visuels qui plongent les joueuses et joueurs au cœur de l’expérience. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la création d’effets haute fidélité pour notre jeu, tout en contribuant à façonner une culture d’équipe fondée sur la créativité, la confiance et le respect.
Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’établissement du pipeline VFX et des standards de qualité visuelle, tout en recherchant et en développant de nouveaux workflows, outils et technologies émergentes, y compris des solutions assistées par l’IA, afin d’améliorer l’efficacité, l’itération et l’évolutivité à l’échelle de la production. Ce rôle convient particulièrement à une personne à l’aise avec l’expérimentation, le prototypage et la contribution à l’évolution de pipelines qui sont encore en cours de développement.

  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des VFX temps réel percutants qui soutiennent une grande variété de moments en jeu et d’expériences pour les joueuses et joueurs.
  • Favoriser l’excellence technique et la créativité artistique dans l’ensemble du pipeline VFX.
  • Rechercher et prototyper de nouveaux workflows, outils et techniques afin de repousser les limites des VFX temps réel.
  • Veiller à ce que tout le contenu VFX soit performant, optimisé et conforme aux contraintes techniques.
  • Coordonner la planification des VFX avec la direction et la production afin de l’aligner sur les jalons et les échéanciers.
  • Fournir de la rétroaction, de la formation et du soutien aux artistes VFX juniors afin de favoriser leur développement et de maintenir les standards de qualité.
  • Rechercher, prototyper et évaluer de nouveaux workflows, outils et approches assistées par l’IA susceptibles d’améliorer le pipeline VFX et les processus interdisciplinaires.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’art technique et d’ingénierie afin de développer des outils et des workflows évolutifs qui réduisent les tâches répétitives et favorisent une production de contenu efficace.

Basic Requirements: 

  • 8+ years of experience as a VFX Artist in game development.
  • Shipped at least one AAA title as a Lead VFX Artist or in a comparable senior leadership role.
  • Proven track record in a leadership role within a creative environment – someone who has mentored others, influenced project direction, and supported team growth.
  • Deep expertise in Unreal Engine 5 and real-time VFX development.
  • Solid knowledge of VFX tools (Houdini, EmberGen, Photoshop, Maya, Blender).
  • Experience with Unreal engine
  • Strong proficiency in real-time and baked simulations.
  • Understanding PBR workflows, shaders, real-time rendering, and lighting.

  • Comfort working in an evolving production environment where pipelines and solutions are still being developed.

  • Avoir participé à la livraison d’au moins un titre AAA à titre d’Artiste VFX Lead ou dans un rôle comparable de leadership senior.

NBCUniversal is looking for a Principal VFX Artist to help shape the visual and technical quality of real-time effects for an ambitious, large-scale interactive project. As a senior individual contributor and discipline expert, you will create high-quality VFX while helping define the standards, systems, and workflows that support rich, cohesive visual experiences at scale. 

Reporting to the Lead VFX Artist, you will collaborate closely with Art Direction, Technical Art, Engineering, and other disciplines to solve complex artistic and technical challenges. At the intersection of art, technology, and R&D, you will explore generative AI, procedural workflows, and automation to improve creative iteration and production efficiency. You will prototype and evaluate new approaches, helping turn promising experiments into reliable production workflows while preserving artistic control, flexibility, and real-time performance. 

Sommaire du role  

NBCUniversal recherche un·e Artiste Principal·e VFX pour contribuer à façonner la qualité visuelle et technique des effets temps réel d’un projet interactif ambitieux et à grande échelle. En tant que contributeur·rice individuel·le senior et expert·e de la discipline, vous créerez des VFX de haute qualité tout en contribuant à définir les standards, systèmes et workflows permettant de produire des expériences visuelles riches et cohérentes à grande échelle. 

Sous la direction du·de la Lead VFX Artist, vous collaborerez étroitement avec la Direction Artistique, le Tech Art, l’Engineering et les autres disciplines pour résoudre des défis artistiques et techniques complexes. À la rencontre de l’art, de la technologie et de la R&D, vous explorerez l’IA générative, les workflows procéduraux et l’automatisation pour faciliter l’itération créative et améliorer l’efficacité de la production. Vous prototyperez et évaluerez de nouvelles approches afin de transformer les expérimentations prometteuses en workflows de production fiables, tout en préservant le contrôle artistique, la flexibilité et la performance temps réel. 

Responsabilities 

  • Create and implement high-quality real-time VFX for gameplay, environments, and characters in a large-scale open world. 
  • Explore and prototype generative AI workflows for VFX ideation, visual exploration, and the creation of effect source assets. 
  • Evaluate AI-generated outputs for visual quality, consistency, editability, and suitability for real-time integration. 
  • Partner with Technical Art and Engineering to combine generative AI, procedural systems, and automation into repeatable production workflows. 
  • Compare experimental approaches with existing methods to determine where they improve iteration, reduce repetitive work, or support production at scale. 
  • Contribute to visual benchmarks and technical standards with the Lead VFX Artist and Art Direction. 
  • Resolve complex VFX challenges and profiles, debug, and optimize effects within memory, GPU, and CPU budgets. 
  • Document validated workflows and support artists through demonstrations, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback. 
  • Collaborate across Art, Design, Animation, Lighting, and Audio to ensure effects support gameplay and environmental storytelling. 

Responsabilités 

  • Créer et intégrer des VFX temps réel de haute qualité pour le gameplay, les environnements et les personnages dans un monde ouvert à grande échelle. 
  • Explorer et prototyper des workflows d’IA générative pour l’idéation, l’exploration visuelle et la création d’éléments sources destinés aux VFX. 
  • Évaluer les résultats générés par IA selon leur qualité visuelle, leur cohérence, leur facilité de modification et leur compatibilité avec une intégration temps réel. 
  • Collaborer avec le Tech Art et l’Engineering pour combiner IA générative, systèmes procéduraux et automatisation dans des workflows de production reproductibles. 
  • Comparer les approches expérimentales aux méthodes existantes pour déterminer où elles facilitent l’itération, réduisent les tâches répétitives ou soutiennent la production à grande échelle. 
  • Contribuer aux références de qualité visuelle et aux standards techniques avec le·la Lead VFX Artist et la Direction Artistique. 
  • Résoudre les défis VFX complexes et profiler, déboguer et optimiser les effets dans le respect des budgets mémoire, GPU et CPU. 
  • Documenter les workflows validés et accompagner les artistes par des démonstrations, le partage de connaissances et des retours constructifs. 
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Art, Design, Animation, Lighting et Audio pour que les effets soutiennent le gameplay et la narration environnementale. 

Basic requirements 

  • 8+ years of experience creating VFX for games, including significant experience on AAA or large-scale productions. 
  • Shipped at least one AAA game or large-scale real-time project as a Senior, Principal, Lead, or equivalent VFX artist. 
  • Deep expertise in Unreal Engine 5 and modern real-time VFX workflows, including Niagara or comparable systems. 
  • Strong proficiency with tools such as Houdini, EmberGen, Maya, Blender, Photoshop, or equivalents. 
  • Excellent understanding of shaders, materials, PBR workflows, lighting, and real-time rendering. 
  • Advanced skills in VFX profiling, optimization, and debugging. 

Qualifications de base 

  • Plus de 8 ans d’expérience en VFX pour le jeu vidéo, avec une expérience significative sur des productions AAA ou à grande échelle. Avoir livré au moins un jeu AAA ou un projet temps réel d’envergure dans un rôle Senior, Principal, Lead ou équivalent.

  • Connaissance avancée du profiling, de l’optimisation et du débogage des VFX. 

Desired Characteristics 

  • Hands-on experimentation with generative AI for visual content creation, with an interest in connecting these tools to real-time VFX workflows.

job.title: Business Analyst III, Data Products & Platforms
job.description:
Position Title: Business Analyst III, Data Products & Platforms Department: Enterprise Products & Services Corporate Area: PBS Technology Status: Regular, Full time Exempt Manager Title: Director, Product Management

Position Overview

The Business Analyst III, Data Products & Platforms is responsible for defining, documenting and managing the business requirements for the mbank API layer and the microservices that connect mbank with external media metadata sources, specifically EIDR (Entertainment Identifier Registry) and IMDb. This role serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, product managers, data engineers and software developers, translating business needs into clear API specifications, integration requirements and acceptance criteria. The Business Analyst III owns the integration backlog, monitors the health and quality of the data exchanged between mbank and its partner services, and supports user acceptance testing and quality efforts. The role requires a strong understanding of media identifiers and metadata, key business processes and drivers, and the short- and long-term strategies and related technologies of the Data Products & Platforms team.

Key responsibilities

will include, but are not limited to: Serves as business owner and subject matter expert for the mbank API and the microservices that integrate mbank with EIDR and IMDb, aligning technical solutions with business strategies across moderate to complex business processes. Gathers, analyzes and documents business, functional and non-functional requirements for API endpoints, data mappings, and microservice workflows, including user stories, acceptance criteria and process flows. Defines and maintains API specifications and integration documentation (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman collections, data dictionaries and mapping documents) in partnership with developers and architects. Manages the integration between mbank and EIDR, including identifier registration, lookup, matching and reconciliation of titles, editions and versions; tracks changes to EIDR schemas, services and registry rules and assesses their impact on mbank. Manages the integration between mbank and IMDb, including data ingestion, field mapping, match logic and refresh cadence; monitors licensing, terms-of-use and usage constraints of the data with Legal and the data owners. Establishes strong, positive relationships with business units, Product Managers and external data providers to identify and document requirements and serves as the point of contact for partner-service questions and issues. Prioritizes business demands; participates in planning and prioritization meetings and maintains a prioritized backlog of enhancements, defect fixes, report requests and other mbank integration work that reflects organizational priorities. Defines data quality rules, validation and exception-handling requirements; monitors API and microservice performance, error rates and data discrepancies, and coordinates root-cause analysis and resolution. Plans and executes user acceptance testing, regression testing and release validation for API and microservice changes; supports deployment, change management and post-release review. Supports data governance and metadata standards by documenting identifier crosswalks, authoritative sources, data lineage and ownership between mbank, EIDR, IMDb and downstream consumers. Collaborates with product and project teams, business partners, IT and security leaders, and often leads planning efforts; manages ambiguity, creates accurate effort estimates, and recognizes the implications of business strategy changes. Develops training materials, process documentation, SOPs and help guides; supports and trains staff and business partners on mbank data and API capabilities. Investigates, resolves and escalates problems, and serves as an escalation point for others. Supports the Scrum Master and acts as a facilitator in all phases of the application lifecycle except development. Requirements for success: 7 years’ related experience, including: Gathering process requirements for IT systems, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria Defining, documenting or testing REST APIs and microservices (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman, JSON/XML payloads) Data migration, integration and governance Developing support materials, including SOPs and Help Guides Tracking risks and changes

Experience

job.title: Senior Accounting Analyst
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Job Description

The New York Times' Accounting team is looking for a Senior Accounting Analyst who has knowledge reviewing contracts and transactions. You will determine proper accounting treatment, and record following generally accepted accounting principles. You can query and analyze data sets, summarize data in a concise and meaningful manner, and highlight insights that help inform validating recorded transactions. This is a hybrid role based in our New York headquarters, reporting to the Senior Accounting Manager. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

About the Role

As a Senior Accounting Analyst, you will participate in month end closing work including the preparation of journal entries and balance sheet account reconciliations. Have the opportunity to recommend, document, and implement processes to facilitate the proper accounting of revenue and expense contracts. Furthermore, you will collaborate with partners to foster communication, learn about new contracts and products, improve processes, and to ensure the accuracy of accounting and reporting.

Responsibilities:

  • Review customer contracts and other transactions and ensure/document the proper accounting following ASC 606 or other relevant accounting standards.
  • Query, mine, report on data sets and use data analytics tools to validate and support recorded transactions.
  • Help research accounting questions related to internal and external reporting issues to ensure that financial results are reported in a complete and accurate manner consistent with our policies and accounting guidelines.
  • Compile information to satisfy requests from our external auditors.
  • Support NYT's Sarbanes-Oxley program by participating in quarterly and annual assessments, testing, review and remediation of test exceptions.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

Basic Qualifications:

  • Degree in Accounting or Finance
  • Certified Public Accountant
  • 3+ years of accounting experience
  • Knowledge of technical accounting pronouncements and standards (GAAP, FASB)
  • Advanced excel skills (i.e. macros)
  • Experienced communicating across multiple partners and ability to work cross functionally, including the ability to understand goals and and translate into transactional and reporting impacts

job.title: Senior Producer, Metro
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

The Metro desk at The Times is seeking a creative, knowledgeable and collaborative Senior Producer for its video journalism. Metro's journalism spans fast-moving breaking news, enterprise and investigations on a range of beats, from politics and education to transportation and criminal justice. We bring the issues of New York and its surrounding tri-state region to readers around the world, with deeply-reported narratives and unexpected tales.

You will bring a passion for news, a commitment to fast, authoritative coverage of breaking and developing stories, and the news judgment to identify enterprise stories and exclusives. An experienced video journalist and a manager, you'll help broaden Metro's coverage in a range of video formats. You are a talented storyteller and strong people manager who is passionate about breaking news, live journalism and enterprise.

Metro is known across the newsroom for its collegial culture. You'll work closely with Metro editors and reporters, and build strong relationships across the newsroom — especially Video and Photo — and partner with Metro leadership to shape and drive coverage. You'll bring an innovative, collaborative approach to motivating and inspiring teams to scale video on the desk and deliver fast-turnaround and ambitious work.

You will oversee everything from live streams and news clips to enterprise projects and Reporter Video, managing a team of video journalists to execute on each of those priorities. Your sharp visual and editorial skills will ensure that the right stories are assigned. Before videos are published onsite and on social media, you will ensure that they meet the editorial standards, style and quality of the Times.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • You will drive innovative, exclusive video coverage across a range of video formats, from short-form live-blog updates to Reporter Videos featuring Times journalists, enterprise stories and columns, and occasional field deployments.

  • You will manage and help hire video journalists on the desk.

  • You will help colleagues assess whether a story is suited to video and whether it should be told primarily or exclusively in that format, and mentor them as they develop their video storytelling skills.

  • You will lead story development and story edits.

  • You will review, assign and provide clear feedback on video productions.

  • You will support and guide script writing and visual approaches for effective short-form video.

  • You will oversee production across multiple projects.

  • You will guide interviews and shoots as needed, both in studio and field.

  • You will work with Metro and Video leadership to develop new video approaches and editorial strategies for the desk.

  • You will coordinate breaking news coverage with Video's Daily News and The Times's Live team, which produces real-time updates and analysis.

  • You will work with the Editor, Video Training to identify coaching opportunities for on-camera and shooting skills.

  • You will oversee the production of social content and off-platform video.

  • You will draw ideas from a range of video sources, including wire services, UGC, eyewitness video, archival footage, motion graphics, and originally-shot footage.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • You will report to the Metro editor.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years experience producing digital news videos.

  • 4+ years experience managing video journalists or newsroom teams.

  • Demonstrated expertise in sourcing, assessing and verifying video from a range of sources.

  • Expert knowledge of digital storytelling formats.

  • Understanding of mainstream and emerging social channels.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Excellent writing, editing and communication skills.

  • Expert knowledge of current events with advanced level experience covering breaking news stories in New York and experience covering news in the eastern United States.

  • Experience overseeing geolocation and UGC verification work.

  • Experience developing and editing visual material for social platforms.

  • Flexibility to work extended hours and some weekends.

job.title: Senior Manager, Workplace Experience
job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). About the Role As Suno grows its teams and real estate footprint across Cambridge, New York, Los Angeles, and San Francisco, the company is looking for a senior lead to own all workplace experience initiatives that make our offices feel unmistakably Suno, while helping us efficiently scale. You're the one who notices what's not landing, figures out why, and fixes it before anyone has to ask. Our Senior Manager, Workplace Experience sits at the center of a lot of moving parts: you'll build and iterate on in-office operations and programming, stand up systems that let workplace experience scale across four sites while keeping our human, music-centered touch, plan and run the operational and financial aspects of major office-based events and company offsites, and act as the cross-functional partner between Workplace and IT, Security, Finance, Communications, Music, Brand, and Executive Assistants, to name but a few. job.title: Application Support Analyst (D365 F&O)
job.description:
The Application Support Analyst provides administration, technical and functional support, maintenance, and continuous improvement for enterprise business applications, with a primary focus on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O). This role owns the operational processing and validation of financial data within D365 F&O, including billing, payments, revenue, and expenses, to support accuracy, financial integrity, and compliance with applicable requirements.

The Application Support Analyst monitors financial batch jobs, manages application configurations, troubleshoots issues, and supports reliable integrations and workflows across business functions. This position serves as a liaison among business stakeholders, IT, developers, and external vendors to resolve issues, improve application performance, and promote effective system utilization. This is an individual contributor position with no direct reports.

MAIN JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the operational processing and validation of billing, payments, revenue, and expense data within D365 F&O. Monitor and execute scheduled financial batch jobs, validate timely and accurate completion, troubleshoot failures, and resolve or escalate issues to support financial integrity, business deadlines, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Serve as the primary contact for application support requests and the primary owner of triaging technical and functional configuration issues across D365 F&O modules and related enterprise applications. Manage incidents through the enterprise ticketing system, investigate root causes, identify recurring issues, and coordinate resolution or escalation of complex application, infrastructure, integration, and code-related problems.

• Configure and maintain application settings, workflows, security roles, user access, and system controls in accordance with approved business requirements and security standards. Coordinate configuration changes across D365 F&O modules and associated upstream and downstream processes to maintain reliable operations and appropriate access.

• Monitor and validate application integrations, interfaces, and related batch jobs to support accurate and reliable data flow. Partner closely with Application Support Engineers, developers, and vendors to maintain, enhance, test, and support custom code, D365 objects, and system integrations.

• Coordinate application upgrades, patches, maintenance, and enhancement deployments to minimize business disruption. Gather requirements, support or lead user acceptance testing, document changes, and assist with implementation and post-deployment stabilization in accordance with IT change management processes.

• Maintain application inventories, architecture diagrams, configuration records, technical specifications, operational runbooks, and knowledge base content. Develop user guides and training materials, and deliver onboarding and ongoing guidance to improve system utilization and adoption of effective practices.

• Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate enhancement requests and identify opportunities to improve workflows, reporting, and operational efficiency. Use approved AI tools, low-code platforms, and automation technologies to support documentation, ticket analysis, and process improvements, and collaborate with technical teams to test and validate solutions.

• Coordinate with business units, IT teams, and external vendors to support service continuity, resolve escalations, and manage support needs, licensing compliance, and supported application versions. Prioritize assigned work independently, communicate service impacts and resolution status.

• Other duties as assigned.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related field and at least four years of progressive experience supporting enterprise or business-critical applications; or at least six years of relevant progressive experience in lieu of a degree.

• Hands-on experience providing technical and functional support for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, including financial processing, application configurations, and scheduled batch jobs.

• Working knowledge of financial workflows involving billing, payments, revenue, and expenses, including related data validation and system controls.

• Experience troubleshooting application issues, managing incidents, conducting root cause analysis, and supporting users in a business-critical environment.

• Working knowledge of integrations, APIs, middleware, and interface technologies, including experience investigating data flow issues and coordinating technical resolution.

• Experience creating, maintaining, or supporting reports using Power BI, SQL, or equivalent reporting tools.

• Experience using enterprise ticketing systems, such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk, to document, prioritize, resolve, and escalate support requests.

• Experience supporting application configuration, user access, security roles, workflows, testing, and change management activities.

• Strong documentation, organization, and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently.

• Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users and collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, developers, IT teams, and vendors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience supporting multiple D365 F&O modules and their upstream and downstream integrations.

• Experience partnering with developers to support custom D365 code, objects, extensions, and integrations.

• Experience with middleware, automation, or integration platforms such as Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, or comparable iPaaS solutions.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, approved AI tools, or other low-code technologies used for workflow automation and operational improvements.

• Experience supporting media, publishing, manufacturing, or multi-entity business environments.

• Familiarity with cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or AWS, and collaboration tools such as Google Workspace.

• Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, or ITIL service management practices.

• Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, or ITIL certification.

For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment.
