job.title: Senior Editor, Arts and Culture Hub
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline: Please submit your application materials by 11:59 pm EST November 19th, 2026

Intro to Position

This editor brings enthusiasm and fresh ideas to the coverage of cultural insights and deep respect for the curious audience. In collaboration with the Arts & Culture Hub editors and platform leads, this senior editor will be responsive to the news and drive NPR’s cultural insights coverage for broadcast and digital. They will work to identify and explain the values, beliefs, and social dynamics that shape our culture and guide the reporting team to explain and contextualize emerging trends with verve, speed and accuracy. This mandate includes providing insights into current artistic movements and trends, as well as deep dives to explain meaningful cultural change. This editor’s leadership will help the team break news and ideas. Because of the breadth of this beat, this editor will be a key decision-maker on the shape and design of day-to-day news coverage for the entire team. 

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with SAG-AFTRA. 

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

Generate story ideas and review story pitches with reporters on the Society & Culture desk, which includes coverage of movies, books, sports, religion and education, among other things.

  • Help develop storytelling approaches and sources, and determine the best platform for coverage.
  • Direct daily news and feature coverage of beat in collaboration with all platform leads, desks and others as appropriate;
  • Ability to fill-in or supplement editing of sports coverage, which may include some weekend work
  • Engage digital and visuals teams at the earliest stage of story and event planning and idea generation;
  • Proactively produce multiplatform coverage plans for major events and stories in collaboration with divisions and teams throughout NPR when necessary;
  • Edit stories for broadcast, digital, social, and newsletters, supporting critics and correspondents in developing and executing stories with speed, voice, and nuance.
  • Ability to advise show programmers and hosts on coverage threads, booking guests and interview questions.
  • Competent at audio production;
  • Competent in SEO, headline writing and other engagement best practices to ensure that all digital stories produced by the team are ready for posting;
  • Participate in, edit, and direct news coverage when needed, including the flexibility to work some evenings or weekends when needed, and also occasional holiday assignments.
  • Ensure that desk content meets NPR’s standards and practices (including accuracy, fairness, honesty, and impartiality). 

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience editing arts, entertainment and culture coverage.
  • Experience editing for radio and/or podcasting.
  • Experience with coverage of arts and culture, including but not limited to: movies, TV, visual arts, and books.
  • Experience in digital media, including editing copy, visuals and coordination with news apps as well as familiarity with content management systems and collaboration tools.
  • A strong record of multi-platform thinking and execution in daily news as well as feature and enterprise coverage.
  • Experience in editorial decision-making, including assigning reporters/correspondents.
  • Ability to handle multiple and complex projects simultaneously under stringent timeframes and changing priorities/conditions.
  • Ability to work quickly and efficiently under deadline pressure.
  • Ability and willingness to work varied shifts.
  • Demonstrated team collaboration and leadership skills.
  • Expertise in writing, with excellence in news, headline and broadcast writing as well as copy editing. 
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and effectively in challenging situations

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Familiarity with NPR member stations and the public media system.
  • Some experience and understanding of sports and sports journalism 
  • Flexibility, creativity and eagerness to innovate and embrace change.
  • Long-standing relationships and contacts in the entertainment industry are a plus. 

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in work experience

Work Location & Requirements

  • SAG-AFTRA Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. / Culver City / New York City location at least 2-3 days per week. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C. / Maryland / Virginia / Culver City / New York City.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $127,500 - $137,499 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees. 

Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.

job.title: Head of Shows, New York Magazine
job.description:
THE ROLE

New York Magazine is seeking a Head of Shows to lead our multiplatform show strategy across audio and video programming. This person will identify the most promising opportunities across our editorial brands, develop original franchises, and build a sustainable slate of shows that extend the reach and impact of New York Magazine across audio, video, social, and live platforms.

The ideal candidate is both a creative leader and a skilled production operator: someone who has successfully developed and launched multiple shows out of newsrooms, understands the audio and video landscape, and can recognize distinctive editorial voices and talent that translate into compelling programming.

In this role, you will work across New York Magazine’s portfolio, including The Cut, Vulture, and its four additional verticals, to identify talent, concepts, and audience opportunities that can become signature New York franchises.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop and execute a long-term video and audio strategy for New York Magazine, identifying the largest audience, editorial, and business opportunities across the magazine’s brands, coverage areas, and talent roster.
  • Conceive, develop, and launch new show concepts from idea through pilot, testing, and release, including the creation of multiple pilots and proof-of-concept projects in the first year.
  • Oversee all aspects of show development, including editorial direction, host development, visual approach, production workflows, and programming.
  • Build a long-term roadmap and development pipeline for a portfolio of multiplatform shows that support audience growth, engagement, and revenue objectives.
  • Partner with audience, video, and social teams to develop programming and distribution strategies for YouTube, podcast platforms, and social channels, including episode packaging, clips, and original social content.
  • Use audience insights and performance data to refine formats, grow existing shows, and inform development and investment decisions.
  • Identify and evaluate the potential to acquire or partner with existing external shows, creators, and talent when there is an opportunity to strengthen coverage areas aligned with the magazine’s audio and video strategy.
  • Build and manage a team, recruiting producers, external creative partners, and talent as needed, and oversee production budgets and schedules.
  • Work with the editorial team to integrate show appearances and video opportunities into major editorial bookings.
  • Partner with editors and production teams to develop author-read audio versions of major stories at a regular cadence.
  • Lead broader cross-functional stakeholder management and execution, e.g., collaborating with the audience team to develop multiplatform growth strategies and partnering with ad sales and subscription teams to build out franchise business opportunities

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 10+ years of experience developing, launching, and growing original video programs, podcasts, or multiplatform franchises.
  • Demonstrated track record of taking shows from concept to launch and audience growth, with experience across both video and audio.
  • Strong editorial instincts and experience translating culture, politics, business, lifestyle, or entertainment coverage into compelling audio and video formats.
  • Experience identifying, developing, and coaching on-air and on-camera talent.
  • Experience cultivating, managing, and collaborating with top-tier talent, creators, and celebrities.
  • Strong understanding of original video programming, video podcasting, creator-led media, and cross-platform content strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of audience behavior and distribution across YouTube, podcast platforms, and social channels.
  • Understanding of how shows can extend into newsletters, community, and live experiences.
  • Experience building teams, managing production budgets, and establishing development and production workflows.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills, including experience working closely with audience and revenue teams.
  • Ability to operate strategically while also executing hands-on development work.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort building programs from the ground up

PAY TRANSPARENCY

The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.

Pay Range$150,000—$250,000 USD

We recognize that great stories, platforms, products and services come from people with all manner of backgrounds and experiences. We recognize that our commitments require ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices.

job.title: Weather Graphics Production Artist
job.description:
We are seeking a weather graphic production artist with strong artistic and communication skills to join the AccuWeather Graphics Team at our Global Headquarters in State College, Pennsylvania, beginning January 2027. In this operational role, you’ll support graphics creation for internal stakeholders and external clientele across several medias, including print, television and digital. We are looking for someone who is collaborative, creative, and passionate about creating clear and accurate weather graphics that help people and businesses make the best weather-informed decisions.

 

Key Responsibilities

· Create weather maps, charts and graphs utilizing several different graphic programs and operating systems, including Baron and Photoshop

· Follow set graphical standards across print, television and digital.

· Assemble complete weather pages and graphic products by client and internal deadlines, utilizing automated and manual assembly procedures.

· Communicate effectively with Clients and other departments regarding any service or schedule changes or client requests.

· Ensure that all responsibilities are carried out with a proper sense of urgency, priority, and accuracy with a focus on the best service to the Client.

· Collaborate with fellow artists and operational team members (meteorologists, editors, broadcasters, etc) to produce clear and descriptive weather graphics.

· Contribute to special projects such as quality assurance, process improvement, customer support, or research and development.

· Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

 

Required Qualifications

· Associates Degree or higher in graphic design or similar field.

· At least 1 year of graphic creation experience.

· Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator software.

· Excellent written and oral communication skills.

· Demonstrated ability to effectively work and collaborate with a team.

· Strong eye for visual design, with the ability to create graphics that are clear, balanced, and visually appealing.

· Ability to follow instructions and standards to deliver on-brand graphical displays.

· Creative curiosity and a desire to develop new graphic concepts that support the established brand identity.

· Flexible availability to support 24-7 operation, including working weekends and holidays.

 

Preferred Qualifications

· Knowledge or hands-on experience with weather design software such as Baron or WSI is strongly preferred, (or similar software from News, Media, Sports industry).

· Interest in or familiarity with meteorology, weather forecasting, climate, environmental science or science communication.

· Experience collaborating directly with technical or scientific subject-matter experts.

· Knowledge of InDesign and Filemaker Pro software.

· Familiarity with using AI, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to create graphics, mock-ups or workflows.

 

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

job.description:
Graham Media Group November 9, 2026 Director of Sales Enablement & Development Graham Media Group November 9, 2026

Reports to: Sr. Director, of Sales

Work location: Detroit, MI

The Director of Sales Enablement & Development leads Graham Media Group’s enterprise-wide strategy for sales training, onboarding, leadership development, and performance excellence.   • Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM best practices, pipeline management disciplines, forecasting standards, and account growth strategies.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and learning solutions that increase productivity and seller performance.

  • Ensure the organization remains at the forefront of modern sales enablement and learning practices.

Required

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in sales leadership, sales enablement, learning and development, organizational development, sales training, or performance coaching.

  • Demonstrated success building enterprise onboarding, training, and enablement programs.

  • Experience leading learning management systems, certification programs, and talent development initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of consultative selling, media sales, digital advertising, and multi-platform revenue strategies.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Copilot, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint.

  • Strong CRM expertise, including pipeline management, forecasting, reporting, adoption, and sales analytics.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

  • Exceptional facilitation, presentation, communication, and leadership skills.

Preferred

  • Media industry sales leadership experience.

  • Experience supporting multi-market organizations.

  • Sales methodology certifications (Miller Heiman, Challenger, Sandler, Strategic Selling, SPIN, or comparable programs).

  • Experience implementing or managing an LMS platform.

  • Background in organizational development, learning strategy, or talent management.

  • Experience leading large-scale change management and transformation initiatives.

The HR Operations Specialist supports employees across the company by coordinating HR transactions, resolving production issues, and responding to questions. job.title: Analyst, Royalty Operations
job.description: Royalty Operations owns the operations behind Spotify’s royalty process across music, audiobooks, lyrics, and creator content. We implement content licenses in Spotify’s proprietary royalty systems, calculate and report royalties to our rightsholder partners, provide analytics to Accounting stakeholders, and serve as the go-to team for royalty questions across the company. As our business grows more complex, we’re focused on staying accurate and on time while getting faster and more flexible through scripting, Gen AI, and agentic workflows.

job.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
job.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business.
The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do.


We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

job.title: Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead
job.description:
At Spotify, our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by connecting creators with fans and helping listeners discover the audio they love. As we continue to grow in India, building lasting relationships with our listeners is central to our success.

Our Marketing team plays a key role in shaping how people discover, experience and stay connected to Spotify. We're looking for a Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead to develop strategies that deepen listener engagement, reduce churn and bring inactive users back. You'll combine consumer insights, data and creativity to build experiences that give listeners more reasons to return to Spotify.

job.title: Senior Accountant, General Ledger Accounting
job.description:
We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it.

As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

job.title: Jr. Royalties Analyst
job.description:
Who we are 

As a new industry alternative for independent artists, UnitedMasters provides premium music distribution services and facilitates unique partnerships between artists and the world’s biggest brands. We enable artists to maintain full ownership over their master recording rights while introducing them to millions of new fans worldwide through our direct brand partnerships.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Instagram, Dropbox, Complex, VICE and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation. 

Essential Responsibilities You’ll Own

  • Participate in the monthly royalty payout run process 
  • Preparation of monthly royalty payment reports and support documentation
  • Reviewing contracts to determine royalty payment requirements
  • Assists in the review of new contracts received from Licensors
  • Enter required contractual data points into the rights management system
  • Review and upload royalty reports including identification and resolution of any data conflicts
  • Liaise with agents to ensure timely receipt of royalty statement reporting
  • Prepare monthly 3rd party royalty statements
  • Work closely with Corporate Finance/Accounting team
  • Ad hoc requests and analytics to support Sales and Finance team
  • Process and review Artist royalty statements for contract compliance
  • Record transactions in our Royalty system
  • Track statements to be processed and update with status of outstanding issues
  • Prepare licensing and royalty data for reporting out to internal business partners
  • Other duties as assigned, including assist with month-end close, assist in preparation of participation reporting to parent company and other parties, assist with licensee audit program, assist with development of standards, processes, and procedures

What will set you up for success

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business/Music Business or closely related field
  •  2+ years of royalty experience
  • Must be detail-oriented and have excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Flexible work style: able to adjust to multiple demands and a changing and fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and exercise professional judgment
  • Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy required
  • Required technical skills: Advanced MS Excel (knowledge of pivot tables, subtotal, sort, filter, if statements, vlookups, etc. required)

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $65,000 – $75,000

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA. As a company, we have a location-based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world's leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodation

UnitedMasters is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

job.title: Accounts Payable Manager
job.description:
Company And Culture   Complex is the definitive platform for global youth culture and music lifestyle, seamlessly integrating cutting-edge content, commerce and live experiences with unparalleled scale. Through innovative content, Complex tells stories of music, streetwear and style, sports, art and beyond. Its content engages in a dynamic conversation with the audience, reflecting and shaping the zeitgeist of convergence culture. A powerful media juggernaut paired with a curated marketplace, Complex is redefining the way fans interact with their favorite brands and artists and reshaping the future of digital culture and commerce.   Why We're Hiring

Complex is a fast-paced company seeking a detail-oriented and self-motivated Accounts Payable Manager with exceptional communication and critical thinking skills, who thrives working in a collaborative environment. job.title: Copywriter
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

The role

We are looking for a dedicated and versatile Copywriter to join the Financial Times' Brand and Partnerships team, creating compelling, creative and persuasive marketing copy that brings the FT brand to life across a wide range of channels and audiences.

Reporting to the Senior Marketing Copywriter, you will work closely with colleagues across global communications, commercial marketing, design, creative and editorial teams to deliver impactful campaigns and messaging that strengthen the FT's reputation and encourage audiences to engage with our journalism.

From conceptual advertising campaigns, podcast and video scripts to digital ads, direct response emails, event marketing, speeches, white papers and social media, you'll have the opportunity to work on a diverse range of creative projects. You'll also help promote the FT's brand platform to both internal and external audiences, ensuring our distinctive tone of voice is reflected consistently in everything we do.

This is an opportunity to join a fast-paced, collaborative and ambitious team at the heart of a global news organisation. We're looking for someone who combines exceptional writing skills with critical thinking, creative flair and a genuine passion for news, brands and digital media.

Key responsibilities

  • Create high-quality, engaging and persuasive copy for a wide range of marketing campaigns, channels and audiences, including both B2B and B2C communications.

  • Work collaboratively with the Senior Marketing Copywriter, brand and creative teams, external agencies and internal collaborators to develop compelling creative concepts and messaging.

  • Champion and protect the FT's brand identity and tone of voice, ensuring consistent and impactful communications that strengthen our reputation as a trusted source of global journalism.

  • Write and adapt copy across multiple formats, including conceptual advertising, digital campaigns, emails, social media, podcast and video scripts, speeches, events and longer-form content.

  • Manage copywriting briefs from across the business, identifying the right approach for each audience and channel while balancing multiple projects and deadlines.

  • Review, edit and refine AI-generated copy, applying creative judgement to ensure accuracy, quality, originality and alignment with the FT's brand standards.

  • Ensure messaging is consistent, complementary and aligned with FT brand guidelines across all marketing activities.

  • Support the wider brand, marketing and business teams in developing communications that build awareness, encourage engagement and attract new subscribers.

Required skills and experience

  • A qualification in English, marketing, advertising, journalism or a related field.

  • At least two years' professional copywriting experience in advertising, marketing, media or a related field.

  • Exceptional writing skills, with demonstrable experience creating engaging and effective copy across a variety of channels, including print, digital, audio and speeches.

  • Experience writing for both consumer and business audiences, with the ability to adapt tone, style and messaging to suit different needs.

  • Strong creative and conceptual thinking, with the ability to interpret and challenge briefs and translate ideas into compelling copy.

  • Experience collaborating with designers, planners, product and technology teams to deliver effective creative communications.

  • Proficiency in using AI tools, alongside strong editorial judgement and the ability to review, edit and rewrite AI-generated content.

  • Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to handle priorities and work in a timely manner.

  • Experience working with senior collaborators and building effective relationships across teams.

  • A strong interest in journalism, current affairs, communications and digital media.

  • A proactive, adaptable and collaborative approach, with the confidence to work across different teams and levels of seniority.

  • Sound strategic judgement, creative curiosity and a commitment to producing consistently high-quality work, whether for a digital banner or a major brand campaign.

Desirable

  • Experience developing creative concepts for integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns.

  • Experience creating copy for brand platforms and maintaining a consistent tone of voice across different audiences and formats.

  • A passion for brand storytelling and an understanding of how creative communications can build reputation, engagement and loyalty.

What's in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may use AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com.

job.description:

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

The Role

The FT Group is entering a new chapter of growth and transformation. With record revenue and subscriptions, the business is evolving from a digital-first media organisation to one positioned for the AI era.

Our global Communications team plays a central role in this transition, protecting and strengthening the FT’s reputation, amplifying its world-class journalism and supporting the growth ambitions of its businesses. Working across the newsroom and business, the team develops integrated communications strategies that build trust, extend our reach and influence, engage employees and support the FT’s long-term success.

We’re looking for a Head of Communications, Editorial to lead our global editorial communications strategy, raise the profile of our journalism and editorial talent, and strengthen the FT’s reputation around the world.

This is an opportunity for an experienced communications leader with a passion for journalism to help shape how one of the world’s most respected news organisations tells its story. You’ll lead proactive communications around our journalism, advise senior editorial leaders on complex reputational issues and identify opportunities to extend the reach and influence of our editorial brands and talent.

Reporting to the Global Communications Director, you’ll work closely with the editor and senior editorial leadership, lead a small team and collaborate with colleagues across our global business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and delivery of communications strategies for the FT’s core editorial brands, products and formats, including the FT, FT Weekend, HTSI, audio and newsletters.

  • Develop creative, proactive communications campaigns around major editorial initiatives, launches, investigations, franchises and other strategic priorities, helping to extend the reach and impact of FT journalism.

  • Raise the external profiles of key editorial talent, identifying and securing opportunities across broadcast, podcasts, speaking engagements, events and other influential platforms.

  • Act as a trusted senior communications adviser to the editor and editorial leadership, providing strategic counsel on sensitive, complex and reputational issues involving the newsroom.

  • Anticipate emerging issues and develop effective communications strategies, messaging, Q&As and supporting materials to protect and strengthen the FT’s reputation.

  • Partner with regional communications colleagues, particularly in New York and Hong Kong, to deliver a coordinated and impactful global editorial communications strategy.

  • Collaborate with Brand, Reader Revenue Group, Commercial Client Group and other teams to ensure editorial communications activity complements wider FT campaigns and supports audience and business objectives, while respecting editorial independence.

  • Lead, manage and develop a small editorial communications team, setting clear priorities, providing direction and supporting professional growth.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Significant experience developing and delivering high-impact communications strategies, ideally within media, journalism or another complex, high-profile organisation.

  • A sophisticated understanding of the global media landscape, alongside a strong interest in journalism, news and current affairs.

  • A strong understanding of the forces reshaping the global media industry, including artificial intelligence, changing audience behaviours and the evolving distribution landscape.

  • A proven track record of developing proactive media campaigns and successfully building the profiles of senior leaders and high-profile talent.

  • Excellent judgement, with significant experience advising senior stakeholders on sensitive, complex or reputational issues.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex subjects into clear, engaging and compelling narratives.

  • Strong relationship-building and influencing skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively with senior editors, journalists and commercial colleagues while understanding and respecting editorial independence.

  • Experience leading, managing and developing communications professionals, with the ability to set priorities, inspire confidence and support team development.

What’s in it for You?

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. The role

We're looking for a Marketing Automation Journey Lead to join our Reader Revenue Group and play a key role in shaping how we engage with customers across their lifecycle.

As our Consumer and B2B subscription businesses evolve towards a more sophisticated, customer-led approach to growth, engagement and retention, Marketing Automation plays a critical role in delivering relevant, connected and effective customer experiences.

Our Marketing Automation teams operate as a Centre of Excellence, bringing together journey expertise, platform capabilities, experimentation, personalisation and measurement to drive customer and commercial value.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing Automation (Consumer or B2B), you'll be responsible for ensuring we're automating and improving the right customer experiences.

Sitting between lifecycle strategy and execution, this is a journey architecture, orchestration and optimisation role. You'll partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing and other collaborators to understand customer needs and commercial objectives, translating these into effective automated experiences.

You'll take a comprehensive view of the automated journey portfolio, finding opportunities to improve how journeys, campaigns, triggers and customer or account states work together. You'll assess existing activity, identify gaps or overlaps, and recommend whether journeys should be optimised, extended, redesigned, consolidated or retired.

Rather than focusing primarily on building individual campaigns, you'll lead the thinking behind journey design and optimisation, developing actionable recommendations and coordinating delivery through Marketing Automation Specialists and Executives.

You'll also work closely with your counterpart in the Consumer or B2B Marketing Automation team, sharing expertise and helping establish consistent standards, experimentation approaches and guidelines across the Centre of Excellence.

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the FT's customer experience, ensuring automated journeys are connected, measurable and continuously improving.

Key responsibilities

Journey architecture and orchestration

  • Partner with Lifecycle Marketing and other collaborators to understand business objectives, customer needs, target audiences and lifecycle challenges.

  • Translate strategic briefs into effective automation opportunities, challenging proposed solutions where necessary to address the underlying customer or commercial problem.

  • Maintain a comprehensive view of the automated journey portfolio, ensuring journeys, campaigns, triggers and customer or account states work together coherently.

  • Map and visualise customer journeys, identifying gaps, overlaps, friction and opportunities to improve reach, relevance and effectiveness.

  • Determine whether objectives are best achieved by optimising existing journeys, introducing new pathways, adjusting triggers, content or sequencing, or retiring existing activity.

  • Design automated experiences using appropriate audiences, channels, behavioural signals, personalisation, decisioning and timing.

  • Define journey sequencing, eligibility, hierarchy and suppression rules to handle interactions between customer experiences.

  • Work with Data, Technology, Creative and Marketing Automation colleagues to translate journey designs into delivered experiences.

Portfolio optimisation and prioritisation

  • Own and maintain the journey opportunity and optimisation roadmap, prioritising activity according to customer and commercial impact, reach, effort and strategic importance.

  • Regularly audit automated journeys to find opportunities for improvement, redesign, consolidation or retirement.

  • Investigate underlying audience, data, design and execution issues to understand journey performance.

  • Find opportunities to improve customer experiences through behavioural triggers, segmentation, personalisation and multichannel orchestration.

  • Ensure journeys are continuously reviewed and optimised rather than treated as one-off launches.

  • Work with the Head of Marketing Automation to align optimisation priorities with the wider strategy and available capacity.

Measurement, testing and learning

  • Establish clear objectives, KPIs and measurement approaches for significant journey interventions.

  • Incorporate testing and experimentation into journey design, including hypotheses, control groups and learning objectives where appropriate.

  • Use customer, account, behavioural and commercial data to assess journey effectiveness and find opportunities.

  • Evaluate broader journey outcomes alongside individual campaign performance, focusing on measurable customer and commercial impact.

  • Translate analysis and experimentation into actionable recommendations and future improvements.

  • Contribute to shared learning, measurement frameworks and procedures across the Centre of Excellence.

Delivery leadership and collaboration

  • Translate journey recommendations into clear, actionable briefs for Marketing Automation Specialists and Executives.

  • Work with delivery teams to define audience requirements, triggers, branching logic, personalisation, sequencing, testing and data dependencies.

  • Provide architectural direction, reviewing implementation proposals and identifying risks or opportunities for improvement.

  • Coach and support colleagues in journey design, optimisation and effective use of automation capabilities.

  • Collaborate with Consumer and B2B counterparts to share expertise, find opportunities and develop consistent approaches.

  • Contribute to Centre of Excellence playbooks and standards for journey design, testing, personalisation and orchestration.

Platform and capability development

  • Apply a strong understanding of marketing automation and customer data platforms to design effective journeys.

  • Find opportunities to make better use of existing automation capabilities and work with technical colleagues where further development may be required.

  • Combine customer and account data, behavioural signals, segmentation and decisioning to improve relevance and effectiveness.

  • Support the development and adoption of scalable, reusable Marketing Automation standards and ways of working.

Required skills and experience

  • Significant experience in marketing automation, CRM, lifecycle marketing or a closely related field.

  • Strong expertise in customer journey architecture, design and orchestration, with the ability to think across interconnected customer experiences rather than individual campaigns.

  • Experience handling or optimising a portfolio of automated journeys, identifying gaps, dependencies and opportunities for improvement.

  • Ability to translate customer and commercial challenges into clear journey strategies and practical automation solutions.

  • Strong understanding of automation principles, including triggers, segmentation, personalisation, decisioning, channel selection, frequency and journey sequencing.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using customer, behavioural and commercial data to improve outcomes.

  • Experience developing testing and experimentation approaches and applying insights to journey optimisation.

  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how automated journeys contribute to acquisition, conversion, onboarding, engagement, retention and customer value.

  • Ability to map, visualise and explain sophisticated customer journeys to collaborators with varying levels of technical expertise.

  • Strong relationship management, collaboration and influencing skills, including confidence challenging briefs and recommending alternative approaches.

  • Experience coaching or mentoring colleagues and supporting the development of others.

  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise contending opportunities and make evidence-based recommendations.

  • Sufficient technical and platform knowledge to understand implementation requirements, identify dependencies and challenge proposed solutions.

Desirable

  • Experience in subscription, digital media, recurring revenue or other customer lifecycle businesses.

  • Familiarity with sophisticated marketing automation or customer data platforms such as Bloomreach, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo or equivalent.

  • Experience with behavioural decisioning, next-best-action, dynamic content or advanced personalisation.

  • Experience designing or optimising multichannel journeys across email, onsite and other digital channels.

  • Knowledge of account-based marketing, multi-contact buying journeys or complex B2B customer relationships.

  • Experience developing reusable journey frameworks, playbooks or operating standards.

  • Experience working across B2C and B2B audiences or within a Centre of Excellence.

job.title: Associate Director, Influence, 12 month FTC (mat cover) - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Burson is building three global Influence & Social Centres of Excellence in the US, Singapore, and London. As part of our UK Centre of Excellence, which serves as the hub for the EMEA region, we are seeking an Associate Director, Influence to play a pivotal, hands-on role in scaling and evolving our Total Influence offer.

This is an exciting opportunity for a mid-to-senior influencer specialist who combines strategic vision with flawless operational execution. Sitting within our multi-disciplinary capability, you will be the day-to-day strategic engine and trusted advisor across all agency practices. You will plan, oversee, and execute best-in-class influencer-led campaigns that earn cultural relevance, protect reputation, and deliver measurable business impact.

As an Influence Associate Director, you will be a dynamic, commercially astute specialist and creative thinker, leading best-in-class, influencer-led content strategies and programmes across all agency sectors. Viewing "influence" holistically, you will provide strategic and practical counsel to clients and internal teams; from identification, vetting, and contracting to creative co-creation, paid integration, and measurement. Partnering with UK head of Influence, you will elevate Burson’s influencer marketing offer, inspire dedicated specialists, and upskill teams to deliver exceptional, measurable results.

What you'll do:

 

Grow: Commercial & Sector Partnership

  • Strategic Influence Partner: Act as a trusted adviser to sector and practice leads, translating client and business briefs into culturally relevant, influencer-led strategies.
  • Commercial & Organic Growth: Partner with the UK Head of Influence and senior teams to develop winning pitches, shape commercial models and identify opportunities to grow influence across existing and new client accounts.
  • Holistic Influence Strategy: Champion a broader view of influence beyond traditional creators, incorporating thought leaders, B2B voices, subject-matter experts and advocates across owned, earned, shared and paid channels.

Enable: Delivery, Operations & Best Practice

  • Best-in-Class Campaign Delivery: Lead end-to-end influencer programmes, from discovery, vetting and contracting through to creator briefing, co-creation, rights management and live campaign delivery.
  • Creative, Paid & Performance Integration: Work closely with creators to deliver authentic, high-quality content while connecting organic influence with paid amplification, licensing, whitelisting and performance marketing opportunities.
  • Governance, Tools & Team Development: Ensure programmes meet ASA, CMA, IP and Burson compliance standards, while embedding tools such as CreatorIQ and GWI and upskilling teams on influencer best practice, cultural trends and effective ways of working.

Transform: Innovation & Modern Measurement

  • Measurement & Impact: Partner with data and intelligence specialists to evolve how influence is measured, moving beyond vanity metrics to demonstrate sentiment, cultural share of voice, reputation shift and conversion.
  • Platform & Innovation Leadership: Build strong relationships with platforms including TikTok, Meta, YouTube and LinkedIn, while testing and embedding AI and emerging capabilities through Burson's AI suite and WPP Open to improve discovery, reporting and workflow efficiency.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Proven Agency Experience: Substantial influencer marketing experience within an agency, PR, or integrated creative environment, operating at Account Director / Junior Associate Director level.
  • Strategic & Creative Rigour: Ability to plan multi-channel content strategies that are influencer-first, with a strong understanding of how audience mapping and data inform creative platforms and creator selection.
  • Negotiation & Contracting Mastery: Deep practical expertise in creator negotiation, complex scope structuring, multi-platform licensing, exclusivity, and contract management.
  • Tech Fluency: Hands-on proficiency with dedicated influencer tech platforms (specifically CreatorIQ) and consumer research tools (such as GWI).
  • Collaborative Leadership: A natural relationship-builder who can seamlessly partner with cross-functional teams (strategy, creative, earned media, paid, data) and mentor junior talent.
  • Client Advisory Skills: Calm, authoritative client-handling skills with the ability to articulate the strategic value of influencer marketing to both senior brand marketers and communications directors.
  • Commercial Acumen: Experience building accurate scopes of work, production budgets, talent fees, and pitch responses that protect agency margins and client ROI.

Burson UK was named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026!

#LI-CY1

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

2027 Weiss Center Ambassadors

*IMPORTANT NOTE*: This application is only for students who are currently enrolled at Syracuse University. About the Weiss Center:
The Weiss Center is a student, faculty and industry-powered incubator that complements classroom curriculum through immersive, real-world application. By connecting classroom learning with the pace and expectations of the communications field, the Center helps students build the skills, perspective and confidence to enter the industry with a leg up.  

About the Role:
Each year, two Syracuse University students are selected to serve as Weiss Center Brand Ambassadors. The program offers a multifaceted experience that allows students to represent the Center on campus, contribute to its programming, and work alongside Real Chemistry experts and clients through a summer internship and other hands-on opportunities. Along the way, Ambassadors build the professional skills, experience and relationships needed to succeed in an evolving communications industry. 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Summer Internship: Complete a full-time, paid, 10-week summer internship with Real Chemistry 
  • Promote Center programming: Work alongside Real Chemistry staff to drive awareness and provide on-the-ground support for the Center’s fall and spring programming, including the Jim Weiss Lecture Series, expert-led workshops, class visits and other hands-on learning experiences. 
  • Manage social and digital content: Manage Weiss Center social channels and collaborate with peers to develop blog posts and multimedia content. 
  • Build professional connections: Attend exclusive networking opportunities with Real Chemistry executives, staff and clients, as well as Syracuse faculty. 
  • Support a potential NYC benchmark trip: Help plan and attend a visit to the Real Chemistry office and other firms, pending schedule. 
  • SXSW trip: Participate in an all-expenses-paid trip to Austin, Texas to attend Real Chemistry’s events at the SXSW Interactive conference and support social media and digital content development

  • Comfort engaging with peers and helping foster an inclusive campus community.
    • Other on-campus involvement is a plus

  • Particular interest in students with a background or interest in public relations, communications, advertising, marketing and/or information studies.

  • Term: Proposed Spring and Fall 2027 on-campus service, plus a full-time, paid, 10-week summer internship. Note: Specific dates of summer 2027 internship program TBD (tentatively June-August 2027)
  • SXSW attendance: Ability to travel for all-expense paid trip to Austin, Texas (tentatively March 14-17), pending schedule

  • Compensation: The summer internship is paid ($20/hour); any potential travel (Austin, TX and/or NYC) are all-expenses-paid. The Brand Ambassador Program is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity.

job.title: WPP Media, Associate Director, Japan
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Associate Director

Description

This role forms a key part of the Mindsahre Japan Leadership Team. The Client Leader will be responsible for working collaboratively with local, regional and global colleagues to deliver best in class service and delivery to the several clients.

Leading the client relationship and maintenance of the quality of contracted services, lobbying additional assignments as well as developing an appetite for and building revenues from out-of-scope offerings and value add services for the assigned client are also a part of this role and collaborate to work with senior management. Additionally, it is expected to work on the new business pitch with the collaboration work with the regional and global teams in Mindshare networks as well as WPP agencies.

Finally ensuring commitments made to clients are specific and deliverable, ideally exceeded!

3 best things about the job:

  1. Opportunity to have the partner relationship with well-known global clients
  2. Key strategic role in Mindshare’s business and being a part of Japan's leadership
  3. Exposure with regional and global teams across Mindshare network and WPP agencies 

Measures of success:

In three months,

  • Gained the respect of your team, leadership team and Mindshare Global / Regional teams
  • Created relationships with key clients
  • Set your own agenda and roadmap for media

In six months,

  • Met revenue and client satisfaction targets
  • Ensured that each member of the team can successfully followed up on their professional growth plan

In twelve months,

  • Optimized the team structure / responsibility as required
  • Be described as our clients’ lead business partner across the assigned accounts

Objectives

  • Lead a brand with services scope focused on communications planning and offline + online media campaign implementation management, by leveraging performance data analytics and your digital expertise.
  • Define the strategic approach on the account to meet the client’s business objectives and strategies and oversees the implementation of the annual planning as well as the implementation approach in conjunction with the client team
  • Support management for the profitable and efficient running of each account through the allocation of resources, process and systems across the portfolio.

Client Management

  • Anticipate the client’s needs and set up internal process to meet / exceed them
  • Own the end to end client interaction and engagement to ensure the long term success of the relationship

Operational Excellence

  • Collaborate with global and regional teams and cascade clear understanding of strategic principles, guidelines and deliverables to the team
  • Manage team to ensure deliverables are met the client expectations
  • Improve interfaces between planning, buying and digital teams within Mindshare and wider GroupM teams

People Leadership

  • Identify, retain and develop talents at all levels in order to effectively deliver to the customer with operational excellence within the team.
  • Manage and develop the team individually and collectively
  • Maintain high level of motivation throughout team members

Qualifications and Requirements

  • 7+ years of senior management experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in a business, numerical or analytical degree
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, ability and flexibility to manage both local and global stakeholders
  • Ability to influence and manage key client stakeholders (media managers)
  • Demonstrable people management experience gained within a matrix management structure and specific capability at developing and sharing knowledge and developing team(s) and resource capabilities
  • Bilingual preferred with fluency in English.

    More about Mindshare

We were born in Asia in 1997, a start up with a desire to change the media world. Now we are a global agency with more than 7,000 employees in 116 offices across 86 countries, operating as one team - #teammindshare. We believe that in today’s world, everything begins and ends in media. We aim to be our clients’ lead business partner, to grow their business, and drive profitability through adaptive and inventive marketing. We do this through speed, teamwork and provocation and by operating as a network of networks rather than a rigid hierarchy. We create new things and have fun doing it. Whenever and wherever you join us, you open a door to opportunities in any and of all aspects of media, technology and innovation. We will support you, recognize you and reward you, making Mindshare the place where you do the best work of your career.

Mindshare APAC has won 500 awards in the last year alone, including “Agency Network of the Year 2017” by both the MMA SMARTIES™ and Campaign Asia for the fifth and third consecutive year, respectively. Mindshare is part of GroupM, the media investment management arm of WPP, the world’s leading communications services group. To learn more about Mindshare and our philosophy of Original Thinking, visit us at mindshareworld.com and follow us on Twitter @mindshareand facebook.com/mindshareapac and linkedin.com/company/mindshare.

job.title: Market Manager
job.description:
Position Summary

Beasley Media Group is seeking a dynamic, results-oriented Market Manager to lead the strategic, operational, and financial performance of the Augusta market. The Market Manager serves as the senior leader responsible for driving revenue growth, cultivating a high-performance culture, and maximizing the impact of Beasley Media Group's audio, digital, event, and marketing solutions.  This is a confidential leadership opportunity.

The ideal candidate is a strong business leader with a proven track record of revenue generation, team development, and market influence. This individual will inspire cross-functional teams while ensuring alignment with company objectives and delivering exceptional results for advertisers, listeners, and community partners.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Market Strategy

  • Lead all aspects of market operations, including sales, programming, digital, promotions, engineering, and business administration.
  • Develop and execute strategic plans to achieve market revenue, profitability, and audience growth objectives.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Build strong relationships with local business leaders, community organizations, and key stakeholders.
  • Represent Beasley Media Group within the market and at industry events.

Revenue Growth

  • Drive revenue performance across broadcast, digital, event, and integrated marketing platforms.
  • Collaborate with sales leadership to establish and achieve aggressive revenue goals.
  • Identify new business opportunities and emerging revenue streams.
  • Review sales pipelines, forecasting, and market performance metrics to ensure consistent growth.
  • Lead and support key client relationships and strategic account development efforts.

Talent Development

  • Recruit, develop, and retain top-performing leaders and team members.
  • Provide coaching and mentorship to department heads and sales leadership.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and accountability measures.
  • Promote employee engagement and professional development across the organization.

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure efficient market operations and adherence to company policies and procedures.
  • Manage budgets and maintain fiscal responsibility while maximizing business performance.
  • Monitor market KPIs and implement corrective action plans when necessary.
  • Collaborate with corporate leadership to support company initiatives and strategic priorities.

Community Impact

  • Strengthen Beasley Media Group's presence and reputation within the local community.
  • Support local events, charitable initiatives, and public service efforts.
  • Champion diversity, inclusion, and community engagement initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Media Management, or related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
  • 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in media, advertising, broadcasting, digital marketing, or related industries.
  • Demonstrated success leading revenue-generating teams and achieving business objectives.
  • Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain executive-level client relationships.

Preferred

  • Experience managing a media or multi-platform advertising operation.
  • Knowledge of digital marketing products, audience analytics, and integrated advertising solutions.
  • Experience leading multiple departments and cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with FCC regulations and media industry best practices.

Why Join Beasley Media Group?

At Beasley Media Group, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, shape the future of local media, and make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. We offer a collaborative culture, entrepreneurial environment, competitive compensation, and opportunities for professional growth.

The position will remain open until filled.

Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values diversity in the workplace.

job.title: GRAY MEDIA TRAINING PROGRAM SPRING '27 - WCAX
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WCAX:

WCAX is the original and leading station in the Burlington-Plattsburgh market. We paved the way for TV in this whole area of the country. We are a station of innovators. If you are the person who will help us inform, educate, entertain, and delight an audience of more than 750,000 people, then you need to send your resume to us right now.

Take this opportunity to build your career in a place people come from all over the world to enjoy. Ski at some of the best-known resorts in America in the winter and hike, boat, and play outdoors in the summer. The Burlington, Vermont, area is one of the most beautiful places in North America. Maybe you'll find yourself at the top of the Green Mountains in Vermont or the Adirondacks in New York. Then again, the foodie culture of downtown Burlington may whet your appetite for delicious traditional favorites or haute cuisine.

Job Summary:

Are you tired of just watching from the sidelines? Ready to stop "shadowing" and start actually doing the work that reaches thousands of people every single day? We’re looking for the next generation of media powerhouses, producers, reporters, weather experts, and sales executives—who are hungry to dive head-first into the fast-paced world of local media. This isn't your typical "get the coffee" internship. The Gray Media Training Program is a high-octane, 10-week immersive experience where you don’t just learn the job, you own it. Whether you’re crafting the lead story for the evening news, tracking a cold front on our weather tech, or closing a digital ad deal, you’ll be a vital part of our award-winning team from day one. The Intern rate of pay can range from minimum wage in your state to $15 an hour.

The Training Program:

General Responsibilities:

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the role: Step into the shoes of a producer, MMJ, meteorologist, or media sales executive and handle real-world assignments (yes, the kind that may go on air and online). 
  • Drive digital engagement: Create content that lives beyond the TV screen; think social media, streaming apps, and web stories because we’re digital-first, always.
  • Collaborate with pros: Work side by side with seasoned veterans who are the best in the business, gaining insights you won’t find in any textbook.
  • Commit to the craft: Dedicate 25 hours per week for 10 weeks to mastering your specialty and building a professional-grade portfolio.
  • Make an impact: Tell stories that matter to the community or help local businesses grow through innovative media strategies. 
  • Build your future: Position yourself at the front of the line for full-time career opportunities within Gray Media’s network of 116 stations.

What You Bring:

  • Current enrollment: You’re a college student (Junior or Senior status preferred) chasing a degree in Journalism, Communications, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A "doer" mindset: You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty and take initiative; you’re here to work, not just watch.
  • Digital savvy: You understand that media happens everywhere, from the big screen to the palm of someone’s hand.
  • Strong work ethic: You bring urgency, organization, and a "can-do" attitude to every shift.
  • Communication skills: You can tell a story, pitch an idea, or explain a forecast with clarity and confidence.
  • Reliability: You’re ready to commit to the full 10-week program and the 25-hour weekly schedule.
  • Passion for local: You care about the community and want to see how local media makes a real difference.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

  • Real-world experience: You’ll graduate with more than just a line on your resume; you’ll have the experience of having done the job.
  • Unprecedented access: With 113 stations across the U.S., you’re part of a massive, innovative network that’s leading the future of media.
  • Career fast-track: We love hiring our own. This program is designed to be the ultimate audition for your first full-time role with Gray.
  • Paid training: Earn while you learn. This is a paid internship. 
  • A culture of innovation: We’re evolving on purpose, and you’ll be right there on the front lines of that evolution.

    Qualifications/Requirements:

    ▪️ Be currently enrolled in a college/university (preferred Junior/Senior)
    ▪️ Strong work ethic and organizational skills
    ▪️ Earning a degree in Journalism/Communications, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, News, Sports, or related fields, with a desire to get hands-on experience in the local media industry

    If you are interested in interning in these areas, the station may have openings in these departments for you:

    • Marketing
    • Creative Services
    • Sports
    • Weather
    • News Production 
    • News MMJ 
    • Engineering 

    Ready to stop practicing and start performing? Let’s build the future of media together

    The intern rate of pay can range from minimum wage in your state to $15 an hour.

    ▪️ Interested in the program?  Go to https://gray.tv/careers#currentopenings, type "Intern WCAX" (in the search bar)

    WCAX-TV/Gray Media is a drug-free company

    Additional Info:

    Gray Media provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Gray Media complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment at every location where the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

    Gray Media expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with Gray’s employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in discipline, up to and including discharge.
