job.title: Application Security Engineer
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide. At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world. In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing. Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere. Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

The Role Overview

We’re looking for a Cyber Security Engineer to help improve application security across the FT’s cloud-native technology estate. This is a hands-on role focused on making secure engineering easier for product, platform and software engineering teams.

Application security experience is essential for this role. You’ll help improve developer-friendly security guardrails across GitHub-based CI/CD pipelines, application repositories and engineering workflows. This includes working with SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning, vulnerability management and secure coding guidance so that security findings are clear, actionable and owned by the right teams.

You’ll work closely with engineers to support practical threat modelling, triage application vulnerabilities, improve security playbooks and help teams remediate issues in a pragmatic way. You do not need to be a deep AWS or cloud security specialist, but some exposure to AWS, cloud security or infrastructure-as-code security would be useful.

We’re looking for someone with practical AppSec experience who wants to grow their impact - someone who enjoys working with engineers, improving tooling and helping security become part of normal delivery rather than a last-minute checkpoint.

What you’ll bring to the role

Application security experience: practical experience identifying, explaining and helping remediate application security risks in modern engineering environments.

Developer-friendly security mindset: you enjoy working with engineers, explaining risks clearly and helping teams adopt secure practices without unnecessary friction.

Vulnerability management experience: experience triaging and tracking application vulnerabilities from sources such as SAST, dependency scanning, secret scanning, penetration tests, bug bounty reports or third-party advisories.

CI/CD and code security awareness: familiarity with security tooling in development workflows, such as SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning or repository security controls.

Threat modelling awareness: experience participating in, supporting or facilitating lightweight threat-modelling sessions for applications, services or new features.

Automation mindset: ability to write scripts or small tools, ideally in Python, to reduce manual effort, improve visibility or make security workflows easier.

Cloud security awareness: Some exposure to AWS, cloud security or infrastructure-as-code security would be useful, but is not essential.

Growth mindset: willingness to keep developing across application security, cloud security, secure development and modern engineering practices.

Required Experience, Essential

  • Practical experience in application security.
  • Experience working with software engineers to explain and remediate security issues.
  • Familiarity with common web application security risks and secure coding practices.
  • Experience with vulnerability triage, prioritisation and remediation tracking.
  • Experience using or interpreting findings from tools such as SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning or similar.
  • Experience participating in or supporting threat-modelling activities.
  • Ability to write scripts or small tools, ideally in Python, to automate tasks or improve visibility.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum ways of working.

Desirable

  • Exposure to AWS security, cloud security or infrastructure-as-code security.
  • Experience with Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with container or Kubernetes security.
  • Experience with bug bounty, penetration testing or security testing programmes.
  • Experience with Splunk or similar logging/SIEM platforms.
  • Exposure to AI security, such as LLM-enabled applications, AI-assisted development workflows or prompt/data leakage risks.
  • Experience building dashboards, metrics or reports to support vulnerability management.
  • Relevant security certifications or training, such as AWS security training, secure coding training, GIAC, ISC2, CREST or equivalent practical experience.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams. 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Director to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, a Real Chemistry subsidiary is an advertising agency born to make healthcare more human. It’s a place where people subscribe to the adage, “Be good to each other, but hard on the work.” A place where people are not just in it for the paycheck, but to make a dent in the universe. This position offers the opportunity to become an internal leader while developing strong relationships with clients.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

  • Establish and maintain productive working relationships to drive agency success

  • Lead by example: exhibit professional conduct while providing ongoing leadership as a role model for the team

  • Pursue business objectives, while developing talent and preserving the 21GRAMS culture
  • Supervise, train, and mentor team members to develop the skills and careers of others by providing guidance

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

job.title: AI Engineer
job.description:
Opportunity

Brunswick is on an exciting journey to harness the power of artificial intelligence and data science to enhance the way we work and the advice we provide to clients. As we continue to expand our AI capabilities, we are looking for an AI Engineer to join our growing team.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining AI-powered applications that deliver real value across the business. Working closely with our existing AI team, you will help build innovative solutions using modern AI technologies, with a particular focus on large language models (LLMs).

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with hands-on experience developing and deploying AI applications who enjoys solving complex problems, working with a high degree of autonomy, and turning emerging technologies into practical, high-quality products.

You will thrive in this role if you are curious, creative, and passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges. You take pride in writing robust, maintainable code and enjoy collaborating with colleagues to continuously improve and expand our AI capabilities.

About the Role

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Support, run, and iterate existing AI applications.
  • Design, develop, deploy, and maintain new AI applications which can be scaled across multiple business use cases, driving operational and commercial outcomes.
  • Trial and test solutions with end users to iterate and optimise them.
  • Research and analyse data sets using a variety of statistical and machine learning techniques.
  • Track and understand the evolving AI landscape.

What We’re Looking For

The successful candidate will be a highly professional, well-rounded individual with strong problem-solving skills, engineering expertise, strategic thinking, and excellent interpersonal skills. They will have a strong academic background complemented by an outstanding career to date. Standout candidates will demonstrate:

  • Experience building solutions with large language models (LLMs) and a deep understanding of the broader generative AI landscape.
  • Experience designing datasets, conducting model evaluations, and fine-tuning foundation models to improve task-specific performance.
  • Strong Python development skills, including experience writing production-quality code.
  • Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, HTML, and CSS.
  • A solid understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.
  • An undergraduate degree in a quantitative discipline, such as Mathematics or Computer Science, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment with changing priorities and an iterative, user-focused approach to development.
  • Curiosity, a strong sense of ownership, and the ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
  • Previous experience in professional services would be advantageous.
  • Experience developing cloud applications on Microsoft Azure would be advantageous.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g. CI/CD, Git) would be desirable.
  • Knowledge of, or experience with, secure software development practices would be advantageous.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. job.description:

Are you a young professional eager to grow your advisory career and work on a variety of high-stakes issues? Brunswick Group is seeking a talented Consultant with 1 to 3 years’ relevant experience to join our Brussels office and help national and international clients navigate complex EU policy, political and stakeholder issues. This is an opportunity to develop in a dynamic, fast-paced advisory environment at the intersection of business, media and politics.

As a Junior Consultant, you will deliver timely across policy, politics and media, while building a strong understanding of our clients’ businesses. You will prepare clear, accurate client materials (documents and presentations), support the effective coordination of projects and work closely with colleagues across teams. You will gain exposure to diverse sectors and international projects, and begin developing your own professional network and advisory skills.

Our Brussels team combines in-depth knowledge of EU and Member State policymaking with experience across a broad range of sectors, including industrials and infrastructure, new technologies, healthcare, energy and transportation, as well as banking and financial services or consumer industries.

  • Keep colleagues informed of project status; develop action plans, engagement trackers, meeting requests and notes.
  • Prepare stakeholder background reports and relevant mapping (political and media).

  • Effectively handle logistics around client meetings and other client events.
  • Identify and assess positioning opportunities for clients.
  • Collaborate with peers and senior colleagues to clarify expectations, manage priorities and deliver work accurately and on time.
  • Build relationships and a professional network outside the firm.

job.description:

job.title: APAC Media AI Orchestration Senior Director, Japan
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

APAC AI Media Orchestration Senior Director – Japan

 About the role Help shape how AI transforms media and marketing for one of WPP Media's key clients: Google. This newly created leadership role within Media Futures Group (WPP Media's bespoke agency for Google) brings together media expertise, practical AI delivery and organizational transformation. Based in Japan, you will help pioneer agentic workflows at scale for Google, connecting regional and global capabilities with the needs of the local market. Your remit is to turn AI ambition into everyday practice: identifying high-impact opportunities, piloting and deploying AI agents across live campaigns, developing solutions for Japan-specific needs, and helping teams adopt new ways of working. You will partner with senior client and agency stakeholders, cross-functional media teams, and APAC AI specialists to move successful experiments into repeatable, measurable solutions. We are looking for someone who understands how media works, brings strong practical fluency in generative AI, and can lead change from initial use case through deployment and sustained adoption.

What you’ll do
  • Lead AI adoption in Japan. Own the execution of the Japan market AI agenda, aligning local priorities with regional and global capabilities.
  • Deploy AI into live media workflows. Partner with strategy, planning and activation teams to identify opportunities, pilot verified agents, and embed successful workflows into campaign delivery.
  • Build and localize solutions. Architect, localize, test, deploy and maintain custom AI tools and agents that address Japan-specific business and workflow needs.
  • Enable teams and lead change. Deliver practical workshops, training and onboarding, while working with cross-functional leaders to overcome adoption barriers and embed new ways of working.
  • Advise senior stakeholders. Translate business challenges into actionable AI initiatives, clearly communicating opportunities, trade-offs and results to client and agency leadership.
  • Measure, govern and scale. Track adoption, quality, productivity and business impact; uphold enterprise standards for responsible AI; and share successful local innovations across the wider APAC network.
What we’re looking for
  • Substantial relevant experience across media strategy, marketing transformation, consulting, marketing technology or adjacent disciplines, with demonstrated leadership of complex initiatives.
  • Business-level or native Japanese and professional English—both essential.

job.description:

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Role Purpose

The Governance & Assurance Analyst supports WPP's governance, certification, assurance, and digital risk management activities.

The role helps maintain governance documentation, support certification and audit readiness activities, coordinate evidence collection, and contribute

to client assurance requests and governance reporting.

Working closely with Strategy & Risk, Technical Security Governance, Assurance, Privacy, Legal, Enterprise Technology, and business stakeholders,

the Governance & Assurance Analyst helps ensure governance processes remain effective, documentation remains current, and evidence required

for certifications, audits, and client assurance activities is readily available.

A key focus of the role is supporting the day-to-day operation of WPP's Information Security Management System (ISMS), maintaining certification

readiness, and coordinating governance and assurance activities across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

Governance & Policy Support

Maintain governance frameworks, policies, standards, procedures, and related documentation.

Support periodic reviews and updates of governance artefacts.

Maintain mappings between policies, standards, controls, and certification requirements.

Assist with governance forums, working groups, and documentation reviews.

Support the preparation of governance materials, meeting outputs, and action tracking.

Provide research and analysis to support governance activities and decision-making.

Digital Risk Governance Support

Support governance reporting activities related to digital risk management.

Assist with the collection and analysis of governance-related metrics and indicators.

Maintain governance dashboards, scorecards, and reporting materials.

Track governance actions and follow-up activities.

Support reviews of governance processes and documentation.

ISO 27001 & Certification Support

Support the operation of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).

Coordinate activities required to support ISO 27001 certification and surveillance audits.

Maintain certification-related records, registers, and supporting documentation.

Coordinate evidence collection and stakeholder engagement activities required for audits.

Track audit findings, corrective actions, and improvement activities through to closure.

Support management review preparation and governance reporting.

Help maintain ongoing audit and certification readiness.

Client Assurance Support

Coordinate responses to client security, governance, risk, and compliance due diligence requests.

Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to gather information required for assurance activities.

Maintain reusable assurance content, responses, and supporting evidence.

Track assurance requests and response status.

Support the continuous improvement of assurance documentation and response quality.

Evidence Management & Audit Readiness

Maintain repositories used to support governance, certification, audit, and assurance activities.

Coordinate evidence collection across relevant business functions.

Ensure evidence is current, appropriately classified, and available for authorised use.

Maintain evidence ownership information, review dates, and supporting metadata.

Identify missing, outdated, or incomplete evidence and coordinate remediation activities.

Support internal, external, certification, client, and regulatory reviews through effective evidence coordination.

Reporting & Operational Improvement

Support the development of governance dashboards, scorecards, metrics, and reporting packs.

Analyse governance and assurance data to identify trends and reporting insights.

Support the standardisation of governance documentation, evidence collection, and reporting practices.

Identify opportunities for process improvements and raise recommendations to management.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of governance operational processes and reporting effectiveness.

Skills & Experience Required

Must-Haves

Fluent English, written and verbal.

Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Risk Management, Audit, Compliance, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or

equivalent relevant experience.

2-4 years of experience in governance, information security, compliance, audit, risk management, assurance, or a related discipline.

Experience supporting an ISO 27001-based management system, audit programme, or certification activity.

Understanding of governance frameworks, controls, audit principles, and certification requirements.

Experience supporting audits, assurance reviews, or certification activities.

Experience coordinating evidence collection and documentation activities.

Strong reporting, documentation, and organisational skills.

Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a global environment.

Nice-to-Have

ISO 27001 Foundation, Lead Implementer, Lead Auditor, or similar qualification.

CISA, CISM, CRISC, CISSP, or equivalent certification.

Exposure to frameworks such as SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2, or similar.

Experience supporting client assurance or security questionnaire activities.

Experience using GRC, audit, compliance, or certification management platforms.

Experience within a large multinational organisation.

Key Behaviours & Competencies

Governance Awareness

Understands the importance of governance, accountability, and effective documentation in supporting organisational objectives.

Analytical Thinking

Uses structured analysis and evidence-based reasoning to support governance activities and reporting.

Quality Focus

Maintains attention to detail and supports high-quality governance and assurance outcomes.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Works effectively with stakeholders across business and technical teams.

Communication

Communicates clearly and professionally with a range of audiences.

Organisation & Planning

Demonstrates a structured approach to documentation, coordination, reporting, and action tracking.

Continuous Learning

Seeks opportunities to improve processes, skills, and ways of working.

Professional Integrity

Acts with objectivity, accountability, professionalism, and discretion.

What This Role Explicitly Does Not Do

This role does not:

Own governance frameworks, policies, or standards.

Own cyber security strategy.

Own enterprise risk management processes or risk registers.

Own Digital Risk Governance frameworks.

Make risk acceptance or risk treatment decisions.

Own technical security controls, security architecture, engineering, or operational security functions.

Perform incident response, vulnerability management, monitoring, or security operations activities.

Act as Internal Audit or provide independent assurance.

Own regulatory compliance programmes.

Serve as the accountable owner for ISO 27001 or certification outcomes.

Own the ISMS.

Design governance operating models or policy architectures.

Approve policies, standards, exceptions, or governance decisions unless formally authorised.

Replace the accountability of risk owners, control owners, policy owners, or business stakeholders.

job.description:
Blog

  • November 10, 2026
  • Posted by ssalas

Chief Engineer

Chief Engineer

Department: Engineering
Reports To: General Manager / Corporate Director of Engineering
FLSA Status: Exempt
Location: Boise Market (KQXR-FM, KJOT-FM, KTHI-FM, KRVB-FM)

 

POSITION SUMMARY

Lotus Boise Corp is accepting applications for a Full-Time Chief Engineer. This position is responsible for the technical operation, maintenance, and regulatory compliance of all broadcast transmission and studio facilities for the cluster. Working closely with the local GM and Corporate Director of Engineering, this role ensures uninterrupted broadcast operations, maintains FCC compliance, and oversees building and facility maintenance.

Due to the nature of broadcast operations, the Chief Engineer position is considered an on-call role and must be available to respond to technical issues or facility emergencies that may impact broadcast operations at any time, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Operations

  • Oversee the installation, maintenance, and repair of all broadcast equipment including transmitters, antennas, STL systems, automation systems, and studio equipment.
  • Ensure reliable operation of broadcast facilities to maintain continuous on-air operations.
  • Monitor transmitter performance and conduct routine inspections of transmitter sites.
  • Ability to resolve complex problems not covered by existing procedures or practices independently often whilst under pressure.
  • Self-motivated to work independently under timeline to achieve departmental and station goals
  • Maintain broadcast automation systems, audio routing systems, and studio consoles.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues affecting broadcast operations.

Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure full compliance with all applicable FCC regulations and licensing requirements.
  • Maintain and update required FCC documentation and station engineering records.
  • Manage EAS (Emergency Alert System) equipment testing and compliance.
  • Coordinate required FCC filings, inspections, and technical reporting.

 

Building and Facility Maintenance

  • Oversee the maintenance and operational readiness of studio facilities, transmitter buildings, and related infrastructure.
  • Coordinate routine maintenance of building systems including electrical, HVAC, grounding systems, generators, and backup power systems.
  • Monitor and address building maintenance needs to ensure a safe and functional work environment for staff and visitors.
  • Coordinate facility repairs and improvements in collaboration with management.
  • Ensure transmitter sites, towers, and studio spaces remain compliant with safety and operational standards.

Vendor Management and Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison with technical vendors, contractors, tower companies, equipment suppliers, and facility maintenance providers.
  • Coordinate vendor scheduling for maintenance, repairs, and equipment installations.
  • Obtain quotes, evaluate service providers, and recommend vendor solutions for engineering and facility needs.
  • Monitor vendor work to ensure quality, compliance with safety standards, and completion of contracted services.

Engineering Leadership

  • Coordinate with General Manager and corporate engineering leadership on capital equipment needs and long-term technical planning.
  • Assist with engineering budgets, equipment procurement, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Provide technical guidance and training to station personnel.

job.title: Seasonal Product Designer
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Seasonal Product Designer to join our Product team. This role is perfect for a passionate and detail-oriented designer who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and is eager to contribute to one of the most iconic brands in sports.

As a Seasonal Product Designer, you will support the design of NFL owned and operated experiences like the NFL App, NFL.com and our Connected TV experience as well as the creation and delivery of digital assets across the NFL’s product portfolio. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams, including Product Design, Marketing, Creative, and Product Management, as well as senior designers and other team members, to craft thoughtful, high-quality design that enhances the fan experience across all platforms and aligns with brand guidelines and project requirements. You will also help design and deliver marketing, e-commerce and promotional assets for various projects and platforms. Responsibilities often include creating app/web/connected TV UI, graphics, mockups, and prototypes, as well as managing and organizing design files. 

This is a unique opportunity to make a real impact on the look and feel of NFL digital products, from concept to execution, throughout the 2026-27 season.

Responsibilities

  • Help design team deliver user experience designs for our portfolio of NFL owned and operated experiences including NFL Connected TV, NFL Mobile App, NFL.com, and more.
    • Some examples of assets UX/UI work you will work on:
      • UX/UI work for app screens on the NFL App, NFL Connected TV App and NFL.com.
      • Improvements, updates and new components.
      • Design system improvements and updates.
  • Asset Design and Delivery: Assisting with asset creation across our product portfolio including NFL Connected TV, NFL Mobile App, NFL.com, and more.
    • Some examples of assets you will create:
      • Artwork for marketing, content, games, events, etc.
      • User Interface assets like icons or illustrations.
      • Processing Image cutouts.
      • UI Mockups with assets for review.
      • Mockups and artwork for presentations.
      • App Store Assets.
      • and more...
  • Follow Design Guidelines: Ensure all the design deliverables adhere to brand guidelines and style guides.
  • Collaborating with teams: Work with designers and other stakeholders to understand project requirements. 
  • Developing design concepts: Contributing to the ideation and development of design solutions. 
  • Managing digital assets: Organizing and maintaining design files and assets.
  • Meeting deadlines: Managing multiple projects and prioritizing work to meet deadlines. 

 Required Qualifications

  • High Proficiency in design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), understanding of photo editing, cutouts and manipulation as well as editing PSD/AI assets that are provided.
  • High Proficiency in Figma: All of our product experiences are designed and managed in Figma and this will be the primary space we will be designing, collaborating, reviewing and delivering work from for not just designers but also our entire Product Team including Product Managers, Engineers, Project Managers and Marketing Team.
  • Strong Portfolio of work showing excellent design.
  • Understanding and Experience with Design Systems as you will be frequently designing within the constraints of our components and screens on different platforms.
  • Understanding of web/app asset delivery requirements like file formats, file sizes, image ratios, saving for multiple devices and device breakpoints.
  • Some understanding of Accessibility guidelines to ensure our assets pass accessibility rules.
  • A strong understanding of design principles and visual elements and art direction.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
  • Attention to detail and a strong eye for visual design.
  • May require experience with AI tools for creative purposes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4-year Bachelor's Degree in Design, UX or Human-Computer Interaction. 
  • 1-2 years of experience working in with a Product teams, Marketing agencies or Digital Media organizations with relevant experience assisting in the design and delivery of design assets.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Have a positive attitude and work well with others on the team.
  • Have a collaborative mindset and aren’t afraid to ask for help or feedback. You understand that open communication leads to better outcomes and stronger design.
  • Eager to learn new skills and take on challenges.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Up to 7 months of employment based on business needs, 40 hours/week expected.
  • Flexible schedule required, including weekends, holidays, and occasional late nights.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
KATU News is seeking a creative, forward-thinking Evening Meteorologist to lead weather coverage across our broadcast and digital platforms. We're looking for more than a great forecaster. We want an innovative storyteller and newsroom leader who can help viewers prepare for what's ahead by tracking the "next big weathermaker" and explaining how changing conditions will impact their lives.

 

The ideal candidate combines strong forecasting skills with engaging, conversational storytelling and a willingness to experiment with new ways to reach audiences. This role requires someone who can take ownership of our evening weather coverage, develop original reporting, and help shape the future of local weather.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver accurate, engaging, and conversational weather forecasts during evening newscasts, with an emphasis on tracking the next big weathermaker and its potential impacts.
  • Take a leadership role in shaping the station's weather coverage and identifying opportunities for innovation.
  • Develop original, enterprise weather stories that go beyond the daily forecast to explain trends, impacts, and issues affecting our communities.
  • Create compelling, platform-specific content, including short-form videos, explainers, live streams, and interactive storytelling.
  • Experiment with emerging technology, new storytelling formats, and creative approaches to audience engagement.
  • Provide authoritative, calm, and timely coverage during breaking and severe weather, including live cut-ins and extended coverage.
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership, producers, reporters, and digital teams to develop creative and impactful weather coverage.
  • Build strong connections with viewers through authentic storytelling, audience interaction, and community engagement.
  • Help establish KATU as a trusted, innovative source for weather information across the Portland DMA.
  • Represent the station professionally on-air, online, and at community events.

 

Qualifications

  • Degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong forecasting skills and a confident, conversational on-air presentation style.
  • Demonstrated creativity and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches to weather storytelling.
  • Experience or strong interest in developing original content for social media, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to inspire new ideas and help bring them to life.
  • Ability to explain complex weather topics in clear, relatable, and audience-focused ways.
  • Comfortable experimenting, taking creative risks, and adapting to changing audience habits.
  • Ability to work effectively under deadline pressure and respond quickly during severe or breaking weather.
  • Commitment to Sinclair's core values and weather philosophy.

 

What We're Looking For

We want a meteorologist who sees opportunity beyond the forecast. Someone who is passionate about helping viewers understand what's coming next, asks "How can we tell this story differently?" and is willing to turn creative ideas into meaningful coverage.

If you're passionate about forecasting, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of local weather coverage, we want to hear from you.

job.title: Sr. Security Engineer
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced, technically driven security professional to advance Sinclair’s Information Security program. You will serve as a Senior Information Security Engineer focused on Security Operations, incident response, and advanced detection engineering. You will independently investigate complex threats, engineer high-fidelity detections across endpoint, identity, network, and cloud environments, and strengthen incident response through security tooling, workflow orchestration, and automation. You will also help evaluate and apply AI-assisted capabilities where they improve investigation quality and response efficiency. You will partner with internal teams, business stakeholders, and external security providers to improve detection coverage, accelerate response, and reduce enterprise risk.

Responsibilities:

Processes & Execution

  • Lead technical investigation, triage, containment, eradication, and recovery activities for complex security incidents across on-premises, cloud, identity, and endpoint environments.

  • Analyze security telemetry, authentication activity, process execution, network traffic, and threat intelligence to determine root cause, attack scope, impact, and appropriate response.

  • Perform proactive threat hunting and retrospective investigations; identify gaps in telemetry, detections, and response capabilities.

  • Own high-severity incident investigations, document evidence-based findings, communicate business impact, and coordinate timely remediation with system owners and external partners.

  • Apply MITRE ATT&CK and other relevant threat-informed methodologies to improve investigation quality, detection coverage, and response effectiveness.

  • Demonstrate independent technical judgment, clear communication, and accountability for outcomes in time-sensitive situations.

Engineering, Collaboration & Partnerships

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and continuously tune complex detection mechanisms for multi-stage attacks, identity compromise, lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration, and other advanced adversary behaviors.

  • Correlate endpoint, SIEM, identity, email, network, and cloud telemetry to create behavioral, contextual, and risk-based detections rather than relying solely on static indicators.

  • Develop and maintain detection-as-code content, queries, analytics, and validation tests; assess false positives, data quality, precision, and detection gaps.

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated SecOps and incident response workflows using security platforms, APIs, SOAR technologies, and enterprise ticketing systems to streamline enrichment, investigation, containment, and remediation.

  • Advance security operations automation by integrating AI-assisted analysis and agent-based capabilities, where appropriate, into existing investigation and response processes to improve context, prioritization, and analyst efficiency.

  • Apply established security engineering controls to automated response workflows, including least-privilege access, action validation, approval for high-impact remediation, logging, exception handling, and escalation to analysts.

  • Integrate third-party alert and investigation outputs with internal telemetry to support independent validation, deeper investigation, and consistent remediation.

  • Collaborate with infrastructure, IAM, cloud, endpoint, IT operations, and external security partners to validate detections, remediate threats, and operationalize new capabilities.

Performance Improvement

  • Measure and improve detection coverage, fidelity, mean time to detect/respond, investigation quality, automation success, and analyst effort saved.

  • Continuously test detections and response workflows using attack simulations, adversary emulation, incident lessons learned, and controlled validation.

  • Document engineering designs, investigation procedures, response decision criteria, automation safeguards, and operational runbooks.

  • Identify repetitive analyst tasks suitable for automation while preserving human oversight for uncertain, destructive, or business-disruptive actions.

  • Mentor engineers and analysts through technical reviews, investigation feedback, and knowledge sharing; promote sustainable engineering standards.

  • Evaluate new security detection and response technologies, including AI-assisted capabilities, based on practical operational value, reliability, security, and measurable risk reduction.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, security engineering, or a closely related discipline, including ownership of complex investigations.

  • Demonstrated experience building and tuning advanced detections in a SIEM, EDR/XDR, or cloud security analytics platform; ability to explain detection logic and validate underlying evidence.

  • Strong understanding of attacker techniques, Windows and Linux internals, identity-based attacks, network protocols, cloud security, and incident response methodology.

  • Hands-on experience integrating security platforms through APIs, developing orchestration workflows, and implementing automated investigation or response actions using SOAR tools and enterprise IT service management platforms.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted security investigation, agent-based automation, or LLM-enabled security workflows is a plus; specialized AI development or production AI-agent experience is not required.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with the Microsoft Defender security suite (such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, or Defender XDR) and related Microsoft security/identity technologies, including Entra ID.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise security technologies such as Zscaler, CrowdStrike Falcon, Abnormal Security, Tines, Armis, and Splunk, or equivalent platforms; strong experience across multiple tools is expected, but experience with every named product is not required.

  • Proven ability to investigate incidents and engineer or tune detections directly in EDR/XDR, SIEM, network security, email security, and identity platforms, including querying telemetry, investigating alerts, and operationalizing response actions.

  • Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, NIST incident response guidance, and security engineering best practices.

  • Professional security certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, or equivalent preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, cross-functional collaboration, and demonstrated ownership of technical initiatives.

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $111,000 to $147,805. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

Job Summary: Job Requirements On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. The Product & Data Engineering team is responsible for end-to-end development for Disney’s world-class consumer-facing products, including streaming platforms Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+, and digital products & experiences across ESPN, Marvel, Disney Studios, NatGeo, and ABC News. The team drives innovation at scale for millions of consumers around the world across Apple, Android, Smart TVs, game consoles, and the web, with our platforms powering core experiences like personalization, search, messaging and data. The ABC Core Content Technologies engineering team is looking for a Principal Product Software Engineer who is passionate about setting technical direction for high-scale content platforms and multiplying the impact of engineers across the organization. As a Principal Engineer, you are a trusted member of the technical leadership of the organization. You build and set the architectural direction for the systems that provide dynamic content management for many of Disney Entertainment’s brands – including ABC Entertainment, ABC News, ABC OTV, Disney, Marvel, National Geographic, and Studios – as well as content ingestion from many internal and 3rd party sources, publishing pipelines, and complex image services. You operate in highly ambiguous and significantly complex problem spaces that have long-term impact on our brands, products, technology, and architecture. You are recognized as an expert across multiple specialties. You influence business and technology direction, bringing industry context to technical decisions, and setting the standard for engineering excellence across the organization. As a hands-on technical leader, you split your time between coding, design, and architecture based on where your skills will have the greatest impact – personally writing critical-path code, deconstructing architectures so multiple teams can execute independently, and aligning those teams toward simple, coherent designs. On a daily basis you should bring: A track record of driving clarity and simplicity in the face of significant ambiguity and complexity. A force-multiplier mindset – amplifying the impact of teams across the organization through design reviews, mentorship, and technical strategy. Deep ownership of the products and platforms your organization delivers. A pragmatic approach to balancing trade-offs between opportunity and architectural complexity. A passion for keeping abreast of industry trends and benchmarking our technology against the best in the industry. Kindness, pragmatic optimism, and your unique view and experience. Responsibilities: Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of software in highly ambiguous and significantly complex problem spaces that have long-term impact on our products, technology, and architecture. Heavily influence the design and personally write a significant portion of critical-path code, making the right trade-offs between opportunity and architectural complexity. Deconstruct large architectures into components that can be developed independently by multiple teams, then align those teams toward simple, coherent designs that come together into an integrated whole. Lead strategically important projects that span multiple teams. Acquire a deep understanding of our business processes, dependent systems, and teams, and develop professional relationships with key stakeholders — including business users, product managers, designers, and other Principal Engineers both inside and outside of our organization — to inform technical strategy and drive alignment. Set the standard for engineering excellence across the organization – producing designs, algorithms, and implementations that are exemplary in terms of robustness, scalability, cost-effectiveness, and simplicity – and drive best practices across the organization, including driving the adoption of AI-assisted engineering tooling and demonstrating a strong commitment to the productivity and quality gains these tools and models deliver. Amplify your impact as a force multiplier: lead design reviews for complex projects, probe assumptions, illuminate pitfalls, foster shared understanding, handle escalations, and mitigate complexity risks. Bring business and industry context to technology decisions and influence business and technology direction. Actively develop and mentor engineers across and beyond your organization, keep the engineering community current on trends and technologies, participate in hiring, and perform promotion assessments to support the career growth of others. Additional Expectations: Promote and reinforce engineering best practices — design patterns, code review, and automated testing — and drive their adoption across the organization Mentor engineers within and beyond your squad, and educate the broader engineering community on advanced technical issues, technologies, and trends Lead and reinforce a high level of operational excellence for the systems underpinning applications used by millions of fans every day Solicit differing views, build consensus, and be willing to change your mind as you learn more Participate in hiring and interviewing, and perform promotion assessments to support the career growth of others Champion the adoption of AI-assisted development tools, models, and workflows, demonstrating a personal commitment to them and helping the broader team realize measurable productivity and quality gains Minimum Qualifications: 10+ years of experience building large-scale, highly available distributed services. Expert-level programming skills in Java or a similar object-oriented language, with strong computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, databases, etc.). Proven track record designing backend architectures that span multiple teams and driving consensus on them. Experience building and operating message-based, distributed systems, including caching strategies. Experience mentoring engineers and setting technical direction beyond a single team. Preferred Qualifications: Experience working on highly scalable, real-time content or data platforms serving millions of consumers. Extensive experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or a similar cloud service, including Terraform and infrastructure as code (IaC) practices. Experience with event-driven messaging architectures (e.g., SQS, SNS) and both relational and non-relational database technologies (e.g., DynamoDB, OpenSearch). Contributions to intellectual property (e.g., patents), industry conferences, or a broader technical community. Job Summary: Job Requirements ABC News Live is seeking expressions of interest from experienced Associate Producers who may be available to support our 24/7 streaming news operation in New York. This is an opportunity to join our as-needed talent pool for future production needs, including breaking news and other coverage requiring additional editorial support. We are interested in journalists who thrive in fast-paced environments, react quickly to breaking news, generate strong story ideas, source compelling video, demonstrate solid news judgment, and work effectively under tight deadlines. This posting is an opportunity to submit your resume for future consideration; this is not a role that is open at this time. We anticipate this role may be open in the future, but we are not actively hiring for the position. If you would like to be considered for this potential role, please submit your resume. If the role becomes available, you may receive an email or call from a recruiter. What You May Do Produce a variety of stories, including writing, editing video, and creating graphics or working with Graphics Team to segment produce. Source video and other editorial elements and help keep coverage fresh as stories develop and editorial needs arise Support production in a high-pressure, fast-paced control room environment. Take initiative while collaborating closely with producers and the broader editorial team. What We’re Looking For At least 3 years of experience producing in a digital, streaming, or broadcast environment. Familiarity with Avid and/or other non-linear editing software, experience with iNews, and camera shooting experience preferred. Ability to take initiative and manage multiple assignments simultaneously. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Prior video production experience, strong editorial judgment, writing skills, organization, and attention to detail. Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, which may include evenings, overnights, weekends, holidays, and breaking-news coverage. Job Summary: Job Requirements Did you grow up dreaming about weather forecasting, wondering about lake-effect snow, hurricanes, tornadoes and the amazing impact of nature on our environment? ABC News is looking for an extremely motivated Meteorologist Producer to join our best in the business weather team. This posting is an opportunity to submit your resume for future consideration; this is not a role that is open at this time. We anticipate this role may be open in the future, but we are not actively hiring for the position. If you would like to be considered for this potential role, please submit your resume. If the role becomes available, you may receive an email or call from a recruiter. RESPONSIBILITIES Our meteorology producers work with our on-air talent and editorial teams to communicate the day’s weather, climate and science stories. Responsibilities include: Creating a division-wide weather note focusing on nationally important weather stories Finding, creating, and organizing all ‘weather of the day’ video, facts, figures, stats Brief Anchor talent, Executive and Senior Producers on national weather editorial. Produce on-air meteorologists Create all WSI/IBM weather graphics for on-air usage and playback Assist producers and writers with correspondent’s weather pieces, headlines and other content. Produce Social Media hits and verify weather-related social posts. Work with News Desk to coordinate correspondent placement for breaking weather coverage. Source and clear latest and greatest weather video Research and pitch weather-related climate stories in conjunction with ABC News climate unit. Research and pitch weather, climate and science stories for ABC News.com Applicants must be enthusiastic multi-taskers who are passionate about weather, climate and science, and being a part of a hard-working team. They must be able to handle pressure under extreme deadlines and be flexible in dealing with breaking news emergencies. The successful candidate is able to clearly and succinctly communicate complex concepts with a wide range of people. The Meteorologist must be willing to work flexible hours including nights, weekends, holidays as part of a 24/7 News team. QUALIFICATIONS Minimum 3+ years’ experience in Broadcast Meteorology Strong Proficiency in WSI/IBM Broadcast Weather Graphics platforms Familiarity with National Weather Service Products, Websites and Chat Basic knowledge of clipping and editing in Adobe Premiere Pro Interest in climate science Preferred Qualification: Basic knowledge of clipping and editing in Adobe Premiere Pro Required Education: Bachelor's degree in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science Must have completed Synoptic 2 Coursework Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The pay rate for this role in New York, NY is $400.00 per day. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Producer – ABC News Live (As-Needed) (Expression of Interest) Job ID 10165030 Location New York, New York, United States Business ABC News Date posted Nov. 11, 2026 Producer – ABC News Live (As-Needed) (Expression of Interest) Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements ABC News Live is seeking expressions of interest from dynamic, editorially strong, innovative Producers who may be interested in future opportunities with our 24/7 streaming news operation in New York. We are looking for skilled newsroom journalists with exceptional editorial judgment, strong video editing abilities, and demonstrated control room experience in a fast-paced live news environment. The ideal candidate thrives under deadline pressure, is energized by breaking news, and has a passion for compelling storytelling. Candidates should be comfortable developing segments from concept to air, producing live coverage, collaborating with talent and correspondents, and making sound editorial decisions throughout the day. This posting is an opportunity to submit your resume for future consideration; this is not a role that is open at this time. We anticipate this role may be open in the future, but we are not actively hiring for the position. If you would like to be considered for this potential role, please submit your resume. If the role becomes available, you may receive an email or call from a recruiter. What You May Do Produce live and taped segments for ABC News Live programming. Edit video packages, tape elements, and visual storytelling components using industry-standard editing tools. Write scripts, teases, banners, headlines, and anchor copy while ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, fairness, and journalistic integrity. Exercise strong editorial judgment to identify, develop, and prioritize stories across a fast-moving news cycle and track emerging stories throughout the day. Monitor breaking news and rapidly adjust rundowns and coverage plans as events unfold. Produce live interviews and breaking news events from the control room. Partner with directors, technical teams, and production crews to ensure seamless execution of live broadcasts. Source and evaluate video, graphics, and airworthy approved social content to enhance coverage and storytelling. What We’re Looking For Minimum 5 years of experience producing live news in a broadcast, cable, streaming, or digital newsroom environment. Strong control room producing experience and demonstrated ability to lead coverage during breaking news. Advanced video editing skills and experience producing visual storytelling under tight deadlines. Excellent news judgment and a strong understanding of journalistic standards and ethics. Proven ability to generate story ideas and execute coverage from planning through air. Strong television writing, copyediting, and communication skills. Ability to multitask, problem-solve, and prioritize effectively in a high-pressure live-news environment. Experience collaborating with talent, correspondents, and cross-functional newsroom teams. Familiarity with iNews or comparable newsroom systems. Flexibility to work varied hours, including weekends and breaking-news coverage as needed. Preferred Qualifications Experience producing live streaming news programming. Experience covering major breaking news and special events. Knowledge of audience trends and digital news consumption habits. Experience working across multiple platforms and formats. Education Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Television Production, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The pay rate for this role in New York, NY is $400.00 per day. Select benefits may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our benefits visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits. This position is with American Broadcasting Companies, Inc., which is part of a business we call ABC News. job.title: Streaming Host/Reporter
job.description:
STREAMING HOST/PRODUCER:

Are you a dynamic journalist who thrives in live coverage? Are you one in your family or friend group who is always explaining this week’s biggest news? Are you ready to be a news influencer?

We’re seeking a talented Streaming Host & Producer to join our team and help us captivate audiences with engaging content. As a Streaming Host & Producer, you’ll be the face of our digital platform, guiding viewers through live news events together and bringing clarity and focus to the most important news in the region.

What you’ll do:

  • Host Streaming News: Host a continuous live stream on a variety of news topics, from breaking news to politics to business and sports.
  • Produce High-Quality Content: Produce your own content, including explainer videos, longform podcast-style interviews, and live reports.
  • Connect with the Audience: Build a strong connection with our audience and your own unique audience through engaging conversations and social media interactions.
  • Stay Ahead of Trends: Stay informed on current events to identify potential content opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the Team: Work closely with producers and editors to create high-quality content.



What you’ll need:

  • A strong on-camera presence and excellent communication skills.
  • A strong understanding of social media platforms and digital trends. You will be editing and posting content on TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram both before and after your hosting and producing.
  • A confirmed skill set in streaming video production and editing; you will be operating live streaming technology LIVE as you host. editing and posting content.


If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, shakeup the news and information industry and become a leading voice in streaming media, we encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.description:

The Director, Food Services will lead the strategy, operations, vendor partnerships, and employee experience for food service offerings across NBCUniversal’s New York campus, with a primary focus on 30 Rockefeller Plaza. job.title: Manager, Internal Audit, Risk and Analytics
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview and Responsibilities

As a Manager of Risk & Data Analytics, you deliver data-driven insights, lead risk-based audits, and support investigations, risk assessments, and special projects across Paramount. You work with leaders across corporate, media, streaming, and production to evaluate processes, governance, and controls using useful judgment and analytics. The role requires comfort with complex data, deep risk assessment skills, and the ability to operate in fast-moving, judgment-heavy environments. Engagements include operational reviews, T&E and production audits, and advisory projects in partnership with SOX, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and other teams.   Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
  • Plan and lead risk‑based analytics to support operational audits, advisory work, and special projects across corporate, media, streaming, advertising, and production areas
  • Develop focused project objectives, scopes, and risk assessments aligned to key business priorities
  • Design flexible approaches for non‑routine or evolving activities requiring solid professional judgment
  • Use analytics to evaluate processes, controls, and governance, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accountability, and growth
  • Conduct end‑to‑end process walkthroughs and root‑cause analysis to address underlying issues
  • Assess operational maturity and scalability in high‑growth or transformational initiatives
  • Apply advanced analytics to audit planning, testing, investigations, and continuous risk monitoring
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging risks across areas such as production, T&E, payroll, vendor payments, and revenue
  • Translate business risks into targeted, meaningful analytics and communicate insights through clear visuals and presentations
  • Lead or support special projects through data collection, validation, analysis, and documentation of findings
  • Synthesize insights from multiple systems and data sources and present conclusions through dashboards and presentations
  • Build robust relationships with business leaders and cross‑functional partners, including SOX, Compliance, Finance, and Legal
  • Communicate results and recommendations clearly, explaining root cause, risk, and business impact in an accessible language

  • Serve as a trusted advisor while maintaining sovereignty and objectivity
  • Manage, coach, and develop team members while ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to internal standards

  • Support continuous improvement of Internal Audit methodologies, analytics capabilities, and investigative approaches
  • Partner with the Audit executive team on analytics tools, technologies, and industry trends to enhance the function’s capabilities

  • Apply sound judgment, professional skepticism, and well-developed communication skills to drive outcomes and maintain high standards of quality and integrity

  • 7+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, data analytics, or a related discipline

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

CBS Sports Digital is looking for a Product Growth Manager to own growth on the CBS Sports app. You'll sit on the app product team and carry your own roadmap alongside feature work. The job is to make sure what we build gets found, adopted, and kept.
That means owning the parts of the product where growth actually happens: onboarding, activation, how users discover new features, and the store listing as a conversion surface. It also means owning the acquisition spend pointed at the app and the instrumentation that tells us whether any of it worked. You'll be measured on install volume, install quality, feature adoption, and retention.
You should be comfortable in a standup and comfortable in a spreadsheet. You think in funnels, you ship experiments, and you can tell the difference between a number that moved and a number that matters.


Responsibilities:
●    Own a growth roadmap for the CBS Sports app, scoped and prioritized alongside feature work.
●    Own onboarding, activation, and in-product feature discovery, from problem definition through shipped changes.
●    Own the app store listing as a conversion surface, including testing, positioning, and editorial pitches for featuring.
●    Own paid acquisition for the app, optimizing toward high-LTV users and aligning spend to the roadmap and the sports calendar.
●    Define the growth instrumentation and reporting the product team runs on. Monitor installs, adoption, engagement, retention, and funnel performance, and act on what you see.
●    Run experiments with clear hypotheses and readable results. Kill what doesn't work.
●    Sequence releases against tentpole windows so launches land when fan demand is highest.
●    Test new acquisition channels and fold the ones that work into a single growth approach.
●    Work with brand, creative, and lifecycle teams so what ships in-product and what runs outside it say the same thing.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
●    5+ years in growth product management, product growth, or mobile growth.
●    Experience owning a growth funnel end to end, including shipping changes to a live product.
●    Hands-on experience running paid user acquisition (Apple Search Ads, Google App Campaigns, or similar).
●    Fluency with app metrics: installs, CAC and LTV, activation, adoption, retention, and cohort analysis.
●    Experience running A/B tests and making calls off the results.
●    Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
●    Experience embedded on a product and engineering team in an Agile environment.
●    Background in sports, streaming, media, or consumer subscription apps.
●    Familiarity with ASO and app store editorial and featuring processes.
●    Experience with product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel), attribution (Kochava, AppsFlyer, Branch, Adjust), and lifecycle tools (Braze, Iterable, Airship, SalesForce Marketing Cloud).
●    A real interest in sports and how the sports calendar shapes fan behavior.


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR.

CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.
