job.title: Cloud Systems Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR is seeking a Systems Engineer for its Distribution IT Infrastructure team to manage, test, and maintain our enterprise virtualized infrastructure, including servers, storage, and networking systems. In this role, you will deploy, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot modern virtualization platforms (such as VMware vSphere, HPE Morpheus VM Essentials, or Proxmox) to guarantee high availability, scalability, and security across NPR's core distribution technologies.

This role sits at the intersection of physical and virtual infrastructure: you will help stand up new data center hardware and build NPR's private cloud environment on top of it, from rack and cable to hypervisor and host networking.

Working collaboratively with Infrastructure and Security colleagues, you will analyze business workflows, implement structured change management processes, and support capacity planning initiatives to deliver resilient, mission-critical operations for NPR and our nationwide Member station network.

Responsibilities

  • Physical Infrastructure Build-Out: Partner with Infrastructure colleagues to install, rack, cable, and configure new server, storage, and network hardware, including firmware updates, out-of-band management (e.g., HPE iLO, Dell iDRAC), and RAID/BIOS configuration, to establish the foundation for virtualized workloads.
  • Virtual Infrastructure Deployment & Maintenance: Deploy, configure, and maintain virtualized systems using enterprise tools (e.g., HPE Morpheus VM Essentials, Proxmox, Nutanix, Incus, or VMware) to support operational reliability.
  • Architecture Evaluation & Testing: Evaluate virtual system architecture, compare existing applications, and create metrics to measure response times and availability for test environments.
  • Change Management Implementation: Recommend and execute system enhancements following established organizational change management policies and procedures.
  • Operational & Capacity Support: Assist the Distribution Infrastructure team in executing cloud/virtualization workflows and capacity planning tools focused on return on investment and business value.
  • Security Alignment & Compliance: Partner with Security Engineers to ensure virtual hosts, operating systems, and network configurations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Workflow & Process Analysis: Analyze and document Distribution IT process workflows, identifying areas for continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Technical Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create comprehensive documentation, procedures, instructions, and training materials for internal colleagues and system users.
  • Incident Escalation & Operational Support: Proactively communicate operational status to management, participate in an on-call rotation, and respond to critical system issues on a 24x7 basis as needed.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, and administering servers and networking within a data center environment.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in the planning, design, deployment, and management of enterprise virtualized cloud infrastructure (e.g., VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, or open-source hypervisors).
  • Hands-on experience with physical data center hardware, including racking and cabling servers, configuring out-of-band 
  • Competence in DNS administration (BIND preferred).
  • Experience with IP address management (IPAM) and DHCP services.
  • Experience with configuration management (Puppet preferred).
  • Experience creating agentless automation workflows (Ansible preferred).
  • Experience with Mail Transfer Agent administration (Exim).
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server administration (2022+) alongside core directory and networking protocols (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS).
  • Practical experience supporting enterprise storage (NetApp or TrueNAS).
  • Comfortable with networking configuration of hosts, switches, and routers, including VLANs, trunking, and NIC bonding/link aggregation as applied to hypervisor hosts.
  • Proven track record as a key contributor or project leader on complex technical initiatives, including the creation of detailed technical documentation and workflow diagrams.
  • Demonstrated ability to participate effectively in a team environment, handle multiple concurrent projects, and contribute to an on-call rotation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Unix/Linux networking configuration and Cisco switches and routers (Catalyst or Nexus/NX-OS).
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript).
  • Experience with enterprise backup/recovery solutions (e.g., Veeam).
  • Experience with HPE ProLiant or Dell PowerEdge server hardware.
  • Knowledge of Linux operating systems and relevant industry certifications (VMware VCP, Microsoft, or AWS).

Required Skills/Competencies

  • System Troubleshooting & Diagnostics: Ability to systematically isolate, diagnose, and resolve complex issues across hardware, server, storage, network, and virtualized layers.
  • Structured Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills to present technical concepts and write actionable system documentation.
  • Prioritization Under Pressure: Capacity to prioritize tasks effectively during high-urgency system maintenance or operational incidents.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to partner seamlessly with Security, Network, and Distribution engineering teams.
  • Continuous Learning Mindset: Commitment to staying current with emerging virtualization tools, cloud platforms, and data center technologies.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience.

Work Location

Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of on-site days they choose.

Job Type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $109,350 - $133,650 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

A Software Architect exemplifies technical expertise and excellence at NPR. Working alongside engineering leadership and cross-functional discipline teams, you will guide strategic technology decisions, design scalable solutions, and build robust pipelines, services, and tools that support NPR and our Member Station Network.

In this role, you will lead technology strategy across our most complex engineering initiatives—those impacting multiple product lines, distributed systems, and mobile platforms simultaneously. Responsible for end-to-end architecture from platform services to client applications and downstream data pipelines, you will balance system performance, developer velocity, data privacy, and cost-efficiency to deliver exceptional public media experiences at scale.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with NABET-CWA DMU.

Responsibilities

Architectural Strategy & System Design

  1. Architect Unified Mobile & Cross-Platform Systems: Define and implement shared architectural patterns and modular design systems across native iOS and Android codebases and cross-platform integrations to maximize code reuse and development velocity.
  2. Design Scalable Personalization & Delivery Pipelines: Lead platform-to-client architecture for personalized content delivery, supporting high-traffic, localized media experiences across owned digital properties and member station networks.
  3. Drive Technology Standards & Evaluation: Conduct technical evaluations for custom builds versus vendor solutions; introduce modern technologies and establish architectural standards across divisions.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Governance

  1. Lead Multi-Team Engineering Initiatives: Provide technical oversight and direction across cross-divisional product roadmaps, project proposals, and OKR planning cycles for multi-team initiatives.
  2. Establish Quality & Code Governance: Conduct architectural proposals and code reviews, providing substantive feedback on system designs, security protocols, workflows, and peer-written software.
  3. Integrate Compliance & Cost Controls: Architect solutions with explicit focus on privacy compliance (GDPR/CPRA), security standards, CDN caching strategies, and cloud cost optimization frameworks.

Operational Excellence & Mentorship

  1. Support Deployment & Operational Resilience: Participate in automated deployments across QA, UAT, and production environments; join the developer on-call rotation to diagnose and resolve critical incidents.
  2. Contribute High-Quality Code: Author documented, resilient code and reusable core libraries aligned with department standards and sprint commitments.
  3. Foster Technical Mentorship & Team Growth: Assist in onboarding, training, and interviewing software engineering staff, advocating for efficient agile processes and inclusive team practices.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including demonstrated success designing and leading technical architecture for complex, multi-team platform environments.
  • Deep technical proficiency in native mobile architecture (iOS and Android) using languages such as Swift, Kotlin, Java, or Objective-C.
  • Proven track record designing high-traffic, resilient distributed systems, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, and client-server integration patterns.
  • Practical experience architecting media playback, streaming protocols, CDN configurations, and cloud infrastructure ecosystems (e.g., AWS or GCP).
  • Hands-on experience integrating data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CPRA) alongside cloud cost optimization frameworks in high-availability environments.
  • Demonstrated experience with modern version control systems (Git), continuous integration pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Polyglot Backend Systems: Familiarity with modern backend languages such as Go or PHP in event-driven or microservice architectures.
  • Advanced Caching & Open Source: Experience optimizing edge media caches, working with relational databases/SQL, or contributing to open-source software initiatives.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Cross-Functional Technical Governance: Ability to translate complex business and product requirements into clear, practical architectural designs accepted across multiple engineering teams.
  • Technical Mentorship & Code Quality Advocacy: Strong commitment to promoting engineering best practices, conducting empathetic code reviews, and elevating overall code quality.
  • Operational Resilience & Diagnostic Vision: Ability to systematically isolate, diagnose, and resolve production incidents under high-urgency conditions during on-call rotation.
  • Structured Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to present software architecture proposals, trade-offs, and technical roadmaps to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Mission-Driven Innovation: Passion for leveraging modern technology to advance public media, accessibility, and audience engagement.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent technical architecture capability.

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Client Coordinator
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the Role

The Client Coordinator sits within Semafor’s Revenue Operations team and plays a central role in supporting sales, client partnerships, and integrated program delivery.

This role is the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing, Program Management, Events, and Ad Operations. The Client Coordinator supports the execution of integrated media programs by partnering with Sales and cross-functional teams to translate client goals into proposals and ensure seamless delivery across pre-sale functions. This role plays a critical part in maintaining organized workflows, clear communication, and a high-quality client experience across Semafor’s media and events portfolio.

  • Ensure opportunities, products, budgets, and deal details are up to date and accurate.

job.title: Engagement Producer, Close All Tabs
job.description:
Title: Engagement Producer, Close All Tabs

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $42.00 - $51.00 per hour
 


Close All Tabs, KQED’s tech and internet culture podcast, is looking for a part-time Engagement  Producer specializing in video to join our team. The show breaks down how the digital world impacts our real lives, and we’re bringing that mission to video. 

You’ll create video and social content for our digital platforms. This includes short-form vertical videos like interview highlights, explainers, behind-the-scenes content, and person on the street interviews. You’ll also create image assets, graphics, and caption copy. 

Working closely with the Close All Tabs podcast team, you’ll adapt the show’s audio storytelling into a visual medium and help refine its look and tone. You’ll take each video from idea to publication: pitching, scripting, shooting, editing/post-production, and posting. You’ll also be responsible for helping grow the show’s social presence, expanding to new platforms, and contributing to audience growth. 

This is a hands-on role for an experienced visual storyteller who wants to combine polished video skills with strange, absurd, and compelling stories from the internet. 

This is a part-time, limited term position reporting to the Senior Editor, Close All Tabs.

 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provides citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.


Job duties:
  • Pitch, produce, and edit short-form video content for Close All Tabs’ social channels, including Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube shorts.
  • Write scripts, production notes, shot lists, and other planning materials
  • Work with the podcast’s producers on a social media plan to promote new episodes 
  • Run single-person or potentially small-crew video production shoots and field work, maintaining professional standards for video and audio recording
  • Direct performance and delivery of host and other on-camera talent
  • Find and license third-party b-roll, photos, music, and other materials, ensuring appropriate rights and permissions
  • Optimize content to perform on each platform (length, format, captions, hashtags, thumbnails, calls to actions) and keep up to date with algorithm changes and new formats
  • Track performance metrics (views, reach, engagement, follower growth, click-throughs to episodes and subscriptions) and use the results to shape creative strategy
  • Maintain an organized archive of assets and templates, and streamline production workflows
  • Follow KQED editorial standards, journalistic ethics, and standards for accuracy and fairness
  • Meet production and publishing deadlines while managing multiple assignments

Knowledge/Experience Required
  • Three or more years of video production, video journalism, or multimedia experience (podcast, newsroom, or digital media preferred)
  • Fluency in video editing and post-production tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or Final Cut Pro, plus Descript for selecting and editing video.
  • Comfort with static image design (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva) and motion graphic templates
  • Demonstrated ability to produce compelling short- and long-form video, especially for talk-based or interview-driven formats
  • Strong storytelling instincts: spotting moments that hook viewers, spark emotion, and prompt engagement
  • Experience growing a show’s or brand’s social presence through original, engaging video ideas
  • Strong grasp of how each social platforms works: (Instagram feed, stories, and reels; TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook), including what drives performance and growth
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects at once, prioritize under tight deadlines, and collaborate closely with teammates
  • Solid understanding of journalistic principles, including ethics, accuracy, fairness, attribution, and editorial standards

Knowledge/Experience Desired:
  • Experience working in a public media newsroom or mission-driven journalism organization
  • Familiarity with audio production and sound design
  • Experience with long-form video content, including interviews, video essays, and short documentaries
  • Experience covering technology and the internet, and a real interest in internet culture, online communities, or gaming
  • Experience producing journalism for younger or hard-to-reach digital audiences
  • Experience with professional cameras, lenses, lighting, and audio equipment
  • B.A./B.S. degree in journalism, communications, film, media production, or a related field preferred
  • Love of absurd internet humor a plus

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

JOB PURPOSE 

The SVP, Product for Marketing Performance will be responsible for defining and executing the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for all capabilities related to marketing measurement, attribution and reporting within the WPP Open platform. This includes the development of visualizations and user experiences to democratize and utilize campaign and performance data, and the development of advanced analytics capabilities to enable Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and Geo-experimentation.  Including the use of agentic tooling for automated analytics outputs and conversational data analytics. 

You will build, inspire, and mentor high-performing, 'full-stack' product teams comprising product managers, engineers, data scientists, UX/UI designers, and enablement specialists. A core part of your mandate will be to foster a culture of agility, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, making decisive progress over perfection in a fast-paced environment. 

KEY RESPONSIBLITIES

Strategic Product Vision & Leadership:

  • Define and champion the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Marketing Performance within WPP Open, ensuring seamless alignment with WPP's overarching business goals, strategic product drivers, and client needs. 
  • Conduct in-depth market research, competitive analysis, and client needs assessment, relentlessly pursuing truly differentiating products that provide a clear competitive advantage. 
  • Translate complex business problems and evolving client challenges into clear, actionable product requirements and features, with a strong emphasis on holistic performance measurement. 
  • Develop and execute a clear strategy for integrating, harmonizing, and evolving existing performance measurement and reporting products/features into a unified, AI-enabled WPP Open offering, moving from customization to configurability. 

 Product Leadership & Team Transformation:

  • Lead, inspire, and mentor high-performing, multi-disciplinary 'full-stack' teams (Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, UX/UI, Enablement specialists), fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
  • Set clear Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and performance metrics for the Marketing Performance product area and individual team members, ensuring product KPI metrics track adoption, impact, and performance. 
  • Cultivate an environment where innovation thrives, talent flourishes, and every team member is empowered to deliver their best work. 

 Commercial Acumen & Growth:

  • Own a significant operating and capital expenditure budget for the Marketing Performance product area, making critical decisions within the financial framework. 
  • In partnership with commercial teams, define and manage the product commercials for your portfolio, including pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, and profitability analysis, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. 
  • Demonstrate ruthless prioritization to maximize business value and achieve ambitious goals, continually identifying and addressing customer pain points and opportunities. 
  • Ensure maximized product investment impact by simplifying the product portfolio and rationalizing product priorities effectively. 

 Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:

  • Collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX/UI Design, Data & Intelligence, Architecture & Infrastructure, and Enablement teams to ensure unified platform vision and successful development and delivery. 
  • Partner with WPP agency leadership, client teams and strategic external partners to understand evolving needs, gather feedback, and ensure optimal product market fit and adoption. 
  • Communicate product strategy, roadmap, and progress effectively and influentially to senior leadership, diverse stakeholders, and internal teams, translating complex concepts into clear, compelling presentations. 
  • Cultivate and manage high-impact relationships with key internal and external partners, driving collaborative initiatives and maximizing mutual value. 

Product Development & Execution:

  • Oversee the entire product lifecycle from discovery and ideation through development, launch, and post-launch iteration, emphasizing agile and iterative development. 
  • Prioritize features and initiatives based on strategic impact, client value, technical feasibility, and business objectives, with a relentless focus on driving meaningful adoption and impact. 
  • Ensure timely delivery of high-quality, scalable products and features that meet defined requirements, performance standards, and the architectural principles of WPP Open. 
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for product success, continually optimizing based on data and user feedback. 

 Domain Expertise & Innovation:

  • Maintain deep expertise in marketing performance measurement, advanced attribution models (MTA, MMM, including various methodologies), media mix optimization, incrementality testing, and experimentation design (e.g., geo-experimentation). 
  • Lead the application of AI and agentic tooling to enhance marketing performance reporting, diagnostics, automated analytics output (eg; Post Campaign Analyses), and recommendations, evolving towards conversational data analytics. 
  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends (in data architecture, analytics, AI) to ensure WPP Open remains at the forefront of marketing performance innovation. 
  • Serve as the definitive subject matter expert on Reporting & Analytics data and technology, offering invaluable support during client pitches and fostering thought leadership within the organization. 

 

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS 

Experience: 

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, with at least 8 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., SVP, VP) managing multiple product teams. 
  • Demonstrable experience leading product strategy, vision, and execution for large-scale marketing performance, analytics, attribution, or optimization platforms in the AdTech, MarTech, or Agency domain. 
  • Proven track record of successfully bringing complex, data-driven, and AI-enabled products from concept to market, driving significant competitive advantage and exponential growth. 
  • Extensive experience navigating and leading product teams through significant organizational change, mergers, or integrations, transforming disparate teams into a unified, high-performing organization. 
  • Strong understanding and application of modern agile product development methodologies. 
  • Experience managing significant operating and capital expenditure budgets and defining commercial models for product portfolios. 
  • Proven experience in managing global product rollouts and supporting a large, diverse client base (e.g., 1000+ clients across multiple markets). 

 

Domain Expertise: 

  • Advanced, hands-on knowledge of how marketing activity across Paid, Earned, Shared, Owned media channels is measured, coupled with a proven ability to translate this expertise into a compelling product vision and strategic roadmap. 
  • Deep expertise in advanced measurement techniques including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) (including various methodologies like Bayesian), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and marketing experimentation. 
  • Strong understanding of marketing data sources, data ingestion, transformation, and reporting challenges. 
  • Deep expertise in data architecture and engineering principles, data modeling, ETL processes, data warehousing, and advanced analytics, particularly in the context of marketing data. 

 

Leadership & Communication: 

  • Exceptional leadership, team-building, and people management skills, with a passion for mentoring and developing diverse talent. 
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and strategic concepts to diverse audiences (technical, business, executive, client) and build compelling presentations. 
  • Strong influencing, negotiation, and conflict resolution abilities, capable of building strong relationships and collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Proven ability to navigate and excel within a fast-paced, multi-market, matrixed global organization. 

 

Strategic & Analytical Thinking: 

  • Exceptional strategic thinking and complex problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to identify ptimal courses of action and articulate a clear, long-term vision. 
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with the ability to make informed decisions based on market insights, user data, and business objectives. 
  • A proactive, independent, and adaptable leader with a strong sense of ownership, thriving within demanding, fast-paced environments. 

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

The Business Consulting Director is a senior consulting leader responsible for leading global branding and global marketing consulting for Japan's leading B2B corporations. Working in English with overseas offices and global client stakeholders, you will design and facilitate cross-functional workshops, lead multiple engagements in parallel, and serve as the bridge between client leadership and our creative teams. This role combines consulting rigor, a deep understanding of global B2B business, and a genuine appreciation for creativity, contributing directly to the global brand value and business growth of our clients.

  • Cross-Departmental Coordination: Align diverse client stakeholders and internal agency teams around shared objectives, managing differing interests and building momentum toward decisions.

  1. Creative Direction & Integrated Delivery
  • Creative Briefing: Write clear, incisive creative briefs that translate consulting outputs into inspiring direction for creative teams.
  • Creative Collaboration: Engage actively in discussions with creative teams, providing strategic input to idea development and evaluating creative work with constructive feedback.
  • Strategic Consistency: Ensure that creative and communication output remains grounded in the agreed brand and marketing strategy and business objectives from concept through execution.
  1. Engagement Management & Practice Contribution
  • Multi-Project Leadership: Lead multiple consulting engagements in parallel, managing scope, timelines, resources, and quality to maximize client value.
  • AI-Enabled Ways of Working: Actively leverage generative AI and other AI tools to enhance the speed, depth, and quality of research, analysis, and deliverables.
  • Practice Development: Contribute to the growth of the Business Consulting practice by sharing knowledge, refining consulting methodologies, and supporting colleagues.

SKILLS and QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience in brand consulting, marketing strategy, or a related field, including hands-on experience in global B2B business.
  • Branding & Marketing Knowledge: Solid foundational knowledge of marketing and branding principles, and the ability to apply them to complex B2B business challenges.
  • Business-Level English: Ability to lead meetings and presentations, read English-language materials, and write proposals in English.
  • Workshop Facilitation: Proven ability to facilitate workshops involving multiple departments and stakeholders, driving productive discussion and alignment.
  • Creative Understanding: A sound understanding of creativity, with the ability to write creative briefs and to evaluate and give feedback on creative ideas.
  • Multi-Tasking: Ability to drive multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Digital & AI Proficiency: Practical, day-to-day proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word, and the ability to make effective use of generative AI and other AI tools in daily work.
  • Preferred Background: Experience at a global agency, brand consulting firm, or consulting firm, or in a B2B company (e.g., marketing, brand, or corporate planning functions). Basic knowledge of and experience with CRM is a plus.
  • Personal Attributes: A constant drive to take on new challenges; a passion for engaging deeply with clients' business issues and solving them through the power of brand and creativity; and self-driven leadership in a fast-changing environment.

job.title: Director, Broadcast Engineering
job.description:
The Director, Broadcast Engineering is responsible for leading the strategy, operation, modernization, and reliability of mission-critical broadcast engineering systems that support live production, studio operations, transmission, post-production, digital media, and multi-platform content delivery. This role manages a team of engineers, technicians, specialists, and vendor partners while bridging traditional broadcast workflows with IP-based, virtualized, and cloud-enabled media infrastructure. The Director will provide technical leadership, staff development, operational discipline, and long-range planning to ensure high-quality, resilient, and scalable production services.

Responsibilities

Staff Leadership and Management

  • Lead, manage, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary broadcast engineering team responsible for live production, technical operations, maintenance, system support, and engineering projects.
  • Define team priorities, assign resources, manage schedules, establish performance objectives, and conduct regular performance reviews.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational readiness, documentation, continuous improvement, and inclusive leadership.
  • Develop career paths, training plans, succession plans, and cross-training programs to strengthen technical depth and leadership bench strength.
  • Partner with production, operations, IT, transmission, digital media, security, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders to align staffing and engineering priorities with business objectives.

Broadcast Infrastructure and Operations

  • Oversee the design, deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle management of studios, control rooms, routing, intercom, audio, video, replay, graphics, monitoring, transmission, post-production, and media asset systems.
  • Ensure reliable operation of live broadcast environments through preventive maintenance, system monitoring, incident response, disaster recovery planning, and root-cause analysis.
  • Establish engineering standards, documentation practices, escalation procedures, commissioning processes, and operational readiness checklists.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable broadcast, safety, security, accessibility, and regulatory requirements. 

IP, Cloud, and Emerging Technology Strategy

  • Lead the transition from traditional SDI and hardware-centric workflows toward IP-based, software-defined, virtualized, and cloud-connected media infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and implement technologies such as SMPTE ST 2110, PTP timing, NMOS discovery and control, AES67, Dante, JPEG XS, SRT, NDI, bonded contribution, REMI production, virtualization, containerization, cloud playout, cloud production, remote monitoring, and observability platforms.
  • Develop hybrid architectures that connect on-premises broadcast facilities with digital media platforms, OTT distribution, FAST channels, content supply chains, and cloud-based production workflows.
  • Partner with IT, cybersecurity, network engineering, and cloud architecture teams to ensure media systems meet requirements for latency, timing, resiliency, security, scalability, and operational support.
  • Create roadmaps that balance current broadcast reliability requirements with future-facing digital media, automation, AI-assisted workflows, metadata, and cloud-native capabilities.

Project, Budget, and Vendor Management

  • Lead capital and operational engineering projects from concept through design, procurement, implementation, testing, training, handoff, and ongoing support.
  • Develop budgets, forecasts, business cases, technical requirements, scopes of work, risk assessments, and implementation schedules.
  • Manage vendor relationships, integrators, managed service providers, service contracts, support agreements, and equipment lifecycle planning.

Operational Support and Incident Management

  • Provide senior technical leadership during live events, critical outages, major launches, and high-priority production support scenarios.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts across broadcast, IP network, storage, compute, cloud, audio, video, and application layers.
  • Develop incident reports, postmortems, lessons learned, corrective actions, and preventative controls.
  • Ensure teams are prepared for 24/7 operations, live-event support, escalation coverage, and business continuity requirements.

Communication and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for executive, operational, production, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration between engineering, production, digital media, IT, security, facilities, vendors, and business leadership.
  • Represent broadcast engineering in strategic planning, technology evaluation, roadmap development, standards alignment, and operational governance.

 Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, broadcast engineering, computer science, information technology, media technology, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in broadcast engineering, media systems engineering, technical operations, or live production technology, including leadership of complex broadcast facilities or production environments.
  • 5+ years of people-management experience leading engineers, technicians, managers, project teams, vendors, or managed service providers.
  • Demonstrated experience managing live production environments where reliability, speed, operational discipline, and incident response are critical.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast signal flow, studio systems, production control rooms, intercom, audio, video, routing, replay, graphics, transmission, post-production, monitoring, and media asset workflows.
  • Working knowledge of IP media standards and systems, including SMPTE ST 2110, SMPTE 2022-6/7, PTP/IEEE 1588, NMOS IS-04/IS-05, AES67, Dante, multicast networking, QoS, and media-over-IP troubleshooting.
  • Experience with cloud, virtualization, digital media, or software-defined infrastructure, including hybrid workflows that connect broadcast operations with cloud production, streaming, OTT, FAST, remote production, or digital distribution platforms.
  • Familiarity with compute, storage, networking, cybersecurity, automation, orchestration, APIs, monitoring, observability, and DevOps-style support practices as they apply to media systems.
  • Proven ability to lead technical strategy, capital projects, budgets, vendor negotiations, RFPs, scopes of work, implementation plans, and lifecycle management.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours as needed to support live events, urgent technical issues, launches, maintenance windows, and business-critical operations.

Qualifications

  • Experience with ST 2110 facility design, IP fabric architecture, timing design, boundary clocks, grandmaster redundancy, multicast routing, and vendor interoperability testing.
  • Experience with media supply chain platforms, MAM/DAM systems, storage orchestration, transcoding, cloud-based playout, streaming workflows, and metadata-driven content operations.
  • Experience leading engineering teams through organizational change, facility transformation, SDI-to-IP migration, cloud adoption, or major technology refresh initiatives.
  • Knowledge of AI-assisted media workflows, automation, quality control, captioning, accessibility, rights-aware distribution, and digital content monetization platforms.

The ideal candidate is creative, highly organized, collaborative, and able to manage multiple partners, deliverables, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Music Operations Specialist
job.description:
Are you ready to take your career to new heights and be a part of a dynamic team at Rogers Sports & Media? We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

 

Music Operations Specialist 

 

***Please note: We offer flexibility in work location. The successful candidate may be based anywhere in Canada where Rogers operates a radio station.***

 

Who we're looking for:

 

Reporting to the National Music Operations Manager, the Music Operations Specialist plays a key role in shaping the sound of multiple music brands across our network through thoughtful scheduling and playlist management.

 

We’re looking for someone who understands that great music scheduling is both an art and a science. You know how to build effective clocks, rules, and parameters that allow MusicMaster to do the heavy lifting, while also recognizing when a playlist needs the human touch to get the flow just right.

 

What you'll do: 

  • Schedule and maintain music logs for multiple brands and formats.
  • Build & manage clocks, categories, rules, and scheduling strategies.
  • Monitor playlist performance to ensure we’re on strategy.
  • Build reports as needed.
  • Maintain music database(s).

 

What you bring: 

  • Experience with music scheduling and playlist management, preferably using MusicMaster.
  • Strong understanding of music clocks, scheduling rules, rotations, categories, and reporting.
  • Ability to balance data-driven scheduling with creative playlist curation.
  • Familiarity with a variety of music formats and programming philosophies.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple brands and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 

Bonus Points

  • Experience scheduling multiple music formats.
  • Advanced MusicMaster knowledge, including rule building, troubleshooting, and workflow optimization.

 

What's in it for you? 

 

We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including: 

 

  • Competitive & flexible health and dental benefits, pension plan, RRSP, TFSA, and Stock matching programs.
  • Discounts: Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers Services and Blue Jays Tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.
  • Paid time off for volunteering.
  • Company matching contributions to charities you support.

 

Growth & Development Opportunities

  • Self-driven career development programs
  • Rogers First: priority in applying to internal roles of interest

 

Wellness Programs

  • Employee & family assistance program
  • Virtual Healthcare
  • Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)
  • Low or no-cost fitness membership

 

Our commitment to diversity:

  • An inclusive and diverse workplace where you can bring your whole self to work.

 

To protect our people, brand and assets, a pre-employment background check will be conducted. As part of our selection process, all candidates must clear a criminal background check. Additionally, a credit check and drivers abstract may be required depending on the role.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive 

*Non-Remote, In-Person Opportunity. * 

 

The Opportunity: 

Townsquare Media is looking for a bright, confident, driven individual to join our multimedia advertising sales team in Bozeman Montana.  Townsquare Media Bozeman is an industry leader in digital advertising and an accredited marketing partner of both Google and Meta as well as home to five top radio stations.   

 

At Townsquare Media Bozeman, we are a team of ambitious individuals who work together to push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally. You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and an unlimited earning potential! 

 

If you’re ready to embark upon an exciting career that affords you the opportunity to form meaningful client relationships, develop creative advertising campaigns using our best-in-class multimedia solutions, all while having your finger on the pulse of Southwest Montana…then we want to hear from you!  

 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Identify, pursue, and schedule meetings with local business owners and decision makers to discuss and uncover their marketing needs and challenges 
  • Use our proprietary data, analytics, and multimedia marketing solutions to build, present, and sell customized advertising plans to potential clients  
  • Build, maintain and develop close working relationships with your clients to identify and upsell new advertising solutions 
  • Use your influence and relationship-building skills to provide ongoing customer service, research, and market analysis 
  • You will be responsible for bringing our premier marketing and advertising solutions to local and regional businesses in the Bozeman area and beyond 
  • You will work with and sell integrated advertising solutions including broadcast radio, LIVE event sponsorships and digital including website design, SEO, SEM, Programmatic, Social, Streaming TV and much more 

 

What You’ll Bring: 

  • 1+ year of sales or marketing experience (preferred) 
  • Strong marketing and advertising acumen 
  • Effective verbal and written communications are essential 
  • Experience selling or a working knowledge of digital advertising solutions preferred 
  • Goal-oriented, strong work ethic and a desire to learn and grow a career in Sales 
  • A passion towards customer focused solution sales 
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required) 
  • BA/BS degree (preferred) 

 

What’s In It for You? 

  • Competitive compensation package with UNCAPPED earning potential  
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days) 
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community 
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance 
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Casual, high-energy, supportive, and collaborative work environment 
  • 4-week long sales training program

Sioux Falls and the surrounding area remain one of the fastest-growing regions in the Upper Midwest and are home to 300,000 people, constituting more than 30% of the state's population. Healthcare and finance make up much of a diverse and broad workforce. The business climate in South Dakota continues to be one of the top in the nation, fueled by no state income tax and a diverse workforce.

There is never a shortage of activities or events, with summers packed with outdoor festivals and concerts, including free concerts at the Levitt at the Falls outdoor music venue.

Still, many also enjoy the city’s nearly 30 miles of bike trails and parks, including the namesake of the city, the beautiful waterfalls of the Big Sioux River! Yes, winters can be challenging, but it does not mean people hibernate. Colder temperatures provide plenty of outdoor and indoor activities all winter long. From parades like the annual Parade of Lights down Phillips Avenue to outdoor ice skating parks, life does not slow down in the winter in Sioux Falls.

The city is home to a 12,000-seat arena that is continually hosting major events and entertainment acts, ranging from the Professional Bull Riders, college and semi-professional hockey, indoor football, to concerts with names like Paul McCartney, Garth Brooks, and Elton John.

The city is also home to a new indoor aquatic center, an indoor ice-skating facility, a basketball arena, and an indoor tennis complex. Multiple award-winning golf courses, both public and private, surround the city, offering a relaxing and challenging day on the links

Culinary appetites never need to look far from being satiated, as there is no shortage of places to eat. Not only is Sioux Falls home to many familiar restaurant chains, but it’s also known for many great locally owned, nationally recognized restaurants and restaurateurs. For those looking for a quick weekend getaway, nothing to fear. You can drive to Omaha in three hours, Minneapolis in four, and the Black Hills in five. Since Sioux Falls is centrally located in the Midwest, direct and connecting flights to almost anywhere in the United States are often less than a few hours in length.

Dakota News Now is an award-winning television operation serving viewers in the eastern half of South Dakota as well as portions of southwest Minnesota and northwest Iowa. The stations operate from a relatively new studio in downtown Sioux Falls, branding all stations under the Dakota News Now umbrella. The Dakota News Now team produces 36 hours of news each week.

Some of our employees have been here for more than 25 years. For others, this is their first job out of college. It’s a great mix that gives us different perspectives while covering the news and assisting local clientele in achieving their marketing goals.

job.title: Press Operator (38) - 3rd Shift
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

This position is Full-time (40 hr) benefits eligible, schedule is Sunday night through Friday morning, 11:30pm - 7:30am.

The Press Operator in Lawrence sets up and operates belt fold machines, page insert machines, double overlay machines, etc. that fold paper, light weight packets, and board stock in multiple ways.  May apply glue to stock during operation.  The machinery is of varying vintages, manufacturers, and types with multiple variables impacting press performance.  Applies acetate, vinyl overlay (materials sensitive to temperature, pressure, ink, etc.) or insert pages to greeting cards.  Performs make-ready duties and prepares press or multiple presses, and types of presses to run a variety of folds, some with severe die cut design.  Maintains and operates glue systems.  Incumbent may also diagnose and perform machinery maintenance repairs and preventive maintenance functions while assisting operators.  Responsible for specified production, quality checks, and TPM’s.  Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.

Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

 

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready duties on multiple press types with varying controls and production factors (speed, temperature, pressure, etc.). 
  • Read layout, tickets and have an understanding of downstream processes.  
  • Diagnose and perform machinery maintenance repairs and preventive maintenance functions. 
  • Execute the Quality System including preflights, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage. 
  • Prepare related paperwork/documentation for shipping accuracy, including completing production data and spoilage.
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished within the shorter periods of time.
  • Utilize good safety practices.   

 

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

You must show how you meet basic qualifications (listed below) in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields.  Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT. 

Internal applicants will be considered in seniority order based on skills, qualifications and performance.  You must address how you meet the basic qualifications of the job in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. In order to be considered for this position:

  • Your performance will be reviewed dating 12-months back from the date the job posting comes down.  You must have been satisfactory in all areas and have no disqualifying CR’s for that full 12-month period in order to be considered. 
  • You must have been in your current job for at least 6 or 12 months, depending on the role.
    • 35, 36, 37 – at least 6 months
    • 38,39,40 – at least 12 months

If additional openings become available within 30 days of the posting coming down and the vacancy is still in an open status, applicants will be selected from the original posting. If interested in this job, please apply now. 

If you are offered and accept this position, you understand that you will be held within this position for 12 months.  If you are offered a new position once you accept, but have been in your position for less than 6 months you will not be able to move to a new role. 

 

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Successful (as defined by Achieves or better performance rating) experience in 37 Packaging Operator classification
  • Ability to frequently transfer stock weighing 20 pounds and occasionally lift up to 50 pounds.  May lift 70 pounds with assistance.
  • Ability to stand and/or  walk approximately 95% of the time
  • Ability to frequently reach, twist, bend, and perform repetitive hand/wrist motion and fine motor skills
  • Ability to occasionally work at or above shoulder level  

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Good math, written and oral communication skills, and basic computer skills
  • High School Diploma, GED or equivalent
  • Ability to understand the computer and ordering systems and successfully operate both systems
  • Ability to organize and set-up work area and re-organize as priorities change.  Ability to work under pressure

  • Ability to accept other duties as assigned
  • Ability to learn and retain knowledge
  • Ability to work in a team environment and be able to contribute positively during problem solving sessions 

 

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • This is a climate-controlled manufacturing environment with normal physical injury hazard.
  • There is some noise and hearing protection is required by Hallmark.

 

This position is located in Lawrence, Kansas.  Relocation is not provided.

  • WKBT is the type of station where you can share your passion with other like-minded storytellers, advance your career, and make an immediate contribution.

  • Demonstrated proficiency with social media platforms and audiences. 
  • Willingness to work evenings, weekends, and holidays if needed. 
  • Ability to lift 30 lbs. of gear and to sit, walk, or stand for long periods of time.

Morgan Murphy Media is a progressive and family-owned business that places our highest values on our employees, the workplace culture, and the communities we serve. job.title: Senior Manager, Community Connections, WTVF
job.description:
At Scripps, we believe strong local journalism starts with strong community connections. As the Sr. Manager, Community Connections at WTVF, NewsChannel 5 in Nashville, Tennessee, you’ll serve as a primary connector between the station and the communities of Nashville and Middle Tennessee, building trusted relationships that deepen local engagement, inform our journalism and create meaningful partnerships.

You’ll bring community voices and insights into the newsroom while helping ensure questions, concerns and story ideas are heard and acted on thoughtfully. Working across News, Sales, Marketing and station leadership, you’ll turn community intelligence into opportunities for greater impact. Your work will help ensure NewsChannel 5 remains an essential, responsive and trusted part of life across Middle Tennessee.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, government and other community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze and share community insights with station leadership, newsroom teams and partners to help inform decision-making, journalism and local engagement.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources and strengthen audience engagement across community channels.
  • Represent WTVF throughout Nashville and Middle Tennessee and develop partnerships that create long-term value, trust and local impact.
  • Respond to community members, partners and stakeholders with timely, professional communication, ensuring audience questions, concerns and story tips are acknowledged, routed and resolved appropriately.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs and other community engagement activities.
  • Collaborate with News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and station leadership to develop meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics and stakeholder coordination while measuring effectiveness to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities, advising leadership on community needs, emerging issues and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, sharing best practices, tracking outcomes and helping build engagement capabilities across teams.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of relevant experience preferred.
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations or a related field.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company-required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills, with the ability to establish credibility across a wide range of communities and organizations.
  • Strong community listening skills and the ability to recognize emerging issues, needs and opportunities.
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to translate community insights into meaningful action.
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, station leadership and external community organizations.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity when working with diverse communities and sensitive topics.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative and adapt effectively to changing community and business needs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM or community relationship platforms and collaboration tools.
  • A strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues.

Application Review:

Applications received by November 18, 2026 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


Nashville is a growing, dynamic community with a rich history, vibrant neighborhoods and a culture all its own. Known around the world as Music City, Nashville is also home to a thriving business community, major league sports, renowned universities, diverse arts and food scenes, and communities that care deeply about the future of Middle Tennessee. This is an opportunity to build meaningful connections across the market and help WTVF continue making a difference in the communities it serves.

To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. job.title: Sr Mgr, Community Connections, WGBA
job.description:
WGBA, the NBC affiliate in Green Bay, Wisconsin, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is searching for a Senior Manager of Community Connections. You'll be the station's main link to the community, building trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, education and government leaders. You'll turn community insights into stronger journalism, partnerships that matter and events people show up for, like town halls and public forums. You'll also lead the newsroom's daily community engagement and make sure audience questions, story tips and concerns get a fast, thoughtful response. If you love connecting people and making a real local impact, we want to hear from you.

From Lambeau Field to the Fox River trails, Green Bay is a close-knit city with big hometown pride. It has a friendly, small-city feel, easy access to the waters of Green Bay and Door County, and some of the most loyal fans anywhere, so it's easy to feel at home in Titletown. Apply today!

job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Part-Time Sports Content Researcher Job ID 10164761 Location Los Angeles, California, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 13, 2026 Part-Time Sports Content Researcher Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements You have a head for stats, an eye for a great story, and the range as a writer to be creative and succinct -- and your passion for sports is the beating heart that fuels it all. This is the type of person who thrives as a Sports Content Researcher at ESPN. This position will work on NFL Network and other shows produced in Inglewood, CA, and be part of the company’s larger Research & Graphics squad – with staff also located in Bristol, CT and Charlotte, NC. Our mission is simple to define but incredibly complex to deliver: Provide ESPN’s television, audio, digital and social platforms with statistics, context and historical perspectives that make our sports coverage as interesting to the sports fanatic as it is understandable to the casual observer. It’s no easy feat, but we do it 24/7, and we think we do it better than anyone else. If this sounds like you and you’re up for the challenge, please apply today! Ok, it’s true: You’re in the office on Super Bowl Sunday. And for the NFL Draft. And the NFL schedule release. But the office is ESPN’s production center in Inglewood, CA, and you’re surrounded by people who share your passion. You’re a member of a tight squad of like-minded professionals who feed an endless flow of differentiating content that lands across ESPN platforms. Sports Content Researchers tap their existing reservoirs of knowledge and use ESPN’s vast resources – including access to world-class advanced metrics -- to hone in on the why and how of the sporting events that are most important to ESPN and sports fans. The NFL, college football, and the NBA are year-round staples, with significant coverage of the NHL, WNBA, and college basketball. Any sport could deliver the story of the day, week, or month. Responsibilities Many people say this, but in Research, it really is true: Sports news is constant, so no two days are the same. On any given day or night, you might: Create original full-screen graphics and anchor lead-ins for live shows such as those on NFL Network or any ESPN platform , using research you’ve done and copy you’ve written; Post the most relevant news on the ESPN BottomLine/NFL Network ticker – from Breaking News alerts to in-depth coverage and putting complex news stories into context; Put your deep knowledge to work to create game previews for shows that are informative, factually accurate, and unique enough that even die-hard sports fans really learn something; Collaborate with colleagues for every element of a studio show, from unearthing little-known facts to quickly bringing up relevant stats when things such as trades, coaching changes, or injuries are announced; Provide real-time updates for anchors and announcers while they are on the air; Flex your storytelling muscles by developing interesting segments, and help your colleagues flesh out their own ideas; ESPN is known for its cutting-edge graphics, and you will be one of the people who develop visually appealing, factually revealing visuals for our TV and digital feeds; Drop everything when news breaks and use your deep knowledge of advanced metrics, analytics, and research tools to create supporting content, often with a deadline of minutes or seconds! Working in Research also means you: Work a schedule that will vary by month and/or season -- you’ll get to dive deeply into sports and have enough variety to keep your days and week fresh; Experience professional growth and development – in addition to onboarding, training, and coaching that is a constant, you’ll meet with your supervisor formally twice a month and receive quarterly performance updates. Basic Qualifications: Minimum of 1 year of related experience in sports, statistics, research, or a related field Full availability for this position to work days, nights, weekends, and holidays Broad knowledge of most sports and deep knowledge of the NFL and several others, including awareness of current/historical sports statistics, milestones, news, and events Elite writing and grammar skills. Must have aptitude to research, write air-ready scripts for BottomLine as well as Event and Studio productions Must be able to communicate information accurately Must be able to adhere to strict deadlines and react to breaking news Must be able to follow all Disney, ESPN, and department policies and directives Preferred Qualifications Minimum 2 years of experience working with statistics in an online, television, or print media environment Fluency in reading, speaking, and writing Spanish Demonstrated track record of training others and/or managing team-based projects Required Education High School diploma or equivalent Preferred Education College degree or equivalent #ESPNMedia Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Los Angeles is $42,280 to $56,630 per year based on a 28 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: Photographer
job.description:
FOX6 is looking to hire a creative, visual storyteller who enjoys collaborating with Newsroom staff to get the latest news into the hands of viewers. You must thrive in a fast-paced environment and be willing to pivot from one assignment to the next.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Not an office job! As a FOX6 Photojournalist, your days will be anything but monotonous. You’ll be in the field chasing breaking news with a reporter and turning stories on a tight deadline. You’ll be tasked with covering local events or even going on your own to capture compelling weather video. You’ll flex your storytelling muscles with long form pieces that you are passionate about. And you’ll create content for digital and social platforms.  We will provide the equipment so you can capture the best sequences, natural sounds and moments to produce compelling stories that our viewers need to know.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Vocational/Technical School degree strongly preferred
  • At least two years of Television News shooting experience, as well as technical knowledge of non-linear editing software, preferably Edius, and photo equipment including lighting equipment
  • Must be physically able to lift, carry and handle 30 to 50 pounds of camera gear, and deal with the realities of a Wisconsin winter or summer
  • Position requires driving
  • Drone license preferred
  • Ability to handle strict deadlines
  • Ability to communicate clearly and work as a team is necessary
  • Working weekend and/or holidays is a possibility
  • Ability to troubleshoot and stay calm during the urgency of live news

*This is a NABET represented position.

job.description:
We are looking for a motivated Associate Photo Editor to be a part of a groundbreaking online news-team for FoxNews.com & FoxBusiness.com. As Associate Photo Editor, you can handle a fast-paced environment and are creative, flexible and have a ''can-do'' attitude. You are willing to learn, enjoy collaborating with a team and are eager to advance within the company.

job.title: Human Resources Business Partner
job.description:
The Fox Television Stations (FTS) HR team is seeking a business-minded, hands-on HR Business Partner to support our Sales Team, Finance and other corporate functions. This role is for an experienced HR professional who pairs strategic thinking with strong day-to-day execution and thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven broadcast and streaming environment.

Reporting to the Senior Regional HR Director, the HRBP will own day-to-day HR support across the full employee lifecycle while acting as a trusted advisor to department leadership. The ideal candidate brings sound judgment, credibility, and the ability to translate business needs into practical people solutions. This individual will be comfortable navigating change and balancing competing priorities.

The HRBP will partner closely with HR Centers of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, HR Operations, and Learning & Development, to deliver a consistent and effective employee experience across stations.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a strategic HR partner and advisor to station leadership, providing guidance on employee relations, performance management, staffing models, and people priorities

  • Identify emerging trends, consumer behaviors, new play patterns, technologies, and white-space opportunities.
  • Translate business and franchise strategies into compelling product concepts and design solutions.
  • Monitor emerging trends and innovation across collectibles, toys, and adjacent product categories.
  • Understand the competitive landscape, target consumer, and evolving collector mindset.
  • Build clear, polished design strategy presentations for internal and leadership reviews.

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

 

Discipline: Design | Team Model: Embedded on a cross-functional CBS Sports App squad

Location: New York, NY

 

The Mission

CBS Sports is the digital stadium for millions of fans. We hold the rights to the biggest moments in sports—NFL, UEFA Champions League, March Madness, the Masters, and UFC. We aren't just a scoreboard; we’re a massive content engine of fantasy leagues, live video, and deep journalism. We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to join a small, cross-functional squad that operates with the speed of a startup and the scale of a legacy giant.

 

The Role: Build and Own

You won’t just work on a product; you’ll own the design outcomes from first framing through ship. We believe in a builder culture where designers aren't waiting for handoffs or research gates. You will:

  • Own the Project: Take full responsibility for your product squad’s design outcomes. You lead the direction from initial concept to the final shipped experience.

  • Build Constantly: Prototype early and often. We use AI tools (like Cursor or Claude) to visualize ideas and test interactions before they hit engineering, letting us move faster than ever.

  • Lead with Visual Craft: We need designers who bring energy, taste, and dynamic design sensibilities. Whether it’s motion that obeys physics or layouts that capture the intensity of game day, your work should set the bar for the squad.

  • Shape the Product: You’ll trade honest, real-time feedback with engineers and PMs. We don't just "deliver" designs; we shape products in the build.

 

Core Capabilities

  • Visual Design: You have a refined eye for type hierarchy, layouts, and intuitive UI/UX. You deliver high-impact, immersive designs for complex app systems that capture the intensity of game day and live sports.

  • Motion & Interactivity: You understand motion as a logical system. Your designs feel tactile, precise, and alive.

  • Fluency in Native Design: You have deep experience with mobile paradigms (iOS/Android). You know how to leverage native capabilities to elevate the user experience.

  • Owner Mindset: You treat research as a velocity tool, not a gate. You use your intuition, analytics, and direct fan feedback to make smart product decisions quickly.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of end-to-end product design experience.

  • A portfolio showing shipped consumer work on mobile apps or web (required).

  • Comfort moving across prototyping, production, and interaction design without handoffs.

 

Additional Qualifications

This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth role built for a broadcast-experienced seller who can do it all — someone who has spent time in local TV knows how to maximize opportunities, and is hungry to excel as a multi-screen, multi-market powerhouse.
As an Account Executive on the Local Ad Sales team at CBS, you will sell across our full O&O footprint — with the ability to close multi-market broadcast deals that span from coast to coast. Layered on top of that is the opportunity to sell Paramount+ and Pluto TV streaming inventory, giving clients a truly end-to-end screen solution backed by one of the most recognized brands in media.

  • Stay ahead of the market. Know the linear and streaming landscape. Understand where categories are investing and why. Bring category intelligence into every client conversation.
