job.title: Producer - WOKV Jacksonville Radio
job.description:
Location: FL-Jacksonville

Job Title:  Producer - WOKV Jacksonville Radio

 

Position Overview

Reporting to the News Director, the WOKV News Producer develops, writes, and delivers timely local and national news content for 104.5 FM, as well as WOKV’s digital and social platforms. This role requires strong news judgment, urgency, accuracy, and the ability to respond quickly to breaking news, severe weather, and developing stories.

 

The News Producer is responsible for creating factual, compelling, and relatable news content that informs and engages the audience. This person will also develop trusted sources, conduct interviews, support reporting needs, and be prepared to anchor newscasts as needed.

 

This is an 8-hour shift based on newsroom needs and the news/event cycle. The schedule will include one weekend day and may include overnight, early morning, daytime, or evening hours, such as 11 p.m.–7 a.m., 3 a.m.–11 a.m., 7 a.m.–3 p.m., or 12 p.m.–8 p.m.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Produce, write, and edit accurate, compelling local and national news content for radio broadcasts, digital platforms, and social media channels.
  • Monitor breaking news, severe weather, and developing stories; respond quickly and responsibly with timely updates across all platforms.
  • Research, verify, and develop story ideas using reliable sources, sound news judgment, and established editorial standards.
  • Report breaking news, top local stories, and top national stories as assigned.
  • Conduct interviews in studio, in the field, on location, and by phone while maintaining professionalism and journalistic integrity.
  • Prepare to anchor newscasts as needed.
  • Build and maintain trusted sources to support ongoing reporting and story development.
  • Collaborate with reporters, anchors, and newsroom leadership to support daily coverage, breaking news, and special projects.
  • Manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom environment.
  • Ensure content follows company policies, legal standards, and digital and social media guidelines.
  • Identify opportunities to improve newsroom workflows, content quality, and audience impact.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the News Director.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience producing, writing, and reporting news content for radio, digital, and social platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to deliver accurate and timely information under deadline pressure.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced breaking-news environment.
  • Sound editorial judgment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to remain composed under pressure.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, early mornings, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively with newsroom colleagues and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, broadcast journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • On-air reporting or anchoring experience.
  • Experience conducting interviews in studio, in the field, on location, and by phone.
  • Familiarity with digital publishing tools, social media platforms, and newsroom content systems.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Associate, Player Relations (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The Player Relations Associate will assist the Sr. Manager, Player Relations and the Sr. Director, Player Relations in building a strong partnership with the entire football community with a focus on marketing and branding opportunities for both players and Legends. The associate will also play a pivotal role in the player procurement process and execution of all player appearances for the League.   

Responsibilities:

  • Player procurement and appearance management
    • Management of all player contracts for 1,000+ annual appearances
    • Liaison between NFL Legal, Finance, players and marketing reps for any contract edits
    • Collaborate with all internal NFL departments that book players to ensure the best players are selected and all contractual elements are executed correctly
    • Management of all appearance tracking documents and reporting including department metrics and fee trackers
    • Management of the Player Procurement System including liaising with NFL IT
  • Cultivate relationships with key stakeholders that support the player partnership
    • Act as the point of contact for the NFLPA Player Services team as it relates to player appearance contracts and creative approvals
    • Management of the quarterly NFL Agents Meeting which disseminates pertinent detail to key marketing representatives
    • Represent the Player Relations team in internal meetings that include player involvement in events or activations
  • Assist with all player brand building and marketing opportunities
    • Assist with league wide NFL marketing initiatives that effect the larger player population including My Cause My Cleats and the NFL Heritage Program
    • Collaborate with the Player Communications and Marketing team on content opportunities involving players or Legends
    • Management of the Player Office Visit program for all players and Legends
    • Manage the process for all group licensing creative approvals across the League to ensure guidelines are followed and player rights are protected
    • Review, track, and route all print, video, online promotions, enhancements and vignettes featuring active NFL players to the NFLPA for necessary approvals
  • Support the overall player experience and event activation
    • Manage the logistics tied to executing player appearances or activations and any support staff or vendors (i.e., Carey Cars, rotational staff, AMEX, etc.)
    • Management of specific groups at tent pole events to ensure they receive a best-in-class experience (i.e. Pro Bowl Roster, NFL Draft Prospects, WPMOY at Super Bowl, etc.)

  • Minimum 1-3 years of relevant experience
  • Experience with Microsoft Office

job.title: Office Services Clerk (TEMP) KRTV
job.description:
Are you someone who takes pride in keeping the office running like a well-oiled machine? KRTV in Great Falls, Montana is looking for an Office Services Clerk (Temp) who thrives on organization, loves helping people, and enjoys wearing many hats throughout the day. From managing correspondence and welcoming visitors to stocking supplies and supporting the team with essential clerical tasks, you'll play a vital behind-the-scenes role in everything we do. If you're detail-oriented, resourceful, and ready to contribute to a fast-moving media environment, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Open, sort and distribute incoming correspondence, including faxes and email.
  • Greet visitors and determine whether they should be given access to specific individuals
  • Prepare invoices, reports, memos, letters, other documents, using word processing, spreadsheets, database, and/or presentation software.
  • Perform general office duties such as ordering supplies, maintaining records management systems, and performing basic bookkeeping work.
  • Maintain inventory flow and storage of office supplies
  • Participate in building safety and evacuation team at supervisors direction
  • Perform other duties as needed and as directed by supervisor/management.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Basic math, reading and computer skills
  • Resourceful, possess excellent communication skills, ability to work with public and with other office personnel in person and by telephone
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM: We have hikers, rock climbers, mountain bikers, kayakers, runners, skiers, gamers, hunters, fishing enthusiasts, beekeepers, western Montana gardeners, travelers, boaters, community leaders, and every other mixture of diverse backgrounds, passions, and life experiences. We are a community of welcoming, mission-focused, and lively people who continue to grow as we grow our company and rise to our full potential in every aspect of our business.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY: Great Falls, MT, is where outdoor enthusiasts enjoy the big small-town charm and quick access to national parks. Skiing is right outside your door as well as an expansive 40 miles along the River's Edge Trail. Enjoy a picnic at Gibson Park and Giant Springs Heritage State Park or get inspired by the local culture and art at the C.M. Russell Museum. Take a step back in time with The Lewis & Clark Interpretive Center and the First Peoples Buffalo Jump State Park to explore Montana's heritage and history. Whether you want to unplug and get off the grid and onto a hike surrounded by wilderness or enjoy the small-town charm of the local farmers market, restaurants, dog parks, and fly fishing or cultural events and performances at the Mansfield Center for Performing Arts, Great Falls has something for everyone. There are many reasons to claim Great Falls as a great place to live, including the reminder that you are walking in the footsteps of "the greats" from Lewis and Clark, the Blackfeet Indians, and the grizzly bear.Montana_Station_Location_Sections.md

job.title: Account Executive, KERO
job.description:
We are looking for a driven, creative sales professional who loves helping local businesses grow? KERO in Bakersfield, California is looking for an Account Executive, Local who will be a true partner to the business community — connecting clients to the audiences that matter most through a powerful, multi-platform suite of advertising solutions. From broadcast television to Over The Top (OTT) video, search strategies, social media, digital display, and e-mail targeting, you'll craft customized campaigns that deliver real results and real return on investment. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making a measurable difference for the businesses in your community, this is your opportunity to shine.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Sell advertising solutions to local and regional businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Apply the Scripps Sales Process (SSP) to analyze current and prospective customer needs and apply customized advertising solutions that provide return on their investment.
  • In addition to television commercial airtime sales, facilitate the customer's ability to take advantage of the full array of digital marketing options available.
  • Independently prospect, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, present and close sales to develop and maintain new business from traditional and non-traditional advertisers.
  • Use ratings data, qualitative information and market trends to negotiate program ratings and advertising rates with advertising agencies in order to maximize revenue as well as develop custom solutions for new advertisers.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor with new and existing clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications and collection of revenue due.
  • Effectively and proactively manage a sales funnel by way of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, monitoring and achieving key performance indicators and expected activity levels.
  • Contribute to the creative development of campaigns though client communication and needs analysis, storyboard and concept creation, and assistance in production aspects.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of a media salesperson including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with sales leadership regarding the status of accounts.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally 2+ years of proven sales success preferred
  • Experience in strategic account management, broadcast ratings and digital execution preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused
  • Highly creative and innovative thinker
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)

WHAT WE'LL OFFER:

  • Uncapped sales commission
  • Monthly allowance for mileage and cell phone
  • Extensive Scripps Sales Process training
  • A career path to grow your professional experiences
  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, life insurance, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Bakersfield is California's ninth-largest city and a place with a character all its own — rooted in agriculture, energy, and a deep musical heritage that gave birth to the Bakersfield Sound, a twangy, West Coast alternative to Nashville country that produced legends like Buck Owens and Merle Haggard. The city is home to the Kern County Museum, a vibrant arts scene, and a calendar full of festivals and community events that reflect its proud, hardworking spirit.

Surrounded by stunning natural landscapes, Bakersfield sits at the southern end of the San Joaquin Valley with easy access to some of California's most spectacular outdoor destinations. The nearby Kern River offers whitewater rafting and scenic hiking, while Lake Isabella is a favorite for boating, fishing, and camping. The southern Sierra Nevada mountains are just a short drive away, putting world-class skiing at Mammoth Mountain and the towering peaks of Sequoia National Park well within weekend reach.

With a lower cost of living than most California metros, Bakersfield gives residents the ability to stretch their dollar further while enjoying a warm climate, a growing restaurant and craft brewery scene, and a close-knit community that takes pride in its roots. The city is well-connected via Highway 99 and is within a two-hour drive of both Los Angeles and the Central Coast — making it an ideal home base for those who want California living without California prices.

job.title: Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, Nashville
job.description:
Scripps Sports is looking for a passionate, experienced sports sales professional to help drive revenue growth for the Nashville Predators TV Broadcasts on Scripps Sports, one of the NHL's most recognized franchises. As a Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, you'll leverage the power of live sports and the strength of the Predators-Scripps partnership to develop strategic sponsorships, build lasting client partnerships, and create innovative linear and digital advertising and marketing solutions for regional and national advertisers. If you're a proven seller who thrives on developing new business, exceeding revenue goals, and delivering winning solutions, this is an exciting opportunity to make an immediate impact with a growing sports media organization.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Prospect and develop relationships with regional and national accounts to generate new business opportunities.
  • Conduct needs analyses and create customized sports sponsorship and advertising solutions that align with client objectives.
  • Secure appointments, present recommendations, negotiate agreements, and close sales to achieve revenue goals.
  • Create and sell sponsorship packages utilizing acquired league and team-controlled sports inventory, with a primary focus on Nashville Predators partnership opportunities.
  • Leverage the strength and visibility of the Nashville Predators brand to develop creative, integrated marketing solutions that deliver measurable results for clients.
  • Collaborate with Scripps national and local Account Executives on strategic sports sponsorship opportunities.
  • Participate in internal planning meetings to establish sales strategies, revenue targets, and growth initiatives.
  • Build long-term client partnerships through exceptional service, retention efforts, and referral generation.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to new and existing clients while identifying opportunities to expand partnerships and drive incremental revenue.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, sponsorship pitches, and partnership recommendations to clients and stakeholders.
  • Manage all aspects of client service, including media negotiations, proposal development, campaign execution, collections, reporting, and account retention activities.
  • Entertain prospective and existing clients through sporting events and other business development opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate client activity, pipeline, forecasting, account information, and revenue projections within CRM systems.
  • Resolve makegoods and other sales-related issues while ensuring client satisfaction.
  • Communicate regularly with sales leadership regarding account status, revenue performance, and business opportunities.
  • Travel up to 25% as needed to support client meetings, sponsorship opportunities, sporting events, and business development activities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Sports Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in sports, media, sponsorship, advertising, partnership sales, or a related industry.
  • Proven track record of success achieving and exceeding revenue goals in a highly accountable sales environment.
  • Valid driver's license, satisfactory driving record, and proof of insurance meeting company requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Strong understanding of sports sponsorships, media sales, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Ability to identify client needs and develop strategic, customized partnership programs.
  • Exceptional prospecting, relationship-building, negotiating, and closing skills.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and uncover new revenue opportunities.
  • Experience using CRM platforms and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Knowledge of media sales platforms and advertising solutions.
  • Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to confidently present to executives and audiences of all sizes in both virtual and in-person settings.
  • Strong organizational and time management capabilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across teams and departments.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for sports, partnership development, and revenue generation.
  • Ability to effectively represent the Nashville Predators and Scripps Sports brands in the marketplace.

WHAT WE'LL OFFER

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission opportunity.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Retirement savings opportunities, including company matching.
  • Generous paid time off and holidays.
  • Employee wellness programs and resources.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • The opportunity to represent one of the most exciting brands in professional sports while helping clients connect with passionate fans.
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture where your contributions directly impact business growth and success.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY

At Scripps Sports, you'll join a team that is redefining local sports media and building powerful connections between fans, teams, and advertisers. Utilizing our Nashville Predators broadcasts, you'll help brands tap into the passion, reach, and engagement of live sports while creating partnerships that drive measurable business results. If you're energized by sports, motivated by sales success, and excited about representing a premier NHL franchise, you'll find an incredible opportunity to grow your career and make a lasting impact in Nashville, Tennessee, one of the country's most vibrant sports, entertainment, and business communities.

Who You Are

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems to help shape the foundations that power experiences across our global streaming portfolio.

This role is anchored in systems thinking and sits at the intersection of product design and engineering. You'll partner closely with Product Design, Product Management, Engineering, and Brand teams to turn product needs into reusable solutions, strengthen the connection between design and code, and make it easier for teams to build high-quality experiences at scale.

We’re looking for someone who sees patterns beyond individual screens, enjoys solving complex platform challenges, and believes a great design system should empower teams rather than constrain them.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and evolve our design system. Design scalable components, patterns, and foundations, using thoughtful component architecture, variables, modes, and tokens to support experiences across products and platforms.
  • Bridge design and engineering. Partner closely with engineers to translate designs into production-ready components, defining properties, states, behaviors, and specifications while strengthening design-to-development workflows.
  • Solve at the system level. Identify patterns across products, standardize where it creates value, reduce unnecessary complexity, and turn individual product needs into flexible solutions that can scale across experiences.

  • Design with accessibility at the foundation. Incorporate accessibility into components and patterns from the start, applying WCAG standards at the component level and supporting consistent experiences across platforms.
  • Improve how the system works. Explore tooling, automation, and emerging technologies that can improve system maintenance, documentation, QA, and design-to-code workflows.
  • Shape what’s next. Explore how tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows can improve how we build, maintain, document, and use the system.
  • Balance today's needs with long-term system health. Help prioritize system evolution based on product needs, adoption, and system health while balancing near-term delivery with the long-term sustainability of the system.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of product design experience, with at least 2+ years of direct experience building, scaling, or implementing design systems.
  • A portfolio demonstrating design systems work, including your approach to components, patterns, systems thinking, and implementation.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including component architecture, variants, auto layout, variables, modes, and library management.
  • Hands-on experience with design tokens, theming, and scalable component architecture.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering to translate design system decisions into production components.
  • Strong systems-thinking skills and the ability to identify patterns, understand tradeoffs, and translate complex product needs into scalable solutions.
  • Strong understanding of interaction design, visual design, and accessibility, including WCAG standards.
  • Experience designing systems that support multiple platforms, products, or devices.
  • Knowledge of and interest in AI-assisted design and development workflows.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions and tradeoffs across Product, Design, and Engineering.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and move complex initiatives forward across multiple teams.

#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We've got the brands, we've got the stars, we've got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet. Now all we're missing is
YOU. Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also
enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together we co-create moments that matter, both for our audiences and our employees, and aim to
leave a positive mark on culture.


Overview
Own the product direction for one of the largest sports sites on the internet. CBSSports.com is the front door to CBS Sports for tens of millions of fans. It is where scores, live gametrackers, news, fantasy, and betting come together during the biggest moments in sports: the NFL, March Madness, The Masters, college football, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full web experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you're in the details.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for CBSSports.com and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on. Own the web plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to
    continue, change, or stop.
  • Treat web as the reach and discovery engine for CBS Sports. Grow organic and direct traffic, sharpen high-intent surfaces like
    gametrackers and scores, and turn anonymous visitors into registered users.
  • Own the role web plays in the broader portfolio: growing registered users at scale and converting web audiences into sticky products
    like the CBS Sports App.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use
    tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held
    the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1 to 2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Partner with editorial to make web the place where great storytelling and great product meet.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.

 

How We Build (The Builder Culture)
We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put
it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions. AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make
ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll
model it and push what's possible further. The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission. 

 

What success looks like:

  • The web product strategy is coherent.
  • People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not
    to do. 
  • Web reliably grows reach, grows registered users, and feeds the rest of the portfolio.
  • The funnel from anonymous visitor to registered user to sticky-product user gets measurably stronger.
  • High-intent surfaces like gametrackers and scores get sharper and convert better, especially during tentpole events when traffic peaks. Ideas are tested before they're committed.
  • Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity.
  • Fewer false starts, less rework.
    PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.


Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer web at scale, ideally high-traffic and real-time. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.


Additional Qualifications

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold site-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Fluency with the levers that move large-scale web: discovery and SEO, performance, identity and authentication, and conversion.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view
    on how AI changes what a product team can do.


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage.

job.description:

LET’S GO!

 

Overview: 

The Senior Vice President, Finance Innovation is a newly created, high-visibility leadership role responsible for reimagining how the Finance organization operates through the application of artificial intelligence and agentic automation. This role will identify, champion, and implement AI-driven opportunities across the Finance function, with a particular focus on building agentic workflows and AI systems capable of autonomously executing multi-step financial processes with human oversight, across Accounting, Forecasting & FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and operational finance areas unique to a media and entertainment enterprise, including Production Finance and Participations & Residuals. This leader will serve as the bridge between Finance, Technology, and Data/AI teams, translating complex financial processes into scalable, intelligent automation while maintaining rigorous controls, auditability, and compliance standards appropriate for a large public company. The successful candidate will combine deep finance domain expertise with a strong point of view on emerging AI capabilities, and the organizational influence to drive adoption across a broad and often decentralized finance ecosystem. As Finance advances its Fusion systems integration, this leader will be a key voice in shaping how that effort intersects with Finance's broader innovation and automation agenda.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Define and lead the enterprise Finance Innovation strategy and multi-year roadmap for AI and agentic workflow adoption across all Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with the CFO organization and Finance leadership to identify, prioritize, and business-case AI opportunities based on value creation, risk profile, and feasibility. 
  • Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of use cases spanning close and consolidation, reconciliations, forecasting and variance analysis, cash and liquidity management, tax provision and compliance, and production finance/participations & residuals calculations and reporting.
  • Stay ahead of the external AI and finance-technology landscape (agentic frameworks, LLM-based finance copilots, RPA-to-agentic evolution) and translate relevant developments into actionable internal opportunities.
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Data & Analytics, and external delivery partners on agentic workflow and AI-tool initiatives as the Finance domain voice, defining use cases, finance requirements, and success criteria, and providing continuous feedback through design, build, and deployment. Product and Technology direct solution design, engineering, and production deployment; this role ensures what gets built reflects finance process reality and business need.
  • Own finance-side accountability across the delivery lifecycle: opportunity identification and prioritization, requirements definition, controls and change management within Finance, driving adoption, and validating realized value while Product and Technology own solution design, build, and rollout execution.
  • Specify the finance control requirements agentic systems must meet: human-in-the-loop oversight, exception handling, and escalation, and validate that the frameworks Product and Technology implement keep those systems within Finance's risk, controls, and SOX/regulatory boundaries. 
  • Convene Internal Audit, SOX, and Compliance to define the control and documentation standards AI-driven finance processes must satisfy, and carry those requirements into the Product and Technology build so solutions meet public-company standards.
  • Partner closely with the EVP of Integration on systems integration work related to Fusion, ensuring Finance requirements, controls, and adoption considerations are represented as Fusion capabilities are integrated into Finance systems and processes.
  • Accounting & Close: Identify opportunities for agentic automation in journal entries, reconciliations, close checklists, and financial reporting. 
  • Forecasting & FP&A: Champion AI-augmented forecasting, scenario modeling, and variance analysis to improve speed and accuracy of business planning.
  • Treasury: Explore agentic support for cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, bank reconciliations, and risk monitoring.
  • Tax: Identify AI applications in tax provision, compliance documentation, and regulatory research and monitoring. 
  • Production Finance: Drive automation of production cost tracking, budget-to-actual analysis, and studio/content cost reporting specific to media production.
  • Participations & Residuals: Champion agentic solutions for the complex, high-volume calculations, contract interpretation, and reporting inherent to participations and residuals processing. 
  • Serve as a visible champion and educator for AI adoption, building Finance-wide fluency and comfort with agentic tools through training, communication, and hands-on enablement.
  • Develop governance structures, including an AI use-case intake process and a Finance Innovation council or working group with representation across Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with HR and Finance leadership to evolve talent, role design, and ways of working as agentic workflows shift the nature of finance work.
  • Manage change resistance thoughtfully, ensuring adoption is durable and supported by the broader finance organization rather than imposed top-down. Stakeholder Management & Reporting
  • Regularly report progress, value delivered, and roadmap updates to executive leadership, including the CFO and relevant Audit/Risk committees as appropriate.
  • Build strong relationships with Technology, Data/AI, Legal, business-unit finance leaders, and the EVP of Integration to ensure alignment and shared ownership of innovation initiatives, including Fusion-related systems integration work. 
  • Represent the company's Finance Innovation agenda in relevant internal forums and, where appropriate, external industry settings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required; MBA, CPA, or equivalent advanced credential preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive finance, accounting, or FP&A experience, ideally within a large, complex, public media, entertainment, or content organization. 
  • Demonstrated track record leading finance transformation, process automation, or technology-enabled change initiatives at scale. 
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML concepts, generative AI, and agentic or RPA-based automation, and how they apply to financial processes; direct experience implementing such tools strongly preferred.
  • Experience with production finance and/or participations and residuals processes is a plus given the specialized nature of these areas in media and entertainment.
  • Prior exposure to SOX controls, internal audit requirements, and the governance considerations of deploying automation in a public-company financial environment. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong finance and accounting fundamentals combined with genuine curiosity about, and fluency in, emerging AI capabilities.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, and business units without direct authority over all of them.
  • Proven ability to translate technical AI/automation concepts into business terms finance professionals can act on, and vice versa.
  • Strong program and change management skills, with comfort operating in ambiguity and building new organizational muscle from scratch.
  • Sound judgment regarding risk, controls, and the appropriate pace and boundaries of automation in regulated financial processes.

job.title: Local Investigations Fellowship Expression of Interest
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times offers a menu of programs and opportunities aimed at up-and-coming journalists and professionals from all backgrounds and with various skill levels.

Learn more about career programs here.

The application window for the Local Investigations Fellowship is currently closed and will reopen in summer of 2027.

Cover Letters for the Local Investigations Fellowship include at least one story idea or pitch, but multiple may be sent in each cover letter. Answers to these questions help us assess where you are in the reporting process and what editorial support and resources the local investigative fellowship could offer you.

  1. What is your investigative story idea or area of focus? How would your story expose something new, something no one else has already revealed?
  2. Describe who has been harmed and in what way. Is the harm enough to spark outrage?
  3. Will your story hold someone accountable? Who and how?
  4. What critical records, data and human sources will be required to tell your story? Describe how you have, or could, obtain these critical sources.
  5. What do you need help with to report this story, and what are the barriers?
  6. Can you give us a sense of what has been written about the subject? Please include clips of notable reporting on the topic.

We appreciate proposals that are as detailed as possible. Previous successful applicants have included specifics about what they aimed to prove through their investigations. 

For example, a reporter for The Baltimore Banner had reason to believe that the city’s overdose crisis was the worst in the nation. Mississippi Today had evidence of abuses in local sheriffs offices. And a reporter for The Desert Sun in Palm Springs, Calif., suspected a pattern of deaths inside local jails. 

Please submit five published clips that show excellence — in evocative writing, through high-impact news stories and by highlighting the voices of local communities. Your clips should be uploaded to the additional materials question below. Please include the full text of your clips, not just the links.

What makes a good local investigation?

  • Starts with high stakes
    How does the story affect people’s lives and livelihoods? Their health, safety and basic quality of life?
  • Has a clear line of accountability
    Great investigations have a line of accountability to someone or some group with significant power.
  • Reveals something
    Does your investigation reveal something that someone or some institution is trying to keep secret?
  • Has a clear sense of place
    The most important element for any local investigation: How is it (e.g. the policy, the circumstance or the failure) unique to your community?

Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

job.title: Assistant Managing Editor, National
job.description:
ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest. 

Applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis. While the anticipated application deadline is December 31st at 11:59 PM ET, the role may close earlier if a candidate is hired. We encourage interested applicants to apply as soon as possible.

ProPublica is seeking an accomplished senior-level investigative editor to help oversee and elevate the accountability journalism produced by editors and reporters on our national staff and serve as part of ProPublica’s masthead leadership team.

The assistant managing editor, national, will supervise teams of editors and reporters and, depending on the candidate, may also directly supervise one or more investigative reporters. The ideal candidate enjoys the challenge of helping editors and reporters envision the most ambitious and creative paths for their projects; deeply understands and embraces ProPublica’s accountability mission; has a facility for high-level story honing and writing; and is dedicated to helping our editors grow and develop. We’re looking for an experienced editor with sound news judgment who is equally comfortable and adept weighing in on what’s working, or not, in a long-form narrative as in a complicated, multipart investigation.

This position involves juggling a variety of high-level projects, weighing in on story selection and direction, providing top-level guidance and editing, as well as working with staffers from other ProPublica teams, from data and research to video and audience. 

The assistant managing editor, national, will report to the managing editor of the national staff.

What you would be doing:

  • Supervising teams of national reporters and editors working on revelatory, important stories and projects.
  • Providing support and guidance to ensure projects are conceived of and told as ambitiously and creatively as possible.
  • Working with editors and reporters to select stories with the potential for impact, and helping them overcome reporting hurdles
  • Editing, including identifying and fixing structural issues and elevating writing when necessary.
  • Helping teams collaborate with researchers, data visualization reporters, engagement reporters, audience and visual staffers, and story producers.
  • Coaching editors to stretch and develop their skills and ambitions.
  • Serving as a champion for accountability journalism.

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • At least 10 years experience overseeing investigative and/or accountability reporting and has managed teams of reporters and editors.
  • A track record as an editor of landing revelatory stories about abuses of power.
  • A passion for and experience with accountability journalism.
  • The ability to juggle many different responsibilities, meet deadlines and handle pressure while remaining calm.
  • Exceptional organizational skills.
  • A collaborative mindset. As a leader, you should work seamlessly with staffers throughout the newsroom. 
  • The ability to adroitly handle fast-breaking stories, monthslong reporting projects and exquisitely written narratives.

This job is full time and includes benefits. 

We’re open to remote candidates based and authorized to work in the United States. Candidates in the New York City region will be expected to work in our office at least two days a week. We also have offices in Washington, D.C.; Atlanta; Chicago; Phoenix; and Berkeley, California. Though not currently in place, an in-person requirement could be introduced at these locations in the future. 

The expected salary range for this position is $200,000 to $250,000.

This is a good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this position. The final salary figure will take into account a person’s experience, accomplishment and location. ProPublica is committed to paying its staff equitably, and these ranges should not be considered career salary limits or caps.

What you should send us:

  • The most important part by far is your past work. We’d like to see examples of projects that show how you work as both a direct editor and as a top editor. Specifically: 
    • (1) Send us links to the investigative stories you directly edited that you are most proud of. These should be stories where you worked directly with a reporter to shape and guide the focus of an investigation. Don’t be shy — tell us what worked (numbers and evidence of impact welcome) and how you’d do it differently next time. Editing is about far more than moving around words. Show us how you think. 
    • (2) Send us a project or story in which you made a significant difference as a top editor. This should be where you honed the structure or narrative or where you identified missing elements necessary before publication. Let us know how your contributions elevated the work.
  • Your resume.                              

We will begin reviewing applications as we receive them, but we will continue to consider candidates as long as the posting remains live on our site.

Questions? Send an email to talent@propublica.org. 

No phone calls, please.

We know there are great candidates who may not fit into what we’ve described above or who have important skills we haven’t thought of. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself.

We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age or any other status protected under applicable law. We are dedicated to building an inclusive newsroom and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

Company Information

Job Summary

AEG is seeking a Lead DevSecOps Engineer to join its global Information Security organization. Reporting to the Vice President of Information Security, this role provides technical leadership for AEG's DevSecOps and Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) programs, driving the integration of security throughout the software development lifecycle. The Lead DevSecOps Engineer partners closely with Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, and GRC teams to establish secure development standards, strengthen application and cloud security, secure CI/CD pipelines, and advance security automation and continuous compliance capabilities. Serving as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, this role influences technology strategy, leads cross-functional security initiatives, and helps improve AEG's overall cybersecurity posture across its global technology environment. This position collaborates with teams across North America and Europe and may require flexibility to support initiatives across multiple time zones.

Essential Functions

  • Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) Enablement:
    • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the organization's Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) program, partnering with Information Security and Engineering leadership to establish enterprise-wide secure development standards and practices.
    • Drive the integration of security-by-design principles and automated security controls across the software development lifecycle, ensuring consistent adoption across development, platform, and DevOps teams in collaboration with other engineers; lead security discussions with Engineering, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to drive adoption of secure development practices.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Security:
    • Lead the architecture, strategy, and continuous maturation of enterprise CI/CD security capabilities, establishing secure-by-design standards for software delivery pipelines, deployment platforms, and development ecosystems.
    • Define and govern secure build processes, deployment workflows, container images, and third-party dependencies; drive and expand automation for security testing, validation, and policy enforcement; establish, integrate, and maintain security controls into build and deployment pipelines to support continuous compliance.
  • Security Tooling and Monitoring:
    • Lead the architecture, implementation, and governance of enterprise application security tooling establishing standards for SAST, DAST, and other application security tools.
    • Oversee the improvement of security visibility and monitoring across development environments; drive the configuration and maintenance alerts, notifications, and security monitoring capabilities.
  • Risk, Compliance, and Governance Support:
    • Lead enterprise application risk assessments and threat modeling exercises; establish and maintain the organization’s SDLC security requirements, procedures, and supporting documentation.
    • Document and monitor that compliance efforts align with ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and related frameworks.
  • Application Security and Vulnerability Management:
    • Perform secure code reviews and work with development teams to remediate vulnerabilities; manage vulnerability reporting, remediation tracking, and disclosure processes.
    • Lead remediation efforts across engineering and development teams.
  • Security Consulting and Cross-Functional Partnership:

    • Participate in control testing, validation, and compliance assessments.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience with OWASP Top 10, NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF), and related security frameworks.

The Manager, Network Infrastructure is responsible for deploying, supporting, securing and managing the lifecycle of AEG Global Technology's network infrastructure across US venues and enterprise environments. The role also provides on-site event support across multiple venues and requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and participate in an on-call rota.

job.title: Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media
job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

 

The Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media sits on the Data Analytics, Reporting & Strategy team and serves as the analytical partner and lead for the Paid Media team. Paid Media drives company-wide digital media strategy, campaign management, and consultative support across AEG divisions, including AEG Presents, Global Touring, Festivals, Goldenvoice, Bowery Presents, and Global Partnerships. Campaigns run across a broad mix of channels, including Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and other social, search, and programmatic platforms.

This role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and modeling campaign data from those ad platforms and joining it with other data sources to build a unified view of performance. The analyst will design scalable data models and automated reporting that measure campaign effectiveness and surface opportunities to optimize budget allocation, audience targeting, creative, and customer acquisition. The role also turns findings into clear, practical recommendations that drive ticket sales, event awareness, and brand initiatives.

The Senior Data Analyst will work closely with the Paid Media, Product, and Data Engineering teams on cross-functional projects covering paid media data ingestion, aggregation, mastering, measurement, and visualization. The position will lead the work to make sure tracking and tagging (pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs) capture accurate marketing data. It will also develop and maintain attribution models and set performance benchmarks for key metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate.

Essential Functions

 

  • Provide analytical support to Paid Media and Marketing teams, compiling performance marketing reports across digital channels using internal BI tools, Google Analytics, native advertising platforms. Communicate results to stakeholders, working with media and strategy teams to demonstrate clear actionable insights for media plans, budget forecasting, targeting/audiences, and creative.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive measurement plans to evaluate paid media performance, calculate benchmarks based on objectives, develop + maintain attribution models to identify trends, testing opportunities, and insights by channel, audience, festival/tour/regional show, and business unit.
  • Partner with Data, Product, Engineering teams to manage data pipelines + ingestion for channel metrics, define data collection requirements and enforce optimal taxonomy for reporting implementations, continual data hygiene + integrity across ad buying and internal platforms.
  • Collaborate with media, marketing, and data teams to inform audience and targeting strategies. Develop tests to evaluate new campaign strategies, ad products, optimization tactics, and targeting features.
  • Manage and lead paid media projects involving data aggregation and measurement tools such as Datorama, Google Analytics / GA4, Tag Manager, DOMO, BigQuery, LiveRamp, server-server integrations with media partners. Ensure appropriate site tracking is in place to capture relevant data points to measure marketing effectiveness.
  • Work closely with data team to develop and maintain reporting dashboards for internal and external use, while providing support for ad hot reporting requests.

 

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree (4-year) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Marketing, or a related quantitative field
  • 4–6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role, with exposure to paid media or digital marketing data on the client, publisher, or agency side; e-commerce experience preferred
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience pulling, transforming, and analyzing large, complex datasets
  • Strong ability to build data models, data flows, and ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and/or Python, bringing together data from multiple media channels into a scalable, automated insights reporting structure
  • Proficiency in BI and data visualization tools such as DOMO, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar, with strong dashboard design and data storytelling skills
  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (formerly Datorama) or similar marketing data integration platforms is a strong plus
  • Working knowledge of paid media data and performance metrics, including impressions, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS, across platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok
  • Familiarity with tracking infrastructure such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, Conversions API, UTMs, and server-side tracking
  • Experience applying statistical methods to performance benchmarking, attribution modeling, and media mix modeling (MMM)
  • Understanding of the ad tech and Martech landscape (programmatic buying, DSP/SSP, audience management, ad serving, social buying platforms), and of privacy regulations’ impact on measurement, including cookie-less tracking and multi-touch customer journeys
  • Ability to clearly communicate insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage multiple cross-functional projects at once

The Touring Project Manager supports advancing activities, event settlements, documentation management, and stakeholder communications to ensure tours are delivered efficiently and in accordance with company standards. Additionally, this role maintains strong relationships with venues, vendors, local partners, and internal departments while proactively identifying operational risks and escalating significant issues when necessary.

  • Strong understanding of live event operations, touring logistics, event production, and artist relations.

job.title: Promoted Ads || Business Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE? 

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com. 

 

WHO ARE YOU? 

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!   

 

THE JOB 

The Business Analyst will support data analysis and reporting for the Business Analytics team within Promoted Ads, Ticketmaster’s proprietary advertising platform. Reporting to the Director of Business Analytics, you will maintain accuracy and hygiene across core reporting datasets, collaborate with Business Development to grow the Promoted platform, and coordinate across divisions to build and maintain data pipelines. You’ll apply statistical fundamentals to ground your analysis, while keeping day-to-day work organized through JIRA/kanban and other team tools. This is a foundational role for someone early in their analytics career who is detail-oriented, curious about the “why” behind the numbers, and ready to grow into greater ownership over time. 

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO 

  • Maintain rigorous data hygiene across core performance reporting and financial accounting workflows, proactively flagging both anomalies and upside opportunities 
  • Write and troubleshoot SQL queries to pull, validate, and reconcile data across multiple sources 
  • Serve as point of contact for Business Development, client representatives, and other commercial leaders for ad hoc client analytics needs, insights into media performance, and intake for data investigations 
  • Translate data into clear commercial narratives, surfacing the “so what” behind trends for non-technical stakeholders 
  • Liaise between Promoted Business Analytics and counterpart analytics teams to ensure Promoted team’s data pipelines are being properly ingested and distributed to other divisions of the company 
  • Manage day-to-day tracking in Asana, JIRA, and other project management tools, keeping tickets, priorities, and status updates current for the team 
  • Document recurring processes and interdepartmental functions to help build out best practices for Business Analytics team 
  • Identify and deploy AI opportunities for Business Analytics team to expand scale and scope of operations 
  • Communicate findings clearly in writing and verbally, adjusting detail and framing based on the audience 

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING 

  • 3+ years of analytical experience, ideally in digital media or advertising 
  • Confident with statistical concepts and understanding of the economics of the digital media ecosystem 
  • Strong attention to detail: proven track record of delivering media and financial reporting with a high degree of accuracy and understanding of nuances of data sources 
  • Experience writing and troubleshooting SQL 
  • Iterating on analytic methodology and output with LLMs  
  • Demonstrated ownership of deliverables and communications to client-facing representatives 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to flex communication style across technical, cross-functional, and executive audiences 
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy in a fast-moving environment where scope may shift based on evolving business priorities 
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience 
  • Bonus: experience in ticketing, live events, or marketplace/advertising platforms 

 

BENEFITS & PERKS 

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits: 

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)  

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days 

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program 

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support 

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment  

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match  

 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY 

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.   

 
Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.   

  

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas. 

  

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process.  Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis. 

  

HIRING PRACTICES

job.title: Head of Inclusion Partnerships and Industry Engagement
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

ABOUT WPP

WPP is undergoing its most significant structural transformation in decades. Through Elevate28, we are moving from a holding company model to a single integrated operating company. The EVP WPP is building for the Elevate28 era is anchored on five dimensions – one of which is Inclusion & Belonging. This role ensures WPP shows up in the industry as one company and as a recognised leader in inclusive practice.

Within this transformation, WPP’s Inclusion & Impact (I&I) team is pioneering an innovative, enterprise-wide approach that moves decisively beyond traditional DEI. We treat inclusion as a strategic business enabler—designing and embedding scalable, measurable, and innovative practices directly into our business operations, creative work, client relationships, and workplace culture to shape meaningful behavioral change. This role ensures WPP show up across the creative, marketing, and media ecosystem as one unified company and recognized voice in inclusive practice.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Head of Inclusion Partnerships & Industry Engagement is an enterprise-wide strategic, advisory, and ambassadorial leader who defines where and how WPP shows up globally for inclusion and impact. This role consolidates historically fragmented decisions into a unified WPP strategy—curating where we invest our brand equity, which strategic partners we ally with, which major industry stages we command, and which recognition benchmarks we pursue.

This is a brand positioning, external engagement, and strategically influential role, centered in inclusion. Operating at the intersection of brand reputation, industry engagement, and modern inclusion, you bring deep agency ecosystem fluency and the presence to build immediate credibility with senior executives, brand marketers, and cultural changemakers. You will establish rigorous investment criteria, steward a dedicated global budget, and serve as an articulate champion for WPP—shaping industry behavior, reinforcing client trust, activating diverse talent pipelines, and earning industry recognition.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Strategic Inclusion Partnership & Investment Strategy (40%)
    Establish a criteria-led, enterprise approach to external alliances and partners.
  • Partnership Strategy: Set the global framework for identifying, assessing, and prioritising external inclusion partners, industry bodies, and community organizations – ensuring alignment to the Inclusion & Impact Strategy.
  • Sponsorship Governance: Build and lead an enterprise intake and evaluation model for global industry partnerships, transitioning legacy, ad-hoc agency investments into a cohesive, high-impact One WPP investment strategy.
  • Investment Allocations: Recommend annual allocations from the dedicated sponsorship budget based on strategic fit, audience, and expected impact. Spend tracking and vendor administration sit with P&C Operations and GBS.
  • Partnership Portfolio Leadership: Direct the overall partnership lifecycle – including renewals, tiering, strategic evolution – with guidance from the Inclusion Partnerships & Client Engagement Lead.

Key KPIs & Objectives:

  • Establish Partnership & Sponsorship Framework, with tiering, selection criteria, and an intake process for event and sponsorship requests.
  • Set an Annual Sponsorship Investment Plan recommended and approved within the allocated budget.
  • Consolidate Legacy agency-level commitments into high-yield, unified enterprise partnerships
  1. Industry Presence & Engagement (35%)
    Positioning WPP as a global growth partner centered on inclusion
  • Event Activation: Lead WPP’s inclusion presence at priority industry moments (e.g., Cannes Lions, Advertising Week, CES, Campaign, Adobe Summit), embedding I&I into mainstage programming, brand roundtables, and other engagements.
  • Frontline Ambassador: Serve as a representative, building relationships with partners, clients, and industry leaders across a range of settings and audiences.
  • Thought Leadership Curation: Translate progressive organizational practices into compelling public narratives; collaborate with Regional Inclusion Directors and MarComms to prepare, position, and amplify diverse executive voices, ERG leaders, and breakthrough creative talent on international stages.
  • Client Co-Creation & Alignment: Partner with client-facing agency leads and the Inclusion Partnerships & Client Engagement Lead to design joint, values-aligned thought leadership platforms and client-partner roundtables that deepen brand relationships.
  • Talent Pipeline Integration: Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure global sponsorships and partnerships alliances actively generate pathways for emerging, diverse creative and strategic talent.

Key KPIs & Objectives:

  • Launch comprehensive Global Industry Activation Plan, that includes details on key messaging and objectives
  • Co-create diverse WPP Thought Leadership & Speaker Bureau.
  • Curate relationships with partners and clients to support business growth and inclusion client opportunities for ongoing engagement.
  1. Industry Recognition, Influence & Impact Measurement (25%)
    Earning recognition for WPP’s inclusive practices through industry benchmarks and measurable business impact.
  • Global Recognition Strategy: Define and lead the enterprise awards and recognition roadmap, identifying high-credibility global, regional, and industry inclusive benchmarks.
  • Integrated Benchmarking Process: Run a shared awards process with Regional Inclusion Directors, GBS team, and the Global Head of Inclusion & Impact.
  • Reputational Narrative Engine: Supply partnership, sponsorship, and award proof points to Talent Acquisition and Marketing & Communications to strengthen WPP’s reputation as an inclusive leader.
  • Impact Reporting: In partnership with the Enterprise Director, Inclusion, Brand, and Client Impact, own the End-of-Year Partnership Impact & ROI Report, using partner and client data provided by the Inclusion Partnerships & Client Engagement Lead.

Key KPIs & Objectives:

  • Unified Global Awards Strategy and submission process in place with Regional Inclusion Directors and GBS.
  • End-of-Year Partnership Impact & ROI Report.
  • Effectively communicate reach, engagement, and talent outcomes linked to sponsorship and partnership investment.

EXPERIENCE & PROFILE

  • Enterprise Strategy Experience: Significant senior leadership experience in communications, marketing, external partnerships, and/or modern inclusion strategy within complex, matrixed global organization.
  • Modern Inclusion Mindset: Passionate about evolving inclusion beyond legacy, compliance-driven HR definitions into an innovative, scalable practice that drives competitive advantage, creativity, and systemic change.
  • Partnership & Sponsorship: Track record shaping partnership or sponsorship strategy and recommending where budget should go.
  • Advertising & Agency Fluency: Familiarity with major cultural and industry moments (e.g., Cannes Lions, Advertising Week, CES), client marketing expectations.
  • Confident Ambassador: Natural connector, with experience working across various organizational levels and functions.
  • Strategic & Structured: Brings clarity to competing requests, sets criteria, and makes clear recommendations to senior leaders.
  • Collaborative Leader: Demonstrates high emotional intelligence and an inclusive, collaborative leadership style; proven track record of mentoring and elevating direct reports while influencing cross-functional peers across multiple geographies.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 such markets measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group, with 46 markets, and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies and the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KTVF:

KTVF (NBC-affiliate and flagship station celebrating 70+ years of broadcasting), KXDF (CBS-affiliate), and KFXF (Gray Sports Network) are Interior Alaska's most viewed and respected commercial broadcast stations. Collectively, we serve our community with important news, information, and entertainment both on-air and digitally. This group of stations also places an important emphasis on community service with year round campaigns directly benefiting area non-profit organizations.
