Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who is naturally curious about the world around you? KTTC in Rochester, MN, is looking for a high-energy Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) who is ready to start their career by making a real impact. We’re not just looking for an employee; we’re looking for a storyteller who is eager to share facts, seek the truth, and own the news cycle across every screen—from the TV in the living room to the phone in the palm of a viewer's hand.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

What You'll Do:

• Own the news cycle: Gather, shoot, and edit high-impact content for multiple platforms, ensuring our audience stays informed.
• Pitch with purpose: Come ready to the editorial meeting with researched ideas pitched through Microsoft Teams. You’ll have already made the calls and prearranged interviews to hit the ground running.
• Master the multi-platform: Write and adapt stories for different screens—from the morning news to quick social updates and deep-dive web articles.
• Report live from the scene: Be the first on the ground when news breaks, delivering authoritative and calm live reports that keep our viewers connected.
• Verify and validate: Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and deep research—because accuracy is our foundation.
• Manage your time: Take charge of your daily workflow—from getting out the door for fresh video to editing your final masterpiece before the deadline hits.
• Stay agile: Update stories as they evolve and be ready to fill in on different shifts when the news demands it.

Why You'll Love It Here:

• A launchpad for your career: Join a young, energetic newsroom led by anchors with decades of experience who are eager to mentor the next generation of journalists.
• Growth every day: We believe feedback should happen in real time, not just during a yearly review. You’ll grow faster here than anywhere else.
• Innovation focus: KTTC is evolving on purpose—we’re serious about the future of media and want you to help shape it.
• Community impact: Tell stories that actually matter to the people of Rochester and the surrounding area.
• Supportive culture: We value scrappiness and digital innovation, but we also value our people. You’ll have the tools and the team to do your best work.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:

• The mindset: Above all else, a relentless desire to learn, seek the truth, and share stories that matter.
• Strong writing chops: You craft scripts and articles that are tight, clear, and compelling (AP style is your best friend).
• Technical potential: While we can teach you to shoot and edit video, a familiarity with camera equipment and systems like ENPS or Edius is a great head start.
• Self-motivated hustle: The ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment without breaking a sweat.
• Versatility: You can manage multiple projects at once and pivot quickly when breaking news hits.
• A valid driver’s license: You’re ready to hit the road and go where the story takes you.
• Human qualities: Empathy for the stories you tell, urgency in how you tell them, and the flexibility to roll with the punches of a dayside shift.

Ready to start your journey and own the news cycle in Rochester? Let’s create something amazing together.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans.   Overview and Responsibilities:   Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Broadcast Maintenance Technician to support engineering maintenance and technical operations for the CBS Network and affiliated production units. This role offers essential support around the clock for broadcast systems that are on-air and in production. It involves setting up, monitoring, and solving problems related to complex technical systems.   We use several systems. These include SDI and ST 2110 IP video routers. We also have channel playout systems, high-speed Ethernet fabrics (25–200GbE), and structured fiber optic cabling. In addition, we utilize media storage and transfer platforms, switchers, and both satellite and terrestrial contribution and distribution systems. Our on-air graphics and internet/cloud streaming encoding systems are included as well.     Basic Qualifications:  
  • 3+ years of engineering support and troubleshooting experience in broadcast environments, including one or more of the following:
  • On-air playout in broadcast and/or streaming environments
  • Live broadcast control room operations, preferably in sports or live entertainment
  • Transmission operations supporting real-time monitoring and distribution across multiple delivery paths
  • Expert-level knowledge of SMPTE ST 2110 IP video infrastructure, including uncompressed video (ST 2110-20), audio (ST 2110-30), and ancillary data (ST 2110-40) flows, with solid comprehension of PTP-based timing and synchronization
  • Proficiency with broadcast test and measurement equipment (waveform monitors, vectorscopes, rasterizers, signal analyzers) for validating video/audio integrity across SDI and IP signal paths
  • You need to know about broadcast network design principles for high-bandwidth, uncompressed video. This includes redundancy models such as dual fabric and hitless switching. It is also important to understand multicast design and how to manage essence flow bandwidth.
  Additional Qualifications:   IP & Broadcast Systems
  • End-to-end signal chain troubleshooting across IP, SDI, LTC, L-Band, and ASI signals, with a structured methodology for isolating issues across network, device, and workflow layers
  • Experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining Evertz IP-based systems, including ST 2110 routing, signal processing, control infrastructure, NMOS integration (e.g., Evertz Magnum), SDP generation/exchange, and control plane vs. data plane separation
  • Knowledge of broadcast engineering best practices related to signal redundancy, failover, and resiliency design
Playout & Monitoring
  • Experience supporting channel origination workflows with Grass Valley AMPP. This work involves playout service orchestration. It also includes graphics insertion, SCTE triggers, and content scheduling.
  • Experience supporting Imagine Communications SNP or equivalent IP gateway systems in live production or playout environments
  • Familiarity with TAG Video Systems multiviewers, including monitoring layout configuration, signal health validation, and alarm interpretation in IP video environments
  • Working knowledge of Telestream PRISM waveform monitors for real-time SDI and ST 2110 signal analysis, including video quality, color space accuracy, and HDR/SDR compliance
Color, HDR & Satellite
  • Knowledge of color space conversion and HDR/SDR compatibility is important. This involves working with LUTs and tone mapping. You should also be able to fix EOTF/gamma errors, address color space metadata mismatches, and ensure consistent HDR/SDR output across devices.
  • Proficiency configuring and troubleshooting IRDs, L-Band routers, and associated RF equipment; solid knowledge of end-to-end satellite downlink signal chains including RF, L-Band, ASI, and IP outputs
Cloud & General
  • Knowledge of cloud-based or hybrid broadcast workflows, including remote production or IP extension of linear streams into AWS or Oracle Cloud environments
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering teams to troubleshoot issues across routing control systems, multicast networking, and downstream playout or monitoring devices
  • Proficient written documentation skills. This includes operational procedures. It also includes troubleshooting guides and engineering run books.
  • You should communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should also be self-directed and able to work in environments where priorities change.

job.title: Morning Show Co-Host / Producer & Assistant Program Director
job.description:
Position Overview
96.3 KKLZ, Las Vegas' heritage Classic Hits station, is searching for an experienced, creative, and entertaining Morning Show Co-Host to join our established morning team.
We're looking for a dynamic personality with a quick wit, strong conversational instincts, and the ability to connect with listeners through humor, storytelling, and relatable content.
This is a hands-on position requiring a versatile broadcaster who can entertain, create, produce, and execute. The successful candidate will serve as a primary on-air personality while also operating the broadcast console and sharing responsibility for daily show preparation and production.

The ideal candidate brings strong ideas, exceptional chemistry, and a collaborative spirit. We want someone who can lead a conversation, share the spotlight, and help create memorable radio every morning.

In addition to morning show duties, this role will provide hands-on daily support to the Programming Department, assisting with music scheduling, log management, and station imaging maintenance. 

Key Responsibilities
On-Air Performance & Content Development
  • Serve as a primary morning show personality, sharing responsibility for the show's entertainment, content, and overall success.
  • Develop and deliver compelling, original content, including topical discussions, humor, storytelling, interviews, and recurring features.
  • Research and prepare relevant daily topics that resonate with the station's adult audience.
  • Demonstrate strong conversational chemistry, improvisational skills, comedic timing, and the ability to engage listeners.
  • Collaborate with fellow hosts to plan show content, develop creative ideas, and maintain a consistent, entertaining presentation.
Broadcast Operations & Production
  • Operate the broadcast console and automation system during live programming.
  • Execute music, commercials, audio elements, contests, and scheduled programming with accuracy and precision.
  • Maintain proper show pacing, timing, and seamless transitions.
  • Share responsibility for producing, editing, and preparing audio elements, including interviews, comedy bits, recurring features, and other show content.
  • Assist with daily show preparation, organization, and execution without reliance on a dedicated producer.
  • Troubleshoot routine technical issues and coordinate with engineering or programming staff as needed.
Programming & Music Support 
  • Assist the Program Director with daily programming operations, including music scheduling, log editing, and log reconciliation.
  • Coordinate and maintain station imaging, liners, promos, and syndicated programming elements.
  • Monitor on-air execution to ensure format clocks, commercial breaks, and programming standards are met consistently. 
Station & Audience Engagement
  • Participate in station promotions, live appearances, community events, and special programming.
  • Engage listeners through phone calls, contests, social media, and other interactive platforms.
  • Contribute to the station's digital presence through engaging and brand-appropriate content.
  • Collaborate with programming, promotions, and sales teams to support station initiatives.
  • Represent KKLZ and Beasley Media Group professionally on and off the air.

Required Qualifications
  • Professional on-air radio experience, preferably in a live, multi-host morning show environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and deliver compelling, personality-driven radio content.
  • Experience operating a broadcast console and radio automation systems.
  • Proficiency with digital audio editing and production software.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, improvisational, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, self-motivation, and the ability to independently prepare content.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously during a live broadcast.
  • Strong understanding of radio formatics, show pacing, and audience engagement.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively, accept direction, and contribute to a positive team environment.
  • Willingness to work early morning hours and participate in occasional station events outside regular broadcast hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Proven success as a primary morning show personality.
  • Experience developing and producing original comedy bits, recurring features, and entertaining audio content.
  • Familiarity with Classic Hits or other mainstream, adult-targeted radio formats.
  • Experience with social media, video production, and digital audience engagement.
  • Knowledge of the Las Vegas market and local community.
  • Hands-on experience with music scheduling software (such as MusicMaster, Selector, or Powergold) and daily broadcast log management. 

The Ideal Candidate
We're looking for a well-rounded broadcaster who loves creating great radio.
Someone who can generate compelling ideas, deliver a great punchline, tell a memorable story, and make their co-host shine. Someone who understands how to balance spontaneity with preparation and entertainment with the demands of a music-intensive format.
You should be equally comfortable behind the microphone, behind the board, and behind the scenes preparing the content that makes a morning show successful.
Most importantly, we're looking for someone who understands that the best morning shows are built on chemistry, creativity, collaboration, and a genuine connection with the audience.

About 96.3 KKLZ
96.3 KKLZ is a heritage Las Vegas radio station delivering Classic Hits, engaging personalities, and strong community connections. As part of Beasley Media Group, KKLZ is committed to creating compelling local radio that entertains and connects with listeners.
Location: Las Vegas, Nevada
Position: Full-Time Morning Show Co-Host / Board Operator
Schedule: Weekday mornings, with additional station appearances as needed

About Us

As an ABC6 News (KAAL-TV) employee, you are surrounded by opportunity while experiencing a forward-thinking philosophy. You will work among passionate, engaged professionals who work together to create content on Television and Digital platforms for our audience. Whether you are searching for a career On-Air, Behind-the-Scenes, or Marketing & Promotion, there is an opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive within ABC6 News and Hubbard Broadcasting.

Job Overview

The Newscast Producer plans, writes, and executes live television newscasts, including the 11 a.m. newscast, and creates and posts stories for digital platforms. This role requires strong editorial judgment, excellent writing skills, and the ability to work effectively under tight deadlines and during breaking news. This position works Monday through Friday, 5 a.m. to 2 p.m.

Job Responsibilities

Collaborate with the Executive Producer to plan and produce daily newscasts in accordance with newsroom standards, determining story selection, format, length, and rundown order.

Write, edit, and update scripts as needed, including contingency planning for developing stories.

Ensure all newscast elements are complete and accurate prior to airtime, including scripts, graphics, video, timing, and rundowns; maintain accurate information in newsroom systems.

Communicate breaking news, live shots, and special situations promptly to appropriate staff.

Produce digital content by writing and posting stories for the website and social media platforms; shoot and edit video as needed.

Work collaboratively with reporters, anchors, photographers, assignment desk staff, and production teams to coordinate coverage and communicate updates throughout the shift.

Manage live newscast execution from the control room, clearly communicating real-time changes to production staff and on-air talent.

Respond effectively to breaking news and unexpected changes, ensuring stories are clear, accurate, engaging, and visually supported.

Complete post-newscast administrative tasks, including technical reports and archiving.

Participate in editorial and planning meetings, contributing daily story ideas and maintaining awareness of local, national, and global news.

Maintain a regular schedule and provide coverage in other newsroom roles as needed. This includes holidays and weekends.

Qualifications

Prior experience producing a local television newscast preferred.

Excellent organization and writing skills including grammar and spelling.

Four-year Bachelor of Arts degree in journalism or communications or equivalent experience.

Ability to work well under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

Must be able and willing to work all newsroom shifts including overnights, weekends, evenings, early mornings and days.

Must have a valid driver's license and safe driving history as determined by the Company. Driving record will be checked.

job.title: Traffic Manager (Full-Time) – Portland Media Group
job.description:
Portland Media Group · South Portland, Maine · On-site

Ever wonder how the right ad hits the airwaves at exactly the right moment?

That’s the job. As our Traffic Manager, you’re the person behind the scenes keeping ads running on time across 8 radio stations and our digital platforms. When the schedule runs smoothly, it’s because of you.

Who we are

Portland Media Group is a local media company focused on clicks, visits, calls and searches. We help businesses get wanted, found and chosen by more customers using radio, search and targeted display. We’re a tight-knit team that works together, gets better every day and we actually like what we do!

What you’ll do day to day

  • Run the schedule. Place commercials across 8 radio stations and other platforms.
  • Work with the team. Partner with sales, production and programming to get ad materials in on time.
  • Manage inventory. Figure out where ads land so they get the best results while maximizing inventory.
  • Fix problems fast. When an issue becomes known, reach out to appropriate person and resolve quickly.
  • If you see something say something, if you need something make the request.

You’ll do well here if you…

  • Like having a system and love crossing things off a list
  • Catch the small details other people miss
  • Can handle a few things at once without dropping any of them
  • Communicate clearly and like working with a team
  • Pick up new software quickly

Bonus points (not required)

  • Experience in traffic, scheduling, media, or something close to it
  • Experience with Marketron or other traffic software

Don’t check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about how you work and how fast you learn than about a perfect résumé.

What’s in it for you

  • Competitive pay: $38,500 – $42,450 salary range
  • Benefits: health, dental, 401K, PTO
  • Room to grow: cross training and promoting from within
  • A team that has your back: supportive, inclusive, and not ego driven

Ready to apply?

Send your résumé and a few lines about why this role caught your eye to talent@portlandmediagrp.com. You don’t need a formal cover letter.

Portland Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

They are also responsible for evaluating and then assigning all video inputs, taking into consideration timing and video levels, all while orchestrating the control room setup. Finally, the Technical Director will operate as the “right hand” of the Line Producer to develop and execute the creative and technical “look” of the production by creating special effects via the production switcher and various external effects equipment.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

* Operate the Video Switcher for live and pre-taped programming
* Where needed, act as Director for certain shows
* Communicate with producers, studio, and control room crew to execute live and pre-taped programming
* Lead the control room and studio crew to produce regular, special, and live show programming
* Work in conjunction with the feeds team for remote guests and live hits
* Perform other duties as assigned
* Work with remote crews on location, reporters in the field, and remote hosts throughout the day
* Communicate with talent in the studio when necessary
* Highly motivated and confident in executing difficult and complex tasks
* Ability to consistently function in a high-pressure role and environment
* Ability to quickly react to changing priorities and needs
* Must be able to troubleshoot difficult problems and develop solutions to address root causes.

Qualifications/Requirements:

* Minimum of 2 years of broadcast experience operating as a Technical Director, live remote and/or live studio productions, with hands-on experience in control room areas such as switching, audio, graphics, character generator, robotics, and automated rundown software
* Knowledge of current industry standards
* Knowledge of video signal flow and video router operations
* Knowledge of IP router operations and the software used to edit panels
* Must be able to technically operate various models of video switchers, digital effects devices, and other associated ancillary equipment
* Experience using ENPS or similar news production systems
* Experience using Ross Overdrive automation
* Knowledge of current broadcast technologies appropriate to the position's job responsibilities
* Knowledge of FCC regulations
* Must take ownership and accountability for assigned projects
* Experience using Edius; Adobe Creative Suite editing software preferred
* Computer skills, using MS Office
* Able to work flexible, non-traditional hours, including weekends and holidays

job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

The Packaging Operator position reports through the Lawrence Production Center and may be in the Quality, Folding, Page Insert, Specialty Packaging and/or Counter Packaging departments.  Individuals in these departments operate various machines to package greeting card products and perform the quality inspector role.

      

This position is a Full time position Sunday - Friday, 11:30pm - 7:30am. First shift will be Sunday night and last shift of the week is Thursday night into Friday morning.

 

The Packaging Operator in Lawrence sets up and operates automatic production machines that involve standard or high speeds to produce/package specialty or greeting card products.  Operations may include such activities as winding or spooling, wrapping or banding, folding, packaging product, labeling, and other final production processes. Makes judgment calls in the make-ready and production and/or packaging stages in order to insure quality production. Monitors, troubleshoots and corrects machine malfunctions. Completes required paperwork and/or computer input on specific SAP screens to confirm production and spoilage/scrap. Adheres to quality standards and procedures and initiates adjustments as needed to correct product and/or packaging defects. Prepares and maintains necessary paperwork. May perform quality inspections on in-process and finished goods in accordance with the Quality Department procedures. Assesses cause of defects, charging responsible operations. Records and inputs pertinent data.      

 

Maintains a neat and safe working environment. Actively engages and asks probing questions regarding press issues or performance.  Performs required preventive maintenance.  Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities. Identifies potential problems and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation. Demonstrates leadership amongst the team. Flexibility is key as the incumbent will operate multiple machines and perform the quality inspector role, as needed. Incumbent possesses moderate mechanical abilities, but training is obtained on the job. 

 

The Packaging Operator position may be in the Quality, Folding, Page Insert, Specialty and/or Counter Packaging departments, and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.   

 

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready procedures and other press adjustments on a variety of equipment with similar skill set.  Prepare the press to run and maintain or exceed the specified quality and production expectations. Troubleshoot from a variety of maintenance issues which may deal with robots, feeders, batches, bow machines, etc.  
  • Set up and operate a variety of automated production and/or packaging type machines, along with continually improving the specified production including throughput, OEE, etc.  May work with the computer systems to track components, order materials, etc. 
  • Execute Quality System including preflight, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage. Develop an understanding of a wide range of quality systems and product specifications. Help prepare related paperwork/documentation for shipping accuracy, including completing production data and spoilage. 
  • Determine sample size and perform audit inspections on in-process and finished goods in accordance with the Quality Department standard operating procedures. Record all required production and defect information on inspection sheets and in SAP.

  • Utilize good safety practices; understand and follow established safety procedures. Complete regular press maintenance and cleaning including TPM's/MIRC's (monthly inspection, repair & cleaning). Demonstrate mechanical ability by problem solving technical issues on the equipment.

job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

JOB OVERVIEW

You’ll be at the heart of our production center, helping millions of customers across the world enjoy Hallmark products. You will have a variety of duties that support the production process in numerous ways. You’ll be cross-trained across multiple departments by a support team of trainers and supervisors to help you learn every step of the way!


SALARY AND SHIFT DETAILS

  • This position is a full-time, 5-day work week position in the 1st shift from 7:30am to 3:30pm, Monday through Friday.
    Don’t see a shift that works for you? We still encourage you to apply! We’ll work with you to find a shift that fits your lifestyle and gives you the flexibility you need.

The Production Support Specialist in Lawrence has a variety of duties that support production in numerous ways.  Prepares greeting card stock for the Cutter to cut.  Jogs, skids and moves stock to the cutter.  Carries stock to skids and moves finished skids into the outgoing area.  Responsible for complete make-ready, run, monitoring and maintenance.  Removes die cut cards from full sheets either using a hammer or by using an Automatic Card Extractor (ACE).  Performs make-readies on the ACE and prepares rails/bars and press set-up.  Responsible for quality sampling and stacking cards onto skids according to register, blockouts, salvage and spoilage.  Determines when adhesive will be mixed and when test will be performed on the mixture.  Responsible for ensuring that the ingredients are in the area for mixing the adhesive.  Assists the Webtron press operator with press set up and changeover, make-readies, machine adjustments and routine preventative maintenance procedures.  Responsible for supporting the production areas by ordering the correct stock, moving components in and out of the areas, inputting information on the computer system, and maintaining a clean, safe, work environment. 

Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.  Sets up and operates a Gem/Cello machine, wholesale sealer, accumulator and shrink tunnel which shrinks poly film around wholesale unit of specialty items and/or operates a lift truck and keeps track of stock in the OAI.  Performs all paperwork assigned involved in moving stock, either into or out of the department.  Packs finished goods on a packaging line.  Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to move to different work assignments as needed.

Important things to know:

  • Position may be in several departments and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

  • In the production areas there is some noise. Hearing protection is provided by Hallmark.
  • Overtime is available and will be covered during the interview process.
  • The reporting area may change as business needs change.

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready duties on the Gem/Cello machines, ACE press and Webtron presses.  Set up wholesale sealer and pack product into shipping containers.  Mix adhesives and assure the proper ingredients and quantities are available in the area. 
  • Execute Quality System including preflight, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage.  Perform quality and/or adhesive test and report results in a timely manner.  Plan and maintain the workflow through the department in accordance with work schedule.  Order and deliver stock, cartons, and other components needed for production to the work area. 
  • Achieve and continually improve specified production including production goals, throughput, etc. during training.  Participate in performance dialogues and team problem-solving activities.  .
  • Complete regular press maintenance and cleaning, including TPM’s.  Move skids of stock into and away from the press, including completion of related paperwork.  Transport and handle hazardous waste material in accordance with all Federal, State, and Local regulations.  Be certified to operate power lift equipment and skid inverting machine. 
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished within shorter periods of time.  Effectively communicate information to the next shift to ensure consistency and continuous operation. 
  • Utilize good safety practices.

 

YOUR AREAS OF KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERTISE

Basic Qualifications

  • You’re at least 18 years of age
  • You have the ability to grip and push/pull lifts of stock 2”-3.5” thick, 80-120 times per hour
  • You have the ability to lift 20-30 lb stacks of stock, 60-80 times per hour, with frequent lifting throughout the shift of 40-60 lbs.
  • You have the ability to constantly stand, walk, twist, bend, and reach above shoulder level
  • You have the ability to constantly use repetitive hand/wrist motion and perform fine motor skills
  • You have the ability to operate a computer independently

Preferred Qualifications

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Strong communication- and problem-solving skills

We want to help you be your best – at work and at home, now and in the future. It’s why providing benefits to support you and your family’s well-being is one of the most important investments Hallmark makes.

  • Your Health: Medical, vision, and dental plans; Specialized plan option for people with type 2 diabetes; Short-term and long-term disability coverage; Life and accident insurance
  • Your Well-Being: On-site registered nurses who provide health consultations and optional seasonal vaccinations. Health rewards program (earn up to $400 per year).
  • Your finances: A 401(k) with a 4% company match vested from day one. Health savings (HSA) or Flexible spending (FSA) accounts.
  • Your life: During your first year, you’ll receive 18 days (144 hours) of PTO and 10 paid holidays. Paid parental leave, adoption assistance, and comprehensive fertility benefits for eligible employees.
  • Your work environment: Climate-controlled and safety-first environment; On-site café that offers hot and cold meals; On-site Hallmark store where you can shop Hallmark products for 50%-75% off; Inclusive environment and a relaxed dress code, with a few safety rules to follow (close-toed shoes are required). Whether you have purple hair or express yourself through body art, we want you to bring your whole self to work.

Operations Support:

  • Creating templated agreements and routing contracts through Docusign and other systems
  • Processing staffing and credential needs for events and meetings

job.title: Associate Counsel
job.description:
The Associate Counsel will report to the Senior Vice President, Labor Relations and be responsible for development, negotiation and administration of the NFL-NFLPA Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), including representing the league and clubs in litigation under the CBA.  The holder of this position will represent the league in grievance hearings and arbitrations brought by or against the NFL and supervise outside counsel in the litigation of such matters.  This critical role will require strong investigative and advocacy skills, and the ability to spot and solve issues related to league policies. 

Responsibilities

  • Acquire and demonstrate substantive mastery of the CBA and league policies regulating the conduct of clubs and players.   
  • Litigate grievances on behalf of the league and member clubs under the collective bargaining agreement with the NFL Players Association.  
  • Provide counsel to the league and clubs regarding rights and obligations under the CBA, the Salary Cap system, Player Personnel rules, and other collectively bargained league rules. 
  • Assist in the investigation and enforcement of potential violations of the CBA and related policies regulating player and club conduct.  
  • Draft and review policy directives for NFL players and Clubs. 
  • Interact with outside law firms, consultants and others involved in the administration of the CBA, policies and/or litigation. 
  • Assist in negotiations with the NFL Players Association. 
  • Prepare legal memoranda for clubs regarding policy obligations. 
  • Independently develop and maintain working relationships with club counsel and NFLPA representatives. 

Required Qualifications

  • Law Degree (J.D.); 4 to 6+ years of litigation experience at a top law firm or federal government agency.   
  • Experience conducting and maintaining a docket of litigation matters and internal investigations.   
  • Experience appearing in court or similar settings, interviewing senior executives and drafting investigatory findings.   
  • Experience deposing and cross-examining witnesses.    
  • Experience making presentations to large groups of senior executives. 
  • Familiarity with NFL and other sports’ labor relations.

job.title: Associate, Real-Time Systems (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The Associate, Real-Time Systems supports the design, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting of Real-Time Systems that power NFL Media digital graphics experiences, including FAST channels, NFL+, RedZone, and other digital productions. This role serves as a technical resource for Viz graphics workflows, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, data integrations, and real-time content delivery while helping ensure reliable operation of critical production systems.

Responsibilities

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Viz graphics systems, render engines, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, and supporting software environments to ensure reliable delivery of graphics across FAST, digital, and RedZone platforms.
  • Support end-to-end graphics workflows including data-driven Viz graphics, scorebars, ticker content, promotional elements, sponsorship integrations, countdown clocks, and lower-third graphic packages to ensure accurate on-air and digital presentation.
  • Maintain RTS applications, databases, APIs, and automated page generation tools while validating data flow between internal services, graphics systems, and production environments.
  • Serve as a frontline technical resource during live productions by diagnosing and resolving graphics, connectivity, software, and data issues to minimize operational disruptions.
  • Partner with production, engineering, and operations teams to support FAST channel graphics, RedZone L-Bar workflows, ticker content management, and digital platform graphics delivery.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, diagrams, workflow guides, system inventories, and operational procedures while identifying opportunities for process improvements and automation.
  • Assist with preparation, testing, deployment, and operational support for major league events including the NFL Draft, NFL Combine, International Games, Kickoff, Playoffs, and Super Bowl coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Digital Media, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting broadcast graphics, digital media operations, production technology, or real-time systems.
  • Experience supporting Vizrt, graphics rendering systems, or similar real-time graphics platforms.
  • Working knowledge of networking, Windows administration, system configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with data-driven graphics, APIs, databases, and content automation workflows.
  • Experience supporting live production, digital streaming, or broadcast operations.
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting FAST channels, OTT streaming platforms, or sports media operations.
  • Experience with Viz Trio, Viz Engine, ticker systems, or graphics automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with SQL databases and scripting/automation tools.
  • Experience supporting major live sporting events.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure during live productions.
  • Strong customer service mindset and production support orientation.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in control rooms, machine rooms, and production environments.
  • Occasional lifting and movement of production or IT equipment up to 40 pounds.

Travel

  • No travel typically required.

 Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Flexible schedule required.
  • Evening, overnight, weekend, and holiday work may be required during live productions and major events.
  • Overtime may be required based on production schedules.

job.title: Associate, Transmission (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL Media group is looking for a TOC Operator who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and demonstrates strong technical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills while supporting live broadcast and transmission operations. The TOC Operator performs a broad range of technical and operational duties, including monitoring systems, coordinating broadcast workflows, and ensuring all technical facility requests are resolved in a timely and effective manner. The ideal candidate has extensive knowledge in operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes and familiarity with other broadcast transmission systems. This role requires a strong understanding of analog, digital, and SMPTE 2110 signal flows, as well as the ability to troubleshoot technical issues in a fast-paced broadcast environment. As the first point of escalation for broadcast and transmission issues, the TOC Operator is responsible for communicating with Operations and Production Management in a timely and effective manner.  

This long term, benefitted contingent role compensates at $35 to $54 per hour.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the NFL Media Production team, Streaming Video Group, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications. 
  • Partner with the Remote Operations team to support the transmission and receipts of feeds for live remote productions, including NFL Network games, the Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and other NFL Network remote projects.  
  • Collaborate with the Streaming Video Group (SVG) to ensure content is captioned across NFL.com, NFL Fast Channel, NFL+ streaming platforms.  
  • Partner closely with the Engineering team to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with a feed or broadcast.  
  • Communicate with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity. 
  • Perform test bar setups as needed 
  • Conduct extensive transmission, sync, and fax checks prior to live shows and remote events.  
  • Manage booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen, AT&T Fiber, and Satellite orders. 
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required. 

 Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a broadcast operations environment, including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals, with the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths. 
  • Strong understanding of analog, digital, and SMPTE 2110 signal flows. 
  • Ability to read audio meters, digital and analog waveform monitors, and set up test bars. 
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them (ex. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, and video issues).  
  • Ability to perform sync and fax checks prior to live broadcasts and events.  
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.  
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple feeds to ensure high broadcast quality.  
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to document on-air issues and have maintain excellent telephone etiquette.  
  • Must be willing to work flexible schedules, including nights, weekends and holidays.  

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Possess a strong work ethic, positive attitude and leadership qualities.   
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. 
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills 
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities at the same time.  
  • Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills.  

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Minimum 40 hours/week or less as business needs permit 
  • This is an in-office position.  
  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule including nights, weekends and holidays.

job.title: Manager, Sponsorship New Business
job.description:
The Manager, Sponsorship New Business, is a key member of the Business Development team responsible for generating revenue by developing and selling integrated marketing partnerships for the NFL globally.

This position will work collaboratively across the NFL to identify partnerships that support key initiatives such as NFL FLAG, International growth, audience growth across youth, multicultural and women, and game innovation.

Given the new business focus of this position, we are seeking candidates with a demonstrated track record of independently sourcing, negotiating, and closing sponsorship or partnership deals, and who can quickly contribute to revenue growth.

Responsibilities: 

  • Responsible for developing a global pipeline and executing partnerships with blue-chip brands to reach Sponsorship revenue goals 
  • Cultivate global and local market category prospects through category analysis and market research, with a focus on international markets without a dedicated new business resource  
  • Establish and build relationships with key external contacts (e.g., corporate decision makers at Fortune 500 companies and influencers in the sports marketing and agency world) 
  • Pursue prospects through contact strategy, development, and delivery of sales presentations, negotiation, and contract execution 
  • Actively contribute innovative thinking and fresh ideas that help lead to new revenue-generating sponsorship opportunities and contribute to cross-functional working groups consisting of key internal stakeholders (e.g., Media, IT, Football Operations, Social Responsibility, etc.) to develop customized marketing platforms that align with prospective partner objectives 
  • Develop and write strategic, customized presentations and partnership proposals for prospects 
  • Effectively maintain sales pipeline and reporting documents, as well as other duties as directed 
  • Help manage Sponsorship Business Development Senior Coordinator contributions to the team in partnership with the Senior Director 

Required Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor's Degree 
  • 5+ years of direct sponsorship sales experience at league, team, agency and/or company 
  • Hands-on experience leading the full new-business sales cycle, from prospecting through deal execution, required

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Excellent written and verbal communicator; ability to build trusted relationships and influence across all levels both internally and externally 
  • Proficient with MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint

job.description:

This role combines concept development, design execution, and animation, requiring creativity, technical expertise, and a strong attention to detail.

Working closely with Art Directors and Creative Producers, the Designer/Animator will develop original concepts, iterate on creative solutions, and deliver polished motion graphics that meet the highest production standards.

  • Conceptualize, design, and animate high-production-value graphics for a variety of NFL Media projects.
  • Create original visual concepts and translate them into compelling motion design solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with Art Directors to ensure creative alignment and execution excellence.
  • Develop scalable, repeatable animation systems and templates that can be shared across internal teams, editors, and external vendors.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe After Effects (including Scripting and Mogrts), Photoshop, and Illustrator.

  • Knowledge of Cinema 4D (C4D)
  • Ability to develop custom designs and animations from original concepts, style guides, existing graphic packages, and creative references.
  • Strong understanding of motion design principles, visual storytelling, and production workflows.
  • Ability to follow established file naming conventions, organizational standards, and production processes.

job.description:

The right candidate has a passion for football, social media and storytelling, and has a drive to create new and innovative original content. As a part of the most creative and experimental group of the NFL, this role is for someone who is comfortable with change and able to balance a heavy workload. Success in this position is reliant on being a self-starter with a willingness to learn and grow alongside the brand. The successful candidate is a creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, with a deep understanding of, and experience with, social design.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and animate various graphics and other creative needs for the NFL's official social platforms and other NFL-affiliated social platforms, teams, and players.
  • Work with large creative team made up of designers, illustrators, editors, and copywriters to conceive and executive multiple daily projects.
  • Pitch and conceptualize original content ideas and franchises for NFL social media platforms.
  • Manage the story telling behind each creative output to ensure it is clear, concise, snackable and true to the content
  • Identify important storylines from around the NFL and know how to best tell them to our audience

Required Qualifications:

  • At least 2-5+ years of relevant experience in graphic design and animation
  • Must have prior experience building and animating assets on social and/or digital platforms
  • Must have a Design portfolio containing various examples of relevant work
  • Strong ability with Photoshop, After Effects, and Illustrator are must-have’s.
  • Video Editing experience is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Must be willing to work early mornings, nights, and weekends due to the nature of the NFL schedule
  • Bachelor's degree preferred
  • Knowledge of football and the NFL audience is a major plus
  • Must be adaptable and able to work quickly under short deadlines
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to take creative direction and incorporate feedback into revised work
  • Must be able to handle concept changes and accept creative feedback

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, including nights and weekends
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organization skills

N/A

N/A

Nights and Weekends, especially during the NFL season.

Opportunities for overtime.

job.title: Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator
job.description:
The National Football League Digital Media Group is looking for a Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator that is highly motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment. The role will require an individual with a flexible schedule that is punctual and dependable. He or she will be expected to operate, monitor, and configure software relative to digital video distribution for the NFL’s FAST Channel. This position is based in Inglewood, CA and does not offer relocation or remote work.

Responsibilities

  • Support live streaming of games, weekly shows, and tent-pole events.
  • Document, escalate, and manage video distribution incidents to resolution.
  • Create and update operational runbooks for live on air workflows.
  • Maintain documentation of video acquisition scheduling and live event programing.
  • Setup and operate digital video environment in Digital Master Control (DMC).
  • Provide live event support during all live operation workflows including holidays, nights, early operation windows and/or weekends.
  • Perform quality control tasks for video streaming distribution.
  • Perform digital ad insertion operations on FAST live games.
  • Setup and maintain electronic programming guide (EPG) metadata for live game broadcasts.
  • Manage video routes for international game channels.
  • Collaborate with department initiatives to automate SCTE-35 insertion for DAI.

Required Qualifications

  • BS degree and/or equivalent experience.
  • Direct sports broadcast production and/or production operations experience (TV studio/truck experience, stadium broadcast operations) preferred
  • Experience monitoring and responding to live streaming service health metrics, alarms, and operational incidents in a 24/7 broadcast, streaming, or FAST channel environment.
  • Knowledge of digital protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HLS, SRT, RTMP, SSH.
  • Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions precisely with minimal supervision.
  • Execute SCTE-35 cue insertion for live and recorded programming, following AD commands and established operational procedures to ensure seamless break triggering and ad insertion.
  • Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across control room and production teams
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to respond quickly to changing production needs
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot audio/video and playout issues
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical information to internal and external stakeholders through well-organized maintenance notices, incident reports, outage summaries, and status updates

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 2-years of experience in a Technical Support role (i.e. IT Service Desk, TOC/NOC Operations, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Content Distribution Networks.
  • Knowledge of 2110 Broadcast Networks
  • Knowledge of Linux and/or Windows web servers.
  • Knowledge of Cloud Video Distribution platforms
  • Experience with Multi-Viewer Systems
  • Working knowledge and experience with FAST distribution systems
  • AI automation experience
  • Knowledge of encoding standards, including H.264, AAC, GOP structure, I-P-B frame schemes, profiles, bitrates, and aspect ratios.
  • Solid troubleshooting experience in Linux/Mac/Windows environments.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must be a Team Player, Initiative, Resourceful.
  • Exceptional composure and accuracy in high-pressure, live broadcast environments
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to on-air quality and precision

Physical Demands

  • Ability to lift and carry video equipment weighing less than 40lbs.

Travel

  • 0 - 10%

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • On-call position working less than 40 hours per week based on production needs
  • Must be available for early mornings, evenings, overnights, weekends, holidays, and remote production support as required
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

job.description:

job.description:

This role will provide supplemental audio production services by coordinating, mixing, and delivering support audio for live news/sports and key show programming. Production services will be located at our State-of-the-Art NFL Media Studios in Inglewood, CA. 

Responsibilities

  • Mix live and recorded show format productions with heavy emphasis on remotes and server playback.
  • Test and verify equipment: Networked audio consoles, intercoms, multiple audio and video servers, EVS Playback audio.
  • Required experience working with cart playback systems such as Ovation or 360systems. Must work with system templates and Music logging files.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Lighting Director
job.description:
NFL Media, Technical Operations is looking for a Lighting Director for shows produced at NFL Media in Inglewood, CA. Qualified candidates will have experience working in multi-camera studio environments and have a general knowledge of lighting studio talent for live sports and key show programming.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with show Directors, Producers, Scenic, and Video teams - implementing and maintaining the specific look of various productions between multiple stages and remote locations.
  • Support stage lighting designs in tandem with our Scenic and Integrations teams.
  • Operation of ETC EOS consoles to playback and modify existing lighting looks.
  • Monitor show productions from shading room and consult with video operator as necessary.
  • Perform tech checks at the beginning of each shift to check for burnouts, repositioning of equipment and overall stage & grid maintenance.
  • Conduct and perform routine and preventive maintenance of lighting fixtures and boards.
  • Report technical and/or equipment issues to Studio Operations and Engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of experience working in a studio environment; live & recorded productions.
  • Have working knowledge of studio lighting equipment and studio light design. Including exterior staging and lighting requirements during all day parts.
  • Have a creative eye and can improvise on the fly.
  • Knowledge of ETC EOS family lightboard(s) and controllers required.
  • Knowledge and understanding of lighting data protocols and networks, DMX-512, SACN and ETC NET3.
  • Knowledge of moving light fixtures, High End Systems, GLP.
  • Knowledge of LED broadcast fixtures: ETC, Chauvet, Arri, Cineo, ChromaQ.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Ability to draft, read, and interpret lighting plots for new or existing sets.
  • Auto-Cad, Vectorworks, ETC Concert and Lightwright experience.
  • Advanced ETC EOS programming training.
  • Advanced ETC NET3 Networking training.
  • Ability to program lighting consoles and Network management.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Familiarity and experience working with 1080p, HDR, UHD, and 4k studio environments a plus.
  • Interpersonal communication and organizational skills.
  • Strong technical/computer skills (Microsoft, Apple.)
  • Ability to “multi-task” various duties as necessary.
  • Be a team player and excel under pressure.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work high above the ground, on lifts and/or ladders.
  • Must be able to lift 75lbs for up to 30 minutes at a time.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to work in fast paced, stressful environments.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Utility
job.description:
As a member of the stage crew the Utility position performs a wide range of tasks in support of the overall program production process. Under supervision of the Stage Manager, Director, and Operations team, Utilities work with technical staff to satisfy production needs for live, taped, and automated programming.

Responsibilities

  • Moving large set pieces and monitors during stage resets
  • Moving and arranging furniture pieces and props (set dressing)
  • Set talent marks on floor at the direction of Stage Manager and Director
  • Work with Stage Manager to support on-camera talent needs (i.e., bottled water, equipment, etc.)
  • Work with Stage Manager and other studio personnel to keep studio, set pieces and equipment clean and organized
  • Possess in-depth knowledge of all studio equipment
  • Support Camera Operators in the setup of studio cameras and over-under cable pulls
  • Familiarity with breakdown/setup of cameras and equipment
  • Ability to troubleshoot cameras on stage (tally, prompter etc.)

Qualifications

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time V1/Shading Operator
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking a part-time Video Operator to lead in-studio and remote camera shading for live and pre-recorded news and sports productions across all platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring consistent, high-quality visual output across all camera feeds by managing real-time shading, color correction, and signal integrity. 

The Video Operator serves as a critical technical resource within the control room and engineering ecosystem, partnering with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production teams to deliver a seamless, broadcast-ready product in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. 

Responsibilities

  • Perform real-time shading of multiple camera sources during live and recorded productions, ensuring consistent color, exposure, and visual quality  
  • Configure and manage camera shading systems, including Sony broadcast camera chains, CCUs, and RCPs   
  • Adjust iris, gamma, black levels, and color balance across multiple camera feeds to maintain a cohesive on-air look  
  • Color correct inbound video feeds using Selenio Network Processor Manager to ensure broadcast quality and consistency  
  • Manage video signal routing for shading and production workflows using Imagine Magellan Control systems   
  • Monitor and troubleshoot video signals using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and diagnostic tools to maintain broadcast standards  
  • Collaborate with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production staff to support the creative and technical execution of productions   
  • Support setup, calibration, and testing of cameras, shading systems, and video infrastructure for studio and remote productions   
  • Adjust shading dynamically based on changing lighting conditions, production requirements, or environmental factors   
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, adapting quickly to real-time production changes and technical challenges   
  • Support advanced production environments, including robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics), Ultimatte systems, and OLED display integrations   

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of experience in camera shading or broadcast video operations in studio and/or remote production environments  
  • Extensive experience with Sony broadcast camera systems, including studio and ENG configurations   
  • Experience shading, color correcting, and routing video using frame synchronizers and production systems (e.g., Imagine, Cobalt)   
  • Strong understanding of broadcast video formats, including 1080p, 1080i, and 720p   
  • Working knowledge of SMPTE 2110 or IP-based video workflows

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience working in live sports or fast-paced broadcast production environments  
  • Experience with automated and robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics)  
  • Familiarity with Ultimatte compositing systems and virtual production workflows  
  • Experience working with OLED walls and large-format display environments   
  • Knowledge of HDR and emerging broadcast technologies   

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional attention to detail with a strong eye for color accuracy and visual consistency  
  • Ability to remain calm and make precise technical adjustments under pressure in live broadcast environments   
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across control room, engineering, and production teams   
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple camera feeds and priorities simultaneously   
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot complex video and signal issues in real time   
  • Self-motivated and adaptable, with the ability to work independently or within a team environment

Physical Demands 

  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs as required for production setup and support   

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Schedule driven by production needs, including live broadcasts and events  
  • Must be available to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays   
  • This is a part-time position based on operational requirements up to 29 hours per week
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

job.title: Seasonal Rights & Clearances Coordinator
job.description:
Summary

The Rights & Clearances Coordinator is responsible for researching, sourcing, and securing third‑party materials for use in NFL Films programming. This role works closely with producers, post‑production, media management, business affairs, and project managers to fulfill content needs while ensuring all material is properly licensed according to deadlines, budgets, and legal requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Research, request, and acquire third‑party materials including—but not limited to—photos, footage, newspaper articles, social media posts, podcasts, and other intellectual property.
  • Navigate and research archival collections, stock footage libraries, and professional photo agencies to locate hard‑to‑find materials.
  • Screen down cuts/programs and create detailed clearance logs to document all third‑party material usage.
  • Secure licenses, permissions, and releases for all third‑party content used in NFL Films programming.
  • Serve as a resource for production teams regarding rights, usage restrictions, and clearance options at all stages of production.
  • Track, organize, and maintain accurate records for all research and clearance documentation including agreements, invoices, purchase orders, and correspondence.
  • Communicate with internal departments to move acquired materials through workflows and deliver them to producers.
  • Maintain strong administrative procedures and uphold departmental standards.
  • Learn and use internal rights/clearance tracking systems and screening tools.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 2 years dedicated Rights & Clearances or Archival Producing experience.
  • Foundational understanding of third‑party rights, licensing, and clearances.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in post‑production or within a similar archival/rights/clearances environment.
  • Experience with AirTable or similar systems.
  • Experience navigating and interpreting EDLs.
  • Proven negotiation experience with major archives, stock footage/photo libraries, and independent rights holders

Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational and time‑management skills.
  • Strong problem‑solving ability; resourceful and proactive.
  • Ability to manage sensitive or confidential information.
  • Flexibility to be on call for occasional weekend work.
  • Comfort working in deadline‑driven environments with shifting priorities.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • Assist with training and mentoring interns as needed.

Physical Demands

  • Occasional handling of physical archival materials such as footage reels, tapes, newspapers, and photo collections.

Travel

  • No regular travel expected.

job.title: Seasonal Senior Coordinator, Studio Technical Operations
job.description:
The Senior Coordinator, Operations provides hands-on technical and operational support to the Director of Production Operations, keeping control room, stage, and studio environments production-ready at all times. The role performs pre-production checks and first-line troubleshooting of router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay, graphics, and audio systems, escalating unresolved faults to Engineering with documented detail. In partnership with Production Management, Scheduling, and Facilities, the Coordinator also confirms daily crew and resource readiness and manages equipment logistics, shipping, and staging for studio, remote, and tentpole productions. Administratively, the role maintains asset records, procurement and purchase order tracking, SOPs, and incident logs that support uninterrupted production. 

Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line troubleshooting and technical support for control room and stage equipment, including router panels, comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, EVS systems, Vizrt graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Perform pre-production technical checks of control room and stage systems, including signal routing, intercom and IFB functionality, camera and lighting readiness, belt pack frequencies and batteries, and audio levels.
  • Assist with setup, strike, and reconfiguration of studio, control room, and stage equipment, including cable management, panel configuration, and equipment swaps.
  • Partner with Engineering and Operations to monitor production and studio spaces and escalate unresolved technical faults, documenting symptoms, troubleshooting steps taken, and resolution to support recurring-issue tracking and preventive maintenance.
  • Coordinate with Production Management to ensure studio spaces, production resources, and operational dependencies are ready before scheduled productions.
  • Work with Scheduling to verify daily crew assignments, confirm personnel arrival and check-in, and promptly escalate staffing gaps or call-outs.
  • Plan and coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, receiving, inspection, equipment staging, transport, and organized storage for studio, remote, and tentpole productions.
  • Work with the IT Asset Management team to maintain equipment lifecycle and asset records in Oracle and ServiceNow, including serial numbers, locations, condition, warranties, inventory audits, check-in/check-out, and disposition.
  • Coordinate procurement activities, including purchase requisitions and purchase orders, vendor onboarding, contract intake documentation, and routine studio and engineering supply orders.
  • Maintain a centralized PO Tracker documenting approval status, delivery timelines, budget classification, SLA tracking, and invoice reconciliation.
  • Maintain SOPs, incident logs, workflow guides, facility reference materials, and operational status reports for the Director of Production Operations. 

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, procurement, or asset management within a broadcast, media, or technical production environment.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control room and stage systems, including router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and wireless mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay and graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform pre-production technical checks, isolate and troubleshoot equipment faults under live production conditions, and escalate unresolved issues to Engineering with clear, documented detail.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office 365 skills, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams, with experience building and maintaining trackers, logs, and operational records.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and multitasking abilities in a fast-paced production setting.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Prior experience in a broadcast facility, live event, or technical operations environment.
  • Hands-on experience with broadcast engineering equipment such as Evertz or Grass Valley routing, RTS or Clear-Com intercom and IFB systems, studio camera systems, EVS replay, Vizrt graphics, and digital audio consoles.
  • Experience with production management tools such as Media Pulse.
  • Experience using Oracle and ServiceNow for purchase orders, asset records, and ticket-based workflows.
  • Experience coordinating shipping, receiving, and equipment logistics for remote or tentpole productions.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Microsoft Forms, and Power Automate for request intake, tracking, and document management. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Composure and decisiveness under live production conditions, where equipment issues must be diagnosed and resolved quickly.
  • Proactive problem resolution; anticipates operational and technical needs before they affect production.
  • Sound operational judgment when prioritizing tasks, escalating faults, and balancing competing demands.
  • Cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Production Management, Scheduling, Facilities, and Operations.
  • Precision and accountability; maintains meticulous equipment, procurement, and incident records with minimal oversight.
  • Safety-minded approach to equipment handling, cable management, and studio and stage work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, time management, attention to detail, and ability to work under pressure. 

Physical Demands 

  • Ability to lift and transport equipment up to 50 lbs and to support equipment setup, strike, and staging. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Full-time, non-exempt position requiring 40 hours per week.
  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on production needs.
  • Seasonal position up to 7 months

job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sr. Manager of Club Revenue Analytics & Data Science to join our Data & Analytics team at the NFL. Based in the League’s New York office, this role partners with internal stakeholders and all 32 clubs to turn business questions and fan data into actionable recommendations, scalable analytics products, and measurable growth across ticketing, premium seating, sponsorship, and fan engagement. The role also works with Data Engineering and Business Intelligence to ensure solutions are accurate, governed, and scalable.

The ideal candidate combines business acumen, data science and advanced analytics experience, executive communication skills, and a consultative mindset to turn insights into action.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and collaborate with stakeholders from Club Business Development and the 32 clubs to understand their analytics needs and deliver actionable insights.
  • Oversee the development and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive analytics platforms to support ticketing, premium seating and sponsorship analytics and insights.
  • Lead advanced analytics to evaluate ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship behavior, including KPI monitoring, segmentation, customer profiling, and predictive modeling.
  • Effectively communicate analytical findings to stakeholders, translating complex data analysis into clear and concise insights.
  • Collaborate with BI and technology teams to ensure ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship platforms receive accurate, reliable data through regular quality audits and validation.
  • Perform data extraction, transformation and analysis using SQL and Python.
  • Develop and implement attribution models to measure the impact of different League-provided data products.
  • Work with the BI COE to create dashboards to provide insights and recommendations based on analytics findings.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in club analytics and data quality management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Club Business Development, Marketing and the 32 clubs to align analytics initiatives and drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Collaborate with analytics consulting vendors.
  • Foster a collaborative and agile work environment, leveraging tools like Jira for project management and task tracking.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in revenue analytics, pricing, customer analytics, ticketing, consulting, ecommerce, hospitality, sports, media, or another commercially oriented industry or other relevant industry experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, direct analytical work, and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with practical experience working with large customer, transactional, or behavioral datasets.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, customer segmentation, forecasting, experimentation or campaign measurement, and analytical storytelling.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex analytical workstreams and coaching analysts
  • Proven ability to communicate with senior business and technical stakeholders and present complex analysis in a clear, concise, and influential manner.
  • Experience partnering with data engineering, BI, product, or technology teams to deliver scalable analytical solutions with strong data quality and governance.
  • 3 years of management experience.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Sports, clubs, ticketing, live events, venue, hospitality, airline, subscription, or revenue management experience.
  • Experience with Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, or comparable ticketing and live-event datasets.
  • Experience developing club-facing, client-facing, or executive-facing recommendations in a consulting or analytics advisory environment.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex analytical findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
  • Strong collaborator who communicates transparently, supports shared goals, and welcomes constructive challenges.
