job.title: VP, International Licensing & Consumer Products
job.description:
The Vice President, International Licensing & Consumer Products, will lead the NFL’s international growth through Consumer Products. The role will lead the development and execution of international Consumer Products strategies to expand the NFL’s presence in priority markets, grow licensing and retail opportunities, and strengthen fan engagement. Working across local markets and global teams, this position will identify and develop new business opportunities, maximize the value of existing partnerships, and build innovative commercial models that drive sustainable revenue and long-term NFL brand growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for leading and managing all licensee accounts with more than 50% of their business generated from the EMEA, LATAM or APAC markets, including product development, retail distribution, and marketing
  • Responsible for setting and achieving annual growth targets and long-range plans for the international CP business
  • Responsible for local account management of global accounts, including product development, retail distribution, and marketing
  • Fan Development/Data Acquisition through international CP partners
  • Liaison to local GMs and marketing teams on all global CP strategy and initiatives
  • Successful International Games execution

Core Responsibilities:

  • New Business
    • Identify and manage international licensing agencies in key territories; lead RFP and negotiations as needed  
    • Lead and execute new business focused on accounts where more than 50% of sales will be derived outside of the US
    • Expand global partner rights through new rights and  development of localized product assortments, retail distribution, and marketing support
    • Identify new retail distribution opportunities and innovative products to drive growth with a specific focus on unique international needs
    • Support GMP with localized Club programs that drive retail revenue or maximize brand exposure for their awarded markets
    • Identify new business models – i.e., licensed events and branded or experiential retail that will drive both revenue and brand awareness
    • Support new LBE initiatives in international markets through marketing, retail execution, and consultation with local country teams
  • Account Management
    • Lead international account strategy to drive NFL Consumer Products revenue growth
    • Own licensing forecasts, performance, and long-term growth plans for internationally focused accounts (>50% of sales come from outside the US) in partnership with Finance and Strategy
    • Develop and own bespoke retail distribution strategies across key markets.
    • Oversee management of licensing agencies and drive them to identify meaningful, strategic new business opportunities
    • Expand global partners by maximizing rights, categories, and geographic reach in collaboration with the Global Licensing team
    • Oversee the local CP leads in managing local teams of key global accounts (e.g., Fanatics, New Era, Topps, etc.) to translate Global account strategy into local implementation across product, retail, marketing, and activations
    • Partner with the GMs and Country marketing leads to understand local opportunities for global and local partners to drive Fan Engagement
    • Drive partner support and engagement in focus markets and at key tentpoles (e.g., Draft, Super Bowl, IGs, and International Watch Parties)
    • Collaborate with local marketing teams to secure revenue-driving marketing / creative for international partners
  • International Football Development Support
    • Partner with Global Licensing and other function heads to ensure on-field partners are supporting strategic League on-field initiatives internationally (e.g., Marketing / Brand, FLAG, International Growth)
    • Act as key liaison to local GMs and marketing teams on new global partner initiatives, i.e., Nike, Wilson
    • Execute implementation of on-field strategies to ensure flawless execution for international accounts
  •  Global / International Collaboration
    • Partner with Global Licensing to ensure the overall consumer products portfolio mix is maximizing fan engagement and revenue
    • Collaborate with Global Licensing leads to ensure partners are activating their rights and that Global partners' rights are being activated in key international markets
    • Provide event retail support and in-market activation support for the larger Global licensing ecosystem by attending site visits, building local relationships, and overseeing market activations in their market
  • Collaboration/Partnership with Strategy Team:
    • Build strategic vision for International Consumer Products long-term to ensure sustainable growth
    • Outline international partner/category insight needs for Consumer Products Strategy to research, investigate, and design to leverage data-based and insights-driven decision-making
    • Provide insights to inform partner strategy planning and forecasting
    • Articulate forecasts and business changes to help shape narrative for ongoing business reviews (e.g., Business Planning, QBRs)
    • Help identify policy challenges and opportunities and support in building business cases for necessary revisions
    • Input into materials for executive-level updates, including EOC, Committee Meetings, and Owners Meetings

Core Categories:

  • Apparel
  • Hardlines
  • Local eCommerce
  • Third Party Retail/DTC
  • On-Field
  • Licensed Events

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 15+ years of experience in Licensing/Consumer Products
  • Proven experience leading teams and developing individuals

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Adaptability & Resilience: The ability to pivot quickly when priorities change, process unexpected disruptions, and bounce back from setbacks.
  • Curiosity & Growth Mindset: An inner drive to learn new things, ask critical questions, and continuously build capabilities rather than staying static.
  • Initiative & Self-Motivation: Acting proactively to solve problems without needing constant direction or oversight.

  • Big-Picture Thinking: Understanding how individual tasks tie into broader organizational goals and market shifts.

job.title: VP, Treasury & Risk
job.description:
The Vice President, Treasury & Risk will be a key leader within the NFL Finance organization, responsible for leading enterprise risk management, treasury, insurance, and internal audit functions. This role will strengthen the League’s governance, risk management, and control environment while providing strategic oversight of liquidity, cash forecasting, banking administration, and financial risk.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Internal Audit and Treasury professionals and manage external/co-sourced service providers as needed
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on risk, controls, governance, liquidity, insurance, and financial stewardship
  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the League’s enterprise risk management framework, including enterprise-wide risk assessments, risk monitoring, mitigation planning, and reporting
  • Prepare clear and timely enterprise risk and emerging risk reporting for senior leadership and the Audit Committee
  • Oversee daily cash positioning activities, including liquidity management and cash position optimization
  • Develop short- and long-term cash flow forecasts to support liquidity planning, strategic business decisions, and investments
  • Develop a structure to work cross functionally to optimize working capital
  • Oversee banking administration, banking relationships, investments, and other treasury operations
  • Invest excess cash within approved cash investment guidelines to optimize interest income while preserving liquidity and principal
  • Design, analyze, monitor, and hedge exposures to foreign exchange and interest rate risk
  • Oversee and evaluate insurance programs to help ensure appropriate coverage, administration, and compliance

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field
  • 15+ years of experience across treasury, enterprise risk management, accounting, or finance, including significant leadership responsibility
  • Management experience and proven success leading and developing teams
  • Proven success building functions and creating or improving processes, policies, controls, and reporting
  • Strong executive presence, judgment, communication skills, and ability to influence across a complex organization

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • CPA, CIA, CTP, CRMA, CISA, or other relevant professional certification
  • Experience using data analytics, automation, and continuous monitoring within treasury, risk, or internal audit
  • Experience managing co-sourced internal audit or other third-party professional service relationships

job.title: Morning Show Host
job.description:
KTVU FOX 2 is looking for a bold, energetic, and engaging personality to help redefine morning news on Mornings on 2. We're not just looking for someone who can deliver the news. We're looking for someone audiences want to spend their mornings with. This isn't your traditional anchor role. We want a natural conversationalist with a big personality, a great sense of humor, and a passion for news. Someone who can talk about anything, think on their feet, and connect with audiences without relying on a script.

You're a news junkie with strong journalistic instincts who can confidently and naturally discuss a wide range of topics—from politics, crime, and breaking news to sports, entertainment, pop culture, and everything in between. You're authentic, curious, quick-witted, and excited about the future of local news across broadcast, digital, and streaming.

A Snapshot of Your Responsibilities

  • Bring energy, personality, humor, and authenticity to live morning broadcasts.
  • Lead engaging, unscripted conversations and interviews.
  • Cover breaking news, current events, lifestyle, sports, and trending topics with confidence.
  • Create compelling content for broadcast, digital, social, and streaming platforms.
  • Connect with local communities and bring fresh ideas to the show.

What You Will Need

  • 3 to 5+ years of news reporting or hosting experience, with the ability to speak knowledgeably and conversationally about a broad range of news and current events.
  • Strong on-camera presence and exceptional live, unscripted communication skills.
  • Deep curiosity about news, culture, and what's happening in the world.
  • Natural charisma, quick thinking, and the ability to connect with different audiences.
  • Strong editorial judgment and journalistic credibility.
  • Passion for digital storytelling and the evolution of local news.
  • Experience in broadcast news, digital media, or streaming.

Nice to Have, But Not a Deal Breaker

  • Familiarity with the West Coast, and especially the Bay Area.
  • An established social media presence or experience building digital audiences.

job.title: Social Media Producer, Commerce
job.description:
FOX News Media is looking for a hands-on Social Media Producerto create and publish commerce-focused content across socialplatforms. This role will bring products, shopping guides and on-air segments to life through engaging videos, graphics and posts.

The ideal candidate is a strong creator who can take an idea from concept through production and publication. This person will help FOX News Commerce reach audiences in fresh ways by making useful, visually compelling content that reflects the FOX voice and keeps up with how people engage on social media.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create, shoot, edit and publish social content, including short-form videos, graphics, carousels and captions
  • Develop content ideas around products, shopping guides, seasonal moments, commerce articles and on-air segments
  • Film products, talent and behind-the-scenes content in studio and on location
  • Follow social trends and identify ways to adapt relevant formats for FOX audiences
  • Work with the Managing Editor of Commerce to plan content around editorial priorities and approved partnerships
  • Write captions, scripts and calls to action that clearly present products and shopping information
  • Check product details, pricing, promotional language and links before publishing
  • Track content performance and use audience response and analytics to improve future posts
  • Manage assigned content from planning through production, approval and publication

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Professional experience creating and publishing social mediacontent for a media, lifestyle, retail or consumer brand
  • A portfolio showcasing original social content, including video and graphic work
  • Hands-on experience filming and editing short-form video for social platforms
  • Strong visual storytelling skills and the ability to create engaging content featuring products
  • Experience writing social copy, captions, scripts or video outlines
  • Proficiency with video editing and design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, CapCut or similar
  • Experience publishing content and managing calendars across platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and X
  • Knowledge of platform-specific formats, audience behavior and social media trends
  • Familiarity with social analytics and the ability to use performance data to inform content decisions
  • Excellent organization, close attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to work within established brand, editorial and legal guidelines
  • A collaborative approach, openness to feedback and confidence pitching new ideas
  • Interest in shopping, retail, consumer products and commerce content

job.description:

  • Serve as a point of contact between the GM and internal/external stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and follow-up.
  • Anticipate needs and proactively manage priorities to keep projects and deadlines on track.

  • Prepare reports, presentations, and other materials as needed.

job.title: Senior Manager, Risk Management
job.description:
Fox Corporation is seeking a collaborative and solutions-driven Senior Manager, Risk Management to support insurance-risk management activities across the enterprise. This role plays a critical part in managing the Company’s risk exposure and insurance programs while fostering strong partnerships with internal stakeholders and external risk partners.

The ideal candidate is a team player who thrives in a dynamic environment and excels at cross-functional collaboration, clear communication, and delivering results through trusted partnerships.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review and analyze insurance provisions of contractual agreements and provide risk assessments and recommendations to Legal department, divisions, and management
  • Prepare submission material for procurement of select insurance programs by gathering, analyzing, and preparing exposure data
  • Develop and run various risk reports using the risk management information system (RMIS) to identify and analyze loss trends
  • Work with various internal departments, third-party administrators, and brokers on submission and management of claims, across multiple lines of coverage, through to resolution
  • Work with television/film productions on all insurance and risk management-related needs as well as securing coverage for all artists
  • Collaborate with Legal department on mergers and acquisitions by reviewing target insurance coverages and onboarding of entities once acquired
  • Collaborate with all departments within the Company as well as risk management support service providers
  • Consult with and guide company divisions regarding insurance and risk management-related issues
  • Support policy renewals by overseeing the process of gathering documentation, exposures, and ensuring applications are completed timely and provided to the broker
  • Review insurance policies and endorsements for accuracy
  • Review, data enter, and track incoming certificates of insurance for comparison against contractual wording and FOX’s insurance requirements
  • Issue certificates of insurance in compliance with contractual wording and FOX’s insurance policies
  • Negotiate the renewals and new business for several of our joint venture insurance programs
  • Processing invoices through the spend management platform
  • Handle various special projects, reports and administrative tasks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 8+ years of experience
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Adobe
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex topics for diverse audiences
  • High attention to detail, discretion, and commitment to confidentiality
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize, manage time effectively, and remain organized in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven ability to work both independently and as a collaborative team member
  • Strong customer service orientation and professional presence

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • CPCU, ARM, CRM, CRM-P, or other similar industry designation(s)
  • Risk Management Information Systems experience
  • Finance, Legal, or Media/Entertainment experience

AirTable and Compass scheduling for all NBC Sports Digital programming

  • Provide event logos, artwork and copy for all live events across platforms
  • Work across several platforms and content management systems while maintaining a strong attention to detail

job.title: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon Internships – Summer 2027
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship. 

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry. 

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:    

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.   
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities. 
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship. 
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship. 
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions. 
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer.  

Summer 2027 Program Details 

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027 (Tonight Show Interns will be expected to work through August 19, 2027) 

Time Commitment: 32-40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need.  

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from New York, NY. 

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline 

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)   

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews    

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews   

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers   

To Apply: 

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year. 
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below). 
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program. 

"The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon" made its debut from Studio 6B in Rockefeller Center on Feb. 17, 2014. Emmy Award and Grammy Award-winning comedian Jimmy Fallon brings a high-tempo energy to the storied NBC franchise with his welcoming interview style, love of audience participation, spot-on impersonations and innovative sketches. For almost 60 years, "The Tonight Show" has been an American television institution home to big-name celebrity guests and top musical and comedic talent. Taking a cue from predecessors, including hosts Johnny Carson and Jay Leno, Fallon carries on the tradition audiences know and love.  

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:  

  • General Production  
  • Art  
  • Costumes  
  • Research  
  • Talent
  • Script  
  • Social  
  • Writers Room

Basic Requirements: 

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program.  
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits). 
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States. 
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 19, 2027. 
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.  

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.  

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.   

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred. 
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above. 
  • Passion for television entertainment space.   
  • Ability to multitask and highly organized.   
  • Excellent communication skills, including written, verbal, and proofreading skills.  
  • Energetic, flexible, collaborative, and proactive.   
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.   

The hourly rate for student interns is $19.00.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

 

As a member of the Paramount+ Content Systems Product team, you will help shape the automation strategy for our tools and systems. These are the systems that power our global streaming experiences. What an exciting place to be! Your mission is to learn the manual, hands-on challenges of our partner teams. Then you build the right solutions to solve the right problems at the right time.

 

You will play a key role in keeping Paramount+ running efficiently. We are growing to millions of new subscribers around the world! This team cares about solving problems and improving workflows for the people we work with each day. Together, we build forward-looking tools that scale right along with our business.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Operational Excellence: Partner with Video and Content Operations to learn where the gaps are in our content supply chain. Then turn those needs into a clear automation plan we can act on.
  • Systems Mapping: Map how our content systems connect from end to end - data flows, handoffs, and dependencies. Then use that picture to find where and how to automate.
  • Process Automation: Guide the product development of our Content Systems. This includes rights, title, and media asset management. Your sharp focus: automate manual, high-touch workflows!
  • AI & Innovation: Find and roll out AI-driven solutions that help our operations teams work more effectively. Think automated metadata extraction, AI-assisted QC, and auto-created localized assets!
  • Technical Documentation: Share a clear vision for technical work. Write up scope, use cases, workflows, and sequence diagrams.
  • Agile Execution: Lead scrum team activities such as grooming, planning, and setting priorities. That way, our development teams always have what they need to succeed.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Bring partners in product, tech, and operations together on delivery scope. Then get set for exciting global launches!

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Experience: 2-4 years in software product management. You know how to put business value first and weigh trade-offs.
  • Systems Thinking: Ability to map and visualize how complex, interconnected systems work together end-to-end - understanding not just individual tools but the relationships between them - in order to identify where and how to automate across the workflow.
  • Automation Mindset: A proven passion for building workflow tools. You want them to be a "joy to use" for internal teams!
  • Technical Depth: Deep comfort with complex technical workflow systems. Engineering experience or a background in AI/ML is a big plus.
  • Domain Knowledge: A strong interest in the streaming media world and the content supply chain.
  • Collaboration: You build caring, trusting relationships across teams. This helps product work run smoothly, even in a complex space.
  • Agile Expertise: Lots of hands-on Agile experience. You also have excellent communication skills.

 

 

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

CBS Sacramento and Good Day are looking for a Meteorologist to drive weather storytelling. An ideal candidate must have superior forecasting and severe weather skills, understand how to forecast major events, including wildfires, floods, and blizzards in the different microclimates of our Market.  Ability to produce easy-to-understand and informational visuals, maps, and graphics to communicate the weather story to the audience conversationally in the communities of our market every day on air, streaming, online, and on social media platforms. A dynamic personality is a must!

 

OVERVIEW & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Other duties include producing weather content, working with a team of meteorologists, including the Chief Meteorologist, and implementing station strategy. Writing/preparing forecasts; producing graphics to tell the weather story across multiple platforms, strong social media presence. The candidate will also be required to periodically write and report weather-related content for newscasts. We want good communicators who are team-focused. 

 

SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE SHOULD HAVE:
•    On-air weather casting experience within a TV Station
•    A degree in meteorology or related science
•    Strong writing skills for broadcast and digital platforms
•    Ideal candidate needs to have strong social media skills
•    Ability to use augmented reality in weather segments is a bonus
•    Ability to provide continuous live severe weather coverage across all programs
•    Write daily weather blog and post weather content on social media platforms.
•    Passionate about being a brand ambassador for CBS Sacramento and the communities we serve

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:  
•    B.S. Degree or equivalent experience in Meteorology or Earth Sciences preferred
•    Proficient in weather graphics production
•    Knowledge of weather patterns and microclimates across Northern California and the Western U.S.
•    Ability to live field report and write packages
•    Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record in order to operate a company vehicle
•    At least three years’ experience on-air in weather casting and weather producing preferred
•    Ability to shoot and edit video
•    WSI weather system knowledge and ability to employ all functions on multiple platforms preferred

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Location: San Francisco – Onsite

 

About This Role

Welcome to Paramount Streaming — the team behind Paramount+, home to a mountain of entertainment for audiences around the globe. We bring together iconic brands, compelling content, and technology to deliver streaming experiences to millions of viewers.

We’re hiring a Lead Software Engineer on the AI Engagement Engine team. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You’ll build native Apple experiences that support content discovery and personalization within the Paramount+ and Pluto TV applications, integrating real-time personalization signals across key touchpoints.

You’ll partner with backend, ML, data, product, and platform teams to deliver reliable, scalable experiences across iOS and tvOS. You’ll own complex technical problems, contribute to client architecture, and work with existing technical leadership to strengthen engineering standards.

AI fluency is a core requirement for this role. We’re looking for someone who uses AI coding assistants and agents daily and understands how to work effectively with context, tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent harnesses. You should be comfortable explaining your workflows, evaluating AI-generated output, and recognizing when human review is needed.

 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Contribute to decisions on architecture, frameworks, and tooling for iOS and tvOS applications in partnership with team leads and senior peers.

  • Evaluate new technologies and adopt approaches that improve engineering quality and productivity.

  • Translate product goals into technical requirements and manageable, shippable work.

  • Explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.

Application Development

  • Design, build, debug, and ship native iOS and tvOS features.

  • Improve performance, reliability, and accessibility across the app experience.

  • Build client experiences for personalization and recommendations in partnership with ML and backend teams.

  • Integrate APIs and personalization signals into responsive, data-driven interfaces.

AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Use AI coding assistants and agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent tools daily to design, write, review, test, and refactor code.

  • Use MCP integrations to connect AI tools with relevant engineering tools and data sources, with appropriate access controls.

  • Work with agent harnesses to manage context, instructions, tool execution, and human review.

  • Validate AI-generated code through review and testing, investigate failures, and recognize when a different approach is needed.

  • Share useful workflows, skills, plugins, and lessons learned with teammates.

Mentorship and Collaboration

  • Help improve code quality through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing.

  • Mentor and unblock engineers through technical guidance and collaboration.

  • Partner with product, design, data, backend, and other client teams to define and deliver features.

  • Build constructive working relationships and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ownership and Delivery

  • Own features and technical problems from requirements through delivery and follow-up.

  • Manage concurrent priorities, surface risks early, and help the team deliver predictably.

  • Contribute to improvements in engineering practices, documentation, and shared standards.

 

Skills

Apple Platform Expertise

  • Strong programming skills in Swift.

  • In-depth knowledge of iOS and tvOS, and proficiency in Xcode.

  • Strong fundamentals in memory management, concurrency, animations, and performance profiling.

  • Experience designing interfaces across size classes and device families.

  • Experience consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with backend services.

AI Fluency, MCP, and Agent Harnesses

  • Practical experience using AI coding assistants and agents in day-to-day engineering work.

  • Working understanding of inference, context windows, tool use, and the capabilities and limitations of AI coding tools.

  • Familiarity with MCP, including connecting AI tools to external tools and data sources, configuring integrations, and managing permissions.

  • Understanding of agent harnesses, including how they manage context, instructions, tool execution, and human review.

  • Ability to explain practical workflows using MCP integrations and agent harnesses, including how you troubleshoot failures and validate results.

  • Working familiarity with skills and plugins, how they extend AI coding tools, and when to use an existing one.

  • Ability to write and refine prompts and context, critically evaluate AI-generated output, and validate generated code.

  • Familiarity with how LLM- or ML-powered product features are built.

  • Sound judgment around privacy, intellectual property, attribution, and responsible AI use.

Architecture and Experimentation

  • Strong problem-solving and architectural skills at the app and module level.

  • Experience with A/B testing, feature flagging, and client-side experimentation, including experiment assignment, holdout groups, and measuring impact.

  • Experience integrating ad-serving products into Apple applications, including ad surfaces, impression tracking, and collaboration with ad tech teams.

  • Working familiarity with ML-driven product features, including API contracts, client-side signals, and distinguishing between data, model, and rendering issues.

Leadership and Communication

  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical colleagues.

  • Ability to mentor and support others without requiring a reporting relationship.

  • A collaborative approach to technical decisions, feedback, and problem-solving.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Apple platform development experience, or equivalent senior-level depth.

  • Hands-on experience using Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and agent harnesses in engineering workflows, including validating outputs and troubleshooting failures.

  • Experience as a key contributor to at least one publicly released native iPhone application.

  • Experience working with Agile development processes.

  • Demonstrable, current use of AI coding tools and agents in your day-to-day engineering workflow, and the ability to explain how they work to others.

Desired Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

  • Background supporting the integration of rich media assets, including video, into mobile applications.

  • Experience building data-driven or server-driven UI, including personalized feeds, ranked content surfaces, and dynamic layouts, with pagination, prefetching, and cache invalidation strategies that keep content fast and fresh.

  • Experience working with entertainment, games, news, or sports-related properties.

Bonus Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience creating reusable skills, plugins, or custom agents for AI coding tools.

  • Experience building or extending MCP integrations or agent harnesses.

  • Continuous build and test automation experience.

  • Understanding of streaming video and DRM concepts.

  • Knowledge of localization practices and tooling in Xcode.

  • Experience with Swift Package Manager.

The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. job.title: Technical Director
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, and we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is…YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team that values authenticity and embraces inclusion for all. We are searching for individuals who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees. You fuel our culture of purpose, passion, and collaboration. We’re in this together.

Role Details:

The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of broadcast operations and production activities.  The Technical Director will work together with Directors, Producers and Graphics/Video Teams in planning newscasts and overseeing the crew on newscast pre-production activities.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Set up and prepare the studio for each broadcast including lighting and camera framing

  • Check in each guest/analyst via LiveU, Zoom, etc. This includes a full audio check

  • Direct, switch, and operate audio and cameras during broadcasts. Show times and durations vary from 15 minutes to full hour broadcasts on CBS Sports HQ

  • Work closely with various Paramount Global entities to connect guests and analysts

  • Must be prepared for breaking news and postgame reactions throughout each shift at any time

 

Key Projects:

Work closely with CBS Sports Broadcast to create compelling content for customers on CBS Sports Digital platforms.

 

Qualifications:

What you bring to the team:

You have -

  • At least 2 years of "hands-on" experience in the technical direction of television newscasts

  • Since the schedules will rotate, you must be able to work all shifts, including weekends and overnights, and holidays. Must be able to work additional hours beyond scheduled shift with little or no notice if needed

  • Must be willing and able to work flexible hours, under tight deadline pressure, including breaking news

  • Experience with ELC OPERATIONS – calling and cutting News Broadcasts, Camera Robotics, Audio Consoles, Playout Servers, and Graphics Playback 

  • Extensive knowledge of video switchers, graphics systems, server playout systems, audio consoles and robotic camera systems is essential. 

  • Desire to learn and adapt in a fast paced environment. 

You might also have –

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Communications or equivalent

  • Experience with Ross products including switchers, Inception and Xpression 


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Paramount’s most dynamic teams.

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The TEGNA NBC station in Buffalo is looking for an Account Manager who will supports Account Executives’ sales efforts by taking ownership of fulfillment in such a way that the AE can play their role of being client-facing, creating opportunities and closing revenue. The Account Manager manages the day-to-day responsibilities of accounts to ensure proper implementation of their solutions. The Account Manager influences and drives sales by providing superior customer service and support across Broadcast Television and Digital, aiming at retaining clients and growing business. This  job reports to Sales Manager. 

 

Responsibilities:

  • Provide support to assigned Account Executives on post-sale activity including campaign implementation, maintenance, and review.
  • Daily interaction with existing advertising agencies and direct clients; this responsibility includes maintenance of client schedules on television and digital in addition to implementation of special projects and promotions.
  • Works in tandem with Account Executives, Marketing Director, Research Director, and Creative Services to support client needs.
  • Attend sales meetings and sales trainings to gain sales, product and process information and keep abreast of company products and services to articulate to client, when appropriate.
  • Partner with designated Account Executives in identifying new/incremental revenue based on campaign results.
  • Assist designated Account Executives with maintenance of contracts, generating avails, traffic, make-goods, collection and overall customer service.
  • Regular tracking of clients’ audience delivery using ratings, impressions, clients KPIs, and campaign fulfillment.
  • Coordinate with team to set up new customer accounts, contracts, order entry and revisions.

 

Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of account management in a professional, fast-paced media sales environment.
  • Track record of successfully retaining and growing clients.
  • Knowledge of marketing solutions including broadcasting and digital advertising is preferred.
  • Knowledge of Google Analytics and advertising solutions is highly desirable.
  • Prior experience using CRM systems and MS Office suite.
  • Able to make decisions and solve problems independently to support customer needs.
  • Self-motivation and willingness to work as a team player are essential attributes.
  • Demonstrate ability to be creative, flexible, and able to adapt to change with evolving priorities.
  • Creative with ability to work effectively as part of a team and independently.
  • Detail oriented with ability to handle and prioritize multiple tasks to meet deadlines.
  • Position requires strong written and verbal communication skills, as well as strong organization and time management skills.
Pay Range$22—$23 USD

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com

Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.

You’ll work across the stack, from modern React front ends to the APIs and services behind them, and you’ll be a strong contributor to how we structure, ship, and scale user-facing software. We build with micro-frontends so that teams can deliver independently without sacrificing a cohesive experience, and we embrace agentic software development, using AI agents as real collaborators in design, implementation, testing, and review. You’ll take product requirements and technical briefs and turn them into well-structured, well-tested features, working closely with product, design, architecture, and platform partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate full stack features, from React UIs through to the backend APIs and services that support them.
  • Develop and evolve micro-frontend architectures, including module boundaries, shared component libraries, versioning, and runtime integration across independently deployed applications.
  • Use agentic development methods in day-to-day work: directing AI coding agents, writing effective specs and prompts, reviewing and validating agent-generated code, and building guardrails (tests, linting, CI checks) that keep agent output reliable.
  • Set and uphold standards for code quality, testing, accessibility, performance, and observability across the front end and back end.
  • Contribute to technical design for meaningful features and help break epics into actionable, well-scoped stories alongside the team lead.
  • Share what works in agent-assisted workflows, and help teammates build effective habits and practices.
  • Modernize legacy front ends and monolithic UIs into scalable, maintainable, componentized applications.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, architects, and platform teams to deliver cohesive user experiences.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined source control and code review practices.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building production web applications.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, including state management, hooks, performance optimization, and component design.
  • Practical experience with micro-frontend architectures (e.g., Module Federation, single-spa, or equivalent approaches), including managing shared dependencies, design systems, and cross-team integration.
  • Solid backend experience building RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs in a language such as Node.js, C#/.NET, or similar, with a working understanding of databases and data modeling.
  • Demonstrated experience with agentic or AI-assisted software development, and good judgment about when to trust, verify, and correct agent output.
  • Strong grasp of web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, accessibility, browser performance, and security basics (authentication, authorization, XSS/CSRF).
  • Strong testing discipline across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, and a genuine concern for code structure and maintainability.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-hosted applications in AWS, Azure, or similar environments.
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum delivery and Git-based source control.
  • Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach, including a willingness to mentor and learn from teammates.
  • Exposure to Docker, monorepo tooling, or design-system development is a plus.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Are you ready to shape the mobile experiences of tens of millions of Americans every month? Join TEGNA’s Development team, where we build cutting-edge websites, mobile apps, OTT apps, and custom editorial tools. Despite being part of a large, publicly traded company, our team operates with the agility and excitement of a startup. We’re a fun-loving group of professionals who thrive on innovation and getting things done. We are seeking a Senior Android Developer to help lead the evolution of our native Android news platform, which powers branded apps for 50+ TEGNA stations from a single shared codebase. In this role, you’ll build new features, mentor teammates, tackle our toughest performance and architecture challenges, and help set the technical direction for the app. If you love modern Android development and working in a collaborative environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you.
This is a hybrid role based in Knoxville, TN, with a mix of in-office and remote work.

Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and ship features for our native Android app using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, aligned with the product roadmap and our engineering standards.
• Own significant areas of the codebase and serve as a key resource for investigating and resolving complex product issues.
• Write efficient, reusable, and reliable code within a Clean Architecture, multi-module structure.
• Identify performance bottlenecks—especially around video playback, memory usage, and UI recomposition— and drive solutions.
• Mentor other developers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance.
• Collaborate with developers, designers, and product/business managers to translate requirements into wellarchitected solutions.
• Help maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and release processes across our multi-station builds.
• Rapidly learn new technologies and adapt to changing business and customer needs.

Requirements:

• 5+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years building native Android applications with Kotlin.
• Hands-on experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android UI development.
• Solid understanding of app architecture patterns (MVVM, Clean Architecture) and separation of concerns.
• Experience with Kotlin Coroutines and Flow for asynchronous and reactive programming.
• Experience with dependency injection (Hilt/Dagger).
• Experience consuming RESTful APIs (Retrofit/OkHttp) and working with JSON.
• Experience with local persistence (Room or similar).

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. Our Account Executive (Integrated Media Specialist) – sales role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

2+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance.

401(k) with company match

Career progression opportunities

Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid/remote work environment

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

EMPLOYEE REFERRAL BONUS ELIGIBLE

job.title: Director, Digital Operations
job.description:
The Detroit Free Press, Michigan's largest news organization and the largest metro publication in the USA TODAY Network, is seeking a Digital Director to lead and evolve our digital journalism strategy in one of the nation's most competitive and dynamic news markets.

This senior newsroom leader will be responsible for audience growth, digital innovation, platform strategy and newsroom transformation across freep.com, search, social media, newsletters, video, emerging platforms and AI-powered tools. The Digital Director will oversee the digital team, partner closely with newsroom leadership and help ensure that Detroit Free Press journalism reaches the largest possible audience while driving loyalty, engagement and subscriptions.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, forward-thinking newsroom leader with a deep understanding of audience behavior, digital publishing, analytics and emerging technologies. They are passionate about local journalism and understand how to balance editorial excellence with audience needs. They are equally comfortable leading major newsroom initiatives, analyzing performance data, experimenting with new products and coaching journalists to succeed in an increasingly digital and AI-driven media landscape.

Detroit is one of the most competitive local news environments in America. The Digital Director will play a critical role in ensuring the Detroit Free Press remains the leading source of trusted journalism in the region by continuously improving how we discover, package, distribute and engage audiences with our work.

This role reports to the executive editor and serves as a key member of the newsroom leadership team.

Key responsibilities:

Lead and execute the Detroit Free Press digital audience strategy across all platforms, including freep.com, app, search, social media, newsletters, video, push alerts and emerging platforms.

Manage and mentor the digital team, fostering a culture of innovation, experimentation, accountability and continuous improvement.

Partner with editors, reporters, visual journalists and newsroom leaders to maximize the reach, impact and engagement of Free Press journalism.

Use audience analytics, market intelligence and performance data to identify opportunities for growth, improve content strategy and support business objectives.

Lead newsroom SEO strategy, ensuring journalism is optimized for search discovery while maintaining strong editorial standards.

Develop and oversee social media strategy across platforms including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky and future platforms.

Drive innovation in digital storytelling, including video, multimedia, newsletters, live coverage and platform-specific experiences.

Lead the newsroom's exploration and adoption of AI tools and workflows, helping journalists responsibly use emerging technologies to enhance reporting, audience engagement, productivity and story optimization.

Monitor audience, platform and technology trends and translate insights into actionable newsroom strategies.

Work closely with product, marketing, consumer revenue and network partners to support audience growth, subscriptions and engagement goals.

Oversee daily digital publishing operations, story presentation and audience-focused coverage planning.

Lead audience development efforts around major news events, breaking news and enterprise journalism.

Help newsroom staff build digital, audience and AI-related skills through coaching, training and professional development.

Represent the Detroit Free Press in network initiatives and collaborate with peers across the USA TODAY Network.

Establish clear audience goals and regularly communicate performance, opportunities and successes to newsroom staff and leadership.

Ensure all audience strategies uphold Detroit Free Press standards for accuracy, fairness, ethics and journalistic excellence.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, media, marketing or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Seven or more years of experience in newsroom management and digital journalism, audience development or a related field.

Proven success leading audience growth initiatives across multiple digital platforms.

Experience managing teams and coaching journalists in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

Strong understanding of SEO, audience development, analytics and digital publishing best practices.

Demonstrated ability to use audience data and performance metrics to inform editorial strategy and decision-making.

Experience overseeing social media strategy and audience engagement efforts at scale.

Excellent news judgment, editing skills and understanding of digital storytelling.

Strong leadership, collaboration, communication and project management skills.

Ability to manage competing priorities and lead through change.

Commitment to innovation, experimentation and continuous improvement.

Management experience leading digital strategy for a news organization.

Familiarity with Parse.ly, Google Analytics, Google Search Console and other audience analytics platforms.

Experience developing newsletters, video products, creator-style journalism and other audience-growth initiatives.

Demonstrated experience implementing AI-powered newsroom tools, workflows or audience strategies.

Experience working with subscription growth, reader revenue and audience loyalty initiatives.

Knowledge of emerging audience platforms, digital product trends and changing search ecosystems.

Experience collaborating across editorial, product, marketing and business teams.

job.title: Director of Financial Planning and Analysis
job.description:
Lee Enterprises is seeking an experienced, hands-on Director of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to lead the company's financial planning, forecasting, and reporting functions. This position will play a key role in supporting financial decision-making across the organization by delivering accurate financial reporting, actionable insights, and forward-looking analysis.

The Director of FP&A will oversee the corporate FP&A team and partner closely with Finance leadership and operational business units to drive financial performance, improve reporting capabilities, and support strategic business objectives.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the company's annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes.

Coordinate financial planning activities across departments and business units, ensuring consistent assumptions, accurate submissions, and alignment with company objectives.

Drive continuous improvement in forecasting accuracy and financial planning processes.

Financial Reporting

Oversee preparation and delivery of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting packages for executive leadership.

Lead financial variance analysis, including comparisons to budget, forecast, and prior-year results, with clear explanations of key business drivers.

Support preparation of financial materials and analysis for executive leadership, Board of Directors meetings, and quarterly earnings reporting.

Partner with Accounting to ensure financial reporting accuracy, consistency, and alignment with monthly and quarterly close processes.

Business Partnership & Financial Analysis

Monitor company performance through financial and operational KPIs, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.

Serve as a key financial partner to departments and business leaders, providing analysis and actionable recommendations to support operational and strategic decisions.

Perform financial analysis related to business initiatives, cost optimization, resource allocation, and investment opportunities.

Develop and maintain models to identify opportunities to improve profitability, manage expenses, and optimize cash flow performance.

Financial Systems & Process Improvement

Oversee administration, maintenance, and ongoing development of the company's financial planning and reporting systems.

Ensure integrity, accuracy, and consistency of financial information across planning, reporting, and accounting systems.

Identify opportunities to automate reporting, streamline financial processes, and improve productivity through technology.

Develop and maintain financial reporting tools and processes, supporting training and adoption across the organization.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, mentor, and develop the corporate FP&A team, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial reporting, forecasts, and analysis.

Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities, processes, and talent to meet evolving business needs.

Core Competencies:

Strong financial planning, forecasting, financial modeling, and analytical capabilities.

Ability to interpret complex financial information and communicate meaningful insights to executive leadership.

Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to develop and motivate team members.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present financial results and recommendations clearly.

Desire to improve efficiencies through technology, automation, and process improvement.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of deliverables.

Strong attention to detail with a commitment to financial accuracy and reporting integrity.

Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and build productive working relationships.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field required.

7+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, accounting, or a related discipline.

Prior experience managing or leading finance professionals preferred.

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling required.

Experience with enterprise financial planning, reporting, or ERP systems preferred.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting tools preferred.

Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis.

Location

This position will be located at Lee Enterprises' headquarters office in Davenport, Iowa, with hybrid and remote work arrangements considered for qualified candidates.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities. We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match. We also offer generous paid time off to allow the flexibility to balance personal life and work. This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

Lee Enterprises is a leading provider of local news and information and a major subscription and advertising platform, with daily and weekly newspapers and rapidly expanding digital products serving 114 markets across 25 states. Our core commitment is to provide valuable, intensely local news and information to the communities we serve.

Lee Enterprises is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We respect and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

For more information about Lee, check us out at www.lee.net.

job.title: Senior Video Producer, Pivot
job.description:
Pivot is hiring a Senior Video Producer who will treat our YouTube channel and social video accounts as products in their own right. The successful candidate will use their creativity to produce appealing content and craft strategies that grow each channel.  This is a hands-on role for someone who's obsessed with how YouTube and short-form platforms actually work — not just a content calendar manager, but someone who analyzes the metrics, tests thumbnails and titles, and knows what makes a clip travel. Speed matters as much as strategy here: we record twice weekly, and the producer needs to turn around publish-ready clips fast — same-day or next-day — to capitalize on news moments while they're relevant. You'll also direct a small remote freelance editing team on longer-turnaround pieces. This role blends strategy, fast hands-on editing, and people management.

What You'll Do

  • Turn around quick, publishable social clips fast — same-day or next-day — with clean cuts, captions, pacing, and sound/music design that fit each platform's native style, prioritizing speed without sacrificing quality; this is a daily part of the role. 
  • Write clear, shot-by-shot scripts and edit briefs for social video clips.  
  • Edit short-form social video: clean cuts, captions, pacing, and sound/music design that fit each platform's native style, with fast turnaround as the default expectation. 
  • Optimize clipping workflow with ongoing testing and assessment of AI clipping tools.
  • When necessary, assign and oversee freelance social video editors. (Freelancers are typically reserved for higher-volume days or less time-sensitive content.)
  • Review and QC freelancer cuts for pacing, accuracy, and brand fit, and give direct feedback to keep quality consistent.
  • Partner closely with our podcast production team to guide clip selection and format decisions based on what's performing well.
  • Own YouTube channel strategy end-to-end: titles, thumbnails, descriptions, chapters, and a dedicated YouTube Shorts pipeline. Run a continuous testing process on titles and thumbnails to improve click-through and retention.
  • Set and manage the posting calendar and platform-specific strategy across Instagram, TikTok, and Threads.
  • Deliver monthly analytics reporting (subscriber growth, average view duration, CTR, follower growth by platform) and use it to inform what gets prioritized editorially on social channels.
  • Stay ahead of platform changes and emerging formats, and bring new ideas to the team proactively.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years running YouTube and/or social channels for a media brand, podcast, or creator, with a track record of measurable audience growth.
  • Fast, efficient video editing skills and a demonstrated ability to hit tight, same-day/next-day turnarounds without cutting corners on quality — this is one of the most important skills for the role.
  • Hands-on proficiency in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar, with a portfolio of short-form clips you've cut yourself (captions, pacing, sound design, platform-native formatting).
  • Experience writing or directing edit scripts/briefs for other editors, and comfort managing remote or freelance contributors — assigning work, giving feedback, and holding a quality bar.
  • Deep fluency in YouTube Studio analytics and YouTube Shorts; comfort with tools like TubeBuddy or VidIQ is a plus.
  • Strong short-form platform instincts — you can look at a piece of content and tell us whether it will work on TikTok vs. Instagram vs. YouTube Shorts, and why.
  • Experience with news, politics, business, or tech content is a strong plus given Pivot's subject matter.
  • Comfortable working with raw or long-form video/audio content and collaborating with editors on cuts.
  • A strategic, analytical mindset paired with genuine creative instinct and hands-on craft — this role is equal parts data, taste, and execution.

Description

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

Do you love uncovering what customers think, feel, and do — then turning those findings into strategies that shape a global brand? Amazon Music's Brand Insights team within the Marketing and Growth organization is looking for a Senior Brand Insights Manager to lead brand tracking and audience insights work that directly influences how we grow and connect with listeners worldwide. In this role, you will manage our global brand health tracker across 14+ markets, develop audience segmentation and profiling analyses, and partner closely with integrated marketing, brand, social media, and country teams to turn complex data into recommendations that drive annual planning, campaign measurement, and audience strategy. You'll work hand in hand with senior leadership across the full Amazon Music organization, ensuring that customer insights sit at the center of every strategic decision.

Key job responsibilities
• Manage the global brand health tracker end-to-end across 14+ markets, from evolving the survey design to vendor management and synthesizing data trends into narrative-driven reports.
• Deliver quarterly and ad hoc reports that track performance across key metrics, surfacing notable trends and changes in brand health
• Leverage first and third-party data to measure holistic brand impact of specific cross-channel activations with target audiences
• Drive ongoing socialization of brand insights and partner with stakeholders (primarily across Marketing verticals) to distill findings into opportunities for optimization and strategic planning
• Conduct meta-analyses to explore strategic questions related to brand impact and the metrics that matter
• Develop audience profiles and segmentation analyses to inform targeting, messaging, and strategy for key listener segments
• Serve as the primary POC for stakeholders across the organization on brand health/measurement and audience insights requests
• Manage ongoing vendor/agency relationships end-to-end, including contract and budget oversight, multi-market fieldwork coordination, and reviewing deliverable reports with actionable feedback
• Build and maintain interactive dashboards and self-service tools for brand and audience data, partnering with third party platforms and internal data science teams
• Build scalable and nimble research solutions and processes, leveraging automation and AI tools to raise the bar on how insights are produced and consumed across the organization
• Drive measurable impact to the business and customer experience through research adoption and integration into strategic decision-making


A day in the life
Your primary focus is brand tracking and audience insights for Amazon Music on a global scale. You might start the morning reviewing the latest brand health data across multiple markets, identifying shifts in upper and mid-funnel metrics and preparing a narrative for your stakeholders. By midday, you're meeting with the integrated marketing or social media team to walk through how a recent campaign moved key brand metrics and where to optimize next. In the afternoon, you could be building audience segment profiles with internal data science partners or coordinating fieldwork with a vendor across several countries. Between meetings, you're refining dashboards, exploring automation opportunities, and connecting the dots between what the data says and what the business should do about it. Throughout, you're collaborating with country heads and senior leaders to ensure audience strategies and planning frameworks are grounded in real listener behavior.

About the team
As the Amazon Music Global Brand Insights team, we are responsible for producing best-in-class market research and customer insights. Our domain spans four key pillars: 1) Brand, 2) Go-to-Market (GTM), 3) Customer Lifecycle research, and 4) Audience, delivering data-driven, actionable recommendations for our business and brand. Our work is strategic in nature and aims to provide value to the entire organization, worldwide, and we are intentional about seeing insight through to action. Our overarching vision is to help teams across AM feel confident in making customer-obsessed decisions. We humanize complex data into compelling narratives and actionable strategies to drive growth for AM. We utilize a mix of traditional approaches and innovative methods to uncover both near- and long-term opportunities. We sit in the Marketing and Growth org, reporting to the Global Head of Brand Marketing.

- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
