Scripps affiliate in Cincinnati, Ohio, is seeking a dynamic Account Executive who will help local businesses realize growth opportunities by reaching customers through compelling multi-platform advertising solutions. You'll be at the forefront of the evolving media landscape, offering everything from traditional broadcast television to cutting-edge digital marketing solutions.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 

  • Sell advertising solutions to local and regional businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Apply the Scripps Sales Process (SSP) to analyze current and prospective customer needs and apply customized advertising solutions that provide return on their investment.
  • In addition to television commercial airtime sales, facilitate the customer’s ability to take advantage of the full array of digital marketing options available.
  • Independently prospect, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, present and close sales to develop and maintain new business from traditional and non-traditional advertisers.
  • Use ratings data, qualitative information, and market trends to negotiate program ratings and advertising rates with advertising agencies in order to maximize revenue as well as develop custom solutions for new advertisers.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor with new and existing clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications, and collection of revenue due.
  • Effectively and proactively manage a sales funnel by way of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, monitoring and achieving key performance indicators and expected activity levels.
  • Contribute to the creative development of campaigns through client communication and needs analysis, storyboard and concept creation, and assistance in production aspects.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of a media salesperson including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with sales leadership regarding the status of accounts
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
     

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

 

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 2+ years of proven sales success preferred
  • Experience in strategic account management, broadcast ratings and digital execution preferred

 

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

 

  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused
  • Highly creative and innovative thinker
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)

Cincinnati offers an incredible blend of Midwestern charm and big-city amenities, making it one of the most livable cities in America. Known for its rich history, world-class museums, and vibrant arts scene, Cincinnati is home to the renowned Cincinnati Symphony Orchestra, Cincinnati Ballet, and the contemporary arts scene in Over-the-Rhine. job.title: Sr. Analyst, Strategic Partner Development
job.description:
Are you ready to drive revenue growth and operational excellence in the fast-paced world of digital media? We're looking for a strategic, results-driven Senior Analyst, Strategic Partner Development to lead the optimization of our digital monetization platforms and partner-managed revenue channels. In this role, you'll be at the intersection of technology, revenue strategy, and cross-functional collaboration—maximizing performance, solving complex challenges, and ensuring our digital operations align with business priorities and brand safety standards.


If you thrive on turning data into action, building strong partnerships, and leading initiatives that directly impact the bottom line, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact at Scripps.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with external platform partners or clients serving as key operational contact.
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key platform and technology partners, including YouTube/Google, serving as a primary liaison to drive revenue growth, platform optimization, content monetization, and partner success.
  • Lead day-to-day platform performance, revenue activity, and compliance requirements for assigned digital monetization platforms, accounts, or partner channels.
  • Support the development, implementation, and refinement of monetization strategies to improve revenue yield, operational efficiency, content monetization, rights management, brand safety, and policy compliance.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex platform, policy, delivery, reporting, or monetization issues; assess root causes and develop practical solutions.
  • Provide timely reporting and analysis to cross-functional teams that connects platform performance, revenue trends, audience behavior, inventory performance, and partner updates to identify risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Content, Product, Sales, Ad Operations, and other stakeholders to identify and execute new monetization opportunities, evaluate emerging platform capabilities, and support business development initiatives that advance Scripps' digital revenue strategy.
  • Maintain a consistent operating rhythm with external platform or technology partners by coordinating updates, tracking follow-through, and communicating changes that may affect revenue, workflows, or compliance.
  • Support cross-functional projects related to platform launches, monetization tools, workflow improvements, reporting enhancements, or partner initiatives.
  • Develop documentation, training materials, and best-practice guidance to support consistency, accountability, and scalability across accounts or platforms.
  • Act as a resource for less experienced team members by providing guidance on complex issues, reviewing work for accuracy, and sharing platform knowledge.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Experience building strategic partnerships with digital platforms, including YouTube/Google, to drive revenue growth and content monetization, is strongly preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Advanced skill with digital ad operations, platform monetization, video operations, or a related digital media role with a track record of increasing responsibility
  • Strong understanding of platform policies, partner requirements, brand safety, rights management, and compliance impacts
  • Ability to analyze complex performance data and translate insights into revenue-focused recommendations
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex, ambiguous, or non-routine issues independently
  • Project leadership skills, including cross-functional coordination, stakeholder influence, and initiative execution
  • Clear communication skills for technical, operational, business, and leadership audiences
  • Strong relationship-building skills with internal teams and external platform or technology partners
  • Ability to mentor others and promote consistent practices across teams or accounts

job.description:

Scripps is seeking a strategic Sr. Account Manager, SMB Growth & Direct Response to join our dynamic team in New York City. In this role, you'll be the driving force behind strengthening advertiser and agency relationships while delivering integrated media solutions that span linear television, digital, and streaming/CTV platforms. If you're passionate about maximizing campaign performance and building strategic partnerships that drive real business results, this is your opportunity to shine.

  • Manage the day-to-day execution, delivery, and performance of assigned accounts and campaigns to meet client objectives, revenue goals, retention targets, and performance KPIs.
  • Serve as a contact for advertisers and agencies, developing a strong understanding of their business objectives, target audiences, marketing strategies, and performance goals while providing responsive, solutions-oriented support as well as upselling opportunities.

  • Partner with Sales, Ad Operations, Traffic, Inventory, Research, Marketing, Content, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure effective planning, execution, issue resolution, and delivery of client commitments.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Demonstrated understanding of national advertising landscapes, agency structures, and enterprise-level client requirements preferred
  • Strong and comprehensive understanding of linear TV, digital, and streaming/CTV media planning, buying, and optimization across integrated platforms
  • Knowledge of Direct Response advertising, performance metrics (CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates), and campaign management processes
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret campaign data, identify optimization opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations
  • Exceptional client-service and communication skills
  • Ability to effectively present strategic recommendations to advertisers, agencies, and internal stakeholders
  • Demonstrated capability in end-to-end campaign oversight with focus on revenue optimization and strategic partnership alignment
  • Proficiency in CRM, analytics platforms, and Microsoft Office with strong organizational skills to prioritize competing demands in fast-paced environments

New York City is the epicenter of media, advertising, and innovation—and there's no better place to advance your career in strategic account management. job.title: Production Manager, Remote & Studio
job.description:
Tennis Channel is seeking a Production Manager to plan and execute full-scale productions for live remote events and studio shows, both domestic and international. This role calls for a highly organized, proactive, and quick-thinking professional with strong communication and interpersonal skills. As a representative of Tennis Channel at events around the world, the Production Manager will maintain a professional appearance and demeanor and serve as an ambassador for the network on an international stage.

What You’ll Do

Remote Production

  • Serve as the primary liaison between production teams and a wide range of partners, including facility management, senior production staff, production and technical crews, talent, site operations, vendors, tournament directors, and other network representatives.
  • Coordinate facilities with host venues and broadcasters, including [V&A] bookings, office space, power, venue logistics, shipping, and transmission.
  • Supervise staffing needs for domestic and international remote productions and help source experienced crews for ATP Masters 1000 events.
  • Oversee the acquisition and distribution of production elements such as event footage, music and music cue sheets, graphics, and equipment.
  • Partner with the Travel and Finance teams to coordinate hotel accommodations.
  • Manage credentials, venue access, parking, catering, and crew scheduling.
  • Plan and track rental equipment, logistics, and shipping.

Studio Production

  • Help supervise studio coordination, staff, and facilities alongside the Production Coordinator.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between internal and external partners during world feed production.
  • Collaborate with production teams to ensure assigned productions meet the network’s creative and technical objectives.
  • Help train new hires in production department processes and procedures.

Across Remote and Studio

  • Create, maintain, and quality-check production books, call sheets, daily crew call times, schedules, trackers, and planning documents using Lasso and established Excel templates.
  • Partner with the Director of Finance and the Production Accountant to manage costs, coordinate crew and show requirements, and ensure timely processing of timecards and contracts/deal memos.

What You Bring

  • Preferred 5+ years of experience in production management or a related role in sports or entertainment production.
  • Proven ability to oversee complex remote productions, manage venue operations and logistics, and work closely with venue management and host broadcasters.
  • Strong ability to multitask and manage several productions from start to finish in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to adapt and thrive in constantly changing environments with unpredictable challenges and a wide range of personalities.
  • Enthusiasm for hands-on work and the resourcefulness to roll up your sleeves and make things happen.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience with Smartsheet preferred; familiarity with Lasso is a plus.

Schedule and Travel

  • Domestic and international travel averaging about 4 months per year, including Grand Slams and other tournaments as needed.
  • Willingness to work 50+ hours per week on a flexible schedule that includes days, nights, weekends, and holidays. The tennis season runs January through November, with the heaviest workload from May through September.

 

Tennis Channel is proud to be equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

 

About Tennis Channel
 

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. Tennis Channel 2, a free FAST channel available in over 100 million homes, brings fans matches from across the globe at every level of the game. The Tennis Channel app brings it all together in one place, delivering live and on-demand matches, original content, and a personalized multi-view experience for fans, available on mobile and connected TV devices. Owned by Sinclair, Tennis Channel is also a co-owner of PickleballTV (pickleballtv.com), a joint venture with the Professional Pickleball Association.


About Sinclair

Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 185 television stations in 86 markets affiliated with all the major broadcast networks; and owns Tennis Channel and multicast networks Comet, CHARGE!, ROAR, and The Nest. Sinclair's content is delivered via multiple platforms, including over-the-air, multi-channel video program distributors, and the nation's largest streaming aggregator of local news content, NewsON. The Company regularly uses its website as a key source of Company information which can be accessed at www.sbgi.net.

Here is a glimpse: great benefits, open-door policy, upward mobility and a strong desire to see you succeed. Ready to be part of a winning team? Let’s talk.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Associate
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: Amplify our sales and marketing team efforts, by helping us to grow our customer base and enhance our brand presence in the market and providing day-to-day business support. This means helping them fulfill orders, manage accounts, craft proposals, create engaging presentations, and develop materials that clearly communicate the benefits of our services. Your creativity will play a huge role here in driving results. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!

 

o Campaign Development: Work with the sales and marketing team to design and implement campaigns that drive sales and amplify brand awareness across various multimedia platforms.

 

o Market Research: Conduct in-depth market research to understand trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities to amplify our sales strategies.

 

o Data Analysis:  Data-driven decisions are the name of the game! Report and analyze sales data, providing insights to optimize our strategies for better results.

 

o Unleash Your Potential: Dive headfirst into the exciting world of media sales, where every interaction is an opportunity to make a lasting impression!

 

o Collaborate and Grow: Work closely with our focused media sales teams and other departments. Ensuring everyone is on the same page creates a cohesive approach to sales marketing, which is super important for overall success. Connect with internal and external clients, building relationships to understand their needs to provide support. Together, we'll amplify our impact and achieve remarkable results!

 

o Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep your finger on the pulse of industry trends and competitive strategies to ensure we're always a step ahead in the marketplace.

 

What We're Looking For

job.title: Editor, Criminally Obsessed
job.description:
About Criminally Obsessed

Criminally Obsessed is Sinclair’s true crime media brand, and it is focused on the cases, investigations and stories that capture the public’s attention. Criminally Obsessed brings together compelling crime news and journalism, expert analysis, exclusive interviews and original storytelling and content across digital platforms.

The Criminally Obsessed Daily Show is a daily crime news and analysis program covering the biggest and most compelling criminal stories making headlines across the country. It goes beyond simply recapping the day’s news. Each episode is built around the most interesting development, question, detail or perspective surrounding a case and is led by an interview that drives the conversation. It is a vodcast and podcast, so the production team constructs each episode keeping in mind that the audience will need to be interested visually and audibly. 

About Sinclair

Sinclair is one of the largest media companies in the United States, with an extensive portfolio in digital media, national programming, local television, news, sports, and entertainment. Sinclair’s portfolio is an asset to Criminally Obsessed, with nearly 30 years of archival content, reporters and photographers on the ground, on the scene and in court. 

Sinclair’s strength is in its wide reach combined with its deep connection to local audiences and journalism. The company continues to expand its digital footprint andcontinues to develop content designed for a multiplatform audience.

About the role

Criminally Obsessed is looking for a talented and creative Editor to join the production team behind the daily show. This is more than a technical editing position. We are lookingfor someone who understands storytelling, pacing, visual language and YouTube audience retention – someone who knows how to turn raw material into a compelling piece of content that makes people want to click, watch and keep watching. 

The Editor for Criminally Obsessed is responsible for the editorial preparation, production, post-production, and delivery of daily and episodic content. This role works closely with the Producer, Senior Producer, Production Assistant, the host, and guests to ensure content is accurate, compelling, visually engaging, technically sound, and delivered on deadline.

The Editor is expected to have a strong understanding of true-crime news, storytelling, editorial standards, broadcast and digital production workflows, and the technical requirements necessary to deliver polished content across multiple platforms. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound editorial judgment, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced production environment. 

We are particularly interested in candidates who understand the unique demands of YouTube as a viewing platform and can bring a digital-first approach to editing, with an eye toward creating content that captures attention, sustains viewer interest, and encourages audiences to keep watching. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Attend Content Strategy Sessions to pitch and produce original social-first true crime content
  • Collaborate with assigned producers and talent to research and gather all necessary creative materials for approved projects
  • Work independently to assemble and edit assigned content through all stages of post-production and the review process
  • Utilize the full Adobe Creative Suite and other design tools to create motion graphics, to deliver high-quality content
  • Design social graphics including thumbnails that maintain brand guidelines
  • Make informed editorial decisions around content, episode length, and metadata, optimizing show for maximum audience growth
  • Advise on workflows to ensure production efficiency; educate both internal and external teams on best practices
  • Keep up with latest trends, software updates, and platform changes to help drive innovative ways to create new content

CORE RESPONSIBILITIESPRE-PRODUCTION

  • Once a topic or editorial angle for the Daily Show has been selected, thoroughly familiarize yourself with the case and the planned story.
  • Develop a working knowledge of the key people, locations, timeline, events, and relevant facts associated with each case. 
  • Review and become familiar with all available editorial, archival, photographic,video, audio, and other media assets.
  • Gather, organize, label, and prepare assets for efficient use during the editing process.
  • Research and obtain appropriate guest information, including names, backgrounds, photographs, video, and information required for lower thirds and other on-screen graphics.
  • Review interview shots and technical setup prior to recording to ensure appropriate framing, lighting, video quality, and audio quality.
  • Be available during recordings to identify and troubleshoot technical or visual issues as they arise.
  • Review raw recordings and correct or flag audio, video, or other technical issues to ensure the highest possible quality before editing.

PRODUCTION / EDITING

  • Edit Producer-created papercuts/scripts, A-roll, and other editorial materials into a polished and cohesive Daily Show segment.
  • Review and incorporate media gathered by the Editor, Senior Producer, Producer, or Associate Producer and identified in the papercut.
  • Select and appropriately place B-roll and supporting visual elements to complement the narration, interviews, and editorial beats of each story.
  • Maintain strong visual storytelling throughout each segment, using appropriatepacing, imagery, graphics, sound, and transitions.
  • Proactively communicate with the Producer and Senior Producer regarding editorial changes, creative opportunities, or potential improvements to the visual presentation, audio quality, pacing, and overall flow of the Daily Show.
  • Create and incorporate graphics for the Daily Show, including fullscreens,dates/courtesies, lower thirds, and other required on-screen elements.
  • Ensure graphics, captions, names, dates, and other editorial information areaccurate and consistent with established production standards.
  • Deliver a clean, polished first pass to the Producer/Senior Producer for review.
  • Implement notes, corrections, and editorial changes efficiently and accurately through subsequent edit passes.
  • Maintain appropriate legal courtesies and source attribution for non-Sinclair content in accordance with established standards and requirements.
  • Complete final edits and deliver finished episodes including accurate time codes for designated advertising breaks.
  • Meet established production deadlines while maintaining a high standard of editorial and technical quality.
     

POST-PRODUCTION

  • Archive and properly organize all content and media assets used in each episode in accordance with established file management and archival procedures.
  • Edit and deliver episodes for a digital broadcast tv network
  • Prepare and edit content intended for broadcast on Sinclair news stations and upload completed materials to location.
  • Edit sales-related audio and video advertisements and promotional materials for sponsorships as assigned.
  • Ensure all final deliverables meet applicable technical specifications, formatting requirements, and deadlines.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Stay current on true-crime content creators, podcasts, news organizations, emerging stories, and relevant industry trends, and proactively contribute compelling content ideas during daily editorial meetings.
  • Maintain awareness of developing stories and potential editorial opportunities that may be relevant to Criminally Obsessed.
  • Collaborate effectively with Producers, Senior Producers, Associate Producers, and other members of the production team.
  • Communicate proactively regarding production challenges, scheduling concerns, technical issues, or potential delays.
  • Maintain organized project files, media, and editorial materials to support an efficient production workflow.
  • Perform other job-related duties and special projects as assigned by the manager.
  • Schedule and hours may flex based on business needs, production requirements, breaking news, or other editorial priorities. Occasional after-hours or weekend coverage may be required when warranted.
  • Travel approximately 10–20% as needed for conferences, training, on-site content coverage, or other business-related assignments.
  • Safely lift, carry, and maneuver equipment or production gear weighing up to 25 pounds, while following all applicable safety procedures and protocols.

PROFESSIONAL EXPECTATIONS

  • Demonstrate strong editorial judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to accuracy.
  • Consistently meet deadlines and communicate promptly when priorities or circumstances may affect delivery.
  • Maintain a collaborative, solution-oriented approach when working with the production team.
     
  • Exercise discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive, graphic, or confidential subject matter.
  • Follow all applicable company policies, editorial standards, legal requirements, technical specifications, and production procedures.
  • Take ownership of assigned projects from initial preparation through final deliveryand archival.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years hands-on experience in all aspects of video production and post production including shooting, lighting, sound recording & editing, and ability to operate and troubleshoot all associated equipment
  • Highly skilled across Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Premiere Rush, Photoshop,After Effects, etc), and other creative software
  • Demonstrated experience editing content for an established YouTube channel, with an understanding of YouTube-specific storytelling, audience retention, pacing, and visual engagement.
  • Experience using YouTube performance metrics, including audience retention and watch time, to inform editing decisions and identify opportunities to improve viewer engagement and overall channel performance
  • Strong understanding of video editing techniques and storytelling
  • Demonstrated experience in motion graphics and creating social media video content
  • Strong knowledge of YouTube and its best practices
  • Proficiency in designing graphics, including thumbnails and infographics
  • An eye for quality content, with an understanding of what plays well across various channels
  • This position requires impeccable spelling and grammar, a deep understanding of social media trends and what works on each platform, vertical video editing skills, and the ability to capture well-composed videos on a phone
  • Must be highly motivated, extremely organized, and come to the position with a uniquely creative mind
  • Flexibility to travel and work nights and/or weekends, as projects call for
  • Only applicants with portfolios, sites, or reels of their work will be considered

job.title: Customer Service Manager
job.description:
Are you ready to help customers get clear, timely answers and a dependable support experience? In this fast-paced role, you will guide digital support requests from intake through resolution, helping stations and sales teams get the information they need to keep campaigns moving.

The Customer Support Manager is a part of a team that manages inquiries through the Digital Helpdesk and responds to questions about programmatic delivery, campaign setup, access, products, and performance. The team uses a ticketing system to organize and prioritize work, investigate issues, coordinate with internal teams and vendors, and keep customers informed until each request is resolved.

We value thoughtful communication, accountability, and a strong focus on service quality. If you enjoy solving problems and making support easier for customers, this role offers a meaningful way to contribute to our digital media work.

Customer Support Duties:

  • Manage customer inquiries in the Helpdesk ticketing system from intake through resolution, organizing, prioritizing, and tracking each request.
  • Respond promptly to customer questions and issues, keep requests moving, and resolve them within agreed-upon time frames and service-level expectations.
  • Answer questions about programmatic delivery, campaign setup, product access, and performance in clear language customers can understand.
  • Review ticket history, order details, campaign setup, pacing, and available reporting to investigate issues and identify next steps.
  • Resolve requests directly when appropriate and coordinate escalations to Ad Operations, Analytics, Technical Account Support, Product, Engineering, or vendors when additional expertise is needed.
  • Provide clear status updates, explain next steps, and maintain professional communication with customers and internal partners throughout the resolution process.
  • Maintain accurate ticket notes, supporting details, customer communications, and resolution steps so each request has a clear record and can be followed through to closure.
  • Become an expert in the ticketing system and use its features to manage, monitor, and resolve customer inquiries effectively.
  • Meet or exceed established service-level agreements and other service measures for response, resolution, and ticket quality.

 

Role Requirements

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information in a customer-friendly way.
  • Strong reading comprehension, active listening, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good organization, attention to detail, and reliable follow-through on open requests.
  • Able to prioritize competing requests and work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, hybrid environment.
  • Able to stay calm, professional, and helpful when responding to customer questions or concerns.
  • Commitment to meeting service-level agreements, response and resolution time frames, and quality standards.
  • Willing to learn, receive feedback, and adapt to changing products, systems, and priorities.
  • Customer service, helpdesk, or digital advertising experience preferred.
  • Experience with Jira or another ticketing system is a plus; able to learn ticket workflows and system features in depth.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel, or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of programmatic advertising, digital campaign delivery, or ad operations is a plus.
  • Candidates must be available during regular US business hours, including Pacific Standard Time as needed 

 

Qualifications

  • College Degree
  • 2+ years job experience ideally in the digital industry

 

The hourly compensation range for this role is $20.43 to $24.03. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: News Reporter/Anchor
job.description:
The news team at FOX 26 and FOX Local Houston is transforming how local news is gathered and delivered. We no longer wait for appointed times to deliver content. We're a 24/7 STREAMING FIRST news organization.

As we continue to evolve, we’re hiring a News Reporter/Anchor for our evening news block. The person chosen for this role will bring the passion and skillset to create and deliver live and unscripted content across streaming programs and platforms, digital news sites, social media and on linear TV.

You’ll focus on reporting big news of the day, adding depth and context to stories in our newly formatted early evening news block from 5:00-6:30pm. Then you’ll transition to our redesigned newsroom, where you’ll anchor 90 minutes of live, unscripted news, while operating our Tricaster switcher. You’ll end your day, anchoring our 10pm linear news broadcast from our primary studio.

Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A streaming and digital-first mindset, that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs. You’re as comfortable and skilled delivering unscripted content as you are with a teleprompter. You bring the same enthusiasm to your delivery and on-air performance regardless of format, studio environment or platform.
  • You ditched the “anchor voice” long ago and you’ve mastered a more authentic style of delivery that doesn’t rely on a teleprompter.  We don’t use teleprompters in our streaming news programs.
  • You have experience and skill anchoring continuous live breaking news events and severe weather such as hurricanes, tornado outbreaks and winter storm coverage. This experience and skill are evident on your reel.
  • You’ve spent a minimum of 3-5 years in the field as a news reporter, covering big news stories, honing your journalism, polishing your on-air performance and proving that the best anchors have built a reputation as aggressive, successful reporters.
  • You have an insatiable curiosity about the world around you, from local and state government and how decisions by elected officials impact our audience to a daily understanding of what’s happening globally and the ability to take complex subjects and make them compelling and relatable.
  • You have experience field anchoring big news, demonstrating a range of skills from hard news and politics to sports and community events.
  • You are a leader in the newsroom, with a demonstrated track record of mentoring younger reporters, helping them become better storytellers and writers.
  • You are an engaged copy editor, carefully reviewing and signing off on scripts before they go on air. You provide constructive feedback and actively participate in the editorial process.
  • You have a relentless commitment to accuracy in your reporting, whether scripted or unscripted. You have impeccable journalistic ethics and integrity. You can spot problematic copy, flag stories that need more vetting, unearth biased narratives and make sound decisions under deadline pressure.
  • You’ve already created a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.  Your content is rooted in news, not selfies and vacation photos.

You must have significant experience as an anchor, on top of 3-5 year of experience as a reporter in a professional news operation. Candidates who have experience hosting unscripted, live news streaming programs will move up the list. This is not an entry-level position or a position for candidates who do not possess a journalism background. 

We’re a 24/7 news operation, so you must be able to work non-traditional hours, weekends and holidays as needed.

The Audience Sr. Product Manager will own the vision, roadmap, and execution of NBCUniversal's audience platform, the products advertisers and internal teams use to build, enrich, forecast, and activate audiences across NBCU's linear, streaming, and digital inventory. This role partners closely with data science, engineering, sales, ad operations, and privacy teams to turn first-party, partner, and third-party data into high-performing, privacy-safe audience segments.   • Partner with sales, ad sales planning, and client teams to understand advertiser and agency needs, translating them into audience products that win business and simplify the planning-to-activation workflow.
  • Ensure audiences activate reliably across NBCU's linear, addressable, streaming (including Peacock), and digital platforms, working with ad tech, ad operations, and partner integration teams.
  • Collaborate with data operations, measurement, and clean room teams to connect audience definitions to reach and availability forecasts, campaign delivery, and outcome reporting.
  • Partner closely with legal, privacy, and data governance teams to ensure audience products meet consent, data-use, and regulatory requirements, translating these constraints into product requirements.

NBCUniversal est l’une des principales entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial que nous diffusons par l’entremise de notre portefeuille de films, de télévision et de plateformes de diffusion en continu, et que nous faisons vivre grâce à nos destinations de parcs thématiques, à nos produits de consommation et à nos expériences partout dans le monde. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des émissions de premier ordre par l’entremise de nos importants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que des quatre studios de télévision internationaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de premier plan partout dans le monde par l’entremise d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, où se trouve Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour en savoir plus.

Notre impact repose sur notre volonté d’améliorer les communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir aux membres de notre personnel la possibilité de s’investir au service de leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer une vaste gamme de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

We’re looking for a Producer for an exciting interactive entertainment project to support the creation, tracking, and execution of game assets for a discipline (environment, characters, audio, animation). In this role, you will help teams stay organized by maintaining asset schedules, tracking progress, coordinating priorities, following up on dependencies, and supporting milestone delivery.

You will work closely with craft directors, producers, pod leads, and multidisciplinary teams to define execution strategy of asset production from request through review, approval, integration, and delivery. You will help ensure creative and technical asset goals are translated into clear tasks, visible progress, and reliable execution across disciplines, pods, and pillars.

RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Formalize asset creation workflows and determine requirements for asset management.
  • Oversee, build and/or maintain asset schedules, task lists, production plans, and milestone deliverables.
  • Track daily progress across assigned teams and ensure asset status is accurate in project tools.
  • Maintain visibility on blockers, dependencies, approvals, reviews, known issues, and next steps.
  • Coordinate priorities between craft directors, product owners, producers, pod leads, and pillar needs.
  • Support asset reviews, feedback sessions, approvals, and follow-up actions.
  • Identify risks, blockers, or priority conflicts and escalate them to producers or production leadership.
  • Facilitate communication between design, engineering, art, animation, audio, QA, and other departments.
  • Help maintain production tracking tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.
  • Work with QA and development teams to ensure asset-related issues are tracked and followed up effectively.
  • Support milestone readiness by helping ensure asset deliverables, dependencies, reviews, and known issues are clearly tracked.
  • Help refine asset workflows, pipelines, tracking practices, and communication habits.
  • Contribute to retrospectives or post-milestone reviews and follow through on actionable improvements.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste de producteur ou productrice dans le cadre d’un projet captivant de divertissement interactif, afin de soutenir la création, le suivi et l’exécution des éléments de jeu pour une discipline (environnements, personnages, audio, animation). Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez les équipes à rester organisées en tenant à jour les calendriers de production des éléments, en assurant le suivi de l’avancement, en coordonnant les priorités, en effectuant le suivi des dépendances et en soutenant la livraison des jalons.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de disciplines, les producteurs et productrices, les responsables de pods et les équipes multidisciplinaires afin de définir la stratégie d’exécution de la production des éléments, depuis la demande jusqu’à la révision, l’approbation, l’intégration et la livraison. Vous contribuerez à faire en sorte que les objectifs créatifs et techniques liés aux éléments soient traduits en tâches claires, en progrès visibles et en une exécution fiable dans l’ensemble des disciplines, des pods et des piliers.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Formaliser les flux de travail liés à la création des éléments et déterminer les exigences en matière de gestion des éléments.
  • Superviser, élaborer et/ou tenir à jour les calendriers de production des éléments, les listes de tâches, les plans de production et les livrables associés aux jalons.
  • Assurer le suivi quotidien de l’avancement des équipes assignées et veiller à ce que le statut des éléments soit exact dans les outils de gestion de projet.
  • Maintenir une visibilité claire sur les obstacles, les dépendances, les approbations, les révisions, les problèmes connus et les prochaines étapes.
  • Coordonner les priorités entre les responsables de disciplines, les responsables de produits, les producteurs et productrices, les responsables de pods et les besoins des différents piliers.
  • Soutenir les révisions des éléments, les séances de rétroaction, les approbations et les mesures de suivi.
  • Repérer les risques, les obstacles ou les conflits de priorités et les signaler aux producteurs et productrices ou à la direction de la production.
  • Faciliter la communication entre les équipes de design, d’ingénierie, d’art, d’animation, d’audio, de QA et les autres services.
  • Contribuer à la tenue à jour des outils de suivi de production tels que Jira, Confluence ou des outils similaires.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de QA et de développement afin de veiller à ce que les problèmes liés aux éléments soient consignés et fassent l’objet d’un suivi efficace.
  • Soutenir la préparation des jalons en contribuant à assurer un suivi clair des livrables liés aux éléments, des dépendances, des révisions et des problèmes connus.
  • Contribuer à améliorer les flux de travail, les pipelines, les pratiques de suivi et les habitudes de communication liés aux éléments.
  • Contribuer aux rétrospectives ou aux revues post-jalon et assurer le suivi des améliorations pouvant être mises en œuvre.

Basic Requirements: 

  • 8+ years of experience in game production, asset coordination, project coordination, external development coordination, or related production roles.
  • Experience supporting content teams, asset production, or a related production role for a specific discipline.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to track multiple assets, tasks, dependencies, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Strong communication and follow-up skills.
  • Comfortable working with creative and technical teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Ability to clarify next steps, maintain visibility, and keep information organized.
  • Proactive mindset with a willingness to solve problems and remove friction.
  • Experience using JIRA or similar project management tools.
  • Interest in AAA game development, asset production, and content pipelines.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing environment with professionalism and adaptability.

Exigences de base : 

  • 8 ans ou plus d’expérience en production de jeux, en coordination d’éléments, en coordination de projets, en coordination du développement externe ou dans des rôles connexes en production.
  • Expérience dans le soutien d’équipes de contenu, la production d’éléments ou un rôle connexe en production pour une discipline précise.
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et grand souci du détail.
  • Capacité à assurer le suivi de multiples éléments, tâches, dépendances, priorités et échéances.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en suivi.
  • Aisance à travailler avec des équipes créatives et techniques dans plusieurs disciplines.
  • Capacité à clarifier les prochaines étapes, à maintenir une bonne visibilité sur l’avancement et à garder l’information organisée.
  • Esprit proactif et volonté de résoudre les problèmes et d’éliminer les obstacles.
  • Expérience avec JIRA ou des outils de gestion de projet similaires.
  • Intérêt pour le développement de jeux AAA, la production d’éléments et les pipelines de contenu.
  • Capacité à travailler dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution, avec professionnalisme et adaptabilité.

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Experience with asset pipelines, review cycles, approvals, dependencies, and delivery tracking.
  • Experience with production tracking, asset lists, delivery reporting, or milestone planning.
  • Understanding of agile production, sprint planning, backlog tracking, or milestone execution.
  • Experience working with craft directors, pod leads, artists, designers, engineers, or QA teams.
  • Background in a creative production discipline.
  • Experience with tools such as Confluence, Miro, Perforce, Git, or build tracking systems.

Caractéristiques souhaitées : 

  • Expérience des pipelines d’éléments, des cycles de révision, des approbations, des dépendances et du suivi des livraisons.
  • Expérience du suivi de production, des listes d’éléments, des rapports de livraison ou de la planification des jalons.
  • Compréhension de la production Agile, de la planification des sprints, du suivi du backlog ou de l’exécution des jalons.
  • Expérience de travail avec des responsables de disciplines, des responsables de pods, des artistes, des designers, des ingénieurs ou des équipes de QA.

  • Expérience avec des outils tels que Confluence, Miro, Perforce, Git ou des systèmes de suivi des builds.

More Americans watch NBC News than any news organization in the world. NBC News’ leading and award-winning television news broadcasts include TODAY, NBC Nightly News, Meet the Press, and Dateline NBC. The rapidly-growing NBC News Digital Group – including its streaming news services NBC News NOW and TODAY All Day – and the network’s award-winning original podcast and audio unit provide continuous content to consumers wherever they are, whenever they want it.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:
Production

  • TODAY: Work directly with producers on stories/segments, with Production Managers in the control room and green room, log tapes, conduct research on assigned topics.
  • Weekend TODAY: Assist producers with research and gathering content for upcoming segments, compile different news stories to pitch to producers for segments, log and transcribe interviews for producers and record music hit times for music cues.
  • Nightly News: Log video, research for stories, answer newsroom phones, pitch story ideas, daily distribution of rundown/scripts.
  • Weekend Nightly News: Log video, research for stories, answer newsroom phones, pitch story ideas, daily distribution of rundown/scripts.
  • Dateline: Plan for morning editorial/pitch meeting: log shows, build slide decks, research stories. Log b roll, transcripts and help prepare for edit.
  • Specials: Compile research for editorial preparation, compile research packets, select and compile footage & stills for on-air elements, design and manage graphics, print and deliver scripts.
  • Investigative Unit: Researching, filing records requests, analyzing data, organizing media, and assisting on local shoots.
  • Booking Unit: Assist the team with guest research and upcoming events, manage lists/pitch packets, support the team with in-studio guests/shoots.
  • Business Technology & Innovation Unit: Assist digital, television, and investigative teams with research, newsgathering, and story production, monitor news outlets for breaking news, pitch enterprise news stories.
  • Climate/Weather Unit: Forecast research, WSI Tru Vu Max graphic creation and updating, researching and presenting information on Climate change and Climate solutions.
  • Network Desk: Assist during breaking news by making calls to relevant sources, by listening to radio traffic by EMS or local police, by logging press conferences and by checking social media postings from witnesses and others. Assist w/the logistics of sending NBC News teams (correspondents, producers, crews, engineers, etc) to cover the news on location.
  • Audio Unit: Here’s the Scoop is NBC’s flagship daily news podcast. The Intern will get exposure to all aspects of daily audio and video production, from researching and booking, to writing headlines and interview scripts, studio recording to audio/video editing, postproduction for audio/video platforms and social media.
  • NBC News Now: Research and fact check stories, assist in editing video and graphics, pitch stories for daily and future segments, mine and edit video and sound.

Commerce

  • NBC Selected: Building articles in our CMS, tracking editorial workflow, helping shape new copy flows and more. You will also have the opportunity to write new e-commerce content for the site, as well as update existing content.

Editorial

  • Digital Documentary: Assisting in pre- and post-production including research, gathering, and cataloguing material from NBC archives. You will also be pitching stories and assisting in story development.
  • Digital Platforms: Marketing promotion plans and alerts for top stories. You will be writing different variations of headlines for stories to optimize click-through rate and engagement.
  • Digital Culture & Trends: Writing and reporting stories on pop culture, entertainment, internet trends and lifestyle news. You’ll work alongside reporters and editors to pitch and write stories for NBCNews.com, contribute to breaking news coverage and help cover major pop culture events.
  • Digital Health & Medical: Reporting and writing timely, in-depth original features on a wide range of health topics for the website. The intern will be interviewing experts about medical studies, pitching story ideas, and identifying trends in lifestyle and wellness, including nutrition and women’s and men’s health.
  • Today.com: Assisting editors across TODAY.com’s news/trending and lifestyle teams, and writing for sections including Pop Culture, Health, Food, Parents, Style and TMRW.

Social

  • Social Newsgathering: Using digital platforms to find user-generated content, verify social media-sourced content, interview sources and obtain information for the network's coverage. You will be covering a range of stories from breaking news to investigations and feature topics.
  • NBC News Social, TODAY Social: Helping drive social media production and publication to multiple social media accounts. You will be writing headlines, editing video and graphics, and distributing content across social media platforms.

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program.

  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

The role provides hands-on delivery support across discovery, requirements definition, backlog management, sprint execution, testing, release readiness, adoption, and continuous improvement.   • Assigned Product Delivery and Workstream Execution

    • Translate portfolio objectives, roadmap direction, and business needs into clear product capabilities, sequenced delivery plans, requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
    • Raise options and recommendations for delivery decisions within the assigned scope and escalate decisions affecting product direction, roadmap, funding, resources, or cross-portfolio priorities to the Manager.
    • Maintain epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog priorities, sprint boards, dependencies, risks, defects, release status, and supporting documentation in Jira and Confluence.
    • Escalate cross-portfolio priorities, unresolved dependencies, capacity constraints, material risks, and strategic decisions to the Manager.

    • Support discovery and lead detailed requirements development, backlog creation and grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and outcome tracking for assigned initiatives; provide analysis and recommendations to planning and prioritization led by the Manager.
    • Coordinate day-to-day product delivery through implementation, integration, migration, testing, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
    • Facilitate and actively manage Agile delivery ceremonies for assigned workstreams, including sprint planning, backlog grooming and refinement, daily stand-ups, estimation, sprint reviews, demos, retrospectives, release planning, and continuous-improvement activities.
    • Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Operations, and vendors to evaluate options, clarify tradeoffs, and support technically sound delivery decisions.

    • Translate complex rights, licensing, contractual, title, territory, windowing, exclusivity, restriction, avails, and distribution requirements into scalable product capabilities.
    • Lead product activities across Legal, Business Affairs, Content Acquisition, Distribution, Finance, Operations, Data, Architecture, Engineering, and Product for assigned scope.

job.title: SAMMA Digitizer
job.description:
CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS Evening News, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

Project Overview

The CBS News & Stations archive is one of the world’s largest and most valuable collections of its kind. Housing millions of original assets dating back to before the 1950s, it represents an extraordinary record of American history, journalism, culture, and broadcast media.

 

CBS News & Stations has launched a major initiative to digitize, catalog, and enrich more than 3 million film reels, videotapes, and audio reels. This initiative includes one of the largest robotic tape digitization operations in existence, paired with cloud-based systems and AI-supported metadata workflows operating at significant scale.

 

SAMMA is CBS News Archives’ robotic tape digitization system. It is used to migrate legacy videotape formats into digital files as part of the broader preservation and access initiative.

 

Position Summary

CBS News Archives is seeking SAMMA Digitization Operators to support this large-scale archive digitization initiative. These roles are part of the end-to-end digitization workflow, with an initial emphasis on preparing archival videotape media for migration through SAMMA digitization systems.

 

Primary responsibilities will initially include tape preparation, barcode application, tape identification, metadata entry, sorting, staging, workflow tracking, and ensuring a steady supply of prepared tapes for digitization. As operational needs evolve and training progresses, SAMMA Digitization Operators may also be assigned to operate SAMMA digitization systems, monitor ingest workflows, troubleshoot routine workflow issues, perform quality-control checks, and support related archive digitization activities, including film preparation and film digitization workflows.

 

The ideal candidates are detail-oriented, reliable, comfortable following specific workflows, and able to work carefully with physical media and metadata entry. Prior experience with broadcast archives, videotape formats, film handling, digitization, media asset management systems, or production operations is helpful, but not required if candidates are organized, trainable, and consistent.

 

Location, Hours, and Compensation

  • These positions are based onsite at the CBS News Archives facility in Metropark/Iselin, NJ.
  • Expected schedule is 40 hours per week. Hours may include nights and weekends depending on operational needs.
  • Hourly rate: $26.44 per hour, equivalent to $54,995.20 annually based on a 40-hour workweek.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the end-to-end archive digitization workflow, with an initial focus on SAMMA tape preparation and staging.
  • Prepare, barcode, label, sort, organize, and stage videotape media for digitization.
  • Enter and verify identifying metadata, including tape IDs, station IDs, dates, and other available information.
  • Follow established workflows for preparing Beta, U-matic, DVCPro, XDCAM, and other legacy videotape formats.
  • Identify and escalate unclear labels, missing metadata, damaged media, equipment concerns, or workflow questions.
  • Maintain accurate tracking of prep, staging, digitization, and workflow status.
  • Support daily production goals by ensuring media is prepared and available for digitization.
  • As trained and assigned, operate SAMMA robotic tape digitization systems and monitor digitization workflows.
  • Perform basic workflow checks and quality-control steps to confirm successful completion of assigned tasks.
  • As trained and assigned, support film preparation and film digitization workflows, including inspection, labeling, documentation, staging, and scanner support.
  • Handle videotape, film, and related archival media carefully to prevent damage or misplacement.
  • Follow all safety, handling, and operational procedures in the archive workspace.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions carefully.
  • Comfortable performing repetitive but detail-sensitive work.
  • Basic computer skills, including data entry and use of web-based tools or spreadsheets.
  • Ability to read handwritten and printed labels and transcribe information accurately.
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to work independently once trained, while escalating questions when needed.
  • Comfortable handling physical media, boxes, labels, barcode scanners, and digitization-related equipment.
  • Ability to stand, sit, bend, and move throughout the workday as needed.
  • Ability to lift and move boxes of videotapes or film materials, typically up to approximately 25–35 lbs.
  • Availability to work onsite in Metropark/Iselin, NJ, including nights and weekends as operational needs require.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in archives, broadcast, libraries, records management, digitization, post-production, or a related media environment.
  • Familiarity with legacy media formats, including videotape and/or motion picture film.
  • Experience with barcode workflows, inventory systems, asset management systems, or media tracking tools.
  • Experience operating or supporting digitization, ingest, playback, scanning, or media migration systems.
  • Comfort working in a production-focused environment with daily throughput goals.
  • Interest in archive preservation, legacy media, and digitization workflows.

 

Skills and Attributes

  • Highly organized and methodical.
  • Patient and careful with legacy media.
  • Comfortable asking questions when instructions or media labels are unclear.
  • Able to maintain focus and accuracy over long periods of repetitive work.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Team-oriented, but capable of working independently.
  • Flexible and willing to adapt as workflows evolve.
  • Willing to be trained across multiple parts of the tape and film digitization workflows.

 

Work Environment

  • These positions are based onsite in an archive/digitization operations environment at the CBS News Archives facility in Metropark/Iselin, NJ. The work involves handling physical videotape, film, and related archival media; applying or scanning barcodes; entering metadata; staging media for digitization; operating or supporting SAMMA digitization workflows; supporting film prep and digitization workflows; and coordinating with Archives staff and digitization operators.
  • The roles support a high-volume digitization operation, so consistency, accuracy, dependability, and careful handling of archival media are critical.

 

Training

  • Training will be provided on CBS News Archives’ specific SAMMA workflows, barcode procedures, tape identification rules, prep and staging processes, digitization procedures, film preparation workflows, film handling procedures, and escalation processes for unclear, unknown, damaged, or problematic media.
  • Initial training and assignments may focus primarily on SAMMA tape preparation and staging. As employees demonstrate proficiency and as operational needs require, additional training may be provided for SAMMA digitization operation, workflow monitoring, basic troubleshooting, quality-control procedures, film preparation, and film digitization support.
  • Additional training and/or certification opportunities may be available as related workflows and partnerships continue to develop.

  • Department: Procure-to-Pay (PTP)

Why Join Us? Ready to turn your university theory into real-world global finance experience? Join our Global Business Services (GBS) team in Budapest as a PTP Intern and see how a multinational company operates from the inside out. Reporting directly to the PTP Manager, you won’t just be doing repetitive admin—you’ll get hands-on exposure to the full Procure-to-Pay lifecycle, from the moment an invoice arrives to the final payment run. We offer a student-friendly, flexible schedule (30–40 hours/week) with 2–3 collaborative days in our Budapest office (ideally Tuesdays and Wednesdays) and remote work for the rest of the week.

  • Master Global Finance Workflows: Dive into daily invoice processing and payment execution, troubleshooting system errors and keeping transactions running smoothly in top-tier systems like SAP and Oracle.

  • Keep Things Moving: Track open Purchase Orders, aged invoices, and upcoming payment runs, teaming up with internal stakeholders to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Ensure Accuracy & Compliance: Help run tax and compliance checks on international transactions, verify vendor details, and step in with manual data handling when needed.

  • Solve Financial Puzzles: Assist with operational reporting, reconcile vendor statements, and investigate intriguing discrepancies like credit balances or overpayments.

  • Be the Go-To Contact: Communicate professionally with external vendors, internal business partners, and fellow finance teams to resolve everyday queries.

  • Bring Fresh Ideas: Spot bottlenecks and share your own ideas on how we can make our daily workflows smarter and faster.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Education: Ongoing university/college studies (or a recent degree) in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Tech Savviness: Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Familiar with SAP or Oracle? Awesome—that’s a plus! Never used them before? No worries, we’ll give you full, structured training from day one.

  • Languages: Fluency in English (both written and spoken) is a must; Hungarian or any other European language is a great bonus.

  • Mindset:

    • A sharp eye for detail, an analytical brain, and genuine curiosity about how global finance works.

    • Strong communication skills and the ability to juggle priorities without breaking a sweat.

    • A proactive, team-player attitude—you enjoy collaborating in an international environment.

  • Availability: Ready to jump in on short notice, commit to 30–40 hours per week, and join the team in our Budapest office 2–3 days a week (preferably Tuesdays and Wednesdays).

What’s in It for You?

  • Resume-Boosting Tech Skills: Comprehensive training and daily hands-on practice with industry-leading ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) in a global corporate setting.

  • True Flexibility: A 30–40 hour schedule designed to fit alongside your studies, backed by a predictable hybrid setup.

  • Mentorship That Matters: A welcoming, down-to-earth team and direct support from your PTP Manager to guide your learning curve.

  • A Launchpad for Your Career: Gain practical experience that sets you apart—with real potential to grow into a permanent role within our GBS center.

About the Role Looking to build your accounting career in a fast-paced, global media environment? We are looking for a detail-oriented RtR Analyst – Cash & Banking to join our Budapest GBS Finance team.

As Skydance (formerly Paramount) builds a next-generation global entertainment powerhouse, our finance operations are evolving too.   • Own Cash & Bank Operations: Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations across multi-currency accounts, and investigate and resolve unallocated cash items and open clearing balances.

  • Drive Automation & Process Improvement: Actively participate in optimizing automated cash-clearing rules in SAP and BlackLine as workflows transition into our GBS model.

  • Partner Across Finance: Liaise directly with Treasury, Accounts Payable (P2P), Accounts Receivable (O2C), and external auditors to resolve operational queries and maintain strong SOX compliance.

  • Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on accounting or finance experience (GL, Cash & Banking, AP/AR, or RtR) within an SSC/GBS or multinational environment.

  • Systems & Tools: Practical knowledge of Excel (Pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS) and experience with an ERP system (SAP is a strong plus). Familiarity with BlackLine is an advantage.

  • Accounting Fundamentals: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles, reconciliations, and month-end cut-off processes.

  • Mindset & Language: Proactive, structured problem-solver with high attention to detail, fluent English (B2/C1, written and spoken), and valid, unrestricted Hungarian work authorization (visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available for this role).

  • Work-Life Balance & Office: Flexible hybrid working model (3 days Home Office / 2 days in our modern, dog-friendly Budapest office with weekly fresh fruit), generous paid time off, and commuting support in line with statutory regulations.

  • Entertainment & Culture: Complimentary annual SkyShowtime and HBO Max subscriptions, exclusive pre-premiere movie screenings, and cross-team social events.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

Executive - Sales, the TEGNA-owned affiliate in , is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to 's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.
  • Sell strategically and consultatively. Uncover each client's real business goals, read the market and competitive landscape, and architect tailored, multi-platform solutions that tie directly to measurable outcomes. 
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain. 

Requirements:  

  • 2-4+ years of media, digital, or advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a competitive market 
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe 
  • Proficiency with CRM and Microsoft Office; familiarity with Google Analytics, DSPs/SSPs, and ad-management tools a plus 
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel locally to meet clients and partners as needed 

Salary: Competitive base + commission

 

#LI-NS1

    • Provide creative direction and guidance to ensure the final product aligns with client objectives.

    • Capture high-quality still images as needed for projects or client campaigns.

job.description:
About TEGNA
