We are looking for a Data Scientist to help build the data science and applied AI capabilities behind TEGNA’s content platform, the systems that turn a high volume of news and media content into insight, enrichment, and better experiences for millions of users. You’ll work with large, messy, text-heavy datasets and use NLP and large language models to turn them into production solutions that make content more discoverable, better organized, and more useful to editorial, product, and audience teams. You’ll be a technical anchor on the team: framing ambiguous business problems as data science problems, setting the bar for rigor in experimentation and evaluation, and mentoring analysts and mid-level data scientists. You’ll partner with engineering and cloud teams on how models and LLM-based services are deployed, monitored, and operated in production.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and evaluate data science solutions that apply NLP and LLMs to content problems such as classification, tagging and taxonomy, entity extraction, summarization, similarity and recommendation, and semantic search.
  • Develop LLM-powered solutions, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vector search, and fine-tuning where it is warranted, with a pragmatic eye on cost, latency, and quality.
  • Own evaluation. Define metrics, build benchmark and golden datasets, and run offline and online experiments (including A/B tests) to show that a solution works, and keep checking that it keeps working.
  • Frame ambiguous business and editorial problems as well-defined data science problems, and help convert epics and tech briefs into actionable, well-scoped stories alongside the team lead.
  • Work with engineers to take models and prototypes into production as reliable services, covering monitoring, drift detection, guardrails, and responsible-AI practices such as hallucination, bias, and content-safety controls.
  • Explore, clean, and model large structured and unstructured datasets, and communicate findings and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Set standards for reproducibility, experiment tracking, code quality, and documentation across the team.
  • Mentor analysts and mid-level data scientists, raising the overall technical maturity of the team.
  • Partner with engineering and cloud teams (who own infrastructure realization, CI/CD, and standards).
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined source control.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data science or applied machine learning, with models or analytical solutions delivered into production.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and the core data science stack (pandas, scikit-learn, and a deep learning framework such as PyTorch), plus solid SQL.
  • Strong grounding in statistics, experimental design, and model evaluation, and the judgment to choose the simplest approach that solves the problem.
  • Hands-on experience with NLP (text classification, named entity recognition, topic modeling, embeddings, semantic similarity) and with modern transformer-based approaches.
  • Practical experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings and vector databases, and evaluating LLM output quality. Experience with Hugging Face or comparable platforms is expected.
  • Experience taking data science work to production in a cloud environment (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and an understanding of MLOps fundamentals: versioning, monitoring, reproducibility, and retraining.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain model behavior, limitations, and trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
  • A track record of mentoring others and elevating team practices.
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum delivery and Git-based source control.
  • Media, publishing, streaming, or high-traffic content platform experience is a plus.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs or Graph-RAG, with Databricks or a managed vector search platform, or with fine-tuning and evaluating open-source LLMs is a plus.

Marketplace is seeking a Deputy Managing Editor, Video Content to lead video strategy across shows, reporting teams and digital platforms. This role will determine how Marketplace uses video to extend its journalism, grow audiences and develop sustainable revenue opportunities.

The Deputy Managing Editor will lead Marketplace’s YouTube and social video strategy, develop formats and franchises, and use audience and performance insights to guide investment. The role will initially manage the Director of Social Engagement and align social and video work around shared editorial, audience and revenue goals.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and lead a cohesive video strategy across Marketplace shows, podcasts, reporting teams and platforms.

  • Lead Marketplace’s YouTube and social video strategy, including programming, packaging, discovery and audience retention.
  • Develop distinctive, repeatable video formats and franchises grounded in Marketplace’s business and economic journalism.
  • Use audience research, analytics and performance data to guide programming, distribution and investment decisions.
  • Partner with Marketplace and APM business teams to develop monetization strategies across advertising, sponsorship, platform revenue and partnerships.

  • Deep knowledge of YouTube, including programming, packaging, discovery, recommendations and retention.

job.title: Daily news editor
job.description:
The Salem Statesman Journal and Eugene Register-Guard, the leading news organizations in Salem and Eugene, Oregon, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, seek an energetic and collaborative editor to oversee breaking news and public safety, trending news and food and drink content.

You will identify and champion breaking news and exclusive storytelling in our markets and across Oregon and help reporters tell stories with speed and context through any medium to inform and inspire the public. You must possess sound skills in using metrics and analytics, social media and online tools to identify trending topics and be able to edit and produce multimedia content. Collaboration and clear communication with other editors, digital producers, and photographers is expected.

Our ideal candidate has a proven record of identifying breaking and trending news, driving engagement and growing audience, and is comfortable leading coverage on topics including public safety, courts and criminal justice, local government, wildfires, extreme weather and news of the day. Excellent news judgment and organizational skills, the ability to supervise quick-turn daily coverage and pivot as news happens is essential. A strong understanding of Oregon public records and open meeting laws as well as the legal system and law enforcement is required.

This editor will be adept at coaching and motivating journalists, helping them refine their reporting and writing, manage their beats and leverage multimedia storytelling to reach audiences wherever they are. Previous experience in government, crime, and public safety coverage is highly valued.

Salem and Eugene are located in the Willamette Valley, famed for its agriculture and hundreds of vineyards and wineries. The cities are situated between the Oregon Coast and Cascade Mountain ranges and are known for their vibrant food and drink scene, arts and culture as well as outdoor recreation and sports.Responsibilities

Lead breaking news and public safety coverage in Salem and support Eugene as news demands.

Develop and oversee trending and service journalism that delivers timely, useful information to diverse audiences in both markets.

Edit food and drink coverage in Salem and Eugene with a focus on utility and service journalism, exclusive stories and multimedia content.

Mentor seasonal interns across beats with a focus on breaking, trending and service journalism and exclusive storytelling.

Drive innovative storytelling in all formats—written, video, audio, and graphics—to enhance multimedia engagement.

Identify and fulfill training needs to support dynamic, multimedia-focused newsrooms.

Supervise simultaneous production of print and digital news products with emphasis on immediacy and relevance.

Collaborate with editors across the USA TODAY Network on best practices and regional multi-site initiatives.

Be available to work evenings and weekends to ensure around-the-clock coverage of critical news developments.

Requirements

Bachelor's or master’s degree in communications, journalism or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Minimum 5 years of journalism experience, with at least 2 years in newsroom editing and leadership roles.

Command of media law, libel law, open records law, and ethical standards.

Strong planning and organizational skills, and a proven ability to lead teams in delivering urgent, high-impact news coverage.

Expertise in managing multiple tasks and balancing daily news demands with long-term strategic audience growth.

Ability to make complex stories accessible, with a keen sense for identifying and communicating urgent local issues.

Experience in harnessing public records and data to inform coverage and answer community questions.

Advanced storytelling skills with emphasis on multimedia engagement.

Expert knowledge of audience metrics, social media, and SEO principles for maximizing reach and engagement.

Self-motivation and self-direction and ability to adapt to the evolving needs of a modern newsroom.

Mastery of writing, spelling, grammar, AP and local style.

Able to multitask and excel under the pressures of rapid, deadline-driven coverage.

Understanding of the changing media landscape and a strategic approach to audience and market needs.

Strong competitive instincts, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to public service journalism.

Ability to manage and motivate high-performing teams.

Knowledge of Salem, Eugene and Oregon communities is a plus.

job.title: Junior HR Business Partner (Remote)
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

 

Location: Remote, U.S.

 

Why this role matters:

We are seeking a proactive and collaborative Junior HR Business Partner to support our HR Business Partner team in delivering a high-quality employee and manager experience across AP. Reporting to the HR Director, News, this role will serve as a key partner to HR Business Partners and business leaders, providing HR support on talent, organizational, and workforce matters.

 

What you will do:

Working closely with HRBPs, HR Operations, and other HR specialist teams, the Junior HR Business Partner will support a wide range of employee and manager needs across assigned client groups. This role will provide hands-on HRBP support on both routine activities and contribute to strategic initiatives led by HRBPs, while partnering directly with managers and employees to resolve issues, coordinate HR processes, and ensure effective delivery of HR services.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Serve as support to HRBPs on a variety of requests, providing guidance and support across a range of day-to-day HR topics and escalating more complex matters as appropriate.
  • Partner closely with HRBPs and HR Operations to support managers and employees and ensure smooth coordination and follow-through on requests and cases.
  • Support managers and HRBPs with employee and labor relations matters, including performance management, disciplinary processes, providing guidance within established policies and practices and escalating complex or higher risk matters as appropriate.
  • Help facilitate employee transfers, mobility-related processes, immigration, and other cross-functional HR activities as needed.
  • Partner with the Talent and HRIS teams to understand data as it relates to people and ensure HRBPs and HR specialist teams are connected on people data.
  • Contribute to HR projects, process improvements and operational initiatives that support team effectiveness and employee experience.
  • Help document and improve HR processes and ways of working in partnership with the HR Operations team.

 

Who you are:

This role is ideal for someone currently in an HR Adviser or Generalist role, with an interest in developing as an HR Business Partner in a fast-paced global environment. The successful candidate will have HR generalist experience supporting employees and managers across the U.S and other countries.

job.title: Producer, Vox Video
job.description:
WHO WE ARE

Vox candidly shepherds audiences through politics and policy, business and pop culture, food, science, and everything else that matters.

Vox is part of Vox Media, the leading modern media company. We guide our audience from discovery to obsession. We inspire essential conversations about what’s now, what’s next, and what’s possible.

As a community of journalists and storytellers, business professionals, creators and technologists, we believe it is a moral and business imperative to amplify voices: to cultivate diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout our organization and media. This applies to our candidates, our teams, our storytelling, our creative work, and our platforms, products, and partnerships.

THE ROLE

Vox is looking for an experienced producer and on-camera host to join our award-winning video team. You will be part of a team that creates thoughtful, original midform videos, preserving the explanatory DNA that is essential to Vox, while also developing new video formats and series. 

Top candidates will have a professional background in video journalism with exceptional reporting, scripting, and editing skills. The producer will be expected to pitch, develop and host original video explainers on deadline and produce best-in-class video storytelling that Vox has become known for. The ideal candidate will have an established track record of timely, relevant video journalism, as well as a portfolio of on-camera work. 

This person will also be a creative thinker who wants to experiment with new storytelling formats. We want someone who’s not afraid to try new things and learn from them. There are many ways to create an explainer, and the right candidate will bring innovation and fresh ideas to the position. 

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life. This role is a part of the Vox Media Union, represented by the Writers Guild of America, East.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Pitch, research, report, script, and host original video stories. 
  • Produce timely, relevant midform videos aligned with the news cycle.
  • Shoot and edit videos in-studio and in the field. 
  • Host videos on camera, bringing a natural presence and a distinct voice to the work.
  • Manage every aspect of video production from start to finish, delivering high-quality results efficiently and on deadline. 
  • Manage multiple projects at various stages of production in a fast-paced setting and maintain a pipeline of work; this role will require strong organizational and time-management skills. 
  • Collaborate closely with journalists across the Vox newsroom to turn our journalism into smart, timely videos.
  • Pitch, develop and test new storytelling techniques, formats, and series.
  • Adhere to all journalistic and legal standards at all times.
  • Complete additional duties as assigned.

WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for a creative, enthusiastic producer with a passion for Vox’s explanatory mission. You’ll have:

  • 3-5 years of experience in video journalism. 
  • A portfolio of on-camera journalism that brings clarity to the subject and demonstrates an ability to connect with audiences.
  • A passion for Vox’s mission of helping audiences understand what really matters.
  • An established record of deep research, reporting, scripting and high-quality field production.
  • Expert-level understanding of Adobe Suite, with a high-level of expertise in Premiere and knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Familiarity with YouTube video production and publishing, as well as, vertical video editing tools such as Capcut, Descript.
  • Proficiency with studio lighting setups and field shoots
  • Strong communication, organizational and time-management skills, as well as, attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team player who will enjoy working across the organization.

To apply, please submit a cover letter outlining your skills and experience. Include links to three videos that demonstrate your ability to pitch, develop, script, and edit original video stories. At least one video example should prominently feature your on-camera work.

job.title: Sr. Quality Assurance Analyst
job.description:
Position Summary

Define and execute quality strategies for BMI’s music rights, copyright, and technology platforms in partnership with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

Deliver functional, automated, API, data, integration, performance, and security testing for cloud applications and complex data workflows. Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate QA while independently validating generated output.

Core Responsibilities

Functional & Data Testing

·       Execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and system tests across UI, APIs, backend services, batch processes, and data workflows.

·       Validate music rights, copyright, ownership, and royalty-related data, including works, cues, writers, publishers, shares, territories, agreements.

·       Validate data integrity and transformations across DB2, PostgreSQL, APIs, and downstream systems using SQL.

·       Develop test strategies, plans, cases, scenarios, and test data; reproduce, document, and track defects through resolution.

Test Automation & AI-Assisted QA

·       Build reusable UI, API, and backend automation with Playwright, Cucumber/Gherkin, Selenium WebDriver, REST-based tools, or comparable frameworks.

·       Integrate automated execution, reporting, regression suites, and quality gates into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.

·       Use AI for test generation, automation, synthetic data, documentation, defect analysis, and coverage gaps; independently validate generated tests and results.

Cloud, DevOps & Security Testing

·       Test Azure-hosted applications and distributed services; use Azure DevOps for test planning, work items, defects, and release validation.

·       Troubleshoot applications, APIs, databases, cloud services, and test environments using Datadog, logs, metrics, Linux, and command-line tools.

·       Test OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and Microsoft Entra ID authentication and authorization, including sign-in, service-to-service access, tokens, roles, and denied-access scenarios.

Performance & Reliability Testing

·       Run performance, load, scalability, and reliability tests with Apache JMeter, Lighthouse, or equivalent tools across applications, APIs, databases, and workflows.

·       Validate response-time, throughput, concurrency, and reliability targets; isolate performance hot spots with engineering.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience & Technical Qualifications

·       5–8 years of software QA experience, including substantial hands-on functional testing and automation in Agile teams.

·       Strong cloud testing experience, preferably Microsoft Azure, and hands-on Azure DevOps expertise in test management, defects, and CI/CD automation.

·       Experience testing data-intensive applications, APIs, backend services, batch processing, ingestion pipelines, and distributed systems.

·       Hands-on DB2, PostgreSQL, or comparable database experience, with SQL-based validation of complex transformations.

·       Automation with Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, Cucumber/Gherkin, or comparable frameworks; API testing with Thunder Client or equivalent tools.

·       Performance testing with Apache JMeter, Lighthouse, or similar tools, particularly for Java services and data-intensive applications.

·       Practical AI-assisted QA experience with independent output validation; familiarity with Datadog or similar diagnostics, Linux, and command-line tools.

·       Experience testing OAuth 2.0/OIDC and Microsoft Entra ID, including JWT access tokens, client-credentials flows, and role/permission-based access.

Preferred Domain Experience

Music industry technology or data experience is strongly desired, especially music rights, copyright administration, publishing, royalty processing, repertoire, and ownership data.

Skills & Abilities

·       Bridge business validation and technical troubleshooting; design maintainable automation and apply strong analytical skills and attention to data accuracy.

·       Communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders; work independently and manage quality across concurrent Agile projects.

Location Requirements

This person must be based in the Nashville area. While the position will have flexibility to work remotely, the candidate must be able to come into the office for the duration of their onboarding, as well as at an ongoing basis as needed.

job.title: Host - new daily show
job.description:
Host, New Daily Show

KNKX | Full-time onsite in Tacoma, WA

Salary Range: $90,000 - $100,000 annually, depending on experience


About the Opportunity

KNKX has a strong history of creating memorable, award-winning content. From long-form documentaries to deep reporting, the station has always valued creativity and the stories that matter to Western Washington.

Now, KNKX is launching something new: a daily, one-hour news, interview, and storytelling program airing Monday through Friday at 3 PM. The show will cover the news of the day while making space for arts, culture, and the stories that surprise and connect us as a region.


We are hiring two Hosts for this show. This is a rare chance to be a founding voice of a new program at a station that is investing and growing. In a media landscape where newsrooms are contracting, KNKX is creating something, and the right people get to shape what it becomes.


This position is based in KNKX's Tacoma, WA studios 5 days a week. This is a SAG-AFTRA union position.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • Be a founding voice of a brand-new daily show and help define its identity from day one.
  • Join a collaborative 6-person production team that values ideas from everyone.
  • Work at a station with deep community trust and a signal that reaches from Vancouver, BC to the Oregon border.
  • Fill a real need: this show is part of KNKX's commitment to serving Western Washington with useful, engaging journalism.


The Role

As Host, you will be one of two on-air voices leading this new program. Reporting to the Executive Producer, and working in partnership with your co-host, and a production team, you will help shape the daily editorial direction, conduct interviews, and deliver a show that is warm, sharp, curious, and grounded in the community.


This is not a role where you show up and read what is handed to you. You are part of the producing force. You bring ideas, you pitch stories, you help decide who gets interviewed and what gets covered. You are also the backstop: the last person to touch something before it goes over the air. That means composure under pressure, the ability to pivot when news breaks, and the instinct to follow a conversation wherever it leads.


Key Responsibilities

On-Air Hosting

  • Host a daily, one-hour live news and culture program, managing show flow, timing, and transitions under live-broadcast pressure.
  • Lead 2-4 daily segments ranging from 10- to 20-minute interviews with newsmakers, community leaders, artists, and experts.
  • Pivot when news breaks. Be willing and able to rework the rundown on the fly during a live broadcast.
  • Interact with listeners through call-in segments and participate in live community events.


Segment Production and Editorial Sourcing

  • Write and edit scripts, intros, commentary, and promotional copy to public radio standards.
  • Source interview subjects and segment topics and pitch ideas in daily team meetings.
  • Collaborate with the Digital Editor to adapt on-air content for digital, podcast, and social media formats.


Community Engagement and Ambassadorship

  • Represent KNKX at public panels, live town halls, station events, fund drives, and community gatherings across Western Washington.
  • Engage authentically with listeners across digital, audio, and social channels to build trust and expand audience reach.
  • Take the show on the road through live remotes and community events.


What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Experience: 7+ years of live broadcast experience in radio, television, or a comparable live format. We need someone with time in the saddle who has handled breaking news, quick pivots, and the pressure of live programming.
  • Interviewing Instincts: A skilled, curious interviewer who comes prepared but knows when to put the questions down and follow the conversation where it leads. You seek the "why" behind every story.
  • Collaboration: A team player who brings ideas, collaborates with producers, and contributes to the editorial direction of the show. This is not a role for someone who only cracks open the mic.
  • On-Air Presence: Someone warm, genuine, and authoritative. You connect with people across political, ideological, and geographic lines through empathy.
  • Writing: Sharp, concise broadcast writing for intros, commentary, scripts, and promotional copy.
  • Technical Proficiency: Working familiarity with digital audio workstations (e.g., Audition, Pro Tools, Hindenburg).
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Political Science, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Location: This position is based in KNKX's Tacoma, WA studios 5 days a week. This is a SAG-AFTRA union position.


Sets You Apart

  • Strong understanding of Pacific Northwest political dynamics, regional history, and Western Washington community issues.
  • Prior experience in public media (NPR/PRI/PRX network ecosystem).
  • Experience hosting or moderating live audience events and community panels.
  • A proven track record of sourcing diverse, non-traditional community voices across ideological and geographic boundaries.
  • A flexible, audience-first mindset. You think about what listeners need, not just what is interesting to you.
  • We want hosts who can handle the hard things and still bring joy and a twinkle in the eye.


About Us

At KNKX we work hard to create a culture where employees feel valued and respected, are trusted and encouraged to be a part of improvements that impact their work, create value, and help build trust in public media. KNKX's vision is to grow and become a more inclusive organization that brings joy, meaning, and understanding into people's lives. We value diverse perspectives and an array of life experiences.

KNKX is a Western Washington public media company, dedicated to bringing jazz, blues, regional news, and NPR programs to the Northwest and beyond. As an independent dual-format station, KNKX employees are energized in their mission to provide the very best music and news content to an audience of more than 400,000 weekly.


How to Apply

Apply here: https://knkx.bamboohr.com/careers/67?source=aWQ9NjE%3D

Submit your:

  • Resume
  • Cover letter detailing your connection to the Pacific Northwest and your editorial philosophy
  • Audio reel (3-5 minutes) featuring live interviews or hosting clips


Compensation and Benefits

Salary: $90,000 - $100,000 annually, depending on experience

KNKX offers a strong benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with FSA option
  • PTO and holidays, including the full week between Christmas and New Year's
  • 401(k) with generous company match
  • Disability, life, and AD&D insurance options
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)


Interview Process

  • One-way video interview (4 short questions recorded on your own time)
  • Phone screening with the myHR Partner hiring team
  • Interview with the KNKX hiring committee
  • Recording a test segment with KNKX on-air talent
  • Final onsite interview

You are welcome to include the name and pronoun you would like to be referred to in your materials and we will honor it. The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is seeking a senior staff editor to help its new Canon team develop and publish ambitious, conversation-starting “best of” projects across various topic areas. This is a role for a journalist who can bring organization, momentum and clarity to complex, multi-team projects.

Working closely with the Canon editor and colleagues across the organization, our ideal candidate has a sharp eye for detail and superb organizational and communication skills. They possess an editor's eye as well as a reader-centric mindset. job.title: Account Executive, Pro Deals
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning content in an audience-first format. We are looking for a creative and collaborative sales professional to help lead new business growth for Axios Pro Deals.

Why it matters: The Account Executive/Client Partner will be responsible for leading the full-cycle sales process for our Pro Deals intelligence solution for the M&A, VC, and Private Equity deal-making marketplace.

Go deeper: Ideal candidates will be highly organized, relationship-focused, and entrepreneurial. Responsibilities will include:

  • Identify, prospect, and acquire new clients within the deal-making landscape. This includes prospects within the Private Equity and Venture Capital space as well as Corporate, M&A Advisors, Legal and Consultancy professionals.
  • Develop and execute targeted sales strategies to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets
  • Partner with a Business Development Associate to identify prospective partners and develop outbound sales tactics to engage them
  • Prepare for and conduct sales meetings with relevant industry targets, ensuring alignment of value, budget, and decision-making process
  • Manage the evaluation process for new business opportunities, including pricing negotiation and contract execution
  • Develop and maintain relationships with existing and new contacts by participating in industry events, Axios Pro events, and in-person meetings

job.title: Associate Program Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, with four days in office and one remote.

Position Summary

The Associate Program Director is the first level of program ownership above the Sr. PM. Reporting to the Group Program Director and managing Sr. Program Managers, Managers, and Associates, this role owns and manages complex, multi-channel Tier 1 programs and the delivery health of that program level, owns account-level scope and SOW, manages staffing across the account team, and co-leads client strategy from the delivery angle in true partnership with the Business Director (and GBD on the largest accounts). This is where a Sr. PM steps into the scoping partnership — beginning to co-own scope and SOW alongside Business Leadership rather than executing against it. The Associate Program Director typically owns one large, multi-channel program or account in partnership with a BD.

Responsibilities

Program & Delivery Health

  • Own program and delivery health across the account; lead internal program coordination at the account level
  • Own account / retainer-level scope tracking and SOW; manage staffing across the account team
  • Escalate capacity needs and scope shifts back to the GPD for redesign

Client Partnership

  • Co-lead client strategy from delivery; hold senior client relationships (director / VP) on operations and scoping
  • Partner with the BD as a true partnership; on the largest accounts, co-lead with the GBD

Team Leadership

  • Lead Sr. PMs, project-focused Managers, and Associates
  • Co-lead junior managers with Business Leadership to identify program-management capability

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $105,000 - $126,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Regulatory Associate
job.description:
Job Description

Are you ready to tackle the complexities of global regulatory compliance and drive innovation in e-invoicing and tax technology? As a member of the Regulatory Affairs team, you can be a part of our journey as the global leader in invoicing compliance.

We, as Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE, are building the world’s largest, open business network. With our cloud-based network, customers can reach any business, anywhere in the world – no matter how many borders their operations may cross. We take care of the technical and regulatory requirements across the entire order-to-cash, purchase-to-pay and freight processes, to give customers data accuracy and security, transparency, and real-time visibility. All this through a single connection.

Global regulatory compliance with e-invoicing and CTC (continuous transaction control) mandates presents a formidable and ongoing challenge for multinationals. The landscape of regulations governing indirect tax and the application of tax technologies is expanding but often involves a lack of uniformity among different regulatory bodies. This complexity, fragmentation, and evolving nature of compliance requirements necessitates a dedicated and knowledgeable team. 


We are seeking an Associate to join ONESOURCE Thomson Reuters’ Regulatory Affairs (RA) team. The RA team has been instrumental in ONESOURCE Thomson Reuters successful global expansion, establishing our position as the global leader in e-invoicing and CTC compliance. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a dynamic and critical area of our business, ensuring that we continue to lead and innovate in this essential field.


Key Responsibilities
In this opportunity as Regulatory Associate, you will: 

  • Analyze and investigate requirements and legislation in markets that Thomson Reuters plans to enter
  • Maintain and monitor up-to-date knowledge of regulatory requirements in markets that Thomson Reuters currently supports
  • Create compliance related content, including blogs and updates, for internal and external readers
  • Collaborate with stakeholders for launching new markets including integration, marketing, delivery, and more departments
  • Present ONESOURCE’s compliance solutions and relevant business cases to customers, curated for both technical and c-level audiences
  • Address queries from internal and external stakeholders, ranging from simple to complex 


Required Qualifications
You’re a fit for the role of Regulatory Associate if you have the following required qualifications: 

  • At least 1-3 years of experience in e-invoicing/CTC, tax technology and/or indirect tax. Applicants with legal or compliance experience in digital, privacy and/or security areas, and the readiness to apply that knowledge to digital settings, as well as to learn new skills, will be considered.
  • Fluent in both spoken and written English
  • Relevant academic degree: ex. Business, Law, Economics, or similar with relevant work experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment and document information clearly.
  • Familiarity with MS Office including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Word and SharePoint
  • Experienced and/or eager to learn and stay informed about indirect tax, e-invoicing, and tax technology trends.
  • Successfully pass an extended background check (criminal and credit).


Preferred qualifications:

  • Knowledge of other languages is highly merited, including French, German, Arabic, Mandarin and more (preferred, but not required)
  • Experience in ERP, B2B and data integration including solutions such as managed services (preferred, but not required)
  • Previous experience in compliance and regulatory analysis (preferred, but not required)

#LI-AB3


What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

job.title: Editorial Lawyer
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We’re now looking for an Editorial Lawyer to provide legal support and advice to our publications. 

 

The GNM Editorial Legal Department provides pre- and post- publication legal advice to all our editorial departments. You’ll be working alongside some of the top journalists and editors. The editorial lawyers have worked on many exciting news and investigative projects.

 

About the Role

Editorial lawyers work closely with our journalists and editors to make sure that what we publish is legally defensible. This involves reading stories before they are published and checking for legal risk in areas such as defamation, privacy and data protection, contempt and copyright. It can be a fast moving and demanding environment. In addition to this pre-publication review, editorial lawyers also advise on the merits of any court cases that may be threatened and / or filed against GNM, working with the appropriate journalists, editors and executives to define a strategic defence and/or approve settlements of disputes where warranted, as well as selecting, retaining, managing, and evaluating any outside solicitors or counsel as needed.

 

Additional responsibilities include:

  • Pre-publication legal and editorial code review on a real-time basis on all content-related issues

  • Managing pre and post publication litigation (including libel, breach of confidence, privacy, data protection, freedom of information, contempt of court (publication), production orders, copyright, open justice + challenging reporting restrictions)

  • Contributing to policy and lobbying discussions and documents

 

About You

  • 2-4 years post qualified experience or equivalent

  • Experience of civil and/or criminal litigation including ability to handle own caseload

  • Background in/knowledge of media law (including libel, breach of confidence, privacy, data protection, freedom of information, contempt of court (publication), production orders, copyright, open justice + challenging reporting restrictions and broadcast

  • Ideally proven experience of pre and post publication litigation work

  • Background in / knowledge of complaint handling and responding

  • Ideally, you’ll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role

 

We actively encourage applications from candidates from other groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media and legal profession. 

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people at the Guardian. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve,

where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future.

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for.

 

The closing date for applications is 6pm, Tuesday 1st December 2026.

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Please contact Sean on sean.brinkley@guardian.co.uk to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

 

Culture & wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace.

 

You will also have the opportunity to hear unique insight from our journalists in our morning conference, a live discussion on the news story of the day.

 

We offer great tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including free yoga and pilates. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

 

Learning & development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships. 

 

Our working environment

We take pride in our surroundings and are pleased to offer versatile meeting rooms and colourful communal areas. We have a brilliant canteen that caters to breakfast, lunch and dinner, with views overlooking Regent’s Canal.

 

Additional benefits & policies

We offer 30 days annual leave per annum, plus an additional 5 day holiday purchase scheme. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

You are entitled to life cover, income protection, healthcare, sick pay and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

job.title: Client Relationship Manager
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

The role

The Reader Revenue Group (RRG) unites the subscription and licensing businesses of the Financial Times. This allows crafting opportunities for broader, deeper, and longer-term relationships globally.

Within RRG, Corporate Licensing provides FT content to organisations worldwide through solutions ranging from group and enterprise subscriptions to customised data feeds. Our Americas team works collaboratively to strengthen customer relationships and drive sustainable commercial growth.

We are looking for an experienced Client Relationship Manager to lead and grow a portfolio of Corporate and Government customers throughout the Americas.

In this role, you will take charge of customer retention, revenue growth, and renewal strategy. You will build diligent connections with senior partners and see opportunities to grow accounts over time.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys handling sophisticated customer relationships, navigating commercial discussions and delivering long-term value to clients.

Key responsibilities

  • Deliver agreed retention and revenue growth targets, taking ownership of portfolio performance, account strategy and forecasting.
  • Develop strategic account plans to protect existing revenue, identify renewal risks and pursue opportunities for growth.
  • Lead renewal and growth conversations, developing proposals aligned with customer needs and navigating complex collaborator, budget and procurement processes.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and key partners within customer organisations.
  • Analyse customer engagement, account performance and market developments to find opportunities for retention and growth.
  • Partner with Customer Success and other internal teams to coordinate account activity, resolve customer issues and deliver a consistent customer experience.
  • Stay informed about relevant market and competitor developments and confidently communicate the value of FT products and services.
  • Maintain accurate account records, commercial activity and pipeline forecasts in Salesforce.
  • Proactively plan renewal activity, handle contending priorities and ensure timely follow-up across a varied portfolio.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across the business to achieve shared customer and commercial objectives.

Required skills / experience

  • At least 2 years of experience handling B2B customer relationships or a revenue-generating portfolio, with a focus on retention and account growth.
  • Strong commercial judgment, with the confidence to lead renewal, negotiation and expansion discussions.
  • Shown ability to run multiple accounts, prioritize effectively and deliver against deadlines and commercial targets.
  • Excellent relationship-building and influencing skills, including experience engaging senior customer partners.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and articulate a compelling value proposition.
  • A collaborative, customer-focused attitude, combined with the initiative to take ownership of work and follow through on commitments.
  • Experience using CRM systems to handle customer activity, pipeline information and forecasts.

Please submit your application by December 1st.

Desirable skills / experience

  • Experience working with Corporate or Government customers, including familiarity with formal procurement processes.
  • Experience using Salesforce and Google Workspace.
  • Knowledge of Corporate and Government sectors across the Americas.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, health coverage, 401k and company match, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

job.title: Night News Editor
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI. 

 

The Role
The FT is looking for a sharp, sure-footed editor to help run its London night news operation. This is a demanding role at the heart of the newsroom, requiring the judgement to make big editorial calls and the skills to commission, edit and present high-profile FT’s journalism.

The London evening is often when the big stories of the day can take a decisive turn. From wars and geopolitical crises to market-moving corporate deals, the night editor needs to respond quickly to breaking developments and decide what matters most to FT readers.

The editor will be responsible for running the FT's UK homepage during the shift, making calls on news priorities and ensuring stories are presented with strong headlines, images and graphics.

Night news commissions breaking news that can cut across all the main newsdesks. The team also plays an important role revising stories for publication, upholding the FT's high standards for accuracy and quality.

The night news operation must work closely with the New York desk, co-ordinating coverage so important stories are handled smoothly between time zones.

We are open to appointing an experienced editor to lead the London night news team, or a strong candidate to join it in a senior editing role. The person taking on leadership responsibility would be expected to set priorities, support colleagues and manage the team.

 

Working arrangements

The role is based in London and involves evening shifts and regular Sunday working. The existing pattern is four night shifts a week, but we are open to discussing different working arrangements with candidates that would ensure the needs of the news operation are met.

 

Please submit your application by the end of the day, Tuesday 1st December 2026.

 

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not by default use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

FT Newsroom staff are expected to work onsite a minimum of three days per week, subject to role requirements and regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for Editorial roles.

job.description:

OUR TEAM

The experience of the 20+ team enables us to deliver integrated communications, from corporate, B2B and consumer communications, to digital & social, influencers, analyst relations, content marketing and public affairs.   • Handling junior client relationships, developing a strong rapport with your day-to-day contact

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES

  • A fan of technology that enhances human progress, with an understanding of the consumer technology market, who is excited by its future within society and business 
  • Experience in the technology and/or telecoms sectors – ideally both, but technology experience is a must 
  • A media hound and storyteller who loves to craft compelling pitches and knows how to sell them to business, trade and national media 
  • A global outlook, with the ability to transfer skills across both UK and global client work 
  • Organisational skills and the ability to tightly manage relationships with international Burson offices 
  • Attention to detail and an appreciation of time management

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

job.description:

Brunswick is seeking a reliable and organized Office Assistant with at least 12 months of administrative experience to support daily office operations. Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

job.title: Accounting Manager / Senior Accounting Manager
job.description:
Overview of the Firm 

FGS Global helps the world's most influential leaders move minds and markets. Working where business, government, and public opinion intersect, we advise CEOs, boards, and leadership teams at the most consequential moments.

We work as one team across geographies and disciplines - bringing together specialists with backgrounds in communications, finance, law, government, journalism, data science, and digital. Whatever the moment demands, we combine multidimensional perspectives to help leaders anticipate what's next, engage the stakeholders who matter, and drive meaningful outcomes.

Across 31 global offices, we draw on the full depth of the firm so clients can operate with clarity, act with confidence, and lead with trust. This collaborative approach has established FGS as a market leader: we are consistently ranked Band 1 for Crisis & Risk Management and Litigation Support by Chambers and Partners, and were ranked the #1 Global M&A PR firm by deal value and deal count for four consecutive years (Mergermarket, 2025).

 

The Role

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Accounting Manager to join our Asia finance team in Hong Kong. Reporting to the Head of Finance, Asia, and working closely with the Finance Operations Senior Manager, this role plays a key part in the accounting operations of the firm across the Hong Kong, Singapore, and China entities, with key responsibility for the month-end close, financial reporting, and tax compliance, as well as supporting the statutory and group audits. The role places a strong focus on income statement analysis to provide insight into revenue and cost performance.

The ideal candidate will be a qualified accountant who combines strong technical knowledge with a hands-on approach, takes accountability for their deliverables, and communicates clearly with senior internal and external stakeholders. They will be comfortable operating in a fast-paced professional services environment and contributing to continuous improvement in processes and controls. Experience with VAT/GST filing across Singapore and China jurisdictions will be highly regarded.

 

Responsibilities

  • Reporting to Head of Finance, this role is a key Act as a key member to perform the month-end closing, including revenue recognition, accruals, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis.
  • Work closely with Global Accounting Team to drive alignment and compliance with Group Policy and Accounting Standards and to support audits and tax filings.
  • Perform detailed monthly income statement analysis, explaining revenue and cost movements against prior periods, budget and forecast, and identifying trends, anomalies and risks.
  • Ensure departmental costs are accurately recorded, coded, and allocated to the correct cost centres, reviewing cost reports and resolving variances with budget holders on a timely basis.
  • Review and deliver monthly, quarterly, and annual financial and management reports, providing analysis and commentary on key variances to the Head of Finance and regional leadership.
  • Support the statutory and group audit processes together with Finance Operations Senior Manager.
  • Manage tax filing obligations across Hong Kong, Singapore, and China, including GST/VAT compliance, corporate income tax, and withholding tax matters, and liaise with external tax advisers.
  • Partner with operational teams on cost budgeting and reforecasting to support business to drive cost control.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to drive cost optimisation, analysing spending trends and recommending practical cost-saving initiatives to the Head of Finance and business leaders.
  • Partner with global finance teams and external service providers on group reporting, intercompany, and consolidation matters.
  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls and accounting policies, and drive process and system improvements to enhance efficiency in the Asia finance function.
  • Support ad hoc finance projects as required.

 

Desired Skills & Qualities

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related discipline from a recognised university.
  • A recognised professional accounting qualification (e.g. HKICPA, ACCA, CPA) is required.
  • 10-15 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in a professional services or multinational environment. Audit firm experience is an advantage.
  • Solid technical accounting knowledge, with experience applying US GAAP and/or IFRS/HKFRS.
  • Strong analytical skills with a proven track record in income statement analysis, able to translate financial results into clear, actionable insights for business leaders.
  • Proven experience supporting statutory audits and managing tax filings across multiple jurisdictions; familiarity with Singapore GST and China VAT filing will be highly considered.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with ERP or accounting systems such as NetSuite is strongly preferred.
  • Strong team player, with the ability to guide and support junior team members.
  • Hands-on, highly organised, and able to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced and dynamic working environment.
  • Treasury experience is a plus but it is NOT a must.
  • Proactive, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills and the confidence to engage senior stakeholders, auditors, and advisers.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English and Cantonese is preferred and be ready to join global calls

job.title: Business Development Representative
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

JOB DESCRIPTION

Position Summary

Bottle Rocket helps clients plan, build, and improve digital products, leading with defined, outcome-oriented offerings. The Business Development Representative (BDR) is the engine at the top of the sales funnel and a key driver of the company’s growth. This role owns outbound prospecting, turning a strong volume of leads into calls, calls into meetings, and meetings into new clients.

The ideal BDR is driven, tenacious, and a great active listener. They understand the front-end digital experience and the back-end that enables it. They can distill the needs behind a prospect’s business challenges, connect them to the right Bottle Rocket solution, and hand a well-qualified opportunity to the Business Development Executive team.

Essential Functions

  • Drive a high volume of outbound activity (calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach, and multi-touch cadences) to create a consistent flow of new leads
  • Convert leads into live conversations, and conversations into qualified first meetings booked for the Business Development Executive team
  • Own and consistently hit weekly and monthly targets for activity, conversations, meetings booked, and pipeline generated
  • Lead outreach with Bottle Rocket’s productized offerings, positioning each around the business problem it solves rather than a list of services
  • Spot buying signals in research and discovery calls, and connect them to the right Bottle Rocket services:
    • Strategy & Research (Experience Strategy, Research & Insights): unclear priorities, fragmented experiences, a new idea to validate
    • Design & Build (Design & Development, Experience Optimization): aging or low-rated apps, redesigns, falling engagement or conversion
    • Enterprise Engineering (Technical Modernization, Cloud Enablement, AI & Data, Application Engineering): legacy platforms, cloud migration, AI pilots, integration gaps
  • Research and build targeted account and contact lists in priority industries (Healthcare, Gaming, Hospitality, Financial Services, and QSR) with Business Development leadership
  • Qualify prospects on pain points, fit, budget, decision-making authority, and timeline, and hand off to Business Development Executives with clear notes and context
  • Partner with Marketing on go-to-market (GTM) campaigns for each offering, and share feedback on messaging, objections, and what is resonating in market
  • Prepare meeting agendas, follow-up emails, and other prospect communications
  • Keep activity, lead, and opportunity data accurate and current in the CRM
  • Track and report on funnel metrics: activity → conversations → meetings → opportunities → new clients
  • Work closely with Business Development, Marketing, and Product Strategy to align on GTM goals, KPIs, and metrics

Additional Duties and Responsibilities

  • Stay current on trends in digital products, AI, cloud, and tech modernization, and on the business priorities of target industries
  • Learn Bottle Rocket’s offerings, case studies, and delivery model well enough to speak credibly with prospects
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Economics, or a related field
  • 2–3 years of experience (post-college) in an outbound sales role, such as SDR or BDR, selling Technology or Consulting Services, SaaS, software, or similar technology products or services
  • Related backgrounds are welcome, such as technology-enabled services, digital agencies, or IT consulting
  • Proven, measurable record of meeting or exceeding activity, meeting, and pipeline targets

Key Competencies

  • Driven and tenacious: persistent follow-up, energized by high outbound volume, and quick to bounce back from a “no”
  • Great active listener: asks sharp questions, listens more than talks, and picks up on what a prospect isn’t saying
  • Technical curiosity: recognizes buying signals across Technical Modernization, AI & Data, Application Engineering, and Cloud Enablement, and can discuss them credibly at a business level (an engineering background is not required)
  • Problem-first, consultative approach that leads with outcomes rather than feature lists
  • Competitive, goal-oriented, and metrics-driven; thrives on clear targets and a visible scoreboard
  • Strong written communication, with the ability to write concise, compelling, personalized outreach
  • Confident and professional communicating with Director, VP, and C-level executives
  • Highly organized; keeps high activity volume and multiple cadences on track
  • Coachable, with a growth mindset and the ambition to step up into a Business Development Executive role
  • Self-starter who works well independently and as part of a fast-paced, collaborative team
  • Experienced using Microsoft Excel and Apple Keynote (preferred) or Microsoft PowerPoint
  • Regular attendance at work is required for successful performance

Preferred Skills

  • Experienced with CRM software; Salesforce preferred
  • Experience with sales engagement tools; Salesloft preferred
  • Experience with prospecting tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator or ZoomInfo
  • Experience with video conferencing (Zoom or Teams) and call recording tools; Gong preferred
  • Uses AI tools to research accounts and personalize outreach
  • Exposure to software development, cloud, or data concepts through a prior role, coursework, or personal projects
  • Experience selling into Healthcare, Gaming, Hospitality, Financial Services, or QSR
  • Previous experience in an entrepreneurial, small-company environment

Supervisory Responsibilities

job.title: OKTA Engineer - SSO
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
