For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Senior Identity and Access security Engineer is responsible for governing who, and what, can access DTS systems, data, APIs, tools, workflows and AI-enabled capabilities.

This is a hands-on governance and control role, reporting into the SVP Security and Compliance. The role ensures that access across DTS is appropriate, auditable, reviewed, least-privileged and aligned with security, privacy, compliance and client commitments.

The scope covers traditional human access, external users, privileged access, service accounts, machine identities, API keys, tokens, dataset access, and the emerging governance of AI agents and agentic workflows.

The role will work closely with Architecture, Security, Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal/DPO, TechOps, Enterprise Technology and the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure DTS has a clear and controlled model for access across platforms such as WPP Open, Choreograph, InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve and related DTS capabilities.

 

What you'll be doing:

1. Identity and access governance framework

Define and maintain the access governance framework for DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining access governance standards, processes and control expectations.
  • Establishing how access should be requested, approved, provisioned, reviewed, revoked and evidenced.
  • Ensuring access governance covers internal users, external users, clients, partners, vendors, service accounts, machine identities and AI agents.
  • Aligning identity and access governance with DTS architecture, security, privacy, compliance and data governance requirements.
  • Ensuring access governance is practical for product and engineering teams to implement.

 

2. Access reviews and recertification

Own the process for regular access reviews and recertification across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining the scope, frequency and evidence requirements for access reviews.
  • Coordinating access reviews for critical DTS systems, production environments, privileged roles, sensitive datasets, client-facing platforms and administrative tools.
  • Ensuring access review outcomes are tracked, remediated and evidenced.
  • Identifying stale, excessive, orphaned or poorly owned access.
  • Escalating overdue, high-risk or unresolved access issues through the appropriate governance channels.

 

3. Privileged access governance

Ensure privileged access across DTS is properly controlled, justified and auditable.

This includes:

  • Reviewing access to production systems, cloud environments, security tools, databases, CI/CD tooling, administrative consoles and sensitive platforms.
  • Supporting least-privilege, just-in-time and time-bound access models where appropriate.
  • Working with Cloud and Platform Security and Infrastructure to improve privileged access controls.
  • Ensuring privileged access risks are visible in the DTS risk register where required.

 

4. External user, client and partner access governance

Govern access for external users, clients, agencies, partners and vendors.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for external user onboarding, approval, permissions, expiry and offboarding.
  • Ensuring external access has a clear business owner and justification.
  • Supporting access governance across client workspaces, agency environments, partner integrations and shared collaboration areas.
  • Working with Product and Engineering to ensure tenant, workspace and client-level isolation is appropriately governed.
  • Tracking risks related to stale accounts, vendor access, partner permissions and external user overprivilege.

 

5. Service account, machine identity and API access governance

Govern non-human access across DTS systems and platforms.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for service accounts, machine identities, automation users, API keys, tokens, secrets and integration credentials.
  • Ensuring non-human access has clear ownership, purpose, scope, rotation, expiry and auditability.
  • Working with Product, Engineering, Cloud Security and Infrastructure to reduce unmanaged credential risk.
  • Ensuring service accounts and machine identities are included in access reviews.
  • Supporting stronger governance of API access, token issuance, credential lifecycle and integration permissions.

 

6. AI and agentic access governance

Define and oversee the governance model for AI agents and agentic workflows across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining how AI agents are identified, permissioned, monitored, reviewed and revoked.
  • Ensuring agents have clear ownership, scoped permissions and auditable actions.
  • Defining which agent actions require human approval or additional control.
  • Governing agent access to APIs, tools, datasets, workflows, client environments and production capabilities.
  • Ensuring agents act within delegated authority and cannot exceed the permissions of the user, system or business process they represent.
  • Working with Product, Architecture and Security to ensure agentic workflows are designed with clear action boundaries.
  • Working with the Product, Application and Offensive Security Lead to test whether agent permissions and action boundaries can be bypassed.
  • Working with Privacy Engineering to ensure AI access models support permitted use, minimisation and data protection requirements.

7. Data access governance

Govern access to sensitive, client, partner and WPP-owned data across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for dataset access approval, review, revocation and evidence.
  • Supporting data classification from an access-control and security-governance perspective.
  • Ensuring access to sensitive data is role-based, purpose-based, least-privileged and auditable.
  • Supporting controls for cross-client, cross-market, cross-agency and partner data access.
  • Ensuring data access governance supports InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve, WPP Open and other DTS data collaboration use cases.
  • Working with Privacy Engineering on data minimisation, permitted use, retention and privacy-by-design requirements.
  • Ensuring data access risks are surfaced through the DTS risk process.

 

8. Governance of access to tools, workflows and actions

Ensure access governance extends beyond systems and datasets into tools, workflows and actions.

This includes:

  • Defining governance for access to operational tools, workflow automation, orchestration systems, AI tools and administrative actions.
  • Ensuring high-risk actions are subject to appropriate approval, logging and monitoring.
  • Supporting segregation of duties across sensitive workflows.
  • Ensuring automated workflows and agents have clearly scoped authority.
  • Working with Security Operations to ensure high-risk access and actions are visible in monitoring and detection processes.

 

9. Auditability, evidence and reporting

Maintain clear evidence of access governance and support audit and assurance requirements.

This includes:

  • Producing access governance evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, client assurance, internal audit and risk reviews.
  • Working with the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure access controls, reviews, exceptions and remediation actions are documented.
  • Reporting on access review completion, high-risk access, overdue actions and access control gaps.
  • Supporting client and audit questions related to identity, access, privileged roles, service accounts, AI agents and data access.
  • Ensuring access governance is repeatable, measurable and auditable.

 

Who you'll be working with:

The Senior Identity and Access Security Engineer will be accountable for:

  • DTS identity and access governance standards.
  • Regular access reviews and recertification.
  • Privileged access governance.
  • External user, client, partner and vendor access governance.
  • Service account, machine identity, API key and token governance.
  • AI agent identity, permission and action governance.
  • Dataset and sensitive data access governance.
  • Governance of access to tools, workflows and high-risk actions.
  • Access governance evidence for audit, compliance and client assurance.
  • Escalation of material access risks into the DTS risk process.

 

What you'll need:

The successful candidate will have:

  • Experience in identity governance, access management, IAM, security governance, GRC, data access control or platform security.
  • Strong understanding of least privilege, role-based access control, attribute-based access control, access reviews, privileged access and segregation of duties.
  • Experience governing access across SaaS platforms, cloud environments, APIs, data platforms or enterprise technology estates.
  • Knowledge of identity platforms such as Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, Azure AD / Entra ID or similar.
  • Understanding of service accounts, machine identities, API keys, tokens, secrets and non-human access governance.
  • Understanding of AI agents, agentic workflows, delegated authority and tool-access governance would be highly valuable.
  • Understanding of data classification, dataset access governance, privacy-by-design and audit requirements.
  • Ability to work across security, architecture, product, engineering, infrastructure, legal, privacy and compliance teams.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to coordinate reviews, evidence, remediation and reporting.
  • Ability to translate complex access issues into clear risks, controls and practical actions.

 

Leadership expectations

The Senior Identity and Access Security Engineer is expected to:

  • Be structured, disciplined and pragmatic.
  • Bring clarity to complex access and permission models.
  • Challenge excessive, unclear or poorly governed access.
  • Work constructively with product and engineering teams to design workable controls.
  • Avoid creating unnecessary bureaucracy while ensuring access is properly governed.
  • Treat human, machine and agent access as part of the same control landscape.
  • Escalate material access risks clearly and early.
  • Support DTS in building a secure, auditable and scalable access governance model.

 

Success measures

Success in the role will be measured by:

  • DTS having clear identity, access and data access governance standards.
  • Regular access reviews completed on schedule with evidence.
  • Reduction in stale, excessive, orphaned or poorly owned access.
  • Stronger governance of privileged access and production access.
  • Clear ownership and review of service accounts, machine identities, API keys and tokens.
  • Defined governance for AI agent identities, permissions and actions.
  • Improved auditability of access to data, APIs, tools, workflows and production systems.
  • Better alignment between identity, security, privacy, architecture, product and engineering teams.
  • Material access risks being visible through the DTS risk register and Risk Review Board.
  • Increased confidence that DTS can answer: who or what has access to what, why, and when was it last reviewed?

job.title: Communications Director
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading

 

 

In addition, a VALUES FIT is top priority. Do our values align with yours? Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on.

 

 

The Communications Director is responsible for the organization, development, and oversight of comprehensive and integrated communications objectives and message positioning in support of established ministry goals. Responsible for the implementation of internal and external communications initiatives, including public relations initiatives and serves as an official spokesperson for the ministry. Works closely with senior leadership on the development and administration of communication plans and strategies. Supervises staff and outside consultants/vendors responsible for the development and production of strategic communications content for employees, media, and community functions.

 

* This is an in-office role at our Franklin, TN Office

 

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Proactively influence our culture, leading by example in demonstrating collaboration, empowerment, innovation, creativity and service, while being a faithful witness on and off the job of K-LOVE’s mission to create compelling media that inspires and encourages our listeners to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.
  • As a member of leadership, contribute to long term planning and vision implementation through identification of strategic Marketing initiatives, collaboration, prioritization, communication, and evaluation of results, while preserving K-LOVE’s reputation for integrity and excellence.
  • Engage Chief Marketing & Communications Officer on communication issues, trends, and proposals for strategic initiatives and delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with other departments such as Programming, Engagement, and other departments.
  • Assist with strategic planning and implementation for communication strategies with a focus on communication goals, timelines, budgets, results tracking, and celebration.
  • Assess communication performance against both annual goals and plans. Provide strategic recommendations based on operational analysis, research, and projections, cost identification and allocation, and resource analysis. Ensure tools and systems are in place to provide critical operational and project information to the Chief Marketing & Communications Officer and others, and make actionable recommendations on both strategic goals and operational constraints.
  • Provide leadership for the communication function and team, ensuring ministry wide collaboration and facilitating appropriate resolution of issues, and competing priorities. Ensure alignment of communication Initiatives with Ministry objectives.
  • Consult with senior leadership to provide communication strategies that protect, promote, and enhance the reputation of the organization.
  • Review and approves the work product of department staff, outside departments, and external vendors and freelancers to ensure quality, accuracy, and brand consistency.
  • Manage the communication strategy and direction for acquisitions, internal communication initiatives, newsletters, and ministry special events.
  • Oversee the writing and production of special reports, executive messages, fact sheets, brochures, newsletters, etc.
  • Provide strategic communication support to the Chief Marketing & Communications Officer and the Ministry Leadership Team in the form of talking points, speeches, and other resources.
  • Plans and directs administrative, financial, and operational activities for the department as needed and requested by senior management. Organize and prioritize critical issues and required information to facilitate efficient decision making.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

We are looking for a very specific skill set. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you!

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, English, or related field, or combination of education/training with relevant experience.
  • Six plus years of communications and/or public relations experience is required.
  • Experience directing and/or managing comprehensive strategic communications, media relations, and related teams preferred.
  • Strong writing skills including a working knowledge of AP Style required.
  • Experience working closely with creative teams on the design and production of creative products that support strategic communication goals.
  • Effective communication skills written, verbal, listening, and presentation are required.
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with all levels of the organization, including senior management. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications is required.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/ministry relationships.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

job.title: Operations & Innovation Specialist
job.description:
Operations & Innovation Specialist 

(Milwaukee, WI)

Good Karma Sports is seeking a full-time Operations & Innovation Specialist to join the Home Office Innovation Team, with a dedicated focus on supporting our Digital business & teammates.


This role will help teammates work smarter by identifying opportunities to improve existing workflows, eliminate repetitive tasks, and implement practical solutions using AI, automation, and technology.


The ideal candidate is curious, creative, analytical, and action-oriented. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding how things work, challenging the status quo, experimenting with new technology, and turning ideas into meaningful operational improvements.


Career responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build strong relationships with teammates to understand their workflows, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Identify repetitive, inefficient, or manual processes across departments and prioritize opportunities for improvement.
  • Evaluate existing workflows, recommend improvements, and design, build, test, implement, and maintain AI-enaabled solutions and automations that improve operational efficiency and consistency.
  • Partner with leadership and the Home Office Innovation Team to prioritize projects and execute improvements.
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools and technologies to identify new ways to improve productivity and operations.
  • Develop clear processes, documentation, and training materials that help teammates adopt new solutions.
  • Support the successful rollout and ongoing adoption of new tools, systems, and workflows.
  • Measure and communicate the impact of innovation initiatives, including time saved, improved efficiency, and increased operational capacity.
  • Collaborate with the Home Office Innovation Team and other teammates across Good Karma Sports to share successful solutions, improve workflows, and implement best practices.
  • Complete additional responsibilities and projects as assigned.
  • Represent Good Karma Sports by demonstrating our core values: Listen, Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Follow Through, and Teamwork.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications:

  • Strong curiosity, analytical thinking, and creative problem-solving abilities.
  • Passion for AI, emerging technology, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to understand complex workflows and translate challenges into practical solutions.
  • Experience with AI platforms, workflow automation, low-code/no-code tools, CRM systems, or reporting tools is a plus.
  • Resourceful, self-directed, and comfortable experimenting with unfamiliar technology.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to influence and support change across teams without direct authority.
  • Ability to balance experimentation, execution, accuracy, and responsible technology use.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-changing environment and managing multiple priorities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and willingness to learn new platforms and systems.
  • Valid driver’s license required.

Hours/Salary/Benefits

This is a full-time, in-office, exempt salaried position offering a competitive base salary based on experience and qualifications.

This role is eligible for full benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, Life Insurance, STD, LTD, 401(k) Plan, Dependent Care, paid parental leave, and more, with opportunities for growth as responsibilities and impact expand.

The position may require occasional evenings and weekends depending on project needs and operational priorities.


Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow within Good Karma and are responsible for representing Good Karma Sports, our story, and our core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than November 25, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.  

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY. 

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

JOB OVERVIEW

You’ll be at the heart of our production center, helping millions of customers across the world enjoy Hallmark products. You will have a variety of duties that support the production process in numerous ways. You’ll be cross-trained across multiple departments by a support team of trainers and supervisors to help you learn every step of the way!


SALARY AND SHIFT DETAILS

  • Your starting pay will be between $19.80 - $23.30 depending on your shift.
  • This position is a part-time, 3-day, 10-hour per day, work week position in the Weekend Shift with the following shift options:
    • Friday/Saturday/Sunday: 7:30am - 5:30pm
      -or-
    • Saturday/Sunday/Monday: 7:30am - 5:30pm

     



    THE RESPONSIBILITIES WE’LL TRUST YOU WITH

    We take great care in every item we create. You will join a diverse team who enjoys fast-paced work. Our teams have physical stamina, an eye for detail, and are reliable to get the job done. You will be trained to support production across different work areas in our facility. Some of your duties may include:

    • You will prepare and move greeting card stock to the cutter and to assigned pallets. You will pack finished goods on a packaging line.
    • You will remove die-cut cards from full sheets by using a hammer or our automatic extractor system. You will prepare and set up the automatic extractor to cut the correct sheet dimensions.
    • You will determine when the adhesive will be mixed and when tests will be performed on the mixture. You will ensure that the ingredients are in the area for mixing adhesives.
    • You will support the production areas by ordering the correct stock, moving components in and out of areas, inputting information into the computer system, and maintaining a clean, safe work environment.
    • You will examine the products to ensure product quality has been met and assist in preventative maintenance.

    Important things to know:

    • Flexibility is key as you will assist with all aspects of the different assignments across departments.
    • In the production areas there is some noise. Hearing protection is provided by Hallmark.
    • Overtime is available and will be covered during the interview process.

    YOUR AREAS OF KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERTISE

    Basic Qualifications

    • You’re at least 18 years of age
    • You have the ability to grip and push/pull lifts of stock 2”-3.5” thick, 80-120 times per hour
    • You have the ability to lift 20-30 lb stacks of stock, 60-80 times per hour, with frequent lifting throughout the shift of 40-60 lbs.
    • You have the ability to constantly stand, walk, twist, bend, and reach above shoulder level

    Preferred Qualifications

    • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
    • Strong communication- and problem-solving skills

    We want to help you be your best – at work and at home, now and in the future. It’s why providing benefits to support you and your family’s well-being is one of the most important investments Hallmark makes.

    • Your life: During your first year, you’ll receive 18 days (144 hours) of PTO and 10 paid holidays. Paid parental leave, adoption assistance, and comprehensive fertility benefits for eligible employees.

Whether you have purple hair or express yourself through body art, we want you to bring your whole self to work.

job.title: Data Engineer - Business Intelligence (Remote)
job.description:
WHO WE ARE & WHAT WE DO

Hallmark’s Data & Business Intelligence organization turns enterprise data into trusted insights that help teams across Hallmark make better, faster decisions. We build and manage the data platforms, pipelines, semantic models, and analytics solutions that support critical business areas including retail, product, consumer, merchandising, planning, finance, and executive reporting.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING & THE IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE

We are looking for an experienced BI Engineer to design and build scalable, governed analytics solutions that enable trusted and intuitive access to enterprise data. This role will focus on developing Power BI semantic models, reusable business/context layers, and self-service analytics capabilities, leveraging Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and AI-assisted development practices. The ideal candidate will have 6–8 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or related areas, with strong hands-on expertise in Power BI, dimensional modeling, semantic model development, SQL, and modern cloud data platforms. This role also requires an AI-first engineering mindset. The engineer will be expected to use approved AI capabilities to accelerate development, testing, documentation, optimization, and modernization while maintaining accountability for the quality, security, and maintainability of production solutions.

This is a progressive role that will be filled at the level based on the skills and experience of the selected candidate.

 

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • The salary range for this role is $85,000 - $110,000. Final compensation varies based on several factors.
  • This is a U.S.-based remote role.* We’re committed to creating a connected, collaborative culture, no matter where you are. You’ll have access to virtual tools, team support, and opportunities to engage and grow with us. *Due to state-specific benefits regulations, Hallmark cannot consider candidates for remote positions who reside in Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico, or any country outside of the United States.
  • This is a progressive role designed to grow with you. We’ll match the job level to your skills and experience so you can hit the ground running and keep building your career.
  • Hallmark is committed to recognizing and rewarding performance. Employees are eligible for annual merit-based increases, aligned with individual and company performance.
  • In alignment with our culture of care, Hallmark offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, paid time off, 401K with company match, and profit-sharing.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS (the following is required to be considered for this role):

  • At lease 6 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technology discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including semantic model development, DAX, Power Query/M, dimensional modeling, Power BI Service, data security, and performance optimization.
  • Experience designing and developing dimensional data models using star schemas, facts, dimensions, aggregations, relationships, hierarchies, measures, and KPIs.
  • Demonstrated experience building shared and reusable semantic/business layers, rather than primarily developing individual reports.
  • Experience developing and implementing self-service analytics capabilities for business users.
  • Experience developing and optimizing SQL queries for performance and efficiency.
  • Hands-on experience working with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
  • Experience developing analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric.
  • Understanding of modern analytical architectures spanning data platforms, analytical data products, semantic models, and visualization layers.
  • Experience designing or developing modern analytical architectures that include data platforms, analytical data products, semantic models, and visualization layers
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into scalable technical and analytical solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating Generative AI or AI coding assistants into real-world development workflows.
  • Ability to use AI effectively to generate, review, refine, and troubleshoot SQL, DAX, M, semantic-model metadata, documentation, and other engineering artifacts.
  • Experience using AI across multiple stages of the development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, troubleshooting, optimization, and documentation.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated solutions for correctness rather than accepting generated code without appropriate engineering review.
  • Experience applying responsible AI development practices, including data protection, security, validation, governance, and human accountability

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (your application will stand out if you have the following):

  • Advanced experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Direct Lake, Dataflows Gen2, and data pipelines.
  • Experience integrating and optimizing Power BI with Snowflake.
  • Experience with medallion or layered data architectures and curated analytical data products.
  • Experience with CI/CD, Git integration, deployment pipelines, source control, and DevOps practices for BI and analytics solutions.
  • Experience establishing BI governance, semantic-model standards, common metric definitions, and self-service analytics frameworks.
  • Experience modernizing legacy BI/reporting platforms to Power BI, Fabric, Snowflake, or other modern cloud analytics platforms.
  • Experience with metadata management, data catalogs, lineage, business glossaries, or Microsoft Purview.

job.title: Senior Account Executive, Advertising Sales
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).


Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is seeking a data-driven, results-oriented Senior Account Executive to drive podcast and digital media sales for some of the most recognized names in the creator marketplace. This role spans across multiple platforms—including Podcast, YouTube, and Social Media—offering a unique opportunity to work with high-profile creators and innovative brands.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive business development by identifying and cultivating relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders across advertising agencies and brands.

  • Develop and deliver tailored sales presentations that clearly articulate value and drive incremental revenue.

  • Prospect and pitch new business, expanding Red Seat Ventures’ footprint and share of client advertising budgets.

  • Sell various ad formats, including host-read endorsements, Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI), video, and custom branded content integrations.

  • Manage the full sales cycle—from initial outreach and proposal creation through negotiation, closing, and post-sale account management.

  • Ensure flawless campaign execution, overseeing all aspects of delivery, reporting, and client satisfaction.

  • Create custom marketing and media solutions that align with client goals and optimize results across multiple platforms.

job.title: Field Photographer, NY Bureau
job.description:
Fox News is looking for an experienced Field Photographer to join our New York Bureau. In this role, you will cover breaking news and planned events domestically and internationally, collaborating with photographers, field technicians, satellite truck operators, engineers, producers, and reporters. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in fast-moving breaking-news environments, including protests, rallies, civil unrest, and conflict zones, using traditional ENG cameras. You must also be comfortable supporting high-end, multi-camera productions with full-frame cinematic cameras and professional lighting techniques. This physically demanding position requires long hours, extensive travel, and the ability to safely lift and transport heavy equipment. This is a Tuesday - Saturday schedule. 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deployed across all FOX News Media platforms, including FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business (FBN), and FOX Nation, and Fox Weather as coverage demands
  • Operate Sony ENG broadcast and cine cameras and manage file-based workflows
  • Edit using Adobe Premiere
  • Lead multi-camera and full-frame camera assignments
  • Configure audio for single and multiple camera set-ups
  • Operate LiveU and Starlink transmission systems
  • Safely operate company-owned and rental vehicles

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional field photography experience
  • Strong video photography and non-linear editing experience
  • Advanced lighting skills, including experience with long format shoots
  • Working knowledge of field audio mixers and multi-camera audio routing
  • Familiarity with streaming technologies and satellite newsgathering vehicles
  • Willingness to train on satellite-camera crew vehicles and larger vehicles
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure breaking-news environment
  • Flexibility to work across bureau, shooting, editing, and satellite-truck operations as needed
  • Availability to travel extensively and deploy on short notice for a 24-hour news operation, including overtime and weekends
  • A valid driver’s license, clean driving record, and valid passport; CDL preferred

job.title: Membership Advisor, Arena
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with leading brands, creators, and organizations to build and scale digital-first media businesses. We combine strategic insight, creative excellence, and operational rigor to deliver content-driven platforms that engage audiences and drive sustainable growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures, in partnership with FOX Corporation, is launching a new membership-based business centered around premium live entertainment experiences. We are seeking Regional Sales Directors to drive new memberships through compelling, relationship-driven sales experiences that convert interest into long-term membership.

Reporting to the VP of Sales, the Membership Advisor  will play a critical role in driving new memberships through high-touch, relationship-driven sales experiences. This role is ideal for an accomplished sales professional who thrives in a startup-style growth environment and excels at engaging discerning high-net-worth individuals. Success in this role requires the ability to convert trial experiences into long-term memberships while representing the brand with professionalism, credibility, and integrity.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive consistent new memberships by managing a robust pipeline of qualified prospects from initial outreach through close, using CRM, internal tools, and sales enablement systems to track activity, forecasting, and performance
  • Engage prospective members across multiple touchpoints, including phone, email, text, in-person meetings, and live event experiences, serving as the primary sales contact
  • Educate prospects, deliver tailored presentations, and convert trial experiences into memberships
    Actively initiate and participate in pipeline development activities, including networking, referrals, and partner relationships
  • Collaborate closely with Member Experience and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and a seamless transition from prospect to active member
  • Represent the brand at live events, trials, and hosted experiences, building trust, capturing insights, and advancing opportunities through the sales funnel
  • Maintain accurate and timely reporting of sales activity, pipeline health, and forecasted revenue in CRM
  • Contribute to the development of best practices, playbooks, and processes as the organization scales

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of experience in a sales role with a proven track record of closing high-value opportunities, ideally with high-net-worth individuals or premium clients
  • Strong ability to build and sustain relationships through trust, credibility, and consultative selling
  • Experience using CRM systems to manage pipeline, track activity, and forecast revenue
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to individuals and small groups
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment where performance is closely tied to results
  • Highly self-motivated, organized, and capable of managing multiple opportunities while traveling frequently within territory

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience selling in hospitality, luxury services, private clubs, live entertainment, or experiential offerings
  • Background in startup environments or newly launched business units
  • Experience leveraging relationships and informal networks to generate referrals and new business
  • Familiarity with live event environments, premium venues, or membership-based models

job.title: Licensing Operations and Billing Specialist- SESAC (Nashville)
job.description:
SESAC is looking for a Licensing Operations and Billing Specialist to join our Nashville team. This role is key to ensuring the accuracy, efficiency and integrity of the day-to-day Licensing Administration operations and billing functions by managing end-to-end billing processes, maintaining accurate records, performing audits, resolving discrepancies and supporting operations workflows. 

The Licensing Operations and Billing Specialist also supports timely and accurate financial and operational reporting through data collection, analysis, report writing and process improvement.

 

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Responsible for managing the end-to-end billing process to ensure timely and accurate generation of invoices, validate that billings are booked to the correct markets, and adherence to company protocols/procedures.
  • Supports resolution of problematic billing by collaborating with the Operations and IT teams to identify and implement solutions. 
  • Contributes to projects aimed at improving billing processes and policies, ensuring continued compliance with internal procedures, license agreements, and external reporting requirements.
  • Runs reporting to assess actual vs. expected billings, investigate variances and shares findings with appropriate team members.
  • Works with the Billing, Licensing Administration and IT team on any billing related issues. 
  • Responsible for communicating/training/documenting any updated billing processes. 
  • Reviews negotiated contracts to ensure proper processing and supply needed details to finance.
  • Participates in testing of upgrades and/or enhancements to the billing systems/processes. 
  • Reviews, analyzes and audits billing information to ensure billings are complete and accurate. 
  • Monitor billing efforts to ensure adherence to company protocols and measure against goals. 
  • Performs audits of licensing processing to identify errors and inform additional team training that may be needed.
  • Supports requests for reporting and analysis received from external auditors
  • Supports revenue related inquiries and month end close process by addressing inquiries from the finance team related to variances between expected billing revenue vs actuals.
  • Utilizes understanding of licensing process, billing impacts and database structure to identify potential issues and recommend solutions to improve data integrity and licensing administration operations.
  • Builds, maintains, analyzes, and validates operational reports, queries, and dashboards to support accurate billing, review outstanding/diligent payments, ensure accuracy of data, etc.
  • Assists with Licensee/Process Audits as needed
  • Reviews current processes and procedures for effectiveness and makes recommendations for changes.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned.

What Makes You Qualified:

job.title: Associate Sales Director
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times' Advertising team is looking for an Associate Sales Director to join our Emerging Business Sales Team. Associate Sales Directors establish new business, agencies, and client groups to secure advertising investment and ensure success of campaigns. You will tailor and pivot the NYT pitch and solution based on advertisers' needs and goals. Through a consultative approach, you will pitch to clients our full New York Times portfolio, which includes The Athletic, NYT Cooking, Wirecutter, NYT News, Games, Audio, and more.

About the Role

Your primary goal is to grow and diversify advertising revenue. You are a team player and contribute to the goals and success of The NYT's Advertising Department, and our mission. You will participate in an Incentive Compensation Program for account-based revenue as determined by Advertising Department Leadership. This is a hybrid role based in our New York headquarters, reporting to the Head of Emerging Business. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Exceed assigned revenue goals by understanding client needs and recommending advertising solutions that support their goals.
  • Respond to inbound advertising inquiries, understand the advertiser's goals, qualify opportunities
  • Prospect for new business and identify potential advertisers and opportunities across assigned industries.
  • Build client relationships through thoughtful follow-up and communication by phone, email, and meetings.
  • Manage the RFP (Request for Proposal) process and create clear sales presentations for clients.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across the Advertising department to share insights and deliver the best possible results for our advertisers.
  • Develop knowledge of New York Times advertising products, sales strategies, and standards.
  • Maintain opportunities in Salesforce to ensure sales management has a clear view of your pipeline and client interactions.
  • Attend and conduct client meetings and outings, being a professional ambassador for New York Times Advertising.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

job.title: Senior Security Engineer
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a respected media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format known as Smart Brevity™. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI security experience to lead our defensive posture, drive threat modeling and vulnerability management, and embed security controls - including AI-driven defense and monitoring - across our platform and automation pipelines.

Why it matters: As a Senior Security Engineer at Axios, you will architect and implement proactive security strategies to protect our audience, platform, and data assets against evolving threat vectors, including AI-driven attacks. In this role, you will define our security roadmap, leverage internal and third-party AI defense tools, and ensure our cloud systems remain resilient, secure by default, and capable of automated threat detection and response.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architectural design and implementation of security controls across cloud infrastructure, platform services, and AI integrations.
  • Drive vulnerability management, threat modeling, incident response, and proactive security assessments across AWS, Kubernetes, and AI application environments.
  • Shape, maintain, and execute the company’s long-term security roadmap in close alignment with engineering and executive leadership.
  • Embed automated security testing, SAST/DAST, and AI-driven compliance checks directly into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code workflows.
  • Oversee identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption protocols, and zero-trust architecture standards.
  • Evaluate, deploy, and maintain internal AI security tools and modern third-party defensive solutions to detect, mitigate, and respond to AI-driven threats and sophisticated attack vectors in real time.
  • Promote a strong security culture across engineering by conducting threat modeling workshops and coaching teams on secure coding and infrastructure practices.
  • Partner with product, infrastructure, data, and QE teams to ensure security is integrated seamlessly into every stage of the development lifecycle.

Skills:

  • Deep expertise in cloud and application security, including threat modeling, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, IAM, secrets management, AI security, and compliance frameworks.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS infrastructure and security controls (IAM, KMS, EKS, RDS, S3).
  • Experience hardening Kubernetes clusters, runtime security, container scanning, and network policy enforcement.
  • Proficiency in integrating SAST/DAST and security automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions).
  • Solid scripting or programming skills in Python, Go, or Bash for security tooling and automated remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, security logging, automated threat intelligence, and AI-powered monitoring frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or modern SOC tooling).
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving security initiatives, defining policy, and guiding engineering teams on security risk.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively balance security requirements and business agility.

What success looks like:

  • Security & Compliance: Focused on proactive security initiatives, including automated vulnerability scans, implementation of controls, remediation, and contributions to the long-term security roadmap.
  • Cloud Security Architecture: Hardened, reviewed, and optimized AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure security to meet strict compliance, resilience, and least-privilege access standards.
  • DevSecOps & Automation: Integrated automated security scans, secret detection, and vulnerability gates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines without disrupting developer velocity.
  • Security Tooling Adoption: Evaluated, piloted, and deployed advanced security and defensive AI tools that measurably enhanced threat detection speed and reduced exposure risk.
  • Threat Detection & Response: Established robust security monitoring, SIEM alerting, and incident response playbooks to maintain real-time visibility and rapid response capabilities across all production platforms.
  • Cross-Functional Security Leadership: Partnered with engineering, product, and QE teams to instill a security-first culture, conduct threat modeling workshops, and guide technical teams on risk mitigation.
  • AI Defense & Security: Evaluated and deployed internal AI security tools and 3rd-party defensive solutions to proactively safeguard infrastructure, applications, and corporate assets against AI-driven threats and emerging attack vectors.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $150,000 - $180,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account the cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

job.title: LN Media & Sponsorship || Regional Brand Manager
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

The Regional Brand Manager helps build and strengthen client relationships while owning the day-to-day delivery and fulfillment of strategic marketing partnerships for local and national brands. This Indianapolis-based role at 2 Amphitheaters and 2 Clubs and theaters collaborates with clients, venue teams, and internal partners to bring programs to life across multiple categories. 

  • Account Ownership: Take ownership of your assigned sponsorship programs and commitments while building strong relationships with clients and internal partners.
  • Strategic Client Partnership: Engaging with brands year-round to understand evolving goals, bring forward ideas to optimize programs, and plan for future growth.
  • Market Ownership: Becoming the go-to expert on your venues, inventory, market, and open opportunities.
  • Venue Excellence: Preparing venues and sponsorship assets for the season and delivering consistent, high-quality execution on show days.
  • Financial Performance: Account forecasting, budget management, accounts payable, reporting, data analytics, and identifying trends.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnering with Sales to understand client commitments, strategy and planning to shape programs, product specialists to deliver the right solutions, and fulfillment and venue teams to execute each element; keeping everyone aligned and informed along the way.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

The best Brand Managers stay hungry. They keep learning, deliver consistently internally and externally, show up to every type of client interaction prepared and present, push to consistently meet client and divisional standards, and take ownership of the outcome, not just the task. Here's what that looks like day to day.


Account Ownership & Client Strategy

  • Know the business inside and out: how Live Nation Media & Sponsorship contributes to company revenue, the products and assets we offer, what's in each of our venues, where the sales team is focused, and which teams you'll partner with to deliver every client commitment.
  • Know your regional and national clients just as well, including their objectives, KPIs, audiences, and what success looks like to them, so you can put the right Live Nation products, inventory, and business solutions to work for them.
  • Execute regional and national sponsorship programs in line with contract deliverables, timelines, and venue requirements, from strategic planning through measurement.
  • Serve as a key day-to-day contact for assigned accounts, venues, and markets, in partnership with the relevant account and venue teams.
  • Hold yourself to a high standard with everyone you work with: be professional, be a great teammate, manage your time, follow through on every commitment, and own your results.
  • Coordinate the sponsorship contract process with Legal and other teams, tracking approvals and helping move agreements forward accurately and on time.
  • Manage program budgets and forecasts, monitor spending and financial risk, and partner with Finance on related financial documents, accurate reporting, and revenue recognition.
  • Build relationships beyond day-to-day client contacts and stay connected with clients year-round through regular meetings and conversations about their evolving business goals and priorities.
  • Create client-facing pacing updates, recaps, reports, and presentations that use KPIs and client feedback to communicate results and recommend ways to optimize programs.
  • Partner with Sales on renewal planning, using client insights and program results to identify opportunities to strengthen and grow each partnership.

Market Excellence & Venue Readiness

  • Become the go-to expert on your market(s), including venue operations, sponsorship inventory, existing partner programs, sales opportunities, market dynamics, and ways to operate more efficiently.
  • Own sponsorship execution on assigned show days, coordinating on-site logistics, activations, venue requirements, and sponsorship event staff from pre-show through close.
  • Lead preseason preparation so every sponsorship asset and activation area is ready by opening day, and partner with venue teams on end-of-season winterization.
  • Partner with Regional Sales and National Brand Management to spot opportunities and shape sponsorship packages using available inventory, client needs, and venue capabilities based on local nuances.

Concert Execution & Staffing

  • Serve as on-site sponsorship coverage at assigned concerts and key engagements, including client hospitality and custom events.
  • Plan schedules and sponsorship coverage across 100+ shows each year, balancing overlapping events, activation deadlines, and staffing needs.
  • Schedule, train, and direct Sponsorship Event Staff for assigned events and alternate show coverage, providing clear briefings, execution guidance, and post-event follow-up.
  • Keep clients and internal partners informed with clear, timely communication on show announcements, presales, day-of-show needs, and post-event follow-up.

Collaboration & Innovation

  • Build strong relationships with venue teams, Sales, Legal, Finance, SES, senior leadership, and other Live Nation partners to keep programs aligned with client objectives.
  • Collaborate with Brand Management counterparts across regions to share best practices, resolve challenges, and strengthen consistency across regional and national programs.
  • Stay curious. Bring audience insights, marketing trends, and emerging technologies to the table to develop fresh activation ideas and keep programs ahead of the curve.
  • Support additional sponsor-related projects and department priorities as requested by management.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 3+ years of direct experience in brand or account management, client service, media, entertainment, marketing consulting, sales, advertising, or activation agencies.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Strong client service instincts, diligent follow-up, and the ability to build trusted relationships with clients and internal partners.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and a calendar of 100+ shows a year at the venue, balancing overlapping schedules, staffing needs, and client deadlines.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with clients, venue teams and event staff.
  • A proactive, organized, and collaborative working style. You anticipate needs, meet deadlines, and take ownership without waiting to be asked.
  • A strong desire to learn and grow, with the drive to stay engaged, ask questions, and show up prepared and present every day.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adjust priorities, respond to changing business needs, and work effectively under pressure.
  • Experience coordinating event staff to deliver flawless on-site programs.
  • Familiarity with marketing programs that connect in-person experiences with digital components preferred.
  • Knowledge of consumer and market research, with the ability to translate insights into client recommendations and performance reporting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Asana, Airtable, Slack, Keynote, AI tools, social media tools, or graphic design applications preferred.
  • Strong financial management skills, including the ability to maintain multiyear budgets, monitor expenses, and prepare reliable forecasts.
  • Attention to detail when reviewing program and financial results, including the ability to identify errors, explain trends, and highlight opportunities.
  • A passion for music, live events, branding, and current entertainment trends.
  • Ability to be based in the Indianapolis area, provide regular on-site coverage at assigned venues, and travel within the market and surrounding areas as needed, including nights and weekends.
  • Reliable transportation to and from assigned venues and the office.
  • Ability to lift items weighing up to 50 pounds as needed.

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. job.title: Tax Director - LATAM
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


THE ROLE

The LATAM Tax Director owns the tax function for Live Nation Entertainment’s Latin American operations (including Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico and Peru). This individual contributor sets the regional tax strategy, makes and recommends the tax decisions affecting the region, and is accountable for the accuracy, efficiency and risk posture of direct tax, indirect tax, transfer pricing and global minimum tax matters across all LATAM jurisdictions.


Operating with a high degree of independence, the Director defines how the region responds to a rapidly evolving Latin American tax landscape, determines the positions the company takes on complex and often unprecedented technical matters, and serves as the authoritative tax voice to regional and corporate leadership. Fluency in Spanish is required.
 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO


Regional Tax Strategy & Governance

  • Own the LATAM tax strategy, including the annual and multi-year regional tax plan, and align it with corporate tax, finance and business objectives.
  • Establish the governance framework, policies and controls under which tax is managed across LATAM jurisdictions, and hold the region accountable to them.
  • Determine and document the company’s technical tax positions for the region, exercising independent judgment on complex, ambiguous and precedent-setting matters.
  • Own the regional tax risk profile: identify, quantify, prioritize and mitigate exposures, and escalate material matters with a clear recommended course of action.
  • Anticipate and interpret regulatory change (SAT in Mexico, AFIP in Argentina, Receita Federal in Brazil and other comparable authorities), assess business impact, and direct the company’s response.


Tax Provision, Compliance & Reporting

  • Oversee LATAM direct and indirect tax compliance — income tax, VAT/IVA and withholding taxes — and ensure appropriate governance and consistency across jurisdictions.
  • Own the tax provision and reporting for LATAM entities under US GAAP and IFRS, including the judgments underlying uncertain tax positions, valuation allowances and effective tax rate drivers.
  • Lead LATAM implementation of and compliance with Pillar Two and Country-by-Country Reporting, including data readiness, modeling of outcomes and the region’s filing strategy.
  • Direct the regional tax calendar and set the standard for quality, timeliness and audit-readiness of all filings and disclosures.
  • Serve as the region’s decision-maker and technical authority in partnership with the U.S. and global tax teams on matters affecting LATAM.

Transfer Pricing & Intercompany

  • Own the tax implications of intercompany transactions across the region and the design and defense of regional transfer-pricing positions.
  • Direct the preparation and maintenance of transfer pricing documentation, local files and intercompany agreements, and approve the methodologies applied.
  • Assess the regional impact of changes to the intercompany operating model and recommend structural adjustments to leadership.

Audit & Controversy

  • Lead LATAM tax audits and controversy end to end, including strategy, negotiation posture, settlement recommendations and coordination of consistent positions across countries.
  • Own root-cause analysis of audit findings and drive the process, documentation and control changes required to eliminate recurring exposures.
  • Manage regional tax advisor and external auditor relationships, including selection, scope, budget, performance and resolution of tax matters.


Transactions & Structuring

  • Lead and advise on LATAM tax planning for cross-border transactions, repatriations and cash-movement strategies, and recommend the approach the company adopts.
  • Own tax due diligence for regional M&A and joint ventures, evaluate identified exposures, and advise deal teams and senior leadership on materiality and mitigation.
  • Determine the optimal structure for new entities, joint ventures and market entries, and direct implementation.
  • Evaluate the existing regional structure for tax inefficiencies and lead the design and execution of optimization initiatives.
  • Negotiate tax provisions, permanent establishment protections, and indirect and withholding tax terms in transaction documents, in partnership with Legal.

Process, Systems & Controls

  • Lead the tax workstream for the Cumulus SAP rollout across LATAM, setting the standard processes, procedures and best practices for the region.
  • Identify and drive process improvement and automation opportunities enabled by expanded data and ERP functionality.
  • Own the design and operating effectiveness of tax-related internal controls for LATAM, including Sarbanes-Oxley documentation, and guide local teams through financial audit requirements.


Stakeholder Leadership & Influence

  • Act as the senior tax business partner for LATAM, advising regional and corporate leadership on the tax consequences of business decisions and influencing outcomes accordingly.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Treasury and Human Resources on payroll tax, permanent establishment, employment structuring and other cross-functional tax matters.
  • Represent the company with tax authorities, external advisors and industry groups on LATAM tax matters.
  • Build regional tax capability by mentoring and developing finance and accounting colleagues across LATAM, and by delegating and reviewing the work of advisors and junior professionals.

Scope & Decision Authority

  • Individual contributor with no direct reports; leads through influence, delegation to external advisors, and direction of in-country finance teams.
  • Sets policy and strategy for the LATAM tax function with a one- to three-year horizon.
  • Operates with minimal supervision; work is reviewed for strategic alignment rather than technical accuracy.
  • Regularly communicates and negotiates with executive leadership, external advisors and tax authorities on matters of material financial consequence

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Law or a related field; CPA, Contador Público, tax law qualification or Master’s in Taxation strongly preferred.
  • Minimum 12 years of progressive international tax experience, including substantial LATAM multi-jurisdiction responsibility gained in a multinational corporate tax department, Big 4, or comparable professional services environment.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a regional or multi-country tax function, including accountability for technical positions, risk and audit outcomes
  • Deep technical command of LATAM direct and indirect tax regimes, transfer pricing, tax treaties, permanent establishment risk and cross-border structuring.
  • Working knowledge of Pillar Two / OECD BEPS 2.0 and Country-by-Country Reporting, with practical implementation experience preferred.
  • Strong US GAAP and IFRS tax accounting and provision expertise (ASC 740 / IAS 12).
  • • Proven ability to influence senior and executive stakeholders and to translate complex technical matters into clear business recommendations
  • Experience leading tax workstreams within an ERP implementation (SAP preferred)
  • Professional fluency in Spanish and English required; Portuguese strongly preferred.

  • Know the business inside and out: how Live Nation Media & Sponsorship contributes to company revenue, the products and assets we offer, what's in each of our venues, where the sales team is focused, and which teams you'll partner with to deliver every client commitment.
  • Know your regional and national clients just as well, including their objectives, KPIs, audiences, and what success looks like to them, so you can put the right Live Nation products, inventory, and business solutions to work for them.
  • Execute regional and national sponsorship programs in line with contract deliverables, timelines, and venue requirements, from strategic planning through measurement.

  • Hold yourself to a high standard with everyone you work with: be professional, be a great teammate, manage your time, follow through on every commitment, and own your results.
  • Coordinate the sponsorship contract process with Legal and other teams, tracking approvals and helping move agreements forward accurately and on time.
  • Manage program budgets and forecasts, monitor spending and financial risk, and partner with Finance on related financial documents, accurate reporting, and revenue recognition.
  • Build relationships beyond day-to-day client contacts and stay connected with clients year-round through regular meetings and conversations about their evolving business goals and priorities.
  • Create client-facing pacing updates, recaps, reports, and presentations that use KPIs and client feedback to communicate results and recommend ways to optimize programs.
  • Partner with Sales on renewal planning, using client insights and program results to identify opportunities to strengthen and grow each partnership.

Market Excellence & Venue Readiness

  • Become the go-to expert on your market(s), including venue operations, sponsorship inventory, existing partner programs, sales opportunities, market dynamics, and ways to operate more efficiently.
  • Own sponsorship execution on assigned show days, coordinating on-site logistics, activations, venue requirements, and sponsorship event staff from pre-show through close.
  • Lead preseason preparation so every sponsorship asset and activation area is ready by opening day, and partner with venue teams on end-of-season winterization.
  • Partner with Regional Sales and National Brand Management to spot opportunities and shape sponsorship packages using available inventory, client needs, and venue capabilities based on local nuances.

Concert Execution & Staffing

  • Serve as on-site sponsorship coverage at assigned concerts and key engagements, including client hospitality and custom events.
  • Plan schedules and sponsorship coverage across 40+ shows each year, balancing overlapping events, activation deadlines, and staffing needs.
  • Schedule, train, and direct Sponsorship Event Staff for assigned events and alternate show coverage, providing clear briefings, execution guidance, and post-event follow-up.
  • Keep clients and internal partners informed with clear, timely communication on show announcements, presales, day-of-show needs, and post-event follow-up.

Collaboration & Innovation

  • Build strong relationships with venue teams, Sales, Legal, Finance, SES, senior leadership, and other Live Nation partners to keep programs aligned with client objectives.
  • Collaborate with Brand Management counterparts across regions to share best practices, resolve challenges, and strengthen consistency across regional and national programs.
  • Stay curious. Bring audience insights, marketing trends, and emerging technologies to the table to develop fresh activation ideas and keep programs ahead of the curve.
  • Support additional sponsor-related projects and department priorities as requested by management.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING 

  • 3+ years of direct experience in brand or account management, client service, media, entertainment, marketing consulting, sales, advertising, or activation agencies.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Strong client service instincts, diligent follow-up, and the ability to build trusted relationships with clients and internal partners.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and a calendar of 40+ shows a year at the venue, balancing overlapping schedules, staffing needs, and client deadlines.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with clients, venue teams and event staff.
  • A proactive, organized, and collaborative working style. You anticipate needs, meet deadlines, and take ownership without waiting to be asked.
  • A strong desire to learn and grow, with the drive to stay engaged, ask questions, and show up prepared and present every day.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adjust priorities, respond to changing business needs, and work effectively under pressure.
  • Experience coordinating event staff to deliver flawless on-site programs.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world.
