You persuasively advocate for an idea, but you stay open-minded and prioritize rigorously. You have a bias toward action. Most of all, you love to dig in and build amazing things with your team, always pushing the envelope.


THE ROLE

Live Nation Core Data Services (CDS) team is looking for a Product Manager to create internal data products, primarily for marketing and operations teams. A major part of this role is helping engineering teams ingest data sources from operations worldwide into a single global data platform on which our data products are built. You'll work with internal customer groups to ideate, define, build, and launch data products that drive outcomes across business functions and markets. This includes onboarding data from new business domain streams, enforcing data contracts, and shaping domain models before the first layer of transformations lands.

 

This is a key role on an entrepreneurial team with the resources, exposure, and customer base of the world's leading live entertainment company. The person we're looking for will combine passionate product management with discipline and a keen attention to detail, and will build trust throughout the business. We need research and iterative validation driving technical solutions. We need someone who manages a roadmap and backlog, often feeding more than one engineering team, and who clearly defines success criteria and post-launch measurement requirements, all of which is found in their documentation. You'll also help us raise the bar on how a product team works with AI, both in your own workflow and in making our data easy for AI tools and agents to use.

 

This role is built for growth: as you establish yourself, you'll take on additional domains and broader responsibility. It's a highly visible role on a high-performing, global team.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Own the roadmap and backlog for one or more data domains, and connect priorities to business outcomes.
  • Get up to speed quickly on in-flight work, producer relationships, and stakeholder commitments.
  • Lead discovery with internal customers and source-system producers; translate business needs into clear technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Jira.
  • Work with source-system teams on data contracts, agreeing on shape, grain, and quality before data lands.
  • Partner with data engineers on delivery, from intake and design through launch, adoption, and iteration; manage dependencies and surface risks early.
  • Define and track success metrics for your area: adoption, freshness, data quality, and consumer impact.
  • Investigate data directly: write SQL against production data to validate requirements, profile sources, and confirm that what shipped is correct.
  • Own documentation for your domain (definitions, lineage, tags, and known gaps) so people and AI tools can find and trust the data.
  • Use AI tools daily for discovery, analysis, requirements, and documentation, and share what works with the team.
  • Communicate status, trade-offs, and changes clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

 

AI COMPETENCIES

  • Hands-on AI use: You use AI assistants and coding agents (for example Claude Code, Codex, or Databricks Assistant and Genie) as part of daily work: drafting SQL, synthesizing research, prototyping, and drafting specs.
  • Critical evaluation: You check AI output against source data and real behavior before acting on it or sharing it, and you can explain why an answer is wrong.
  • AI-ready data: You understand what makes data usable by AI, and you build that into your product requirements.
  • Specs that agents can execute: You write requirements and acceptance criteria precise enough for an engineer, or an engineer's AI agent, to build from without guessing.
  • Responsible use: You know the basics of how LLMs work (context, retrieval, hallucination) and apply data privacy and governance rules when data is used with AI tools.

  • 3+ years of product management experience, ideally on data, platform, or technical products.
  • A strong data background; experience in BI, analytics, or data engineering is a plus.
  • Experience connecting directly to data sources and writing your own SQL. Familiarity with Python, Spark, or Databricks, enough to read a notebook or pipeline and follow what it does, is a big plus.
  • Working knowledge of how data moves from source to consumption (ingestion, modeling, and delivery) in batch and streaming systems.
  • Demonstrated, practical use of generative AI tools (AI assistants, prompt engineering, agent workflows) to improve your own work, with examples you can walk through.
  • Experience writing requirements that turn business needs into technical requirements, plus Jira and agile story writing.
  • Working knowledge of privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA, including consent and data subject requests, and how they shape data products.
  • Experience with customer or behavioral data is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable facilitating discussions across technical and business teams.
  • Comfortable managing several projects at once and prioritizing between competing stakeholders.
  • Willingness to work across time zones and outside normal hours when needed.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • A passion for live music and events is a plus.

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

The role / Position overview

The FT's B2B division licenses content and information solutions to organisations worldwide. We're looking for a driven Business Development Manager to grow our corporate licensing business across the Banking and Financial Services sector in North America.

You'll develop and implement a strategic sales plan, build relationships with senior decision-makers and win new business. Supported by a Sales Development Representative and colleagues across marketing and customer success, you'll join a collaborative team with opportunities to grow as we expand across the region.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and implement a strategic sales plan to drive growth across the North American Banking and Financial Services sector.
  • Take ownership of achieving annual new business revenue targets.
  • Handle the assigned travel budget efficiently, prioritising face-to-face meetings with prospective clients.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to identify and deliver activities that support new business acquisition.
  • Work closely with customer success colleagues to find opportunities and coordinate activities that drive new business.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior decision-makers and key collaborators at prospective client organisations.
  • Represent the Financial Times at relevant industry events, building networks and developing an understanding of emerging sector trends.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of sales activities and opportunities in Salesforce.

Required skills / experience

  • Shown track record of developing new business and consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Experience in solution-based sales, ideally within the online information or subscription services industry.
  • Experience selling into the Banking and Financial Services sector.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the confidence to articulate a compelling value proposition to senior partners.
  • Ability to work independently, handle priorities and maintain motivation in a remote working environment.
  • Strong initiative, commercial awareness and a proactive approach to identifying new business opportunities.
  • Ability to build effective networks and relationships both internally and externally.
  • Well-developed influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to secure commitment from prospective clients and internal collaborators.

What's in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, health coverage, 401k and company match, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is 90,000-95,000, along with a commission package. To ensure pay fairness, the successful candidate will be offered a salary within the estimated salary range based on a number of considerations including but not limited to: skills; experience and training; certifications; and other business and organisational needs. The disclosed range estimate is for our NYC office and has not been adjusted for other locations.

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may use AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com.

job.title: Intern, Songwriters & Composers Wing
job.description:
INTERNSHIP DETAILS 

 

SPRING INTERNSHIP 

APPLICATION DEADLINE FOR STUDENTS: 11/20/2026 

SPRING INTERNSHIP PROGRAM DATES: 1/11/2027 – 4/16/2027  

*The Songwriters & Composers Wing Intern position pays county/state minimum wage rates, based on work location. 

 

 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

 

The Recording Academy Songwriters & Composers Wing is seeking a “rock star” student for a spring 2027 Internship with our team. 


Celebrating music through the Grammy® Awards, The Recording Academy continues its legacy as the premier national organization for honoring achievements in the recording arts and supporting the music community. As a membership organization, we represent the most talented music professionals in the world. Our members include recording artists, producers, engineers, attorneys, music supervisors, composers/arrangers, managers, agents, social media and record label executives and many others. 


Our paid Internship Program offers a unique opportunity for full-time college students (juniors or seniors) to gain on-site training in office administration, events management and artist relations, in exchange for college credit. Candidates should be energetic, hard-working and have aspirations of a career in the music industry. 

 

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 

  • Internship duration is for a semester (12 weeks or equivalent). 
  • Hours are part-time (20-24 hours a week). 
  • Intern will work with the chapter office on local events during regular business hours as well as some evenings and weekends. 
  • Internship will provide in-depth exposure to professional recording industry techniques and practices. 
  • Projects may include assistance with event management, educational programs, newsletters, membership recruitment, database management, demographics analysis, and administrative office support. 

 

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE  

 

  • Currently enrolled in a college/university. One year of course work towards degree in related field is preferred. 
  • Letter from school stating that intern will receive college credit for the Recording Academy internship. 
  • Display an interest in music and commitment to a career in the recording industry. 
  • Possess strong verbal, written and analytical skills. 
  • Exhibit proficient computer skills. 
  • Be a junior, senior or graduate student. 


PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES:   

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.   


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time. The employee will be required to lift and/or move up to 60 pounds.   

 

 

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES 

 

RECORDING ACADEMY 

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators. 

 

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY 

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation. 

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION 

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives. 

 

MUSICARES 

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs. 

 

GRAMMY MUSEUM 

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Your Role


CBC/Radio-Canada is seeking a Lead Analyst, Data Protection Specialist, to design, lead and evolve the Corporation’s data security program. 

In this role, you will provide technical and operational leadership to safeguard sensitive data and personal information throughout the data life cycle (collection, processing, storage, transmission, archiving and destruction). You will collaborate closely with Legal Services, privacy officers, enterprise architects and IT Operations to align data security with regulatory requirements and industry standards.

This position can be based in Montreal or Toronto.

What’s in It for You

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. You’ll be working with leading-edge data management, cloud, IP broadcasting, AI, security and reliability technologies.

As Lead Analyst, you will:

  • Define data security strategy: Develop and refine the road map for the Corporation’s data protection program.
  • Implement data classification: Establish and deploy data classification policies and frameworks.
  • Administer data protection technologies: Select, deploy and optimize data loss prevention (DLP) tools.
  • Protect cloud and hybrid environments: Design security controls tailored to cloud-hosted data and hybrid architectures.
  • Partner on compliance and policy frameworks: Work closely with the policy, compliance and legal affairs lead to align security controls with statutory requirements.
  • Manage the data security risk register: Document, maintain and map risks related to confidentiality, potential data breaches and approved exceptions.
  • Adjudicate and govern exception requests: Evaluate, document and follow up on exception requests when standard security controls cannot be immediately applied, ensuring appropriate compensating controls are established.
  • Lead data breach response: Actively participate in investigations of suspected or confirmed data breaches in co-ordination with the Information Security, Legal Services and Incident Response teams.
  • Develop metrics and dashboards: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to monitor program effectiveness.
  • Assess program maturity: Plan and conduct periodic evaluations, performance reviews and audits of data protection controls to identify gaps, measure maturity progress and formulate recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Maintain industry expertise: Stay current on information security best practices and industry trends.

What You Bring

  • University degree in computer science, IT or information security.
  • Minimum five years’ experience in data protection, privacy security, DLP or data governance, including at least three years in an information security role.
  • Proven track record of implementing and evaluating technical data protection programs within large, complex organizations.
  • Deep technical expertise in data protection, including cryptography (encryption at rest and in transit, PKI), DLP tools (network, endpoint, cloud), CASB technologies and SQL/NoSQL databases.
  • Extensive knowledge of security technology and risk assessment methodologies, policies and processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical decision-makers (e.g., governance committees, business units, legal teams).
  • Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with compliance programs as well as their technical and security requirements.
  • Technical expertise across key domains:
    • Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, NIST SP 800-53 / 800-161, COBIT and ITIL.
    • Cloud and Web Architecture Security: Solid understanding of web infrastructure and cloud environment security.
    • Network and Security Technologies: Thorough understanding of network architectures (LAN/WAN, routers), network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, DNS, web filtering) and cryptographic principles (encryption at rest and in transit).
    • Architecture and Data Security: Working knowledge of database architecture concepts and secure software development best practices.
    • Operational Resilience and Physical Security: Solid understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning (BCP/DRP), operational resilience and physical security controls.
  • Relevant professional security certifications a definite asset (e.g., CISSP, CRISC, CBCP, CISA, CISM or equivalent).
  • Bilingualism (English and French) essential.

CBC News is expanding its financial and consumer storytelling to help Canadians navigate complex economic realities. Affordability remains top of mind for most Canadians. Young people are struggling to land that first job at a time when artificial intelligence and technology are changing the workforce. Canadians are faced with a myriad of complex economic realities.


We’re looking for people who are excited to show up to work knowing anything can happen on their watch, thrives when news breaks, and have a keen interest in the way money and the economy shapes the lives of Canadians.


On the business beat, you will focus on the intersection of money and everyday life. This means looking beyond the market and financial headlines to break down and bring home complex economic stories.

You will actively track economic, corporate, consumer and policy shifts both nationally and in your region with the goal of helping Canadians understand the financial and money forces that are affecting their lives.


Your task would be to break news and build a pipeline of memorable original stories. You'll experiment with various formats and platforms, from graphics and social media to radio and TV. You’ll have the voice and reporting chops to explain business news and bring to life economic stories.


Data excites you. You use charts, graphs and explainers to provide clarity and context in our storytelling. This role emphasizes mobile-first and vertical video storytelling tailored to reach younger, diverse, and underserved audiences where they consume media.

  • Consistently pitches original ideas in line with the unit’s mandate and objectives.

  • Participates in all aspects of the production; and brings a willingness to appear on camera for production shoots, as required.
  • Experience writing short-form and vertical video for presentation on mobile and streaming platforms that describes complex business, financial and consumer information in a clear and concise manner.
  • Pivot to breaking news and quickly turnaround stories in a way that enhances the understanding of the audience.

  • A minimum of five years of relevant journalism experience including vertical and short-form visual storytelling.

Participant, First Peoples Program 2027 (French Services) (Telework/Hybrid)

Status of Employment:

Contractee Short-Term (Durée déterminée)

Position Language Requirement:

French

Language Skills:

French (Reading - C - Advanced), French (Speaking - C - Advanced), French (Writing - C - Advanced)

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-12-04 11:59 PM

Please note there are four (4) positions to be filled.


About the First Peoples Program


The First Peoples: Tell Us a Story initiative is a specialized professional development program designed to build bridges between First Peoples and Radio-Canada. It aims to amplify Indigenous voices in the media while nurturing lasting, reciprocal relationships with Indigenous communities.


Building on the success of its 2025 pilot, the initiative returns this year with a redesigned format. This paid training opportunity has been expanded to eight (8) weeks and will focus on the craft of storytelling. Throughout the program, you will hone your skills through hands-on workshops led by both Indigenous and non-Indigenous media professionals. You will also have a dedicated platform to share your stories, showcase your culture, language and lived experiences, and highlight your community's achievements.


We are looking for four (4) individuals from First Nations, Inuit or Métis communities ready to take the next step in their media careers.


The program runs full time for eight (8) weeks, from February 1st to March 26, 2027. Full-time availability, Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (ET) for the entire eight-week program is mandatory.


This program is in hybrid mode (remote work with required travel to Montreal and a regional station).


Candidates must meet the following eligibility requirements:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Self-identify as First Nations, Inuit or Métis.
  • Be available full time for the duration of the program (February 1st to March 26, 2027).
  • Be willing and able to travel for three (3) separate five-day sessions during the eight (8) weeks (travel and accommodation expenses are fully covered by Radio-Canada).
  • Be able to work and communicate in French (reading, writing and speaking). 

Who You Are:

  • You have a working proficiency in French across speaking, reading and writing. 
  • You have a genuine curiosity about news and current affairs, paired with a passion for storytelling.
  • You have an open, collaborative attitude.
  • You are eager to learn new things.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace tools is an asset.

Program Overview:

As part of this second cohort, you will complete an eight-week learning curriculum running from February 1st to March 26, 2027.


The program includes the following:

  • Orientation and Onboarding: Settle into the cohort and preview your training plan through a combination of virtual sessions and in-person activities in Montreal. 
  • Theory Instruction (Three (3) weeks, Virtual): Build foundational journalism skills across digital writing, audio/radio storytelling and video production, culminating in one (1) to three (3) portfolio-ready pieces. 
  • Regional Station Placement: Shadow and work alongside Radio-Canada journalists at a regional station to experience the day-to-day rhythm of an active newsroom.
  • Professional Development (Virtual): Take part in sessions designed to support your learning and development. 
  • Closing Week (Montreal): Wrap up the program alongside your peers with a final week of hands-on activities. 

Workplace and Technical Requirements :

The theory instruction will take place primarily online; however, you must be available to travel to Montreal and to a regional station during designated periods. All required travel and accommodation expenses are fully covered by Radio-Canada.


Please note:

  • You must have access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection.
  • You must have access to a desktop computer, laptop or iPad Pro. 
  • Any specialized production gear required for your training modules will be provided by Radio-Canada for the duration of the program. 

Full-time availability for the entire eight-week program is mandatory.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates who advance to the next

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:  

  • A mandatory Criminal record check. 

  • Other background checks may be conducted based on the operational requirements of the position.


CBC/Radio-Canada is committed to being a leader in reflecting our country’s diversity. That’s because we can only create and tell the stories that connect Canadians, by having a workforce that mirrors the ever-changing makeup of our country. That’s why we, as an employer, value equal opportunity and nurture an inclusive workplace where our individual differences are not only recognized and valued, but also extend to and pervade all the services we provide as Canada’s public broadcaster. For more information, visit the Diversity and Inclusion section of our website. If you have accommodation needs at this stage of the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible by sending an e-mail to recruitment@cbc.ca.
 
You are invited to consult and familiarize yourself with our Code of Conduct, which can be found on our corporate website. All employees must adhere to the Code as a condition of employment. We also invite you to take a look at our policy on conflicts of interest. In the event that you become an employee, it will be important to inform us, as quickly as possible, of any situation that, because of your hiring, constitutes or could appear to constitute a conflict of interest.

Primary Location:

1000, Rue Papineau, Montreal, Quebec, H2K 0C2

Number of Openings:

1

Work Schedule:

Part time

job.title: Senior HRIS/Business Analyst
job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

If you enjoy making processes work better, solving problems, and learning new areas of Workday, this is a great opportunity. You'll start by owning key processes and gradually expand your expertise across multiple HR functions.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Start with Performance Management, configuring and testing it end to end alongside an HR Generalist who knows the business
  • Help troubleshoot Workday cases across the employee lifecycle, including payroll
  • Learn, and eventually assume responsibility for, Time and Attendance as the business analyst
  • Streamline HR processes so our HR business partners can focus on supporting the business, and explore where new tools like AI can help
  • Balance day-to-day operational support with continuous process improvement projects. Stay abreast of new Workday features and functions.
  • Pick up new process areas as ownership rotates, so no process depends on one person

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • 5+ years configuring Workday HCM yourself, in more than one area
  • Hands-on Performance Management configuration, including a full review cycle
  • Experience configuring and testing new Workday functionality, and putting existing features to work on new business needs
  • Experience turning policy or regulation into requirements someone else builds, then validating the result
  • Experience making HR processes simpler, and curiosity about how tools like AI can help
  • The judgment to own a process with little oversight, and the confidence to explain the why behind it to anyone

It would be nice if:

  • You've worked with Workday Time Tracking or Absence, wage-and-hour rules, or union contracts
  • You've configured or supported Workday Benefits
  • You love learning new technology to solve real business problems
  • You've sat inside an HR team and know what managers and employees need

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

‎
Required

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • Full proficiency and understanding of job function

  • Ability to work independently with minimal guidance

  • In-depth knowledge of key business drivers and how this impacts your team

  • Experience in team and project management for mid-sized projects

  • Ability to recognize and mitigate risk

  • Confidence to solve complex problems using multiple sources of information

  • Growth mindset and desire for continued knowledge sharing and learning

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Ability to identify new opportunities for continued improvement across business

  • Comfort acting as a trusted advisor for colleagues with less experience

  • Ability to manage complex and confidential information and to influence others to build consensus across all levels

‎

                                                                 

Location:

Dallas, TX: 14001 N Dallas Parkway, Suites 200 and 300, 75240

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  
     

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


 

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

‎
Required

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

‎

job.title: National Account Executive, Digital
job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

iHeartMedia's Direct Response team is looking for a driven seller to help grow our national business with performance-driven agencies and brands, with a focus on podcasts and digital. The ideal candidate has 3+ years of experience in media, advertising or sales and a solid understanding of how audio drives measurable results like conversions, site traffic and ROAS. In this role, you'll build new agency and brand relationships, manage and grow your own book of accounts, and turn test campaigns into ongoing, scaled programs. You'll work closely with senior sellers, leadership and teams across the company to drive new business and carry out digital campaigns. If you're a self-starter with a results-focused mindset and a passion for podcasts, we'd love to hear from you.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Support and carry out the national go-to-market strategy for the Direct Response business with a focus on podcasts and digital assets, working with senior sellers and leadership on account and agency plans.
  • Identify and build new relationships with direct response and performance marketing agencies and brands nationwide.
  • Manage and grow a book of assigned accounts and agencies.
  • Meet quarterly and annual revenue goals according to the sales plan. This requires a strong working knowledge of iHeartMedia's audio and digital product portfolio and available ad inventory, including broadcast radio, streaming audio, podcasts, video, display, sponsorships, social platforms and custom marketing programs.
  • Manage the sales process from outreach through close, with guidance from senior team members on larger opportunities.
  • Help move performance-driven advertisers from initial test campaigns to ongoing programs, using results data to show value and grow spend.
  • Work with research, analytics and attribution teams to report campaign performance against client KPIs such as CPA, ROAS, site traffic and conversions.
  • Provide responsive, high-quality service to drive customer satisfaction for direct response accounts.
  • Partner with the operations organization to set proper expectations with customers and meet their needs.
  • Build presentations and proposals for brands and agencies.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders, including product marketing, research, account management and more, to maximize advertising revenue.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

Required Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in media, digital, audio, advertising or direct response sales (or a related client-facing role)
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative attitude
  • Knowledge of performance marketing concepts (e.g., CPA, ROAS, attribution)
  • Familiarity with digital and social platforms; in-depth knowledge of podcasts a plus
  • Organized and self-motivated, able to manage multiple accounts and priorities

job.title: Associate Product Designer (Cinmar)
job.description:
CBFG0168Associate Product Designer — Color, Print & Pattern

Location: West Chester, Ohio
Brand/Business: Grandin Road
Reports to: Senior Designer

About the Role

The Associate Product Designer is a developmental role designed to build the skills and experience needed to advance to a Designer position. Specializing in color, print, and pattern, this designer will also contribute to product design and concept development across home categories.

Working under the guidance of the Senior Designer, you’ll help translate global trends and customer insights into brand-relevant concepts and product designs. You’ll support projects from initial concept through revisions, sample review, and final approval—balancing creative vision with business needs, product requirements, and established design processes.

What You’ll Do

  • Curate trend research and develop seasonal and trend boards that balance market insight with brand relevance.
  • Create seasonal color palettes and curate print and pattern direction aligned with the brand vision.
  • Develop and place artwork across product types, creating cohesive capsule collections across categories.
  • Translate global trends into relevant concepts and designs, considering shape, materials, color, and print and pattern.
  • Under the Senior Designer’s direction, develop SKU-level designs from initial concept through revisions and final sample approval.
  • Design within the line plan and support financial growth and profitability, considering assortment strategy, price points, and cost engineering.
  • Ensure designs align with seasonal concepts, big ideas, and the overall creative direction.
  • Present concepts to the design leader for review and approval.
  • Present product concepts and final specifications to cross-functional teams; partner with Merchandising on sketch revisions and approvals.
  • Present final designs to the Executive team.
  • Review first and final samples with Merchandising, helping ensure feedback, revisions, and approvals are completed on schedule.
  • Prepare complete, accurate product design specification packages and meet calendar deadlines.
  • Collaborate with Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, and manufacturers/vendors throughout the development process.
  • Travel for inspiration and to build knowledge of vendor capabilities.

Product Categories

Experience designing for home products is essential, including:

  • Home decorative accessories
  • Entertaining products, including serveware and dinnerware
  • Home textiles, including bedding, decorative pillows, doormats, and table linens

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience designing products for the home market, especially in the categories listed above.
  • Strong design skills and a point of view in color, print, and pattern.
  • The ability to interpret trends and translate them into designs that feel relevant to the brand and customer.
  • An understanding of how to develop designs across product types and create cohesive collections.
  • The ability to work within a design process, follow direction, manage revisions, and meet deadlines.
  • Strong collaboration and presentation skills, including comfort sharing work for feedback and approval.
  • Attention to detail when preparing designs, specifications, and sample comments.
  • A growth mindset and interest in developing toward a Designer-level role.

Success in This Role

Success means creating thoughtful, brand-right designs; contributing to cohesive seasonal direction; supporting product development with care and accuracy; and building the skills to take on increasing design ownership.

Our Total Rewards package includes benefits you’ll love such as competitive compensation, paid time off, an employee assistance program, parental leave, paid volunteer hours, and amazing company discounts! In our US market, you can also expect health care benefits starting on day 1, 401(k), and tuition reimbursement benefits.

Working at QVC Group means joining a live social shopping company with incredible teams, ambitious projects and rewarding careers. WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

This position requires weekly travel to WWE shows (Raw, Smackdown, Live Events and PLE's), both domestically and internationally, based on the show schedule.


Position Summary

The Manager of Broadcast TV Audio Infrastructure assists senior management with responsibilities for the design, operation, maintenance, and strategic development of audio systems while supporting live and recorded television production. This role supports a team of broadcast audio technicians, ensuring reliable, high-quality audio across studios, control rooms, remote productions, and transmission facilities. The manager works closely with production, engineering, IT, and operations teams to support current workflows while planning future technology upgrades.


Key Responsibilities

Audio Infrastructure Management

  • Oversee the operation and maintenance of broadcast audio systems, including intercoms (wired/wireless), audio-over-IP networks, RFOF systems, RF Microphones and IEM monitoring systems.
  • Develop and maintain preventative maintenance schedules and system documentation.
  • Collaborate with external vendors to prioritize, schedule, and expedite repairs, ensuring maximum system reliability and uptime.

 

Technical Leadership

  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex audio and broadcast infrastructure issues.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend upgrades to improve efficiency, scalability, and audio quality.
  • Collaborate with IT teams on networked audio systems.

Project Management

  • Plan and execute capital projects, upgrades, technical work books, equipment refreshes, and system integrations.
  • Coordinate installation, testing, commissioning, and acceptance of new systems.
  • Demoing new audio technologies.

Team Leadership

  • Collaborate with upper management to supervise, mentor, and develop broadcast audio engineers and technical staff.
  • Coordinate staffing and technical support coverage for live events and special productions.

 

Operational Support

  • Support live broadcast, entertainment, and special event productions.
  • Ensure compliance with FCC regulations, company standards, and industry best practices.
  • Participate in on-call escalation support for critical broadcast operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Engineering, Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in broadcast engineering, professional audio, or television infrastructure environments.
  • Extensive knowledge of broadcast audio systems, signal routing, and transmission workflows.
  • Understanding Dante platforms.
  • Strong understanding of television production environments and live broadcast operations.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale network television operations.
  • Familiarity with broadcast intercom systems.
  • Professional certifications in broadcast engineering.
  • Experience with wireless communications, and Audio production technologies.

Key Competencies

  • Broadcast systems infrastructure
  • Audio engineering expertise
  • Project planning and execution
  • Problem-solving under pressure
  • This role combines broadcast audio engineering expertise with operational leadership to ensure reliable, high-quality audio delivery across all television platforms.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with all levels of the department

  • High proficiency in using computer systems particularly Advanced Excel, Microsoft Word, Database Management skills, and ERPs e.g. Workday

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

job.description:
Job Title

Workflow Engineer, 1

Job Description

AI Workflow & Automation Engineering

  • Prototype and productionize new AI-driven automations.

  • Design and implement Slack features including slash commands, message actions, interactive modals, triage flows, and user-friendly bot behaviors.

  • Develop frameworks, templates, and reusable automation components to accelerate future workflow builds — both for code-first builds and for our low-code stack (n8n, Zapier, Google Workspace Studio).

  • Raise concerns when a proposed approach has technical risk, and help shape a better path forward.

Retrieval, Data Pipelines & AI Quality

  • Build and refine retrieval pipelines, vector stores, data-sync workflows, hashing/diffing systems, and content preprocessing pipelines.

  • Implement structured outputs, evaluation loops, hallucination prevention methods, and AI quality assurance systems.

  • Maintain and improve RAG pipelines using content from Confluence, Google Sheets, Jira, Slack logs, and other internal knowledge sources.

Backend, Reliability & Production Readiness

  • Build and maintain backend services, REST APIs, and serverless orchestrators powering our internal automation platforms.

  • Implement logging, monitoring, retry logic, structured error handling, and observability to keep our automations production-grade.

  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows, testing practices, and version-controlled deployment patterns.

Cross-Team Enablement & Expansion

  • Partner with teams across People Inc. to identify processes that can benefit from intelligent automation or AI augmentation.

  • Translate business needs into reliable automated workflows and internal tools.

  • Contribute to documentation, change management procedures, and the overall evolution of People Inc.'s internal AI platform.

  • Take initiative to propose new AI-enabled enhancements, systems, or assistants the organization has not yet defined.

What You'll Likely Work On in Your First 6 Months

  • Dottie as a service: help extract Dottie (our L1 tech support triage agent) from the existing in-process #it-techsupport implementation into a standalone API, define quality metrics, and onboard at least one new consuming surface.

  • Reusable build patterns: turn our "Slack workflow + AI matcher + Apps Script" pattern into proper templates with example code, intake forms, and stakeholder-facing docs so future builds ship faster.

  • Stack-level upgrades: identify where our current Sheets-based audit logs, Apps Script glue, and ad-hoc retrieval should graduate to more durable infrastructure, and help drive the migration where it makes sense.

Required Skills

Background

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful exposure to AI/LLM-based systems.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

Core Engineering

  • Solid experience with Python and JavaScript; comfort working in Apps Script, or willingness to become fluent.

  • Comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven integrations.

  • Experience building and shipping services that have run in production.

AI & LLM

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, OpenAI APIs, embeddings, retrieval pipelines (RAG), and prompt engineering.

  • Familiarity with data normalization, indexing, content segmentation, and retrieval basics.

Cloud & Systems

  • Experience with Google Cloud, particularly Cloud Functions (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, IAM a plus).

  • Experience building on Slack via the SDK, Bolt, or Events API, including interactive UI components.

  • Experience integrating with Jira and similar APIs.

Preferred Skills (Not Required)

  • Experience with low-code or iPaaS tools (n8n, Zapier, Make) used alongside code.

  • Background in agentic workflows or LangChain.

  • Exposure to observability tools and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience designing systems with reliability and a real user-experience focus.

  • Experience operating internal tools — running them, watching usage, iterating — not just building them.

  • Knowledge of Confluence APIs, content hashing, or knowledge retrieval.

  • Experience containerizing AI workloads (Docker) or working with vector databases.

Who Thrives in This Role

  • Engineers who think in systems, not isolated tasks.

  • Builders who enjoy being a strong technical contributor on a small team and want their work to ship and get used.

  • Developers who care about reliability, uptime, and high-quality user experience.

  • Technologists who stay curious about emerging AI advancements and adopt them responsibly.

  • Problem-solvers energized by complex, cross-functional technical challenges.

job.description:
Job Title

Senior Technical Product Manager

Job Description

About The Position

We're seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the product strategy for our knowledge graph and content platform that connects People Inc.'s content, taxonomy, usage rights, and audience signals across 30+ brands, reaching over 100M users monthly. Alongside our content system of record, it powers discovery, personalization, and editorial tooling through GraphQL APIs, search and indexing, and vector-based retrieval. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering and product strategy: building scalable, reusable, self-service capabilities that let other teams ship faster without custom work from us.

As a senior IC partner to the engineering leads of Graphene Foundation, Graphene Services, and Search, you will define and champion the roadmap for core platform capabilities and shape how our services are consumed by both developers and AI agents. Success requires technical depth, strong product judgment, and the ability to balance long-term architectural coherence with the tactical needs of consuming teams. This role reports to VP of Product, Core Platform.


Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.
 

About The Positions Contributions:

Strategic Roadmapping

  • Define and maintain a roadmap across the Foundation (content store, GraphQL engine), Services (APIs, relationships, taxonomy, validation), and Search (indexing, site search, internal search) sub-teams, aligned with company goals and engineering priorities.
  • Prioritize investments against the platform's guiding principles: a connected foundation, trust and transparency, enabling intelligence, and self-service.
  • Make deliberate tradeoffs, focusing as much on what not to build as what to include.
  • Define and track platform leverage metrics, such as team adoption, time to first integration, engineering hours saved, search relevance and latency.

Platform-as-a-Product Thinking

  • Champion the platform as a product, not a set of endpoints, through careful, opinionated curation.
  • Avoid the "feature shop" trap by recognizing patterns across brand and team requests and designing extensible, self-service capabilities, such as a generic relationship service that can link data from many sources.

Cross-Org Orchestration

  • Lead multi-team initiatives that span platform engineering, editorial, Data Science and consuming program teams.
  • Partner with editorial, legal, and rights stakeholders as the platform becomes the source of truth for asset rights, attribution, and lineage.
  • Serve as the connective tissue between teams, aligning stakeholders around shared technical outcomes and influencing without authority.

Internal Developer Experience

  • Treat internal product development teams as primary customers, improving API and schema usability, documentation, and onboarding.
  • Lower the barrier to entry so external teams can integrate without hands-on support from our team.
  • Build strong feedback loops and solve real developer pain points with empathy and insight.
  • Shape agent-ready interfaces, such as MCP servers for search, that let other teams and AI agents use our capabilities on a self-service basis with appropriate access controls and guardrails.

Operational Excellence

  • Partner with engineering to ensure reliability, stability, and performance of GraphQL, indexing, and retrieval services as data volume and audience-signal complexity grow.
  • Champion SLOs, observability, and data quality as foundational product attributes, and treat maintenance and stability as first-class roadmap work.


 

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:


Education: Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, and/or equivalent experience.


Experience: 5+ years in product management, including 3+ years owning platform, API, data, or developer-facing products in a B2B or internal tools setting.


Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Strong technical fluency with API-driven platforms, including GraphQL or similar schema-based APIs, data modeling, and distributed system tradeoffs; able to read schemas and technical designs and challenge them constructively.
  • Working knowledge of search and retrieval systems, including indexing, relevance, and vector databases; experience with knowledge graphs, taxonomy, or metadata systems is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with LLM application patterns and emerging agentic tooling, such as MCP, and a point of view on how platform services should be exposed to AI agents.
  • Proven success leading technical products that span multiple teams or business units.
  • Deep fluency in partnering with engineers on architecture, tradeoffs, and system design.
  • Track record of avoiding reactive build cycles by thoughtfully prioritizing platform focus and extensibility.
  • Ability to define and use data to measure platform outcomes, including adoption, reliability, and developer satisfaction.
  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, able to influence without authority and translate technical tradeoffs for senior engineering, editorial, and business stakeholders.

Job Title

Associate Brand Director, Walmart

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

The Associate Brand Director, Walmart will play a key role within People Inc.’s Business Management team supporting the Better Homes & Gardens collection at Walmart (BHGxWalmart), with primary responsibility for the strategy and business management of designated product categories.This role will develop deep expertise across assigned categories, building strong relationships throughout the Walmart merchant organization and serving as a primary BHG business partner to drive category performance and growth. Working within the broader strategy and priorities of the BHGxWalmart business, the Senior Brand Manager will connect business performance, consumer and marketplace insights, product and assortment strategy, and cross-functional partners to translate broader objectives into category-specific strategies and actions.


In-office Expectations: This position is remote and based in Bentonville, Arkansas, with no regular People Inc. in-office requirements. The role is expected to maintain an active presence with Walmart partners in the Bentonville area, including in-person meetings and business activities as needed. Occasional travel to People Inc. offices and other business locations will also be required.


About The Team | The Team and/or Brand.

The BHGxWalmart Business Management team sits within People Inc.’s Brand Development organization and supports the Better Homes & Gardens licensed collection at Walmart. The team partners closely with Walmart, external product development partners, and cross-functional People Inc. teams to drive business growth, strengthen the BHG brand, and identify opportunities across the product portfolio.


About The Positions Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


Category Strategy & Business Management (30%)

  • Lead the strategy and ongoing business management of designated BHGxWalmart categories, developing deep expertise in performance, assortment dynamics, product pipelines and Walmart priorities.
  • Evaluate sales, inventory, distribution, digital performance and assortment productivity to identify key business drivers, risks and opportunities.
  • Translate broader BHGxWalmart strategies and objectives into clear category-specific priorities and action plans.
  • Develop a strong point of view on where assigned categories should grow, evolve or improve based on business performance, consumer insights and marketplace dynamics.
  • Maintain visibility across assortment changes, product launches, distribution shifts and other developments impacting category performance.

Walmart Merchant & Partner Management (25%)

  • Serve as a primary BHG business-management partner for designated categories, building strong relationships throughout the Walmart merchant organization.
  • Lead category-level conversations with Walmart merchant partners, developing a deep understanding of their priorities, strategies, challenges and growth objectives.
  • Build productive relationships with external product development partners, creating connectivity across Walmart, People Inc. and external teams around shared category priorities.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to advance Walmart category goals and the BHG business, elevating significant opportunities, risks and decisions to Business Management leadership.

Product, Assortment & Consumer Strategy (25%)

  • Represent the business and brand perspective throughout the product development lifecycle, partnering with Walmart merchants and external product development teams on category strategies, assortment plans and future opportunities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of consumer needs, competitive activity and marketplace trends within assigned categories.
  • Partner with People Inc. Research & Insights to identify knowledge gaps and translate consumer, competitive, digital and business insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Identify assortment gaps, priority products, whitespace opportunities and areas for innovation or expansion.
  • Help ensure product and assortment decisions support Walmart business objectives and BHG brand positioning.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Brand Stewardship (20%)

  • Lead and influence cross-functional partners around assigned category strategies, opportunities and business priorities.
  • Serve as a central Business Management connector across People Inc. teams, including Research & Insights, Marketing, Creative, Editorial and Digital/PDP.

Job Title

Art Director

Job Description

People Inc. is the largest digital and print publisher in America. From mobile to magazines, nearly 200 million people trust us to help them make decisions, take action, and find inspiration. People Inc. has more than 40 iconic brands, including PEOPLE, Entertainment Weekly, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, Food & Wine, The Spruce, Allrecipes, Byrdie, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, and Southern Living. We are building engaging experiences that excite users and amplify the voices of our brands.


We are seeking an Art Director — New Initiatives to work closely with the Senior Creative Director and partners across marketing, editorial, product, commerce, and growth. This new role specializes in branding and marketing design for paid memberships and premium products, including Southern Living Insiders, as well as other cross-brand and net-new initiatives. The Art Director will help develop distinctive identities, launch campaigns, and scalable creative systems that express the value of premium experiences and engage audiences across channels.


As Art Director — New Initiatives, you will be responsible for leading the visual development and execution of high-visibility, high-value initiatives from concept through launch and ongoing optimization. You will create and evolve identity systems, premium brand expressions, and integrated marketing campaigns; translate strategy into clear, compelling creative; and provide flexible senior-level design capacity that can shift as organizational priorities change.

Own assigned branding, campaign, and premium product design projects from brief through launch and ongoing optimization, following established processes to ensure smooth delivery of creative assets.

Collaborate with marketing, editorial, product design, commerce, growth, and cross-brand partners to translate business goals and audience insights into effective creative.

30%

Present strategic design concepts and solutions, articulate the rationale behind the work, and build consensus among a broad range of stakeholders.

Lead and participate in brainstorming and critique sessions that foster big-picture thinking, strengthen concepts, and raise the bar on craft and premium brand expression.

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent education and experience

3–5 years as an Art Director and 5–10 years as a designer, with experience leading brand and marketing work from concept through execution

Strong typography skills

Strong integrated brand and marketing campaign design skills

Working knowledge of motion graphics

Proficient in Figma

Strong attention to detail

A collaborative team player ready to work in a fast-paced, matrixed environment

Job Description

People Inc is looking for a Senior Enterprise Security Engineer with a demonstrated track record of innovative thinking, technical expertise, and execution. You’ll be responsible for maintaining (and raising) the security posture across our infrastructure and end-user SaaS applications and endpoints, designing and implementing enterprise security solutions, and reducing toil through automation.


As a highly visible professional within the Security team, you will be responsible for helping to set technical direction for enterprise security, managing technical projects, and partner with other groups within the organization to deliver tools and services that align with our security roadmaps.


Remote or Hybrid 3x a month 

In-office Expectations: This position offers remote work flexibility; however, if you reside within a commutable distance to one of our offices in New York, Des Moines, Birmingham, Los Angeles, orChicago, the expectation is to work from the office three times per month.

Security Engineering

  • Harden systems for cyber resilience including Operating Systems, and Network Devices and SaaS platforms
  • Architect and design log management systems to collect security events across multiple log sources
  • Perform orchestration and automated response (SOAR)
  • Oversee vulnerability remediation

  • 5+ years of experience in Security with 3+ years of experience as a Security Engineer with a focus on securing end user SaaS applications, user endpoints, and associated infrastructure.

  • Able to concisely communicate security risks to both technical and business audiences.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, and as part of a team.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize work effectively.

Benefits Manager

Job Description

The Benefits Manager will assist with the design, implementation, administration, and promotion of our employee benefits programs across People Incorporated. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Benefits, this individual will collaborate to ensure that People Incorporated’s benefit offerings remain highly competitive, fully compliant with regulations, and aligned with overall organizational goals. This role requires an experienced professional with vendor management expertise and project management skills to support benefit initiatives, manage partner relationships, and drive program rollouts.


The position is based in the New York City corporate headquarters and is hybrid in-office with the ability to work remotely up to 2 days per week.


About The Position

Benefits Strategy & Administration

  • Manage employee benefits programs across the People Incorporated portfolio, including healthcare, life/disability, 401(k), voluntary benefits, and leave management.
  • Serve as an escalation point for employee benefit questions, policy interpretations, and operational concerns.
  • Evaluate existing benefit vendors and assist with RFPs and implementations as needed.
  • Oversee the annual open enrollment process, including plan design decisions, benefits administration system testing, multi-channel communications, onsite events, and employee education.

Vendor Management & Strategic Partnerships

  • Manage benefit vendor relationships, brokers, consultants, and administration partners to ensure all issues are escalated and resolved quickly and appropriately.

  • Act as a key contact point for vendor service issues, financial reconciliations, and operational discrepancies.

Project Management & Process Optimization

  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and milestone tracking for key HR and benefits initiatives. Coordinate with vendors to track updates.
  • Tracks the status of contracts. Coordinates with Legal and Vendors as necessary to facilitate the review and approval of contracts.
  • Partner with HRIS and our 3rd party  benefits administrator to ensure seamless integrations, early detection of any issues, and oversight of the resolution.
