job.title: Senior Growth Manager
job.description:
M+C Saatchi Group is looking for a strategic, commercially minded and highly motivated Senior Growth Manager to help shape how the UK Group shows up, connects and grows.

Sitting at the heart of our UK Growth and Marketing team, and reporting to the UK Head of New Business, you'll play a pivotal role in identifying, developing and converting new business opportunities, leading major pitches and bringing together the collective strength of our specialist businesses.

This is an opportunity to work across one of the UK's most diverse creative communications groups, with clients and opportunities spanning major Government departments, leading commercial brands, sport and entertainment, brand communications, consultancy, social and media.

You'll help drive our proactive growth agenda, develop our recently launched Culture Collective community and deliver marketing initiatives that strengthen our reputation, relationships and commercial pipeline.

You'll also play an important role in bringing our Cultural Power proposition to life, ensuring our thinking, storytelling and market presence reflect our ambition to shape culture and create meaningful connections.

Working closely with senior leadership and specialist teams across the Group, you'll operate in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two opportunities look the same.

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with exceptional delivery, thrives on complexity and brings clarity, energy and momentum to everything they do.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
This is a varied, high-impact role focused on driving growth through proactive business development, world-class pitching and a compelling marketing presence.

You'll help develop complex, high-value new business opportunities from initial qualification through to final delivery, often bringing together multiple specialisms to develop integrated responses to challenging client briefs.

Our opportunities span major public sector procurement processes, significant commercial pitches and proactive growth initiatives across advertising, PR, sport and entertainment, brand consultancy, social, data and media.

You'll need to be comfortable managing multiple priorities, influencing senior stakeholders, navigating ambiguity and delivering to demanding deadlines without compromising quality.

Beyond pitching, you'll help shape our approach to prospecting, relationship development, thought leadership and industry engagement, ensuring the Group is present in the right conversations, with the right message.

Success will be measured through the quality and conversion of our new business pipeline, the effectiveness of our pitches, the strength of cross-Group collaboration and the commercial impact of our marketing activity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

New Business & Pitch Leadership

  • Lead major new business pitches end-to-end, including opportunity qualification, strategy, team mobilisation, content development, commercial coordination and final delivery.

  • Bring together specialist capabilities and senior stakeholders from across the UK Group to develop compelling, integrated responses to complex client challenges.

  • Lead public sector and commercial procurement processes, including tenders, framework opportunities, RFIs and RFPs, ensuring submissions are strategically strong, compliant and commercially considered.

  • Manage multiple concurrent opportunities against demanding deadlines, maintaining momentum, quality and accountability throughout.

  • Partner with senior leadership to evaluate opportunities, shape competitive positioning and make informed recommendations on where to invest time and resources.

  • Work with finance, commercial and legal teams to support pitch budgets, commercial submissions and governance requirements.

Growth Strategy & Prospecting

  • Partner with the CMO, UK Head of New Business and business leads to shape and deliver our annual growth and marketing strategy.

  • Develop proactive prospecting strategies, identifying priority audiences, building contact plans and nurturing relationships with prospective clients.

  • Identify opportunities to connect Group specialisms, unlock cross-selling potential and develop broader, more valuable client relationships.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Group's capabilities, identifying opportunities to bring together expertise in response to emerging client needs.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, opportunity tracking and reporting through HubSpot.

Marketing, Reputation & Relationships

  • Develop and grow Culture Collective as a platform for meaningful industry connections, prospect engagement and new business opportunities.

  • Support the delivery of the UK Group marketing strategy, bringing our Cultural Power proposition to life through compelling content and market engagement.

  • Contribute to thought leadership, social content, PR and industry events, working closely with communications and specialist teams.

  • Maintain and evolve credentials, case studies, pitch templates and other new business collateral, ensuring consistency, quality and relevance.

  • Coordinate industry award entries, directory submissions and other reputation-building opportunities.

  • Build strong relationships across the UK Group, fostering collaboration and ensuring our collective expertise is represented effectively in the market.

ABOUT YOU

  • You're a natural connector, a strategic thinker and someone who knows how to make things happen.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, ambitious environment where priorities shift, opportunities are complex and collaboration is essential.

  • You're equally comfortable shaping a compelling pitch narrative, influencing senior stakeholders, coordinating multiple teams and getting into the detail to ensure exceptional delivery.

  • You understand that great business development is about more than responding to briefs. It's about spotting opportunities, asking the right questions, connecting capabilities and building relationships that create long-term value.

  • You bring strong commercial instincts, excellent judgement and a genuine curiosity about the wider marketing, communications and cultural landscape.

  • Above all, you take ownership, bring people with you and deliver.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: (Experience and qualifications)

  • Significant experience in business development, growth, client leadership or strategic marketing within a creative, communications or integrated agency environment.

  • A proven track record of leading major new business pitches, from opportunity qualification and strategic development through to final presentation and delivery.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-disciplinary opportunities involving multiple agency specialisms or business units.

  • Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to assess opportunities, understand client challenges and develop compelling, commercially credible responses.

  • Exceptional storytelling, writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear, persuasive narratives.

  • A broad understanding of the marketing and communications landscape, including advertising, PR, social, brand strategy, sport and entertainment, consultancy and media.

  • Experience of significant public sector, Government or complex commercial procurement processes would be advantageous.

  • Strong project management skills, with experience managing multiple high-priority projects simultaneously.

  • Confidence using CRM systems, managing pipelines and reporting on business development activity, ideally using HubSpot.

  • A track record of building relationships and influencing senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

WHAT YOU'RE GOOD AT: (Behaviours)

  • Connecting the dots: Seeing opportunities across different businesses, capabilities and client challenges, and bringing the right people and ideas together.

  • Making sense of complexity: Turning ambiguous briefs, competing perspectives and complex information into clear strategies and actionable plans.

  • Driving momentum: Taking ownership, anticipating challenges and keeping people and projects moving, even when priorities shift.

  • Thinking commercially: Understanding what makes an opportunity valuable, where to focus effort and how to create compelling reasons for clients to choose us.

  • Influencing and collaborating: Building trust, navigating different perspectives and aligning senior stakeholders and specialist teams.

  • Delivering under pressure: Remaining calm, resourceful and solutions-focused while maintaining exceptional standards.

  • Balancing strategy and execution: Seeing the bigger picture while being equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and delivering the details.

  • Staying culturally connected: Bringing curiosity, fresh thinking and an informed perspective on the trends and conversations shaping our industry.

WHAT YOU’LL GET:

For the right candidate, we will offer a competitive salary and benefits package which includes 27 days annual holiday, private healthcare, employer contributory pension, life assurance and income protection. We also offer a host of benefits that support wellbeing including subsidised gym membership, whilst our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion sees us offer learning opportunities around D&I, mentoring programmes and the opportunity for all to participate in a number of active Employee Led Networks and associated events. Finally, this role will be supported with all the necessary personal development required to set someone up for success.

Summary:

 

The General Ledger Manager is responsible for ensuring all general ledger and financial close activities are completed timely and accurately for the MNG properties managed in the Shared Services Center, as well as ensuring all payroll activity is recorded timely and accurately for MediaNews Group and Tribune Company. Working in Oracle and its respective reporting tools (EPM), this role handles all activities related to preparing and recording journal entries, maintaining sufficient backup documentation, and account reconciliation. Additionally, this position will be assigned the financial statement responsibilities for one or more newspaper properties and all payroll activity, supervise other staff, and serve as a key communication link with assigned properties' FP&A contacts. This position may also be responsible for tracking newsprint inventory and calculating expense.

 

Although this is a remote position, candidates must reside in Colorado or Ohio.

 

What you will do:

 

  • Supervise the General Ledger Team within the Shared Services Center to ensure all financial close activities are completed in a timely and accurate manner in accordance with GAAP
  • Review and post journal entries and review and approve payroll journal entries and reconciliations
  • For assigned properties, prepare monthly journal entries and supporting schedules, ensuring proper approvals have been received
  • Prepare documentation for journal entries in the following areas: ad revenue, interactive revenue, circulation revenue, circulation expenses, advertising expenses, newsprint expenses, payroll expenses, benefits expenses, and allocations

  • Identify areas for process improvement and increased efficiency
  • Hire, train, and manage the General Ledger Team

What you will bring:

 

  • Knowledge of accounting processes and internal controls
  • Strong knowledge and application of GAAP
  • Experience executing the financial statement close
  • Ability to read and comprehend written instructions (including process, policy, and procedure manuals), correspondence, and financial documents
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Advanced Excel proficiency, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and the ability to build reconciliations and roll-forward schedules

job.title: Assistant, Sync Licensing Administration
job.description:
Assistant, Sync Licensing Administration

Role Purpose

The Sync Assistant, Licensing Administration provides foundational administrative and operational support to the Sync Licensing team across the Company’s publishing catalogue. Working closely with the Director, Sync Licensing Administration. The role is responsible for drafting basic template agreements, maintaining contract databases, and tracking signatures through to completion.

This entry-level position is ideal for an organized individual looking to build a career in music publishing, copyright, and sync licensing administration while developing a solid grounding in commercial contracts.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Administration

  • Prepare Standard Documentation: Draft initial sync licence agreements using approved commercial deal terms and company templates.
  • Execution Tracking: Coordinate the signature process (via digital signature tools), actively monitoring and following up on outstanding agreements to ensure timely execution.
  • Basic Amendments: Assist with minor, non-legal administrative updates to documentation (e.g., entity name changes, term extensions, or fee confirmations) under the direction of the Director.
  • Escalation & Support: Assist the Director with gathering background information or precedent contracts for more complex negotiations. 

System & Database Management

  • Data Entry & Maintenance: Accurately enter and update contract status, metadata, and license terms across the company’s contract management and rights administration databases.
  • File Management: Maintain fully organized digital archives of executed agreements, deal memos, and underlying correspondence.
  • Reporting: Assist with compiling routine status reports on pending sync licenses for appropriate stakeholders.

Technology & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date data within contract management, rights administration and workflow systems.
  • Effectively utilise contract management, document automation and digital signature platforms to support efficient contract administration.
  • Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and workflows, sharing suggestions with the Director, Sync Licensing Administration.
  • Support the implementation, testing and adoption of new technologies, automation tools and system enhancements across the Licensing Administration function.
  • Assist in maintaining contract templates and standard documentation to support consistency, efficiency and process automation.
  • Demonstrate a proactive and adaptable approach to learning new technologies, AI-enabled tools and digital solutions that enhance team productivity and service delivery.

Team & Stakeholder Support

  • Internal Coordination: Liaise regularly with Creative Sync, Copyright, Finance, and Royalties teams to ensure smooth handoffs of executed deals for invoicing and rights logging.
  • External Communication: Serve as a professional, friendly point of contact for routine administrative inquiries from licensees and external business affairs contacts.
  • General Administration: Provide general administrative support to the Licensing Administration team as needed, including assisting with payment chasing and vendor set ups, monitoring licensing and payment inboxes and providing basic payment processing cover when required

Knowledge & Experience

Essential

  • Strong passion for the music industry, specifically music publishing and sync licensing.
  • Prior administrative experience (internships, placements, or entry-level positions within music, media, or legal environments are highly desirable).
  • Basic familiarity with music publishing, copyright concepts, or commercial contracts.
  • High proficiency in standard office software (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, GSuite, DocuSign/Adobe Sign).

Desirable

  • Exposure to rights management databases or contract management systems.
  • Educational background in Music Business, Law, Media, or a related field.

Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to reviewing data, deal terms, and document formatting.
  • Strong Organizational Skills: Ability to prioritize routine administrative tasks, multitask, and manage deadlines effectively.
  • Clear Communication: Professional written and verbal communication skills when interacting with internal teams and external clients.
  • Eagerness to Learn: Highly proactive, curious, and motivated to develop technical knowledge in contract drafting and sync administration.
  • Team Player: Collaborative mindset with a willingness to support colleagues during busy periods.

Why Choose Us

At Kobalt, we’ve championed creators since 2000. Our technology and music services are built to make the industry more transparent, fair, and rewarding for artists, songwriters, and rights holders. We’re proud to work with some of the world’s most influential talents including Phoebe Bridgers, Sam Fender, Paul McCartney, Foo Fighters, Karol G, Young Thug, Kali Uchis, and Andrew Watt as well as acclaimed writers like Simon Aldred (Rag’n’Bone Man, Liam Gallagher, Celeste) and Clarence Coffee Jr. (Dua Lipa, Lizzo, The Snuts).

We’re a company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and progress. Our values: Music First, Transparent, Tech Powered, and Transformative. Shape how we work, build, and grow together. We are a community of people who care deeply about making a meaningful impact in music and technology.

job.description:
Director, Income Tracking & Business Intelligence

Department: Royalties & Income Tracking
Location: London, UK
Hybrid Working: 3 days per week in the office
Employment Type: Full-time | Permanent

The Role

We are looking for a Director of Income Tracking & Business Intelligence to join our Royalties & BI team in London. In this role, you will lead a cross-territorial team responsible for maximizing global publishing collections, identifying and fixing underperforming tracking and revenue assurance processes, and delivering business intelligence to key stakeholders across Kobalt Publishing and the Kobalt Group.

You will manage five analysts who develop and refine workflows based on complex internal and external big data sets, identify gaps in royalty collections, and design automated mitigation processes to recover revenue as efficiently as possible. You will also lead cross-functional projects and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for our Executive Board to drive data-informed decision-making across Kobalt.

Working closely with the VP of Income Tracking & Business Intelligence, you will oversee relationships with third-party data providers to ensure our tools and services deliver value and support Kobalt's evolving business intelligence needs. This includes collaborating with colleagues across Royalties, Copyright, Technology, Writer & Publisher Relations, and Finance to ensure our processes remain efficient, accurate, properly resourced, and best-in-class in light of industry developments.

This position requires a combination of strong analytical expertise, deep music publishing knowledge, commercial acumen, and people leadership. The ideal candidate will have the ability to coach a high-performing team, manage and report ROI on structured operational processes, and foster creative analytical investigation.

What You'll Do

Income Tracking & Royalty Collections

  • Develop and maintain processes to identify gaps in global publishing collections, investigate under-collections and support the recovery of outstanding revenue across all income streams.
  • Develop and maintain forecasting methodologies to proactively prioritise income tracking activities and improve collection performance.
  • Work closely with Copyright and Royalties teams to assess changes in royalty reporting, catalogue information and deal structures, ensuring tracking and analysis remain accurate and relevant.
  • Monitor deal economics, including the recoupment of advances and minimum guarantee payments.
  • Establish and maintain service level agreements (SLAs) for incoming requests, ensuring appropriate prioritisation and efficient turnaround times.

Business Intelligence & Reporting

  • Develop and maintain internal business intelligence reporting tools, providing stakeholders with accurate, timely and actionable insights.
  • Maintain KPI reporting, ensuring methods of data retrieval, analysis and presentation remain efficient and up to date.
  • Produce regular reports to help stakeholders assess operational performance, identify risks and evaluate potential impacts on client royalty statements.
  • Deliver ad hoc business intelligence analysis and reporting for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Translate complex datasets into clear findings and recommendations to support commercial, operational and strategic decision-making.

Operational Leadership & Process Improvement

  • Lead and develop a cross-territorial team, coordinating operational priorities and ensuring objectives are delivered within agreed timeframes.
  • Document, review and improve operational processes, ensuring colleagues have clear guidance to complete tasks and resolve queries efficiently.
  • Balance structured, recurring data-processing activities with more complex analytical investigations.
  • Partner with the SVP, Royalties, to evaluate technology solutions, assessing effort, cost and potential impact to improve analytical efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance existing tools, workflows and reporting processes in response to changing business requirements and industry standards.

Data Partnerships & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage relationships with third-party data providers, including vendor evaluation, selection, performance reviews and contract renewals.
  • Assess the return on investment of external data services, identifying opportunities to improve value and exploring alternative providers where appropriate.
  • Work cross-functionally with Royalties, Copyright, Technology, Writer & Publisher Relations and Finance to understand requirements and develop practical solutions.
  • Provide clear recommendations and communicate complex analytical findings to stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge and seniority.

What You'll Bring

Preferred

  • Significant music industry experience with a strong understanding of music publishing, copyright and royalty administration processes.
  • Experience managing, supervising and motivating teams, including colleagues working across different territories and time zones.
  • Proven experience in income tracking, royalty analysis, business intelligence or a related analytical function, with a track record of reviewing and improving processes, reporting tools and analytical workflows.
  • Knowledge of SQL or analytical programming languages such as Python or R for large-scale data processing and analysis.
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage workload distribution, competing deadlines and under pressure deliveries.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting complex information, recommendations and trade-offs to stakeholders across different functions and levels of seniority.

Additional Skills That Could Add Value

  • Experience working with commercial KPIs and OKRs to monitor performance and drive operational improvements.
  • Hands on experience developing business intelligence visualization dashboards such as Tableau.
  • Experience managing third-party data providers, vendor relationships or commercial agreements.
  • Familiarity with best-in-class Snowflake data platform and other emerging analytical technologies, automation and AI-enabled tools.

What Success Looks Like

By Month 3: You'll have developed a strong understanding of Kobalt's income tracking processes, reporting tools, third-party data partnerships and operational priorities. You'll have established relationships with key stakeholders, assessed existing workflows and identified opportunities for improvement.

By Month 6: You'll be confidently leading the team's operational activities, ensuring consistent KPI reporting, effective prioritisation of income tracking initiatives and timely delivery of business intelligence requests. You'll have begun implementing improvements to processes, reporting and analytical capabilities.

By Year 1: You'll have delivered measurable improvements in income tracking effectiveness, reporting quality and operational efficiency. Your team will have established reliable processes for identifying under-collections, supporting revenue recovery and delivering actionable business intelligence that informs decision-making across Kobalt.

Ownership & Accountability – Takes responsibility for operational performance, follows through on commitments and ensures priorities are delivered accurately and on time.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation – Challenges existing processes, explores new technologies and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency, reporting and income tracking.

Leadership & Development – Provides clear direction, supports team development and model high-quality structured operational delivery based on analytical investigation.

Director, Sync Licensing Administration & Operations

Department: Sync
Location: London, UK
Hybrid Working: 3 days in your local office
Full-time | Permanent

The Role

We’re looking for a Director, Sync Licensing Administration & Operations to oversee our UK sync licensing administration function.

You’ll be responsible for ensuring sync agreements move efficiently from deal through contracting and administration, providing expertise on complex licensing matters and maintaining the contractual and operational standards that protect Kobalt and our creators.

But this role is about more than running the process as it exists today.

We’re looking for someone with a curious, solutions-focused mindset who wants to understand how work gets done, challenge unnecessary complexity and find better ways of doing things. You’ll look for opportunities to streamline workflows, use data more effectively and introduce automation and AI where they can improve speed, accuracy and scalability.

You’ll work closely with our US team and colleagues across Creative, Business Affairs, Legal, Copyright, Product, Technology and Data to help evolve licensing administration into an increasingly data-led and technology-enabled function.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the UK Sync Licensing Administration function, working closely with US counterparts to deliver consistent global standards and ways of working.
  • Oversee the end-to-end administration of publishing sync agreements, ensuring licensing activity is accurate, commercially responsive and appropriately governed.
  • Provide expertise and escalation support on complex licensing and contractual matters.
  • Work closely with Business Affairs and Legal on negotiation principles, contractual approaches and appropriate commercial risk.
  • Get close to existing processes and workflows, identifying bottlenecks, repetitive tasks and opportunities to simplify how work gets done.
  • Take the initiative in designing and implementing more efficient workflows, rather than accepting established processes as fixed.
  • Explore and implement automation, AI and agentic solutions that reduce manual administration and allow the team to focus on higher-value work.
  • Work confidently with large datasets, using SQL and increasingly AWS Athena to query and investigate operational data.
  • Build and interpret dashboards and reporting in Tableau to understand performance, identify trends and inform decisions.
  • Define meaningful operational KPIs and use data to understand licensing volumes, turnaround times, exceptions, risk and opportunities for improvement.
  • Experiment with Kobalt’s available technology and AI tooling to identify practical solutions to operational problems.

job.description:
Job Title: VP, Commerce

Headline: The Closer Who Scales the Engine Behind KOSIGN's Revenue Growth

Department: KOSIGN

Reporting To: Global Head of KOSIGN

Location: Los Angeles

Hybrid Working: 3 days in office per week

Status: Full-time | Permanent

About Us

KOSIGN is a recently-launched business within Kobalt Music Group, built to deliver premium global music publishing administration for today’s most independent and forward-thinking songwriters, producers, and artists. Developed by the team behind Kobalt’s industry-leading infrastructure - trusted by Max Martin, Phoebe Bridgers, Bon Iver, Paul McCartney, and more - KOSIGN brings transparency, flexibility, and control to the publishing process. We’ve built a modern platform tailored to artists and producers who want to stay in control and move fast.

The Opportunity

KOSIGN is looking for a VP, Commerce to lead writer acquisition and commercial partnerships. This is a high-impact role for a proven closer who can also build the machine: someone equally comfortable on the phone with a top writer's manager and designing a data-driven outreach operation that turns qualified leads into signed KOSIGN writers.

You will own KOSIGN's sales pipeline from lead generation through signing, serve as the lead commercial voice for the business, and bring KOSIGN to the wider industry, including management companies, law firms, and business management firms. You'll work hand in hand with Marketing, Client Services, and Client Onboarding to make sure every stage of the client journey supports the sales cycle.

This is a fast-paced role at the intersection of music, technology, and startups. You’ll be part of a lean, high-impact team building something new within one of the most innovative music companies in the world. It’s a rare opportunity to directly shape how the next generation of independent writers, producers, and artists manage their publishing.

The Role

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Sales & Business Development: Own all sales and business development for KOSIGN, managing the Client Relations & Sales Manager and growing the team as the department scales. Accountable for departmental revenue goals and writer acquisition goals.
  • Sales Operations: Build, scale, and optimize a data-driven, efficient sales and outreach operation with clear metrics and repeatable process.
  • Build the Pipeline: Partner with Marketing, Kobalt’s in-house research team, and external partners to grow the volume and quality of qualified writer leads.
  • Convert and Close: Oversee outreach and sales calls that convert qualified leads into accepted, signed KOSIGN writers, and personally lead conversations with high-priority writers and their managers to close key signings.
  • Commercial Leadership: Serve as KOSIGN’s lead commercial point person, setting and negotiating terms for larger deals and structuring conditions that work for both sides.
  • Sales Enablement: Identify the case studies, decks, and demos the team needs, and work with Marketing and Product to produce them.
  • Partnerships & Referrals: Build and manage referral partnerships and other channel partnerships that generate new business.
  • Industry Presence: Represent KOSIGN across the industry, building relationships with management companies, law firms, business management firms, and other key intermediaries.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Marketing, Client Services, and Client Onboarding, providing input so each function efficiently aligns with the sales cycle.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience in A&R, sales, or business development, ideally at a music publisher or record label
  • A proven track record as a closer, with strong relationships across writers, managers, and their advisors
  • Experience operationalizing, scaling, and managing a data-driven sales or outreach function
  • Strong commercial judgment and deal-structuring experience
  • A history of working closely with Marketing, Product, and client-facing teams
  • Managerial experience leading and developing sales or client-facing staff
  • Experience with CRM platforms and sales analytics
  • Experience using AI for workflow optimization and automation
  • Working knowledge of music publishing administration
  • An existing network across artist management, music law, and business management

Key Behaviors for Success

  • Closer Mentality: Knows how to move a conversation to a signature and is comfortable leading high-stakes calls.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Uses pipeline and conversion data, not instinct alone, to decide where to focus.
  • Operational Rigor: Treats outreach, signing, and onboarding as one continuous process and removes friction between them.
  • Commercial Judgment: Structures deals that grow KOSIGN while building long-term industry relationships.

What Success Looks Like

  • By Month 3: Audit the lead-to-signing funnel, establish baseline metrics (lead volume, conversion rates, time to sign), and build relationships with key referral partners and intermediaries.
  • By Month 6: Run an optimized, repeatable outreach operation that is tracking toward acquisition targets, with refreshed sales enablement materials and new referral partnerships in place.
  • By Year 1: Deliver against departmental revenue and writer acquisition goals with a scalable sales engine and a clear plan for growing the department.

Interview Process

  • Round 1: Recruiting Team
  • Round 2: Head of KOSIGN
  • Round 3: President, Kobalt
  • Round 4: CEO, Kobalt

job.title: Broadcast & Digital Operations Specialist
job.description:
About the Role

Fox Tech runs one of the most complex 24/7 streaming and broadcast operations in the industry. Our overnight and weekend coverage depends on people who can move smoothly between disciplines, so we're hiring a Floating Operations Specialist who can cover wherever the business needs them most.

This is not a single-desk job. On one shift you might be monitoring live event streams for FOX One, FOX Sports, and FOX Nation. On the next, you might be running master control playlists or watching SCTE ad markers and CDN dashboards in the Media Control Center. You'll learn each area, build the skills to work in it independently, and help the team respond quickly when priorities change mid-shift.

If you get energy from switching gears, learning new systems, and adapting to whatever the night brings, this role was built for you.(add in get to expand technical stack)

What You'll Do

  • Digital Operations: Monitor live events, app clients, and video performance across FOX One, FOX Sports, FOX Nation, and Tubi. Run pre-flight checks, encoder validations, entitlement sweeps, and post-event validation (DVR, highlights, short-form), and complete regular app sweeps for functionality and parity.
  • Master Control: Support media ingest, quality control, assembly, playout, and distribution for pre-programmed and live content. Perform on-air switching and run automation playlists in multicast and live sports environments.
  • Media Control Center: Monitor SCTE markers, CDN performance, and transmission dashboards for signal health and delivery quality. Support inbound contribution and outbound distribution across linear and OTT platforms.
  • Incident & Handoff Support: Log incidents accurately in JIRA, PagerDuty, and ServiceNow, escalate issues to the right team, and write clear shift handoff notes for the morning team.
  • Documentation: Help create and update runbooks, checklists, and playbooks as processes evolve.
  • Cross-Team Coverage: Step in to support Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and Live Media teams when needed.

What You Need

  • Strong attention to detail, checklists, and ticket documentation/ escalation
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new tools and workflows quickly and apply them under time pressure
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially for handoffs and incident updates
  • Availability for overnight, weekend, and holiday shifts

Nice to Have, not a Dealbreaker

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field
  • Experience in a 24/7 environment such as master control, broadcast operations, a network operations center, or digital streaming operations
  • Bilingual Spanish/English
  • Prior experience leading or documenting incidents

What Success Looks Like

  • You can move from one area to another without losing focus or accuracy.
  • You stay calm when priorities change in the middle of a shift and adjust the plan without being asked.
  • You notice small details, such as a missing ad marker or a slow app load, and act on them.
  • You learn a new system quickly, ask good questions, and document what you learn for the next person.
  • Teammates count on you to cover gaps, and you pick up the work that needs doing.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

 


About the Role  

We are looking for an experienced and driven Account Director to join our team and take ownership of a portfolio of high-profile, globally recognized clients. This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, multi-disciplinary environment - someone who loves the craft of integrated storytelling just as much as they love the rigor of running a seamless account. 

You'll be working across 360 campaigns - from strategy and ideation through to production and performance - partnering with some of the best creative, strategy, and media minds in the industry. 

What You’ll Do 

Client Leadership 

  • Serve as the senior day-to-day lead across a portfolio of well-known brands, building deep, trusted relationships at senior client levels. 
  • Act as a strategic partner to clients - understanding their business objectives, challenges, and opportunities, and proactively bringing forward ideas and solutions. 
  • Lead and facilitate strategic briefings, presentations, and reviews, ensuring the agency's output consistently exceeds client expectations. 

Campaign & Project Management 

  • Oversee the end-to-end delivery of fully integrated 360 campaigns spanning brand, digital, social, content, experiential, and more. 
  • Manage and coordinate cross-functional internal teams (Creative, Strategy, Media, Production, Data) to ensure seamless project delivery- on time, on brief, and on budget. 
  • Maintain a clear view of all workstreams, proactively identifying risks and removing roadblocks before they impact delivery. 

Commercial Accountability 

  • Own the financial health of your accounts - managing scopes of work, budgets, forecasting, and billing with accuracy and confidence. 
  • Identify and pursue organic growth opportunities across existing clients, partnering with senior leadership to develop proposals and presentations. 
  • Maintain accurate revenue forecasting and contribute to the team's commercial targets. 

Team Development 

  • Lead, mentor, and develop more junior members of the account team (Account Supervisors, Account Executives), fostering a culture of excellence, curiosity, and accountability. 
  • Contribute to a positive, inclusive team environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated. 

 

Who You Are 

  • A natural relationship builder - you make clients feel confident, heard, and excited to collaborate. 
  • A champion of great work - you understand what makes creative ideas powerful and know how to protect and elevate them. 
  • Calm under pressure - you bring clarity and structure to complexity, and your team looks to you for direction. 
  • Commercially minded - you understand the business of advertising and can speak fluently about scopes, margins, and growth. 
  • A connector - you know how to bring together the right people at the right time to solve problems and unlock opportunities. 
  • Inclusive and collaborative - you lead with empathy, create space for others, and bring out the best in every team around you. 

 

What You'll Need 

  • 8+ years of experience in an integrated agency environment, with proven Account Director-level responsibility across multiple accounts or brands. 
  • A strong track record of delivering complex, multi-channel (360) campaigns - from brief through to final delivery. 
  • Experience managing senior client relationships across well-known, high-profile brands. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills - written, verbal, and visual. 
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience managing budgets, scopes, and profitability. 
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously without sacrificing quality or attention to detail. 
  • Experience leading and developing junior talent. 
  • A passion for creativity, culture, and the ever-evolving marketing landscape. 

 

How We’ll Support You 

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates.  

À propos du poste 

Nous recherchons un(e) Directeur(trice) de Comptes expérimenté(e) et motivé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe et prendre en charge un portefeuille de clients prestigieux, reconnus à l'échelle mondiale. Ce poste s'adresse à une personne qui s'épanouit dans un environnement dynamique et pluridisciplinaire - quelqu'un qui aime autant l'art de la narration intégrée que la rigueur d'une gestion de compte sans faille. 

Vous interviendrez sur des campagnes 360° - de la stratégie et l'idéation jusqu'à la production et la performance - en collaborant avec certains des meilleurs esprits créatifs, stratégiques et médias de l'industrie. 

Vos missions 

Gestion de la relation client 

  • Assurer le rôle d'interlocuteur(trice) principal(e) au quotidien pour un portefeuille de marques reconnues, en établissant des relations de confiance solides avec les interlocuteurs clients de haut niveau. 
  • Agir en tant que partenaire stratégique pour les clients - comprendre leurs objectifs business, leurs défis et leurs opportunités, et proposer proactivement des idées et des solutions. 
  • Animer et piloter des séances de briefing stratégique, des présentations et des bilans, en veillant à ce que les livrables de l'agence dépassent systématiquement les attentes des clients. 

Gestion des campagnes et des projets 

  • Superviser la livraison de bout en bout de campagnes 360° pleinement intégrées, couvrant la marque, le digital, les réseaux sociaux, le contenu, l'expérientiel, et bien plus encore. 
  • Coordonner les équipes internes transversales (Création, Stratégie, Médias, Production, Data) afin de garantir une exécution fluide des projets - dans les délais, dans le respect du brief et du budget. 
  • Maintenir une vision claire de l'ensemble des flux de travail, en identifiant proactivement les risques et en levant les obstacles avant qu'ils n'impactent la livraison. 

Responsabilité commerciale 

  • Assurer la santé financière de vos comptes - en gérant les périmètres de mission, les budgets, les prévisions et la facturation avec précision et assurance. 
  • Identifier et saisir les opportunités de croissance organique auprès des clients existants, en collaborant avec la direction pour développer des propositions et des présentations. 
  • Maintenir des prévisions de revenus précises et contribuer aux objectifs commerciaux de l'équipe. 

Développement des équipes 

  • Encadrer, accompagner et faire évoluer les membres juniors de l'équipe comptes (Superviseurs de Compte, Chargés de Compte), en favorisant une culture d'excellence, de curiosité et de responsabilité. 
  • Contribuer à un environnement d'équipe positif et inclusif, où la diversité des perspectives est valorisée. 

 

Votre profil 

  • Un(e) bâtisseur(euse) de relations naturel(le) - vous donnez aux clients confiance, sentiment d'être écouté(e)s et envie de collaborer. 
  • Un(e) défenseur(e) du travail de qualité - vous comprenez ce qui rend les idées créatives percutantes et savez comment les protéger et les sublimer. 
  • Serein(e) sous pression - vous apportez clarté et structure face à la complexité, et votre équipe se tourne vers vous pour trouver une direction. 
  • Orienté(e) business - vous comprenez les enjeux économiques de la publicité et maîtrisez les notions de périmètres de mission, de marges et de croissance. 
  • Un(e) connecteur(trice) - vous savez réunir les bonnes personnes au bon moment pour résoudre des problèmes et saisir des opportunités. 
  • Inclusif(ve) et collaboratif(ve) - vous managez avec empathie, créez de l'espace pour les autres et faites ressortir le meilleur de chaque équipe. 

 

Ce dont vous aurez besoin 

  • 8 ans d'expérience minimum dans un environnement d'agence intégrée, avec une responsabilité avérée au niveau Directeur(trice) de Clientèle sur plusieurs comptes ou marques. 
  • Un solide bilan dans la livraison de campagnes complexes et multi-canaux (360°) - du brief jusqu'à la livraison finale. 
  • Une expérience dans la gestion de relations clients senior auprès de marques reconnues et à fort profil. 
  • D'excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation - à l'écrit, à l'oral et visuellement. 
  • Une forte acuité commerciale, incluant une expérience dans la gestion de budgets, de périmètres de mission et de rentabilité. 
  • La capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément sans sacrifier la qualité ni l'attention aux détails. 
  • Une expérience dans l'encadrement et le développement de talents juniors. 
  • Une passion pour la créativité, la culture et le paysage marketing en constante évolution. 

 

Comment nous vous soutiendrons 

Ogilvy célèbre ses collaborateurs. Pleinement. Avec enthousiasme. Sans réserve. Nous vous donnerons les outils dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir. Nous vous accorderons l'autonomie nécessaire pour explorer de nouvelles voies et trouver de meilleures façons de faire les choses. Nous vous entourerons de collègues experts dans leurs domaines respectifs, issus de l'ensemble du réseau Ogilvy. Et nous vous offrirons des opportunités de réaliser un travail dont vous serez fier(ère), aux côtés de personnes que vous serez fier(ère) d'appeler vos coéquipiers. 

 

The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications.

Salary Range $90,000—$140,000 CAD

At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. 

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.

  • Practical experience with Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), particularly solution design, implementation or configuration
  • A strong understanding of customer data architecture, data modelling and integration patterns
  • Experience translating business and analytics requirements into technical specifications and solution designs
  • The ability to design and communicate end-to-end technical solutions
  • Experience working directly with enterprise clients, particularly data and technology stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and technical documentation skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Adobe Experience Platform or Adobe Customer Journey Analytics certifications
  • Experience with Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform (RT-CDP)
  • Knowledge of XDM, identity resolution and profile unification
  • Experience with Adobe Analytics and other Adobe Experience Cloud products
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with enterprise data platforms
  • Knowledge of web and mobile analytics, event tracking and data collection

  • Experience working on large-scale customer data, digital experience or analytics transformation programs.

About Ogilvy

Ogilvy was founded in 1948 by David Ogilvy. David created a culture that deeply respects and cares about its people and clients. Our mission is to inspire people and brands to make an impact and we are committed to attracting, growing, and retaining the best talent in the industry. 

About the Role  

A Designer should have an good grasp of visual design behavior and craftsmanship. The Designer is a critical player in bringing master campaigns to life across the final touchpoints of the consumer journey. They should have a solid grasp of visual design behavior, craftsmanship, and proficiency in mainstream design software. The successful candidate will be fully embedded with our client's team and will be on-site at client’s office thrice a week. You will act as Ogilvy’s on-the-ground creative ambassador, handling high-volume adaptation and shopper design requirements directly aligned with the client's daily operational needs, while remaining a core part of Team Ogilvy/WPP. A Designer in this role focuses heavily on the adaptation and rollout of visual design outputs, specializing in Shopper Marketing, Point-of-Sale Materials (POSM), e-commerce assets, and localized brand cascades. The ideal person is highly detail-oriented, possesses a strong sense of collaboration, and understands crucial brand standards required to maintain a consistent design aesthetic. He/she must be able to multitask various adaptation projects and formats while maintaining a gold-standard quality of output. Experience in shopper marketing is a strong advantage, but a rigorous eye for design adaptation is the primary requirement.

What You’ll Do 

Brand Execution & Guardianship

  • Deeply understand the Client's brand guidelines, visual identity, and specific layout requirements.
  • Act as a meticulous guardian of brand consistency when adapting global or regional toolkits for local use or specific retail channels.

Brief Comprehension & Application

  • Thoroughly read and understand daily creative briefs, specifically looking out for shopper path-to-purchase and channel-specific requirements (retail, e-commerce, digital).
  • Understand the technical specifications, structural realities, and limitations of the formats being designed (e.g., printed POSM vs. digital banners).

Design & Adaptation Craft

  • Under the guidance of senior creatives and client stakeholders, adapt and produce high-quality materials, translating master Key Visuals (KVs) into various formats, sizes, and specs.
  • Complete the daily design and adaptation work independently, accurately, and at speed in an embedded environment.
  • Demonstrate strong time management skills to handle high-volume adaptations and meet tight client deadlines.
  • Maintain strict attention to detail in typography, color-matching, layout adjustments, and image resizing.
  • Note: Prior experience in Shopper Marketing (understanding retail environments, gondolas, endcaps, shelf-talkers) is a plus, but a willingness to learn is required.

Collaboration & Professionalism

  • Be passionate about design craft; take pride in ensuring even the smallest adaptations meet both the client's expectations and the Ogilvy standard of excellence.

ABOUT THE ROLE: 

In this role, you’ll be responsible for evolving our end-to-end social offering from organic and culture-first social through to business influence and social commerce.  

You’ll play a key role in the realisation of our strategic and creative process as we deliver a truly integrated, social-first and earned-first approach to clients and prospects. Working with senior stakeholders across the business, you’ll be responsible for shaping and growing a best-in-class social offering and driving impact with existing and new clients. You'll have the opportunity to shape the role that our clients play in culture, leveraging our proprietary tech stack, deep creative talent pool and proven methodologies.  

The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of culture-first brand strategy, a passion for creative excellence in social and the ability to consult with clients across the full spectrum of social media.  

You’ll be an empathic leader and a highly effective collaborator who drives growth by enabling those around you to deliver the best work of their careers. This role presents a unique opportunity for an established social leader to develop their career on one of the biggest agency stages in Australia and New Zealand with the support of the wider regional and global leadership team.  

With social and influencer marketing firmly on the radar of CMOs and marketers in Australia and New Zealand, there’s never been a better time to take your career in social media to the next level with Ogilvy.

Consulting

  • Lead the development and execution of social-first brand strategies that drive cultural relevance and business impact for consumer, corporate, public sector and health clients  
  • Play a lead role in the development of distinctive social strategies for our major clients with a focus on brand building and meaningful cultural impact 
  • Develop social-first creative briefs and guide creative teams through ideation and execution  
  • Manage senior client relationships and serve as strategic advisor on social brand building and drive integration of social strategy across broader marketing and communications programs 

Product & Growth 

  • Lead and evolve the four product offers – commerce, paid, organic and influence – and develop integrated strategies and campaigns that weave specialist teams together 
  • Manage and extend a best-in-class cultural and social listening program to identify reactive and strategic opportunities for brands

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities through the development of innovative social solutions and product offerings

Siendo el foco el diseño estratégico, la conceptualización y la supervisión cualitativa de los proyectos. Principales responsabilidades:

  • Dirección Estratégica 360°: Diseñar marcos y estrategias de influencia de alto nivel que se integren coherentemente con los planes de PR, social media, medios pagados y activaciones de marca.
  • Propuestas de nuevo negocio: Idear y liderar la propuesta estratégica de influencia en pitches y concursos clave para la captación de nuevas cuentas.
  • Estrategias Anuales y Proyectos Clave: Desarrollar hojas de ruta estratégicas anuales (always-on) y marcos conceptuales para proyectos especiales de gran envergadura.
  • Supervisión y Validación de Castings: Definir los criterios estratégicos de selección (perfiles, afinidad, brand safety, representatividad) y supervisar/validar las propuestas de perfiles elaboradas por los equipos operativos o agencias colaboradoras.
  • Ideación Creativa: Generar conceptos, narrativas y dinámicas innovadoras de la mano del equipo creativo que sirvan de guía para que los creadores desarrollen contenidos alineados con los objetivos de marca.
  • Supervisión de Calidad y Regulación: Garantizar que las activaciones respeten la estrategia definida y cumplan rigurosamente la normativa legal vigente sobre publicidad de influencers y transparencia.
  • Frameworks de Medición & Análisis: Definir los KPIs y modelos de atribución/impacto; supervisar los informes de resultados para extraer aprendizajes e insights estratégicos para los clientes.
  • Rol Consultor Transversal: Asesorar y actuar como referente estratégico de influencia para los directores de cuentas, directores creativos y equipos de PR de la agencia.
  • Tendencias & Innovación: Identificar tendencias emergentes en la creator economy y plataformas para traducirlas en oportunidades estratégicas para nuestros clientes.

Requisitos:

  • Experiencia: Entre 3 y 5 años en roles estratégicos de Influencer Marketing, Estrategia Digital o PR Estratégico en agencia.
  • Pensamiento 360° (PR + IM): Capacidad probada para conectar la disciplina de influencia con la narrativa corporativa/de marca y las Relaciones Públicas.
  • Enfoque analítico y creativo: Capacidad para traducir datos, métricas y herramientas del sector en conceptos creativos e historias con impacto de negocio.
  • Capacidad de supervisión: Criterio sólido para evaluar propuestas, validar selecciones de talento y asegurar la calidad sin necesidad de involucrarse en la gestión operativa del día a día.
  • Conocimiento normativo y de plataformas: Dominio de las plataformas sociales y pleno conocimiento de la regulación y códigos de autorregulación publicitaria aplicables a creadores de contenido.

    •    Autonomía y rigor: Habilidad para liderar proyectos estratégicos con criterio propio y de forma resolutiva.
    •    Flexibilidad: Adaptabilidad para saltar de un sector a otro (FMCG, belleza, tech, lifestyle, etc.) y gestionar distintos ritmos de trabajo.
    •    Trabajo en equipo y comunicación: Excelentes dotes de presentación ante clientes y facilidad para colaborar de forma transversal con diferentes equipos.
    •    Idiomas: Español nativo/bilingüe e Inglés fluido (C1).

¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Rol 100% estratégico con gran impacto en el crecimiento y nuevo negocio de la agencia.

Twój zakres obowiązków:

  • Kontakt z twórcami i ich agencjami, briefowanie, zbieranie materiałów oraz pilnowanie terminów publikacji.
  • Przygotowywanie umów z twórcami, wprowadzanie dostawców do systemów, pilnowanie rozliczeń, faktur i rachunków. 
  • Wsparcie działań PR i biura prasowego – tworzenie komunikatów prasowych, dystrybucja i stały kontakt z mediami 
  • Codzienna współpraca z domem mediowym  -przekazywanie materiałów influencerskich do płatnego promowania zgodnie z harmonogramem. 
  • Wsparcie przy realizacji materiałów na kanały marki. 
  • Pomoc przy organizacji eventów i akcji specjalnych. 
  • Przygotowywanie podsumowań, zestawień i prezentacji kampanii - w dużej mierze w języku angielskim. 

Nasze wymagania: 

  • Świetna organizacja pracy i dokładność: potrafisz zaplanować swoją pracę, dbasz o detale, pamiętasz o formalnościach i terminach bez konieczności stałego przypominania. 
  • Aktywnie korzystasz z TikToka, Instagrama i YouTube'a, wiesz, co jest teraz w trendach, kto jest na fali, a kogo lepiej unikać ze względu na kontrowersje. 
  • Bardzo dobry język angielski (min. B2/C1): będziesz go używać na co dzień przy tworzeniu prezentacji, raportów, rekomendacji oraz w stałej (mailowej) komunikacji z klientem.  
  • Łatwość w nawiązywaniu relacji - u nas każdy członek zespołu ma bezpośredni, partnerski kontakt z klientem, twórcami i dostawcami.

  • Doświadczenie (nawet stażowe) w agencji PR, digital lub influencer marketingu. 
  • Zmysł wizualny i podstawowa umiejętność montażu wideo na telefonie (np. CapCut, Canva).

  • Pełne wdrożenie i mentoring: trafiasz do zgranego, wspierającego zespołu, który krok po kroku nauczy Cię procesów agencyjnych. 

Benefity: 

  • Dostęp do platform edukacyjnych i rozwoju: szkolenia, webinary oraz narzędzia globalnej sieci agencji (w tym innowacyjne narzędzia AI wspierające codzienną pracę). 
  • Prywatna opieka medyczna o podwyższonym standardzie oraz dofinansowanie do karty sportowej. 
  • Elastyczność i wygoda: model hybrydowy (min. 2 dni z biura, reszta z domu) w nowoczesnej przestrzeni w Centrum Praskim Koneser. 

     

    _______________________________________________________

As a strategic business leader, you will own the employee experience and people-related outcomes for a defined part of our business, acting as a primary "Experience Account Manager." You will orchestrate HR products and services to solve real business problems and drive significant change, directly impacting engagement, performance, capability, and retention for your "account" areas.

This role requires a proactive, data-driven individual who can act as a credible 'thinking partner' to senior leaders, translating business strategy into impactful people plans and ensuring Ogilvy remains an employer of choice. You will be instrumental in driving organisational change and transformation, shaping the people narrative, and leveraging HR as a critical toolkit to achieve commercial success and foster our Borderless Creativity culture.

 

Responsibilities:

  1. Strategic Leadership Advisory & Development:
  • Act as a primary "thinking partner" to senior business leaders, providing expert counsel and strategic challenge on people, culture, performance, and organisational risk.
  • Proactively work with leadership to achieve commercial goals, business strategy, and desired culture, using data from 360-degree feedback, engagement surveys, performance reviews, and attrition analysis.
  • Treat your business areas as your "clients," understanding their unique needs and delivering tailored people solutions.
  • Develop and implement strategic people plans aligned with business objectives, driving outcomes such as improved engagement, performance, capability uplift, and retention within your business areas.

 

  1. Organisational Change & Transformation:
  • Partner with your business for significant business initiatives, including restructurings, acquisitions, integrations, and new growth areas, framing the people, culture, and capability implications.
  • Lead organisational design and workforce planning conversations, developing scenario models for structures, critical roles, skills, and future talent needs.
  • Work in Partnerships with centralised Centres of Excellence and HR Operations to ensure effective end to end HR service.
  • Identify and mitigate risks such as culture challenges, leadership bottlenecks, key person dependencies, employee relations and burnout.

 

  1. Planning, Design & Delivery (Product & Portfolio Mindset):
  • Clarify and diagnose critical business problems (e.g., growth, margin, productivity, churn) that can be addressed through people solutions.
  • Partner with specialist HR Centres of Excellence (L&D, TA, Reward, People & Culture and People Operations), acting as the voice of the business leader and employee into the wider People team.
  • Continually look for ways to improve approach/ ways of working to managing ongoing "BAU" People needs (e.g., hiring processes, manager support, benefits, etc), ensuring efficiency and freeing up capacity for truly strategic initiatives. 

 

  1. Commercial & Financial Acumen:
  • Understand the commercial context of your business areas and link HR initiatives directly to business value drivers (e.g., margin improvement, revenue growth, productivity gains, risk reduction).
  • Collaborate closely with finance teams to manage HR-related budgets, analyse data, and ensure people investments deliver clear ROI.
  • Contribute to workforce planning initiatives, assessing staffing needs, developing strategies for talent retention, and succession planning.
  • Lead talent management activities, ensuring robust succession planning, critical role identification, and proactive development pathways.

 

  1. Employee Engagement & Experience:
  • Own and drive initiatives that promote a positive, inclusive work culture and enhance employee engagement across your business areas.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and provide guidance to managers and employees on various HR-related matters, including performance management, employee relations, and career development.
  • Facilitate feedback channels, interpret engagement survey results, and lead the creation and implementation of action plans.
  • Ensure compliance with employment legislation and regulations in the UK, providing clear guidance to managers and employees.

 

Please note that these responsibilities are not exhaustive and may vary depending on the specific needs and priorities of the business. 

 

Key Skills & Experienced Required:

  • Commercial and Financial Literacy: Proven ability to understand P&Ls, budgets, value drivers, and business models. Able to credibly discuss margin, revenue, productivity, risk, and growth strategy with senior leaders.
  • Strategic HR Experience: Significant proven experience as a People Partner in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, ideally within a creative agency or similar industry, and have experience of working within a centralised HR model. Demonstrable track record of owning outcomes and driving business impact through people strategy.
  • Leadership, Coaching & Consulting Skills: Credible peer to senior leaders; able to challenge and support effectively. Highly skilled at framing complex problems, contracting work, and delivering difficult feedback constructively.
  • Change, Communications & Storytelling: Expertise in leading organisational change initiatives. Able to craft compelling narratives, gain leadership buy-in, and understand both behavioural and process change.
  • Data & Insight Fluency: Strong analytical skills with a data-driven mindset. Proficient in using people and business data for diagnosis, prioritisation, and building simple, sharp insight packs for leaders. Experience with HR analytics and metrics to inform decision-making.
  • Organisational Design & Development: Demonstrated knowledge and experience in leading org design, workforce planning, and talent management (succession, critical roles, development).
  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively build trust and influence stakeholders at all levels, including external partners.
  • Technical HR Expertise: CIPD certification (Level 7 preferred). Strong understanding of HR best practices, employment legislation, and regulations in the United Kingdom. Experience with HRIS (Workday implementation experience is a plus).
  • Resilience & Adaptability: Proven ability to thrive in a complex, ambiguous, and continuously evolving environment, managing multiple priorities and driving continuous improvement.

Nous sommes une agence de publicité, de marketing et de communication.

Ogilvy est une des filiales du Groupe WPP, ce qui fait de nous la plus internationale de toutes les agences de communication françaises.

David Ogilvy, notre fondateur, a un parcours atypique et peu scolaire. Entrepreneur dans l’âme, c’est son travail, son talent et sa vision qui lui ont permis de devenir l’un des plus grands communicants des années 60. Il a, d’ailleurs, beaucoup inspiré la série Mad Men.

Il a fondé la maison Ogilvy en 1948, en plein cœur de New-York avant de se développer aux États-Unis et à l’international.

En plus d’avoir bâti un empire, il a aussi réussi à transcender notre vision des produits, des marques et notre façon de les raconter.

70 ans plus tard, nous continuons de transmettre son héritage avec un seul but : « Making brands matter ».

 

TA DREAM TEAM 🌈

Au sein de l’équipe Créative et sous la responsabilité du Directeur de Création, tu travailleras aux côtés de directeurs artistiques et de créatifs confirmés qui t'accompagneront dans ton développement. Tu participeras à la conception et à la réalisation de projets créatifs 360°.

Nous recherchons avant tout un profil avec une vraie sensibilité artistique, un regard graphique affirmé et une forte appétence pour la création d'images.

À ce titre, tu auras pour missions :

  • Participer aux réunions de travail : briefs, moodboards, points créa, PPM, présentations clients, etc.

job.description:
Sr. Client Success Manager

#26-198

Apply

Job Description

Strengthening and empowering all of the communities we serve.

Senior Client Success Manager

Remote- based position

About BookingsCloud

BookingsCloud is a pioneering SaaS platform and demand-generation operating system developed for professional vacation rental managers. Backed by a major media company, we score portfolios, run the media, and own the direct-booking loop using real-time property, PMS, and market data, helping managers grow direct bookings, maximize revenue, and reduce reliance on OTAs. Our clients are operators who care deeply about their homes and guests. We succeed by helping them own their demand instead of renting it from the OTAs.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, data-savvy Senior Client Success Manager who can combine strong analytics skills with client-facing strategy. In this role, you will own a portfolio of accounts end to end as the revenue strategist and technical point of contact, lead client reviews, and translate BookingsCloud attribution, PMS reservation data, and Meta and GA4 signals into clear ROI stories that drive trust and earned growth in campaign budgets.

This is a senior individual contributor position with the opportunity to help shape the future of client success and analytics at BookingsCloud. It’s ideal for someone who thrives on turning complex performance data into compelling client narratives and is eager to prove how marketing investments can fuel revenue growth. You will be the steady, credible voice that keeps clients anchored to results, even when a month is soft, tracking breaks, or the numbers are questioned.

Key Responsibilities

Client Success & Analytics

Lead the conversation with clients through onboarding, monthly calls, and monthly business reviews.

Reconcile BookingsCloud attribution with PMS, Meta, and GA4 data, and translate it into ROI-focused recommendations.

Create client-facing report packs (Page engagement, booking windows, same-store velocity vs. prior year, revenue, gross and net ROAS). Flag soft months and rising cancellations plainly.

Identify and recommend opportunities to earn budget increases through verified results, refine property prioritization, and align spend to each portfolio’s booking seasonality.

Own the revenue strategy for each account by building annual demand plans from the client’s own PMS history, and frame budget conversations around demand the client already owns.

Lead retention and escalation conversations, including pause requests and off-season budget reductions, in partnership with billing and leadership.

Playbook & Best Practices

Refine and implement the 90-day client success playbook across your accounts.

Document client success stories and share best practices with the team.

Develop repeatable templates and reporting frameworks that scale.

Collaboration & Insights

Partner with product and data teams to improve dashboards, attribution models, and reporting.

Own technical triage end to end with product and engineering: tracking and GTM issues, ad feed and catalog mismatches, and PMS integration discrepancies.

Provide actionable client feedback as we expand into new channels and products, including Google search and owner acquisition.

Support marketing and sales with referrals, case study development, and client expansion opportunities.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Minimum 7 years in client success, account management, or marketing analytics

Strong command of attribution models and cross-channel campaign reporting, with working fluency in GA4

Technical aptitude to diagnose tracking (GTM, CAPI), ad feed, and PMS integration issues and write clear escalations to engineering

Experience with Google Ads/PPC and familiarity with SEM and multi-channel tracking

Proven ability to grow client budgets by earning trust with verified data, including when a month is soft

Executive presence with excellent communication skills for business owner, GM, and ops leadership conversations

Process-oriented with experience creating playbooks, templates, or scalable client programs

Comfortable using AI tools to analyze data and draft client narratives, with the judgment to verify and refine the output.

Strong presentation skills

Nice to Have

Experience driving budget expansion or account growth through marketing analytics

Hands-on campaign execution in paid social or paid search.

Vacation rental or hospitality experience, including PMS platforms and OTA economics

Location & Travel

Remote (U.S.), though role operates on CST/EST business hours

Travel- up to 20% of the time for conferences or team meetings; reliable transportation is required.

Additional Information

Advance Local Media offers competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package with affordable options for your healthcare including medical, dental and vision plans, mental health support options, flexible spending accounts, fertility assistance, a competitive 401(k) plan to help plan for your future, generous paid time off, paid parental and caregiver leave and an employee assistance program to support your work/life balance, optional legal assistance, life insurance options, as well as flexible holidays to honor cultural diversity.

Advance Local Media is one of the largest media groups in the United States, which operates the leading news and information companies in more than 20 cities, reaching 52+ million people monthly with our quality, real-time journalism and community engagement. Our company is built upon the values of Integrity, Customer-first, Inclusiveness, Collaboration and Forward-looking. For more information about Advance Local, please visit www.advancelocal.com.

Advance Local Media includes MLive Media Group, Advance Ohio, Alabama Media Group, NJ Advance Media, Advance Media NY, MassLive Media, Oregonian Media Group, Staten Island Media Group, PA Media Group, ZeroSum, Headline Group, Adpearance, Advance Aviation, Advance Healthcare, Advance Education, Advance Originals, Advance Recruitment, Advance Travel & Tourism, BookingsCloud, Catalyst IQ, Cloud Theory, Fox Dealer, Hoot Interactive, Search Optics, Subtext.

Advance Local Media is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, encouraging applications from people of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or any other category protected under federal, state or local law.

If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please contact Human Resources and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

Your Role


CBC/Radio-Canada is seeking a Lead Analyst, Data Protection Specialist, to design, lead and evolve the Corporation’s data security program. 

In this role, you will provide technical and operational leadership to safeguard sensitive data and personal information throughout the data life cycle (collection, processing, storage, transmission, archiving and destruction). You will collaborate closely with Legal Services, privacy officers, enterprise architects and IT Operations to align data security with regulatory requirements and industry standards.

This position can be based in Montreal or Toronto.

What’s in It for You

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. You’ll be working with leading-edge data management, cloud, IP broadcasting, AI, security and reliability technologies.

As Lead Analyst, you will:

  • Define data security strategy: Develop and refine the road map for the Corporation’s data protection program.
  • Implement data classification: Establish and deploy data classification policies and frameworks.
  • Administer data protection technologies: Select, deploy and optimize data loss prevention (DLP) tools.
  • Protect cloud and hybrid environments: Design security controls tailored to cloud-hosted data and hybrid architectures.
  • Partner on compliance and policy frameworks: Work closely with the policy, compliance and legal affairs lead to align security controls with statutory requirements.
  • Manage the data security risk register: Document, maintain and map risks related to confidentiality, potential data breaches and approved exceptions.
  • Adjudicate and govern exception requests: Evaluate, document and follow up on exception requests when standard security controls cannot be immediately applied, ensuring appropriate compensating controls are established.
  • Lead data breach response: Actively participate in investigations of suspected or confirmed data breaches in co-ordination with the Information Security, Legal Services and Incident Response teams.
  • Develop metrics and dashboards: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to monitor program effectiveness.
  • Assess program maturity: Plan and conduct periodic evaluations, performance reviews and audits of data protection controls to identify gaps, measure maturity progress and formulate recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Maintain industry expertise: Stay current on information security best practices and industry trends.

What You Bring

  • University degree in computer science, IT or information security.
  • Minimum five years’ experience in data protection, privacy security, DLP or data governance, including at least three years in an information security role.
  • Proven track record of implementing and evaluating technical data protection programs within large, complex organizations.
  • Deep technical expertise in data protection, including cryptography (encryption at rest and in transit, PKI), DLP tools (network, endpoint, cloud), CASB technologies and SQL/NoSQL databases.
  • Extensive knowledge of security technology and risk assessment methodologies, policies and processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical decision-makers (e.g., governance committees, business units, legal teams).
  • Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with compliance programs as well as their technical and security requirements.
  • Technical expertise across key domains:
    • Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, NIST SP 800-53 / 800-161, COBIT and ITIL.
    • Cloud and Web Architecture Security: Solid understanding of web infrastructure and cloud environment security.
    • Network and Security Technologies: Thorough understanding of network architectures (LAN/WAN, routers), network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, DNS, web filtering) and cryptographic principles (encryption at rest and in transit).
    • Architecture and Data Security: Working knowledge of database architecture concepts and secure software development best practices.
    • Operational Resilience and Physical Security: Solid understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning (BCP/DRP), operational resilience and physical security controls.
  • Relevant professional security certifications a definite asset (e.g., CISSP, CRISC, CBCP, CISA, CISM or equivalent).
  • Bilingualism (English and French) essential.
