Role:


Reporting to the Manager, Budgeting & Internal Reporting, the Financial Analyst serves as the primary subject matter expert for managers and staff, providing guidance on the interpretation and application of administrative, financial and human resources policies. In this role, you provide critical support to the Productions leadership team, specifically in the following areas:


  • Financial planning, budgeting and forecasting.
  • Management report preparation.

You also perform rigorous financial research and analysis to ensure compliance with established accounting policies and practices. Additionally, you provide administrative and financial support to the division’s Manager and Director.

Key Responsibilities:

Budget Management and Oversight


  • Lead the end-to-end budgeting process, including monthly performance tracking.
  • Play an active role in developing and preparing monthly budget forecasts.
  • Support divisional budget management through detailed analysis, cost estimations and targeted tracking of resources and production costs.
  • Assist in the auditing, recording and reconciliation of accounts for the revised annual budget across relevant departments.

Financial Analysis and Reporting


  • Prepare and analyze the department’s financial position while ensuring data integrity.
  • Develop financial reports, tables and analytical tools, providing insightful commentary on results.
  • Identify significant variances, gather input from various business areas and draft preliminary performance analyses.
  • Produce the management reports required to evaluate departmental budgetary performance.
  • Conduct ad hoc financial research and analysis as required.

Accounting Operations and Compliance


  • Oversee daily financial operations, ensuring precise data entry so that recorded expenses accurately reflect operational realities.
  • Manage the allocation of labour costs to specific productions and projects.
  • Prepare journal entries for approval.
  • Interpret and apply recognized accounting standards, policies, methods and practices, ensuring alignment with auditor recommendations.

Support and Administration


  • Provide daily support to production teams regarding policy compliance and budget queries.
  • Investigate and resolve administrative discrepancies.
  • Authorize fees and payments.
  • Provide direct assistance to the Manager or Director on ad hoc projects.

What You Bring:

Required Qualifications


  • University degree in accounting or equivalent.
  • Minimum two years’ relevant experience in a similar financial role.
  • Professional accounting designation (CPA) or currently enrolled in a CPA certification program.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and the MS Office Suite.

Required Skills


  • In-depth knowledge of general accounting principles.
  • Excellent communication skills in French (both spoken and written).
  • Proven ability to organize and prioritize effectively.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure.
  • Sound judgment and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset.
  • Highly adaptable with a proactive approach to organizational change.

Nice-to-Haves:


  • Experience with management information systems such as SAP, BW, TM1 or Oracle.
  • Proficiency in English.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

Senior Writer  CBC Money, Multiple Locations (English Services) (On-Site)-Vancouver

CBC News is expanding its financial and consumer storytelling to help Canadians navigate complex economic realities. Affordability remains top of mind for most Canadians. Purchasing power is being squeezed by inflation and tariff policies. Young people are struggling to land that first job at a time when artificial intelligence and technology are changing the workforce. Canadians are faced with a myriad of complex economic realities.


We’re looking for people who are excited to show up to work knowing anything can happen on their watch, thrives when news breaks, and have a keen interest in the way money and the economy shapes the lives of Canadians.


On the business beat, you will focus on the intersection of money and everyday life. This means looking beyond the market and financial headlines to break down and bring home complex economic stories.

You will actively track economic, corporate, consumer and policy shifts both nationally and in your region with the goal of helping Canadians understand the financial and money forces that are affecting their lives.


Your task would be to break news and build a pipeline of memorable original stories. You'll experiment with various formats and platforms, from graphics and social media to radio and TV. You’ll have the voice and reporting chops to explain business news and bring to life economic stories.


Data excites you. You use charts, graphs and explainers to provide clarity and context in our storytelling. This role emphasizes mobile-first and vertical video storytelling tailored to reach younger, diverse, and underserved audiences where they consume media.


Key Tasks:

  • Consistently pitches original ideas in line with the unit’s mandate and objectives.
  • Cover stories of regional and national importance, including gathering, writing, vetting, and presenting for all audio, visual, and digital platforms.
  • Maintain a base of sources that allow you to lead on key stories in your region or a beat, including economic experts, business leaders, and voices from underserved communities
  • Participates in all aspects of the production; and brings a willingness to appear on camera for production shoots, as required.
  • Experience writing short-form and vertical video for presentation on mobile and streaming platforms that describes complex business, financial and consumer information in a clear and concise manner.
  • Pivot to breaking news and quickly turnaround stories in a way that enhances the understanding of the audience.
  • Work with the CBC Money team across the country to deliver the stories Canadians need to understand the economy and how it affects them.
  • That will include collaboration and editing the work of others.
  • As a subject matter expert on business, financial and consumer trends and issue, you will describe these issues and events in a clear and concise manner and provide detailed analysis to enhance the understanding for our audience.
  • Your Profile

We are looking for a candidate with the following:

  • A minimum of five years of relevant journalism experience including vertical and short-form visual storytelling.
  • Able to analyze complex data focused on business, economics, and money
  • Solid journalistic skills, including an understanding of legal risk, and demonstrated understanding of CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices.
  • Able to work with experienced producers and hosts to develop and produce high-impact short-form and vertical video under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent research, writing and editing skills.
  • Able to keep track of a number of simultaneous activities and prioritize and plan.
  • Able to communicate both verbally and in writing clearly and concisely.
  • Must be available for flexible work hours, that could include overtime, early mornings, evenings and weekends.

About the First Peoples Program


The First Peoples: Tell Us a Story initiative is a specialized professional development program designed to build bridges between First Peoples and Radio-Canada. It aims to amplify Indigenous voices in the media while nurturing lasting, reciprocal relationships with Indigenous communities.


Building on the success of its 2025 pilot, the initiative returns this year with a redesigned format. This paid training opportunity has been expanded to eight (8) weeks and will focus on the craft of storytelling. Throughout the program, you will hone your skills through hands-on workshops led by both Indigenous and non-Indigenous media professionals. You will also have a dedicated platform to share your stories, showcase your culture, language and lived experiences, and highlight your community's achievements.


We are looking for four (4) individuals from First Nations, Inuit or Métis communities ready to take the next step in their media careers.


The program runs full time for eight (8) weeks, from February 1st to March 26, 2027. Full-time availability, Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (ET) for the entire eight-week program is mandatory.


This program is in hybrid mode (remote work with required travel to Montreal and a regional station).


Candidates must meet the following eligibility requirements:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Self-identify as First Nations, Inuit or Métis.
  • Be available full time for the duration of the program (February 1st to March 26, 2027).
  • Be willing and able to travel for three (3) separate five-day sessions during the eight (8) weeks (travel and accommodation expenses are fully covered by Radio-Canada).
  • Be able to work and communicate in French (reading, writing and speaking). 

Who You Are:

  • You have a working proficiency in French across speaking, reading and writing. 
  • You have a genuine curiosity about news and current affairs, paired with a passion for storytelling.
  • You have an open, collaborative attitude.
  • You are eager to learn new things.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace tools is an asset.

Program Overview:

As part of this second cohort, you will complete an eight-week learning curriculum running from February 1st to March 26, 2027.


The program includes the following:

  • Orientation and Onboarding: Settle into the cohort and preview your training plan through a combination of virtual sessions and in-person activities in Montreal. 
  • Theory Instruction (Three (3) weeks, Virtual): Build foundational journalism skills across digital writing, audio/radio storytelling and video production, culminating in one (1) to three (3) portfolio-ready pieces. 
  • Regional Station Placement: Shadow and work alongside Radio-Canada journalists at a regional station to experience the day-to-day rhythm of an active newsroom.
  • Professional Development (Virtual): Take part in sessions designed to support your learning and development. 
  • Closing Week (Montreal): Wrap up the program alongside your peers with a final week of hands-on activities. 

Workplace and Technical Requirements :

The theory instruction will take place primarily online; however, you must be available to travel to Montreal and to a regional station during designated periods. All required travel and accommodation expenses are fully covered by Radio-Canada.


Please note:

  • You must have access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection.
  • You must have access to a desktop computer, laptop or iPad Pro. 
  • Any specialized production gear required for your training modules will be provided by Radio-Canada for the duration of the program. 

Full-time availability for the entire eight-week program is mandatory.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Role

 

Using a variety of methods, you will provide real-time and prerecorded captioning for deaf or hard of hearing viewers in line with CBC/Radio-Canada standards and policies.

 

Description of Duties

  • Use voice recognition software to paraphrase, summarize and revoice the audio content of programs or program segments in real time.
  • Switch captioning sources for live presentation. Report any issues with caption presentation to broadcast and technical maintenance staff.
  • Create and maintain a personal voice profile within the voice recognition software.
  • Adapt dialogue to the language of broadcast in line with closed-captioning standards.
  • Report errors and technical issues.
  • Share technical expertise and best practices with other respeakers.
  • Assist in development of work tools.
  • Assure la mise à jour de son dictionnaire;
  • Research programs or program segments scheduled for real-time and prerecorded captioning to ensure accuracy.
  • Train other employees on captioning duties and techniques, providing them with all relevant information.
  • Perform captioner duties.
  • Carry out all other related tasks as required.

 

Job Requirements

 

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

 

Experience:

  • Three years’ relevant experience, including at least two in a captioning role.

 

Skills:

  • Solid command of French (working language).
  • Strong computer proficiency.
  • Knowledge of the other official language.
  • Wide general knowledge.
  • Knowledge of current events.

 

Selected candidates will be tested as follows:

  • French test.
  • Speech recognition test.
  • Interview.

CBC News is expanding its financial and consumer storytelling to help Canadians navigate complex economic realities. Affordability remains top of mind for most Canadians. Young people are struggling to land that first job at a time when artificial intelligence and technology are changing the workforce. Canadians are faced with a myriad of complex economic realities.


We’re looking for people who are excited to show up to work knowing anything can happen on their watch, thrives when news breaks, and have a keen interest in the way money and the economy shapes the lives of Canadians. 


On the business beat, you will focus on the intersection of money and everyday life. This means looking beyond the market and financial headlines to break down and bring home complex economic stories.  You will actively track economic, corporate, consumer and policy shifts both nationally and in your region with the goal of helping Canadians understand the financial and money forces that are affecting their lives.


Your task would be to break news and build a pipeline of memorable original stories. 

You'll experiment with various formats and platforms, from graphics and social media to radio and TV. You’ll have the voice and reporting chops to explain business news and bring to life economic stories.


Data excites you. You use charts, graphs and explainers to provide clarity and context in our storytelling. This role emphasizes mobile-first and vertical video storytelling tailored to reach younger, diverse, and underserved audiences where they consume media. 


Key Tasks:


  • Consistently pitches original ideas in line with the unit’s mandate and objectives. 
  • Cover stories of regional and national importance, including gathering, writing, vetting, and presenting for all audio, visual, and digital platforms.
  • Maintain a base of sources that allow you to lead on key stories in your region or a beat, including economic experts, business leaders, and voices from underserved communities
  • Participates in all aspects of the production; and brings a willingness to appear on camera for production shoots, as required.
  • Experience writing short-form and vertical video for presentation on mobile and streaming platforms that describes complex business, financial and consumer information in a clear and concise manner.
  • Pivot to breaking news and quickly turnaround stories in a way that enhances the understanding of the audience.
  • Work with the CBC Money team across the country to deliver the stories Canadians need to understand the economy and how it affects them. 
  • That will include collaboration and editing the work of others.
  • As a subject matter expert on business, financial and consumer trends and issue, you will describe these issues and events in a clear and concise manner and provide detailed analysis to enhance the understanding for our audience.

We are looking for a candidate with the following:


  • A minimum of five years of relevant journalism experience including vertical and short-form visual storytelling.
  • Able to analyze complex data focused on business, economics, and money
  • Solid journalistic skills, including an understanding of legal risk, and demonstrated understanding of CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices.
  • Able to work with experienced producers and hosts to develop and produce high-impact short-form and vertical video under tight deadlines.

We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Your Role

 

As a key member of the Real Estate Transactions team, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, actively supporting the Corporate Director on complex, high-value transactions and strategic initiatives. You will lead a team of two, oversee lease administration, manage critical reporting and maintain strict data integrity and thorough documentation.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead portfolio development and leasing strategies to meet the operational needs of internal business partners.
  • Maintain strong, long-term relationships with real estate brokers to ensure they thoroughly understand CBC/Radio-Canada’s specific portfolio needs.
  • Negotiate the terms of real estate agreements, including leases, letters of intent or agreement, amendments, renewals and assignments.
  • Partner with the Corporate Director of Real Estate Transactions to streamline internal governance and approval workflows, from financial analysis through to executive sign-off.
  • Provide strategic advice to, and maintain strong working relationships with, national and regional management.
  • Collaborate with business partners to develop and maintain annual, three-year and five-year strategic plans.
  • Help align the objectives of the Real Estate Transactions department with broader corporate strategy.
  • Ensure all real estate transactions target optimal locations and deliver the strongest financial value.
  • Establish annual leasing assumptions and model rent payable and receivable for a portfolio of over 200 leases.
  • Provide the lease management team (BGIS) with the leasing assumptions needed to prepare operating budgets for the managed portfolio.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, real estate or a related field.

 

Experience: Minimum 10 years’ experience in commercial real estate leasing and transactions.

 

Core Competencies

  • Strong commercial lease and contract negotiation skills.
  • Advanced financial analysis capabilities.
  • Demonstrated track record of taking ownership of complex projects and executing them with precision.

 

Software and Tool Proficiency

  • Strong proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (advanced Excel formulas and pivot tables, Word, PowerPoint), Adobe Acrobat and Google Workspace.
  • Demonstrated aptitude in database administration, web platform/microsite maintenance and data governance.
  • Familiarity with commercial real estate property management and accounting software an asset.

 

Organizational Skills and Autonomy: Strong initiative and a proven ability to work independently with minimal direction; highly methodical, organized and detail-oriented, with the demonstrated capacity to manage competing priorities simultaneously under tight deadlines.

 

Interpersonal Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (executives, Legal, Finance, Risk Management, and business units) and external service providers.

Working Conditions: Frequent travel across Canada, often requiring flexible or extended hours.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This role requires full-time on-site presence.

 

Please note that this posting is for two positions.


Your role

 

This technician will be mainly assigned to the MPC Operation in the Toronto Broadcast Centre. The primary function will be to oversee the playback of Digital, Radio and TV signals through an automated system to the Canadian public.

 

Based on established requirements, perform tasks needed for the efficient and accurate presentation of digital, radio or television material for programs or events. Creative problem-solving may be required during presentation. Work is generally performed according to accepted CBC or industry standards, but independent action, judgment and initiative are also needed to solve operational issues. When directions or requirements are not clear, contact staff concerned for clarification, or use independent judgment under severe time constraints. Signal problems or imperfections clearly and promptly to the relevant authority.

 

Key Duties:

  • Perform presentation operations for Digital, Radio and TV programs.
  • Perform necessary checks, adjustments and alignments in accordance with standard procedures to ensure technical equipment remains in good working order.
  • Monitor and control signals, ensuring adherence to approved technical standards, and take appropriate action if quality is below standard. Report errors, imperfections and gaps.
  • Operate, program, and keep in good working order all complex presentation systems.
  • Keep equipment, applications and technical devices in a suitable state and available for use by ensuring they remain in good working condition.
  • Oversee the distribution of complex, fast-paced live news and current affairs programs, using studio or location signals, coping with programming changes, multiple or unknown sources and other elements on an ongoing basis.
  • In the absence of supervisors or management, assist broadcasting staff in solving problems.
  • Direct and coordinate the work of other staff assigned to prepare, set up, install and operate equipment. Help train co-workers.
  • Advise partners on technical operations needs and requirements related to equipment and facilities.
  • Perform, in whole or in part, the functions or duties of an equivalent or lower classification.

 

We are looking for a candidate with the following:

  • Willing to work a variety of shifts in an on-site 24/7 operation, including weekends and holidays.
  • Overall general knowledge of Digital streaming, Radio and TV program production, delivery and presentation methods, including a basic understanding of production crafts. Knowledge generally gained through college studies or equivalent relevant experience in TV/radio broadcasting.
  • Directly related experience, including one year as a broadcast technician.
  • Functional bilingualism (English and French) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of the Digital, Radio and TV server environment is a major asset.
  • Knowledge of Avid, Dalet+, iNews applications, and Windows OS.
  • Able to program complex automated presentation systems.
  • Good knowledge of TV and Radio control rooms is an asset.
  • Knowledge of communication networks and audio hookups.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Must have high availability and be accountable for the smooth presentation of programs.
  • Must demonstrate creativity in finding solutions rapidly.
  • Able to perform assigned duties effectively under tight deadlines, producing quality work and maintaining a positive, professional attitude.
  • Able to rise quickly and effectively to challenges in the work environment.
  • Able to get organized quickly.
  • Excellent communicator.
  • Able to analyze a situation and make decisions efficiently and rapidly, also communicating them effectively.

job.title: Broadcast Network Monitoring Operator
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Technology

Work Status: Full-Time (on-site)

Location: Toronto - Corus Quay

About the Role:

Corus Entertainment is seeking a dynamic and innovative professional to join the Broadcast Operations team at our Toronto location as a Broadcast Network Monitoring Operator.

Reporting to the Lead, Broadcast Network Monitoring, the Broadcast Network Monitoring Operator is part of team that ensures Corus’ broadcast signals are present for over-the-air (OTA) and cable/satellite (BDU) viewers across the country and maintains revenue by ensuring simultaneous substitutions with US networks are in place. The BNM team is also the communication hub for the internal network connecting all of Corus’ news production centres together. The team works extensively with various internal departments and external clients, maintaining a high level of customer service while meeting strict deadlines in a 24/7/365 signal monitoring environment.

You will contribute by:

• Monitor all return broadcast signals originating from Corus for quality, signal integrity, and regulatory compliance and escalate internally and externally accordingly

• Monitor network connectivity and performance within the Corus broadcast and news production footprint and escalate internally accordingly

• Confirm simultaneous substitutions of US network content and communicate information and issues to BDUs in a professional and timely manner

• Accurately create and compile reports detailing issues with broadcast signals, Corus’ network, and simultaneous substitutions

• Perform first-level checks and basic troubleshooting on IP-based broadcast systems such as encoders, decoders, switches and SD-WAN devices

• Help track daily network performance metrics for uptime, stream stability, and error rates

• Gain a firm understanding of broadcast operations technology, workflows and networks to troubleshoot, solve and escalate issues

• Follow existing departmental procedures, workflows, and documentation

• Provide updates and support in a 24/7/365 broadcast and news environment for Corus’ network and all broadcast signals originating from Corus

• Stay current with equipment, workflows and procedural changes required to perform tasks

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Diploma or degree in broadcasting, communications, IT, media or other technology fields or equivalent experience

• Basic knowledge of IP networking (IP addressing, multicast, latency, jitters, bandwidth) and comfort working with network monitoring tools

• A good understanding of video/audio technical standards, cable TV, OTA, satellite (DTH) and IPTV distribution platforms in order to troubleshoot and escalate signal problems

• Experience with broadcast transmission chains, networks, video platforms and associated systems

• Proficiency in computer skills – Microsoft Office suite and other integrated applications and communication tools

• Must be adaptable, able to multi-task and work with acute attention to detail

• Communicate in a positive, friendly manner and with a customer service approach

• Ability to handle challenging situations with professionalism, empathy and sincerity

• Able to work a flexible schedule that includes evenings, overnights and weekends

• Fluency in French is an asset

Operate and troubleshoot radio equipment used in the course of the production of a live or recorded broadcast.

Technical perfection and flawless execution of control board and equipment to regulate the volume and sound quality during radio broadcasts.

Observe monitors and manage outgoing audio and sounds levels.

Follow program log.

Monitor all systems and make sure they are all running on schedule. Note any issues or concerns on log.

Monitor and update severe weather forecasts.

When required, go on-air to report on life-threatening or emergency situations until further support arrives.

Record, edit or play back any sound requested from broadcasts.

Voice and produce news stories/features as requested/needed.

Answer phone calls during shift and screen calls.

Monitor automation, transmitter controls, which includes pattern/tower changes and record required readings.

Assess emergency situations for the station, and make decisions on when to call for additional support.

Knowledgeable of, and applies as needed, all current FCC rules and regulations.

Report to work on time and work established schedule/hours. Ability to work other hours or alternate schedules as needed, as assigned or requested by Program Director with little or no notice. Such alternate/additional work can include weekdays, evenings and weekends.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

High School diploma, GED or equivalent required, with a minimum one (1) year experience running a radio board preferred; or a combination of education and work experience to perform the essential functions of the job.

Must be able to respond and work well in a crisis and handle last minute and unexpected changes during work shift.

Be able to communicate quickly and clearly to co-workers and others as needed.

Ability to hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction.

Ability to think critically and quickly and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others.

Ability to think spontaneously and ad lib while on air in a coherent manner in situations that can change quickly.

Ability to learn automation systems.

Knowledge of transmission, broadcasting, switching, control, and operation of telecommunications systems.

Project a professional appearance and demeanor.

Ability to work in compliance with company and FCC policies and procedures.

Multi-task with a variety of duties while running the board.

Must be flexible and able to deal with unexpected changes calmly.

Able to make decisions and judgments quickly.

Follow directions well, especially over the phone.

Work well under pressure.

Available to work with short notice including early mornings, late evenings and weekends.

Ability to work established schedule and other hours as needed.

Physical Requirements: Ability to communicate in English, both verbally and in writing. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and board controls as well as general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.) for extended periods of time. Wear headsets and be confined to a specific space during the course of work. Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. Average pushing, pulling, bending, stooping and reaching over head. The Company may make reasonable accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job functions.

What We Need:

iHeartMedia is looking for a strategic, creative, and highly independent Senior Manager to join our Digital Media Strategy & Planning team. In this role, you’ll help shape innovative digital campaigns that span streaming audio, podcasts, social platforms, and live events positioning iHeartMedia as the leading force in digital audio and entertainment.

You’ll serve as a key strategic partner to the sales organization, leading RFP responses, driving creative ideation, and crafting compelling narratives that bring our capabilities to life. You’ll be expected to work independently, navigate complex internal systems and business rules, and proactively escalate issues when necessary, articulating challenges and solutions with clarity and confidence.

The ideal candidate role will have a strong understanding of the digital landscape including fast growing platforms like social, emerging platforms (i.e. connected devices, OTT) and podcasting. We’re looking for a digital expert that can craft compelling stories for clients as well as determine effective media strategies. They will be self-starters with polished written and oral communication skills to effectively communicate their ideas coupled and analytical skills to accurately translate those ideas into media plans. Collaboration is key as they will be working with Go to Market, Sales, Packaging, Research, Creative Services and Product Teams.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Lead the strategic development of digital media plans in response to RFPs across streaming, podcasting, social, and live experiences
  • Own the creation and writing of presentation decks, translating strategy and insights into clear, persuasive storytelling
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, research, and inventory teams to bring fully integrated programs to market
  • Bring forward creative, insight-driven ideas that connect advertiser objectives to iHeartMedia’s unique assets
  • Interpret and apply internal business rules to ensure compliant, feasible proposals
  • Operate independently to manage timelines, solve problems, and escalate challenges when needed—clearly articulating complex situations to cross-functional partners
  • Leverage post-sale performance data and insights to inform and enhance future campaign planning
  • Work within planning and inventory systems to confirm campaign viability and availability

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • 4–5 years of experience in digital media planning, integrated strategy, or a related field
  • A strong balance of strategic and creative thinking with a passion for storytelling and campaign ideation
  • Proven ability to manage projects independently, with sound judgment and strong attention to detail
  • Deep understanding of internal processes, pricing structures, and the ability to apply and uphold business rules
  • Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to distill and present complex ideas clearly
  • Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel (or Google Slides/Sheets)
  • Highly organized, deadline-driven, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • A collaborative mindset with professional maturity and the confidence to lead and influence

job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Consumer Reporter - WSB TV

 

Position Overview

WSB TV Channel 2, the #1 television station in Atlanta, Georgia is looking for an energetic, creative and enterprising Consumer Reporter who can help viewers save money, make smarter decisions and avoid costly mistakes. The reporter will create timely, useful stories about shopping, products, scams, technology, travel, housing, automobiles, insurance, utilities and the everyday cost of living. The goal is simple: give viewers information they can use.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop original daily and weekly consumer stories focused on saving viewers money and helping them make informed decisions.
  • Write news stories that are clear, accurate and unbiased.
  • Cover the cost of living in metro Atlanta, including groceries, housing, utilities, insurance, transportation and recurring household expenses.
  • Compare products, services, apps and technology, clearly showing viewers what is worth the money.
  • Alert audience to spam calls, fraudulent texts and emails, identity theft, online fraud and emerging scams, with clear steps viewers can take to protect themselves.
  • Identify hidden fees, unwanted subscriptions, seasonal savings and practical ways to lower monthly bills.
  • Use real Atlanta consumers, documented prices and clear demonstrations to make stories useful, visual and relatable.
  • Create compelling coverage for television, streaming, digital and social platforms, and contribute to breaking news by identifying the consumer impact.
  • Utilize all platforms including broadcast, social, digital to inform our audience using a variety of storytelling formats like broadcast pkgs, vertical videos, social posts, web stories.
  • Ability to narrate, ad-lib and add value to live breaking news and severe weather coverage.
  • Thorough understanding of social media and demonstrated ability to move audience between all platforms.
  • Ability to cover live events for all platforms, including live breaking news and station initiatives.
  • Collaborate with consumer investigator and investigative team
  • Carry out daily reporter duties and assist with station coverage needs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently produces original stories that save viewers money or help them avoid costly mistakes.
  • Builds on a recognizable and trusted consumer franchise for WSB-TV.
  • Translates complicated issues into clear, accurate and actionable information.
  • Creates stories viewers talk about, search for and share across platforms.

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least three years of professional television reporting experience.
  • Strong writing, storytelling, interviewing, live-reporting and on-camera presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently generate relevant, original story ideas.
  • Strong understanding of social media, digital video and multiplatform storytelling.
  • Ability to demonstrate products, technology and consumer concepts naturally on camera.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred.

job.title: News Reporter/Anchor
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The news team at FOX 26 and FOX Local Houston is transforming how local news is gathered and delivered. We no longer wait for appointed times to deliver content. We're a 24/7 STREAMING FIRST news organization.

As we continue to evolve, we’re hiring a News Reporter/Anchor for our evening news block. The person chosen for this role will bring the passion and skillset to create and deliver live and unscripted content across streaming programs and platforms, digital news sites, social media and on linear TV.


You’ll focus on reporting big news of the day, adding depth and context to stories in our newly formatted early evening news block from 5:00-6:30pm. Then you’ll transition to our redesigned newsroom, where you’ll anchor 90 minutes of live, unscripted news, while operating our Tricaster switcher. You’ll end your day, anchoring our 10pm linear news broadcast from our primary studio.


Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A streaming and digital-first mindset, that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs. You’re as comfortable and skilled delivering unscripted content as you are with a teleprompter. You bring the same enthusiasm to your delivery and on-air performance regardless of format, studio environment or platform.
  • You ditched the “anchor voice” long ago and you’ve mastered a more authentic style of delivery that doesn’t rely on a teleprompter.  We don’t use teleprompters in our streaming news programs.
  • You have experience and skill anchoring continuous live breaking news events and severe weather such as hurricanes, tornado outbreaks and winter storm coverage. This experience and skill are evident on your reel.
  • You’ve spent a minimum of 3-5 years in the field as a news reporter, covering big news stories, honing your journalism, polishing your on-air performance and proving that the best anchors have built a reputation as aggressive, successful reporters.
  • You have an insatiable curiosity about the world around you, from local and state government and how decisions by elected officials impact our audience to a daily understanding of what’s happening globally and the ability to take complex subjects and make them compelling and relatable.
  • You have experience field anchoring big news, demonstrating a range of skills from hard news and politics to sports and community events.
  • You are a leader in the newsroom, with a demonstrated track record of mentoring younger reporters, helping them become better storytellers and writers.
  • You are an engaged copy editor, carefully reviewing and signing off on scripts before they go on air. You provide constructive feedback and actively participate in the editorial process.
  • You have a relentless commitment to accuracy in your reporting, whether scripted or unscripted. You have impeccable journalistic ethics and integrity. You can spot problematic copy, flag stories that need more vetting, unearth biased narratives and make sound decisions under deadline pressure.
  • You’ve already created a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.  Your content is rooted in news, not selfies and vacation photos.

You must have significant experience as an anchor, on top of 3-5 year of experience as a reporter in a professional news operation. Candidates who have experience hosting unscripted, live news streaming programs will move up the list. This is not an entry-level position or a position for candidates who do not possess a journalism background. 


We’re a 24/7 news operation, so you must be able to work non-traditional hours, weekends and holidays as needed.

  • Commitment to accurate, fair and ethical journalism
  • Strong news judgment and understanding of audience interests
  • Excellent writing and editing skills with experience writing full articles
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong spelling, grammar, fact-checking and copy editing skills 
  • Ability to write compelling headlines and social copy to drive engagement without clickbait
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills within a newsroom environment

    • Work closely with Engineering, News, Production, Sales, and other departments to identify technology requirements and resolve operational issues.

    • Read and interpret technical documentation, network diagrams, equipment manuals, and basic schematic drawings.
    • Assist vendors and other technical personnel with troubleshooting, installation, upgrades, and system maintenance.

    • Respond to system outages and critical technology issues when required.

  • Required Skills and Experience
      • Strong hands-on hardware troubleshooting and break/fix skills.
      • Strong Windows desktop and end-user support experience.
      • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 / Office 365.
      • Experience supporting Microsoft Windows environments.
      • Experience with Microsoft Intune and on-premises Active Directory.
      • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Ethernet, and network troubleshooting.
      • Ability to troubleshoot problems methodically.
      • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
      • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
      • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
      • Ability to prioritize multiple technical issues in a fast-paced operational environment.
      • Ability to independently research problems, learn unfamiliar technologies, and work with vendors or other technical resources when necessary.
      • Ability to safely lift, carry, move, and position equipment weighing 50 pounds or more as required.

 

Preferred Technical Qualifications

  • Industry certifications are strongly preferred and may include:
    • CompTIA A+
    • CompTIA Network+
    • CompTIA Server+
    • Microsoft certifications related to Microsoft 365, Windows, Endpoint Management, Intune, Azure, or related technologies
    • Cisco certifications or equivalent Cisco networking experience
    • Equivalent hands-on professional experience may be considered in place of certifications.

 

  • Additional preferred experience includes:
    • Microsoft Intune
    • Active Directory
    • Windows Server
    • Microsoft 365 administration
    • Webex Calling / cloud-based VoIP
    • Cisco IOS switching
    • Juniper networking environments
    • Virtualization technologies
    • Server and storage hardware
    • IT service management / ticketing platforms
    • Familiarity with OBS Studio and/or vMix

 

Broadcast Technology Experience

Previous experience in television broadcasting, broadcast engineering, media production, newsroom technology, or similar environments is considered a plus.

Candidates are not required to be experienced broadcast engineers. A strong IT professional who has solid troubleshooting skills, understands networks and computer systems, and is willing to learn specialized broadcast technologies may be successful in this position.

Experience with broadcast automation, routing, storage, newsroom, editing, production, or related broadcast systems is beneficial.

 

Education and Experience

A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required.

Relevant technical certifications, military technical experience, vocational training, or demonstrated professional IT experience may substitute for formal education.

Approximately 3–5 years of hands-on IT support, systems support, network support, or related technical experience is preferred.

Experience within a television station, broadcast facility, media organization, or other 24/7 operational environment is a plus.

 

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be someone who enjoys hands-on troubleshooting and is comfortable working across a broad range of technologies.

A strong troubleshooting mindset, willingness to learn, good communication skills, and a “can do” attitude are more important than being an expert in every technology used within the facility.

job.title: Service Desk Supervisor

Process Improvement, Automation & Documentation

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KSTU
job.description:
News is changing, and we’re looking for journalists who want to help shape what comes next. At KSTU Fox 13, an E.W. Scripps station, you’ll do more than report the news. You’ll help reimagine how stories are discovered, told, and experienced across every platform.


As a Multimedia Journalist, you’ll be part of a newsroom that believes local journalism can spark conversation, strengthen communities, and make a real difference. If you’re energized by breaking news, meaningful storytelling, and the opportunity to connect with one of the nation’s rapidly growing communities, this is your chance to be part of something bigger.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize materials and write stories according to editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit or assist in editing videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on TV in live or pre-recorded situations.
  • Work cooperatively with photographers assigned to stories, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscasts.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multimedia stories.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in a related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on non-linear systems
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company-required insurance limits

OUR TEAM:

You’ll join a newsroom filled with curious, creative people who believe great journalism starts with understanding the community we serve. Our team brings different perspectives, backgrounds, interests, and experiences to the table, united by a shared drive to tell stories that matter. Whether you thrive on breaking news, unforgettable characters, accountability reporting, or finding the story everyone else overlooked, there’s room here to make your mark.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Salt Lake City gives you the rare chance to pursue ambitious journalism in a place where adventure is practically part of the commute. The Wasatch Mountains rise just outside the city, putting legendary skiing, hiking, biking, and mountain landscapes within easy reach, while Utah’s red rock country and five national parks make weekend road trips hard to beat.

Beyond the outdoors, Salt Lake City offers a vibrant mix of neighborhoods, restaurants, arts, culture, sports, and a thriving tech scene. It’s a place where your career can grow alongside the community you cover, with no shortage of people to meet, places to explore, or stories waiting to be told.

job.title: Category Growth & Business Development Manager - Remote
job.description:
Are you a category-savvy sales strategist who thrives at the intersection of market intelligence and revenue growth? Operations Shared Services, part of The E.W. Scripps Company, is looking for a Category Growth & Business Development Manager to accelerate revenue across Scripps local television markets by serving as a go-to expert in priority advertising industries.

In this role, you'll partner directly with local sales leadership and account executives across the country, bringing category expertise, hands-on sales support and strategic vision to integrated linear and digital advertising opportunities. Your work will shape how Scripps competes and wins in key categories like automotive, legal and healthcare, making a measurable impact on markets from coast to coast.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop and execute division-wide growth strategies for priority business categories, including automotive, legal, healthcare and others identified by the organization.
  • Serve as the subject-matter expert for assigned categories by monitoring advertiser business models, customer-acquisition strategies, consumer behavior, competitive conditions, regulatory considerations, advertising trends and emerging marketing technologies.
  • Partner with local sales managers and account executives to identify high-potential prospects and revenue-growth opportunities across Scripps markets.
  • Participate directly in the sales process by supporting prospecting, discovery, needs analysis, solution development, proposals, presentations and negotiations, and assist in closing new business and expanding existing advertiser relationships through integrated linear and digital solutions.
  • Create scalable, category-specific sales strategies, prospecting approaches, discovery questions, presentations, case studies and other resources for consistent use by local teams.
  • Translate advertiser needs, audience insights, market research, performance data and industry trends into compelling marketing recommendations, and communicate actionable guidance to local sales teams, sales leadership and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop and deliver ongoing training, coaching and sales tactics that improve category knowledge, prospecting effectiveness, advertiser conversations, solution development and closing performance.
  • Join local sales representatives and leaders in advertiser and agency meetings to provide category expertise and advance priority opportunities.
  • Build relationships with key advertisers, agencies, industry associations and strategic partners that generate opportunities across multiple Scripps markets.
  • Collaborate with digital sales, research, marketing, creative, revenue operations and campaign execution teams to ensure solutions are strategically sound, executable, scalable and positioned to produce measurable advertiser outcomes.
  • Support campaign reviews, performance discussions, renewal strategies and upsell recommendations to improve advertiser retention and grow existing business.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity, pipeline, activity, billing and forecast information in applicable CRM and reporting systems.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience.
  • Generally, 8+ years of experience in related field preferred.
  • Valid driver's license and good driving record required. In addition, proof of insurance and liability coverage may be required.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated success developing new business, closing complex opportunities and growing revenue from existing advertiser relationships.
  • Expertise in selling or supporting integrated linear television and digital advertising solutions strongly preferred.
  • Understanding of automotive, legal, healthcare or other high-value local advertising categories preferred.
  • Skilled in supporting sales teams across multiple markets or geographic regions preferred.
  • Adept at delivering sales training, coaching, presentations or category-specific enablement preferred.
  • Strong understanding of category-based selling, consultative sales practices, advertiser needs analysis and solution development.
  • Superior knowledge of linear television advertising and digital marketing products, strategies, performance measures and emerging capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence sales outcomes and lead cross-functional initiatives without direct reporting authority.
  • Ability to establish credibility and build productive relationships with local sales leaders, account executives, corporate partners, advertisers and agencies.
  • Strong coaching and facilitation skills, with the ability to improve sales performance through practical guidance, field support and category expertise.
  • Ability to convert industry research, audience insights, performance data and advertiser information into practical sales strategies and compelling proposals.
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to manage revenue goals, forecasts, pipelines and performance reporting.
  • Highly organized, self-motivated and goal-focused, with the ability to manage multiple categories, markets and sales opportunities simultaneously.
  • Ability to balance strategic planning with direct, hands-on participation in advertiser opportunities.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms, sales-reporting tools, Microsoft Office applications and virtual collaboration platforms.

job.title: Multimedia Managing Editor, KJRH
job.description:
KJRH, the NBC affiliate in Tulsa, Oklahoma, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is creating a new role for a new era of local news. We're looking for a newsroom leader who understands that today's audience expects news wherever they are, whether that's on a streaming channel, a phone, social media, or television. You'll be at the center of our operation, helping drive a 24/7 news stream while making sure the newsroom stays connected, informed, and focused on the stories that matter most. This role is part coach, part editor, part conductor. You'll help reporters and MMJs tell stronger stories, make smart decisions in the moment, and find creative ways to connect our journalism with the communities we serve.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Lead the daily execution of KRJH's 24/7 streaming news channel, ensuring a constant flow of relevant, timely, and engaging content.
  • Serve as the central hub for information entering and leaving the newsroom, helping teams stay aligned on priorities and coverage plans.
  • Coach and develop reporters, MMJs, and content creators to elevate storytelling across all platforms.
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership to execute audience-focused content strategies that deliver meaningful community impact.
  • Oversee story writing, editing, and publishing workflows across broadcast, digital, social, and streaming platforms.
  • Provide timely and constructive feedback that drives continuous growth and stronger journalistic performance.
  • Develop and refine newsroom processes that improve efficiency, communication, and content execution.
  • Ensure all content meets the highest standards of journalistic ethics, editorial judgment, accuracy, and fairness.
  • Inspire trust and collaboration among reporters, photographers, producers, and newsroom staff.
  • Contribute to breaking news coverage and provide multi-platform reporting or on-air support when needed.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Seven or more years of newsroom, content leadership, digital media, streaming, or related experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading editorial decision-making and managing content workflows in a fast-paced news environment.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Deep expertise in digital journalism, streaming content strategy, and audience engagement.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast-style storytelling and how to adapt content across multiple platforms.
  • Exceptional editorial judgment and thorough knowledge of journalistic ethics, media law, and libel considerations.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence, mentor talent, and foster a culture of collaboration and growth.
  • Curiosity about the communities, cities, states, and world we cover every day.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize rapidly changing news situations.
  • A passion for innovation and finding new ways to tell stories that resonate with audiences.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to connect teams around a common vision.
  • Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including nights, weekends, early mornings, and holidays as newsroom needs require

job.title: Community Connections Coordinator, KNXV
job.description:
KNXV | Phoenix, AZ | Full-time | Onsite

What does it take to truly connect a newsroom with the community it serves? At KNXV in Phoenix, AZ, we're looking for a passionate and people-first Community Connections Coordinator to be that essential bridge. In this role, you'll cultivate meaningful relationships with community organizations, residents, and local leaders — surfacing the stories that matter, supporting journalists with trusted voices and timely intelligence, and coordinating the events and conversations that bring our station closer to the people we serve. If you thrive at the intersection of community, journalism, and engagement, this role was made for you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain relationships with community organizations, residents, leaders, and trusted sources to gather community insights and identify emerging issues, events, and story opportunities.
  • Monitor, track, and route audience tips, questions, and leads from community channels, ensuring timely communication and escalation to newsroom teams.
  • Support newsroom listening efforts, community conversations, and source development by connecting journalists with credible and diverse community voices.
  • Assist with breaking and developing news coverage by gathering community context, maintaining source networks, and providing timely intelligence to newsroom staff.
  • Serve as a responsive point of contact for community organizations and residents, fostering positive relationships and trust.
  • Coordinate outreach, maintain partner and contact records, and represent the station at community meetings, events, and activities.
  • Support newsroom talent by coordinating interviews, identifying community contacts, gathering background information, and facilitating community appearances.
  • Coordinate logistics and execution for community conversations, listening sessions, public programs, newsroom events, special coverage initiatives, and station appearances.
  • Manage event-related activities including outreach, scheduling, partner coordination, participant communications, on-site support, and post-event follow-up.
  • Support audience engagement across digital and in-person channels, including live discussions, community groups, neighborhood platforms, and other audience interaction opportunities.
  • Maintain community calendars, project plans, contact databases, and engagement records to support execution of the market community strategy.
  • Track community insights, engagement outcomes, story leads, and best practices, preparing summaries and reports that help inform newsroom and community engagement priorities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Associates degree in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in journalism, communications, community engagement, nonprofit work, events, public relations or related fields
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong listening, relationship-building and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to establish rapport with diverse community members and organizations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization, follow-through and attention to detail
  • Ability to identify and communicate relevant community information quickly and accurately
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with journalists and station teams
  • Comfort working independently in the community and adapting to newsroom needs
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/contact systems, social platforms and collaboration tools
  • Solid news judgment, comfort with newsroom urgency, ability to verify and relay information quickly, and understanding of how community tips can develop into stories
  • Ability to communicate clearly and accurately across digital platforms, maintain professionalism in public-facing conversations and collaborate closely with reporters, producers, anchors, meteorologists and newsroom leaders

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Phoenix is one of America's most dynamic and fast-growing cities, offering a lifestyle as big and bold as the desert sky. As the capital of Arizona and the fifth-largest city in the country, Phoenix is a hub of culture, cuisine, and outdoor adventure. Explore world-class attractions like the Desert Botanical Garden, the Heard Museum celebrating Native American art and culture, and the Phoenix Art Museum. The city's thriving food scene spans everything from authentic Sonoran cuisine to innovative farm-to-table dining, and the year-round sunshine makes rooftop dining and outdoor festivals a regular pleasure.

Sports fans will feel right at home — Phoenix is a proud major-league city, home to the NBA's Phoenix Suns, the NFL's Arizona Cardinals, the MLB's Arizona Diamondbacks, and the WNBA's Phoenix Mercury. When you're ready to get outside, iconic destinations like Camelback Mountain and South Mountain Park offer hiking and climbing with breathtaking city and desert views just minutes from downtown. For a weekend escape, the red rock formations of Sedona and the grandeur of the Grand Canyon are both within easy driving distance, making every weekend a potential adventure.

You'll cover the stories that matter most to our community while working both independently and collaboratively in an award-winning newsroom. job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
The Digital Content Producer is responsible for producing, publishing, and managing timely, accurate, and engaging content across the station’s digital platforms, including the website, social media channels, mobile apps, YouTube, and email communications.

This role actively monitors breaking news, gathers information from official sources, and creates digital-first content that keeps audiences informed in real time. The Digital Content Producer collaborates with News, Sales, Promotions, and Station Management to ensure consistent messaging, audience engagement, and strong digital storytelling while maintaining journalistic integrity and brand standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Write, edit, and publish news stories and multimedia content for the station website and digital platforms.
  • Manage and maintain all station social media platforms, including posting content, monitoring engagement, and responding to audience interaction when appropriate.
  • Monitor breaking news and developing stories, gathering information from official sources and public officials when necessary.
  • Conduct phone calls and outreach to law enforcement, public information officers, and other officials to confirm details and obtain updates on developing stories.
  • Create and publish digital-first content across multiple platforms, including social media, YouTube, mobile apps, and newsletters.
  • Review and edit reporter scripts, video, and multimedia assets for digital publication, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and adherence to journalistic standards.
  • Update digital platforms throughout the day with breaking news, live updates, and timely information to keep audiences informed.
  • Coordinate and execute digital promotions and contests in partnership with Sales, News, and Promotions teams.
  • Maintain consistent brand voice and visual standards across all digital platforms.
  • Track digital engagement and content performance metrics as directed by management.
  • Communicate closely with newsroom staff and management to support daily news coverage and digital initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience in digital journalism, news production, or multimedia content creation preferred.
  • Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience managing social media platforms and creating platform-specific content.
  • Familiarity with content management systems (CMS), social media tools, and basic video editing.
  • Ability to work quickly and effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven news environment.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across multiple departments.
  • Demonstrated commitment to journalistic ethics, accuracy, and responsible reporting.

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Capable of occasional lifting or moving of light equipment (up to 20 lbs).

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Meteorologist in Baltimore, MD. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of meteorology and its application in the context of local weather patterns and events. The Meteorologist will be responsible for providing accurate and timely weather forecasts, and effectively communicating weather-related information to our audience. Additionally, proficiency in managing and posting content across various social media platforms is crucial for this role. Other Responsibilities:
  • Develop and present comprehensive and detailed weather reports for various segments, ensuring clarity and accessibility for a diverse audience.
  • Monitor weather conditions, analyze data, and utilize state-of-the-art technology to provide timely and precise weather updates and alerts.
  • Collaborate with news producers, reporters, and other team members to integrate weather information seamlessly into news broadcasts and other programming.
  • Maintain a strong social media presence by regularly posting weather updates, forecasts, and relevant content across various platforms to engage and inform the community.
  • Develop and implement strategies to enhance the station's digital weather presence, including interactive weather maps, live streaming, and other innovative features.
  • Build and maintain relationships with local authorities, emergency management agencies, and community organizations to ensure effective communication during severe weather events and emergencies.
  • Participate in community outreach events, educational programs, and public speaking engagements to promote weather awareness and preparedness within the local community.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's or master's degree in meteorology, atmospheric science, or a related field.
  • 7-10 years of experience in a professional meteorology role, preferably in a broadcast environment.
  • Profound knowledge of meteorological tools and software, including weather radar systems, satellite imagery, and forecasting models.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with a demonstrated ability to present complex weather information in a clear and engaging manner.
  • Proven experience in managing and leveraging various social media platforms to disseminate weather information and engage with the audience effectively.
  • Ability to work under pressure and in a fast-paced environment, particularly during severe weather situations.
  • Familiarity with the Baltimore, MD, metropolitan area and its unique weather patterns is preferred.
 

If you are passionate about meteorology, possess strong leadership skills, and have a keen interest in leveraging social media for community engagement, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $78,600 to $98,200.  Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.
