job.title: Investigative Journalist, Spotlight on Maryland
job.description:
Sinclair’s Spotlight on Maryland is looking for Investigative Journalists who are comfortable asking elected leaders and government officials smart, thought provoking, and tough questions. Spotlight on Maryland produces high impact and accountability stories for digital, social, print and television. These stories go beyond the basics of general reporting to expose a problem, hold government and elected leaders accountable for their actions and press for a solution. Our goal is to offer audiences on multiple platforms something meaningful that will have an impact on the communities we serve.   

The ideal candidate will have strong news judgment, be a compelling and fact-based writer, and be able to multitask. We are looking for someone with a clear understanding of how to dig for a story, research it, write it with a thought-provoking edge. Knowledge of the FOIA (Freedom of Information Act) process, computer-assisted reporting, and data-driven reporting is required along with familiarity of legal issues related to investigative news reporting. Strong writing skills and knowledge of current events is essential. Dynamic storytelling skills are a must.

This is a highly collaborative environment. The ability to work as part of a team is a must.

Essential Duties and Requirements include the following:

  • Develop and maintain contacts and sources in the community to enterprise story ideas
  • Identify and pitch investigative angles on big daily news stories
  • Work closely with local and corporate news leadership to refine investigative pitches and story scripts
  • Write online, print and broadcast versions of investigative reports and produce digital specific content for each investigation
  • The position is located on-site in Hunt Valley, MD*
  • Other duties as assigned

 

Qualifications- To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. 

  • Three (3) years of reporting/producing experience preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred
  • Must be a strong storyteller with the ability to make the complicated understandable
  • Must be able to use all available tools to enhance stories, from graphics to social media
  • Should be able to generate story ideas and determine the legitimacy of viewer tips
  • Strong writer, storyteller
  • Must be naturally inquisitive with an interest in holding government officials accountable

 

Please provide a link to examples of your work.

job.title: Manager, TV Audio Infrastructure
job.description:
Who We Are:

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

This position requires weekly travel to WWE shows (Raw, Smackdown, Live Events and PLE's), both domestically and internationally, based on the show schedule.


Position Summary

The Manager of Broadcast TV Audio Infrastructure assists senior management with responsibilities for the design, operation, maintenance, and strategic development of audio systems while supporting live and recorded television production. This role supports a team of broadcast audio technicians, ensuring reliable, high-quality audio across studios, control rooms, remote productions, and transmission facilities. The manager works closely with production, engineering, IT, and operations teams to support current workflows while planning future technology upgrades.


Key Responsibilities

Audio Infrastructure Management

  • Oversee the operation and maintenance of broadcast audio systems, including intercoms (wired/wireless), audio-over-IP networks, RFOF systems, RF Microphones and IEM monitoring systems.
  • Develop and maintain preventative maintenance schedules and system documentation.
  • Collaborate with external vendors to prioritize, schedule, and expedite repairs, ensuring maximum system reliability and uptime.

 

Technical Leadership

  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex audio and broadcast infrastructure issues.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend upgrades to improve efficiency, scalability, and audio quality.
  • Collaborate with IT teams on networked audio systems.

Project Management

  • Plan and execute capital projects, upgrades, technical work books, equipment refreshes, and system integrations.
  • Coordinate installation, testing, commissioning, and acceptance of new systems.
  • Demoing new audio technologies.

Team Leadership

  • Collaborate with upper management to supervise, mentor, and develop broadcast audio engineers and technical staff.
  • Coordinate staffing and technical support coverage for live events and special productions.

 

Operational Support

  • Support live broadcast, entertainment, and special event productions.
  • Ensure compliance with FCC regulations, company standards, and industry best practices.
  • Participate in on-call escalation support for critical broadcast operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Engineering, Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in broadcast engineering, professional audio, or television infrastructure environments.
  • Extensive knowledge of broadcast audio systems, signal routing, and transmission workflows.
  • Understanding Dante platforms.
  • Strong understanding of television production environments and live broadcast operations.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale network television operations.
  • Familiarity with broadcast intercom systems.
  • Professional certifications in broadcast engineering.
  • Experience with wireless communications, and Audio production technologies.

Key Competencies

  • Broadcast systems infrastructure
  • Audio engineering expertise
  • Project planning and execution
  • Problem-solving under pressure
  • This role combines broadcast audio engineering expertise with operational leadership to ensure reliable, high-quality audio delivery across all television platforms.

It powers growth of revenues, fanbases and IP for more than 250 federations, associations, events, and teams, including the National Football League, English Premier League, International Olympic Committee, National Hockey League, Major League Soccer, ATP and WTA Tours, the AELTC (Wimbledon), Euroleague Basketball, CONMEBOL, World Rugby, DP World Tour, and The R&A, as well as UFC, WWE, and PBR. IMG is a subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

This is a contract position through end of August 2027. This role requires heavy travel from late May through late June. Candidates must be available for an extended international travel commitments during this period and comfortable with a fixed-term engagement.

What You’ll Do:


This is a fantastic opportunity to join IMG as a Production Coordinator, where you’ll be at the center of a fast-paced, high-profile sports production, driving planning, logistics, and shoots alongside a seasoned production team.

If you’re organized, proactive, and excited by sports, this is your chance to be part of something truly special.


Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Provide key production coordination support across the production, working closely with the Production Management team to ensure the smooth running of the production in the office, remote hub, and onsite.
  • Organize shoots and onsite bookings, including arranging clearances, film permits, and associated logistical planning such as transport, accommodation, and catering.
  • Book and coordinate crew, including onboarding, scheduling, and creating Work Orders via the payment portal.
  • Liaise with third‑party suppliers and process invoices as required.
  • Liaise with internal departments (including Legal, HR, Finance, and Immigration) to assist with securing visas and work permits when required.
  • Create and distribute detailed call sheets and risk assessments, acting as a key point of contact for crew.
  • Track costs on a daily basis, working closely with the Accounts Assistant to monitor spend, process invoices, and raise purchase orders.
  • Troubleshoot and respond to ad‑hoc production queries and duties in conjunction with the Production Manager.
  • Complete post‑production paperwork, including music cue sheets, PAPs, and archive and music clearances where applicable.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with internal facility providers and external suppliers.
  • Assist with the creation and distribution of production documentation, including call sheets and studio information.
  • Champion IMG’s Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion initiatives and actively support the organization's mental health programs.
  • Assist in implementing all health and safety procedures, including risk assessments.
  • Work closely with colleagues across pre‑production, production, and post‑production to support IMG’s GreenToScreen sustainability goals and reduce the production’s carbon footprint wherever possible.
  • Carry out other duties within the scope and purpose of the role as required.

Skills and Abilities

  • Positive, professional, and proactive approach to work.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective working relationships.
  • A collaborative team player with clear and confident communication skills.
  • Ability to plan, prioritize, and manage workload effectively in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Calm, resilient, and solutions‑focused under pressure.
  • Able to work independently with initiative, as well as collaboratively within a team.
  • Computer literate with experience using a range of project management and production tools.

Knowledge and Experience

  • Proven experience in a Production Coordinator role, ideally with international experience across a range of projects, including live OBs and/or remote production operations.
  • Strong ability to support cost management of production budgets, working closely with Production Managers and Finance teams.\
  • Knowledge of production and post‑production technologies and workflows.
  • Understanding and practical experience of archive and music clearance processes.
  • Knowledge of production insurance and health and safety requirements.
  • Experience working directly with clients and on‑screen talent.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong organizational capability.
  • Confidence in managing large crew teams during pre‑production and event time.
  • Experience working with international teams and stakeholders where English is not a first language (essential).
  • Multi‑language skills (desirable).

Working Conditions

  • The work location is Stamford, CT
  • This is a fixed term contract until August 2027
  • Some international travel may be required

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN. ã

¤ We are CNN. THE WORLD'S MOST ESSENTIAL AND ENGAGING SOURCE OF DIGITAL NEWS. We are in the midst of rapid transformation and need our next generation of innovators, makers, and dreamers who will lead and drive our growth. We aim to make the world a better, more connected place. Your New Role… CNN is seeking an exceptional and strategic Associate Manager of Business Development responsible for supporting CNN’s Commerce team by growing affiliate revenue through content and linking optimizations, new affiliate solutions, and overseeing key merchant relationships. Revenue from affiliate transactions is the primary monetization vehicle of CNN Underscored, and we are looking to grow this revenue for our 2,000+ existing merchant partners, as well as expand the presence of affiliate through new verticals and unique partnership opportunities. Outside of working with merchant partners, the Associate Manager of Business Development will collaborate with Business and Editorial team members to identify new monetization opportunities, operationalize relevant strategies, and analyze performance for continued growth through both Organic and Paid channels. They will also work closely with Product, Engineering, and Revenue Insights on new features and incremental earnings opportunities. Your Role Accountabilities... Partner Management: Oversee a portfolio of priority merchants to nurture and grow affiliate earnings with through performance incentives, commission negotiations, and strategic initiatives. Content & Linking Optimization: Maximize affiliate revenue from content by implementing high-yield partner links, optimizing content to increase click through rate and conversion rate, and oversee network migrations to mitigate revenue loss. Performance Analysis: Analyze merchant and article-level performance to identify alternative monetization tactics that improve core performance metrics through diverse attribution and partner diversification strategies. Cross Collaboration: Work with Business Development, Editorial, Product and Analytics stakeholders to identify, analyze, and develop new business and product solutions that increase user engagement and revenue earnings. New Revenue: Assist Business Development team in sourcing, identifying and developing new opportunities to create revenue on and off platform through Sponsorships, Paid Media, and other digitally driven concepts. Qualifications & Experience… Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, data science, or related field. Minimum 3 years’ experience in digital marketing, analytics, or related field. Experience working with internal and external stakeholders to develop new concepts, strategies, and processes that drive revenue growth. A fundamental understanding of affiliate revenue KPIs such as, earnings-per-click, cost-per-action, revenue-per-impression, click-through rate, and conversion rate. Affiliate marketing experience and familiarity with affiliate network reporting platforms is preferred. The ideal candidate is organized, has strong analytical skills, the ability to problem solve, and can effectively communicate informative findings to others. Job Summary: Job Requirements Job Description Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: ● Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. ● Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. ● Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment & ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. News & Entertainment (N&E) Machine Learning The N&E ML team is responsible for building robust data pipelines and advanced machine learning platforms that deliver personalized experiences to users across Disney's News & Entertainment portfolio including ABC News, ABC Entertainment, National Geographic, Marvel, and Disney Studios. Our services leverage machine learning models to enable real-time content personalization and targeted distribution across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms, ensuring that users receive the most relevant and engaging content tailored to their interests. Our mission is to drive seamless, resilient, and low-latency personalized content delivery at scale, while continuously advancing our ML infrastructure and recommendation algorithms across one of the world's most iconic collections of entertainment brands. Job Summary: As a Principal Machine Learning Engineer, you will define and own the technical architecture and strategic direction of the N&E ML Platform across a large, complex problem space spanning Disney's News & Entertainment portfolio. You will drive step-function improvements in personalization, recommendation systems, and ML infrastructure - not just at the feature level, but across entire product and platform domains. You will serve as a thought leader who bridges business objectives and technical execution, partnering with senior leadership, product, and cross-org engineering communities to set the standard for ML excellence within News & Entertainment. Your impact will be measured by the quantifiable outcomes you drive for our guests and the durable technical foundations you build for the teams around you. Responsibilities and Duties of the Role: -Focus on major areas of work, typically 20% or more of role Architecture Ownership: Define and own the end-to-end architecture of the N&E ML platform across a large problem space spanning ABC News, ABC Entertainment, National Geographic, Marvel, and Disney Studios. Author architecture documents, drive them through review, and oversee implementation to ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with platform-wide standards. Strategic Technical Leadership: Identify, scope, and prioritize the most impactful and time-sensitive ML workstreams across the N&E portfolio. Break down and sequence complex initiatives, proactively surface risks to leadership, and drive outcomes with a clear metrics-driven mindset. ML Platform & Infrastructure: Drive the design and evolution of infrastructure supporting the full ML lifecycle across diverse content types and brands: data pipelines, workflow orchestration, feature stores, batch training, and low-latency online serving. Champion reliability, quality, and operational excellence across the platform. Innovation & Industry Awareness: Stay at the forefront of industry trends in ML, AI, and data engineering. Proactively identify and champion the adoption of new technologies, frameworks, and patterns that drive improvement across the N&E portfolio (e.g. recommendation systems, LLMs, RAGs, object detection, autogenerated content tagging). Incident & Reliability Ownership: Own and speak to production incidents during weekly meetings with leadership. Hold the team to the right engineering processes and drive a culture of reliability, observability, and continuous improvement across the N&E ML problem space. Cross-Org Engagement: Actively participate in and contribute to the broader Machine Learning community across Disney Entertainment & ESPN. Drive and influence engineering standards, cross-org programs, and best practices that extend beyond the N&E ML team. Business & Objectives Alignment: Serve as a thought leader who deeply understands the business objectives and problems across the N&E portfolio - not just the technical ones. Lead metrics-driven programs that connect ML platform investments directly to measurable guest experience and business outcomes across all brands. Mentorship & Culture: Mentor and elevate senior engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, technical rigor, and continuous learning. Be a confident, vocal, and optimistic leader who inspires the team and drives outcomes people want to rally around. Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training: Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Statistics, Math, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience 10+ years of experience building and operating ML engineering systems in production environments, with a track record of owning large, complex problem spaces Deep expertise in data science, deep learning algorithms, and statistical methods applied to real-world, large-scale engineering problems Demonstrated experience owning architecture across a significant platform or product domain - including authoring architecture documents, driving reviews, and leading implementation Proven ability to drive quantifiable improvements in ML platform capabilities, personalization quality, or recommendation system performance Experience designing and evolving backend microservices for large-scale distributed systems using REST Strong expertise with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS (Step Functions, Lambda, Glue, SQS, SNS, Personalize) Deep hands-on experience with big data technologies such as Databricks, Spark, Kinesis, and Kafka Experience leading incident response for high priority incidents and driving reliability programs across a team or platform Active participation in cross-organizational engineering communities, standards-setting, and architectural governance Proven track record as a metrics-driven technical leader who connects engineering decisions to business outcomes Exceptional communication, influence, and collaboration skills — comfortable presenting to and aligning senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with strong prioritization and stakeholder management skills Preferred Qualifications Experience with agentic AI workflows and frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and applying them to automate complex ML and data engineering tasks Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to accelerate software development lifecycle and engineering productivity Familiarity with prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation frameworks for large language models in production environments Experience with MLOps platforms and modern model lifecycle management tools (e.g. MLflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI) Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in New York City is $220,600-$295,900 and for Glendale, CA is $210,500- $282,300 per year. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Sr Media Engineer Job ID 10163757 Location Los Angeles, California, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Nov. 10, 2026 Sr Media Engineer Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements ***This is an onsite position and must sit four (4) days a week in Hollywood Park, CA ***This is a “swing” shift starting at 10:30 am but may have the need to cover the night shift 12:30 pm – 9:30 pm occasionally, depending on coverage needs. Department/Group Overview: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams. Job Summary: Disney Media Engineers have a clear charter: to transform the capability and flexibility of how Disney acquires, produces, and distributes content worldwide, all while ensuring the highest levels of quality, efficiency, and resiliency. Disney Media Engineers often find themselves at the crossroads between hardware and software-based technology and must possess a comprehensive theoretical and practical understanding of the technology that powers the generation, monetization, and distribution of all forms of consumer- facing linear and digital video/audio content. Responsibility includes numerous systems such as Playout Technology, Studios, Production Control Rooms, Remote Production, Post-Production, Contribution/Distribution Systems, Networking, Cloud Compute, Production Software and Virtual Environment and more. The Sr. Media Engineer is, simply put, is an expert engineer in the acquisition, production, and distribution of media content. They are well-versed in multiple technical standards and have hands-on experience in the sustainment of production systems. The Sr. Media Engineers are part of a tiered sustainment model where incidents are escalated from a shared operations team (tier 1) to the Media Engineer II’s (tier 2) and beyond. They are able to tackle the most complicated technical issues, often spanning media software, networking and hardware troubleshooting with little assistance from senior engineers. The Sr. Media Engineer, while primarily focused on sustainment and incremental advancement of technology, may work on design/build projects that advance our overall business. Responsibilities and Duties of the Role: Respond to and resolve issues that affect acquisition, production, and content distribution across multiple DEEPT networks including system outages, malfunctions, and related technical problems, and conduct diagnostic testing, repair, and replacement activities necessary to solve routine, specialized, and complex problems. Utilize system health and performance monitoring software and platforms; troubleshoot and participate in repairing system problems and failures, participates in maintenance of systems, installs software patches, updates etc., to resolve and avoid service problems, and troubleshoots system problems as they relate to these services Analyze and troubleshoot streaming audio/video signals in traditional SDI and IP 2110 essence flow routing environments. Analyze and troubleshoot cloud platforms as necessary Performs upgrades to system hardware and software workflows under the supervision of a more experienced engineer or supervisor. When required perform preventative maintenance on all broadcast systems and equipment, such as distribution systems, switchers, consoles, playout servers, cameras, robotics, electromechanical equipment, automation systems and radio facilities to ensure optimum broadcast performance. Participates in engineering projects at the direction of more experienced engineers. Reviews and contributes to system/workflow documentation. Support third-party service providers by enforcing the agreed upon scope of services within the various signed service agreements (i.e., full time, freelance, union agencies, maintenance providers, contractors, service providers, etc.). Select, train, motivate and evaluate technical staff; provide or coordinate staff training; work with employees to correct deficiencies; implement discipline procedures. Support the procurement of equipment, supplies and materials for Media technology systems within budget guidelines; receive and maintain equipment and supplies. Support long range planning for future media technology needs, including capital improvements, to enhance production and distribution capabilities. Lead the development and implementation of policies and procedures regarding technology facilities with a focus on maximizing the integration of all systems to meet business, marketing, and entertainment goals. Lead operational support of all activities related to operating, maintaining, and programming the audio and video production/distribution systems across the enterprise and other connected properties. Participates in regular training and development objectives. Extraordinary influencer who is skilled at connecting the dots at the organization, strategy, program, project, and event levels. Able to persuade and change the thinking of others without damaging relationships. Comfort working in a fast-paced, growth environment with minimal direction, delivering under tight deadlines while multitasking, prioritizing projects, and communicating priority updates to team members. Able to operate with limited resources, exhibit dispassionate critical-thinking, and creatively solve problems. Motivated and inventive, always finds a way forward—eternal optimist with a committed drive for contributing and making a difference. Any other duties needed to help achieve Business Objectives Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training: Minimum Qualifications: 5+ years of previous and relevant experience in ensuring efficient sustainment, uptime, and overall stability of the technical environments of Media Engineering and live media production and distribution environments. Expert level knowledge and experience with integrating, implementing, or refreshing broadcast control room equipment, including familiarity with modern broadcast cabling infrastructure used in broadcast environments. Proficiency will be an advantage with technologies like microservices, DevOps tools, design principles, practices, standards and guidelines Scripting proficiency will be an advantage (Python, NodeJS, Bash, PowerShell) Proficient in SMPTE standards for broadcast television and video production/streaming environments with a current certification such as not limited to ST 292M, ST 424M, ST 2110, ST 2059, IEE1588, ST 2022-7, SCTE-104, etc. Advanced level knowledge and experience with on-prem and cloud-based storage and compute infrastructure platforms and current technological offerings. At least one foundational cloud certification required, including but not limited to Microsoft Certified: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, CompTIA Cloud+, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate. Advanced level knowledge and experience with compression techniques such as MPEG2/4, HEVC, JPEG 2000, and JPEG XS. Expert level knowledge and experience with Evertz software control systems such as frame control via VistaLink or Magnum, EQX/EXE routers, and their monitoring software VLPRO, SDVN, VIP, VUE, MVP. Advanced level knowledge and experience with major media systems and the vendors that supply them in areas such as asset management systems, file-based workflows, media acquisition, transcoding/encoding, graphics, and NAS/SAN technologies Expert level knowledge and experience with Nielsen (NACAT), VANC equipment, Linear Acoustics, and other related systems. Expert level knowledge and experience with coordinated receiver decoders IRDs, core devices, edge devices, timing of video and audio systems, audio and video media file formats are a plus. Ability to create, read and interpret AutoCad and other technical drawing/documentation tools. Demonstrated advanced troubleshooting and sustaining in one or more of the following: IP-based broadcast equipment including routers, switchers, audio boards, signal processers, encoder/decoder, video scalers, playback systems, etc. Studio technology includes video walls, cameras, VR set technology, image processing systems, touch screens, lighting, etc. File-based workflows like enterprise Media Asset Management systems (Cloud-based Cloud Compute or Local Network-based) including storage, compute, encode and distribution. Production control systems such as Imagine Communications or Grass Valley automation systems, Avid, Adobe, Viz, Dalet, Riedel trunking, Lawo, Calrec, Evertz, Ross and others. Transmission systems such as RF (Radio Frequency), Satellite Distribution, Fiber Distribution, etc. Proven track record for troubleshooting and sustainment knowledge of AWS Infrastructures and other cloud-based technologies including S3/Glacier storage and cloud compute (EC2) services. Ability to travel to support live remote events and facilities. Physical requirements and work environment: Ability to climb ladders, work on raised structures and building roofs, operate areal lift platforms and have valid driver’s license. Preferred qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree and/or equivalent work experience. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY Can you please summarize the interview for me in-depth? Job Summary: Job Requirements Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Management is responsible for driving the overall user experience, feature strategies and concepts, and engagement paradigms for Disney Entertainment & ESPN's global portfolio of consumer-facing streaming and digital products – including Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, ABC, ABC News, Nat Geo, Marvel, and Star Wars. We are looking for a Director, News & Entertainment Growth Products to lead the product strategy across user journey, messaging and algorithmic consumer experiences to drive acquisition and retention across the News & Entertainment portfolio. This role reports to the VP of Product Management, News & Entertainment and leads a team of product managers. You will define the vision and roadmap for the growth that powers how we understand and drive user reach, engagement and retention for our audiences — from advancing our lifecycle messaging to optimizing more direct relationships for our users, and so much more. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of consumer experience, engineering, data science, programming & editorial, and marketing. Responsibilities Define the long-term product vision, roadmap, and OKRs for growing reach and deepening engagement to drive loyalty across the News & Entertainment portfolio Lead and develop a team of product managers; provide coaching, career development, and clear direction Drive the strategy for driving direct 1:1 relationships with users, enabling more relevant and engaging content experiences for our audiences across brands that drive our OKRs around habituation and stickiness Oversee audience messaging across email, push, and in-app channels across portfolio so our users get the right messages and the right time - whether those messages are editorially-driven or programmatic Lead development of personalized consumer experiences across our product suite to deepen relevance Define how we use data signals in our user experiences to improve targeting, timing, and relevance and drive users further into their user journey Evolve our experimentation culture across News & Entertainment in partnership with our Platform teams — making it easier for teams to test, learn, and iterate quickly Identify and prioritize cross-brand needs across the portfolio, advocating for the infrastructure investments that enable better product decisions Partner closely with cross functional teams internal to Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology and Product as well as end creative stakeholders Basic Qualifications 12+ years of product management experience, with a track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives Background in consumer products at scale, ideally worked in news products or storytelling experiences Proven experience managing and developing teams of product managers Deep expertise in driving product acquisition and retention strategies and experience in driving growth through key levers i.e. personalization, experimentation and A/B testing, CRM/lifecycle messaging, or data products Strong analytical instincts — you define KPIs, understand data, and make decisions grounded in evidence Demonstrated ability to define and execute product strategy in ambiguous, high-stakes environments Exceptional communication and influence skills; comfortable navigating complex, matrixed organizations Experience in consumer digital media, streaming, or entertainment Passion for news, entertainment, or media and creating transformative user experiences at scale Education Bachelor's degree required; any field of study considered #TECHATDISNEY Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $220,600 - $295,900 per year and in Glendale, CA is $210,500 - $282,300 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Executive Director, Solutions Engineering Job ID 10165418 Location New York, New York, United States / Bristol, Connecticut, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Nov. 18, 2026 Executive Director, Solutions Engineering Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Job Summary: The Executive Director, Solutions Engineering leads a critical function within Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology, responsible for strengthening the operational health, stability, and resilience of the services that support consumer, platform, and enterprise experiences. Reporting to senior Product & Technology (P&T) leadership, this role oversees a broad operational scope spanning the Global Support Center and Operational Readiness, with responsibility for setting strategy, driving execution, and leading other executives, managers, and technical professionals across the organization. This leader is accountable for operational readiness across launch planning, change governance, incident management, problem management, and they oversee the Global Support Centers, an organization that owns monitoring of service health in a complex, always-on technology environment. The role ensures new products, features, and platform changes are introduced in a controlled and supportable manner, major incidents are led with urgency and clarity, and recurring issues are addressed through disciplined root cause resolution. The Executive Director also serves as a key operational voice across the organization, providing clear and timely communication to technical teams, business partners, and senior leaders during critical events and ongoing operational reviews. In addition, the role is expected to advance modern operational capabilities, including the use of AI-enabled tooling, automation, and intelligent event detection to improve visibility, reduce manual effort, and support faster, more coordinated response. Success in this position will require strong executive judgment, operational leadership at scale, and the ability to influence outcomes across a highly matrixed business and technology landscape. This is an opportunity to shape how Product & Technology anticipates risk, responds to disruption, and continuously improves the reliability of the services it delivers. Responsibilities and Duties of the Role: This position exists to provide unified operational leadership across a global, always on technology environment where many teams, platforms, and changes intersect. Without a single accountable leader for operational readiness, monitoring, incident response, and operational communication, service risk is managed in silos and major events are slower to detect, resolve, and communicate. The Executive Director, Operational Readiness brings these disciplines under one organization and one operating standard. The major areas of work are summarized below. Operational Readiness and Launch Governance (Approximately 20%) Lead the Operational Readiness function and own the support standards that prepare services for production. Direct proactive launch planning and change management so new features and platform changes are reviewed, risk assessed, and supportable before go live. Oversee launch readiness reviews, change governance and the associated review forums, load tests, runbooks, rollback plans, and a forward view of upcoming changes shared with stakeholders. Global Service Monitoring, Incident, and Problem Management (Approximately 20%) Lead the global 24x7 Support Center, including continuous monitoring of service health and leadership of major incidents. Set standards for incident command, escalation, and triage, and serve as the senior point of coordination during high severity events. Own problem management, ensuring recurring issues are driven to root cause and corrective actions are tracked to completion. Core deliverables include continuous monitoring and alerting, major incident leadership, executive escalation, and post incident reviews that reduce repeat events. Stakeholder Communication and Operational Reporting (Approximately 20%) Serve as the unifying voice of operational communication across the business and technology organizations. Translate complex technical status into clear and timely updates for technical teams, business partners, and senior or executive leaders. Deliver real time communication during major events, regular operational reviews of service health, change, and risk, and consistent reporting that gives leadership a trusted view of operational posture. AI Enabled Detection and Operational Automation (Approximately 20%) Advance the adoption of AI enabled operational tools that move the organization from a reactive model to a proactive one. Leverage anomaly detection, event correlation, and intelligent automation across operational telemetry to surface issues earlier and reduce noise. Drive earlier detection of service impacting events, faster and better coordinated response, reduced manual effort for operations teams, and improved service stability over time. Organizational Leadership, Strategy, and Talent (Approximately 20%) Lead other executives, managers, and technical professionals, both directly and through their organizations. Develop and execute the operational strategy for P+T, set performance and service standards, and hold accountability for the structure, budget, and results of the function. Build a high performing leadership team, establish clear operating standards and policies, and drive talent development, succession, and year over year operational maturity. Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training: Basic Qualifications Minimum 12 years of progressive experience in technology operations, service delivery, or site reliability, including direct accountability for the operational posture of a large and complex technology environment. 10 or more years of leadership experience, with a proven track record of leading a function through multiple levels of managers and directors, in addition to senior technical professionals, both directly and indirectly. Demonstrated experience leading mission critical, global technology operations and serving as the executive escalation point during major incidents. Proven ability to set and enforce ITIL aligned incident, problem, and change management practices at enterprise scale. Experience owning launch and operational readiness governance for major product launches and platform changes. Ability to build and deliver operational communications and reporting for audiences that range from technical teams to senior and executive leaders. Strong executive presence, with the ability to influence and negotiate with great latitude on outcomes and to present and defend complex or delicate matters with sensitivity to the audience. Demonstrated ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure and to bring clarity, structure, and urgency to high severity events. A proactive orientation that favors prevention over reactive firefighting, with the judgment to balance speed of restoration against operational risk and sound governance. Experience developing functional strategy and operating plans, with accountability for the structure, budget, and results of a function. No specific license or certification is required for this position. Preferred Qualifications An advanced degree, such as a Master of Business Administration or a technical master's degree. Experience in a large, consumer facing technology environment, such as media, streaming, or entertainment. Experience leading a global, always on Support Center, network operations center, or command center. Hands on experience adopting AI enabled detection, event correlation, and intelligent automation to improve operational outcomes. Experience applying site reliability engineering practices, including automation, observability, resilience, and the reduction of manual effort. Experience managing operating budgets, vendor relationships, and sourcing strategy for an operations function. ITIL 4 certification at the Foundation level or higher. A site reliability, DevOps, or change management certification. Relevant cloud platform certifications. Experience with: Supporting the operational health of large scale, consumer facing streaming services, including live and on demand video delivery. Incident management and major incident command, including incident bridges, escalation, and post incident review. Problem management and root cause analysis that drives corrective action through to completion. Change management and release readiness, including change review forums and a forward schedule of upcoming changes. Continuous monitoring, alerting, and observability across metrics, logs, traces, and events. AIOps capabilities, such as anomaly detection, event correlation, and intelligent automation. ITSM platforms, such as ServiceNow. Operational reporting and executive communication during service impacting events. Operating a global, always on support or command center model. Service level objectives and the measurement of service health, availability, and reliability. Oversight of vendors and managed service partners within an operations function. Required Education A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Job Summary: Job Requirements Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: 1. Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. 2. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. 3. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment & ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality engineering, and the engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. Job Summary: The DEEP & Technology team is seeking a Sr. Software Development in Test Engineer to join our Engineering Services team to build test automation and processes to ensure the quality of our advertising systems. When our systems work properly, they are able to reliably deliver relevant ads to all of our viewers; driving higher revenue for our business and helping our customers to discover brands and products that are relevant to their interests. Defects in our ad systems can negatively impact revenue and deliver advertisements that detract from the viewer experience due to irrelevance, repetition and other factors. This is a unique opportunity to join an excellent team and have a meaningful impact on the QE and automation process and culture, as well as the products we release. As a result, those most likely to excel in this role are independent, creative, and able to operate effectively in ambiguous circumstances. If you are interested in a testing role with a heavy emphasis on automated testing where the results of your testing will have significant impact on the business and be highly visible to company leadership, then this might be the right opportunity for you! job.title: Programming & Executive Assistant, FOX Nation & Talent Development
job.description:
FOX News Media is seeking a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant to support the President of FOX Nation & Talent Development. This role provides high-level executive and operational support across FOX Nation programming, talent development, and FOX News Books. The ideal candidate is a resourceful, detail-oriented professional with exceptional communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and handle confidential information in a fast-paced environment.

**You must submit a cover letter in order to be considered for this role.**

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage a complex executive calendar, coordinate meetings with internal and external stakeholders, resolve scheduling conflicts, and oversee communications with professionalism and discretion.
  • Prepare daily briefings on ratings, programming, talent schedules, premieres, and production updates. Conduct research and develop polished presentations, talent profiles, organizational charts, and executive materials.
  • Coordinate talent meetings, visits, and engagements; support prospective hires and industry partners; and manage onboarding for new talent.
  • Track upcoming releases, premieres, livestreams, and production developments; coordinate screeners and viewing materials; and prepare programming summaries for executive review.
  • Collaborate with talent on book projects from concept through publication, coordinating editorial development, research, design, cover art, marketing, and promotional opportunities.
  • Coordinate talent appearances, promotional shoots, live events, executive meetings, and other strategic initiatives, ensuring schedules, logistics, and materials are aligned.
  • Arrange domestic and international travel, accommodations, transportation, itineraries, catering, and meetings for executives, talent, and guests.
  • Process expense reports through Workday, manage correspondence and office needs, and maintain efficient day-to-day operations while safeguarding sensitive information.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Prior administrative experience in a fast-paced professional environment.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities and changing schedules.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with senior executives, talent, and external partners.
  • Strong research, problem-solving, presentation development, and information management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; experience with Canva and other presentation tools.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle confidential information.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the flexibility to adapt quickly, collaborate across departments, and adjust work hours as business needs require.

job.title: Field Photographer, LA Bureau
job.description:
Fox News is looking for an experienced Field Photographer to join our Los Angeles Bureau. In this role, you will cover breaking news and planned events domestically and internationally, collaborating with photographers, field technicians, satellite truck operators, engineers, producers, and reporters. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in fast-moving breaking-news environments, including protests, rallies, civil unrest, and conflict zones, using traditional ENG cameras. You must also be comfortable supporting high-end, multi-camera productions with full-frame cinematic cameras and professional lighting techniques. This physically demanding weekend position requires long hours, extensive travel, and the ability to safely lift and transport heavy equipment.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Operate Sony ENG broadcast and cine cameras and manage file-based workflows
  • Edit using Adobe Premiere
  • Lead multi-camera and full-frame camera assignments
  • Configure audio for single and multiple camera set-ups
  • Operate LiveU and Starlink transmission systems
  • Safely operate company-owned and rental vehicles

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional field photography experience
  • Strong video photography and non-linear editing experience
  • Advanced lighting skills, including experience with long format shoots
  • Working knowledge of field audio mixers and multi-camera audio routing
  • Familiarity with streaming technologies and satellite newsgathering vehicles
  • Willingness to train on satellite-camera crew vehicles and larger vehicles
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure breaking-news environment
  • Flexibility to work across bureau, shooting, editing, and satellite-truck operations as needed
  • Availability to travel extensively and deploy on short notice for a 24-hour news operation, including overtime and weekends
  • A valid driver’s license, clean driving record, and valid passport; CDL preferred

NBCUniversal Enterprise Business Solutions needs a dedicated Director, Content Solution Delivery and Portfolio Management to own complex Studio and Media transformation delivery. This role would lead Title Master Data (GTM Integration) and Capstone - Int'l Royalties and TVD by converting priorities into executable plans, managing dependencies, confirming data and operational readiness, and giving leadership concise decision-ready information.

Key Responsibilities:

  • This is an executive leadership role within NBCUniversal, the right leader is a self-starter and can drive end-to-end strategy through execution and solution delivery. This includes developing a sound technology strategy to support business goals, developing artifacts in support of the strategy (business cases, presentations etc.), driving buy in from all stakeholders to greenlight their approach
  • Lead NBCU Studio Finance transformation to S/4 Rights & Royalties Mgmt. by Vistex
  • Collaborate with NBCU S/4 transformation initiative to manage interdependencies between S/4 Core and Studio Finance transformation
  • Develop strong relationships with business stakeholders (VP/SVP) and work cohesively with them to drive their vision
  • Develop plans inclusive of budget, organizational design and technology roadmaps that support our strategic goals in partnership with Segment Business stakeholders and Enterprise Business Solutions partners
  • Advise on solution roadmap for S/4 SAP Transformation projects considering current footprint
  • Design and architect SAP solutions related to Film Studios, Media and Streaming related business processes including Royalties, Participations, Residuals, Production accounting, Ultimates, Amortization and Media Product Master Data (Title / WBSE) etc.
  • Understand the content supply chain and architect SAP solutions that integrate well within non-SAP solutions across the entire supply chain, for a variety of Business Units (Film Studios, Media, and Streaming)

Basic Requirements:

  • 15+ years of progressive SAP hands on experience in a consultative and/or IT capacity with at least 6 SAP project implementations of high complexity, large scale, and global user base, primary liaison between technology, accounting, and finance, from executive to analyst level
  • Project Management and Leadership experience that is cross-functional across technology, accounting, and finance, skilled in translating strategy into actionable project plans, driving complex initiatives to value realization
  • Experience with S/4 SAP BRIM, Media Product Master (MPM) and knowledge of Media related business processes is a must
  • A proven track record of working with SAP S/4 GL, Rights and Royalties Mgmt. solutions e.g., Vistex
  • Prior experience with leading large Finance/Studio and Media Finance transformation initiatives along with demonstrable experience working on large S/4 HANA transformations
  • Ability to translate complex strategies and roadmaps into executive friendly content and messaging

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience with SAP S/4 HANA, S/4 Rights and Royalties Mgmt. by Vistex, Studio and Media business processes
  • PMI Certified+
  • Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power Point, Visio, Teams, and Co-Pilot)
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment
  • Subject matter expertise in Entertainment relevant technologies and implementation architecture
  • Familiarity and comfort in working in an outsourced module with onshore and offshore resources
  • Strong/effective influencing skills and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage budget and other organizational tasks
  • Willingness to work off business hours and weekends as needed in a demanding environment
  • Certified Public Account or Equivalent
  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Accounting or Business from an accredited institution or equivalent

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $140,000 - $180,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible)

Desired Characteristics

  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based networking, firewall, security and data products.

  Overview   We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the development of our multimodal embedding and retrieval systems that power content discovery across Paramount's video library. In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of multi-modal embedding systems, optimized for text and video understanding, from generation, ingestion and indexing, to retrieval — directly impacting how millions of users discover and engage with short-form clips.   You will partner with product leadership, Content and Personalization engineering teams, mentor engineers and serve as a senior technical voice shaping how the platform "sees" and retrieves video clip content at scale.   The ideal candidate will be:
  • A hands-on systems builder who takes full ownership of pipelines that enable storing, indexing, and querying high-dimensional vector embeddings
  • Skilled at designing hybrid retrieval systems that combine vector similarity, lexical search, and reranking
  • Invested in multimodal video understanding as the foundation for meaningful content representations
  • Skilled at translating embedding system tradeoffs — latency, recall, cost — into product-relevant context that drives cross-functional decisions
  • Committed to mentoring and knowledge sharing with engineering resources
  • Effective at operating in a dynamic environment and comfortable taking ownership of project outcomes end-to-end


Responsibilities

Video Understanding & Multimodal Embedding

  • Design and build embedding pipelines for video content metadata and clip-level representation
  • Design collection and vector schemas to shape data structure, indexing behavior, and retrieval performance under scale and modality complexity
  • Lead the transition from traditional feature engineering to a vector-centric "context-first" architecture, through compositional queries and by designing high-dimensional hyper-vector representations that unify visual, textual, and behavioral signals
  • Design offline/online evaluation frameworks (e.g., nDCG, MRR, Recall@K) specifically for multimodal alignment, ensuring content embeddings match search intent
  Vector Search & Retrieval Infrastructure
  • Build hybrid retrieval systems that combine vector similarity search with lexical search and reranking layers to deliver fast, accurate, and scalable performance at production scale
  • Engineer the retrieval layer to capture nuanced user-content relationships that model training alone cannot surface, combining multimodal embeddings to improve recommendation depth at scale
  • Implement query-time optimizations including caching, filtering, and index sharding strategies
  • Tune vector quantization strategies (PQ, SQ, Binary Quantization) to reduce memory footprint and improve search throughput without compromising retrieval precision
  • Own performance SLAs and monitor retrieval systems for latency, throughput, recall, and cost efficiency
  Production Systems, Pipeline Engineering & APIs
  • Build and maintain scalable batch and streaming pipelines, with logging, metrics, and alerting to surface anomalies and maintain observability
  • Process content at scale using distributed frameworks such as Spark or Ray
  • Architect and build scalable integration layers on top of vector databases, exposing robust APIs and services for similarity search, hybrid retrieval, and metadata filtering
  • Own model versioning and embedding migration strategies, building compatibility tooling that prevents embedding drift from degrading retrieval quality across model upgrades
  • Collaborate with backend and platform teams to ensure interoperability with upstream data pipelines and integration with downstream personalization and discovery surfaces
  Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration
  • Communicate technical system behavior, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor direct reports, providing technical guidance in multimodal ML, vector retrieval, and production systems design
  • Take ownership of project outcomes from scoping through delivery in a dynamic environment, proactively identifying and mitigating risks across video processing, metadata, and indexing workflows


Basic Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, with a focus on production ML systems
  • Expertise in multimodal ML, including experience with video, image, and/or audio embedding models
  • Deep knowledge of vector embedding generation, storage and retrieval, with preference for hands-on Qdrant experience (FAISS, Pinecone, Pgvector, AlloyDB or similar also considered)
  • Strong Python proficiency; Java is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating data pipelines at scale, including batch and streaming ingestion workflows
  • Solid understanding of hybrid retrieval systems: vector search, lexical search, and reranking
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and partner effectively with product and engineering teams
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions in a team setting


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic systems and multi-agent orchestration
  • Knowledge of Diversity & Relevance algorithms such as Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) within the re-ranking phase
  • Background in video codecs, FFmpeg, or low-level video processing pipelines
  • Awareness with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems

Job Title: Lead ML Engineer
Team: Technology - Enterprise Solutions
Location: Los Angeles (Burbank)

Overview
Paramount’s Platforms & Intelligent Automation team (Enterprise Solutions & Technology) is building a knowledge layer for the company. This layer helps AI agents and decision-makers access important information. It includes titles and content, rights and contracts, talent and participants, and other business data that connects them. As our Lead Machine Learning Engineer for Enterprise Knowledge Graph & Ontology, you will design Paramount’s enterprise ontology and knowledge graphs. You will build machine learning systems to ensure these graphs are precise. This includes tasks like entity resolution, LLM-based information extraction, and graph learning. You will also deploy models and graph services. This will help create knowledge-grounded AI agents. They will have a consistent and semantically linked view of the business. You will set the technical direction for this program. This includes data modeling, MLOps, and production operations. You will work autonomously, with minimal oversight. Close collaboration with data owners, enterprise architects, and agent developers across Enterprise Solutions & Technology and the business units will be key.

Key Responsibilities
● Enterprise ontology and semantic modeling (25%). Design and manage Paramount’s enterprise ontology and domain models. This includes content and title hierarchies. It also covers rights and obligations, talent and participants, organizations, deals, and financial and operational entities. Ensure that all of these align with industry standards. You make the modeling decisions; enterprise-wide changes are ratified with data owners and architecture review.
● Knowledge graph construction and entity resolution (25%). Build scalable pipelines that control both structured and unstructured systems. This includes structured data from rights management, ERP, contract and talent systems, and metadata catalogs. It also includes unstructured sources like contracts, scripts, and documents. The goal is to create knowledge graphs using platforms like Spanner Graph, Neo4j, or Amazon Neptune. Use machine learning for entity resolution and record linkage, along with LLM-based information extraction and data quality scoring. Manage the master-identity process to align entities across these systems.
● Advanced machine learning on graphs (20%). Develop, evaluate, and deploy graph-based learning techniques. These techniques include node and link prediction, graph neural networks, and graph embeddings. Work on predictive and semantic search as well. This includes GraphRAG retrieval, which supports knowledge-grounded agents. Additionally, set the evaluation methodology. Establish the quality standards for the program.
● MLOps and production knowledge services (15%). Use Vertex AI Pipelines and MLflow to productionize models and graph services. Implement versioning and use feature stores. Set up automated evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection. Share knowledge through well-governed APIs and MCP tools. Make sure agent applications can use these tools while meeting security, privacy, and audit requirements.
● Stakeholder partnership and program management (10%). Partner with Rights, Finance, Content Operations, and Talent business leads. Work with engineers in enterprise data governance and AI platforms. Define key questions and service levels. Create a plan. Translate requirements for offshore and vendor data engineers, and review their work.
● Standards, reuse and mentorship (5%). Establish modeling standards, reusable graph and ML components and documentation; mentor engineers and data scientists in knowledge engineering and graph machine learning.
● Ad hoc. Perform various ad hoc projects as needed, including executive proofs-of-concept and evaluation of emerging graph, retrieval and model capabilities.

Required Qualifications
● 8+ years of experience in machine learning, data, or software engineering, including 3+ years building knowledge graphs, semantic data models, or entity-resolution systems in production.
● Expertise in Python and SQL, and proficiency with ML frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow, plus scikit-learn).
● Hands-on experience with at least one graph database (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph) and one graph query language (Cypher/GQL, SPARQL, or Gremlin).
● Robust knowledge of ontology and semantic-web standards (RDF, OWL, SHACL, SKOS) and/or property-graph modeling, with experience turning business concepts into governed, versioned models.
● Proven experience with entity resolution at scale (e.g., probabilistic or embedding-based matching, Splink, Zingg, Senzing) and LLM-based information extraction from documents.
● Hands-on experience with graph machine learning is required. This includes working on graph embeddings and link prediction using PyTorch Geometric or DGL. Experience with classical predictive modeling is also needed. Involving thorough offline and online evaluation.
● Experience deploying ML on a major cloud (Google Cloud preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable) with MLOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, model registry, and monitoring.
● Proficient communication skills: able to gather requirements from business experts, document models clearly, and present trade-offs to senior stakeholders. Experience working with distributed or offshore teams is a plus.
● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science or a related field, or equivalent applicable experience.

Preferred Qualifications
● Media and entertainment experience (e.g., rights and royalties, content metadata, distribution and avails) or experience with rights-management platforms.
● Experience with GraphRAG, including hybrid retrieval (vector search plus graph traversal) and connecting knowledge to agent frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, LangGraph) via MCP.  
● Experience with master data management and data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, Google Dataplex), and with data-product or data-mesh delivery.
● Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning or Information Science; publications, patents or open-source contributions in knowledge graphs, NLP or graph ML.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans.
