Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

 

Job Title: Sr. ML Platform Engineer
Department: Data & Insight Group
Location: New York City, Los Angeles, San Francisco

 

We are seeking a Sr. ML Platform Engineer who is excited to deploy MLOps products that shape business strategy, optimize content, inform marketing investment decisions, and enhance the user experience. You will build the foundations of our ML platform that will enable the Data Science team to deploy models at web scale data driving interactions with millions of customers across the globe. Specific projects will include designing the ML Ops platform and Agentic AI layer that will enable the Data Science team to scale their model deployments and automate analytical workflows. Success in this role requires a strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), comfort writing production-quality code in a collaborative environment, effective communication with Data Science team and stakeholders, and a team player who is excited to design and develop the MLOps deployment that will enable the team to multiply their impact.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Design and implement our greenfield ML platform and suite of analytical AI agents, 10Xing the Data Science team’s impact.

  • Work closely with Data Scientists to understand their development needs

  • Work closely with Stakeholders to understand the business problems driving model deployments, translating complex models into self-serve, LLM-callable tools that augment stakeholder workflows.

  • Assess and integrate cutting-edge software and practices in Data Science and MLOps.

  • Refactor disjointed data science scripts and workflows into modular 'skills' that act as procedural knowledge for AI agents, streamlining stakeholder interactions. 

Key Projects:

  • Manage deployment and contribute to models driving Paramount+’s global, financial forecasts 

  • Design and implement Paramount’s model deployment platform

  • Design and implement robust monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability of ML deployments

  • Design and implement UIs and natural-language AI agents that enable a variety of stakeholders to intuitively interact with DS models.

  • Drive adoption of best practices for CI/CD workflows tailored to Data Science & Agentic Workflows

  • Drive adoption of agentic workflows (e.g., automated SQL generation, variance diagnostics, model post-mortems) across Data Science and the larger Paramount organization.

Qualifications:

You Have:

  • 5+ years experience in Data Science and ML Engineering.

  • Deep experience developing as a team using Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Docker, & Kubernetes

  • Deep experience designing and implementing MLOps platforms and multi-agent systems in a cloud environment.

  • Deep experience implementing CI/CD workflows that manage model deployments

  • Experience developing containerized applications

  • Ability to innovate without over-engineering

  • Familiarity with well-known statistical and ML models and methods

  • Strong detail orientation with a penchant for deployment reliability

  • Must successfully pass a background check

 

You might also have:

  • Experience integrating LLMs into existing business processes and creating tools using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Experience developing APIs

  • Experience using Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, ML Engine, and APIs).

job.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
job.description:
Job Title

Senior Technical Product Manager

Job Description

About The Position

We're seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the product strategy for our knowledge graph and content platform that connects People Inc.'s content, taxonomy, usage rights, and audience signals across 30+ brands, reaching over 100M users monthly. Alongside our content system of record, it powers discovery, personalization, and editorial tooling through GraphQL APIs, search and indexing, and vector-based retrieval. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering and product strategy: building scalable, reusable, self-service capabilities that let other teams ship faster without custom work from us.

As a senior IC partner to the engineering leads of Graphene Foundation, Graphene Services, and Search, you will define and champion the roadmap for core platform capabilities and shape how our services are consumed by both developers and AI agents. Success requires technical depth, strong product judgment, and the ability to balance long-term architectural coherence with the tactical needs of consuming teams. This role reports to VP of Product, Core Platform.


Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.
 

About The Positions Contributions:

Strategic Roadmapping

  • Define and maintain a roadmap across the Foundation (content store, GraphQL engine), Services (APIs, relationships, taxonomy, validation), and Search (indexing, site search, internal search) sub-teams, aligned with company goals and engineering priorities.
  • Prioritize investments against the platform's guiding principles: a connected foundation, trust and transparency, enabling intelligence, and self-service.
  • Make deliberate tradeoffs, focusing as much on what not to build as what to include.
  • Define and track platform leverage metrics, such as team adoption, time to first integration, engineering hours saved, search relevance and latency.

Platform-as-a-Product Thinking

  • Champion the platform as a product, not a set of endpoints, through careful, opinionated curation.
  • Avoid the "feature shop" trap by recognizing patterns across brand and team requests and designing extensible, self-service capabilities, such as a generic relationship service that can link data from many sources.

Cross-Org Orchestration

  • Lead multi-team initiatives that span platform engineering, editorial, Data Science and consuming program teams.
  • Partner with editorial, legal, and rights stakeholders as the platform becomes the source of truth for asset rights, attribution, and lineage.
  • Serve as the connective tissue between teams, aligning stakeholders around shared technical outcomes and influencing without authority.

Internal Developer Experience

  • Treat internal product development teams as primary customers, improving API and schema usability, documentation, and onboarding.
  • Lower the barrier to entry so external teams can integrate without hands-on support from our team.
  • Build strong feedback loops and solve real developer pain points with empathy and insight.
  • Shape agent-ready interfaces, such as MCP servers for search, that let other teams and AI agents use our capabilities on a self-service basis with appropriate access controls and guardrails.

Operational Excellence

  • Partner with engineering to ensure reliability, stability, and performance of GraphQL, indexing, and retrieval services as data volume and audience-signal complexity grow.
  • Champion SLOs, observability, and data quality as foundational product attributes, and treat maintenance and stability as first-class roadmap work.


 

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:


Education: Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, and/or equivalent experience.


Experience: 5+ years in product management, including 3+ years owning platform, API, data, or developer-facing products in a B2B or internal tools setting.


Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Strong technical fluency with API-driven platforms, including GraphQL or similar schema-based APIs, data modeling, and distributed system tradeoffs; able to read schemas and technical designs and challenge them constructively.
  • Working knowledge of search and retrieval systems, including indexing, relevance, and vector databases; experience with knowledge graphs, taxonomy, or metadata systems is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with LLM application patterns and emerging agentic tooling, such as MCP, and a point of view on how platform services should be exposed to AI agents.
  • Proven success leading technical products that span multiple teams or business units.
  • Deep fluency in partnering with engineers on architecture, tradeoffs, and system design.
  • Track record of avoiding reactive build cycles by thoughtfully prioritizing platform focus and extensibility.
  • Ability to define and use data to measure platform outcomes, including adoption, reliability, and developer satisfaction.
  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, able to influence without authority and translate technical tradeoffs for senior engineering, editorial, and business stakeholders.

Job Description

The Benefits Manager will assist with the design, implementation, administration, and promotion of our employee benefits programs across People Incorporated. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Benefits, this individual will collaborate to ensure that People Incorporated’s benefit offerings remain highly competitive, fully compliant with regulations, and aligned with overall organizational goals. This role requires an experienced professional with vendor management expertise and project management skills to support benefit initiatives, manage partner relationships, and drive program rollouts.


The position is based in the New York City corporate headquarters and is hybrid in-office with the ability to work remotely up to 2 days per week.


About The Position

Benefits Strategy & Administration

  • Manage employee benefits programs across the People Incorporated portfolio, including healthcare, life/disability, 401(k), voluntary benefits, and leave management.
  • Serve as an escalation point for employee benefit questions, policy interpretations, and operational concerns.
  • Evaluate existing benefit vendors and assist with RFPs and implementations as needed.
  • Oversee the annual open enrollment process, including plan design decisions, benefits administration system testing, multi-channel communications, onsite events, and employee education.

Vendor Management & Strategic Partnerships

  • Manage benefit vendor relationships, brokers, consultants, and administration partners to ensure all issues are escalated and resolved quickly and appropriately.
  • Assist with monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for benefit vendors, ensuring high-quality execution, accountability, and continuous performance review.
  • Lead benefits billing for multiple vendors including tracking administrative and claims costs and managing the intercompany billing process.
  • Act as a key contact point for vendor service issues, financial reconciliations, and operational discrepancies.

Job Title

Principal Designer

Job Description


About The Position:


People Inc. is looking for a Principal Designer to take on some of the company’s most varied, visible, and important work.


You’ll work directly with the Chief Communications Officer and Chief Design Officer on the work that most visibly represents People Inc.: our events, our brand identity, our sites, what we put in front of investors, and the spaces we work in. Much of it has no precedent, so not every project starts with a defined brief. You’ll collaborate with leadership to frame the problem, and along with the Senior Creative Director, develop the concept and creative direction and bring it to life.


That means pairing ambitious creative thinking with close attention to the details that make the work successful. For events, you’ll work directly with vendors, production companies, and internal partners to carry the design through production, and stay involved through on-site execution. You’ll bring fresh ideas for what our events can be and the resourcefulness to make the most of the budget, spaces, materials, and time available.


You’ll lead other designers and outside partners project by project while staying hands-on. This is a role for someone highly experienced and influential who loves making the work and seeing it through.


In-office Expectations: At least three days per week at our 225 Liberty Street headquarters in New York City.


About The Team:

_____________________________________________________________________________


The Design Group at People Inc. brings together multiple teams supporting Revenue Design, Brand & Editorial Design, Product & UX Design, Design Systems, Creative Operations, Transactional Creative, and Events.

job.description:
Remote Account Manager/Sales – Inside Sales & Advertising

Remote | Existing Account Management | Customer Retention & New Business

Company: LocaliQ, powered by USA TODAY Co.Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)Start Date: January 11, 2027

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by combining trusted local media, advanced marketing technology, and expert guidance to deliver measurable results. From digital advertising solutions to the reach of the USA TODAY Network, we help businesses connect with the right customers and grow with confidence.

As an Account Manager, you'll play an important role in helping local businesses succeed by building lasting customer relationships, maintaining existing advertising accounts, and identifying opportunities to expand their advertising reach.

About the Role

We're looking for a motivated, customer-focused sales professional who enjoys building relationships, managing an established book of business, and working in a fast-paced, high-activity sales environment.

This position is primarily focused on managing and retaining existing customer accounts (approximately 80% of your time), with the remaining 20% dedicated to new business development. You'll work with an assigned portfolio of customers, primarily supporting basic classified advertising needs, while ensuring accounts remain active, customers receive consistent communication, and opportunities for additional business are identified.

This is a phone-driven role that requires consistent daily outreach, strong follow-up habits, and the ability to manage multiple customer conversations throughout the day. While much of your focus will be on maintaining existing relationships, you'll also be expected to prospect for new business when opportunities arise.

During your first 90 days, you'll learn LocaliQ's products, advertising processes, and technology while developing the skills needed to confidently manage your assigned accounts. With structured onboarding, ongoing coaching, and support, you'll build a strong foundation for long-term success.

Why This Role Stands Out

Base salary of $40,000 plus uncapped commission, with first-year on-target earnings of $55,000–$60,000

Three-month commission guarantee to support your onboarding and ramp

Established book of business with a primary focus on customer retention and relationship management

Opportunity to identify additional revenue through upselling, account growth, and new business development

100% remote work arrangement with a dedicated home workstation

Ongoing sales training, coaching, and professional development

Recognition programs, contests, and performance incentives

Opportunity to build a long-term career with one of the nation's most trusted media organizations

Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, and more

What You Will Do

Manage an assigned portfolio of existing advertising customers, focusing primarily on account retention, satisfaction, and long-term relationships.

Maintain consistent communication with customers through a high volume of outbound and inbound calls, averaging 50+ calls per day.

Identify opportunities to retain customers, address concerns, and prevent account cancellations.

Recommend relevant advertising solutions and additional services based on customer needs.

Generate new business through outbound prospecting and follow-up when opportunities arise.

Manage short, transactional sales conversations with a focus on responsiveness, accuracy, and customer experience.

Process advertising orders, campaign updates, and customer requests efficiently.

Maintain accurate CRM activity, account information, and pipeline documentation using Salesforce and other sales tools.

Balance account management, prospecting, administrative responsibilities, and customer follow-up throughout the workday.

Partner with internal support teams to ensure a positive customer experience and successful advertising execution.

Qualifications

Previous experience in inside sales, account management, customer retention, advertising sales, or business development preferred.

Experience managing customer relationships or an established book of business is a plus.

Comfortable making 50+ outbound and inbound calls per day in a high-activity, metrics-driven environment.

Confident communicating with customers, identifying needs, handling objections, and recommending solutions.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, conversations, and follow-up activities.

Comfortable balancing customer retention responsibilities with occasional new business prospecting.

Ability to work independently while remaining accountable to daily activity and performance expectations.

Comfortable learning CRM platforms, sales technology, and multiple internal systems.

Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms is preferred but not required.

Who Thrives Here

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys the relationship side of sales just as much as the opportunity to generate revenue. They're comfortable managing an established customer base, making consistent outbound calls, following up on opportunities, and finding ways to keep customers engaged and satisfied.

Successful Account Managers are proactive, organized, resilient, and motivated by results. They understand that retaining customers requires consistent communication, strong follow-through, and the ability to recognize opportunities before they are missed.

Candidates with backgrounds in high-volume inside sales, advertising sales, customer retention, or account management environments will be particularly well-suited for this role. Experience in transactional, phone-based sales organizations is especially valuable.

This is not a passive account management position. While the primary focus is on maintaining and growing existing relationships, success requires a willingness to make calls, manage activity expectations, and pursue new business when needed.

Remote Work Expectations

This is a fully remote position, with the expectation that employees work from their assigned, dedicated home workstation throughout their scheduled workday.

Employees must:

Perform their work from their designated home workstation using company-issued equipment.

Remain at their assigned workstation and be available throughout scheduled working hours.

Use company-approved systems and technology to perform their job responsibilities.

Maintain a consistent, professional, and productive remote work environment.

This position does not offer a work-from-anywhere arrangement. Working from alternate locations, using personal devices in place of company-issued equipment, or downloading unauthorized applications onto personal devices is not permitted.

Benefits

We believe great performance deserves meaningful rewards, career development, and opportunities for growth.

Base salary plus uncapped commission

Three-month commission guarantee

Fully remote work environment

Career advancement opportunities

Medical, dental, and vision insurance

401(k) with company match

Generous paid time off and paid holidays

Ongoing onboarding, training, and coaching

High-performance culture with recognition and incentive programs

Access to industry-leading marketing solutions and sales technology

Interested in building customer relationships, growing accounts, and making an impact in a fast-paced sales environment? Apply today!

The hourly rate for this role will range between $17.00 and $19.24. Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable

job.title: Video Journalist
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

 

The Associated Press seeks a nimble and enterprising video journalist to cover breaking news in Los Angeles, California. We’re looking for a creative visual storyteller with demonstrated experience independently reporting, shooting, editing and transmitting video, covering live events, writing text stories and making still photographs for news organizations. You’ll join a team delivering accurate, competitive coverage for national and global audiences across digital, mobile and broadcast platforms. This is a newsgathering staff position within U.S. News, covered by AP’s agreement with the News Media Guild.   Responsibilities: You’ll shoot, edit and produce video, including live video, and contribute substantive reporting across formats. You’ll independently gather and verify facts, conduct interviews, write breaking news updates and text stories, and make news photographs with accurate captions. You’ll set up and transmit live video from the field, coordinate feeds with receiving editors, monitor picture and sound, and resolve routine connection and signal problems. You’ll pitch, develop and research distinctive stories, collaborating with colleagues across text, photo, video, audio, digital/social, interactive and graphics. You may occasionally help edit and produce live video, affiliate contributions and video from other AP journalists. Covering extreme weather across California and elsewhere is an essential responsibility. This position requires travel to a variety of news events, sometimes with little to no advance notice, and reports to the US Assistant News Director overseeing California.   Required Qualifications:
  • At least three years of professional electronic newsgathering (ENG) and field videojournalism experience for a broadcast station, news agency, digital news outlet, newspaper or comparable news organization. Candidates must demonstrate direct responsibility for reporting, shooting, editing and filing news video under deadline. A bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience is required separately.
  • Demonstrated experience covering live events and fast-moving general breaking news, including severe weather, wildfires or other emergencies. Candidates must be able to identify the news, verify conflicting information, interview sources and explain the significance of local developments to national and global audiences.
  • Advanced professional competency in independently shooting news video with professional equipment, including manual control of focus, exposure and white balance, strong composition and visual sequencing, interview lighting and recording and monitoring clear interview audio and natural sound.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard editing software such as DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with demonstrated ability to independently edit and transmit complete news packages and rapid updates to technical specifications under deadline.
  • Professional experience delivering live video and transmitting recorded material from the field using LiveU or comparable transmission systems, with the ability to coordinate coverage with receiving editors as news develops.
  • Demonstrated experience reporting and writing text stories for news organizations. Candidates must independently gather and verify information, conduct interviews, and write clear, accurate breaking news updates and complete news stories for editing. Contributing information to another reporter’s story alone does not demonstrate the required writing experience.
  • Demonstrated experience making still photographs for news organizations. Candidates must produce editorially usable news images, control focus and exposure, select and transmit photographs under deadline, and write accurate captions identifying people, locations and events.
  • Excellent news writing and scripting skills, advanced professional competency in written and spoken English, and experience or demonstrated ability to present accurate reporting on camera and/or on audio as assignments require.
  • Proven ability to make sound editorial decisions, manage competing priorities and deliver accurate coverage under deadline pressure. Strong organization, visual creativity, calmness under pressure, curiosity and a collaborative approach to producing trusted journalism are essential.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain sources, report across communities and quickly build working knowledge of California’s institutions and major news issues.
  • Ability and willingness to travel to assignments, sometimes with little to no advance notice, and work nights and weekends as news demands.
  • Ability to carry and operate video equipment and work for extended periods in varied terrain and weather conditions, with or without reasonable accommodation. AP will provide necessary protective equipment, safety training and ergonomic support.
  • All applicants must be able to work in the U.S. or be able to gain permission to do so.
  • You’ll pursue innovative and inclusive coverage while maintaining AP’s standards for accuracy, integrity and objectivity.
  Preferred Qualifications:

California reporting experience, existing California sources, experience in a global-news environment, longer-term enterprise work across formats, innovative digital storytelling and professional competency in a language besides English are preferred.

 

Why join us:

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success. 
  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals. 
  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions. 

 

This position is covered by The Associated Press’ contract with the News Media Guild, which provides for an annual salary range of $55,349.32 to $88,197.20, based on location and years of professional experience. Additional compensation is negotiable based on a job candidate’s skills, qualifications and market location. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:  
  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Retirement benefits
  • Company paid life insurance
  • Paid vacation and sick days
  • Paid parental leave for any new parent
  • Mental well-being resources

 

Application deadline is December 2, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET.

 

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Senior Systems Engineer
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

  • The Senior Systems Engineer helps keep The Washington Post’s identity, collaboration, endpoint, and core IT service platforms secure, reliable, and available.
  • This role serves as a senior technical resource for Identity and Access Management, supporting Active Directory, Okta, single sign-on, and automated user-lifecycle processes.
  • Through hands-on systems engineering, administration, integration, and automation, this role improves the reliability and efficiency of technology services used across the organization.
  • Working with IT Operations, Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, HR, and other partners, this role helps translate operational and security requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • As an individual contributor, this role provides technical guidance and project leadership but does not have formal people-management responsibilities.

What Motivates You

  • You enjoy solving complex systems and infrastructure problems through careful analysis and hands-on technical work.
  • You are interested in identity management, enterprise platforms, automation, and secure service delivery.
  • You look for practical ways to reduce manual work, improve reliability, and strengthen operational controls.
  • You take pride in building solutions that are documented, supportable, and sustainable for the broader team.
  • You are comfortable responding to immediate operational needs while continuing to improve the underlying systems and processes.
  • You enjoy collaborating with cybersecurity professionals, administrators, engineers, and business partners to solve shared problems.
  • You value sharing your knowledge and helping colleagues develop their technical capabilities.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Administer and improve Identity and Access Management services, including Active Directory, Okta, single sign-on, multifactor authentication, and role-based access, supporting secure and reliable access to enterprise systems.
  • Design and implement automated provisioning, deprovisioning, and access-change workflows within established security and platform standards, improving the accuracy and timeliness of identity administration.
  • Develop and maintain integrations among platforms such as Workday, Okta, Active Directory, Google Workspace, Proofpoint, and ServiceNow, improving the consistency of data and service workflows.
  • Engineer and support assigned enterprise platforms, which may include Google Workspace, storage and collaboration services, endpoint-management tools, asset-management systems, and ITSM platforms, maintaining reliable day-to-day operations.
  • Use APIs, scripting, and systems-management tools to automate recurring administrative and operational processes, reducing manual effort and preventable errors.
  • Troubleshoot complex incidents involving identity, access, integrations, endpoints, systems administration, and enterprise applications, restoring service and identifying corrective actions.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity and Compliance to implement approved security configurations, access controls, and remediation plans, reducing identity and infrastructure risk.
  • Support the technical implementation of data-retention requirements, legal holds, and e-discovery requests in partnership with Legal, Cybersecurity, and designated data owners, ensuring requests are executed accurately and securely.
  • Contribute technical expertise to system upgrades, platform changes, integration projects, and service improvements, helping projects meet operational, security, and delivery requirements.
  • Maintain system documentation, technical procedures, integration records, and operational runbooks, improving service continuity and reducing reliance on individual knowledge.
  • Recommend improvements to system configurations, workflows, and working methods, strengthening the effectiveness and reliability of the IT Operations team.
  • Provide technical guidance, cross-training, and mentoring to engineers and administrators, helping colleagues resolve issues and work effectively within established standards.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Five or more years of relevant experience in systems engineering, systems administration, enterprise infrastructure, Identity and Access Management, or a related discipline.
  • Advanced knowledge of Active Directory, Okta, SSO integrations, multifactor authentication, access provisioning, and role-based access controls.
  • Experience administering Google Workspace in a large or complex environment, including experience with the Google Admin SDK, OAuth, and service accounts.
  • Hands-on experience integrating enterprise systems, SaaS applications, IAM tools, HR platforms, or IT service-management platforms.
  • Proficiency in at least one relevant scripting language, such as Python, JavaScript, Bash, PowerShell, or Google Apps Script.
  • Experience working with REST APIs and troubleshooting system-to-system integrations.
  • Practical experience implementing identity, endpoint, configuration, or access controls in partnership with cybersecurity or compliance teams.
  • Experience supporting ITSM, CMDB, asset-management, endpoint-management, storage, or enterprise collaboration platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including the ability to identify root causes and resolve issues involving multiple systems.
  • Ability to manage assigned projects and technical work independently while recognizing when decisions or risks require escalation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues and recommendations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience creating technical documentation, operational procedures, and support runbooks.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance and mentoring without formal supervisory authority.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, or other modern systems-engineering practices is preferred.
  • Experience supporting legal holds, e-discovery, data retention, or information-governance processes is preferred.
  • A bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, certifications, training, and practical experience.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$108,700 - $181,100 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

job.title: Manager, FP&A - Revenue & Growth
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Manager, FP&A – Revenue & Growth is a key finance business partner supporting The Washington Post’s B2C digital subscription, B2B revenue, and emerging growth initiatives. This role translates business performance, market dynamics, and operating decisions into clear financial insight that helps leaders invest wisely, manage risk, and build sustainable revenue.

Reporting within the FP&A organization, the Manager leads planning, forecasting, and performance analysis for assigned revenue businesses while developing financial talent and strengthening the tools, processes, and partnerships that support informed decision-making across the company.

 

What Motivates You

  • You are energized by helping mission-driven media organizations build durable, diversified revenue models.
  • You enjoy translating complex financial and operating data into clear insights that guide decisions.
  • You value collaborative partnership with leaders across Product, Marketing, Sales, Newsroom, Data Analytics & Insights, and Finance.
  • You are motivated by improving planning processes, models, and reporting so teams can act with greater clarity and confidence.
  • You take pride in developing financial talent and creating an inclusive, accountable team environment.

 

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Lead annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-range plans for assigned revenue streams, producing aligned financial plans that support enterprise priorities and growth goals.
  • Develop driver-based revenue models that connect pricing, volume, pipeline, customer behavior, and other operating metrics to reliable financial outcomes.
  • Analyze actual revenue performance against budget and forecast, identifying variance drivers, risks, opportunities, and outlook changes that enable timely leadership action.
  • Advise business leaders on operating performance, investment choices, and resource-allocation decisions, resulting in actionable recommendations grounded in financial and strategic analysis.
  • Evaluate new products, partnerships, pricing strategies, and growth initiatives through business cases, scenario analyses, and financial models, enabling informed decisions on investments and tradeoffs.

This role provides dedicated people and delivery leadership for the team while partnering closely with Android, Staff Engineering, Product, and shared engineering teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences quickly and predictably.


This is a hands-on engineering management role. The Manager, Software Development will set priorities and assignments, develop engineers, remove blockers, identify delivery risks early, and establish clear accountability for delivering approved work to readers, while remaining close enough to the technology to guide difficult engineering decisions. The manager is expected to write code, build prototypes, and review pull requests on a regular basis, and will partner with Staff Engineers and feature leads to verify progress, identify misalignment, and follow work through to release.


The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with deep iOS engineering knowledge, sound technical judgment, and a disciplined approach to execution. This manager will help the team ship faster while maintaining the architecture, performance, reliability, quality, and technical health readers expect from The Washington Post’s flagship mobile experience. The role is data-driven: priorities, estimates, improvements, and results are tracked against agreed baselines and measured by evidence, such as time to users, commitments met, blocker resolution time, and app stability and performance, not by activity or opinion.


What Motivates You

  • You want to help bring The Washington Post’s journalism to readers through high-quality mobile experiences.
  • You measure success by the value delivered to users and how quickly it reaches them.
  • You develop engineers through direct feedback and clear expectations, and you judge your impact by their growth.

  • You want to stay technically hands-on, writing code, prototyping, and reviewing pull requests to solve problems, evaluate approaches, and stay connected to the systems your team builds.
  • You care deeply about mobile architecture, application quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability.

  • You enjoy building AI agents and automation that solve real mobile engineering problems, and you care about proving that they work and that people actually use them.
  • You stay current on the iOS ecosystem, including new Apple platform releases, Swift language and concurrency changes, and AI-assisted development in Xcode, and you know which changes are worth adopting and when.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Lead and develop the software engineers responsible for The Washington Post’s iOS app, providing timely feedback, career development, performance management, and coaching that builds independent ownership and accountability.
  • Establish priorities and assignments, set delivery baselines, and track progress against estimates through to availability for users. Report on measures such as time to users, commitments met by the agreed date, and blocker resolution time, and surface material delivery risks early with clear facts, tradeoffs, and decisions needed.
  • Address performance concerns promptly and directly, set clear expectations, and confirm that behavior and results improve.
  • Partner with the Android Manager, Staff Engineers, Product, feature leads, and shared teams to sequence work, resolve dependencies and blockers, and keep mobile initiatives aligned without taking over others’ ownership.
  • Provide technical leadership across iOS architecture and development in partnership with Staff Engineers, helping the team make sound decisions on application design, performance, testing, maintainability, and platform best practices across Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Objective-C, and Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).
  • Track changes in the iOS ecosystem, including new Apple OS releases and design updates, Swift and Swift Concurrency evolution, and agentic and AI-assisted tooling in Xcode, and turn them into clear recommendations on what the team should adopt, when, and at what cost.
  • Stay hands-on by writing code, building prototypes, and reviewing pull requests to solve technical problems, evaluate approaches, and set the quality bar for the team.
  • Establish and reinforce engineering practices that support robust testing, code quality, application performance, reliable releases, and the long-term health of the iOS platform.
  • Identify bottlenecks, unnecessary work, technical debt, and opportunities to improve engineering processes and productivity, setting a baseline before each change and measuring the benefit afterward against its cost, rework, and any regressions.
  • Partner with Product and engineering leadership to balance reader experience, business priorities, delivery commitments, and long-term technical health.

Verify their output, keep human accountability for decisions, and measure whether they remove delay and effort or only move it.

  • BA/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of professional native iOS development experience with the iOS SDK, including Swift and modern iOS tools and frameworks, and experience building and releasing production mobile applications.
  • Substantial experience writing production iOS code and designing app architecture, including modular design, concurrency, performance, and testable code, with the ability to review pull requests and architecture proposals at a senior level, evaluate tradeoffs, and diagnose and fix defects.
  • Experience directly managing software engineers, including coaching, career development, and performance management, with a record of timely, specific feedback and of coaching engineers toward independent ownership.
  • Experience leading complex engineering work from planning and estimation through implementation, testing, release, and production support, including setting priorities, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks, and revising forecasts as evidence changes.

job.title: Director, Business Intelligence

We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Director of Business Intelligence

CD Baby | A Virgin Music Group Company

Full-Time | Los Angeles, CA / Nashville, TN / New York, NY | Remote Considered

The Opportunity

As Director of Business Intelligence, you will define and own the strategy and roadmap for making data accessible, trusted, and actionable across CD Baby. You’ll establish the metrics that matter most, drive data normalization across teams, and build the infrastructure that enables self-service insights at scale.

You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Finance, Data Engineering and stakeholders across the company to prioritize the highest-impact KPIs, ensure consistent definitions across the organization, and embed data into how decisions get made.

This role is both strategic and hands-on: you’ll architect the BI function while also building dashboards, leading analyses, and translating complex data into clear business recommendations.

What You'll Do

Define the BI Strategy & Roadmap

• Establish a company-wide BI vision and multi-quarter roadmap.

• Standardize core metrics and KPIs across business, product and technology teams.

• Prioritize the highest-impact insights that drive growth, retention, and artist success.

• Build scalable and self-service reporting that reduces ad hoc dependency.

• Evaluate and deploy AI-enabled analytics tools that scale insight generation and reduce dependency on manual reporting

Drive Customer & Product Insights

• Lead segmentation, cohort analysis, lifetime value modeling, and churn analysis.

• Identify growth opportunities, at-risk artists, and high-value segments.

• Define and measure success metrics for new product and feature launches.

• Support experimentation and A/B testing with rigorous statistical analysis.

• Analyze streaming consumption, revenue, and audience trends across digital platforms to identify opportunities for artist growth, monetization, and business performance.

Build Data Analytics Models

• Partner with Data Engineering to continuously improve data quality, modeling, and governance.

• Own the business-facing analytics layer, building scalable data models, reporting infrastructure, and self-service tools that enable trusted, actionable insights across the organization.

Description

Français:
Amazon Music est un service de divertissement audio immersif qui connecte les fans, les artistes et les créateurs. Des playlists personnalisées aux podcasts exclusifs, en passant par la diffusion de concerts en direct et les produits dérivés des artistes, Amazon Music innove à l’intersection entre musique et culture. Nous proposons des expériences adaptées à tous les auditeurs grâce à nos différentes offres: les membres Prime bénéficient d'un accès sans publicité à l'ensemble du catalogue musical en mode aléatoire, ainsi qu'aux meilleurs podcasts sans publicité, le tout inclus dans leur abonnement; les clients peuvent opter pour Amazon Music Unlimited afin d'accéder en illimité et à la demande à 100 millions de titres, dont des millions en HD, Ultra HD et audio spatial ; enfin, chacun peut écouter de la musique gratuitement en téléchargeant l'application Amazon Music ou via des appareils compatibles avec Alexa. Rejoignez-nous pour contribuer à façonner la manière dont Amazon Music interagit avec les fans, les artistes et les créateurs à l'échelle mondiale.

Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable de programme (Program Manager) maîtrisant le français (langue maternelle ou niveau C2). Vous intégrerez notre équipe International Product, responsable de l'expérience client dans les nombreux pays où Amazon Music est présent. Vous contribuerez à améliorer le quotidien de nos clients francophones et à définir les exigences linguistiques pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités d'Amazon Music qui améliorent leur expérience musicale. Vos missions consisteront notamment à analyser et résoudre les problèmes rencontrés par les clients, à identifier les lacunes de l'expérience client (CX) via des audits de parcours et des workshops, à fournir un support produit et créer des rapports personnalisés pour les parties prenantes internes et externes, ainsi qu'à accompagner nos équipes mondiales Produit et QA (Assurance Qualité) pour tester l'expérience locale des nouvelles fonctionnalités. Nous recherchons une personne à l'aise avec les données et les produits technologiques pour prendre des décisions et proposer des améliorations de l'expérience client, et qui s'épanouit dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide.

English:
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music ad-free in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

We are looking for a Program Manager with native / C2 level proficiency in French. You will be part of our International Product Team that owns the customer experience in our vast number of Amazon Music supported countries around the world. You will help us improve the day-to-day experience of our French speaking customers and define language-specific requirements for new Amazon Music features that make it easier for customers to fall in love with music. Your focus will be to analyze and fix current customer issues, identify CX gaps by conducting walk-the-store and workshops, provide product support to and create customized reports for internal and external stakeholders, and support our global Product and QA teams to test the local experience of brand-new features. We're looking for someone who is comfortable working with data and technology products in order to make decisions and suggest improvements to the CX, and thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities
Français:
- Connaissance client : Vous adorez vous mettre à la place des clients, et êtes curieux(se) d'explorer les différentes manières dont ils consomment la musique. Vous tirez des enseignements des retours clients, des données d'utilisation et d'études externes, et alimentez la réflexion de nos chefs de produit grâce à des analyses ponctuelles ou des rapports hebdomadaires/mensuels sur l’expérience client.

- Gestion des problèmes : Vous gérez simultanément de nombreuses demandes ponctuelles, tout en priorisant et en résolvant les lacunes de l'expérience client, qu'elles soient internes ou externes. Vous simplifiez des problèmes complexes, produisez des rapports personnalisés grâce à votre capacité à analyser les données, et communiquez efficacement avec les chefs de produit ainsi qu'avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.

- Soutien au lancement de fonctionnalités : Vous incarnez la voix locale du client pour les nouvelles expériences Amazon Music. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes mondiales d'assurance qualité (QA) pour comprendre et vérifier l'expérience client locale. Vous communiquez vos conclusions de manière précise et orientée vers les solutions, tout en sachant trouver le juste équilibre entre rapidité d'exécution et obsession du client.

- Soutien éditorial : Vous travaillez avec les équipes éditoriales, de programmation de contenu et de relations avec les labels pour garantir une expérience produit optimale lors de nos campagnes marketing et artistiques. Vous conseillez sur l'expérience visée, puis définissez et mettez en œuvre des solutions créatives pour ravir nos clients.

- Benchmarking : Vous êtes l'expert(e) concernant l'expérience client du streaming musical local. Vous comparez notre produit à ceux d'autres fournisseurs internes et externes, et utilisez vos conclusions pour formuler des recommandations à nos chefs de produit.
- Gestion des parties prenantes: Vous collaborez avec un large éventail d'interlocuteurs clés, notamment les chefs de produit locaux et mondiaux, le service client, les ingénieurs QA, le marketing, la programmation de contenu et les équipes chargées des relations
avec les artistes et les labels.
- Gestion des processus : Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres chefs de programme et membres de l'équipe à l'élaboration de protocoles et de processus pour les mécanismes existants et futurs. Vous évaluez en permanence les outils et processus de collecte de données et proposez des solutions pour garantir leur efficacité, leur qualité et leur évolutivité.

- Adoption de l'IA : Vous identifiez des opportunités d'utiliser des outils d'IA pour optimiser et automatiser des processus tels que l'analyse de l'expérience client, le reporting et le tri des problèmes, réduisant ainsi la charge de travail manuel tout en étendant la couverture géographique. Vous restez à l'affût des capacités émergentes de l'IA et formulez des recommandations concrètes pour améliorer l'efficacité de l'équipe grâce à ces technologies.

English
- Customer Insights: You live and breathe customer insights, and are curious to explore the differences in how customers consume music. You derive insights from customer feedback, usage data, and external research, and provide input to our product managers through ad-hoc analyses or weekly/monthly CX reporting.

- Issue Management: You manage numerous ad hoc requests concurrently, and prioritize and resolve internal and external customer experience gaps. You simplify complex issues, provide customized reporting with the ability to understand and analyze data, and effectively communicate to product managers, internal and external stakeholders.

- Feature Launch Support: You are the local voice of the customer for new Amazon Music experiences. You work closely with global QA to understand and verify the local CX. Do you have an eye for detail? Are you looking to kickstart your journalism career in a 24/7 newsroom? Apply to be an Associate Producer at Spectrum News.

  

Part of Charter Communications, Spectrum News is made up of over 30 hyper-local news and regional sports networks that are constantly expanding and dedicated to producing original, unbiased, and high-quality content. We use innovative journalistic approaches, backed by comprehensive research, to engage and inform viewers on the most essential news, issues, and events taking place in their communities. 

 

Beyond TV news distribution, our newsrooms publish via the Spectrum News app and connected television. We’re committed to providing viewers with 24-hour news—no matter how, when and where they want it. Check out all the ways we share news on the Spectrum News Mobile App.


BE PART OF THE CONNECTION

As an Associate Producer, you will collaborate with producers in the newsroom to craft compelling stories. Alongside the team, you’ll represent what’s happening in your community and connect audiences with the stories that matter.

  • Transforming stories from a simple pitch into a hit that inspires and delights viewers

  • Connecting with neighbors as you dig into the issues that matter to your local community
  • Telling stories across platforms including TV, connected television, and digital

 

As a part of Spectrum News, you’re creative, highly technical, and ready to bring your community’s stories to life in our newsroom. job.title: Producer and Host, Morning Edition
job.description:
About WHYY

WHYY serves the Philadelphia region with trusted journalism, eye-opening storytelling and intimate local arts programming. Our curiosity and commitment to this community is what drives our programming. It’s also what drives our hiring.

 

Below you’ll find an employment opportunity in the fast-paced setting of the Philadelphia region’s leading public media provider. The award-winning professional staff of WHYY sets the bar high in television, radio and online. Whether it’s preparing a program to air or a behind-the-scenes role in support, all positions are vital to continuing—and growing—our impact in our community.

 

WHYY offers a voice to those not heard, a platform to share everyone’s stories, a foundation to empower early and lifelong learners and a trusted space for unbiased news. Learn more about our Social Responsibility Program. It’s how we live.

 

About the Role

 

This position elevates WHYY’s Morning Edition broadcast by creating a new role that will act as both an on-air voice and behind-the-scenes producer. Working closely with the lead Morning Edition host, the producer and host helps shape WHYY’s local presentation during morning drive by identifying timely stories and conversations, preparing interviews and program elements, and responding to breaking and developing news. The producer and host also provides dedicated support for story development, guest booking, live production, digital content, remote broadcasts, and special programming.

 

Working with the FM programming team, the producer and host creates and adapts content for broadcast, podcast, livestream, video, and social platforms. The role requires someone with multifaceted skills. They must have excellent journalistic judgement. They must excel as a conversational live broadcaster and thrive as a behind-the-scenes producer capable of booking guests and using audio production skills to ensure Morning Edition is relevant and dynamic.

 

Crucially, this all must be done while collaborating with the lead morning edition host to create an alluring, trusted and compelling program. The ideal candidate is curious, collaborative, organized, and creative, with strong editorial instincts and a talent for finding compelling stories and guests. They are comfortable working in a live environment, can pivot quickly as stories develop, and understand how to extend great radio content across platforms to reach new audiences. This position requires an early-morning schedule aligned with WHYY’s live Morning Edition broadcast. Shift hours will be 4a-12p.

 

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work closely with the lead Morning Edition host to plan and produce WHYY’s local presentation of the program, identifying timely stories, interviews, and content that strengthen the morning broadcast.
  • Monitor breaking and developing news, weather, traffic, and other information, responding quickly to changing program needs during the live broadcast.
  • Research, write, and edit local breaks, interview briefs, billboards, promotional copy, web content, and other materials supporting broadcast and digital distribution.
  • Identify and book compelling guests for Morning Edition and other FM Programming initiatives, coordinate interviews, schedules, and pre-production logistics
  • Produce live and recorded programming, including studio production, audio editing, control room support, livestream coordination, and timely delivery of assigned content
  • Research, develop, and pitch original story ideas for other FM Programming initiatives that reflect audience interests and the issues, people, and conversations shaping the region
  • Adapt and extend radio content across podcasts, livestreams, web, video, and social media to increase audience reach and engagement
  • Support the lead Morning Edition host’s presence beyond the daily broadcast, identifying opportunities for digital content, social video, special programming, community engagement, and other multi-platform initiatives
  • Help plan and produce remote broadcasts, live events, political forums, and community-based programming
  • Collaborate with WHYY News, Digital Studios, Audience Engagement, Communications, and other content teams to identify story opportunities and maximize the reach and impact of locally produced content
  • Use audience insights and platform performance to inform story selection, content development, and opportunities to better serve and grow audiences.
  • Stay current with emerging audio production tools, digital storytelling techniques, and audience engagement best practices; perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Candidates should have a strong interest in local and regional issues, current events, arts, culture, and the stories and conversations that matter to Greater Philadelphia audiences.

 

Experience: At least three years of experience in radio, audio, broadcast, podcast, or multimedia production. Experience working in a live production environment and under tight deadlines is strongly preferred. Candidates should have a proven ability to develop compelling story ideas, conduct thorough research, book and prepare guests, and produce engaging interviews and program content.

 

Technical Skills: Experience with professional audio editing software such as Pro Tools or comparable platforms. Familiarity with live studio production, digital publishing tools, content management systems, livestreaming, and social media platforms is preferred. Candidates should be comfortable learning and adapting to new production tools and technologies.

 

*This position is represented by SAG-AFTRA.

job.title: Senior Video Producer
job.description:
We create possibilities that move life and commerce forward

Welcome to Manhattan. Every day, our supply chain commerce technology connects two billion people to 20 billion consumer choices. In the warehouse, on the road and in the store, we make what was once impossible, possible. If you want to tackle complex problems and redefine markets, you’ve come to the right place.

The Opportunity:


Manhattan is building a more visible, more distinctive, and more dominant brand. Video sits at the center of that work, and we have a dedicated in-house studio to make it happen.


We are looking for a Senior Video Producer to own that studio and the video workflow that runs through it, from first setup to final export. This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable with a signal chain as they are with a timeline. You will keep the studio running, the cameras rolling, the streams live, and the edit moving. That covers interviews, podcasts, executive presentations, scripted pieces, social clips, and live broadcasts to audiences inside and outside the company. You will also help define how AI can improve our video workflow adopting tools that increase speed or quality without lowering the creative bar.


You will be equally comfortable building a multi-camera setup, fixing an audio problem five minutes before a stream goes live, cutting a two-minute highlight reel from two hours of footage, or making the case for a new tool. The work should be polished, reliable, and unmistakably Manhattan.



A Day in the Life:

Studio operations

•Own the day-to-day operation and upkeep of our in-house studio, including all camera, audio, and lighting equipment

•Set up, calibrate, and strike equipment for interviews, podcasts, presentations, scripted video, and live events

•Keep a current studio inventory, run maintenance schedules, and coordinate repairs and replacements

•Set technical standards for how the studio is used, and help the rest of the team follow them

Camera and audio

•Run professional cameras and multi-camera setups with consistent, broadcast-quality results

•Build and optimize audio signal chains, including microphones, mixers, preamps, interfaces, and monitoring, for studio and live use

•Troubleshoot issues quickly before, during, and after a shoot

Live streaming

•Plan and run live streams for internal and external audiences on YouTube, LinkedIn, Zoom, and other platforms

•Manage encoding, switching, graphics, and real-time monitoring during broadcasts

•Solve problems in real time so viewers never notice them

•Build repeatable runbooks for recurring live events

Editing and post-production

•Edit long-form video, short-form social clips, highlight reels, and event recaps with strong pacing and storytelling

•Handle color correction, audio mixing, motion graphics, and titles to a professional standard

•Keep projects, file names, and archives organized in shared storage

•Work with the creative team through review and approval to hit delivery dates

AI in the video pipeline

•Test and adopt AI tools across production and post, such as transcription and captions, clip selection, voice enhancement, background removal, and generative B-roll

•Recommend tools that improve speed or quality without lowering the creative bar, and share what you learn with the team

•Stay current on AI video and help shape how we build our production stack


What We need from You:


· 3 to 6 years of experience in a studio, broadcast, content production, or live events environment

· Hands-on skill with professional camera systems (Sony, Canon, Blackmagic, or similar) and multi-camera production

· A strong working knowledge of audio equipment and signal flow, including dynamic, condenser, and lavalier mics, mixers, interfaces, and DAW basics

· Experience running live streams with production software such as OBS, StreamYard, vMix, or Wirecast

· Expert editing skills in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve, plus a solid grasp of color grading, audio post, and motion graphics

· Real curiosity about AI video tools, and ideally hands-on experience with some of them

· Comfort working independently, managing several projects at once, and making technical calls on the fly

· Clear communication with creative, marketing, and technical partners


Nice to have

· Lighting design for studio and on-location shoots

· Teleprompter, green screen, or virtual set experience

· Motion graphics in After Effects or DaVinci Fusion

· A background in podcast production, webinar infrastructure, or broadcast news

· Experience with Vidyard for hosting, sharing, and tracking video


Tools You'll Use:

· Editing and post: Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve; After Effects or Fusion for motion graphics

· Live production: OBS, StreamYard, vMix, Wirecast, or similar

· AI-assisted production: tools such as Descript, Adobe Speech Enhance, Runway, ElevenLabs, and Gling

· Vidyard: video hosting, sharing, and viewer analytics

· Bynder: digital asset management for finished video and approved assets

Direct experience with these specific platforms is a plus. Fluency with comparable tools is what matters most.


Why Join Manhattan?

  • Competitive Rewards: Market-leading pay, comprehensive health coverage, and a 401(k) with 50% match up to 6% from day one.
  • Career Growth: Access Global Path, our structured development program with global opportunities, free LinkedIn Learning, and mentorship.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse team and Employee Connection Groups like Multicultural Network, LGBTQ+ Alliance, Women’s Initiative Network, and MA Mamas.
  • Flexibility & Balance: Hybrid work options, flexible policies, and onsite fitness centers to help you recharge.
  • Community Impact: Monthly volunteer events and opportunities to make a difference locally and globally.

#LI-CS1

Committed to diversity and inclusion

At Manhattan, it’s about more than just the work. From cultural celebrations to interest groups to volunteer opportunities, your true self is always welcome here. Our team members’ backgrounds, experiences and perspectives add to us as a whole and make us unique.

We are proudly an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a veteran. Participation in the E-Verify Program allows Manhattan to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees after the Employment Eligibility Verification Form (Form I-9) has been completed.

job.title: Strategy Manager
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Strategy Manager

The New York Times is looking for a Strategy Manager to join the Strategy & Development team. Strategy & Development is a small, high-impact team that partners with senior executives including the Publisher, CEO and CFO to shape our strategy, and to translate that strategy into results.

This is an exciting moment to work at The Times. Our journalism has never been stronger or more relevant. Our products are used by millions of passionate and engaged people every week. And we've rapidly grown our business across subscriptions, advertising, affiliate and licensing to become one of the world's leading digital media companies.

We see enormous potential for continued growth. You will help leaders across all our products — News, Games, The Athletic, Cooking, and Wirecutter — solve the most important opportunities and challenges facing us, from AI to video and beyond.

This is a role with the opportunity to lead high-profile work that helps us achieve our enterprise goals, find new areas of growth, and make our operations more effective.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York headquarters, reporting to the Vice President, Strategy & Operations. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

Role

  • Scope and lead projects to help The New York Times reach its near- and long-term business goals; projects may range across product strategy, market assessment, business case development, organizational design, inorganic opportunities, and beyond
  • Communicate important insights to senior leaders and ensure recommendations have the right owners for execution
  • Work with leaders across partner teams (e.g., Advertising, Data, Finance, Marketing, Product) to implement relevant recommendations
  • Provide rigorous quantitative analysis and insights to company and department leaders that shape their perspectives and influence departmental and cross-company plans
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

Qualities:

  • Strong quantitative skills and ability to generate insights
  • Entrepreneurial drive for creative problem solving, and embracing new ideas and tools, like AI
  • Commitment to the highest standards
  • Clear and concise communication style
  • Deep interest in and understanding of the trends and challenges facing the media industry, and The Times in particular
  • Passion for The New York Times and the impact its journalism can have on our world

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of relevant work experience, including 2+ years of experience in management consulting
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver quantitative and qualitative insights, including analyzing data, building financial models, and developing strategic frameworks
  • Experience communicating recommendations to senior leaders in writing and verbally
  • Experience breaking down complex problems into pieces that can be solved with data, analysis, and clear assumptions
  • Experience leading through influence and working cross-functionally with partners in Product, Data, Finance and Marketing
  • Bachelor's Degree

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in digital product development, or at a digital subscription or digital advertising business
  • Enthusiasm for collaboration, and building strong, trusting relationships with colleagues across all levels and departments

job.title: Product Manager, Visuals
job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination. About the Role Suno has made it possible for anyone to turn an idea into music. Now we’re exploring how anyone can bring their music to life through video. As the Product Manager for Video, you will take a new product from its earliest stages through launch and growth. You will shape intuitive creation experiences across web and mobile, work with the broader product team to make videos a compelling part of Suno, and help define a business model that can support creators as the product scales. We’re looking for an experienced PM with strong product and design judgment, firsthand experience creating videos, and excitement about what generative video makes possible. You should care as much about the people making videos as you do about the technology behind them—and be eager to build tools that help more people express what they hear and imagine. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/visual/cmp_01a1ef02-a4e1-7bae-b9b7-9cf8c6567c7b What You’ll Do Define the video creation experience — Understand how people want to bring their music to life, then turn those insights into a clear product vision and roadmap. Build from zero to one — Lead the product from early prototypes through launch, making thoughtful choices about creative controls, generative video capabilities, and the path from a song to a finished video. Make video part of Suno — Partner with other product teams to design how creators share their videos and how audiences discover and engage with them across web and mobile. Shape a sustainable business — Explore how video creates value for creators and Suno, and help develop a business model that can grow with the product. Launch and grow the product — Define what success looks like, learn from what creators make and where they get stuck, and improve the experience as adoption grows.
