job.description:
This is a hybrid position. Applicants must reside in the Tri-State Area to be on location for occasional programming and meetings.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 

The Education and Community Engagement Manager supports the development, implementation, and refinement of Grammy Museum Education & Community Engagement programs with a focus on educator-facing initiatives, curriculum development, professional development, student recruitment, and regional program support. Based in New York City, you will help expand the Museum’s East Coast education presence and support programs primarily East of the Mississippi River including Grammy in the Schools, professional development sessions, and seasonal Grammy Camp support.

 

You will provide curriculum expertise across programs to ensure consistency, continuity, and alignment with the Museum’s educational goals. You will build and maintain relationships with K-12 teachers, school partners, districts, and arts education organizations to support educator engagement, student recruitment, and professional development. You will also support application and recruitment processes for student and educator programs, ensuring outreach, application review, and participant communication reflect program goals and expand access for students and teachers.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 

Professional Development & Educator Engagement

  • Lead planning, development, and facilitation of educator professional development programs, including virtual, in-person, district-based, and conference-based sessions.
  • Build and maintain relationships with K–12 teachers, school districts, arts coordinators, and education partners to support professional development, program participation, student recruitment, and ongoing educator engagement.
  • Identify and cultivate professional development opportunities with schools, districts, conferences, and partner organizations.
  • Collect and synthesize educator feedback to inform future professional development offerings, curriculum tools, and program improvements.

 

Program Alignment

  • Provide curriculum expertise across Education programs to ensure consistency, continuity, and alignment with departmental learning goals, while remaining adaptable to different student, teacher, and community contexts.
  • Develop and refine learning objectives, instructional materials, rubrics, classroom extensions, and develop and maintain program manuals.
  • Support alignment of programs with music education, arts education, career and technical education, college/career readiness, and workforce development frameworks where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with internal team members to connect curriculum and instructional design across Grammy Camp, Grammy in the Schools, Industry Sessions, professional development, and other education initiatives.

 

Recruitment, Applications & Program Process Support

  • Support recruitment for student and educator programs including outreach to schools, teachers, districts, community partners, and professional networks, building an application pipeline.
  • Support application and review processes for selected programs, including outreach, applicant communication, submission tracking, rubric development, review coordination, and documentation.
  • Help ensure recruitment and application processes are accessible, organized, and aligned with program goals, student readiness, educator needs, and equity of access.
  • Collaborate with the Coordinator and program leads to maintain accurate applicant records, support review timelines, and communicate next steps to applicants and participants.

 

Grammy in the Schools Support

  • Support planning and implementation of Grammy in the Schools programs, particularly those based on the East Coast and primarily East of the Mississippi River.
  • Assist with educator and school partner communication, program planning, instructional materials, and on-site implementation.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure Grammy in the Schools programming is educationally consistent, student-centered, and aligned with the Museum’s broader learning goals.
  • Support development of program resources that help students connect music learning to industry pathways, creative careers, and transferable skills.

 

Grammy Camp Support

  • Support Grammy Camp planning and implementation including curriculum alignment, faculty support, student learning outcomes, and summer travel for on-site program delivery.

  • Represent the Education & Community Engagement team in meetings with schools, districts, partners, artists, faculty, and external stakeholders.
  • Travel for programs, conferences, partner meetings, Grammy Camp, Grammy in the Schools and other education initiatives as needed.
  SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree preferred in music education, arts education, curriculum and instruction, education, music industry, or a related field.
  • 3-5+ years of experience in music education, arts education, curriculum development, professional development, or youth program implementation.
  • Experience designing or facilitating professional development for educators preferred.

job.description:
Senior Client Success Manager - Dow Jones Senior Client Success Manager Dow Jones New York, NY Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Job Description: About the Team Our team brings together the capabilities to position, commercialize, and grow Dow Jones’s B2B and enterprise portfolio. We translate customer needs, audience insight, and market intelligence into product strategy, clear value propositions, differentiated positioning, and relevant product and content experiences. We enable commercial performance through sales operations, go-to-market enablement, and cross-functional coordination. We also help drive client outcomes across onboarding, adoption, engagement, and retention. Working in close partnership with Product, Editorial, Sales, and Client Success, we ensure Dow Jones’s enterprise solutions are compelling in the market, equipped for commercial success, and deliver sustained value to clients.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Client Success Manager to own the post-sale client journey for assigned new business accounts- from signed deal through launch, activation, early adoption, and handoff into ongoing account management. This role serves as the primary relationship owner and cross-functional coordinator during the early post-sale phase, working closely with Sales, Regional Sales Coordinators, Operations, Engagement, Customer Care, and Account Management. The goal is a seamless transition from signed account to active, engaged client- reducing friction, accelerating time to value, surfacing risk early, and bringing in the right resources at the right time. The Senior Client Success Manager is the primary post-sale relationship owner and "quarterback" across the early client lifecycle, accountable for client readiness, launch coordination, onboarding progress, standard-account adoption execution, early engagement, and risk management. The role doesn't personally own every specialist workstream, but ensures each one happens successfully. This is not a quota-carrying role. Success is measured by how effectively clients launch, activate, adopt key products and workflows, engage early, and transition cleanly into ongoing account management. You Will: Own the post-sale relationship and launch orchestration Serve as the primary point of contact from signed deal through onboarding and early adoption. Lead the handoff from Sales, ensuring client goals, use cases, stakeholders, and launch priorities are clearly understood and documented. Build 60–90 day onboarding milestones and success plans so clients know what success looks like and can achieve early wins. Maintain proactive, coordinated communication with clients and internal stakeholders to keep launches on track. Coordinate account setup with Regional Sales Coordinators and Operations Partner with RSCs on order processing, account setup/changes, billing, CRM updates, and related handoffs. Partner with Operations and Fulfillment on provisioning, entitlements, technical readiness, SLA readiness, and launch execution. Own coordination and follow-through, while RSCs and Operations retain responsibility for their own administrative execution. Drive onboarding and adoption for standard accounts Execute onboarding using established playbooks, milestones, and training guidance. Ensure clients understand activation steps and build early usage habits. Support in designing and implementing playbooks and frameworks Apply learnings and best practices across the client base. Partner with Engagement and Lifecycle teams to deepen usage Work with Engagement Strategy & Performance and Customer Lifecycle Marketing to ensure clients get the right communications, campaigns, and enablement programs. Use engagement reporting and health signals to prioritize interventions. Connect clients to the right in-life programs as they move from onboarding into sustained engagement. Monitor account health and manage risk Track usage, activation milestones, and health signals to catch stalled onboarding, weak adoption, or early churn risk. Escalate early and coordinate support across Engagement, Customer Care, Operations, and Account Management. Ensure critical issues stay owned and teams stay aligned on actions and timing. Act as the voice of the client internally Share feedback, adoption insights, and emerging needs with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Care, and Client Success leadership. Partner with the Enterprise Customer Care & Voice of Customer Lead on escalations and service themes. Support a clean handoff into ongoing account management Ensure a clear transition from early post-sale ownership into the ongoing account management motion once onboarding and early adoption are complete. Share account context, progress, risks, and adoption status with Account Managers so momentum carries through on high-value accounts. Success Measures Measured on adoption, engagement, readiness, and handoff outcomes rather than direct revenue. KPIs may include: Account launch readiness and setup completion rate Time to onboarding completion and time to first value Activation and seat activation rate Adoption of priority products, workflows, and features Usage frequency, engagement depth, and health score movement Participation in training, webinars, and lifecycle programs Early identification and escalation of churn risk or stalled onboarding Quality of handoff into ongoing account management Cross-Functional Partnerships Sales Account Executives — post-sale handoff and continuity from signed deal into launch Regional Sales Coordinators — order processing, account setup/changes, billing coordination Operations and Fulfillment — provisioning, entitlements, technical readiness, launch execution Engagement Strategy & Performance / Customer Lifecycle Marketing — health monitoring, engagement plays, in-life programs Enterprise Customer Care & Voice of Customer — escalations, white-glove service, feedback loops Account Managers — transition planning and ongoing relationship continuity You Have: 7 years of

experience

in client success, onboarding, implementation, account coordination, or related post-sale roles in B2B, SaaS, media, or subscription environments Strong cross-functional project management skills, able to coordinate multiple stakeholders through launch, onboarding, and adoption milestones Excellent client communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills Comfort using data and health indicators to monitor trends and flag risk early A proactive, organized, solutions-oriented approach to client coordination A client-first mindset focused on driving value through usage, adoption, and engagement — not transactional account support Our

Overview

The Art Director will bring a strong creative point of view and exceptional design craft to a portfolio of HarperCollinsChristian Direct-to-Consumer brands. Reporting to the Creative Director, they will partner with brand teams to develop original campaign concepts that feel distinctive, ownable, and true to each brand, then translate those ideas into finished assets across websites, email, programmatic advertising, social media, print, and catalogues. This is a hands-on role with responsibility for both concept development and day-to-day design execution, combining thoughtful typography, compelling imagery, and cohesive storytelling. The Art Director will uphold brand guidelines while identifying opportunities to refine, modernize, and evolve each brand’s visual identity.

Bring fresh ideas and your own creative perspective to a diverse portfolio of brands, with room to experiment, push the work forward, and help shape what comes next. job.title: Sports Reporter
job.description:
Summary:


The Republican Herald in Pottsville, Pa., seeks a full-time sports reporter with an enterprising approach to covering local sports, including youth, recreation, high school, and college sports.


Although this is a remote position, candidates must reside in Pottsville, Pa.


What you will do:


  • Be fast and accurate, always striving to provide readers with what we know when we know it, and be transparent about sources of information
  • Employ creativity every day to conceive of stories, produce or secure visuals, get sources to cooperate, corroborate facts, and present information to readers in the most relevant, interesting way
  • Maximize audience engagement with the site through the use of various storytelling formats, including photo galleries, video, aggregation, and a variety of layouts
  • Create premium content that is among the newsroom’s most compelling work—strong on grammar, punctuation, clarity, and accuracy
  • Take the initiative to fact-check, run background checks, and confirm information before publication
  • Deliver on time with minimal to moderate supervision and editing
  • Cultivate beats, where appropriate, and sources
  • Uncover and propose exclusive stories on newsworthy events and trends
  • Conceive, create, edit, aggregate, or produce various types of content; depending on the department, this may include videos, maps, timelines, multimedia, documents, graphics, photo galleries, GIFs, and social aggregations
  • Take or secure photos, produce basic videos, and make them available in the content management system

What you will bring:


  • Professional-level grasp of proper grammar, spelling, and punctuation, along with the ability to write accurately, with clarity, and without bias
  • Knowledge of libel laws and adherence to the Tribune’s and Editorial’s codes of ethics
  • Strong work ethic, entrepreneurial spirit, and competitive instincts
  • Ability to multitask and perform in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Up-to-date skills across various digital platforms
  • Familiarity with current events and newsmakers
  • Basic familiarity with analytics and the ability to translate data into tactics and strategies, including using metrics from Chartbeat, Adobe Analytics, social, and other tools
  • Knowledge of Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), and other social platforms, along with the ability to develop and follow best practices for social media
  • Basic knowledge of SEO best practices and the ability to research SEO and appropriately populate fields and headlines
  • Ability to work independently when required while operating efficiently in a team dynamic

Who we are:


The Republican Herald, a subsidiary of MediaNews Group, is a leading source for local news, sports and features serving Pottsville, Schuylkill, and surrounding counties seven days a week, 365 days a year. We connect with our audience across multiple platforms, offering local coverage and advertising opportunities through our website, mobile app, tablet and print publication. We are part of one of the largest media groups in the U.S., serving high-value audiences and connecting advertisers to them.


“4x Built In Best Places to Work Winner - 2023-2026”


EEO Statement:


We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.


How To Apply:


  • Please submit an online application along with your resume for this position here. In addition to your resume, please include a cover letter and 4-5 samples showcasing your best work.

Closing Date:


  • Continuous recruitment until the position is filled

Conditions of Employment: 


  • A full pre-employment background check and MVR will be conducted as part of the selection process. Must be willing to submit and pass the necessary required checks
  • Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license and have reliable transportation
  • Travel – This position entails occasional driving for work assignments, in-person training sessions and/or meetings. The employee will be responsible for transporting themselves between different sites as needed

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst – FP&A & Revenue Management
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

Edelman is looking for a Senior Finance Analyst to join our Commercial Finance team. This is an exciting opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys working at the intersection of financial analysis, business operations, and client partnership.


In this role, you'll support financial planning, revenue forecasting, billing, and reporting across multiple client accounts, working closely with finance leadership and account teams to drive financial accuracy and informed business decisions. You'll also have the opportunity to take ownership of client financial management and grow your responsibilities over time.


If you're a detail-oriented, collaborative finance professional ready to take the next step in your career, we'd love to hear from you.


Who You Are

You're an analytical and proactive finance professional who enjoys turning financial data into meaningful insights. You're comfortable managing multiple priorities, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and taking ownership of your work. You bring a solid understanding of financial processes, strong attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow in a dynamic agency environment.


What You'll Do

  • Support financial planning, budgeting, and revenue forecasting across multiple client accounts, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Manage revenue-related activities, including accruals, deferrals, reconciliations, and monthly revenue tracking.
  • Partner with finance leadership, project managers, and account teams to monitor project budgets, profitability, and financial performance.
  • Coordinate and support high-volume client billing processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely invoicing.
  • Analyze budget-to-actual performance, identify financial trends and variances, and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
  • Support financial operations, including purchase orders, service orders, contract reviews, and project financial documentation.
  • Take ownership of assigned client financial activities, with opportunities to independently manage client accounts as you grow in the role.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across teams, embracing diverse perspectives and contributing to an inclusive and supportive work environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field and a minimum of two years of relevant finance or accounting experience; or at least four years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, or financial reporting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in commercial finance, FP&A, or financial operations, ideally within an advertising, public relations, communications, or professional services environment.
  • Understanding of revenue recognition principles, including accruals, deferrals, and revenue forecasting.
  • Experience supporting client billing, reconciliations, project budgets, and profitability analysis.
  • Ability to interpret financial information and communicate insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with financial systems such as Workday, Ariba, or Coupa is a plus.

Salary Range

$60,000–$80,000 Annually

An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, travel requirements, revenue-based metrics, any contractual agreements, and business or organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of DJEH’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, a Paid Time Off policy, and region-specific benefits.

DJEH offers a wide range of benefits: medical and dental insurance, vision, 401K, life insurance, disability insurance, paid time off, travel assistance and wellness programing.

DJEH is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and believes in diversity, equity, and inclusion. We seek applications from all qualified candidates without regard to race, color, gender, sex, age, religion, physical or mental disability, military and veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. If you require a reasonable accommodation in any part of the employment process, please let us know.

job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

The Edelman Project Management team is passionate about finding smart ways to deliver great work. We sit at the center of our business, collaborating with best-in-class teams to ensure Edelman ideas make an impact in our clients’ real worlds. From cars to consumer goods, fashion and retail, financial service, food and beverage, luxury, technology or healthcare – we are fanatics about integrated project management that enables our creative, strategy and account teams to deliver smart and brilliant programming for our clients.

 

This is an exciting opportunity for a process-oriented, go-getter who wants to become a key part of a forward-thinking, integrated team. We want passion and excitement. We want someone who is unafraid to ask questions, is willing to challenge the norm and is eager to be the best in the business. Our Senior Project Managers are fluent in PM fundamentals and best practices – they have the experience to lead the day-to-day work on integrated projects, the drive to ensure flawless execution, and the ability to influence teams to achieve great work within the boundaries of scope, time and budget.

 

About Your Day-to-Day:

Edelman Senior Project Managers lead the day-to-day workflow of integrated projects and team. Serving as the common thread on projects, they manage schedules, deliverables, priorities and teams towards flawless execution. They collaborate with Account and Specialty peers to ensure that project deliverables connect with creative intent, while meeting time specifications and budget parameters.

  • Demonstrate business acumen by producing top-down and bottom-up estimates, and leading definition of scopes and staff plans with account leads and specialty teams, utilizing appropriate tools.
  • Lead the development and approval workflow of Statements of Work with Finance, Contracts and Account teams.
  • Through the use of established project management tools, author and maintain project schedules, project briefs, cost estimates and project financial management (OOP & fee) and other relevant project documentation with input from cross-discipline teams.
  • Own the delivery of a workstream within large, complex initiatives and/or own mid-size projects independently and with minimal oversight.
  • Work with the Account and Specialty leads to resolve project-related issues, escalating project blockers and risk to the Project Director.
  • Partner with Finance and Account teams to manage and communicate project burn, raise scope creep, share budget reporting, and participate in the monthly forecasting process.
  • Participate in client discussions related to project plans and set expectations on due dates needed in order to meet project goals.
  • Partner with Resource Management to establish staff plans, providing clarity that aligns specialty team needs with project future staffing requirements in order to identify the best talent for the work.
  • Oversee, manage and communicate the status of integrated initiatives across multiple projects to ensure successful delivery against client assignment and scoped deliverables.
  • Ensure the quality and consistency across all projects is consistent with brand guidelines.
  • Begin management, leadership and effective communications trainings.
  • Balance a sense of urgency with a calm and confident leadership at all times.

 
About Your Background:

  • A 4-year degree or equivalent work experience
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is an asset.
  • 7 years of project management, integrated marketing/advertising/PR agency, or related experience
  • Mastery of PM fundamentals and best practices; mid-level to large-level project delivery
  • Fluency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Smartsheet (or other similar project management tool) is required.

About You:

  • A self-reliant multi-tasker, with the ability to work calmly and efficiently in a fast-paced environment
  • A strategic mindset, with a knack for creative and head-on problem solving
  • A bias for action and the ability to confidently lead projects and teams through ambiguity
  • A “get things done” and positive mentality
  • A passion for both the art and the science of problem solving
  • A strong and fearless communicator, both verbally and in writing

 

$75,000 - $90,000 per year

#LI-PP1

 

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

job.title: Sr. Director, Social Creator Strategy
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

About the Role

UEG is seeking a Senior Director, Social & Creator Strategy to help shape how leading brands connect with audiences, participate in culture, and drive impact across the evolving social and creator landscape.


This role sits at the intersection of social strategy, creator marketing, cultural insights, and creative development, translating audience behaviors and emerging trends into compelling brand platforms, social-first campaigns, and creator-led experiences.


We're looking for a strategic thinker and creative problem-solver who understands that social is more than a distribution channel and creators are more than media placements. You know how brands can authentically participate in culture, build communities, and create work that earns attention, sparks conversation, and delivers measurable business results.


As a senior strategic leader, you'll partner closely with creative, account, talent, experiential, and integrated marketing teams to develop breakthrough ideas and programs for UEG's clients. You'll play a central role in shaping strategic recommendations, inspiring creative work, advising senior clients, and identifying new opportunities for growth.


The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of the social and creator ecosystem with strong cultural instincts, exceptional storytelling abilities, and the confidence to turn complex challenges into clear, actionable strategies.


What You'll Do

Lead Social & Creator Strategy

  • Lead the development of integrated social and creator strategies that connect brand objectives, audience insights, cultural opportunities, and business outcomes.
  • Define the role of social platforms, creators, influencers, and online communities within broader brand marketing and entertainment strategies.
  • Develop social-first and creator-led campaign approaches that move beyond traditional sponsorships and endorsements to create authentic cultural relevance.
  • Translate consumer behaviors, platform dynamics, and emerging cultural trends into actionable strategic recommendations, creative briefs, and compelling brand narratives.

Shape Creative Thinking & Cultural Relevance

  • Partner with creative teams to develop culturally relevant, platform-native ideas that are rooted in audience insight and designed to earn attention.
  • Write and present compelling strategic briefs that inspire breakthrough creative thinking and establish a clear direction for campaign development.
  • Bring a strong point of view on creator culture, social behaviors, emerging formats, and the evolving relationship between brands and audiences.
  • Apply cultural intelligence, social listening, audience research, and performance insights to identify creative territories and opportunities for innovation.
  • Provide strategic guidance throughout campaign development and execution, ensuring the work remains connected to the original insight and business objective.

Drive Creator & Influencer Innovation

  • Develop creator and influencer strategies that go beyond reach and engagement to build meaningful brand affinity, credibility, and cultural impact.
  • Guide strategic approaches to creator identification, audience alignment, partnership models, content collaboration, and long-term creator ecosystems.
  • Understand the nuances of working with creators across different audience sizes, platforms, communities, and content categories.
  • Collaborate with talent, partnerships, and account teams to connect creator strategy with talent relationships, brand partnerships, experiential programs, and broader integrated campaigns.
  • Stay ahead of emerging creator business models, platform innovations, social commerce, and the evolving role of creators as cultural and commercial partners.

Serve as a Strategic Partner to Clients & Teams

  • Act as a trusted strategic advisor to senior clients, bringing proactive recommendations and a clear perspective on where social, creator, and cultural marketing are headed.
  • Lead the strategic development of client presentations, campaign recommendations, creative briefs, and new business pitches.
  • Partner with account leadership, creative, talent, experiential, earned media, and paid media teams to deliver cohesive, integrated programs.
  • Translate complex audience and market insights into persuasive stories and actionable recommendations that inspire confidence and drive decisions.
  • Contribute to organic account growth and new business opportunities by identifying emerging trends, unmet client needs, and innovative strategic solutions.

Measure Impact & Advance the Practice

  • Partner with analytics and measurement teams to establish meaningful success metrics across social, creator, and integrated marketing initiatives.
  • Evaluate campaign performance, audience response, and cultural impact to optimize work and inform future strategic recommendations.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Community Engagement Manager to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, is a full-service healthcare advertising agency built on the belief that healthcare should feel more human. We combine bold creativity, strategic rigor, and deep scientific understanding to create work that changes behavior, improves outcomes, and makes a meaningful impact on people's lives. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to doing exceptional work. We believe in being good to each other while pushing ourselves to deliver ideas that move audiences, brands, and healthcare forward.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as primary point of contact for patient outreach with the ability to conduct patient interviews
  • Assist in vetting and assessing appropriate patient candidates for program selection
  •  Maintain privacy standards in collecting, storing and processing patient information
  • Liaise between patients, internal teams, and clients
  • Provide daily logistical support for patient speaking events and programs
  • Assist in training of patient speakers
  • Maintain client relationship and manage weekly status calls
  • Support in development of core program materials as well as review and approval in VEEVA
  • Must be willing to travel, potentially once per month

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

  • 1-2 years of experience in Account Management in an agency setting  
  • Experience in patient support and/or meetings planning
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical marketing regulations and guidelines (i.e., FDA regulations)   
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex ideas and concepts   
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously   
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment  
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office

In addition to base salary, Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefits package and a variety of programs designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and success.

Real Chemistry reserves the right to update compensation and benefits programs at any time.

job.title: Account Executive, Paid Social
job.description:
About Ogilvy  

Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

 

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

 

OGILVY HEALTH: WE INSPIRE PEOPLE AND BRANDS TO IMPACT THE WORLD

Guided by this vision, Ogilvy Health, part of WPP, combines borderless creativity, scientific precision, cultural fluency, and AI-enabled capabilities to build healthcare's most influential movements. We believe the future belongs to those who can seamlessly blend human ingenuity with emerging technologies, using AI not simply as a tool, but as a catalyst for deeper insights, faster problem solving, and more impactful work. We drive measurable impact and category-defining growth for brands ready to shape what's next. Our approach is powered by fearless creativity that dares to be different, sparks emotional connections, and inspires action, ensuring cultural resonance. Scientific precision translates complex data into stories that resonate, while our impact-obsessed mindset focuses on delivering real-world outcomes.

For more information on us, visit OgilvyHealth.com, or follow Ogilvy Health on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and Threads.

About the Role 

As an Account Executive specializing in Paid Media Buying, Social Analytics, and Generative Impact, you will assist the technical and strategic processes across paid social and digital media activation, social listening, and emerging AI search visibility for leading healthcare and pharmaceutical clients.

This is not a traditional Account Management AE role—you will not be managing day-to-day project logistics, call agendas, or administrative client account management. Instead, your core focus is technical media buying, campaign trafficking, data analytics, social listening, and Ogilvy's proprietary Generative Impact (Generative Engine Optimization / GEO) offering.

What You’ll Do:

Paid Social & Digital Campaign Execution & Media Operations

  • Campaign Setup & Media Buying: Assist in building, launching, trafficking, and managing paid social media campaigns across self-serve ad platforms (e.g., Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, etc.) and support activation and coordination across digital media channels such as GOOH (Digital OOH), Programmatic, Search, Direct Partnership and Sponsorships.
  • Audience & Targeting Strategy: Assist in building and implementing compliant audience targeting parameters tailored to healthcare stakeholders (HCPs, patients, caregivers) in alignment with platform policy and healthcare privacy regulations.
  • Medical/Legal/Regulatory (MLR) Compliance: Ensure all paid social assets, ad copy, and targeting parameters comply with brand guidelines, platform policies, and FDA/MLR regulatory requirements.

Generative Impact & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)

  • AI Search Visibility Tracking: Support Ogilvy’s Generative Impact offering by tracking, analyzing, and measuring brand visibility, sentiment, and share of voice across generative AI search engines and LLM platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews).
  • GEO Insight Generation: Identify prompt opportunities, content gaps, and source citation trends in AI-generated responses to help optimize healthcare brand discovery.
  • Search-Social Integration: Connect paid social strategy with GEO insights to ensure brand messaging is aligned across both social feeds and AI discovery platforms.

Social Intelligence, Analytics & Listening

  • Data Aggregation & Performance Reporting: Extract performance metrics across paid social campaigns and aggregate data to build weekly, monthly, and post-campaign analytical reporting decks.
  • Social Intelligence & Listening: Utilize enterprise social listening tools (e.g., Brandwatch, YouScan, Quid, Sprinklr) to monitor share of voice, emerging disease-state conversation trends, competitor paid activity, and audience sentiment.
  • Dashboard Management: Maintain and update client analytics dashboards and reporting templates to ensure data accuracy and real-time visibility into KPI performance.

Client Relations

  • Paid Media & Analytics Advisory: Interact directly with clients to answer technical questions regarding paid media execution, social listening findings, platform algorithm updates, and GEO trends.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal creative, strategy, media planning, and account management teams to optimize creative ad assets based on real-time performance data and social listening insights.

What You’ll Need:

  • Experience: 1–2 years hands on in paid social media execution, social listening, or marketing analytics—preferably within an advertising agency or healthcare/pharmaceutical environment.
  • Paid Social & Media: Direct experience trafficking campaigns inside self-serve ad platforms (Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, etc.).
  • Search: Hands on experience supporting paid search campaigns in Google Ads, including keyword research, campaign and ad group setup, ad trafficking and quality assurance, negative keyword management, budget pacing, bid and performance optimization, and reporting.  
  • Analytics, Listening & GEO: Familiarity with enterprise social listening/reporting platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Brandwatch, YouScan, NetBase Quid, Google Analytics, advanced Excel/Google Sheets).
  • Strong interest in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI search platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), and prompt monitoring.
  • Self-motivation, strong organizational skills, attention to detail and excellent time management skills.
  • Healthcare Knowledge: Understanding of pharmaceutical/healthcare marketing, MLR review processes, and healthcare privacy/compliance guidelines is highly desirable.
  • AI Fluency: Demonstrated curiosity and proficiency in using generative AI and applicable emerging technologies. Ability to adapt to new tools and integrate AI responsibly into day-to-day work is expected.

How We’ll Support You 

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates. 

 

The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click here for more details.

Pay Range$45,000—$100,000 USD

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. 

Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Senior Identity and Access security Engineer is responsible for governing who, and what, can access DTS systems, data, APIs, tools, workflows and AI-enabled capabilities.

This is a hands-on governance and control role, reporting into the SVP Security and Compliance. The role ensures that access across DTS is appropriate, auditable, reviewed, least-privileged and aligned with security, privacy, compliance and client commitments.

The scope covers traditional human access, external users, privileged access, service accounts, machine identities, API keys, tokens, dataset access, and the emerging governance of AI agents and agentic workflows.

The role will work closely with Architecture, Security, Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal/DPO, TechOps, Enterprise Technology and the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure DTS has a clear and controlled model for access across platforms such as WPP Open, Choreograph, InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve and related DTS capabilities.

 

What you'll be doing:

1. Identity and access governance framework

Define and maintain the access governance framework for DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining access governance standards, processes and control expectations.
  • Establishing how access should be requested, approved, provisioned, reviewed, revoked and evidenced.
  • Ensuring access governance covers internal users, external users, clients, partners, vendors, service accounts, machine identities and AI agents.
  • Aligning identity and access governance with DTS architecture, security, privacy, compliance and data governance requirements.
  • Ensuring access governance is practical for product and engineering teams to implement.

 

2. Access reviews and recertification

Own the process for regular access reviews and recertification across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining the scope, frequency and evidence requirements for access reviews.
  • Coordinating access reviews for critical DTS systems, production environments, privileged roles, sensitive datasets, client-facing platforms and administrative tools.
  • Ensuring access review outcomes are tracked, remediated and evidenced.
  • Identifying stale, excessive, orphaned or poorly owned access.
  • Escalating overdue, high-risk or unresolved access issues through the appropriate governance channels.

 

3. Privileged access governance

Ensure privileged access across DTS is properly controlled, justified and auditable.

This includes:

  • Reviewing access to production systems, cloud environments, security tools, databases, CI/CD tooling, administrative consoles and sensitive platforms.
  • Supporting least-privilege, just-in-time and time-bound access models where appropriate.
  • Working with Cloud and Platform Security and Infrastructure to improve privileged access controls.
  • Ensuring privileged access risks are visible in the DTS risk register where required.

 

4. External user, client and partner access governance

Govern access for external users, clients, agencies, partners and vendors.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for external user onboarding, approval, permissions, expiry and offboarding.
  • Ensuring external access has a clear business owner and justification.
  • Supporting access governance across client workspaces, agency environments, partner integrations and shared collaboration areas.
  • Working with Product and Engineering to ensure tenant, workspace and client-level isolation is appropriately governed.
  • Tracking risks related to stale accounts, vendor access, partner permissions and external user overprivilege.

 

5. Service account, machine identity and API access governance

Govern non-human access across DTS systems and platforms.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for service accounts, machine identities, automation users, API keys, tokens, secrets and integration credentials.
  • Ensuring non-human access has clear ownership, purpose, scope, rotation, expiry and auditability.
  • Working with Product, Engineering, Cloud Security and Infrastructure to reduce unmanaged credential risk.
  • Ensuring service accounts and machine identities are included in access reviews.
  • Supporting stronger governance of API access, token issuance, credential lifecycle and integration permissions.

 

6. AI and agentic access governance

Define and oversee the governance model for AI agents and agentic workflows across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining how AI agents are identified, permissioned, monitored, reviewed and revoked.
  • Ensuring agents have clear ownership, scoped permissions and auditable actions.
  • Defining which agent actions require human approval or additional control.
  • Governing agent access to APIs, tools, datasets, workflows, client environments and production capabilities.
  • Ensuring agents act within delegated authority and cannot exceed the permissions of the user, system or business process they represent.
  • Working with Product, Architecture and Security to ensure agentic workflows are designed with clear action boundaries.
  • Working with the Product, Application and Offensive Security Lead to test whether agent permissions and action boundaries can be bypassed.
  • Working with Privacy Engineering to ensure AI access models support permitted use, minimisation and data protection requirements.

7. Data access governance

Govern access to sensitive, client, partner and WPP-owned data across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for dataset access approval, review, revocation and evidence.
  • Supporting data classification from an access-control and security-governance perspective.
  • Ensuring access to sensitive data is role-based, purpose-based, least-privileged and auditable.
  • Supporting controls for cross-client, cross-market, cross-agency and partner data access.
  • Ensuring data access governance supports InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve, WPP Open and other DTS data collaboration use cases.
  • Working with Privacy Engineering on data minimisation, permitted use, retention and privacy-by-design requirements.
  • Ensuring data access risks are surfaced through the DTS risk process.

 

8. Governance of access to tools, workflows and actions

Ensure access governance extends beyond systems and datasets into tools, workflows and actions.

This includes:

  • Defining governance for access to operational tools, workflow automation, orchestration systems, AI tools and administrative actions.
  • Ensuring high-risk actions are subject to appropriate approval, logging and monitoring.
  • Supporting segregation of duties across sensitive workflows.
  • Ensuring automated workflows and agents have clearly scoped authority.
  • Working with Security Operations to ensure high-risk access and actions are visible in monitoring and detection processes.

 

9. Auditability, evidence and reporting

Maintain clear evidence of access governance and support audit and assurance requirements.

This includes:

  • Producing access governance evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, client assurance, internal audit and risk reviews.
  • Working with the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure access controls, reviews, exceptions and remediation actions are documented.
  • Reporting on access review completion, high-risk access, overdue actions and access control gaps.
  • Supporting client and audit questions related to identity, access, privileged roles, service accounts, AI agents and data access.
  • Ensuring access governance is repeatable, measurable and auditable.

 

Who you'll be working with:

The Senior Identity and Access Security Engineer will be accountable for:

  • DTS identity and access governance standards.
  • Regular access reviews and recertification.
  • Privileged access governance.
  • External user, client, partner and vendor access governance.
  • Service account, machine identity, API key and token governance.
  • AI agent identity, permission and action governance.
  • Dataset and sensitive data access governance.
  • Governance of access to tools, workflows and high-risk actions.
  • Access governance evidence for audit, compliance and client assurance.
  • Escalation of material access risks into the DTS risk process.

 

What you'll need:

The successful candidate will have:

  • Experience in identity governance, access management, IAM, security governance, GRC, data access control or platform security.
  • Strong understanding of least privilege, role-based access control, attribute-based access control, access reviews, privileged access and segregation of duties.
  • Experience governing access across SaaS platforms, cloud environments, APIs, data platforms or enterprise technology estates.
  • Knowledge of identity platforms such as Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, Azure AD / Entra ID or similar.
  • Understanding of service accounts, machine identities, API keys, tokens, secrets and non-human access governance.
  • Understanding of AI agents, agentic workflows, delegated authority and tool-access governance would be highly valuable.
  • Understanding of data classification, dataset access governance, privacy-by-design and audit requirements.
  • Ability to work across security, architecture, product, engineering, infrastructure, legal, privacy and compliance teams.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to coordinate reviews, evidence, remediation and reporting.
  • Ability to translate complex access issues into clear risks, controls and practical actions.

 

Leadership expectations

The Senior Identity and Access Security Engineer is expected to:

  • Be structured, disciplined and pragmatic.
  • Bring clarity to complex access and permission models.
  • Challenge excessive, unclear or poorly governed access.
  • Work constructively with product and engineering teams to design workable controls.
  • Avoid creating unnecessary bureaucracy while ensuring access is properly governed.
  • Treat human, machine and agent access as part of the same control landscape.
  • Escalate material access risks clearly and early.
  • Support DTS in building a secure, auditable and scalable access governance model.

 

Success measures

Success in the role will be measured by:

  • DTS having clear identity, access and data access governance standards.
  • Regular access reviews completed on schedule with evidence.
  • Reduction in stale, excessive, orphaned or poorly owned access.
  • Stronger governance of privileged access and production access.
  • Clear ownership and review of service accounts, machine identities, API keys and tokens.
  • Defined governance for AI agent identities, permissions and actions.
  • Improved auditability of access to data, APIs, tools, workflows and production systems.
  • Better alignment between identity, security, privacy, architecture, product and engineering teams.
  • Material access risks being visible through the DTS risk register and Risk Review Board.
  • Increased confidence that DTS can answer: who or what has access to what, why, and when was it last reviewed?

Title: Lead Software Engineer

Level: Lead Engineer, Data & Technology Solutions

Location: Copenhagen

Reporting to: Director of Engineering

About Open Intelligence:

We are the Activation arm of WPP Open Intelligence. Our team builds the foundational data infrastructure and high-performance edge services that power WPP’s position in the market. With approximately one-third of all global media spend flowing through WPP, our platform operates at the core of this massive network-deeply integrated and adopted by the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. Operating at our scale presents unique engineering challenges. Our edge services currently handle over 60,000 classification requests per second, while our contextual classification pipelines process 10,000 requests per second. With operations spanning the US, UK, and ongoing expansion into EMEA and APAC, our infrastructure continuously interacts with up to 98% of the population in our active markets. We are an engineering-led team focused on building robust, scalable, and highly reliable systems.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer who thrives on owning backend systems end to end — architecture, delivery, and the people who build them. You care more about sound software design, reliable APIs, and clear ownership than about any single framework or language.

You are comfortable setting technical direction for a squad, mentoring engineers, and turning product roadmap into shippable, versioned contracts. Hands-on when it matters, you design and operate services, partner integrations, and orchestration components in production — authentication, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, and the operational discipline that keeps live systems healthy. You are likely highly proficient in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin, and experienced with cloud platforms, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production observability. Interest in infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), durable workflows, and AI coding assistants is a plus when it helps the team ship faster without lowering the quality bar.

Beyond the technical craft, you are a strong communicator who can explain trade-offs to engineers, Product, and non-technical stakeholders, and align sibling teams on interfaces. You take ownership of reliability and technical debt for the systems your squad runs, escalate blockers early with clear options, and are motivated by growing both the platform and the engineers who build it.

 

WHY ARE WE HIRING We are at a critical inflection point in our growth and need to scale our engineering team to tackle an expanding set of complex challenges. As the digital ecosystem evolves, we are actively developing and releasing a new catalog of privacy-preserving data products. These solutions are designed to scale advanced targeting capabilities while remaining uncompromising on our promise to protect user privacy.

To support this product evolution, our infrastructure is undergoing massive global expansion. By the end of this year, we will be fully operational across the rest of the EMEA and APAC regions. Concurrently, we are deepening our integrations to support even more of the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. We are hiring because we need strong engineering talent to help us architect for this next order of magnitude in scale-ensuring our systems remain resilient, performant, and compliant as our global footprint and feature set rapidly expand.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

· Lead an engineering squad: set technical direction, prioritize delivery, run design and code reviews, and grow engineers through mentoring and clear ownership.

· Own the architecture and health of activation and orchestration services — API, databases, partner gateways, internal integrations, MCP and agentic integrations.

· Partner with Product and sibling teams to turn roadmap phases into shippable, versioned contracts — not ad hoc

integrations.

· Drive API integration engineering: authentication, rate limiting, idempotency, retries, partial-update patterns, and runbooks as partner APIs evolve.

· Establish and uphold production standards — CI/CD, testing, observability, auditability, and safe release practices.

· Keep an end-to-end overview of how data flow through activation — what is live, what is in progress, and where dependencies or technical debt block the next phase.

· Contribute hands-on where it matters: critical paths, new gateways, framework foundations (e.g. tool registry, workflow runtime, guardrails hooks).

· Identify and address technical debt deliberately; balance speed with reliability for systems that support live campaigns.

· Share knowledge in design reviews, stand-ups, and cross-team forums; escalate blockers early with clear options.

· Stay curious about agentic orchestration, durable workflows, and AI coding assistants to improve how the team designs and ships software.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

· Strong communication — you explain trade-offs to engineers, product, and non-technical stakeholders and align multiple teams on interfaces.

· 6+ years in software engineering with 2+ years leading engineers or owning a significant technical area (team lead, staff, or equivalent).

· Proven delivery of backend and API-centric systems in production — services, integrations, or platforms at meaningful scale.

· Solid experience building and operating REST/HTTP APIs and event- or workflow-driven systems (durable state, async jobs, or orchestration).

· Comfort owning third-party integrations — auth, errors, versioning, operational monitoring, and partner-driven change.

· Strong proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g. Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin) and sound software design (patterns, testing, code review).

· Experience with CI/CD, Git, and testing — unit, integration, and boundary/contract tests where APIs matter.

· Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and deploying services with containers and Kubernetes.

· Familiarity with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and production observability (metrics, logs, tracing).

· A track record of technical debt and reliability ownership — incidents, postmortems, and systemic fixes, not one-off firefighting.

· Interest in leveraging AI coding assistants and prompt engineering to improve team productivity without lowering the production bar.

 

NICE TO HAVE

· Experience leading delivery of orchestration, workflow, or agentic systems (tool registries, policy/guardrails, human-in-the-loop flows).

· Full-stack exposure — internal UIs or ops tools (e.g. change logs, escalations) backed by the same APIs you own.

· Familiarity with AdTech / MarTech — SSPs, DSPs, deals, audiences, or campaign activation terminology.

· Experience in a monorepo or large shared codebase with many integration surfaces.

· Awareness of data privacy and safe handling of sensitive data in distributed deployments.

· Prior work on audit trails or decision logs for high-trust or automated systems.

We are looking for a Lead Application Security Engineer to strengthen Secure Development across WPP. 

Working within TSG, you will partner with software engineers, architects and product teams to establish practical security guardrails, help teams build the capabilities needed to meet them, and develop technical assurance that demonstrates whether those controls remain effective. 

You will not own development pipelines, security tooling or software delivery. Instead, you will provide the technical leadership, evidence and challenge that helps engineering teams build security into the way they develop software and continuously improve their security practices. 

Success requires strong technical credibility with engineers, a practical understanding of modern software development, and the ability to influence technical outcomes without direct authority.

  • Continuously evolve WPP’s Secure Development approach as engineering practices, technologies and threats change. 
  • Own Application Security Risk Factors through their lifecycle, raising and documenting issues, advising teams on remediation, tracking progress and challenging where exposure is not being addressed effectively.

Essential criteria: 

  • Strong practical understanding of modern software development and how security fits across design, development, testing, CI/CD and release. 
  • Meaningful experience in Application Security, Product Security, DevSecOps or Secure Development, with enough technical depth to work credibly with software engineers and architects.

Working within TSG, this role will investigate vulnerabilities and attack opportunities across a highly diverse environment spanning cloud, infrastructure, operating systems, identity, applications, AI and emerging technologies. You will use modern security, exposure and adversarial-testing capabilities to understand whether weaknesses are genuinely exploitable, how they could combine into realistic attack paths, and which exposure deserves attention first. 

This is a hands-on technical role with enterprise-wide reach. You will investigate complex security questions, challenge assumptions with evidence, identify systemic patterns, and translate technical findings into clear priorities for the teams responsible for remediation. You will not own every fix. Your role is to establish technical reality, determine what matters, and direct attention towards the improvements that will most meaningfully reduce WPP's exposure. 

The role sits within Technical Security Governance (TSG), reporting to the Director, Security Governance & Posture within the Group CISO organisation.

  • Act as WPP’s technical Principal for Exposure Management, providing senior technical judgement on attack paths and systemic exposure across the global technology environment.
  • Investigate suspected vulnerabilities across infrastructure, operating systems, identity, cloud, applications, data and AI.
  • Follow the evidence beyond the tool output, combining information from multiple sources to determine what is genuinely exploitable, how weaknesses connect, and what actually matters.
  • Assess attack paths and systemic exposure, maintaining enough perspective to distinguish significant enterprise risk from isolated or technically interesting findings.
  • Establish technical priorities for mitigation, helping teams focus effort on the exposures most likely to materially improve WPP's security posture.
  • Work with TSG specialists across Cloud, Identity, Data, Infrastructure, Application and AI to understand findings in context and develop technically credible recommendations for system owners.
  • Provide broad technical security expertise on complex security questions, technologies and protective approaches, including areas such as encryption, security tooling and emerging threats.

  • 5+ years of hands-on technical security experience, with meaningful practical experience investigating, defending or validating real enterprise technology.

  • Strong investigative and critical-thinking skills, including the curiosity to challenge assumptions, question tool output and follow evidence until the underlying technical reality is understood.

  • Ability to work primarily from WPP's São Paulo office as part of the wider security team.

  • Department: Data & Technology Solutions (DTS)
  • Reports To: SVP Security and Compliance
  • Location: [London/Hybrid 2 days a week in office]
  • Position Type: Full-Time

Role Purpose

The GRC Technology Analyst is responsible for managing and continuously improving the Information Security Management System (ISMS) across Data & Technology Solutions. You will ensure that security policies, controls, risks, exceptions, and governance processes are properly maintained, evidenced, reviewed, and acted upon.

Reporting to the SVP Security and Compliance, you will provide the operational backbone for security governance across DTS. This is a hands-on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) role. You will collaborate across security, product, engineering, infrastructure, architecture, legal, risk, compliance, and delivery teams to transform security governance into a dynamic, working management system rather than a static documentation exercise.

Key Responsibilities

1. ISMS Ownership & Operation

  • Manage the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of the DTS ISMS.
  • Maintain the ISMS framework, documentation, control library, policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Ensure the ISMS accurately reflects how DTS operates across products, platforms, infrastructure, data, and engineering.
  • Support alignment with frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA (where applicable), and wider WPP security requirements.
  • Ensure ISMS artefacts are version-controlled, approved, reviewed, and communicated appropriately.
  • Maintain clear evidence of security governance activity, control operation, risk treatment, and management reviews.

2. Policy Management & Control Governance

  • Own the lifecycle of DTS security and compliance policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation.
  • Coordinate policy reviews with Security, Architecture, Infrastructure, Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, and Enterprise Technology stakeholders.
  • Ensure policies are practical, clear, enforceable, and aligned with DTS's operating reality.
  • Track policy exceptions, waivers, compensating controls, and review dates.
  • Ensure policy changes are communicated and seamlessly embedded into operational processes.

3. Risk Review Board Operation

  • Establish and continuously run the DTS Risk Review Board.
  • Define the Board’s cadence, agenda, inputs, outputs, attendees, and escalation routes.
  • Prepare comprehensive risk packs, dashboards, decision logs, and action trackers.
  • Ensure risks are presented clearly, consistently, and with appropriate supporting evidence.
  • Track decisions, owners, due dates, mitigations, exceptions, and residual risks.
  • Escalate risks exceeding agreed thresholds to the SVP Security and Compliance, DTS leadership, the CISO office, or other appropriate forums.

4. Risk Register Management

  • Own and maintain the central DTS security and compliance risk register.
  • Capture, assess, categorise, and maintain security, compliance, privacy, operational resilience, third-party, and technology risks.
  • Ensure all risks have clear descriptions, owners, likelihood/impact ratings, inherent risk scores, mitigations, residual risk scores, treatment plans, and target dates.
  • Partner with risk owners to ensure mitigations are realistic, funded, and actively progressed.
  • Track overdue risk actions and escalate insufficient progress.
  • Produce regular risk reporting for DTS leadership and wider WPP governance forums.

5. Control Assurance & Evidence Management

  • Support ongoing assurance activity by ensuring controls are consistently evidenced, tested, and reviewed.
  • Maintain control evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2, client assurance, internal audits, and other compliance needs.
  • Coordinate evidence collection from Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Product, HR, Legal, and Enterprise Technology.
  • Identify gaps between documented controls and actual operating practices, tracking remediation plans.

6. Compliance Support & Audit Readiness

  • Support DTS compliance obligations (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR-related controls, and client-specific requirements).
  • Help prepare for internal/external audits, client reviews, security questionnaires, and due diligence exercises.
  • Maintain an organized, always-ready evidence library and audit trail.
  • Support management reviews required by ISO 27001 and other governance frameworks.

7. Exception, Waiver & Remediation Tracking

  • Manage the formal process for security exceptions, policy waivers, risk acceptances, and remediation plans.
  • Ensure exceptions are documented, reviewed, approved, time-bound, and assigned to accountable owners.
  • Track compensating controls, monitor residual risk, and manage the renewal/escalation of expired exceptions.

8. Third-Party & Supplier Risk Support

  • Help assess security and compliance risks associated with vendors, partners, tools, platforms, and managed services.
  • Maintain supplier risk records and coordinate with Procurement, Legal, CISO, Enterprise Technology, and Product teams.
  • Ensure third-party risk is appropriately integrated into the DTS risk register and Risk Review Board.

9. Security Governance Reporting

  • Produce clear, reliable, and actionable governance dashboards and reports for the SVP Security and Compliance and DTS leadership.
  • Translate complex governance and technical data into clear business language, highlighting trends, overdue actions, and material risks.

10. Stakeholder Engagement & Culture

  • Foster a collaborative and practical security governance culture across DTS.
  • Coach risk owners on how to describe, assess, treat, and monitor risks.
  • Ensure risk processes support business delivery rather than becoming bureaucratic overhead.

Key Accountabilities

The ISMS and Risk Officer will be directly accountable for:

  • Effective operation, accuracy, and maintenance of the DTS Senior Technology Risk Analyst.
  • Continuous, disciplined operation of the DTS Risk Review Board.
  • Up-to-date, approved, and realistic security policies, standards, and control documentation.
  • Structured tracking of risks, exceptions, waivers, and remediation plans.
  • Audit-ready evidence management and reliable governance reporting to leadership.

Skills & Experience

Required:

  • Proven experience in information security governance, risk management, compliance, audit, or ISMS operation.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 27001 and practical ISMS management.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, cloud security, SaaS platforms, and enterprise security controls.
  • Experience maintaining risk registers, policy frameworks, control libraries, and audit evidence repositories.
  • Experience running or supporting risk committees, governance forums, or control review boards.
  • Excellent technical writing skills (policies, standards, risk statements, and governance reports).
  • Ability to collaborate with technical teams and translate technical issues into business risk/compliance language.
  • Strong organizational skills, high attention to detail, and a constructive yet persistent approach to driving action.

Preferred:

  • Experience operating within a complex, matrixed, enterprise environment is highly valued.

Leadership Expectations

  • Disciplined & Reliable: Bring structure, order, and high standards of documentation to risk and compliance processes.
  • Pragmatic & Delivery-Aware: Build trust with technical teams by making governance useful, proportionate, and aligned with delivery.
  • Proactive: Follow through persistently on actions, dates, and evidence, and escalate bottlenecks clearly.
  • Collaborative: Support the SVP Security and Compliance in building a mature, transparent, and well-governed security function.

Success Measures

  • Security policies and standards reviewed, updated, and communicated on schedule.
  • The Risk Review Board operating systematically with clear actions and high leadership engagement.

  • Security governance fully embedded as a natural part of daily DTS operations.

Stagwell (NASDAQ: STGW) is the challenger network built to transform marketing. Mark, our Chairman and CEO, has spent five decades at the intersection of data, technology, and strategy. Under his leadership, Stagwell is leaning hard into AI: through Stagwell AI, we build agentic AI solutions that connect data, intelligence, and execution for the world's most ambitious brands.

Agentic AI will change the marketing profession. AI agents that research, plan, create, launch, and optimize alongside marketers will let brands move faster and spend smarter.
