You will join Stagwell's Enterprise AI Solutions go-to-market organization, a new Stagwell-level team that sells the Machines across Stagwell's agencies, clients, and partners. We start with a small founding team in every function and scale on what the data shows works.

This is a player-coach role reporting to the SVP, Enterprise AI Solutions. At launch there is no separate implementation team: you and your customer success managers own go-live, adoption, value realization, and first-line support. You will run the first go-lives personally, and build account strategies with Account Executives and agency client leads that turn a first Machine into a multi-Machine program.

Responsibilities

  • Own the post-sale journey: onboarding, go-live, adoption, value reviews, and renewal readiness.
  • Run the first go-lives personally while building and coaching the customer success team.
  • Build customer success plans, health scores, and playbooks for each Machine.
  • Lead executive business reviews that show measurable outcomes and return on investment.
  • Build account growth plans with Account Executives and agency client leads: which Machine comes next, for which team, and when; hand expansion opportunities to the AE and partner on renewals.
  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, agency delivery teams, and the existing Machine teams on implementation and support.
  • Turn customer feedback into product priorities with Product and Engineering.
  • Report on adoption, account health, and retention to leadership.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in customer success, client strategy, account management, or client services for B2B technology, including team leadership.
  • Experience owning onboarding, implementation coordination, adoption, and renewals for enterprise clients.
  • Track record of improving retention and showing measurable customer outcomes.
  • Builds trusted relationships with senior executives and day-to-day practitioners.
  • Strong analytical and project management skills.
  • Commercial acumen for renewals and expansion.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in SaaS, AI, marketing technology, advertising, or media.
  • Supported customers adopting generative or agentic AI.
  • Built a customer success function from scratch, using platforms such as Gainsight or Planhat.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Success Looks Like 

  • On-time go-lives: New customers go live on schedule without a separate implementation team.
  • Faster time to value: Customers reach their first measurable outcome quickly.
  • Retention and growth: Clients renew and add Machines, with expansion plans agreed with the AE and agency team.
  • A clear health view: Leadership has a reliable view of adoption and account health.

 

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of total compensation for this role is $160K (70/30 split). Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

At Bonneville International, our purpose is to build up, connect, inform, and celebrate communities and families in the markets we serve. As an integrated media company, we provide content, advertising, and digital marketing solutions across 19 radio stations in Denver, Phoenix, Sacramento, Salt Lake City, and Seattle, along with the NBC Affiliate TV station, KSL-TV 5, in Salt Lake. We are responsible for lifting and inspiring with respect and giving voice to all the communities and clients we serve.

 

We believe that empowering our employees to share their ideas and experiences will fuel creativity, innovation, and inspiration. A diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to our ability to create and deliver exceptional content, products, and services that represent our communities. We’re proud of our history and we want talented people to join us as we continue to grow!

 

To learn more about Bonneville and how our local media matters, visit: https://bonneville.com/

 

Position Overview

We're looking for someone with exceptional digital acumen to act as our Digital Media Strategist in the Seattle market. This role will contribute to achieving digital revenue goals working collaboratively with our team to represent our digital advertising assets, both owned and operated and third-party vendor extension products, to new and existing clients. In addition, this person will work as a trusted consultant providing recommendations of digital advertising strategies to reach key performance goals and providing evaluations of relevant digital performance metrics.

 

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.


What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:


  • Work with AE’s on prospecting and identifying digital revenue opportunities, creating digital sales packages, presenting to clients and assisting in closing the sale. 
  • Conduct virtual and in-person meetings demonstrating digital knowledge and expertise.
  • Achieve and grow digital revenue on all digital platforms both existing and newly added.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends, platform changes, and emerging ad technologies; translate market intelligence into actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
  • Communicate campaign performance and strategic recommendations to stakeholders ranging from marketing managers to C-suite executives.
  • Product knowledge expert. Demonstrate knowledge of selling digital advertising products including digital display ads, SEO, paid media, social media, mobile, programmatic, IP targeting, OTT, e-mail, mobile advertising and website and landing page development
  • Oversee onboarding and fulfillment of digital advertising campaigns, providing valuable audience insights, tactical consultation, and performance evaluations. 
  • Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of improvement to meet revenue goals.
  • Collaborate with account executives to identify and grow new opportunities.
  • Collaborate with account executives to promote retention of customers and overall positive experience with the brand.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

  • College degree in business, communications, sales, marketing, related field or equivalent, preferred  
  • Excellent project management skills; experience with sales operations preferred 
  • Possess excellent oral, written, presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • Three to five years of digital marketing and advertising sales experience, preferably with programmatic placement 
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising products, attribution tool, and conversion metrics
  • The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, positive, persistent, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment
  • Strong analytical abilities
  • Extensive knowledge and experience with DV360, Google Ads, Google Analytics (G4) and TapClicks.
  • Ability to develop client facing presentations 
  • Willingness to embrace AI innovation in accordance with Bonneville’s policies and procedures
  • Ability to create and present comprehensive marketing solutions 
  • Experience with Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools is a must 
  • Proficiency in managing sophisticated advertising programs and delivery methodologies

  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.

Compensation Range

$81,000 - $95,500 This salary range spans multiple levels for this role.

  • 401(k) with Company match and employer-funded retirement account, both fully vested from day one

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) team is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technologies and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Role Overview

 

This role serves as a strategic bridge, functional reference, and provides advanced analysis for our corporate tools portfolio. Its primary focus is on maximizing user adoption, understanding, and safe usage of our core productivity tools, including the Google Workspace ecosystem, and its rapidly evolving AI capabilities.

 

Moving dynamically between business strategy and technical evaluation, you will be responsible for demystifying AI, scoping business needs, and participating in pilot projects primarily within Google Workspace, but also across the full suite of productivity tools. Furthermore, you will collaborate with other Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) support teams for enterprise platforms such as Workday or Oracle as needed to ensure strategic alignment in the use of AI.

 

You will act as a technology scout and functional tester, ensuring teams understand how to use new tools effectively. With a strong technical background and a focus on increasing organizational productivity, you will evaluate new AI capabilities, deliver engaging training, and participate in cross-functional risk mitigation procedures to ensure secure and compliant rollouts.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Tech Watch, Testing & Functional Configuration
    • Feature Evaluation & Tech Watch: Track the fast-moving AI market, acting as a technology scout for upcoming generative and agentic AI capabilities embedded primarily within the Google ecosystem, assessing other systems like Workday and Oracle as needed.
    • Functional Testing & Test Documentation: Actively test new AI features (such as Workspace Studio, NotebookLM, and Gemini) within sandbox or Alpha environments as soon as they are announced, evaluating user experience, functional limitations, and integration risks. Meticulously document all test plans, execution steps, and outcomes to maintain a clear and reliable functional knowledge base.
    • Technical Configuration & Issue Tracking: Build master templates and configure advanced operational setups (such as automated project structures or intelligent workflows) to support business pilots. Provide specialized guidance for advanced Google products, utilizing scripting where necessary to automate simple workflows. Create, manage, and escalate technical tickets effectively to track bugs, vendor issues, and user feature requests.

 

  • User Adoption, Training & Enablement
    • Driving Adoption & Productivity: Develop and execute strategies to champion the active user adoption of AI tools across the business. Build awareness around enterprise-approved tools while guiding and migrating users away from unapproved tools toward Google Workspace and other supported solutions. Identify opportunities to leverage technology to streamline daily tasks, eliminate bottlenecks, and significantly increase overall workforce productivity.
    • Documentation & Translation: Translate complex vendor release notes and technical evaluations into clear, easy-to-understand functional impact analyses and plain-language user guides.
    • Training & Upskilling: Design and deliver engaging training sessions and workshops to raise the overall AI literacy of employees, acting as an expert to help productivity teams understand how various corporate AI tools intersect.
    • Best Practices Watch: Observe how peer media organizations or similar enterprises use AI in their daily operations.

 

  • Cross-Functional Support & Risk Mitigation
    • Governance Participation: Assist in partnering with internal compliance teams (Legal, Privacy, InfoSec, Accessibility) to ensure corporate AI tools meet enterprise standards. Help prepare functional impact analyses for governance committees, shaping corporate policies without leading the committees.
    • Risk Mitigation: Support the ongoing monitoring of automated vendor updates and the execution of deployment strategies designed to protect sensitive organizational and personal data.

 

  • AI Pilots, Accelerators & Special Projects
    • Business Analysis & Scoping: Partner directly with diverse business units to identify practical AI opportunities, translate complex user requirements into actionable functional use cases, and scope corporate special projects.
    • Pilot Deployment & Value Tracking: Support the analysis and deployment of "AI Accelerator" pilot projects. Define, monitor, and measure business success metrics (such as workflow simplification or time saved) to assess the real-world return on investment for corporate tool AI initiatives, ensuring pilots directly contribute to increased business productivity.

 

Qualifications & Ideal Profile

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Product Owner, or in a similar role.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a rigorous approach to documenting processes, managing tickets, and maintaining project structures.
  • Demonstrated passion for driving user adoption, change management, and leveraging technology to increase organizational productivity and efficiency.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience).
  • Strong technical knowledge of Google Workspace and its core applications, combined with AI literacy and a sharp ability to rapidly leverage AI tools.
  • Fluency in both French and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both official languages.
  • Comfortable speaking in front of groups, delivering interactive training sessions, and producing clear, high-impact reporting for executive stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of conducting thorough business process analysis, testing tools, and mapping complex workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with legal, privacy, security, or accessibility partners, with the diplomacy needed to balance user innovation against corporate risk frameworks.

job.title: Director, FAST Licensing
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Entertainment Global is seeking a Director of FAST Licensing to manage content strategy, channel programming, and account management across international FAST digital platforms, working internally with relevant groups within the wider FOX organization. Reporting directly to the Executive Director, TVOD & Revenue Share, this role will drive revenue and viewership growth primarily through the strategic licensing of FOX content to established third party channels and platforms, while simultaneously collaborating with internal teams to establish the foundation for the future launch and management of owned FOX FAST channels.


The Director will serve as a senior, client facing leader responsible for daily platform relationships, commercial strategy, and channel performance. The role will maximize the value of FOX content by applying a deep understanding of ad supported media rights, windowing, audience engagement, programming strategy, and partner business objectives. Success will require strong analytical judgment, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to move complex initiatives forward under strict deadlines.


Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage FAST distribution strategy internationally and leverage relationships across the organization to license FOX content to third party platforms, structuring deals to maximize inventory yield, reach, and revenue
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for key accounts, building trusted relationships to support renewals, channel placement, and long-term collaboration
  • Partner directly with OEM platforms and digital partners to negotiate and secure premium in-platform merchandising, promotional placement, and marketing visibility that enhance channel discoverability and viewer acquisition
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Ad Sales to execute distribution plans, track deliverables, and present forecasts to internal leadership
  • Collaborate with internal teams across the organization to help drive the future international rollout of owned FOX FAST channels, partnering to coordinate programming, technical setup, asset delivery, and operational readiness
  • Operationalize KPI frameworks to evaluate viewership metrics, channel performance, and audience retention to inform content selection and optimize engagement
  • Develop joint business plans and evaluate content availability, rights, and windowing to maximize revenue across ad supported and revenue share opportunities
  • Support deal negotiations and review licensing agreements to balance partner needs with FOX financial and strategic objectives

WHAT YOU WILLNEED

  • 7+ years of experience in FAST distribution, digital distribution, licensing, or account management, preferably at a major studio or media company
  • 2+ years of experience operating as a direct client facing primary point of contact and managing daily account activities
  • Experience working with international clients, markets, or digital distribution businesses and understanding of global audiences
  • Experience managing programming strategy, including content selection, channel scheduling, audience retention, and performance optimization
  • Direct, hands-on experience partnering directly with OEM platforms such as Samsung TV Plus, LG, and Roku
  • Demonstrated experience in sales analysis, performance reporting, forecasting, and joint business planning
  • Familiarity with licensing agreements, ad revenue share structures, commercial terms, and deal execution; negotiation experience
  • Deep understanding of licensed media rights, content availability, windowing, and digital distribution models
  • Entrepreneurial, "builder" mindset with a proven ability to help take digital channels from concept to successful launch and execution
  • Strong critical thinking skills and the ability to translate data, market dynamics, and client objectives into practical recommendations
  • Proven ability to lead projects and workflows across multiple teams while managing competing priorities and strict deadlines
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship building, and stakeholder management skills
  • Professional who takes initiative, exercises sound judgment, and is comfortable managing responsibilities with limited direction
  • Highly organized, detail oriented, and able to manage multiple accounts, deliverables, and timelines in a dynamic environment

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • MBA

job.title: Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KTVU FOX 2 is seeking a versatile, hands-on Broadcast Engineer to join our team in Oakland, CA. Maintains and installs equipment at the studio and technical facilities, provides broadcast engineering support for all news and production operations (both linear and streaming), assists and trains operators, and collaborates on technical projects varying in scale. This role is ideal for a proactive engineer with strong troubleshooting instincts looking to contribute to a live, 24/7 news operation.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Studio & Production Support: Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot studio cameras, robotic pedestal systems, production switchers, audio consoles, graphics systems, and news video playback equipment.

Signal Flow & Routing: Maintain central routing, master control systems, TOC, and terminal equipment to ensure flawless linear and streaming video/audio delivery.

Newsroom IT & Systems Maintenance: Assist with the upkeep and integration of newsroom computer platforms, editing bays (NLEs), playout servers, virtual platforms, and production automation systems (e.g., Ross Overdrive, NRCS).

System Integration & Documentation: Design, wire, and integrate equipment racks, patch bays, and IP-based broadcast infrastructure. Develop support documentation and standards for operations personnel.

Operational & Incident Support: Perform operational duties in Master Control and TOC as scheduled. Respond to, manage, and track technical issues as they arise in a live 24/7 environment with urgency.

Compliance & Standards: Ensure all operations and broadcast technology comply with FCC rules, safety standards, and station engineering protocols.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience: 3–5 years of experience in broadcast equipment maintenance, studio AV setup, system integration, or IT/networking in a broadcast environment.

Technical & IT Skills: Strong diagnostic skills; working knowledge of computer networking (IP, subnets, switchers), virtual computing, basic tools, soldering, and custom cable fabrication.

Emerging Technologies: Familiarity with IP-based broadcast standards (e.g., SMPTE 2110, DANTE, NDI) and compressed video encoding/decoding techniques.

Communication & Logistics: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Must hold a valid driver's license with a good driving record for local travel as needed.

Schedule Flexibility: Ability and willingness to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to support continuous news operations.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & EDUCATION

Physical Demands: Ability to stand, walk, reach, stoop, climb ladders, work behind equipment racks, and lift up to 50 lbs.

 

Education & Certifications: Technical degree in Electronics, IT, or equivalent military/trade experience. SBE, Cisco, CompTIA, or Microsoft certifications and AutoCAD experience are a plus.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Corporate Travel Consultant is responsible for coordinating and managing end-to-end domestic and international travel arrangements for executives, talent, production teams, and groups, ensuring an efficient, well-organized travel experience aligned with the company's operational needs.

This role requires specialized expertise in Global Distribution Systems (GDS), travel reservations and ticketing, supplier negotiations, and corporate travel policy compliance.

The position also involves providing timely assistance and follow-up on travel-related requests and issues that may arise before, during, and after trips, offering support as operational needs require and in accordance with established company procedures and service arrangements.

 

Key Responsibilities

1. Travel Operations and Reservations

  • Coordinate and manage end-to-end travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, car rentals, and rail services for executives, vice presidents, talent, and production teams.
  • Research and compare routes, schedules, fares, and connections to recommend cost-effective travel options aligned with corporate policies and approved budgets.
  • Develop and manage complex and multi-destination itineraries, ensuring seamless coordination of all travel services.
  • Maintain accurate traveler profiles, loyalty program information, and required travel documentation.

 

2. GDS and Ticketing Operations

  • Utilize Global Distribution Systems (Sabre and/or Amadeus) to create, modify, and manage Passenger Name Records (PNRs), electronic tickets, and Electronic Miscellaneous Documents (EMDs).
  • Manage public, private, and corporate fares, fare rules, routing requirements, IATA codes, and BSP procedures.
  • Process ticket issuance, reissues, itinerary changes, cancellations, refunds, and applicable penalties in accordance with established policies.
  • Monitor unused tickets and travel credits to maximize cost recovery and optimize company resources.

 

3. Payments, Billing, and Reconciliation

  • Manage authorized payment methods, including corporate credit cards, centralized payment solutions, and bank transfers.
  • Ensure accurate allocation of expenses to the appropriate cost centers, projects, and internal accounting records.
  • Request, validate, and follow up on tax invoices, ensuring compliance with Mexican fiscal requirements, including RFC, legal entity information, and CFDI usage.
  • Support financial reconciliation processes with airlines, hotels, and other travel suppliers, identifying discrepancies, duplicate charges, and billing inconsistencies.

 

4. Traveler Support and Incident Management

  • Provide timely assistance and follow-up on traveler requests, ensuring a responsive and service-oriented experience.
  • Manage travel disruptions, including flight delays, cancellations, missed connections, overbookings, and last-minute itinerary changes.
  • Coordinate alternative arrangements to address accommodation, transportation, or travel documentation issues.
  • Maintain effective communication with travelers and relevant internal teams, providing updates and escalating critical situations when appropriate.
  • Assist with travel-related operational matters requiring special attention, based on business needs and in accordance with established internal procedures and service coordination arrangements.

 

5. Supplier Relations and Cost Management

  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with airlines, hotel chains, car rental companies, and travel service providers.
  • Negotiate waivers, special arrangements, traveler protections, and alternative solutions when necessary.
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities and recommend improvements to travel booking and procurement processes.
  • Monitor supplier performance and service quality while promoting compliance with corporate travel policies.

 

Requirements and Qualifications

Professional Experience

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience as a Corporate Travel Consultant, Executive Travel Agent, or In-Plant Travel Consultant.
  • Previous experience in the media, entertainment, sports, or live production industries is preferred.

Technical Expertise

  • Advanced proficiency in Sabre and/or Amadeus is required.
  • Strong knowledge of IATA/BSP procedures, fare rules, NDC platforms, and IATA codes.
  • Experience with SSR, OSI, and APIS procedures.
  • Proven experience in domestic and international ticket issuance, modifications, cancellations, and refunds.

Languages

  • Native Spanish proficiency.
  • Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively in international business environments.

Technical Tools

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Experience with corporate travel booking and expense management platforms.
  • Familiarity with Workday, Coupa, or Graphite is preferred.

Core Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation.

  • Effective problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Adaptability to changing operational requirements and unexpected situations.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Supplier negotiation and relationship management.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks in fast-paced, high-demand environments.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

About the Role

Fox Tech runs one of the most complex 24/7 streaming and broadcast operations in the industry. Our overnight and weekend coverage depends on people who can move smoothly between disciplines, so we're hiring a Floating Operations Specialist who can cover wherever the business needs them most.

This is not a single-desk job. On one shift you might be monitoring live event streams for FOX One, FOX Sports, and FOX Nation. On the next, you might be running master control playlists or watching SCTE ad markers and CDN dashboards in the Media Control Center. You'll learn each area, build the skills to work in it independently, and help the team respond quickly when priorities change mid-shift.

If you get energy from switching gears, learning new systems, and adapting to whatever the night brings, this role was built for you.(add in get to expand technical stack)

What You'll Do

  • Digital Operations: Monitor live events, app clients, and video performance across FOX One, FOX Sports, FOX Nation, and Tubi. Run pre-flight checks, encoder validations, entitlement sweeps, and post-event validation (DVR, highlights, short-form), and complete regular app sweeps for functionality and parity.
  • Master Control: Support media ingest, quality control, assembly, playout, and distribution for pre-programmed and live content. Perform on-air switching and run automation playlists in multicast and live sports environments.
  • Media Control Center: Monitor SCTE markers, CDN performance, and transmission dashboards for signal health and delivery quality. Support inbound contribution and outbound distribution across linear and OTT platforms.
  • Incident & Handoff Support: Log incidents accurately in JIRA, PagerDuty, and ServiceNow, escalate issues to the right team, and write clear shift handoff notes for the morning team.
  • Documentation: Help create and update runbooks, checklists, and playbooks as processes evolve.
  • Cross-Team Coverage: Step in to support Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and Live Media teams when needed.

What You Need

  • Strong attention to detail, checklists, and ticket documentation/ escalation
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new tools and workflows quickly and apply them under time pressure
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially for handoffs and incident updates
  • Availability for overnight, weekend, and holiday shifts

Nice to Have, not a Dealbreaker

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field
  • Experience in a 24/7 environment such as master control, broadcast operations, a network operations center, or digital streaming operations
  • Bilingual Spanish/English
  • Prior experience leading or documenting incidents

What Success Looks Like

  • You can move from one area to another without losing focus or accuracy.
  • You stay calm when priorities change in the middle of a shift and adjust the plan without being asked.
  • You notice small details, such as a missing ad marker or a slow app load, and act on them.
  • You learn a new system quickly, ask good questions, and document what you learn for the next person.
  • Teammates count on you to cover gaps, and you pick up the work that needs doing.

About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 markets measured by Nielsen in 2025. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KBTX:

KBTX Media operates the CBS and CW affiliates in Bryan-College Station, Texas, serving an 18-county area known as the Brazos Valley. For nearly 70 years, we’ve been the dominant choice for local news and entertainment. Our team produces nearly 40 hours of broadcast content each week, along with a constant presence online at KBTX.com.

KBTX is routinely recognized among the best in the state by organizations including the Associated Press, RTDNA, and the Lone Star EMMY Chapter of the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences. The station has won four consecutive Texas Association of Broadcasters’ Bonner McLane Public Service awards, and in 2023 won a National Edward R. Murrow Award for Digital content. KBTX is also a recent Texas AP Broadcasters/Freedom of Information Foundation of Texas Station of the Year and Texas Associated Press Broadcasters Station of the Year.

The station has launched the careers of many well-known journalists, meteorologists, and network executives, and takes pride in helping talent grow quickly into the nation’s largest television markets. The work family of KBTX is made up of a group of dedicated, professional, and passionate individuals who are the backbone of our daily mission.

Bryan-College Station, Texas, is a community of more than 250,000 people and the largest single metro in the Waco-Temple-Bryan DMA. The twin cities have a unique small-town feeling, but offer big city amenities, including a vibrant arts community, a city-wide, all-terrain trail system, and world-class dining and nightlife. Bryan and College Station are routinely recognized as a leader in quality of life and as one of the fastest-growing communities in the country.
College Station is home to Texas A&M University, the nation’s largest university. Aggie home football games attract more than 100,000 in the stands, with tens of thousands more camped outside celebrating at tailgates during football weekends.

Learn more about KBTX at www.kbtx.com.

WIS is currently recognized as the South Carolina Broadcasters Association's Station of the Year and has won the award a record 17 times. WIS has earned the Edward R. job.title: Digital Campaign Specialist
job.description:
WKRG is seeking an experienced Digital Campaign Specialist to support the execution, measurement, and optimization of our digital advertising solutions. This role serves as the technical bridge between our sales team, corporate ad operations, digital partners, and clients.  You will coordinate campaign setup, implement tracking, monitor performance, and analyze results to help ensure campaigns deliver measurable value. You will also equip our sales team with the insights, recommendations, and technical expertise they need to grow client relationships and digital revenue.  This is a hands-on technical role for someone who understands digital advertising tools, can troubleshoot problems independently and knows how to turn data into actionable business insights.

Key Responsibilities

 

Campaign Strategy & Coordination

  • Translate client objective into coordinate, full-funnel campaign plans rather than disconnected tactics.
  • Coordinate campaign setup with corporate ad operations and extended digital partners, communicating essential requirements such as creative assets, tracking pixels, audiences, geography, product specifications, timelines, and measures of success.
  • Work with digital partners across programmatic, CTV/OTT, online video, streaming audio, social, paid search, and email.
  • Monitor campaign pacing and performance, identify issues and coordinate solutions or recommend optimizations.

 

Tracking and Measurement

  • Implement and troubleshoot Google Tag Manager, GA4 events, pixels, conversion tags, UTM standards, call tracking and form tracking.
  • Measure relevant outcomes such as qualified visits, calls, leads, appointments, bookings, purchases, and matched-audience activity where data allows.
  • Distinguish delivery metrics from business outcomes and communicate attribution or cross-platform measurement limitations clearly.
  • Analyze campaign, audience, and client-provided data to identify trends and next steps.

 

Technical Expertise & Sales Support

  • Build and maintain mobile-friendly landing pages and lead forms and conversion pathways aligned with campaign goals.
  • Audit digital readiness to include website experience, analytics, conversion friction, content quality, local business information, reviews and brand consistency. 
  • Develop clear, client-ready reports that connect campaign performance to client goals.
  • Identify performance trends, optimization opportunities and potential upsells, sharing actionable recommendations with sales team.
  • Partner with sales team to develop digital proposals, including recommended tactics, budgets, targeting, estimated delivery and measurement plans.
  • Join client meetings, discovery calls, and campaign reviews when technical expertise is needed.

 

Qualifications

 

Required

Candidates must have hands-on experience with the following:

  • Analytics and tracking: Proficiency with GA4, Google Tag Manager, tracking pixels, conversion events, UTMs, and attribution fundamentals.
  • Digital campaign operations:  Experience with campaign setup, targeting, creative requirements, pacing, performance troubleshooting, and optimizations across multiple channels.
  • AI-era discovery:  Understanding of generative search, AI visibility, zero-click behavior, content authority, and video discoverability.
  • Audience strategy:  Familiarity with first-party data, household or addressable targeting, propensity signals, retargeting, match back, and privacy conscious measurement.
  • Conversion experience: Experience with landing pages, forms, websites, and digital touchpoints that influence lead quality and conversion.
  • Paid digital advertising: Working knowledge of SEM and other paid digital campaigns, including performance analysis and optimization.
  • Reporting and analysis: Ability to analyze data across multiple platforms, identify trends, explain limitations, and communicate actionable recommendations.

 

Preferred

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience in digital advertising, ad operations, campaign strategy, marketing analytics, or performance media.
  • Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, ad servers, DSPs, CTV/OTT platforms, social platforms, YouTube, CRM systems, or first-party data workflows.
  • Experience with AI visibility audits, content strategy, generative search readiness, publisher content, or video discoverability.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, including sound judgement about what campaign data can and cannot prove.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical concepts and performance results in plain language.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines while working collaboratively with sales, corporate teams, and external partners.
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, analytics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

The Traffic Reporter serves as the face of the FOX 2 CrossRunner, a first-of-its-kind cross-platform mobile newsroom that allows you to work on the go while streaming live to air and digital audiences. Equipped with workstations, cameras, live streaming capabilities, and an onboard drone, the CrossRunner enables real-time traffic reporting and breaking news coverage from anywhere in the market.

The Ideal Candidate:

·         Pitch, shoot, write, edit, produce, and present content for broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.

·         Build direct relationships with audiences through authentic engagement on social media and community events.

·         Collaborate with producers, reporters, photographers, content creators, and digital teams to maximize the reach and impact of coverage.

·         Maintain the highest standards of journalistic integrity, accuracy, fairness, and production quality.

·         Participate in special projects and other duties as assigned.

 

Qualifications

·         Minimum two years of experience in reporting, multimedia journalism, traffic reporting, anchoring, or related newsroom experience.

·         Strong live presentation, conversational delivery, and ad-lib skills.

·         Superior on-air presence and the ability to communicate complex situations clearly and confidently.

·         Excellent writing, editing, storytelling, and communication abilities.

·         Experience creating engaging content for broadcast, digital, streaming, social, and video platforms.

·         Experience shooting, editing, and producing multimedia content.

·         Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

·         Flexibility to work schedules driven by breaking news and coverage needs.

job.title: Director, Association Events & Strategic Sourcing
job.description:
Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.

The Director of Association Events & Strategic Sourcing leads long-range strategic sourcing, procurement, and contract negotiations for hotel accommodations, meeting venues, and food and beverage programs across all premier Championships and Association initiatives. This role oversees third-party vendor relationships, manages event budgets, and ensures financial stewardship and legal protection for major events, including the PGA Championship, Ryder Cup, Board of Directors meetings, Annual Meetings, governance meetings, executive leadership events, PGA REACH functions, and other Association initiatives. Additionally, the position drives operational excellence, establishes procurement best practices, and directs the planning and execution of executive and Association special events.


RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):


Strategic Sourcing & Long-Range Planning

Lead the multi-year planning cycle, securing hotel room blocks, meeting spaces, event venues, and key supplier relationships up to three to five in advance of Championships and Association events. 


Continually monitor hospitality industry trends, market compression cycles, and market fluctuations to identify risks and leverage negotiation opportunities early.


Lead destination research, hotel evaluations, venue assessments, and site inspections to identify facilities that best support the operational and strategic needs of the PGA of America.


Contractual Engagements & Financial Stewardship

Direct sourcing, RFP development, evaluation, negotiation, and execution of hotel agreements, all master service agreements, venue contracts, catering agreements, and other event related vendor contracts.


Negotiate contracts that protect the PGA of America from attrition, cancellation, force majeure while maximizing concessions,  rebates and value added services.


Develop and manage multi million dollar event budgets, forecasting future costs while ensuring procurement decisions maximize return on investment and operational efficiency.


Association Event Planning & Association Event Management

Serve as the strategic lead for planning and executing Association events, including Board of Directors meetings, the Annual Meeting, PGA REACH events, executive leadership and governance meetings, officer functions, awards events, VIP receptions, and internal conferences and retreats.


Develop comprehensive event plans including timelines, logistics, staffing, transportation, décor, entertainment, audiovisual production, registration, signage, and overall guest experience.


Establish operational standards and best practices to ensure consistency across all Association events regardless of location.


Food & Beverage Strategy

Develop comprehensive food & beverage strategies supporting Association meetings, executive functions, and special events.


Collaborate with hotels, venues, caterers, and culinary partners to develop menus, banquet service plans, beverage programs, and hospitality experiences that reflect the PGA of America's standards.


Oversee banquet guarantees, menu pricing, catering negotiations, service standards, and budget performance.


Identify innovative culinary experiences that enhance executive and member engagement while maintaining financial discipline.


Vendor & Strategic Partner Management

Develop and maintain long-term relationships with preferred hotel brands, convention centers, destination marketing organizations, destination management companies, transportation providers, audiovisual firms, entertainment partners, production companies, rental suppliers, registration vendors, and other strategic event partners.


Evaluate vendor performance through measurable service standards while identifying opportunities for increased efficiencies, innovation, and cost savings.


Maintain preferred supplier programs that create long-term value for the Association.


Executive & VIP Experience

Develop a thorough understanding of the expectations of PGA Officers, Board Members, Executive Leadership, PGA REACH donors, Championship leadership, players, sponsors, international guests, and member volunteers.


Serve as the Association's hospitality advisor for executive meetings and special events, ensuring every experience reflects the professionalism and brand standards of the PGA of America.


Oversee executive accommodations, VIP logistics, transportation coordination, and personalized service strategies.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Championship Directors, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Communications, Player Services, Volunteer Operations, Corporate Partnerships, Ticketing, and Executive Leadership to ensure all procurement and event strategies support organizational priorities.


Provide strategic guidance during championship planning related to Association functions and executive events conducted alongside PGA Championships and Ryder Cups.


Operational Excellence & Risk Management

Develop contingency plans for lodging, transportation, food & beverage, venue operations, and other critical event services.


Lead operational response during unexpected disruptions including weather, vendor issues, hotel challenges, transportation delays, and other event-related risks.


Continuously evaluate processes and implement improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance the Association event experience.


Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Recruit, mentor, and develop a high performing team responsible for strategic sourcing, special event planning, and Association meeting execution while  fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.


Develop a deep understanding of the diverse clientele, ranging from PGA Executives, Board Members, and PGA REACH donors to players, and various sponsors, tailoring housing strategies to meet their distinct expectations.


Manage housing bureaus, registration providers, destination management companies and other event partners to ensure seamless execution and exceptional service delivery.


INCLUSION:

Employees are expected to contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and respecting others’ beliefs, backgrounds, identities, abilities, and individuality to help ensure a supportive and engaging experience for Association Members, partners, customers, and guests. PGA of America respects the uniqueness of each employee and offers everyone the means to find their place and thrive. 


SHARED VALUES:

Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values challenges and opportunities impacting you and your team.  Keep Leadership aware of the pulse of the workforce; recognizing, discussing, and addressing any cultural concerns.


SUPERVISION:

This is a supervisory position responsible for the performance management and hiring of employees within the department.  


FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:

Responsible for preparation and oversight of the Department budget and for monitoring results.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience preferred. 


Eight years of progressive leadership experience in strategic sourcing, hospitality management, corporate events, luxury hotel sales, meeting planning, or corporate procurement, with a focus on large-scale, citywide events and major sporting championships. Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams.


Four years team management experience.


Extensive knowledge of hotel contract law, attrition clauses, food and beverage agreements, venue contracts, and complex corporate or association negotiations.


Demonstrated experience managing multimillion-dollar event budgets, analyzing financial data, forecasting long-term costs, identifying savings opportunities, and ensuring all contractual obligations are met.


Experience in developing standard operating procedures, planning templates, and negotiation guidelines to support consistent and efficient event execution.

Travel and hospitality experience required.


SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES:

Must have thorough knowledge of administrative principles and procedures with the ability to work on various projects and programs as assigned.  A knowledge of the organization's functions of a business operation.  Skills in planning and organizing.  Ability to understand legal and contractual terminology as it pertains to event contracting. Ability to gather information, analyze data, and provide recommendations.  Ability to maintain the confidentiality of sensitive information with the highest level of integrity. Must have working knowledge of Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Google Docs. Basic fluency in artificial intelligence (AI) tools and concepts. This includes using AI to enhance business operations and drive innovation, enabling us to better serve our Members and stakeholders.


Ability to travel up to 25%.

job.title: Senior Director, Product Analytics

JOB TITLE: Senior Director, Product Analytics

LOCATION: Miami, FL

 

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

TelevisaUnivision is the world's leading Spanish-language media company, reaching millions of consumers through streaming, digital platforms, social media, audio, linear television, sports, news, entertainment, and live events. As we continue expanding our global streaming platform, ViX, we are investing in innovative technology, data capabilities, and advanced analytics to support business growth and deliver exceptional digital experiences.

The ViX Data & Insights team plays a critical role in enabling data-driven decision-making across our advertising-supported (AVOD) and subscription-based (SVOD) streaming businesses. Our team partners closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Acquisition, Advertising, Content, and other business functions to understand customer behavior, evaluate product performance, and identify opportunities to improve engagement, conversion, retention, and monetization.


We are looking for a Senior Director, Product Analytics to join our team in Miami, Florida. In this role, you will lead the Product Analytics function across ViX's digital platforms, including mobile, web, and Connected TV. You will be responsible for defining and executing the product analytics strategy, establishing measurement frameworks, advancing experimentation capabilities, and delivering actionable insights that influence product decisions, optimize customer experiences, and drive measurable business outcomes.

You will lead and develop a team of Product Analytics professionals, establishing priorities, driving accountability, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality analytical insights. You will also partner closely with senior Product, Engineering, Design, and Data leadership to improve data instrumentation, strengthen measurement capabilities, and promote a culture of data-driven decision-making across the organization.


ABOUT YOU:

You are an experienced analytics leader with a strong background in digital product analytics, customer behavior, experimentation, and data-driven product optimization. You have demonstrated success building and leading high-performing analytics teams that influence product strategy, improve customer experiences, and deliver measurable business outcomes, ideally within streaming, media, or direct-to-consumer digital businesses.

You have a deep understanding of the digital customer journey, from initial discovery and activation through engagement, conversion, retention, and monetization. You are skilled at identifying opportunities to improve product performance, establishing meaningful measurement frameworks, and translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that inform strategic business decisions.

You bring strong expertise in product experimentation, A/B testing, funnel analysis, behavioral analytics, and statistical methodologies. You understand how to establish reliable experimentation practices, evaluate product initiatives, and distinguish meaningful performance improvements from statistical noise or external influences.

You recognize that effective product analytics depends on accurate instrumentation, consistent user identification, reliable data validation, and standardized metrics across mobile, web, Connected TV, and other digital platforms. You are comfortable partnering with Product, Engineering, QA, and Data Engineering teams to strengthen data quality and ensure trustworthy measurement.

You are a strategic, collaborative, and influential leader who can build strong relationships with senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders. You combine analytical judgment with business acumen, helping teams prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, business value, and measurable results.

You are passionate about developing analytical talent, fostering accountability, advancing experimentation practices, and leveraging modern analytics technologies and AI to improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and product outcomes.



YOUR DAY-TO-DAY (RESPONSIBILITIES):

Product Analytics Strategy & Leadership

  • Lead the development and execution of ViX's Product Analytics strategy, priorities, and measurement frameworks across digital platforms and markets.
  • Establish the strategic direction, operating priorities, and analytical capabilities required to support product innovation, customer experience optimization, and business growth.
  • Partner with senior Product and business leadership to influence product roadmaps, investment decisions, feature prioritization, and long-term optimization strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, conversion, retention, and monetization, translating analytical insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators that measure product effectiveness, customer behavior, and the business impact of product initiatives.
  • Present product performance insights, analytical findings, and strategic recommendations to senior executives, influencing decisions through clear, data-driven storytelling.

People Leadership & Team Development

Lead, manage, coach, and develop a team of Product Analytics professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, analytical excellence, and continuous improvement.

  • Oversee employee performance management, including goal setting, ongoing feedback, performance evaluations, individual development plans, and career development discussions.
  • Establish team priorities, manage workload distribution, and ensure accountability for analytical deliverables, quality standards, and timelines.
  • Partner with leadership on workforce planning, talent acquisition, organizational capabilities, and succession planning to support the continued development of the Product Analytics function.
  • Provide technical and analytical guidance to team members, strengthening expertise in experimentation, statistical analysis, product measurement, and business insights.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, professional development, and consistent analytical methodologies across the team.

Customer Journey & Product Performance

  • Lead the development and execution of customer journey analytics strategies across discovery, onboarding, activation, engagement, conversion, and retention.
  • Oversee analyses that identify customer friction points, behavioral patterns, and opportunities to improve user experience, feature adoption, and conversion funnels.
  • Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the effectiveness of content discovery, search, recommendations, personalization, and other product experiences.
  • Drive consistent evaluation of product performance across AVOD and SVOD business models, customer segments, devices, and geographic markets.
  • Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to identify opportunities for product improvements and prioritize initiatives based on customer impact and business value.
  • Ensure product analytics insights inform strategies that improve customer engagement, subscription conversion, retention, and long-term customer value.

Experimentation & Product Optimization

  • Lead the strategy, development, and continuous improvement of ViX's product experimentation and A/B testing capabilities.
  • Establish standards and best practices for experimental design, statistical analysis, hypothesis development, and measurement methodologies.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design teams to define experiment objectives, success metrics, audience requirements, and analytical approaches.
  • Oversee experiment quality and reliability, including validation of audience allocation, sample sizes, statistical significance, data integrity, and measurement accuracy.
  • Guide the interpretation of experimental results and ensure findings translate into actionable recommendations for product launches, feature enhancements, and optimization initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of continuous experimentation and evidence-based decision-making across Product and Engineering teams.

Product Instrumentation & Data Quality

  • Define and oversee product analytics instrumentation strategies, event tracking requirements, measurement plans, and data collection standards across digital platforms.
  • Partner with Engineering, QA, and Data Engineering teams to ensure accurate event tracking, user identification, cross-device measurement, and data validation.
  • Establish consistent definitions and methodologies for product metrics to ensure reliable reporting and meaningful performance comparisons across platforms and markets.
  • Identify measurement gaps, data quality issues, and instrumentation opportunities, partnering with technical teams to implement sustainable improvements.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and Data Product Management teams to ensure underlying data capabilities support product analytics requirements and evolving business needs.

Reporting, Insights & Business Impact

  • Define and oversee the development of product performance dashboards, executive reporting, and self-service analytics capabilities that support timely, informed decision-making.
  • Lead analytical initiatives connecting customer behavior and product performance to engagement, subscription growth, retention, advertising monetization, and customer lifetime value.
  • Establish frameworks to measure the business impact of product releases, user experience changes, experimentation initiatives, and strategic product investments.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations and measurable business actions.
  • Monitor the effectiveness and adoption of product analytics capabilities, identifying opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, analytical quality, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, advanced analytics, and emerging AI capabilities to improve analytical workflows, insight generation, and operational efficiency.

YOU HAVE (QUALIFICATIONS):

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Product Analytics, Digital Analytics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related functions, including significant experience leading analytics teams and strategic initiatives.

  • Proven success building or scaling Product Analytics capabilities for large-scale consumer digital products, preferably within streaming, OTT, media, entertainment, gaming, or subscription-based businesses.
  • Strong understanding of digital product performance measurement, including customer journeys, activation, conversion funnels, feature adoption, engagement, retention, and monetization.
  • Extensive experience designing, analyzing, and interpreting A/B tests and controlled experiments, including statistical significance, sample size estimation, statistical power, and experiment validation.
  • Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, experimental design, cohort analysis, segmentation, funnel analysis, and customer behavioral analytics.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency and demonstrated experience working with large-scale analytical datasets, cloud data warehouses, and complex data models.
  • Experience with digital product analytics and event tracking technologies, including Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong understanding of product event instrumentation, data collection methodologies, user identification, cross-platform tracking, and data quality validation.
  • Experience establishing product KPIs, analytical frameworks, executive reporting, and measurement standards that translate complex datasets into actionable business insights.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with senior Product, Engineering, Design, and business leaders to influence product strategy and drive measurable improvements.
  • Proven ability to establish team priorities, manage resources, oversee complex analytical initiatives, and ensure accountability for deliverables and business outcomes.
  • Strong analytical reasoning and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate competing hypotheses, and develop evidence-based recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical findings to technical and nontechnical audiences, including senior executives.
  • Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on analytical oversight in a fast-paced, evolving digital business.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and collaborating effectively with geographically distributed teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Master's degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Experience leading Product Analytics within streaming, OTT, digital media, entertainment, gaming, or direct-to-consumer subscription businesses.
  • Strong understanding of AVOD and SVOD business models, including customer acquisition, engagement, subscription conversion, retention, churn, advertising monetization, and customer lifetime value.
  • Experience analyzing product experiences across mobile applications, web, Connected TV, and other digital platforms.

  • Experience developing and scaling experimentation programs, including experimentation governance, statistical standards, and organizational best practices.

  • Experience developing analytics operating models, establishing team performance standards, and scaling analytical capabilities across complex organizations.
  • Experience working with geographically distributed teams and supporting products across multiple markets, particularly the United States and Latin America.

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Employment and education verification may be required.

Job Summary: Job Requirements The Music Assistant maintains, records, and supplies the flow of music from the in-house music archive to the producers for on-air usage, is involved in the input of music cue reporting and coordination of cue sheet tracking, and helps coordinate music shipments in and out of the Bristol Campus. Responsibilities: Works with others on the Music staff on the implementation of the company’s music procedures and policies as they pertain to ESPN Content. Organizes and inputs audio assets and music cue metadata into the cue sheet management system for all ESPN networks. Assists in the registration of ESPN-owned copyrights and organization of copyright metadata. Management of the storage, organization, updates, and ingest of digital metadata for tracking and monetization. Edits music cuts for thematic, commercial, and library music packages, as needed. Works with Music Coordinators to organize, compile, and deliver series/seasonal music packages for assigned productions. Assists in the preparation, filing, trafficking, and organization of music licenses and related music documentation. Inputs song and license fee information for cleared third-party songs into the departmental database. Cue sheet support including, but not limited to, the approval of music cue sheets, facilitation of cue sheets to licensors, compliance reporting for all ESPN networks, delivery of ESPN cue sheets to affiliated networks and/or publishing entities. Coordinates updates from production music libraries, tracks usage, and liaises with production contacts at the libraries. Assists in the procurement and monitors the circulation of physical audio media. Maintains the department’s Music Resource website. Responsible for the organization, upkeep, and maintenance of the Music Department’s audio equipment. Manages the conversion of music from physical CDs to audio files for storage in digital archives. Exhibits the ability to train incoming employees on the department’s basic functions, cue sheet management system, and administrative systems currently in use. Assists others on the music team with other music-related projects and tasks, as needed. Assists in the preparation of clearance requests, reporting, correspondence, and licensing agreements, as needed. Required Qualifications: Must be willing to work second shift and weekends. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Prioritizes projects based on time and resources available. Demonstrates the required organizational and communication skills and abilities. Knowledge of both Mac and PC operating systems required, including proficiency in MS Word and MS Excel. Preferred Qualifications: Minimum of two years of college with some professional experience or understanding related to broadcast, technical operations, library science, or music backgrounds preferred. Ability to operate audio/video equipment and recording equipment, including Cart, ENCO, CD duplication, and various digital media software. Experience using Adobe Audition audio editing software or a similar DAW. Experience using WordPress or a similar Content Management System. Spanish proficiency. Required Education: High School Diploma or Equivalent. Preferred Education: Bachelor’s Degree. #ESPNMEDIA Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Bristol, Connecticut is $45,300.00-$60,700.00 per year based on a 40 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: Good Day New York Trainee, 6-Month Training Program
job.description:
FOX 5 – WNYW offers a hands-on, six-month training program for college graduates interested in television broadcasting. Working with the Good Day New York team, trainees gain practical experience in live news production and develop skills to pursue entry-level opportunities in broadcasting.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist producers with all aspects of production for Good Day New York.
  • Research stories, locations, celebrities, politicians and current newsmakers in the New York metropolitan area.
  • Greet guests and escort them from the lobby to the green room and studio.
  • Attend daily staff meetings and support producers with daily production tasks, including logging footage and organizing scripts.
  • Coordinate video clips and live feeds from the Scando computer with the Ingest team.
  • Monitor vertical video livestreams for TikTok.
  • Support show operations by escorting guests throughout the building and running production-related errands as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS

  • College graduate with a working knowledge of television production, news broadcasting, journalism and communications.
  • Strong interest in pursuing a career in broadcast journalism or television news production.
  • Strong research, communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, adapt to changing priorities and collaborate effectively with the Good Day New York team.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, live show environment.
  • Availability to work Monday through Friday on one of the following schedules: 4:30 a.m.–12:30 p.m. or 6:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m.
  • Ability to navigate the building using stairs and elevators while escorting guests and completing production-related tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
KTVU FOX 2 is seeking a versatile, hands-on Broadcast Engineer to join our team in Oakland, CA. Maintains and installs equipment at the studio and technical facilities, provides broadcast engineering support for all news and production operations (both linear and streaming), assists and trains operators, and collaborates on technical projects varying in scale. This role is ideal for a proactive engineer with strong troubleshooting instincts looking to contribute to a live, 24/7 news operation.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Studio & Production Support: Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot studio cameras, robotic pedestal systems, production switchers, audio consoles, graphics systems, and news video playback equipment.

Signal Flow & Routing: Maintain central routing, master control systems, TOC, and terminal equipment to ensure flawless linear and streaming video/audio delivery.

Newsroom IT & Systems Maintenance: Assist with the upkeep and integration of newsroom computer platforms, editing bays (NLEs), playout servers, virtual platforms, and production automation systems (e.g., Ross Overdrive, NRCS).

System Integration & Documentation: Design, wire, and integrate equipment racks, patch bays, and IP-based broadcast infrastructure. Develop support documentation and standards for operations personnel.

Operational & Incident Support: Perform operational duties in Master Control and TOC as scheduled. Respond to, manage, and track technical issues as they arise in a live 24/7 environment with urgency.

Compliance & Standards: Ensure all operations and broadcast technology comply with FCC rules, safety standards, and station engineering protocols.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience: 3–5 years of experience in broadcast equipment maintenance, studio AV setup, system integration, or IT/networking in a broadcast environment.

Technical & IT Skills: Strong diagnostic skills; working knowledge of computer networking (IP, subnets, switchers), virtual computing, basic tools, soldering, and custom cable fabrication.

Emerging Technologies: Familiarity with IP-based broadcast standards (e.g., SMPTE 2110, DANTE, NDI) and compressed video encoding/decoding techniques.

Communication & Logistics: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Must hold a valid driver's license with a good driving record for local travel as needed.

Schedule Flexibility: Ability and willingness to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to support continuous news operations.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & EDUCATION

Physical Demands: Ability to stand, walk, reach, stoop, climb ladders, work behind equipment racks, and lift up to 50 lbs.

Education & Certifications: Technical degree in Electronics, IT, or equivalent military/trade experience. SBE, Cisco, CompTIA, or Microsoft certifications and AutoCAD experience are a plus.
