job.title: Director, FAST Licensing
job.description:
FOX Entertainment Global is seeking a Director of FAST Licensing to manage content strategy, channel programming, and account management across international FAST digital platforms, working internally with relevant groups within the wider FOX organization. Reporting directly to the Executive Director, TVOD & Revenue Share, this role will drive revenue and viewership growth primarily through the strategic licensing of FOX content to established third party channels and platforms, while simultaneously collaborating with internal teams to establish the foundation for the future launch and management of owned FOX FAST channels.

The Director will serve as a senior, client facing leader responsible for daily platform relationships, commercial strategy, and channel performance. The role will maximize the value of FOX content by applying a deep understanding of ad supported media rights, windowing, audience engagement, programming strategy, and partner business objectives. Success will require strong analytical judgment, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to move complex initiatives forward under strict deadlines.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage FAST distribution strategy internationally and leverage relationships across the organization to license FOX content to third party platforms, structuring deals to maximize inventory yield, reach, and revenue
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for key accounts, building trusted relationships to support renewals, channel placement, and long-term collaboration
  • Partner directly with OEM platforms and digital partners to negotiate and secure premium in-platform merchandising, promotional placement, and marketing visibility that enhance channel discoverability and viewer acquisition
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Ad Sales to execute distribution plans, track deliverables, and present forecasts to internal leadership
  • Collaborate with internal teams across the organization to help drive the future international rollout of owned FOX FAST channels, partnering to coordinate programming, technical setup, asset delivery, and operational readiness
  • Operationalize KPI frameworks to evaluate viewership metrics, channel performance, and audience retention to inform content selection and optimize engagement
  • Develop joint business plans and evaluate content availability, rights, and windowing to maximize revenue across ad supported and revenue share opportunities
  • Support deal negotiations and review licensing agreements to balance partner needs with FOX financial and strategic objectives

WHAT YOU WILLNEED

  • 7+ years of experience in FAST distribution, digital distribution, licensing, or account management, preferably at a major studio or media company
  • 2+ years of experience operating as a direct client facing primary point of contact and managing daily account activities
  • Experience working with international clients, markets, or digital distribution businesses and understanding of global audiences
  • Experience managing programming strategy, including content selection, channel scheduling, audience retention, and performance optimization
  • Direct, hands-on experience partnering directly with OEM platforms such as Samsung TV Plus, LG, and Roku
  • Demonstrated experience in sales analysis, performance reporting, forecasting, and joint business planning
  • Familiarity with licensing agreements, ad revenue share structures, commercial terms, and deal execution; negotiation experience
  • Deep understanding of licensed media rights, content availability, windowing, and digital distribution models
  • Entrepreneurial, "builder" mindset with a proven ability to help take digital channels from concept to successful launch and execution
  • Strong critical thinking skills and the ability to translate data, market dynamics, and client objectives into practical recommendations
  • Proven ability to lead projects and workflows across multiple teams while managing competing priorities and strict deadlines
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship building, and stakeholder management skills
  • Professional who takes initiative, exercises sound judgment, and is comfortable managing responsibilities with limited direction
  • Highly organized, detail oriented, and able to manage multiple accounts, deliverables, and timelines in a dynamic environment

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • MBA
  • Familiarity with AI tools and their practical application in professional environments

job.title: Commercial Administrator
job.description:
The Commercial Administrator involves managing and coordinating commercial content for both linear and digital platforms ensuring that commercials are aired according to agency guidelines and standards. Key responsibilities include confirming the receipt of commercial instructions and media assets, editing and preparing daily program and commercial logs, and maintaining effective communication with Sales, Programming, and Agencies to promptly address any issues or missing elements. Strong organizational skills are essential to meet daily deadlines, and collaboration with On-air and programming teams, as well as Sales Administration and Operations/Live Ops, is crucial for managing schedules, formats, and promo/filler time. The position also involves assisting with additional Commercial Administration tasks as directed by Management, accurately reflecting program schedules and inventory in the system, and updating systems promptly to ensure accuracy and compliance. This role requires excellent organizational and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with various departments to ensure smooth operations.

  • Edit commercial placement in accordance with Sales directives 
  • Adjust log formats as necessary to insure correct log timing

  • Make needed adjustments to log automation elements

  • Any other Commercial Administration duties as assigned by Management

  • High school diploma
  • Prior computer experience
  • Experience with Windows-based software and database programs
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to communicate precise information clearly and accurately
  • Basic math, must be able to use calculator, timing calculator
  • Well organized and able to prioritize and manage time well
  • Able to make judgments within parameters as trained
  • Able to spot discrepancies and problem-solve using reports and other tools as trained
  • Able to balance multiple requirements and know when to bring an issue to Management’s attention
  • Ability to work within deadlines and maintain professional demeanor under pressure
  • Ability to multi-task and manage large volume of work

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • College degree
  • Prior Commercial Administration/Agency/Traffic experience
  • Microsoft Excel experience

job.title: Consultor De Viajes
job.description:
The Corporate Travel Consultant is responsible for coordinating and managing end-to-end domestic and international travel arrangements for executives, talent, production teams, and groups, ensuring an efficient, well-organized travel experience aligned with the company's operational needs.

This role requires specialized expertise in Global Distribution Systems (GDS), travel reservations and ticketing, supplier negotiations, and corporate travel policy compliance.

The position also involves providing timely assistance and follow-up on travel-related requests and issues that may arise before, during, and after trips, offering support as operational needs require and in accordance with established company procedures and service arrangements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Travel Operations and Reservations

  • Coordinate and manage end-to-end travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, car rentals, and rail services for executives, vice presidents, talent, and production teams.
  • Research and compare routes, schedules, fares, and connections to recommend cost-effective travel options aligned with corporate policies and approved budgets.
  • Develop and manage complex and multi-destination itineraries, ensuring seamless coordination of all travel services.

NBCUniversal is seeking a Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) and Site Utilites Manager to join the Facilities Operations and Engineering team in Universal City, CA.

The MEP & Site Utilities Manager provides technical and operational leadership for the mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and utility infrastructure supporting a large-scale, mission-critical facility or campus.

You will be responsible for ensuring the safety, reliability, efficiency, and resiliency of critical building and utility systems, including electrical distribution, HVAC and central plant equipment, plumbing, water, natural gas, stormwater, wastewater, and emergency power systems.

You will lead preventive and predictive maintenance strategies, infrastructure reliability initiatives, capital improvement projects, utility planning, emergency response, and regulatory compliance. You will also oversee multidisciplinary technical teams, contractors, vendors, and engineering partners while collaborating closely with Facilities, Engineering, Construction, Operations, EHS, Finance, Sustainability, and other business stakeholders.

What You’ll Do:

Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing & Critical Infrastructure Operations

  • Serve as the primary technical and operational resource for MEP systems and site utility infrastructure, directing the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and modernization of critical systems across multiple facilities.
  • Oversee medium- and low-voltage electrical distribution, including transformers, switchgear, substations, motor control centers, generators, automatic transfer switches, and UPS systems.
  • Manage central utility plants, chillers, cooling towers, chilled water systems, pumps, air handling units, HVAC, and building automation systems, as well as domestic water, sanitary sewer, stormwater, natural gas, industrial piping, drainage, and pumping stations.
  • Ensure equipment and infrastructure are maintained in accordance with engineering standards, manufacturer requirements, operating procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with engineering, construction, environmental health and safety, sustainability, security, and business units to evaluate equipment capacity, system redundancy, and expansion requirements, and to align infrastructure operations with production schedules, facility occupancy, and organizational priorities.

Infrastructure Reliability & Business Continuity

  • Develop and manage preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance programs for mission-critical infrastructure.
  • Lead risk assessments, equipment condition evaluations, and root-cause investigations; implement sustainable corrective actions to reduce equipment failures and unplanned outages.
  • Maintain emergency response plans, utility shutdown procedures, contingency strategies, and recovery plans; coordinate planned shutdowns with affected business units to minimize disruption(s).
  • Evaluate system redundancy, backup generation, UPS capacity, and emergency cooling, and support business continuity efforts during utility failures, natural disasters, and other critical events.

Site-Wide Utilities & Energy Management

  • Oversee electrical, natural gas, domestic water, wastewater, stormwater, and other utility services supporting facility and campus operations.
  • Build productive relationships and coordinate with public utilities, municipalities, regulatory agencies, engineering consultants, equipment manufacturers, and service providers on capacity, upgrades, planned shutdowns, and emergency restoration.
  • Monitor demand, peak loads, consumption, and system capacity to support planning for new construction, facility expansion, and changing operational requirements.
  • Drive utility reliability, energy efficiency, demand management, electrification, renewable energy, and distributed generation or microgrid initiatives.

Capital Projects & Infrastructure Modernization

  • Develop, prioritize, and execute capital improvement projects focused on infrastructure reliability, lifecycle replacement, energy efficiency, and long-term facility needs.
  • Manage MEP and utility projects from feasibility and design through procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout.
  • Prepare scopes of work, technical requirements, cost estimates, schedules, and capital justifications; review engineering drawings, specifications, submittals, and construction plans.
  • Coordinate architects, engineers, contractors, specialty trades, vendors, and internal stakeholders, evaluating lifecycle cost and total cost of ownership to ensure projects meet safety, budget, schedule, and operational requirements.

Team Leadership & Operational Management

  • Lead and provide technical direction to multidisciplinary facilities personnel, technicians, supervisors, engineering partners, and contractors.
  • Establish work priorities, performance expectations, and accountability; oversee daily maintenance, preventive maintenance schedules, work orders, inspections, and emergency repairs.
  • Support technical training, performance evaluations, employee development, workforce planning, and succession planning.
  • Manage vendor performance, service agreements, and service-level expectations while fostering a culture of safety, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Financial Management & Operational Budgeting

  • Develop and manage operating budgets, maintenance expenses, service contracts, and capital funding for MEP and utility infrastructure.
  • Evaluate replacement costs, project estimates, and infrastructure investments; prepare forecasts, budget justifications, and capital recommendations for senior management.
  • Manage vendor proposals, competitive bids, contract negotiations, purchase approvals, and project cost controls.
  • Identify cost savings through energy optimization, maintenance efficiencies, lifecycle planning, and strategic procurement while balancing reliability, safety, business continuity, and long-term asset preservation.

Regulatory Compliance, Safety & Risk Management

  • Ensure operations, maintenance, construction, and infrastructure modifications comply with applicable codes, standards, safety requirements, and environmental regulations.
  • Promote compliance with OSHA/Cal-OSHA requirements, NFPA standards, electrical safety practices, lockout/tagout, confined-space, and contractor safety requirements.
  • Coordinate inspections, permits, testing, certifications, and corrective actions; maintain operating procedures, safety records, inspection reports, and maintenance histories.
  • Identify operational hazards and infrastructure risks and implement mitigation strategies to protect personnel, facilities, equipment, and business operations.

Facilities Technology & Performance Reporting

  • Utilize CMMS, IWMS, BMS, asset management, and infrastructure monitoring technologies, including Archibus, ArcGIS/ESRI, Siemens, Tridium, and comparable systems.
  • Maintain accurate asset inventories, equipment records, electrical single-line diagrams, utility maps, and infrastructure drawings.
  • Establish KPIs, outage tracking, and dashboards for infrastructure availability, utility reliability, maintenance performance, asset condition, energy consumption, safety, and capital project delivery.
  • Use performance data, trends, and condition assessments to inform risk-based maintenance and capital decisions, and communicate infrastructure risks, service interruptions, project milestones, capital requirements, and technical recommendations to senior leadership.

Let’s Talk About You…

  • Analytical - You create tools and processes quickly and accurately to provide job estimates for clients levering deep industry experience, historical trends, teams and vendor relationships.
  • Executer - You get things done and take accountability! Using strong business acumen, organizational and superior process/project management skills, you prioritize and execute numerous complex projects in parallel.

  • Principles- Displays integrity, responsibility, accountability, teamwork, and ethics.
  • Team Player Fosters a culture of teamwork, mutual respect, and collaboration across diverse teams. Builds and maintains strong, productive relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Leadership - You are a proven leader known to challenge the status quo, introduce new and better ways of delivering results, and make difficult decisions and lead through change.

  • Strong technical understanding of electrical distribution, HVAC and mechanical infrastructure, plumbing systems, utility distribution, emergency power, and critical facility systems.

  • Ensure a consistent, diligent approach to peer review of code and configuration change within sensible, maintained repository structures and CI/CD pipelined deployment.
  • Participate in, or lead design reviews, architectural discussions and team knowledge‑sharing sessions with peers and stakeholders.
  • Make best use of our observability systems & advanced analytics to surface issues, drive diagnosis and develop fixes.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a relevant field is required.
  • 5+ years of experience in working with big data: ETL, pipeline building, analysis and code, with expertise in at least one programming language
  • Experience implementing scalable, distributed, highly available, and resilient systems using industry standard data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, GCP, AWS, etc.)
  • Skilled with using software repositories, CI/CD pipelines and test automation.
  • Experience with data visualization tools and techniques
  • Strong skills in data processing using SQL
  • Experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices for ensuring scalability and reliability in cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum and Kanban).  
  • A flair for communicating clearly via design document, text, voice and code to a wide variety of nationalities.
  • Knowledge and/or production exposure to using CDNs to deliver streaming media is advantageous or full training can be provided.

The Senior Development QA Tester partners directly with designers, engineers, and artists to test features throughout the development cycle. You’ll validate functionality, identify issues early, analyze root causes, and help maintain build stability. You will collaborate closely with developers, review requirements, and use tools to perform functional, regression, and performance tests, ensuring software is reliable, secure, and user-friendly.

  • Test new features during development and provide clear, actionable feedback to developers.
  • Identify, reproduce, and document bugs with detailed steps, logs, and supporting evidence.
  • Analyze issues to determine severity, patterns, and potential root causes.
  • Collaborate with engineers and designers to understand feature intentions, edge cases, and technical constraints.
  • Verify bug fixes and ensure regressions are caught early.
  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and checklists for ongoing features.
  • Support integration testing when new systems, builds, or content are merged.
  • Participate in daily stand‑ups, feature reviews, and sprint planning to stay aligned with development progress.
  • Use debugging tools, logs, and engine features to investigate issues more deeply.
  • Provide feedback on usability, clarity, and player experience from a QA perspective.
  • Help maintain build stability by identifying blockers quickly and communicating them effectively.

RESPONSABILITÉS

La personne responsable des tests QA senior en développement travaille directement avec les équipes de conception, d’ingénierie et d’art afin de tester les fonctionnalités tout au long du cycle de développement. Vous validerez les fonctionnalités, repérerez rapidement les problèmes, analyserez leurs causes fondamentales et contribuerez à maintenir la stabilité des builds. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de développement, examinerez les exigences et utiliserez différents outils pour effectuer des tests fonctionnels, de régression et de performance afin de garantir que le logiciel est fiable, sécuritaire et convivial.

  • Tester les nouvelles fonctionnalités pendant le développement et fournir aux équipes de développement une rétroaction claire et exploitable.
  • Repérer, reproduire et documenter les bogues en fournissant des étapes détaillées, des logs et des éléments probants à l’appui.
  • Analyser les problèmes afin d’en déterminer la gravité, les tendances et les causes fondamentales potentielles.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie et de conception afin de comprendre les objectifs des fonctionnalités, les cas limites et les contraintes techniques.
  • Vérifier les correctifs de bogues et veiller à ce que les régressions soient détectées rapidement.
  • Créer et tenir à jour des plans de test, des cas de test et des listes de vérification pour les fonctionnalités en cours de développement.
  • Soutenir les tests d’intégration lorsque de nouveaux systèmes, builds ou contenus sont fusionnés.
  • Participer aux réunions quotidiennes, aux revues de fonctionnalités et à la planification des sprints afin de rester au fait de l’avancement du développement.
  • Utiliser des outils de débogage, des logs et les fonctionnalités des moteurs de jeu afin d’analyser les problèmes plus en profondeur.
  • Fournir une rétroaction sur la convivialité, la clarté et l’expérience des joueurs du point de vue de l’assurance qualité.
  • Contribuer à maintenir la stabilité des builds en repérant rapidement les blocages et en les communiquant efficacement.

Basic Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (QA), software testing, or a related testing role, preferably within game development.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Selenium, Jira, SQL, or scripting languages.
  • Knowledge of software development lifecycles (SDLC) and debugging tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to simulate real-world user scenarios.
  • Strong understanding of game development workflows and common tools (Unity, Unreal, or proprietary engines).
  • Ability to write clear, concise, and reproducible bug reports.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with developers.
  • Ability to stay organized and detail‑oriented in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Passion for games and curiosity about how systems and features are built.

Exigences de base :

  • 4 ans ou plus d’expérience en assurance qualité (QA), en tests logiciels ou dans un rôle connexe en matière de tests, de préférence dans le domaine du développement de jeux.
  • Familiarité avec des outils tels que Selenium, Jira, SQL ou des langages de script.
  • Connaissance des cycles de développement logiciel (SDLC) et des outils de débogage.
  • Grand souci du détail et capacité à simuler des scénarios d’utilisation réels.
  • Solide compréhension des processus de développement de jeux et des outils couramment utilisés (Unity, Unreal ou moteurs propriétaires).
  • Capacité à rédiger des rapports de bogues clairs, concis et reproductibles.
  • Solides compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication et aisance à travailler directement avec les équipes de développement.
  • Capacité à rester organisé et à faire preuve de minutie dans un environnement au rythme soutenu.
  • Passion pour les jeux et curiosité à l’égard de la façon dont les systèmes et les fonctionnalités sont conçus.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Knowledge of version control systems (Perforce, Git).
  • Experience in embedded QA, feature‑focused QA, or Dev QA roles.

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Is this role for you?

The Licensing Manager – Softlines owns revenue growth, partner relationships and new business for the Softlines category, with a particular focus on home & accessories.

Working in a retail-first model, you’ll manage licensing relationships end to end, from pitch and negotiation through contract, launch and in-store performance. You’ll be the commercial lead for property launches with the region’s key retail partners, and accountable for your own numbers: budget, forecast, minimum guarantees (MGs) and sell-through as part of the wider softlines business.


What you will be doing?

Commercial ownership and performance

  • Own the Softlines portfolio on home & accessories and deliver or exceed annual revenue, MG and new-business targets.

  • Own the forecast, budget and long-range plan inputs for the portfolio, providing regular variance analysis that explains gaps to budget, the drivers behind them and the recovery actions.

  • Build growth plans per category and per partner, balancing retention and expansion of existing partners, collaborations, new brands and categories at current partners, and new partners.

  • Monitor concentration risk by property and by partner, and diversify the portfolio where needed.

New business and expansion

  • Define white space through market, consumer and retail analysis, and expand successful partnerships across additional categories and retailers.

  • Pitch and close new partners.

  • Secure MG-backed partners across categories ahead of major releases, partnering with the retail & marketing team to convert them into retail activations.

  • Partner with the Creative team to develop retailer-exclusive collections, capsules and limited editions, and collaborate with the team on cross-category initiatives.

  • Maintain a qualified pipeline with clear stages, owners and conversion targets.

Market analysis

  • Attend key trade shows and use in-house tools, including WGSN, to analyze fashion, retail and consumer trends, and bring them into strategy, partner pitches and growth plans.

  • Monitor competitor activity and developments in the market.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Partner closely with Operations, Product Development, Legal/BALA, Franchise, Retail & Marketing and Finance to deliver DTR programs efficiently and without interruption for partners.

  • Partner with Global CP teams on global launches and DTR initiatives, and share market insight and best practice with colleagues in the region.

What are we looking for?

  • 4+ years of experience in Softlines, fashion licensing or DTR models.

  • A track record of closing MG-backed deals and managing key retail accounts on exclusive or DTR programs.

  • Strong commercial, negotiation and business development skills, with a solid understanding of contracts.

  • Strong analytical skills: P&L ownership, forecasting, and the ability to explain performance against budget.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, internally and with external partners.

  • A self-starter who builds a pipeline from scratch and works well across cultures and markets.

  • Experience with licensing and royalty systems.


How Success Is Measured

  • Delivery against revenue and new-business targets, and MGs secured.

  • Retention and growth of key Softlines partners.

  • Pipeline value and conversion to signed agreements.

  • Sell-through and campaign performance at key retailers.

  • Forecast accuracy and the quality of variance analysis.

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. WKYC-TV Cleveland, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Cleveland, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of NBC broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers.

With sports stories and events happening year-round, there is no shortage of opportunities to tell compelling stories, uncover unique perspectives and connect with passionate sports fans across the region.

•    Co-host a high-energy daily sports streaming show, helping shape the format, develop segments and create engaging content from concept through execution.
•    Anchor sportscasts and deliver daily sports coverage across WFAA's linear newscasts.
•    Maintain a strong pulse on the North Texas sports landscape, from the Cowboys, Mavericks, Rangers, Stars and Wings to college programs and high school sports.
•    Identify compelling stories and emerging trends across the market and turn them into must-watch content for sports fans.
•    Produce cinematic, original, long-form sports stories that showcase the personalities, passion and events.
•    Cultivate strong industry and team contacts, consistently generating leads and serving as a key contributor to breaking sports news and developing exclusive stories.
•    Develop content for sponsored sports franchises and branded content opportunities across dayparts and platforms.

•    5+ years of sports journalism experience in a medium to major market.
•    Strong knowledge of the North Texas sports landscape.
•    Experience shooting with professional ENG cameras.
•    Ability to produce and edit video using Adobe Premiere Pro, Edius or equivalent editing software.

job.description:
Job Title

Senior Identity & Access Management Engineer

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements 

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Identity & Access Management Engineer to join the SaaS Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of automations within Okta and other SaaS applications, primarily using Okta Workflows. You will play a key role in streamlining identity and access management processes, improving operational efficiency, and enhancing security.

About The Team: | The Team and/or Brand.

The SaaS Management team is responsible for the overall health, optimization, and security of our core SaaS applications. This includes managing and maintaining critical services like Google Workspace, Okta, Jira, Slack, and Identity Management platforms. The team ensures seamless user experiences, efficient workflows, and cost-effectiveness across these applications. A key focus is automating processes to streamline operations, improve productivity, and enhance security across our SaaS landscape. This involves implementing and managing automations that simplify user onboarding/offboarding, license management, and other key tasks. Through all of this, the team strives to provide a delightful experience for our users, empowering them to do their best work.


About The Positions  Contributions:

Weight % - Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


30%: Manage and maintain the Okta Identity Cloud environment, including user lifecycle management, application integrations, and security policies.


30%: Design, develop, and deploy complex Okta Workflows to automate various identity and access management tasks (e.g., user provisioning, de-provisioning, group management, password resets, multi-factor authentication).
Continuously analyze and optimize existing Okta automations for efficiency, reliability, and scalability. Integrate Okta with other systems and applications using Okta APIs and connectors.


10%: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for Okta automations and processes.


10%: Provide support and troubleshooting for Okta-related issues, including workflow failures, user access problems, and integration errors.


20%: Adhere to security best practices and industry standards in the design and implementation of Okta automations. Keep up-to-date with the latest Okta features, updates, and best practices. Ensure the Okta data is backed and readily available for restorations in emergencies  Foster close collaboration with application owners and teams to ensure seamless integration.


The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements

Education: BA/BS Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering or Information Technology or relevant work experience.


Experience:

5+ years of industry experience in Identity and Access Management.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Deep understanding of Universal Directory (user/group management, directory integration), Single Sign-On (SSO) configuration (SAML, OIDC, WS-Federation), and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
  • Ability to design and build highly complex, multi-step workflows with conditional logic, loops, and error handling. 
  • Expertise in using Okta's built-in connectors and creating custom connectors to integrate with other systems and APIs.
  • Deep understanding of Okta's workflow functions for data manipulation, transformations, and system interactions.
  • Ability to analyze and optimize workflow performance for efficiency and scalability.
  • Experience with managing workflow versions, testing changes, and deploying updates in a controlled manner.
  • Advanced skills in working with Okta's APIs for automation and integration with other systems.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages like JavaScript for extending Okta's functionality and creating custom integrations.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform) for managing Okta configurations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to diagnose and resolve complex Okta-related issues.
  • Expertise in troubleshooting Okta workflows, SSO integrations, and other identity management challenges.
  • Ability to analyze Okta system logs to identify root causes of issues and performance bottlenecks.
  • Ability to create clear and concise documentation for Okta configurations, workflows, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with IT teams, HR teams, developers, and business stakeholders.
  • 5+ years of industry experience in Identity and Access Management.
  • Possess strong regular expression (Regex) skills for data manipulation and pattern matching.
  • Okta Certifications or/and other industry certifications

job.title: Analyst, Automation
job.description:
At Warner Chappell Music (WCM) - the global music publishing arm of Warner Music Group (WMG) - we shape the culture of songwriting and champion songs that resonate for generations by creating transformational opportunities for songwriters everywhere. Our people and culture are at the epicenter of our company, and we are looking for team members who share our service-oriented mindset and have a passion for looking after our songwriters.

Job Title: Analyst, Data Analytics

Location: Los Angeles


A little bit about our team:  

The Warner Chappell Global Strategy & Growth team is a team focused on delivering and implementing business objectives.  Working closely with our global leaders, we are responsible for driving and embedding our global business strategy. 


The Opportunity:

We're hiring an early-career Analyst (A&R focused) who lives at the intersection of music culture and data. We're open to two different backgrounds for this role: someone who has worked as an A&R coordinator and wants to build real skills in data analytics, SQL, and Python, or someone with analyst experience and SQL or Python skills who has a genuine interest in, or some exposure to, A&R and scouting. Either way, you'll help turn charts, streams, and catalog signals into insight that A&R teams can act on. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on continuous learning, whether that learning is on the technical side or the music industry side.


Your role:

You will translate key A&R questions—such as which artists are breaking, who is the next to break, who is behind a particular song, and which deals warrant attention—into actionable datasets, dashboards, and intuitive tools that empower A&R teams to make informed decisions. With the support of the broader Data Analytics & Automation (DA&A) team, you will also play a critical role in designing and building custom code-based tools and AI agents tailored to the specific needs of our A&R Research Team. You'll work closely with the entire DA&A team, who own the underlying pipelines and platform, while you focus on understanding what A&R actually needs and making sure it's delivered in a form they can use and trust.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Support Publishing Intelligence in Snowflake: Help build and maintain datasets that combine streaming performance, chart movement, and catalog context so A&R can spot momentum and publishing opportunities with confidence.
  • Help Deliver Recurring Insight Products: Contribute to regular briefings and reporting so scouting teams get timely, consistent narratives instead of one-off analyses.
  • Build Self-Service Research Tools: Help develop and improve internal tools that let A&R pull curated artist, writer, and release information without waiting on ad hoc requests.
  • Learn to Unify Internal and Market Data: Work with warehouse data alongside external chart, streaming, and market sources, and learn how we keep identity, such as writers, ISRCs, and credits, consistent at scale.
  • Apply AI Responsibly: Use LLMs and governed data tools to help accelerate research and answer questions, with outputs your A&R stakeholders can verify and act on.
  • Ship with Engineering Discipline: Work from prioritized tickets through documentation and simple code review, so your work is traceable and easy for others to pick up.
  • Partner with A&R Stakeholders: Translate scouting and signing questions into measurable definitions, and build relationships with A&R teams across different markets.
  • Learn and Grow: Actively participate in training and development, whether that means deepening your technical skills in SQL and Python or your music industry and A&R knowledge.

About you:

  • An A&R Background with a Data Interest, or a Data Background with an A&R Interest: You have either worked as an A&R coordinator or in a similar scouting-adjacent role and want to build real SQL and Python skills, or you have worked as an analyst and have genuine interest in, or some exposure to, A&R and the music industry.
  • Market and Repertoire Fluency: A genuine interest in charts, breaking artists, and publishing, including who controls the song versus the master, or a fast learner willing to pick this up from A&R partners.
  • Growing SQL Skills: You are comfortable with SQL already, or very motivated to become comfortable quickly, and understand, or want to understand, how to pull, clean, and structure data from relational databases.
  • Developing Scripting Skills (Python): Some hands-on Python experience, or strong motivation to build it, for data manipulation and light automation.
  • Collaboration with A&R Stakeholders: Ability to translate vague scouting asks into measurable definitions, such as market, genre, major versus indie, home territory, and time window, or a willingness to learn this quickly.
  • Product-Minded and Pragmatic: You have a “get it done” mentality and a knack for finding the most direct path to a useful answer.
  • Highly Autonomous and Collaborative: You take ownership of your own work, but thrive in a tight-knit team where you share ideas and ask for help.
  • Detail-oriented: Ability to pay close attention to detail and keep your work accurate.
  • Strong analytical aptitude: Ability to break down a problem and contribute to a solution.
  • Good communication skills: Ability to clearly articulate ideas and contribute to team discussions.
  • Team player: Ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (or equivalent practical experience), or equivalent experience working in an A&R, scouting, or roster-facing role.
  • Demonstrable SQL and/or Python experience through work experience, coursework, internships, or personal projects is expected from an analyst-background candidate, and a strong plus, though not required at the time of applying, for an A&R-background candidate.
  • Prior A&R, scouting, or artist/roster management experience is expected from an A&R-background candidate, and a plus, though not required, for an analyst-background candidate.
  • Exposure to BI tools or dbt is a plus.

job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

We currently have a fantastic opportunity for talented individuals to join our innovative and highly sought-after Emerging Talent Associate Program as an Emerging Talent Associate (ETA) this Spring.


Warner Music Group’s Emerging Talent Associate Program is a paid internship program designed to provide individuals with the opportunity to apply their skills and gain hands-on experience in the music industry. This multidimensional, semester-long program begins by matching ETAs to specific departments based on their interests as well as the position qualifications.


Here you’ll get to:


Upon joining the program, Emerging Talent Associates (ETAs) are fully immersed in the day-to-day activities of their assigned department.  They participate in strategic meetings, help solve key business issues, and offer ideas and perspectives to further WMG’s global success. In addition, working as an Emerging Talent Associate ensures access to incredible developmental activities such as our Professional Development Workshops, Industry Insights, and the Emerging Talent Associate Capstone Project.  


A little bit about the program:

  • Application Deadline: Friday, January 1, 2027 at 11:59pm 
  • Program Duration:
    • OPTION ONE: January 19, 2027 - March 26, 2027
    • OPTION TWO: January 25, 2027 - April 2, 2027
    • OPTION THREE: February 1, 2027 - April 9, 2027
  • Scheduled Weekly Hours: 20-25 hours per week (varies based on department)
  • Internship Credit is also provided for students seeking academic credit for this experience

A little bit about you:

  • At least 18 years of age by January 19, 2027
  • Located and legally authorized to work within the United States for the duration of the program
  • Emerging Talent Associates are responsible for their own housing and transportation within the designated city
  • A self-starter attitude with a genuine curiosity for our business
  • Able to commit to a 20-25 hour work week

It would be music to our ears if you also had:

  • Professional goals that align with Warner Music Group’s core values and business objectives
  • Knowledge of and passion for the different business units that makeup WMG
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as effective problem solving and organizational skills
  • Strong passion for and knowledge of the music industry
  • Leadership experience on or off campus

Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. The Sr. Brand Manager role is responsible for the day-to-day brand management of our strategic 360 artist partners, delivering full-service coordination across creative services, apparel and accessory production, touring, ecommerce and pop-up events. This includes day to day management of event collection launches that are in line with the artist's brand vision, drive revenue growth, and build great artist partnerships. The successful candidate must have experience managing high profile artist relationships, 5+ years in the music industry with an emphasis on merchandise management inclusive of pitching and managing artist and artist teams, developing business plans for artist retail merchandise collections with a focus on revenue margin and driving significant top and bottom-line results, and managing multiple responsibilities, within an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment.

Own the end-to-end merchandise strategy for strategic artist partners, serving as the primary point of contact for artist teams/management

Lead full-service coordination across creative services, apparel and accessory production, ecommerce, artist D2C, touring, and pop-ups

Collaborate with creative directors and manufacturers to develop innovative, on-brand products that resonate with fan communities

Own P&L accountability for assigned artist partnerships with a focus on revenue margin optimization and delivering significant top and bottom-line results

Leverage data and analytics to inform business decisions, identify growth opportunities, and measure collection performance

- 8 years in the Music Industry and artist management.
- 5+ years experience managing artist merchandise initiatives
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and/or Senior Leadership)

- 8+ years of experience in artist merchandise, licensed consumer products, or music industry brand development with demonstrated revenue growth
- Experience managing pop-up retail activations, live event merchandise, or experiential commerce programs
- Proven track record of building and scaling artist or talent-driven merchandise businesses, delivering measurable YoY revenue and margin improvement
- Experience leveraging data and analytics to inform product assortment decisions, identify growth opportunities, and optimize collection performance
- Deep relationships within the music industry, including artist management, labels, and creative agencies
- Experience working within a high-growth, entrepreneurial environment where you built processes and mechanisms from the ground up

job.title: General Manager of Local Media Services
job.description:
AccuWeather is searching for a General Manager of Local Media Services (LMS) to manage the four business units of this AccuWeather division, that include operations of TV systems, radio, newspaper, and Digital out of Home. These businesses have over 2000 customers and deliver significant local brand value and revenue to AccuWeather. The role will be responsible for the day-to-day oversight of the staff and will be responsible for driving revenue and profit growth through innovation, digital extensions, and integrated sales opportunities across the AccuWeather platforms. Will use LMS to help grow the AccuWeather brand in local and national markets, increase traffic to digital products (mobile and web) and drive app downloads (in print, radio or digital out of home).

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Manage the staff of four divisions of LMS –TV Systems, radio, newspaper and Digital Out of Home.

· Manage the P&L and be responsible for building and meeting/exceeding the annual budget

· Develop and create new products and services by working with AccuWeather executives, managers, product, and marketing.

· Drive sales, while working in partnership with Business Development, Digital Media, AccuWeather for Business and other relevant business units and divisions.

· Must be able to find opportunities that: drive traffic to the AccuWeather content, drive App downloads, and drive revenue.

· Provide leadership to a diverse team of TV technicians, sales and account managers

· Work with customers across all divisions to ensure quality of service, promoting new ideas, and growing the business through upsells and services

· Work with Forecast Operations to find efficiencies and new ways to deliver audio products (Podcasts, radio), graphics (across print and DOOH), and TV products.

· Develop new products like CityVue (Smart Cities application), Text to Speech forecast alerts, and digital linking partnerships with digital publishers.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

· Bachelor’s Degree with at least 5 years of successful business growth experience required

· Experience in managing B2B sales

· Experience with traditional media and digital

· Experience in broadcast engineering and broadcast technology preferred

· Experience working in or with local media station groups preferred

· Excellent sales knowledge and ability to develop new sales opportunities and creatively package integrated sales opportunities.

· Ability to multi-task and be detail oriented

· Should thrive in a high-paced work environment – manage multiple departments and people

· Experience leading development of innovative new products

· Must be a hands-on leader

· Ability to capitalize on traditional media reach/understanding and apply to digital media opportunities

 

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion 

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.  
 
AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Reporter
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KGW is looking for a creative, driven and curious news reporter who can shoot and edit his or her own stories. Known in our newsroom as a “multi-skilled journalist,” MSJs are a key part of our newsroom’s coverage on both broadcast and digital platforms.

We are looking for a candidate who isn’t afraid to tackle complicated stories, who will hold the powerful accountable, and who gets excited at the prospect of creating great journalism. The ideal candidate will pitch smart stories and tell them in way that is both creative and engaging.

Most stories will be same-day turns, while other times you’ll be given more time to execute your vision. You can expect to work solo many days, although there are ample opportunities to work with a photographer, especially on breaking news or complex stories.
Please let us know if you have experience producing and anchoring weather forecasts. While not required, candidates who have weather experience will be given extra consideration.

Our ideal candidate embraces the digital future of our industry and can show examples of strong work on digital, streaming and social media platforms.

This role is a full-time, non-exempt position represented by SAG-AFTRA. The position may include weekend shifts.

Responsibilities:

•    Report, write, shoot and edit news stories for broadcast and digital platforms. Use creative production techniques such as graphics and new forms of media to enhance stories.
•    Consistently pitch strong story ideas.
•    Maintain the highest journalistic standards in every story you cover. We expect you’ll report stories accurately and honestly, treat sources with fairness and empathy, and hold yourself accountable when you make a mistake.

Requirements:

•    Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or related field
•    Strong understanding of journalism ethics and best practices with a minimum of three years of experience in broadcast journalism or a related field
•    Experience with shooting video, video editing, and web content management systems
•    Ability to generate creative, engaging, content-driven live shots
•    Strong social media skills and presence
•    Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and changing events
•    Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
•    Knowledge of ENPS, Edius, Premiere, After Effects and Photoshop a plus
•    Ability to work days, mornings, nights or weekends as needed

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com

job.title: Producer
job.description:
Producer, Radiolab

Radiolab, pioneer of narrative nonfiction podcasting, is seeking a full-time Producer to join the team. Radiolab producers take ideas from pitch to broadcast, participating in all parts of the production process. We’re seeking an ambitious, deep-thinking, deep-feeling journalist who is obsessed with great stories, eager to help our team tackle the big questions facing our world today. The Producer will spend much of their time deep in tape, sorting through vast amounts of audio, crafting the arc of the episode in ProTools, and building out the story. They will work closely with the editorial team, making new drafts of episodes. Sometimes the Producer will work on ideas they’ve pitched; oftentimes they’ll produce other team member’s work. The Producer will help craft the soundscape of the show.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Regularly produce episodes from pitch to broadcast with minimal support

  • Find, pitch more ambitious, nuanced, and successful story ideas

  • Develop the arc of an episodes and craft narratives, with minimal editorial support

  • Executing notes from editors on new drafts of episodes

  • Cut interview selects and tracking tape

  • Source archival tape

  • Research for story ideas, booking guests, arranging logistics (ie ISDN, travel)

  • Pre-interview, book potential guests, engineer in-studio interviews and tracking

  • Perform field reporting and/or recording

  • Conceive of storyboards with the team

  • Write narration and craft the sound design/soundscape of episodes.

  • Create new drafts of episodes in ProTools, experimenting relentlessly with story construction

  • Liaise with fact checker for episodes

  • Write and produce content for web, newsletter, and other platforms as needed


Key Qualifications:

  • At least five years experience producing, reporting and/or editing in long-form narrative audio, and/or comparable experience in a related field

  • Preferably has experience creating stories similar to the ones heard on Radiolab

  • Has a clear grasp of what makes a surprising, impactful and complicated story that could be heard on Radiolab

  • Has a proven ability to develop story arc and narrative

  • Has solid journalism skills including: interviewing, database research and fact checking

  • Has experience with linear editing software (ProTools, Logic, et cetera), and an advanced understanding of sound design

  • Sense of humor and musicality are a plus

It's important on the Radiolab team for everyone to work hard, be willing to pitch in on whatever is needed to get the job done, have an open mind, demonstrate integrity in their journalism, be wildly curious, and not be afraid to be a little bit weird.


Additional Information


This is a full-time non-exempt position with a salary range of $87,771-$95,000 and includes eligibility for medical, dental and vision insurance through SAG-AFTRA.

This role is based in New York City and is expected to work at our NYC Headquarters two days per week.

This position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement between New York Public Radio and SAG-AFTRA.


Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion


New York Public Radio is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We continuously strive to place our employees at the center of our thinking and elevate inclusive practices to develop and support a more engaged and productive workforce. Our journalism and operations in the service of that journalism benefit from a broad range of perspectives, from all backgrounds, at all levels of the organization. Diversity is essential to honest, authentic, accurate storytelling and reportage; creating an institution in which all voices are encouraged, valued, and heard.

Equal Opportunity


New York Public Radio is an equal opportunity employer committed to achieving the goal of equal employment opportunity for all. Applicants and employees are considered and evaluated for positions without regard to mental or physical disability, race, creed, color, religion, gender, national origin, citizenship status, age, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, employment status or any protected federal, state or local status unrelated to the performance of the work involved.


About Radiolab:


Created in 2002 by host Jad Abumrad, and now co-hosted by Lulu Miller and Latif Nasser, Radiolab began as an exploration of science, philosophy, and ethics using innovative composition and sound design. Radiolab has expanded and evolved to become a platform for long-form journalism and storytelling. The show challenges its listeners’ preconceived notions about how the world works. Radiolab provokes, it moves, it delights, and it asks its audience to see the world around them anew.

In the past year, the show released a series on a Guantanamo Bay detainee named Latif Nasser; covered the pandemic (by looking at the present and the past); composed an experimental non-narrative meditation on the end of the world; reported out topical stories on the power of protest (here and here, too), the risk of Donald Trump trying to steal the election, the responsibilities of the police (and lack thereof); and escaped to the bottom of the sea to spend time with an octomom.

Since its founding nearly two decades ago, Radiolab has won some of the most prestigious awards in journalism, including two George Foster Peabody Awards, Third Coast awards, The Silver Gavel, as well as other accolades. In 2011 Abumrad received the MacArthur Genius grant. The show has spawned successful spinoff series, like More Perfect, Gonads, The Other Latif, G, Border Trilogy, and Radiolab for Kids.

job.title: Supervising Senior Producer
job.description:
Description

Supervising Senior Producer, Weekends

WNYC

The WNYC and Gothamist newsroom is looking for a motivated and thorough Supervising Senior Producer for our highly-rated weekend magazine shows, Weekend Edition and Weekend All Things Considered. This role will oversee the shows’ sound and editorial direction, supervise producers, and professionally coordinate with hosts and engineers

The Supervising Senior Producer, Weekends pushes the boundaries of our storytelling with their creativity. The Supervising Senior Producer, Weekends eagerly integrates smart data analysis with inventive approaches to storytelling that produce distinctive show segments and elements that make the WNYC air a compelling listen, and represents and impacts all those who live in our coverage area. They also inspire their teams to find inventive ways to reach new, diverse audiences.

Supervising Senior Producers are newsroom leaders who reinforce our culture of audience centricity, professional respect and journalistic excellence. They are the conduit between upper management and individual contributors, and play an important role in our newsroom culture. The ideal candidate has experience overseeing live news coverage as well as managing – directly and indirectly – a team of journalists.

This role, which reports to the Senior Editor of Audio Strategy, will work a Wednesday through Sunday schedule, with conventional business hours on weekdays, and a 7 a.m. start time on weekends. This leader will also be required to flex their schedule as needed to account for developing news and to contribute to weekday shows and special projects as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the programming, production and editorial needs of WNYC’s weekend magazine shows. Set the shows’ daily rundown, delegating tasks, and prepare hosts

  • Lead planning for each weekend’s coverage as well as logistics for breaking news.

  • Directly manage producers and daily assignments, providing clear expectations as well as consistent feedback

  • Lead weekly meetings with the weekend hosts and producers; represent weekend coverage at newsroom meetings

  • Hold all content up to the highest standards, editing for adequate sourcing, accuracy, fairness and clarity

  • Collaborate with newsroom editors on assignments, ensuring our reporting is multiplatform and aligned for all our audiences

  • Collaborate with the shows’ engineers throughout each live broadcast

  • Reinforce standards for ethics, professionalism and excellence, regularly articulating how coverage fits into the WNYC newsroom vision of serving the needs of a diverse population, and encouraging the production of content that gives daily utility to listeners and readers.

  • Model and exhibit the highest standards of professionalism at all times.

  • Propose and accept one-time or ongoing assignments or special projects within the newsroom, as decided with their relevant supervisor.

  • Serving on newsroom committees focused on issues such as editorial standards, style or training.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience producing audio news

  • Sophisticated understanding of the broadcast landscape, including applicable metrics, relevant audience trends, and audience engagement techniques. Experience in using audience data to inform good journalistic decisions to drive results

  • Demonstrated commitment and ability to contribute an equity lens to every aspect of people development and management processes, and ability to increase diversity, equity, and inclusion competency in their teams

  • Demonstrated knowledge of complex social and cultural issues

  • The intellectual and emotional depth, maturity, self-confidence and interpersonal skills to work effectively and/or interact with the public and with other staff at NYPR

  • Self-starter with proven ability to meet deadlines and pay close attention to detail and fact-checking

  • Ability to manage several projects concurrently

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a team and supervise content creation

  • Excellent broadcast writing and editing skills

  • Experience working with and managing on-air talent

  • Fluency in audio editing, working in a variety of content management systems, and other broadcast and digital delivery systems

  • Interest and appreciation for the medium of audio and text and how they can be used to reach separate audiences

  • Experience leading breaking news coverage

  • Impeccable journalistic integrity and editorial judgment

  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written

Additional Information:

This is a full-time role with an annual salary $103,500.00. New York Public Radio also offers excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance, vacation, personal and sick time as well as inclusive family leave.

This role is a hybrid capacity of two days in the office; with the ability to work from home at times. However, this position is part of the NYC staff and will be expected to work from WNYC's Lower Manhattan offices on specified days with regularity.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

New York Public Radio is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We continuously strive to place our employees at the center of our thinking and elevate inclusive practices to develop and support a more engaged and productive workforce. Our journalism and operations in the service of that journalism benefit from a broad range of perspectives, from all backgrounds, at all levels of the organization. Diversity is essential to honest, authentic, accurate storytelling and reportage; creating an institution in which all voices are encouraged, valued, and heard.

job.title: Executive Producer
job.description:
NVE Experience Agency (NVE) is a leading independent creative marketing agency specializing in brand experience. Founded on the principle that ‘The Right Moment Will Transform Someone Forever,’ NVE is on a mission to transform the industry through the power of strategic, craft-led experiences that are rooted in culture. With a global network and hubs in LA, NY, and London, NVE partners with some of the world's most iconic brands to help them build deeper, more meaningful relationships with their customers. The agency offers a suite of integrated capabilities, including Marketing Strategy, Experiential Marketing, Event Production, Content, and Communications. For more information, visit ExperienceNVE.com and follow NVE on Instagram and LinkedIn.

Summary of Position:

NVE Experience Agency seeks an Executive Producer to lead large-scale experiential programs from concept through execution. This is a hands-on role. You will own production across your full slate of projects rather than simply oversee it. Primary responsibilities include leading complex productions end to end, translating client briefs into clear scopes, budgets and timelines, directing internal teams and vendor partners, and supporting the agency's new business pipeline alongside the rest of the production department.

Strong relationship skills, a service mentality and the ability to provide multiple options for solutions are essential to this role. You are equally comfortable presenting to a client's leadership team and standing on a loading dock at 5am. An extensive background in event production is required, including deep knowledge of event design and layout, staging, lighting, sound, scenic elements, guest flow and timing. This role carries real accountability for the quality of the work and for the teams who deliver it.

Job Responsibilities:

Project Delivery

  • Take a client brief and develop the scope, budget, timeline and staffing plan from it, translating creative intent into a buildable, costed plan
  • Serve as the senior production lead on your projects, personally building and owning core project documentation including deliverable timelines, production schedules, budgets and run of show
  • Lead large-scale, high-complexity experiential programs from concept through strike, across brand activations, conferences and summits, product launches, press and consumer events, and multi-city tours
  • Be on site and in the room, running load-in through strike, technical rehearsals and show flow alongside your production and technical teams
  • Solve problems in real time and make the call when the schedule, the budget or the client needs one
  • Ensure programs are delivered on time, on budget and to NVE’s standard
  • Manage clear communication across internal teams and agency partners throughout each project

Client Management

  • Build and maintain effective client relationships, ensuring that client needs are heard, understood, and addressed promptly
  • Provide clear communications to the client regarding roles and responsibilities, scope, budget and schedules for assigned programs

Budget Management

  • Build and own project budgets, from initial estimate through final reconciliation
  • Set target margins with production leadership, track spend against budget throughout the project, and flag variance early
  • Oversee coordination with internal teams on invoices and vendor payments
  • Support the finance team by ensuring you and your teams close out projects promptly
  • Negotiate directly with vendors and production partners to secure the best value without compromising the work

New Business

  • Support the agency's new business pipeline, contributing production expertise to pitches and RFP responses as needed
  • Help translate pitch concepts into realistic scopes, budgets and timelines so that what we sell is what we can build
  • Transition wins cleanly into delivery, carrying scope, budget and assumptions intact to the project team

Team Management

  • Build, lead and develop teams, mentoring producers and production managers through the work itselfWork closely with production leadership to create training and development plans for your team, including regular goal setting and tracking in the performance management system
  • Hold regular check-ins with your teams to provide feedback
  • Foster a collaborative team environment that ensures deliverables are met
  • Interview and hire full-time and freelance support to staff projects appropriately
  • Ensure company policy is followed when onboarding temporary production staff, and that timesheets are completed on time across your project workstreams
  • Allocate internal and external resources accurately across projects

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred
  • 10+ years of event production experience
  • Proven track record leading large-scale experiential programs, including complex, multi-day, multi-stakeholder productions
  • Strong project management skills with proven ability to lead teams while staying in the work yourself
  • 5-7 years of management or supervisory experience
  • Technical Production knowledge
  • Broadcast production experience
  • Extensive freelance and vendor network across experiential production
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills and self-motivation
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, agency environment
  • Proficient with Microsoft and Apple applications and project management software
  • Thorough understanding of permitting standards (Including but not limited to TPA, Special Event, Fire, Health & Safety, Building & Safety, Noise, etc.) and ability to manage production timelines around permit procurement
  • Ability to effectively manage tasks across multiple projects/various clients at the same tim

Extra Credit:

  • Entertainment industry experience, including work for studios, streamers or networks, and comfort operating inside IP, licensing and brand approval processes
  • Immersive or narrative-driven experiential production experience, including walk-through environments, installations and extended-run footprints
  • Experience designing and managing guest journey and throughput, including capacity modeling, timed entry, queue management and pacing
  • Themed entertainment, location-based entertainment or attraction experience
  • Red carpet premieres, screenings and talent-forward press moments

Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% or more of the time while working remotely and in a standing position 50% or more of the time while working offsite
  • Must be able to work outdoors in various weather conditions
  • Have a valid Driver’s License
  • Regularly required to stoop, kneel, bend, crouch and lift up to 25 pounds and occasionally heavier items
  • Available to work weekends and evenings as needed for events

Location:

We are a hybrid company with hub locations in Los Angeles and New York. The ideal candidate is located in New York, however, we will consider remote candidates for this role.

Perks & Benefits:

  • Health & Wellness Benefits
  • 401(k) Match
  • Communication Stipend
  • Paid Company Holidays & PTO
  • Flexible WFH Policy
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Company Gatherings & Retreats
  • Growth & Development Opportunities

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging:

At NVE, we are led by curiosity and fueled by humanity. Authentic connection is at the heart of our work and we embrace the opportunity and responsibility we have as an organization to provide the tools and resources needed to deliver the best and most equitable experiences possible for our employees and the clients we serve.

Salary Estimation: [$140,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year]

NVE intends to provide a competitive total compensation package which includes a variety of incentives, benefits, growth and developmental opportunities. There are many factors to the presented salary range, including but not limited to - location, departmental budgets, certifications, and overall job-related qualifications.

NVE reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. NVE may require an employee to perform duties outside his/her normal description.

Employment eligibility verification is required for this role. In certain states, NVE participates in the E-Verify program in accordance with local regulations.
Applicable states: Utah, Arizona, Louisiana, Mississippi, Tennessee, Alabama, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Florida.
