job.description:
Morning Reporter-Producer

Help Keep Pittsburgh's Public Media Strong

Pittsburgh Community Broadcasting Corporation (PCBC), home to 90.5 WESA and 91.3 WYEP, is seeking a skilled and motivated person to join the 90.5 WESA newsroom as our Morning Reporter-Producer.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to help shape the news Pittsburgh wakes up to each morning. Working closely with the Morning Edition host and newsroom team, the Morning Reporter-Producer will research, report, write, and produce timely, accurate, and engaging news conte3nt for WESA's broadcast and digital platforms.

The ideal candidate brings strong writing and audio production skills, sound news judgment, and a commitment to delivering accurate, engaging journalism. We're looking for someone who works well in a collaborative newsroom, thrives under daily deadlines, and is eager to contribute to the stories that inform and connect the Pittsburgh community.

This position is primarily based in our Pittsburgh office, with flexibility for remote work when job responsibilities and organization needs allow.

What You'll Do:

  • Report, write, and produce daily news content.
  • Collaborate with the Morning Edition host and newsroom to develop newscast rundowns, coordinate coverage, and prepare a timeline for engaging content.
  • Produce live and recorded interviews, including research topics, preparing hosts and guests, and editing audio for broadcast.
  • Edit and update news stories to ensure accuracy and adhere to journalistic standards.
  • Gather audio and reporting materials to support daily coverage and breaking news.
  • Contribute to additional newsroom projects, which may include feature reporting, podcast production, social media, and station events.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism or a related field, or an equivalent combination of experience and training.
  • At least one year of professional experience in reporting, radio, or audio production.
  • Strong writing, storytelling, and digital audio editing skills.
  • Sound editorial judgment and a commitment to accurate, fair, balanced, and ethical journalism.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, meet tight deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced newsroom environment.
  • An understanding of the NPR audience and news style.

Why Join Pittsburgh Community Broadcasting?

At Pittsburgh Community Broadcasting, you'll join a team dedicated to serving our community through trusted journalism and music discovery. We believe our employees are our greatest asset, and we are committed to creating a workplace built on collaboration, respect, accountability, and continuous learning. We invest in professional development, encourage innovation, and believe every employee plays an important role in advancing our mission.

Work Environment

This position is based in our Pittsburgh office. Standard business hours are 6:00AM – 2:00PM Monday through Friday, with evening or weekend work as events require.

Our Commitment

Pittsburgh Community Broadcasting is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive, equitable, diverse workplace where all employees feel welcomed, respected, and empowered to succeed.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

What's it like working at PCBC?

At Pittsburgh Community Broadcasting, you'll find a team that is passionate about serving our community through trusted journalism and music. We work hard, celebrate our successes, and genuinely enjoy working together. Our culture is collaborative and inclusive, with approachable leaders, open communication, and a shared commitment to helping one another succeed. We value flexibility and understand that supporting work-life balance helps our employees bring their best selves to work every day.

We provide competitive salaries in an affordable city. The minimum compensation for this position is $52,020, commensurate with experience and ability. Our full-time exempt employees also get access to an extensive benefits package, including a 403(b)-retirement plan with 6% company match, medical, dental and vision, three weeks of vacation, sick time, 10 company holidays and 12 weeks of paid new parent leave. We invest in the professional growth of our team, encouraging continuing education and participation in conferences and seminars.

Want to know more?

We believe a strong organization includes employees from a broad range of backgrounds, with different skills, experiences, and passions. And if you don't meet every position qualification, but you have a story to tell, we'd still like to hear it. Please apply and tell us more about yourself. Visit our careers page to get more details and to apply. Submit a resume, cover letter, three samples of work relevant to this position and three references.

job.title: Assistant Producer, Brand & Content
job.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. 

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Assistant Producer, Brand & Content


Why We Have This Role

At Qualtrics, great stories help people connect with our brand, our tech, and the humans behind our customer experiences. We’re looking for an Assistant Producer who has natural storytelling instincts, loves digging into research, and wants to learn the ins and outs of brand producing from the ground up.
If you just wrapped up a degree in Broadcast, Journalism, or Media and want to put your reporting and writing chops to work in a fast-paced creative environment, this role is built for you. Instead of spending your day behind a camera lens or buried inside an editing timeline, you’ll focus on the heart of the narrative: researching guests, setting up shoots, drafting interview questions that get past corporate speak, and serving as a key right hand to our Brand and Content leadership.

How You’ll Find Success

  • A Reporter’s Instinct for a Good Story: You just know when an angle works. You can listen to someone talk for 10 minutes, cut through the fluff, and spot the compelling human hook that makes people stop scrolling and pay attention.
  • Curiosity & Interview Smarts: You love digging into a topic, learning what makes a subject tick, and writing fresh, conversational interview questions that draw out memorable, authentic soundbites.
  • Poise Around Team Leaders: You’re confident jumping into conversations, sharing your point of view, and working side-by-side with senior leaders on the Brand & Content team. You stay one step ahead, anticipating what needs to get done next.
  • Video Production Fluency: You speak the language of video. While you won't be trapped behind a camera or an edit bay, you already understand how shoots run from pre-pro to post, making it easy for you to coordinate with videographers, freelance crews, and editors.
  • Scrappy, Get-It-Done Energy: Production moves fast and plans change. You stay organized, keep your cool when schedules shift, and take pride in coordinating shoot logistics, prepping guests, and keeping projects on track.

How You’ll Grow

  • Learn Directly from Creative Leaders: Work hand-in-hand every day with senior directors and strategists, getting a front-row seat to how enterprise creative campaigns and brand strategies are built.
  • Master High-Stakes Storytelling: Build your portfolio by turning complex business and human topics into engaging video packages, mini-docs, and social-first narratives.
  • On-Camera & Hosting Opportunities: If you have an interest or background in front of the lens, we love putting talented storytellers on camera for social segments, event coverage, and internal features.
  • Cross-Media Versatility: Sharpen your voice across video, audio, social media hooks, and written editorial content.

Things You’ll Do

  • Set Up & Build Interviews: Research internal leaders, customers, and industry experts; coordinate interview schedules and logistics; and write tailored interview guides designed to get authentic, unscripted answers.
  • Own Pre-Interview Prep: Run pre-interviews to vet storylines, brief guests so they feel comfortable before the cameras roll, and flag key talking points for the production team.
  • Support Brand & Content Leadership: Act as a central point person for our creative leaders by drafting briefs, prepping meeting decks, keeping track of action items, and ensuring team projects cross the finish line.
  • Write Supporting Creative Copy: Draft video outlines, social copy teasers, video hooks, and promotional blurbs that support our multimedia campaigns.
  • Coordinate On-Set Logistics: Keep shoot days running smoothly by building call sheets, greeting and prepping talent, managing schedules, and keeping external videographers looped in on creative goals.
  • Help Bridge Pre-Production to Post: Review raw interview footage, pull the best quotes and soundbites, and pass time-coded notes to video editors to help shape the final cut.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • 1-3+ years of experience in Broadcasting, Videography, or another relevant field.
  • Background in Storytelling: A degree in Journalism, Broadcast Media, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on student media/internship experience).
  • Interview & Writing Samples: A portfolio or reel featuring work you’ve produced, reported, or written—such as student broadcast packages, interview transcripts/articles, video scripts, or multimedia stories.
  • Organizational Hustle: Experience coordinating shoots, managing production schedules, or juggling multiple creative deadlines in a newsroom, studio, agency, or internship environment.
  • Awesome Bonuses:
    • On-Camera Experience: Experience reporting for a campus news station, hosting a podcast, or presenting on social channels.
    • Basic Editing Literacy: Familiarity with tools like Adobe Premiere Pro, Descript, or CapCut for pulling selects or rough assemblies.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • High-energy, collaborative team culture that values curiosity, fresh ideas, and taking initiative.
  • Fast feedback loops with real opportunities to pitch ideas and see them produced.
  • Direct mentorship from experienced brand storytellers and creative leaders.
  • A hybrid setup that blends in-person creative collaboration with remote flexibility.

Perks and Benefits Highlights

  • Performance-based incentive structure and 100% merit-based promotions driven by impact rather than tenure.
  • Continuous professional growth opportunities and direct creative mentorship.

  • On-site amenities including catered lunches, quarterly team socials, seasonal parties, and Qualtrics swag.
The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic. Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:Family & Medical Leave Act, Equal Opportunity Employment, Employee Polygraph Protection Act Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. job.title: Producer
job.description:
Job Description :

Position: Producer

Location: Dallas TX

Type: In office

What's the role?

News24, recently rebranded from Sky News Australia, is owned by News Corp Australia. After 30 years as an innovator in the news industry, the network has adopted a new brand name and is expanding its world-leading news and commentary digital strategy. As one of the top 10 most viewed English-language news channels in the world on YouTube, this new role is a unique opportunity to join an established news brand with global reach which also has the agility, dynamism and ambition of a startup brand.

As a News24 US Producer, reporting to the Executive Producer, based in the USA, you are responsible for driving the delivery of editorial content for productions across News24's digital platforms.

You bring a strong news judgment, strategic thinking and the ability to operate in complex and fast-paced editorial environment.

A keen eye for talent and a deep understanding of major global news events is a must have for successful candidates.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Help drive a small team to put together a unique program with a wide variety of topical news, politics and current affairs stories to build a show packed with compelling content.

  • Work closely with our fearless opinion hosts, helping them create a show that drives ratings and sets the agenda.

  • Learn from our talented Executive Producers, with an eye to step into their shoes when required.

  • Compile rundowns and output shows live from the control room, communicating with pilots, TDs, host, reporters and guests

  • Book guests and studios and manage talent in the newsroom, finding fresh faces where possible.

  • Use our editing software to cut grabs and overlay to add depth to our programs.

  • Build attractive graphics to complement arguments put forward by our hosts.

  • Meet the quality control standards expected by News24 and comply with company policies.

  • Work to ensure your content is legally safe and complies with the broadcasting codes.

  • You will be exposed to all the best bits of television production - leadership, creativity, writing, chasing, talent management and much more

Who are you?

  • Must have solid newsroom experience and an ability to master software to produce TV programs.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including an ability to effectively communicate with everyone from politicians of all persuasions, to CEOs, contributors and colleagues.

  • Must have a very good knowledge of global politics and current affairs, and a good understanding of news events occurring elsewhere in the world.

  • Proficiency in Frame Light X, our editing software, and ENPS, the system we use to compile rundowns would be ideal. Training will be provided regardless.

  • Needs to be able to write headline straps that are eye-catching and unfailingly accurate.

  • Should be able to write editorial content and suggest sharp questions for hosts and panellists.

  • Must be able to work under pressure to meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude.

  • Must be willing to learn and adapt to new working practices and contribute to new programs.

  • Ability to work independently when required and to carry out assignments that are not part of the day to day routine.

  • Previous experience in TV or radio broadcasting a requirement.

  • Deep understanding of digital platforms and modern publishing strategies.

Why News Corp Australia

Join a culture where innovation is our operating rhythm. You’ll work on a diverse portfolio of Australia’s most loved brands and play a pivotal role in leading the technological shift in how we create commercial content. Our vibrant, hybrid work environment and dynamic, values-driven culture empowers you to push boundaries, collaborate as one unified team, and make a positive, measurable impact for all Australians.

Who are we?

Bringing a unique Australian perspective to the world, News24 champions open discussion and presents a broad range of perspectives on the issues that matter most.

The multi-platform network reaches more than 11.3 million Australians each month across broadcast and digital platforms. It is the number one non-sport channel on national subscription television service Foxtel and the country’s most engaging digital news brand.
News24’s unrivalled 24-hour multi-platform news service is owned and operated by Australian News Channel Pty Ltd (ANC). ANC is owned by News Corp Australia, a subsidiary of News Corp.
ANC operates and distributes News24 branded broadcast and streaming services including News24, News24 Weather, News24 World, News24 Regional, News24 Now and News24 in New Zealand, as well as FOX SPORTS News in Australia. News24 has a national presence with its headquarters operating out of Sydney and interstate bureaus in Canberra’s Parliament House, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, the Gold Coast, Adelaide, Darwin and Hobart. It also has international bureaus in the United States (Washington DC), Asia (Taiwan) and New Zealand (Wellington).

job.title: Social Media Editor, Seoul, Weekends
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is looking for a weekend social media editor with experience in journalism, social media strategy and off-platform video promotion.

You will establish a vision for shaping and targeting our journalism for different platforms, and you will be responsible for understanding and developing new strategies, tools and workflows as those platforms evolve. This means you’ll be building our presence on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, WhatsApp and other platforms, including emerging ones. Engaging our readers, monitoring on-site and off-platform conversations for story ideas and integrating readers’ contributions into our report is essential. 

You will know how to adjust social programming targets and priorities amid a shifting global, 24-hour news cycle and ever-changing platform landscape. You will also work with reporters and editors across the newsroom on how social media and readers’ voices can inform our journalism, both pre- and post-publication.

This is a hybrid, weekend position based in Seoul, with a Saturday-Tuesday schedule. It includes regular attendance in the office, per your departmental guidance. The role will report directly to the Editor, Social, based in Los Angeles.

Main responsibilities:

  • Supporting The Times’s social presence across our main accounts, ensuring coverage of breaking news and live events; strategizing around social video; conceiving and executing innovative social plans for enterprise projects; and leveraging videos, photography and graphics to elevate our off-platform report.
  • Support the increase in video production across the newsroom by prioritizing time-sensitive projects and ensuring that our video journalism reaches a wide audience off-platform. 
  • Developing and refining the voice of The Times on all of our off-platform channels, exhibiting excellent news judgment and audience-sensitive framing
  • Collaborating with Social Visuals editors and across our Video team, especially in Seoul, on developing and executing visual storytelling formats and strategies for social platforms 
  • Building creative social native content (e.g. visual cards, Instagram stories, etc.)
  • Skillfully editing, shaping and elevating headlines, copy and visual assets for social media
  • Suggesting story ideas, identifying video opportunities and partnering with desks across the Seoul newsroom to produce stories that:
    • Anticipate readers’ prospective social and search needs sparked by a Times exclusive or a news event
    • Respond to readers’ real-time social and search needs and trends
  • Developing testing strategies around medium (images, video) and message (headline, social share text), to inform a constantly updating set of best practices for engaging off-platform audiences (social, search, etc.)
  • Partner with editors across the newsroom to workshop on-platform framing of articles that leverage off-platform performance insights and reader interest
  • Interpreting data and signals to know what pieces are the right fit for what audiences both on and off our platforms
  • Tracking success through engagement rates, growth statistics, reader responses and other metrics
  • Working with journalists in the newsroom on best social media practices, including framing pieces for specific audiences
  • Collaborate with other audience editors, in Seoul and around the world, on flagging coverage opportunities informed by off-platform trends and sharing performance insights and case studies with desks
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world. 

Our ideal candidate:

  • Proven experience in social media and digital journalism
  • Deep understanding of all mainstream and some emerging social channels
  • Deep understanding of how social video travels off-platforms
  • Consistent record running Facebook, Twitter/X and Instagram accounts for major media outlets
  • Demonstrated interest in visual storytelling, including through video
  • Strong editorial judgment; comfortable with experimenting and refining strategies to optimize sharing for different social audiences
  • A passion for news and a dedication to The Times and its journalistic mission
  • Skill at bridging specialties, including reporting, editing, product, analytics, design and user research
  • Strong writing and editing skills, and knowledge of Times style or the ability to absorb and apply it quickly
  • Strong analytical skills and familiarity with how to use data to inform editorial decisions 
  • Experience working independently and collaborating across time zones

REQ-020991

Additional Compensation and Benefits:

For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process.

Candidate Use of GenAI Tools:

We’re excited to learn more about you and your experience. To keep our hiring process as fair and authentic as possible, we ask that you submit your own work and not use GenAI tools to generate substantive content during the application and interview process.

If you’re an engineering candidate, we’ll let you know what specific GenAI tools you are permitted to use for your technical assessment.

 

The New York Times Company is committed to being the world’s best source of independent, reliable and quality journalism. To do so, we embrace a diverse workforce that has a broad range of backgrounds and experiences across our ranks, at all levels of the organization. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of an individual's sex, age, race, color, creed, national origin, alienage, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation or affectional preference, gender identity and expression, disability, genetic trait or predisposition, carrier status, citizenship, veteran or military status and other personal characteristics protected by law. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. The U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC)’s Know Your Rights Poster is available here. 

The New York Times Company will provide reasonable accommodations as required by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. Individuals seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process should email reasonable.accommodations@nytimes.com. Emails sent for unrelated issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.

For information about The New York Times' privacy practices for job applicants, click here.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings. Scammers may post fraudulent job opportunities, and they may even make fraudulent employment offers. This is done by bad actors to collect personal information and money from victims. All legitimate job opportunities from The New York Times will be accessible through The New York Times careers site. The New York Times will not ask job applicants for financial information or for payment, and will not refer you to a third party to do so. You should never send money to anyone who suggests they can provide employment with The New York Times.

If you see a fake or fraudulent job posting, or if you suspect you have received a fraudulent offer, you can report it to The New York Times at NYTapplicants@nytimes.com. You can also file a report with the Federal Trade Commission or your state attorney general.

job.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Media Streaming
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.   SoundCloud is looking for a software engineer to join our Media Streaming Team, with a mission to operate a media streaming platform at global scale, delivering the best possible audio experience to creators, listeners, and partners alike. We are handling petabytes of data and gigabytes per second of traffic. You will join a tightly-knit team where you will help shape how millions of people experience music.  

Read about engineering at SoundCloud

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Contribute to building, scaling and maintaining backend APIs and services that serve millions of users
  • Collaborate closely with Android, iOS, web, and full-stack engineers to deliver seamless end-to-end media experiences
  • Ensure performance, scalability, and maintainability of SoundCloud’s services
  • Debug complex issues across systems, ensuring a consistent experience for users globally
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and roadmap planning
  • Be part of on-call rotation to ensure the reliability and availability of SoundCloud’s systems

Experience and Background:

  • 8+ years of experience in building and operating large-scale backend or distributed systems
  • Proficiency in Go
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform
  • Experience with cloud-native environments such as AWS or GCP
  • Experience with microservices, SQL/NoSQL databases, and container technologies
  • Familiarity with audio/video codecs, streaming protocols (HLS, DASH), and transport container technologies
  • You care about the craft of software engineering: continuous delivery, defensive programming, automated testing, clean code principles
  • You have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast-moving environments
  • You bring a humble attitude, an eagerness to help your colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team succeed 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing APIs and backend services consumed by multiple client platforms
  • Experience with Scala or other functional programming languages
  • Knowledge of API communication patterns (e.g., gRPC, GraphQL)
  • Exposure to media streaming, playback, audio engineering or adjacent domains
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools and a strong intuition for their strengths, weaknesses, and emerging opportunities

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard.
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.title: Manager, Product Management
job.description:
Job Description


We are seeking a Manager, Product Management  to define and execute the strategy for our Tax and Accounting Products portfolio. This role will be responsible for connecting customer needs, market opportunities, business strategy, and technology capabilities, ensuring clear priorities, high-quality execution, and sustainable outcomes for both customers and the business.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the strategy, vision, and roadmap for the products under your responsibility, aligning local and global priorities.
  • Lead product discovery and prioritization processes, combining data, customer research, business strategy, and technical feasibility.
  • Ensure structured management of product backlogs, objectives, expected outcomes, and success criteria for initiatives.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Content, Value Proposition, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Lead and develop Product professionals, fostering autonomy, sound decision-making, execution excellence, and results orientation.
  • Establish operating rhythms, methodologies, and metrics to track adoption, usage, customer satisfaction, quality, efficiency, and business impact.
  • Engage directly with customers and stakeholders to understand needs, validate solutions, and manage expectations.
  • Anticipate risks, dependencies, and critical decisions while promoting executive alignment and transparency on progress and outcomes.
  • Connect the local portfolio with the Thomson Reuters global ecosystem, identifying opportunities for integration, reuse, and scale.
  • Promote the responsible use of data and artificial intelligence in the development and evolution of legal products.
  • Contribute to the development of MVPs, proof of concepts, and fast-win initiatives that generate measurable impact.



Required Qualifications

  • Primarily, experience with tax technology, information services, or enterprise solutions designed for professional users, such as ERP, payroll, and SaaS platforms.
  • Experience in digital product management, preferably within B2B software or SaaS environments.
  • Experience leading and developing Product teams.
  • Strong expertise in product strategy, discovery, roadmap management, prioritization, metrics, and agile methodologies.
  • Ability to make decisions in complex environments, balancing customer needs, business objectives, and technological constraints.
  • Experience collaborating with technical, commercial, and operational teams and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Intermediate to advanced English proficiency, with the ability to participate in meetings, collaborate with global teams, and work with professional documentation.
  • Experience with AI-enabled solutions, workflow automation, or digital transformation initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation frameworks, and portfolio management.
  • Strong executive communication skills, analytical thinking, and a consistent focus on results.
  • Agile-related certifications such as Scrum, Agile Coach, or similar.
  • Experience leading or contributing to product modernization efforts, especially migrations from: legacy technologies, on-premise/client-server solutions, SQL-based environments and toward cloud-based products.

#LI-AC1

 

 


¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido: Hemos adoptado un entorno de trabajo híbrido y flexible para nuestros roles en oficina, ofreciendo una experiencia fluida que está conectada digital y físicamente.
  • Flexibilidad y Equilibrio entre Trabajo y Vida Personal: "Flex My Way" Consiste en un conjunto de políticas de apoyo en el entorno laboral, diseñadas para facilitar la gestión de las responsabilidades personales y profesionales, ya sea atendiendo a la familia, participando en actividades comunitarias o dedicando tiempo al descanso y la renovación personal. Estas políticas se basan en nuestro enfoque flexible de trabajo, que permite a los empleados trabajar desde cualquier lugar hasta 8 semanas al año, promoviendo así un equilibrio ideal entre sus compromisos laborales y personales.
  • Desarrollo y Crecimiento Profesional: Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de habilidades, preparando a nuestro talento para enfrentar los desafíos del futuro y ofrecer soluciones reales. Nuestro programa "Grow My Way" y el enfoque en habilidades garantizan que tengas las herramientas y conocimientos para crecer, liderar y prosperar en un futuro habilitado por la inteligencia artificial.
  • Beneficios Competitivos del Sector: Ofrecemos planes de beneficios integrales que incluyen seguros de gastos médicos, dos días de descanso por salud mental a nivel de la empresa, programas de incentivos para empleados y recursos para el bienestar mental, físico y financiero.
  • Cultura: Reconocida globalmente con una reputación premiada por inclusión y pertenencia, flexibilidad, equilibrio entre trabajo y vida personal, y más. Vivimos nuestros valores: Obsesión por nuestros Clientes, Competir para Ganar, Desafiar nuestro Pensamiento, Actuar Rápido / Aprender Rápido, y Más Fuertes Juntos.
  • Impacto Social: Genera un impacto en tu comunidad con nuestro Instituto de Impacto Social. Ofrecemos a los empleados dos días de voluntariado pagados anualmente y oportunidades para involucrarse en proyectos de consultoría pro bono e iniciativas de Medio Ambiente, Sociales y de Gobernanza (ESG).
  • Haciendo un Impacto Real en el Mundo: Somos una de las pocas compañías a nivel global que asiste a sus clientes en la búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Trabajando en conjunto con los profesionales e instituciones a los que servimos, contribuimos a sostener el estado de derecho, fomentar el comercio, detectar a los infractores, informar sobre los hechos y ofrecer información confiable e imparcial a personas en todo el mundo.

 

 

Quiénes somos

Thomson Reuters marca el camino hacia el futuro al reunir contenido confiable y la tecnología que las personas y organizaciones necesitan para tomar decisiones correctas. Servimos a profesionales en los sectores legal, fiscal, contable, de cumplimiento, gubernamental y de medios. Nuestros productos combinan software altamente especializado e información para capacitar a los profesionales con los datos, inteligencia y soluciones necesarias para tomar decisiones informadas y ayudar a las instituciones en su búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Reuters, parte de Thomson Reuters, es un proveedor líder mundial de periodismo y noticias confiables.

Contamos con el talento de 26,000 colaboradores en más de 70 países, donde todos tienen la oportunidad de contribuir y crecer profesionalmente en entornos de trabajo flexibles. En un momento en el que la objetividad, precisión, equidad y transparencia están bajo ataque, nos comprometemos a buscarlos. ¿Suena emocionante? Forma parte de nuestro equipo y contribuye a moldear las industrias que impulsan el progreso de la sociedad.

Como empresa global, confiamos en los antecedentes únicos, perspectivas y experiencias de todos los empleados para cumplir con nuestros objetivos comerciales. Para asegurarnos de poder hacerlo, buscamos colaboradores talentosos y calificados en todas nuestras operaciones alrededor del mundo, sin importar raza, color, sexo/género, incluyendo embarazo, identidad y expresión de género, origen nacional, religión, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad, estado civil, estado de ciudadanía, condición de veterano u otra clasificación protegida bajo la ley aplicable. Thomson Reuters se enorgullece de ser un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades laborales, proporcionando un ambiente de trabajo libre de drogas.

Asimismo, ofrecemos adaptaciones razonables para personas calificadas con discapacidades y para aquellas con creencias religiosas sinceras, conforme a la legislación vigente. Puedes encontrar más información sobre cómo solicitar una adaptación aquí.

job.title: Business Systems Analyst, SAP & Systems Integration
job.description:
Business Systems Analyst, SAP & Systems Integration

Job Description

We are hiring a Business Systems Analyst, SAP & Systems Integration, for our Manufacturing Operations Support team at Westbridge Print. This full-time, hybrid role reports to the Manager of Manufacturing Operations Support. You will bridge manufacturing operations, business stakeholders, technology teams, and implementation partners, combining business analysis with deep SAP experience to support software implementations, system improvements, and integrations. Early work will focus on integrations between iQuote, iPlan, EFI, and SAP, with the role growing as we build our SAP S/4HANA environment.

Location: Eagan, Minnesota (hybrid)

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the business analyst for software implementations, system enhancements, and integration projects
  • Translate business needs into clear requirements, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Provide functional SAP expertise for business processes, integrations, and the future S/4HANA environment
  • Lead business analysis for integrations between SAP and manufacturing systems, including iQuote, iPlan, and EFI
  • Map data flows, interfaces, business rules, and downstream impacts across connected systems
  • Collaborate with internal technology teams, vendors, and implementation partners to ensure designs meet operational needs
  • Support implementations from discovery through testing, cutover, and post-launch stabilization
  • Partner with existing subject matter experts to capture and document critical SAP and manufacturing knowledge

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of substantive, hands-on SAP experience supporting business processes, implementations, or integrations
  • Experience as a Business Operations Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, SAP Functional Analyst, or comparable role
  • Experience serving as a business analyst for new software implementations and complex systems-integration projects
  • Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and validating complex business and functional requirements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementations, migrations, or transformation programs
  • Experience supporting manufacturing or production environments
  • Experience with EFI, iQuote, iPlan, or comparable manufacturing, estimating, planning, or print-industry platforms

#LI-CB1

 

 


What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

 

 

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $88,200 USD - $163,800 USD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

Thomson Reuters makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities, including veterans with disabilities, and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. If you reside in the United States and require an accommodation in the recruiting process, you may contact our Human Resources Department at HR.Leave-Expert@thomsonreuters.com. Disability accommodations in the recruiting process may include things like a sign language interpreter, making interview rooms accessible, providing assistive technology, or other relevant accommodations. Please note this email is not intended for general recruitment questions and we will promptly respond to inquiries regarding accommodations. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

job.title: Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

 

Thomson Reuters Special Services (TRSS) is looking for a Data Scientist to support our Federal Law Enforcement customers. TRSS Data Scientists serve several Federal Law Enforcement agencies by collecting, integrating, resolving, analyzing, modeling, and explaining large data in support of complex investigations. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, the initiative to operate with minimal direction, creativity to develop novel solutions, the ability to work directly with customers, and a mission-focused mindset.

 

TRSS Data Scientists support the full range of Federal Law Enforcement missions including, but not limited to: Emerging Threat Detection, Money Laundering, Fraud, Force Protection, Human Rights Crimes, Transnational Crime, and more. Outside of contract work, TRSS Data Scientists contribute to internal innovation by participating in research and development (R&D), developing and maintaining shared capabilities, strengthening technical skills, and supporting business development efforts such as proof-of-concept projects and capabilities briefings.

This opportunity is specifically for positions located on US Government customer sites in the Arlington, Merrifield, Fairfax, Crystal City, and DC area. This is not a telework position. If you are passionate about the chance to put your Data Science skills to practice in support of Federal Law Enforcement, then we are looking for you!

Data Scientists in this role will support Federal Law Enforcement missions by applying technical expertise to complex investigative and operational challenges. Responsibilities include:

  • Collect, integrate, clean, verify, resolve, and maintain large and complex datasets.
  • Analyze data using statistical methods, graph networks, anomaly detection, spatial analysis, pattern-of-life analysis, sentiment analysis, and related techniques.
  • Develop and apply data models, including risk models, community detection, classification, computer vision, machine learning, and artificial intelligence models.
  • Translate data findings into actionable insights through dashboards, visualizations, briefings, and clear explanations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Write, edit, customize, and execute Python code to support mission requirements.
  • Use SQL for data extraction, pipelining, exploration, and analysis.
  • Work directly with customers to understand problem statements, define project goals, develop methods, and deliver results within required timeframes.
  • Contribute to internal innovation, research and development, shared capabilities, technical skill development, and business development efforts such as proof-of-concept projects and capabilities briefings.

job.description:
Job Description

The Social Impact Specialist supports the development and execution of Thomson Reuters global social impact and employee engagement programs. With a particular focus on employee volunteering and giving, this role will help grow and strengthen the Global Volunteer Network, support global signature programs including Global Volunteer Day and the Social Impact Sprint, and assist with the company's employee matching gifts program.


The ideal candidate is an organized, collaborative and highly motivated professional who is passionate about corporate social impact and enjoys turning ideas into well-executed programs. This role offers the opportunity to work across a global organization, build relationships with employees and nonprofit partners, and gain exposure to the broader Social Impact, Government Affairs and ESG functions.


What success looks like

  • A stronger, more connected Global Volunteer Network with engaged local leaders and increased support for employee-led volunteering.
  • Well-coordinated global Social Impact campaigns that provide a strong experience for employees and nonprofit partners.
  • Timely, accurate and responsive administration of employee matching gifts and giving programs.
  • Clear and consistent tracking of employee engagement, participation and program impact.
  • Strong working relationships across the Social Impact team, employee volunteers and nonprofit partners.
  • Growing knowledge of ESG reporting and the ability to take on increasingly complex Social Impact and ESG responsibilities over time.

Key Responsibilities

Employee Volunteering & Global Volunteer Network

  • Support the continued development and expansion of the Global Volunteer Network (GVN), strengthening employee-led volunteer engagement across Thomson Reuters locations globally.
  • Build and maintain relationships with GVN leaders and regional advocates, providing resources, communications and ongoing support to help them develop meaningful volunteer opportunities.
  • Help identify and recruit employees to establish or strengthen GVN presence in priority locations.
  • Coordinate GVN communications, resources, meetings and training opportunities.
  • Support collection of participation data, employee feedback, impact outcomes and volunteer stories to help measure and communicate the network's impact.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen collaboration between the GVN and other employee communities and programs.

Signature Social Impact Programs

  • Support planning and execution of Thomson Reuters signature global social impact programs, including Global Volunteer Day and the Social Impact Sprint.
  • Coordinate project plans, communications, volunteer recruitment, nonprofit engagement, logistics and post-program follow-up.
  • Partner with colleagues across regions and functions to drive employee participation in volunteer and pro bono opportunities.
  • Support nonprofit partners participating in employee engagement programs and help ensure a positive partner experience.
  • Capture participation, outcomes, feedback and stories that demonstrate program impact.

Employee Giving & Matching Gifts

  • Support administration of Thomson Reuters employee giving and matching gifts program through MyGiving.
  • Assist with employee inquiries, nonprofit eligibility questions and day-to-day program administration.
  • Support review and processing of matching gifts and other employee giving activities in accordance with program guidelines.
  • Help maintain employee-facing resources, guidance and communications related to giving and volunteering.
  • Assist with program reporting, issue tracking and identification of opportunities to improve the employee experience.

Social Impact Measurement & Storytelling

  • Track participation and program metrics across employee volunteering and giving initiatives.
  • Help collect qualitative and quantitative impact data from employees and nonprofit partners.
  • Maintain dashboards, trackers and program documentation.
  • Identify compelling employee and nonprofit stories that demonstrate community impact.
  • Contribute data and stories for internal communications, leadership updates and the annual Social Impact & ESG Report.

ESG Development & Support

  • Assist with collection and validation of selected social impact and ESG data used in internal and external reporting.
  • Learn how employee giving, volunteerism, community investment and other social metrics connect to the company's broader ESG reporting.
  • Develop familiarity with Thomson Reuters ESG reporting processes, commitments and disclosure requirements.
  • Support research and benchmarking projects related to evolving ESG practices and reporting expectations.

Cross-Functional Support

  • Collaborate with colleagues across Social Impact, ESG, Government Affairs, Communications, HR and other business functions.
  • Prepare presentations, program materials, employee communications and briefing documents.
  • Support nonprofit and community partner engagement as needed.
  • Contribute to special projects across the Social Impact Institute and broader team.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 2–5+ years of relevant professional experience in corporate social impact, corporate responsibility, employee giving, employee volunteering, nonprofit engagement or a related field.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships across functions, geographies and levels of an organization.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking program metrics and translating results into clear communications and stories.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive and collaborative, with a genuine interest in social impact and corporate responsibility.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting employee giving, matching gifts or volunteer programs.
  • Experience working with employee giving or volunteer management platforms such as Benevity.
  • Interest in developing knowledge of ESG reporting, measurement and disclosure practices.

job.title: Growth Analyst
job.description:
Job Description


Corporates serves legal, tax, risk, and compliance professionals inside corporations. This role is a core partner within the Growth Strategy team, giving them and Corporates leadership the evidence behind their growth decisions. You build the analysis, measurement, and field intelligence that show where Corporates is ahead or behind and which growth opportunities are worth pursuing. You work across the Legal, Risk & Fraud, and Tax & Trade markets, which keeps the analysis consistent from one market to the next and gives the segment a holistic view for a unified growth vision.


Key Responsibilities


  • Partner with each Growth Strategy Lead on the ecosystem view for their market: customer needs end to end, where TR is strong, where the gaps are, and the build, buy, partner, and integrate options for each gap
  • Work with Revenue Operations on targeted analysis of what sits behind the numbers in each market: why deals are won, lost, or stall, where pipeline is building or thinning, and what the patterns say about opportunities and gaps
  • Test build, buy, partner, and integrate options against what we know about Corporates’ customers, products, and sales motion, drawing on deal data and input from account and product teams, and package the segment’s input for corporate development and partnerships
  • Build a view of how competitors win in Corporates deals to strengthen the competitive picture:
  • Pricing and packaging seen in live deals
  • How account and sales teams describe competitors’ positioning and strengths
  • Competitor product and partnership moves the field surfaces
  • Partner with the central Strategy team: build on their enterprise and market view, models, and planning inputs, and feed back what the growth work finds in each market so analysis is reused across both teams
  • Keep the data, assumptions, and sources behind each analysis documented so others can reuse and challenge them

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in strategy, corporate development, consulting, investment banking, or market research 
  • Strong modeling skills and comfort turning messy data into a clear answer
  • Curiosity about how competitors win and how markets change
  • A habit of building on others’ work and sharing yours, across teams with adjacent remits
  • Clear writing and presenting, including to senior audiences
  • Judgment about what matters, and the discipline to say what the data does and does not show

job.description:
Job Description


This account manager position leads the migration of existing Thomson Reuters Corporate SMB customers to CoCounsel, working a defined list of assigned target accounts from first conversation through completed migration. You will be expected to meet/exceed migration and customer engagement activity targets (emphasis on account outreach, discovery conversations, and migration progression) as established.


This position supports the efforts of the SMB Corporates organization within Thomson Reuters Legal by accelerating CoCounsel adoption across our existing customer base. This role requires a seasoned, consultative seller who can quickly diagnose each customer's current workflows, articulate the value of CoCounsel, overcome resistance to change, and guide accounts through a smooth upsell transition.

Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as a CoCounsel Account Manager, you will:

  • Achieve and exceed monthly and annual migration quotas, measuring accounts migrated within set KPI’s and sales processes
  • Proactively engage decision-makers and end users at assigned accounts using outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to schedule discovery and migration conversations
  • Gather and log all call information, migration orders, and account activity within Salesforce, Thomson Reuters CRM system, correctly and accurately, ensuring migration status and stage are tracked for every target account
  • Develop and deliver accurate migration forecasts and account-level progress reporting against the target list
  • Identify and escalate migration risks (contract and renewal timing, technical or adoption blockers) and build account-specific plans to resolve them
  • Assume other responsibilities as required or requested by Sales Management
  • Own a defined list of existing Corporate SMB target accounts and drive each account from initial outreach through completed transition to CoCounsel

Relationship Management

  • Serve as the trusted advisor for each assigned account through the migration, using consultative discovery to map current workflows to CoCounsel capabilities and demonstrate clear value
  • Work with organizations (Customer Success, Onboarding and Training, Product Specialists, Order Fulfillment, Customer Service, etc.) throughout Thomson Reuters to ensure migrations are executed efficiently and accurately and customer issues are resolved in a timely manner
  • Actively contribute to and works responsibly in a team environment, including collaborating with Account Managers and key stakeholders who own the broader customer relationship
  • Capture customer feedback, objections, and competitive insights from conversations and share them to refine playbooks and product strategy
  • Maintain expert knowledge of CoCounsel and the legacy products being migrated, along with migration programs and incentives within the sales division
  • Actively participate in meetings, training sessions and individual professional development and skill building

job.description:
Job Description

We are hiring a strong US-based engineering leader to own delivery of the Thomson Reuters enterprise data platform, end to end. Retention, pricing and sales effectiveness all depend on trusted, connected customer, contract and product usage data. This leader makes sure that data arrives reliably, can be certified, and reaches the systems sellers, customer teams and AI agents use every day.

Engineering delivery is centered in India. This role adds senior leadership in the US, working in the same time zone as Product, Finance, Sales and Operations, while building leadership depth across both geographies.


Key Responsibilities

  • Platform delivery: deliver ingestion, data trust, certified data and governed access against committed plans.
  • Certification standards: define what "certified" means for data and metrics, with data quality, reconciliation and lineage checks built into delivery.
  • Ingestion modernization: consolidate many ingestion patterns into a small standard set, so new sources reach the business faster, at lower run cost and with less key-person risk.
  • Governed data access and AI: provide safe, governed access to certified data for CRM, marketing systems, customer-facing products and AI agents, through data contracts and platform standards.
  • Platform economics: lead cost attribution, showback and chargeback for Snowflake, and own tooling rationalization, vendor negotiation and renewal decisions across ingestion and BI.
  • Operating standards: run one set of SLAs and one incident management practice across every platform team, including L1/L2 coordination with the CIO organization.
  • Team visibility and planning: know the team's workload, capacity and priorities in detail, and own resource and budget plans with Finance.
  • US–India operating model: build leadership depth across both geographies and develop the next generation of platform leaders.

job.title: Customer Service Representative
job.description:
Job Description

 

Senior Customer Success Representative – Our Legal Products

We are seeking a bilingual lawyer with strong Customer Success experience and hands-on expertise in generative AI tools to lead adoption and value realization for our Legal Products across law firms and in-house legal teams in Chile.


This role is responsible for the end-to-end onboarding experience and for becoming the client's trusted product expert. The successful candidate will ensure that the workflows built in Legal Products are successfully integrated into the client's day-to-day legal work and deliver measurable business impact.


The ideal candidate combines legal training, consultative client management, and practical knowledge of AI-powered workflows. This person must be comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders, including law firm partners, General Counsel, and legal leadership teams, and must be able to drive long-term adoption, demonstrate value, and identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

Key Responsibilities


  • Lead the end-to-end customer journey, including onboarding process and loyalty plan
  • Develop and execute a success plan for each account, including clear onboarding milestones and completion criteria.
  • Become the subject matter expert on legal products, including its capabilities, limitations, best practices, and legal use cases.
  • Guide clients in applying the product effectively to their legal workflows and day-to-day operations.
  • Drive user adoption and recurring usage by enabling key users, removing friction points, and helping legal teams build sustainable AI-enabled work habits.
  • Partner with clients to define success metrics, measure productivity gains, and document evidence of value delivered.
  • Conduct business reviews and present outcomes, recommendations, and impact to senior legal and executive stakeholders.
  • Identify additional workflows and account growth opportunities, and collaborate with the Account Executive to support expansion within existing clients.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients by combining product expertise, consultative problem-solving, and change management capabilities.
  • Support long-term customer outcomes, including renewal protection and expansion success.

Required Qualifications

  • Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • 5+ years of professional experience.
  • Proven experience in Customer Success, strategic account management, or technology adoption.
  • Strong practical and regular use of generative AI tools, with the ability to explain use cases, limitations, output quality, and when human review is required.
  • Ability to lead conversations credibly with law firm partners, General Counsel, and other senior legal stakeholders.
  • Strong consultative skills and the ability to understand legal processes and translate them into concrete adoption actions.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive client adoption, value realization, and workflow change.
  • Experience working in a professional environment where client-facing communication, executive presence, and business judgment are essential.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Law degree
  • Experience in a legal tech company or B2B software environment serving enterprise clients.
  • Previous experience leading the adoption of AI tools within an organization.
  • Experience in a law firm or in-house legal department.
  • Background in legal operations, legal innovation, digital transformation, or consulting.
  • Experience delivering user training, workshops, or enablement sessions related to technology.
  • Knowledge of the Chilean legal market and a relevant professional network.
  • Experience identifying opportunities for account expansion and partnering with commercial teams to drive growth.



#LI-AC1

 

 


¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido: Hemos adoptado un entorno de trabajo híbrido y flexible para nuestros roles en oficina, ofreciendo una experiencia fluida que está conectada digital y físicamente.
  • Flexibilidad y Equilibrio entre Trabajo y Vida Personal: "Flex My Way" Consiste en un conjunto de políticas de apoyo en el entorno laboral, diseñadas para facilitar la gestión de las responsabilidades personales y profesionales, ya sea atendiendo a la familia, participando en actividades comunitarias o dedicando tiempo al descanso y la renovación personal. Estas políticas se basan en nuestro enfoque flexible de trabajo, que permite a los empleados trabajar desde cualquier lugar hasta 8 semanas al año, promoviendo así un equilibrio ideal entre sus compromisos laborales y personales.
  • Desarrollo y Crecimiento Profesional: Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de habilidades, preparando a nuestro talento para enfrentar los desafíos del futuro y ofrecer soluciones reales. Nuestro programa "Grow My Way" y el enfoque en habilidades garantizan que tengas las herramientas y conocimientos para crecer, liderar y prosperar en un futuro habilitado por la inteligencia artificial.
  • Beneficios Competitivos del Sector: Ofrecemos planes de beneficios integrales que incluyen seguros de gastos médicos, dos días de descanso por salud mental a nivel de la empresa, programas de incentivos para empleados y recursos para el bienestar mental, físico y financiero.
  • Cultura: Reconocida globalmente con una reputación premiada por inclusión y pertenencia, flexibilidad, equilibrio entre trabajo y vida personal, y más. Vivimos nuestros valores: Obsesión por nuestros Clientes, Competir para Ganar, Desafiar nuestro Pensamiento, Actuar Rápido / Aprender Rápido, y Más Fuertes Juntos.
  • Impacto Social: Genera un impacto en tu comunidad con nuestro Instituto de Impacto Social. Ofrecemos a los empleados dos días de voluntariado pagados anualmente y oportunidades para involucrarse en proyectos de consultoría pro bono e iniciativas de Medio Ambiente, Sociales y de Gobernanza (ESG).
  • Haciendo un Impacto Real en el Mundo: Somos una de las pocas compañías a nivel global que asiste a sus clientes en la búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Trabajando en conjunto con los profesionales e instituciones a los que servimos, contribuimos a sostener el estado de derecho, fomentar el comercio, detectar a los infractores, informar sobre los hechos y ofrecer información confiable e imparcial a personas en todo el mundo.

 

 

Quiénes somos

Thomson Reuters marca el camino hacia el futuro al reunir contenido confiable y la tecnología que las personas y organizaciones necesitan para tomar decisiones correctas. Servimos a profesionales en los sectores legal, fiscal, contable, de cumplimiento, gubernamental y de medios. Nuestros productos combinan software altamente especializado e información para capacitar a los profesionales con los datos, inteligencia y soluciones necesarias para tomar decisiones informadas y ayudar a las instituciones en su búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Reuters, parte de Thomson Reuters, es un proveedor líder mundial de periodismo y noticias confiables.

job.title: Lead/Senior Research Scientist (Agentic RL)
job.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters Labs builds and ships custom models for professional workflows requiring fiduciary-grade AI. The Thomson LLM family was developed by training leading open-weight models on decades of authoritative Thomson Reuters content, with thousands of hours of subject-matter-expert input. Owning the model layer is how we earn trust in the most regulated, highest-stakes professional workflows. See the Thomson 1.0 Technical Report on Hugging Face for more on the latest model release.

The research team trains and evaluates the Thomson models to perform at a frontier level for professional workflows. We work with a range of large open-weight models and use continual learning to improve them comprehensively, rather than pre-training from scratch or doing narrow fine-tuning. The training pipeline includes value alignment, data-centric mid-training on curated proprietary data, DPO, and reinforcement learning (RL) for product-ready tasks. The evaluation group builds the measurement side: expert-annotated legal and tax benchmarks, agentic systems, and human preference studies with subject-matter experts. We regularly publish work that comes out of our training and evaluation efforts.

We are hiring scientists at Senior and Lead level across three areas of emphasis. In your application, please tell us which one or two fit you best:

  • Agentic reinforcement learning: post-training for agentic behaviour (planning, long-context reasoning, tool calls, long-horizon tasks inside real agent harnesses), multi-turn RL and policy optimisation, reward modelling and training-signal design.
  • Model training: continued pre-training and post-training of open-weight models, DPO and RL, training data and reward design, forgetting and replay in continued pre-training.
  • Model evaluation: benchmarks and targeted evaluations for complex legal and professional workflows, LLM-as-a-judge and rubric design, human preference studies with legal experts, and evaluation results that inform training objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design new benchmarks, training datasets, rewards and training signals to improve the Thomson model family, including for tasks where ground truth is scarce, delayed or partly subjective.
  • Design rigorous experiments and diagnostics (for example ablations) that separate algorithmic effects from data, reward and system artefacts, and carry results into production models.
  • Build and extend the evaluation suite to understand Thomson's strengths and weaknesses, and use the results to inform training objectives and technical trade-offs.
  • Work hand in hand with Research Engineers on our large-scale training and evaluation infrastructure, and with subject-matter experts in law, tax and other professional domains.
  • Coordinate with product teams and other model consumers to understand adoption requirements and drive integration.
  • Publish regularly at top-tier ML and NLP venues and represent Thomson Reuters Labs in the research community.
  • At Lead level: own a research agenda, turn emerging methods into a roadmap for our models, and mentor scientists and engineers.


Required Qualifications

  • PhD in machine learning, computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on LLM post-training and/or evaluation experience, preferably at frontier model development scale, using Python and PyTorch.
  • A track record of research impact you can point to: publications at top-tier venues (for example NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, COLM) and/or work that shaped an LLM development cycle.
  • Experience working closely with researchers and cross-functional stakeholders, including subject-matter experts, to turn ideas into practical training or evaluation assets.
  • Excellent written and oral communication, and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
  • For Lead level: 3+ years of research experience after the PhD, a record of leading a research agenda to published or deployed results, and of mentoring or supervising researchers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with RL post-training frameworks (NeMo-RL, verl, OpenRLHF, TRL) or evaluation frameworks (Inspect, lm-evaluation-harness).
  • Experience designing LLM-as-a-judge or rubric-based reward and evaluation pipelines and measuring their reliability.
  • Experience with Mixture-of-Experts or long-context models.
  • Experience with law, tax or other professional, non-verifiable domains, particularly grounding and citation.
  • Experience in experimental design and best practices for working with human data.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding and using coding agents at scale.

Even if you don't have all of the above requirements, we encourage you to apply to explore a mutual fit!
