job.title: AI Innovation Manager
job.description:
Job Description:

Merkle is dentsu’s global leadership brand for business and technology consulting, differentiated by an approach to enterprise transformation that’s data-driven, experience-led, and outcomes-obsessed.

With a heritage in data and marketing performance, Merkle has evolved into a transformation consultancy recognized for excellence in CRM, loyalty, digital commerce, technology, engineering, experience design, business advisory, market research, and analytics.


Merkle is seeking an AI Innovation Manager to help us scale how we use AI across our delivery work. Our delivery teams have already built a strong base of AI pilots and tools, and the next step is scaling that work so more of what we deliver gets done efficiently with AI. This individual will run AI pilots day to day, measure results, report progress to leadership, and scale knowledge sharing so what works on one account reaches the next. 


You will be part of the DDM AI Hub, a small central team that points all AI work at four goals: margin, revenue generation, scaling pilots and quality controls. Results go to an AI Steering Committee of DDM senior leadership every month, so this role has direct visibility with the people setting priorities and funding. 


We are looking for someone who is genuinely excited by AI tooling and builds with it, not just talks about it. You understand how tools like Claude fit into real business processes, and you can lead busy delivery teams toward a common goal without managing them directly. AI tools and best practices change month to month, so we want someone adaptable who learns quickly and shifts their approach as the technology evolves. 


There are no direct reports for this role. You will direct teams during sprints and partner with practice leads and account leadership, carrying full ownership of the program's cadence, measurement and reporting. 


Key Responsibilities 

The responsibilities below cover how we run, measure, report on and scale AI across our delivery work. 


  • Run AI pilots day to day. Work with delivery teams to find and prioritize AI opportunities, map current-state workflows, and lead each pilot through build, measurement, and a scale, hold or stop recommendation. 
  • Measure results. Set baselines before each pilot for hours saved, cycle time, quality, adoption and cost, then track those metrics on a regular cadence to confirm results hold. 
  • Report to leadership. Publish regular roll-ups in one consistent format and surface blockers such as tool access and governance approvals for escalation. 
  • Scale knowledge sharing. Lead knowledge sharing across DDM, partnering with Merkle Operations, so team members can find AI assets, pilots and subject-matter experts, and help proven workflows and best practices travel from one team or account to the next. 
  • Lead through influence. Coordinate the four practice AI points of contact through a monthly practice update, assign and direct part-time support from forward-deployed engineers and our global delivery bench during sprints, and confirm every AI deployment has a human-review step and a named reviewer before launch. 

Qualifications 


  • 4+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy, program management, business operations, or similar 
  • Hands-on experience building with AI tools such as Claude (Projects, Skills, artifacts or Claude Code), ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar, with examples of something you built that you or others use 
  • Strong understanding of how AI tools relate to business processes: where they save time, where they need human review, and where they fall short, with experience mapping workflows and measuring before-and-after results 
  • Proven ability to lead people toward a common goal without direct authority, across teams with competing priorities 
  • Strong organization and prioritization skills, with experience structuring ambiguous problems into clear plans, owners and timelines 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with experience turning complex, multi-threaded work into clear executive updates 
  • Highly adaptable and quick to learn, energized by new technology and comfortable changing tools, methods and priorities as AI capabilities evolve 
  • Marketing services, agency or professional services experience (nice to have) 
  • Familiarity with marketing technology platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Adobe or Snowflake, or with program and reporting tools such as Smartsheet, Jira or Power BI (nice to have) 
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience preferred.

job.title: Senior Account Manager (m/w/d)
job.description:
Job Description:

Dentsu ist ein weltweites Agentur Netzwerk im Bereich Marketing und Werbung und wurde 1901 in Tokio gegründet und ist heute in mehr als 145 Ländern vertreten. Zusammen mit unseren Kund*innen schaffen wir bedeutende Medienerlebnisse auf führenden globalen Plattformen, produzieren Content und erschaffen Influencer-Programme.

Mit unserer einzigartigen Kombination aus Media, Customer Experience Management und Creative transformieren wir Geschäftsmodelle und ermöglichen nachhaltiges Wachstum für Marken, Menschen und die Gesellschaft.



Tätigkeiten / Verantwortlichkeiten


  • Eigenständige Betreuung und Beratung von Kund*innen sowie Steuerung der laufenden Kundenkommunikation und Abstimmung mit relevanten Stakeholdern.
  • Commercial & Budget Management: Erstellung von Kostenvoranschlägen, Projekt- und Kampagnenkalkulationen, Budgetsteuerung, Forecasting sowie Vorbereitung und Begleitung der Abrechnung.
  • End-to-End-Projektmanagement: Steuerung von Projekten und Kampagnen vom Briefing bis zur Auslieferung, inklusive Team-Setup, Ressourcenkoordination, Timings, Qualitätsmanagement und Stakeholder-Abstimmungen.
  • Integriertes Kampagnenmanagement: Übergreifende Koordination und Steuerung von Kampagnen über verschiedene digitale Kanäle und Formate hinweg.
  • Display Campaign Management: Sicherer Umgang mit Produktionsplänen, Vermarktenden/Publishern, Media-Spezifikationen, Formaten, Timings und der Koordination der benötigten Werbemittel.
  • Paid Social Campaign Management: Steuerung und Koordination von Paid-Social-Kampagnen, insbesondere für Meta und TikTok, inklusive Abstimmung von Assets, Formaten, Timings und Anforderungen mit Creative- und Media-Teams.
  • Creator & Influencer Management: Koordination von Creator-Kooperationen inklusive Vertragsabstimmung, Honorarverhandlung, Kostenkontrolle und Abrechnung sowie Abstimmung von Briefings, Content-Ideen und Deliverables.
  • Organic Social: Betreuung und Koordination von Redaktions- und Contentplänen sowie grundlegender Umgang mit dem Meta Business Manager und TikTok Business Tools; Verständnis von Social KPIs, Reportings und Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen.
  • Strategische Kundenberatung: Identifikation von Optimierungs- und Entwicklungspotenzialen sowie Beratung zu Kampagnen, digitalen Touchpoints, Social Media und kanalübergreifenden Kommunikationsmaßnahmen.
  • Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Enge Steuerung und Koordination interner und externer Teams, insbesondere aus den Bereichen Creative, Media, Social, Strategy, Production und weiteren Spezialdisziplinen.



Fertigkeiten / Anforderungen


  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Account Management, idealerweise in einer Digital-, Creative- oder Integrated Agency.
  • Sehr gute Fähigkeiten in der Betreuung von Kund*innen und im Stakeholder-Management, auch bei komplexen Projekten mit mehreren beteiligten Disziplinen.
  • Ausgeprägte Projektmanagement-Kompetenz und Erfahrung in der parallelen Steuerung mehrerer Kampagnen und Workstreams.
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis sowie Erfahrung mit Budgets, Kalkulationen, Kostenvoranschlägen und Abrechnungsprozessen.
  • Gutes Verständnis digitaler Media- und Produktionsprozesse, insbesondere in den Bereichen Display, Paid Social und Organic Social.
  • Praktische Kenntnisse der Anforderungen und Prozesse von Meta und TikTok sowie ein solides Verständnis relevanter Social-Media-KPIs.
  • Erfahrung im Creator-/Influencer-Management, idealerweise einschließlich Vertrags-, Honorar- und Content-Abstimmungen.
  • Fähigkeit, Produktionspläne, Media Specs und technische Anforderungen zu verstehen und zwischen Kund*innen, Media-, Creative- und Production-Teams zu übersetzen.
  • Hohe Beratungs-, Kommunikations- und Präsentationskompetenz sowie souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Kund*innen.
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitäts- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Job Description:

Architect the Future of Omnichannel Commerce


Are you a seasoned solutions architect who thrives at the intersection of business strategy, enterprise architecture, and cutting-edge order management technology? We're looking for a Lead Solutions Architect to drive the design and delivery of large-scale omnichannel commerce solutions that power exceptional customer experiences across digital, retail, marketplace, and B2B channels.

In this highly visible leadership role, you'll partner with clients, executives, and delivery teams to architect enterprise Order Management System (OMS) solutions, shape technical strategy, and lead complex digital transformation initiatives from concept through production.

What You'll Do

Lead Enterprise Architecture

  • Own end-to-end OMS solution architecture, integrations, data flows, and technical roadmap development.
  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable, resilient enterprise solutions.
  • Conduct client workshops and guide stakeholders through architecture decisions, tradeoffs, and implementation strategies.

Drive Omnichannel Innovation

  • Design and optimize order orchestration, inventory visibility, fulfillment, returns, and customer service processes.
  • Architect solutions supporting BOPIS, ship-from-store, ship-to-store, marketplace fulfillment, drop ship, and multi-node fulfillment models.
  • Build scalable solutions that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

Lead Technical Delivery

  • Provide architectural leadership throughout the full software development lifecycle.
  • Mentor engineering teams, lead design reviews, and establish technical standards and best practices.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure performance, reliability, security, and production readiness.

Act as a Trusted Client Advisor

  • Present complex technical concepts to executive audiences with clarity and confidence.
  • Support solution proposals, estimations, and strategic client engagements.
  • Influence enterprise technology decisions that shape long-term business success.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 18+ years of experience in enterprise application development and solution delivery.
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience with IBM Sterling OMS or comparable enterprise OMS platforms.
  • 5+ years of architecture leadership experience delivering large-scale enterprise programs.
  • Proven success leading at least two enterprise OMS implementations through production launch.
  • Strong expertise in Java, REST APIs, XML, JSON, SQL, integrations, and distributed systems.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with IBM Sterling Intelligent Promising, Inventory Visibility, Order Hub, Store Engagement, or Call Center.
  • Integration experience with SAP, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Shopify, or other enterprise commerce platforms.
  • Experience with cloud modernization, SaaS migrations, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Architecture certifications, IBM Sterling credentials, or contributions to technical communities.

You'll Be Successful If You Are...

✅ A strategic thinker who can connect business goals to technical solutions.
✅ A confident client-facing leader with executive presence.
✅ A hands-on architect who enjoys solving complex systems challenges.
✅ A mentor who develops talent and elevates engineering teams.
✅ Passionate about transforming commerce and supply chain experiences at enterprise scale.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to lead some of the most complex commerce and fulfillment transformations in the industry, working alongside talented teams and influential stakeholders to build solutions that impact millions of customers. If you're ready to shape enterprise architecture, drive innovation, and become a trusted advisor to some of the world's leading brands, we'd love to hear from you.

job.description:
Job Description:

We're looking for a Senior Strategist, Social Marketing & Strategy to join our team. In this role, you'll report to the Group Director, Social Marketing & Strategy and serve as the strategic lead for a leading outdoor-focused CPG snack brand. This is a highly visible opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of social strategy, content planning, creative development, and client leadership. 

 

As the primary strategic contact for the business, you'll help shape how content moves across owned, earned, and paid channels while partnering closely with clients, creative teams, media partners, and agency stakeholders. You'll act as both a strategic storyteller and content curator, ensuring every piece of content reaches the right audience in the right place. 

 

What You'll Do 

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day strategic contact for the client and build strong relationships across client and agency teams. 
  • Develop social and content strategies that connect business objectives, audience insights, and creative opportunities. 
  • Lead internal and client-facing meetings, presenting recommendations and strategic POVs with confidence. 
  • Partner with creative teams to ensure ideas are rooted in insight and aligned to the overall strategy. 
  • Translate social, cultural, category, and consumer trends into actionable recommendations and creative inspiration. 
  • Create and refine creative briefs, content frameworks, and strategic recommendations.

job.title: Legal Counsel
job.description:
Job Description:

We are looking for an exceptional and experienced commercial lawyer for a role with the dentsu U.S. Legal and Compliance team. The role will focus on dentsu’s media practice in the U.S. The media practice at dentsu provides a diverse range of services to clients to maximize the effectiveness, relevance, and performance of their marketing investment in media. The media practice capabilities help clients manage the ever-increasing complexities of media, data, and customer advocacy and privacy while maximizing business outcomes and drive improved marketing results and competitive advantage. The successful candidate will join a large and vibrant international community of lawyers who provide practical and focused legal advice supporting dentsu as it drives sustainable business growth for our clients. 


We are looking for an individual who is passionate about marketing and will bring energy and enthusiasm to the role. There is plenty of opportunity to develop professional and personal skills, and work alongside senior management as a trusted business advisor. While a background in media is not necessary for the role, a keen interest in learning about all aspects of media marketing, advertising and communication is critical.


Responsibilities of the role include the following:

  • Draft and negotiate a variety of commercial agreements, including services agreements (MSAs and SOWs), media vendor contracts for services like custom content, digital media, OOH, linear and CTV, etc., reseller agreements, data licenses, DPAs, BAAs, SaaS agreements, and other commercial and operational agreements.
  • Analyze comments from opposing counsel and propose solutions. Provide risk assessments.
  • Oversee contract administration and compliance.
  • Review legal contracts for execution by management.
  • Interpret and apply contract terms.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment.
  • Develop training and legal risk management plans for senior management and other partners at different levels.
  • Help implement best-practices in compliance, contract management, intellectual property, and data privacy.

Qualifications

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in commercial transactions, with particular preference for those with experience in marketing, advertising, data, intellectual property, or privacy.
  • Licensed to practice law and in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • Possesses a law degree (e.g., Juris Doctor) from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Knowledge of legal principles in relation to contract law, marketing/advertising law, data, intellectual property, and data privacy.
  • Someone who:
  • has a great sense of humor, a client-service mentality, and the ability to collaborate with colleagues across teams and jurisdictions, as well as with clients who place their trust in dentsu;
  • has a desire to learn more about the wider media, advertising, data, and technology industries;
  • possesses well-developed prioritization skills given the likelihood of dealing with multiple projects and internal clients at any one time;
  • can work autonomously, take initiative and be proactive in addressing new matters or challenges;
  • has a passion for the work they do and the industries in which they work;
  • is confident to communicate clearly on matters that involve senior management attention;
  • has strong commercial and business acumen that allows the individual to efficiently and expeditiously compare the relevant legal risks to the scope of commercial strategy and corporate objectives; and
  • believes in the importance of contributing to social impact, DEI, and pro bono initiatives at dentsu.

job.title: Manager, FP&A
job.description:
Job Description:

The Manager, FP&A will serve as a strategic finance partner across the full spectrum of financial planning and analysis activities for the US CXM portfolio. This role focuses on revenue forecasting, cost management, financial close operations, and commercial P&L analysis across all CXM. They will partner closely with client management, commercial finance partners, and practice leadership to ensure consistency, integrity, and forward-looking clarity in financial projections and reporting. 

Main Responsibilities 

Revenue Forecasting & Analysis: 

  • Lead or support the RF forecast process for the US CXM portfolio, ensuring timely, accurate, and aligned revenue forecasts on a monthly cycle. 
  • Collaborate with client management and commercial finance partners to gather, validate, and refine client billing and revenue forecasts. 
  • Ensure consistency across all revenue streams sourced from Salesforce and supporting systems. 
  • Challenge client billings and revenue forecasts, including phasing and timing, to ensure projections are realistic and aligned with contractual obligations. 
  • Lead discussions with client management and commercial finance teams to refine forecast assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and adjust forecasts accordingly. 
  • Work in partnership with practice management to review client and practice P&Ls, ensuring margin health through constructive review and analysis. 
  • Conduct scenario analyses to evaluate financial impacts of identified risks and opportunities, developing actionable recommendations for leadership. 
  • Maintain data integrity across forecasting systems and ensure revenue recognition aligns with IFRS 15 standards. 

 

Cost Management & Resource Analysis: 

  • Own or support labor and resource cost management across the CXM portfolio, including forecasting, budget tracking, and variance analysis. 
  • Analyze cost structure (payroll, contractor, allocation models) and develop recommendations to optimize cost efficiency and margin health. 
  • Partner with practice management on resource planning and cost allocation to support commercial decision-making. 
  • Ensure cost forecasts align with revenue forecasts and overall business strategy. 

 

Variance Analysis & Financial Control: 

  • Lead or support monthly variance analysis on cost, revenue, and actuals versus forecast and budget, identifying root causes and trends. 
  • Provide insights and recommendations to leadership on financial performance, profitability drivers, and portfolio health. 
  • Ensure cost accruals, allocations, and revenue recognition are accurate and timely. 

 

Month-End Close & Operations: 

  • Coordinate and support month-end close processes, ensuring timely cost accruals, P&L accuracy, and compliance. 
  • Work with RRA and finance teams to align on cost allocation, revenue recognition, and overall close integrity. 
  • Address discrepancies proactively to ensure accurate reporting across practice areas. 

 

Strategic Business Partnering & Insights: 

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to revenue and operations leadership, clearly communicating financial performance, trends, risks, and opportunities across the CXM portfolio. 
  • Provide forward-looking commentary and insights to support strategic planning and decision-making at the client and portfolio level. 
  • Develop and present actionable recommendations to senior leadership on growth opportunities, cost optimization, profitability, and portfolio strategy. 

 

Process Optimization & Systems: 

  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency and accuracy of forecasting, close, and cost management processes. 
  • Support systems integration work (Workfront/D365) to improve data flow, reduce manual effort, and enhance forecast reliability. 
  • Collaborate with FP&A and finance operations on continuous improvement initiatives and best practice implementation. 

 

Candidate Qualifications 

Academics / Work Experience: 

  • Bachelor degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred. 
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, forecasting, reporting, and/or cost management. 
  • 2+ years in a managerial or senior analytical role. 
  • Agency or professional services experience strongly preferred; demonstrates understanding of client-facing P&L management and commercial finance. 

 

Technical Competencies: 

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas, scenario modelling, multi-tab workbooks). 
  • Proficiency in Financial Reporting visualization. 
  • Experience with Salesforce, D365, Workfront, or similar enterprise and forecasting systems. 
  • Knowledge of labor cost management, resource allocation modelling, and revenue forecasting methodologies. 
  • Comfort with Power BI, Tableau, or other analytics platforms. 
  • Proficiency in SharePoint and collaborative financial tools. 
  • Proficiency in AI tools preferred. 

 

Key Attributes: 

  • Strong analytical mindset with strategic thinking; able to synthesize data into actionable recommendations. 
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable engaging with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. 
  • Detail-oriented with exceptional organizational skills to manage complex data sets, multiple concurrent projects, and tight deadlines. 
  • Proactive problem-solver with appetite for process improvement and fresh perspectives. 
  • Collaborative and flexible; able to work effectively in a lean, dynamic team environment and adapt quickly to shifting portfolio priorities. 
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of defining work scope and prioritization independently. 

 

Career Horizons 

  • Growth into Senior Manager or Director roles overseeing broader FP&A, commercial finance, or operations responsibilities. 
  • Opportunities to specialize in specific functional areas (revenue forecasting, cost management, process optimization) and lead those disciplines. 
  • Opportunities to lead cross-regional or global initiatives within the dentsu organization. 
  • Transition to strategic finance roles supporting regional P&L leadership or practice-level business transformation. 

The annual base salary range for this position is ($94,000 - $132,000). Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.
